venues/AAAI/2025/cold_start_rec/bayescns.title: Recommendation Is a Dish Better Served Warm

venues/AAAI/2025/cold_start_rec/bayescns.title: Online Item Cold-Start Recommendation with Popularity-Aware Meta-Learning

venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/active_large_la.title: Do LLMs Memorize Recommendation Datasets? A Preliminary Study on MovieLens-1M
venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/active_large_la.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用少样本提示探测 GPT/Llama 对 MovieLens-1M 的物品、用户与交互记忆覆盖率，揭示记忆量与推荐性能强相关且放大流行度偏置。

venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/bridging_the_us.title: LLM2Rec: Large Language Models Are Powerful Embedding Models for Sequential Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/bridging_the_us.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 两阶段将 LLM 改造为融合协同信号与语义的物品嵌入模型，Full-Ranking 下域内平均提升约 15%、跨域仍稳定增益。

venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/bridging_the_us.title: Unleashing the Power of Large Language Model for Denoising Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/bridging_the_us.description: [WWW 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] LLaRD 用 LLM 生成偏好知识与图 CoT 关系知识，再以信息瓶颈对齐去噪图，Full-Ranking 下 Recall@20 最高提升约 14%。

venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/bridging_the_us.title: EAGER-LLM: Enhancing Large Language Models as Recommenders through Exogenous Behavior-Semantic Integration
venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/bridging_the_us.description: [WWW 2025][大语言模型推荐] 以双源知识富集物品索引+非侵入多尺度对齐重建+退火适配器，将外源行为/语义信号注入 LLM 生成式推荐，Amazon 三数据集 Full-Ranking 下 Recall@10 最高提升 26.16%。

venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/bridging_the_us.title: Knowledge Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation for LLM-based Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/bridging_the_us.description: [ACL 2025][LLM4Rec] 用跳场知识子图索引+流行度选择性检索+GNN软提示，将KG结构知识注入冻结LLM，MovieLens-1M ACC 相对提升58.6%且推理仅慢0.14s

venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/bridging_the_us.title: From IDs to Semantics: A Generative Framework for Cross-Domain Recommendation with Adaptive Semantic Tokenization
venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/bridging_the_us.description: [AAAI 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 用领域自适应语义ID分词+对称动态路由的生成式跨域推荐框架，Leave-Last-Out全库排序下全面超越SOTA。

venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/coherency_impro.title: Enhancing Recommendation Explanations through User-Centric Refinement
venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/coherency_impro.description: [ACL 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出 RefineX 多智能体推理期精炼框架，以 plan-then-refine 与分层反思将 PETER 解释在事实性/个性化/连贯性三维度大幅提升。

venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/coherency_impro.title: The Utility of LLMs in Recommender Systems Explanation Evaluation
venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/coherency_impro.description: [RecSys 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 系统评测 14 个 LLM 作为推荐解释评审员与 216 名人类评分的一致性，发现排序相关中等但绝对评分一致性低，并给出四条实用准则。

venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/coherency_impro.title: Disentangling Likes and Dislikes in Personalized Generative Explainable Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/coherency_impro.description: [WWW 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用 LLM 重构正负观点分离的可解释推荐数据集，提出情感匹配与正负内容相似度指标，并证明将预测评分作为输入可显著提升情感感知解释生成。

venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/coherency_impro.title: Curr-RLCER: Curriculum Reinforcement Learning For Coherence Explainable Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/coherency_impro.description: [DASFAA 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用三阶段课程强化学习（CTR→评分→解释生成）训练 LLM，并设计一致性奖励与评估方案，使解释与评分双向对齐。

venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/coherency_impro.title: Explainable CTR Prediction via LLM Reasoning
venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/coherency_impro.description: [WSDM 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用 PPO 双奖励（LC 用户意图对齐 + IC 与 ID-CTR 模型对齐）把 LLM 解释生成嵌入 CTR 流程，免解释数据集，AUC 最高提升 18.2%。

venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/harnessing_mult.title: Multimodal Large Language Models with Adaptive Preference Optimization for Sequential Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/harnessing_mult.description: [SIGIR 2026][LLM4Rec] 面向 MLLM 序列推荐，用难度感知重加权 DPO + 高斯噪声正则分布优化，缓解样本难度失衡与跨模态语义偏差，三数据集 NDCG@3 提升 7.4%–11.0%。

venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/harnessing_mult.title: NoteLLM-2: Multimodal Large Representation Models for Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/harnessing_mult.description: [KDD 2025][多模态推荐] 端到端微调 LLM+视觉编码器构建高效 MLRM，用 mICL 与门控后期融合缓解视觉忽视，I2I 全库召回 R@100 显著提升并落地线上 A/B。

venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/harnessing_mult.title: CAMMSR: Category-Guided Attentive Mixture of Experts for Multimodal Sequential Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/harnessing_mult.description: [ICDE 2026][多模态推荐] 用类别预测任务引导注意力 MoE 动态分配模态权重，并以模态交换对比学习对齐跨模态序列表征，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@5 最高提升 15.3%。

venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/harnessing_mult.title: Do Recommender Systems Really Leverage Multimodal Content? A Comprehensive Analysis on Multimodal Representations for Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/harnessing_mult.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 用受控噪声实验证明多模态增益源于语义而非模型容量，并以 LVLM 结构化提示生成「原生多模态」[EOS] 嵌入替代晚期融合，Borda 聚合排名第一。

venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/harnessing_mult.title: MLLMRec: A Preference Reasoning Paradigm with Graph Refinement for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/harnessing_mult.description: [SIGIR 2026][多模态推荐] 用 MLLM 推理用户偏好画像替代噪声聚合初始化，并以阈值去噪+共现增强精修物品图，三数据集 11/12 指标 SOTA。

venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/predicting_user.title: Simulating Before Planning: Constructing Intrinsic User World Model for User-Tailored Dialogue Policy Planning
venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/predicting_user.description: [SIGIR 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用扩散模型刻画用户画像、布朗桥预判用户反馈，构建内在用户世界模型以定制对话策略，P4G/ESConv 上 SR 显著提升。

venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/predicting_user.title: HORIZON: A Benchmark for In-the-wild User Behaviour Modeling
venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/predicting_user.description: [ACL 2026 Findings][跨域与多场景推荐] 重构 Amazon Reviews 为 54M 用户跨域长程基准，提出时间-用户双轴四象限评估与 LLM 查询改写/长程建模任务，揭示 ID 模型在时间外推下崩塌。

venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/predicting_user.title: Generative Spatiotemporal Intent Sequence Recommendation via Implicit Reasoning in Amap
venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/predicting_user.description: [RecSys 2026][时空轨迹与POI本地生活推荐] 将LLM显式CoT压缩为隐式潜token并配合时空反事实DPO，在Amap工业数据与线上A/B中实现低延迟意图序列生成。

venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/predicting_user.title: Is More Context Always Better? Examining LLM Reasoning Capability for Time Interval Prediction
venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/predicting_user.description: [WWW 2026][LLM4Rec] 系统评测 GPT-4o/Claude/Gemini 在复购时间间隔预测上的零样本能力，发现 LLM 仅胜统计基线、全面落后 XGBoost，且中等上下文最优、高上下文反降。

venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/predicting_user.title: PERSCEN: Learning Personalized Interaction Pattern and Scenario Preference for Multi-Scenario Matching
venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/predicting_user.description: [KDD 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用用户专属特征图 + VQ 码本蒸馏场景感知偏好 + 渐进式 GLU 融合，在 KuaiRand/Alimama 四场景召回上全面超越 ADIN/SASS/M5。

venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/re2llm_reflecti.title: R4ec: A Reasoning, Reflection, and Refinement Framework for Recommendation Systems
venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/re2llm_reflecti.description: [RecSys 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用 actor/reflection 双小模型迭代反思精炼 LLM 知识，注入 CTR 主干，AUC 相对提升 2.5%+，线上收入 +2.2%。

venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/re2llm_reflecti.title: Balancing Fine-tuning and RAG: A Hybrid Strategy for Dynamic LLM Recommendation Updates
venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/re2llm_reflecti.description: [RecSys 2025][LLM4Rec] 以十亿用户短视频兴趣探索系统为案例，量化对比微调与RAG的更新代价/敏捷性，提出月度微调+周内RAG刷新的混合更新策略，线上A/B显著提升满意度。

venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/re2llm_reflecti.title: EAGER-LLM: Enhancing Large Language Models as Recommenders through Exogenous Behavior-Semantic Integration

venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/re2llm_reflecti.title: ReRec: Reasoning-Augmented LLM-based Recommendation Assistant via Reinforcement Fine-tuning

venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/re2llm_reflecti.title: DELRec: Distilling Sequential Pattern to Enhance LLMs-based Sequential Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2025/llm_rec/re2llm_reflecti.description: [ICDE 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用软提示两阶段蒸馏传统序列模型的时间感知与推荐模式，再微调 LLM 做序列推荐，四数据集 HR/NDCG 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/AAAI/2025/multi_task_reranking/di.title: Efficient Multi-task Prompt Tuning for Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2025/multi_task_reranking/di.description: [TOIS 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 提出两阶段 MPT-Rec：GAN 解耦任务共享/特有信息后冻结主干，仅用任务感知 Prompt 微调新任务，参数降至 10% 且性能保持 95%+。

venues/AAAI/2025/multi_task_reranking/di.title: Towards Personalized Federated Multi-Scenario Multi-Task Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2025/multi_task_reranking/di.description: [WSDM 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 首个联邦多场景多任务推荐框架 PF-MSMTrec，通过专家参数解耦、联邦批归一化与冲突协调缓解数据/模型/任务三级冲突，AliExpress 与 Tenrec 上 CTR/CTCVR AUC 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/AAAI/2025/multi_task_reranking/di.title: Personalized Task Dependency Graphs for Mitigating Signal Erosion in Multi-Task Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2025/multi_task_reranking/di.description: [CIKM 2026][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用低秩个性化任务依赖图+硬因果掩码GCN替代刚性漏斗，缓解深层稀疏任务信号侵蚀，离线AUC最高+1.45%，线上CVR+1.2%。

venues/AAAI/2025/multi_task_reranking/di.title: MPFormer: Adaptive Framework for Industrial Multi-Task Personalized Sequential Retriever
venues/AAAI/2025/multi_task_reranking/di.description: [CIKM 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用目标条件化 Transformer 统一多目标召回，并以排序分数监督动态配额分配，在快手 4 亿 DAU 上实现 +0.43% 总时长与 66.7% 推理资源节省。

venues/AAAI/2025/multi_task_reranking/di.title: Mosaic: A Fleet of User Embedding Specialists for Recommendation at Meta
venues/AAAI/2025/multi_task_reranking/di.description: [RecSys 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 以四类异构专家模型族构建用户表征舰队，配合 MRM 与余弦冗余损失最大化增量信息，并提出免日志 CoEval 评估，离线 NE 稳定下降、线上 A/B 显著提升。

venues/AAAI/2025/multimodal_rec/befa_a_g.title: A Content-Driven Micro-Video Recommendation Dataset at Scale
venues/AAAI/2025/multimodal_rec/befa_a_g.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 发布十亿级含原始视频模态的微视频推荐数据集 MicroLens，并系统基准 IDRec/VIDRec/VideoRec 三类范式，揭示端到端视频编码优于冻结特征的关键结论。

venues/AAAI/2025/multimodal_rec/befa_a_g.title: Efficient Multimodal Streaming Recommendation via Expandable Side Mixture-of-Experts
venues/AAAI/2025/multimodal_rec/befa_a_g.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 冻结 BERT/ViT 主干，用可扩展侧调 MoE 增量吸收新时段知识并按利用率剪枝，在三个流式数据集上 HR@10 全面超越 SOTA 且显存/训练时间更省。

venues/AAAI/2025/multimodal_rec/befa_a_g.description: [SIGIR 2025][多模态推荐] 将短视频切分为5秒片段，用CLIP视觉+ID双模态跨注意力建模片段级动态兴趣，以段内排序损失解决标签缺失，在跳看预测与视频推荐两任务上大幅超越基线。

venues/AAAI/2025/multimodal_rec/beyond_g.title: MLLMRec: A Preference Reasoning Paradigm with Graph Refinement for Multimodal Recommendation

venues/AAAI/2025/multimodal_rec/beyond_g.title: Hypercomplex Prompt-aware Multimodal Recommendation

venues/AAAI/2025/multimodal_rec/exploiti.title: Mend the Measurement Gap: Latent User Preference Modeling for Short-Form Video Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2025/multimodal_rec/exploiti.description: [RecSys 2026][多模态推荐] 将异构行为反馈视为隐价值状态的噪声测量，用受限基线+因子化路由瓶颈解耦时长混杂，YouTube Shorts 线上主指标提升 2.67%

venues/AAAI/2025/multimodal_rec/mentor_m.description: [SIGIR 2025][多模态推荐] 用行为模态早期精炼+晚期注意力融合的双阶段融合，配合异质/同质复合图与自适应BPR，在三个 Amazon 数据集上 R@20 相对提升 4.4%–6.1%。

venues/AAAI/2025/multimodal_rec/mentor_m.description: [CIKM 2026][多模态推荐] 以互信息/条件熵分解为理论视角，用行为校准图精炼+兴趣对比+共享子空间选择性对齐，三数据集 Full-Ranking 全面 SOTA。

venues/AAAI/2025/multimodal_rec/mentor_m.title: Hypercomplex Prompt-aware Multimodal Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2025/multimodal_rec/mentor_m.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 用 Cayley-Dickson 超复数多分量嵌入 + 超复数乘法非线性融合 + Prompt 动态补偿，在四个 Amazon 数据集 Full-Ranking 下 Recall@20 最高提升约 13%。

venues/AAAI/2025/multimodal_rec/mentor_m.title: Beyond Graph Convolution: Multimodal Recommendation with Topology-aware MLPs
venues/AAAI/2025/multimodal_rec/mentor_m.description: [AAAI 2025][多模态推荐] 用拓扑剪枝+邻域对齐损失替代GCN消息传递，以MLP建模多模态物品关系，全库排序下Recall@10最高提升7.53%

venues/AAAI/2025/multimodal_rec/mentor_m.title: Modality Alignment with Multi-scale Bilateral Attention for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2025/multimodal_rec/mentor_m.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 提出 MambaRec，用多尺度空洞卷积+双注意力做局部图文对齐、MMD+InfoNCE 做全局分布对齐，Amazon 三数据集 Recall@20 最高提升约 5.4%。

venues/AAAI/2025/multimodal_rec/stair_ma.title: Training-free Graph-based Imputation of Missing Modalities in Multimodal Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2025/multimodal_rec/stair_ma.description: [TKDE 2026][多模态推荐] 将缺失模态重铸为物品-物品共购图上的图特征插值，提出四种免训练传播式填补算子，可即插即用并保持甚至扩大多模态与传统推荐的性能差距。

venues/AAAI/2025/multimodal_rec/stair_ma.title: MLLMRec: A Preference Reasoning Paradigm with Graph Refinement for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2025/multimodal_rec/stair_ma.description: [SIGIR 2026][多模态推荐] 用 MLLM 推理用户偏好画像替代噪声聚合初始化，并以阈值去噪+共现增强精修物品图，三数据集 11/12 指标 SOTA。

venues/AAAI/2025/multimodal_rec/stair_ma.title: Beyond Graph Convolution: Multimodal Recommendation with Topology-aware MLPs
venues/AAAI/2025/multimodal_rec/stair_ma.description: [AAAI 2025][多模态推荐] 用拓扑剪枝+邻域对齐损失替代GCN消息传递，以MLP建模多模态物品关系，全库排序下Recall@10最高提升7.53%

venues/AAAI/2025/multimodal_rec/stair_ma.title: COHESION: Composite Graph Convolutional Network with Dual-Stage Fusion for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2025/multimodal_rec/stair_ma.description: [SIGIR 2025][多模态推荐] 用行为模态早期精炼+晚期注意力融合的双阶段融合，配合异质/同质复合图与自适应BPR，在三个 Amazon 数据集上 R@20 相对提升 4.4%–6.1%。

venues/AAAI/2025/multimodal_rec/stair_ma.title: One Graph, Multiple Gains: Single High-Quality Item-Item Graph for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2025/multimodal_rec/stair_ma.description: [ACM MM 2026][多模态推荐] 构建一次高质量物品-物品图，经三元闭包重加权后复用于表征、交互图与优化三阶段，四数据集全指标SOTA且训练更快更省显存。

venues/AAAI/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/.title: SEP-GCN: Leveraging Similar Edge Pairs with Temporal and Spatial Contexts for Location-Based Recommender Systems
venues/AAAI/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/.description: [SIGIR-ICTIR 2025][时空轨迹与POI推荐] 以时空相似交互边对构建边级相似图并注入LightGCN传播，在NYC/Gowalla/Brightkite全库排序上Recall@20最高提升14.89%。

venues/AAAI/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/.title: From Time and Place to Preference: LLM-Driven Geo-Temporal Context in Recommendations
venues/AAAI/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用 LLM 从时间戳+粗粒度位置生成地理-时间上下文嵌入，以特征融合或辅助对齐损失注入 SASRec，并提出轻量信息量诊断测试。

venues/AAAI/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/.title: Decoupled Temporal Encoding for Generative Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/.description: [CIKM 2026][生成式推荐] 将宏观时间动态与微观序列顺序解耦的双模块位置编码，工业数据集 GAUC +1.16pt，线上 CTR +1.8%、RPM +3.0%，延迟仅 +0.3%。

venues/AAAI/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/.title: SPOT-Trip: Dual-Preference Driven Out-of-Town Trip Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/.description: [NeurIPS 2025][时空轨迹与POI推荐] 首次形式化异地行程推荐，用知识图谱静态偏好+Neural ODE动态偏好解耦建模，F1最高提升17.01%。

venues/AAAI/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/.title: Time Matters: Enhancing Sequential Recommendations with Time-Guided Graph Neural ODEs
venues/AAAI/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/.description: [KDD 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用时间引导扩散补全稀疏用户时间图、图神经ODE对齐用户兴趣与物品演化，五数据集Recall@20最高提升46%。

venues/AAAI/2025/rl_bandit_rec/contrasti.title: Semantic Retrieval Augmented Contrastive Learning for Sequential Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2025/rl_bandit_rec/contrasti.description: [NeurIPS 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用 LLM 语义检索构建用户/物品候选池并配可学习样本合成器，替代随机增广与 K-Means 硬规则，全库排序下 HR@20 最高提升 11.82%。

venues/AAAI/2025/rl_bandit_rec/contrasti.title: RecRec: Latent Interests Recursive Reasoning for Sequential Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2025/rl_bandit_rec/contrasti.description: [RecSys 2026][序列与会话推荐] 解耦推理态与预测态、以 R 个潜在兴趣做递归推理的免 RL 序列推荐框架，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@10 最高提升 14.8%。

venues/AAAI/2025/rl_bandit_rec/contrasti.title: RecLM: Recommendation Instruction Tuning
venues/AAAI/2025/rl_bandit_rec/contrasti.description: [ACL 2025][大语言模型推荐] 以两轮协同指令微调+RL画像精炼为LLM注入协同信号，作为即插即用画像增强器在零样本冷启动下带来最高 200%+ 的 Recall 提升。

venues/AAAI/2025/rl_bandit_rec/contrasti.title: Maximum In-Support Return Modeling for Dynamic Recommendation with Language Model Prior
venues/AAAI/2025/rl_bandit_rec/contrasti.description: [CIKM 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 将轨迹拼接从训练期移至动作推理期，用 expectile 回归估计最大在支撑回报并自适应截断历史，配合 LLM 先验初始化 DT，在 5 个离线数据集与 VirtualTB 仿真上全面超越 EDT4Rec。

venues/AAAI/2025/rl_bandit_rec/contrasti.title: Intent-guided Heterogeneous Graph Contrastive Learning for Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2025/rl_bandit_rec/contrasti.description: [TKDE 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 用元路径意图构建双对比学习视图，并以信息瓶颈掩码自编码器去噪，六数据集全库排序 Recall@20 最高提升 12.4%。

venues/AAAI/2025/rl_bandit_rec/neural_co.title: Revisiting Clustering of Neural Bandits: Selective Reinitialization for Mitigating Loss of Plasticity
venues/AAAI/2025/rl_bandit_rec/neural_co.description: [KDD 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 针对神经聚类 Bandit 的可塑性丧失问题，提出选择性重初始化框架 SeRe，配合自适应变点检测，在六个推荐数据集上最多降低 12.82% 累积遗憾。

venues/AAAI/2025/rl_bandit_rec/neural_co.title: Optimal and Efficient Contextual Combinatorial Semi-bandits with General Function Approximation
venues/AAAI/2025/rl_bandit_rec/neural_co.description: [NeurIPS 2026][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 提出 SquareCB.Comb，用回归 oracle + 对数障碍边际优化实现通用函数逼近下 CCSB 的极小极大最优 regret，并在网页推荐与最短路任务上验证。

venues/AAAI/2025/rl_bandit_rec/neural_co.title: Exploitation Over Exploration: Unmasking the Bias in Linear Bandit Recommender Offline Evaluation
venues/AAAI/2025/rl_bandit_rec/neural_co.description: [RecSys 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 大规模实证揭示线性 Bandit 离线回放评估系统性偏袒纯利用策略，贪心模型在 89% 数据集上不劣于探索变体。

venues/AAAI/2025/rl_bandit_rec/neural_co.title: Incentivized Exploration with Stochastic Covariates: A Two-Stage Mechanism Design for Recommender System
venues/AAAI/2025/rl_bandit_rec/neural_co.description: [ICML 2026][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 面向在线随机用户协变量的激励相容探索，提出两阶段 RCB 算法（冷启动补贴 + 逆比例间隙采样），在满足 ε-DBIC 约束下达到 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{KdT})$ 遗憾。

venues/AAAI/2025/rl_bandit_rec/neural_co.title: Preference is More Than Comparisons: Rethinking Dueling Bandits with Augmented Human Feedback
venues/AAAI/2025/rl_bandit_rec/neural_co.description: [AAAI 2026][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用增强置信界把相似/依赖观测注入无模型 Dueling Bandit，给出样本复杂度与遗憾权衡，在推荐、多目标优化与 LLM 响应优化上显著降遗憾。

venues/AAAI/2025/sequential_rec/augmenti.title: Tail-Aware Data Augmentation for Long-Tail Sequential Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2025/sequential_rec/augmenti.description: [WWW 2026][冷启动与长尾推荐] 用线性物品相似度构建候选集，设计 T-Substitute/T-Insert 两个尾部感知算子并在表征层 Mixup，实现头部与尾部双赢的长尾序列推荐数据增强。

venues/AAAI/2025/sequential_rec/augmenti.title: MixRec: Individual and Collective Mixing Empowers Data Augmentation for Recommender Systems

venues/AAAI/2025/sequential_rec/augmenti.title: Bridge the Domains: Large Language Models Enhanced Cross-domain Sequential Recommendation

venues/AAAI/2025/sequential_rec/future_s.title: SimDiffRec: Semantic Similarity-Guided Diffusion for Contrastive Sequential Recommendation

venues/AAAI/2025/sequential_rec/future_s.title: Intent-aware Diffusion with Contrastive Learning for Sequential Recommendation

venues/AAAI/2025/sequential_rec/lightwei.title: Rethinking Convolutional Networks for Attribute-Aware Sequential Recommendation

venues/AAAI/2025/sequential_rec/lightwei.title: TV-Rec: Time-Variant Convolutional Filter for Sequential Recommendation

venues/AAAI/2025/sequential_rec/lightwei.title: SGCL: Unifying Self-Supervised and Supervised Learning for Graph Recommendation

venues/AAAI/2025/sequential_rec/lightwei.title: AlphaFree: Recommendation Free from Users, IDs, and GNNs

venues/AAAI/2025/sequential_rec/multifac.title: Personalized Federated Collaborative Filtering: A Variational AutoEncoder Approach

venues/AAAI/2025/sequential_rec/multifac.title: Efficient Sequential Recommendation for Long Term User Interest Via Personalization

venues/AAAI/2025/sequential_rec/multifac.title: A Survey of Personalized Federated Foundation Models for Privacy-Preserving Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2025/sequential_rec/multifac.description: [IJCAI-ECAI 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 综述提出“主动语义保人格”范式，用几何正交约束与语义感知聚合解耦全局知识与用户人格，并给出五类开放问题与未来路线。

venues/AAAI/2025/sequential_rec/prelimin.title: Dual Test-time Training for Out-of-distribution Recommender System

venues/AAAI/2025/sequential_rec/prelimin.title: Exploring Test-time Scaling via Prediction Merging on Large-Scale Recommendation

venues/AAAI/2025/sequential_rec/prelimin.title: ZoRRO: A Zero-Weight Personalized Recommender System for Scalable News Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2025/sequential_rec/prelimin.description: [SIGIR 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 零权重免训练新闻推荐框架，以时间衰减×表征相似度打分，离线全库排序超越 NRMS，线上 CTR 逼近 SOTA 且推理快 600 倍。

venues/AAAI/2025/sequential_rec/prelimin.title: ORBIT: Open Recommendation Benchmark for Reproducible Research with Hidden Tests
venues/AAAI/2025/sequential_rec/prelimin.description: [NeurIPS 2025][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 统一可复现推荐基准，含5个公开数据集标准化划分与ClueWeb-Reco隐私安全网页推荐隐藏测试集，评测12个模型并引入LLM-QueryGen基线。

venues/AAAI/2025/sequential_rec/prelimin.title: Can LLMs Outshine Conventional Recommenders? A Comparative Evaluation
venues/AAAI/2025/sequential_rec/prelimin.description: [NeurIPS 2025 DB Track][大语言模型推荐] RecBench 系统对比 17 个 LLM 与 DLRM 在 4 种物品表征、CTR/SeqRec 双任务上的精度-效率权衡，LLM 精度领先但推理慢千倍。

venues/AAAI/2025/sequential_rec/sigma_se.title: Lost in Sequence: Do Large Language Models Understand Sequential Recommendation?
venues/AAAI/2025/sequential_rec/sigma_se.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 揭示现有 LLM4Rec 模型无法捕捉交互序列顺序信息，提出冻结 LLM 与 CF-SRec、仅训练轻量 MLP 的蒸馏框架 LLM-SRec，在 Amazon 四数据集上 NDCG@10 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/AAAI/2025/sequential_rec/sigma_se.title: GLINT-RU: Gated Lightweight Intelligent Recurrent Units for Sequential Recommender Systems
venues/AAAI/2025/sequential_rec/sigma_se.description: [KDD 2025][序列与会话推荐] 单层并行专家混合（密集选择GRU+线性注意力）+门控MLP的高效序列推荐，Leave-One-Out全库排序下精度与推理速度双超SOTA。

venues/AAAI/2025/sequential_rec/sigma_se.title: Multi-Grained Preference Enhanced Transformer for Multi-Behavior Sequential Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2025/sequential_rec/sigma_se.description: [KDD 2025][序列与会话推荐] M-GPT 用交互级图卷积建模跨类型行为依赖，并以多粒度多尺度注意力抽取行为感知偏好，Leave-One-Out 全库排序下 HR@5 相对提升 12.2%。

venues/AAAI/2025/sequential_rec/sigma_se.title: RoTE: Coarse-to-Fine Multi-Level Rotary Time Embedding for Sequential Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2025/sequential_rec/sigma_se.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 将时间戳分解为年/月/日多粒度并借 RoPE 旋转注入 Q/K，即插即用提升 SASRec/RPG，NDCG@5 最高 +20.11%

venues/AAAI/2025/sequential_rec/sigma_se.title: A Contextual-Aware Position Encoding for Sequential Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2025/sequential_rec/sigma_se.description: [WWW 2025][序列与会话推荐] 首个为序列推荐定制的上下文感知位置编码 CAPE：用目标-上下文不相似度累加动态分配位置，配合门控融合异构特征，在 5 个骨干与工业 A/B 上稳定涨点。

venues/AAAI/2025/social_group_rec/disent.title: MixRec: Heterogeneous Graph Collaborative Filtering
venues/AAAI/2025/social_group_rec/disent.description: [WSDM 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 参数化异质超图解耦多行为意图，配合节点/图级自适应对比学习，Leave-One-Out 全库排序下 HR@10 最高提升 9.8%。

venues/AAAI/2025/social_group_rec/disent.title: Leveraging Member-Group Relations via Multi-View Graph Filtering for Effective Group Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2025/social_group_rec/disent.description: [WWW 2025][社交与群组推荐] 提出免训练多视图图滤波 Group-GF，用三张物品相似图与多项式滤波器聚合成员-群组关系，HR@10 最高提升 16.4% 且运行时间仅 1.55s。

venues/AAAI/2025/social_group_rec/disent.title: MixRec: Individual and Collective Mixing Empowers Data Augmentation for Recommender Systems
venues/AAAI/2025/social_group_rec/disent.description: [WWW 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 用 Beta/Dirichlet 混合在嵌入空间零成本造正负视图，配合双混合对比损失，全库排序下 Recall@20 最高提升 5.05%。

venues/AAAI/2025/social_group_rec/disent.title: Squeeze and Excitation: A Weighted Graph Contrastive Learning for Collaborative Filtering
venues/AAAI/2025/social_group_rec/disent.description: [SIGIR 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 仅扰动末层GCN视图并用SENet动态加权特征，在三个数据集上实现最高24.45%的NDCG@20提升。

venues/AAAI/2025/social_group_rec/disent.title: Community-Aware Social Community Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2025/social_group_rec/disent.description: [CIKM 2025][社交与群组推荐] 提出 CASO，用模块度最大化、社交紧密度聚合与协同编码三路解耦用户表征，并以 HSIC 互斥与 KL 社区检测损失优化，在 6 个真实社交网络上 Full-Ranking 全面超越 9 个基线。

venues/AAAI/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: R4ec: A Reasoning, Reflection, and Refinement Framework for Recommendation Systems
venues/AAAI/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [RecSys 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用 actor/reflection 双小模型迭代反思精炼 LLM 知识，注入 CTR 主干，AUC 相对提升 2.5%+，线上收入 +2.2%。

venues/AAAI/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: Inverse Theory of Mind Modeling for Content Recommendation: From Web Browsing to Dynamic Intelligent Interfaces
venues/AAAI/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [RecSys 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用 LLM 从浏览轨迹反向推断信念并合成多假设人格画像，在 OPeRA 上超越真实人格基线并驱动 VisionOS 空间界面。

venues/AAAI/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: ThinkRec: Thinking-based Recommendation via LLM
venues/AAAI/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [WWW 2026][大语言模型推荐] 以合成推理链激活 LLM 的 System 2 思维，并用实例级 LoRA 专家融合适配异构用户，AUC 平均提升 7.96%。

venues/AAAI/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: RecUserSim: A Realistic and Diverse User Simulator for Evaluating Conversational Recommender Systems
venues/AAAI/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [WWW 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出四模块 LLM Agent 用户模拟器，以有限理性三层 Rating-Action-Response 机制实现真实角色扮演、多样人群覆盖与显式打分，并落地华为 Celia 餐饮助手。

venues/AAAI/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: Think before Recommendation: Autonomous Reasoning-enhanced Recommender
venues/AAAI/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [NeurIPS 2025][LLM4Rec] 用纯 GRPO 强化学习替代教师蒸馏，让单个 LLM 自主习得「用户分析→物品分析→匹配→打分」推理链，评分预测 MAE 最高降 29.9%。

venues/AAAI/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: Dual-Diffusional Generative Fashion Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 双分支扩散 Transformer 联合生成时尚单品图像与属性级文本，以结构化偏好加权采样建模用户，PFITB/GOR 双任务个性化指标显著领先且训练提速约 7 倍。

venues/AAAI/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: LaViC: Adapting Large Vision-Language Models to Visually-Aware Conversational Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [KDD 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用视觉知识自蒸馏把商品图压成5个[CLS] token，再做推荐提示微调，在新建Reddit-Amazon三域上HR@1最高提升54.2%。

venues/AAAI/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: Personalised Outfit Recommendation via History-aware Transformers
venues/AAAI/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [WSDM 2025][序列与会话推荐] 双层 Transformer 堆叠建模套装内部兼容性与用户购买史，配合监督对比与自适应间隔损失实现个性化套装打分，CP-Hard AUC 提升 15.7%/19.4%。

venues/AAAI/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: Bootstrapping Conversational Recommendation Agents At Spotify: Synthetic Data Generation and Self-Improvement Loops
venues/AAAI/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [RecSys 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用多轮合成对话+方差归因自改进循环冷启动对话推荐智能体，线上A/B提升14%收听与5%周活。

venues/AAAI/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: FUSE: Failure-aware Usage of Subagent Evidence for MultiModal Search and Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [ICDM 2025][多模态推荐] 用紧凑 GDR 替代原始图像提示，系统对比 7 种上下文预算策略并以五阶段归因层定位失败，Context Compression 在意图/路由/召回/NDCG@5 全面最优且 p95 延迟降 45%。

venues/AAAI/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: A Content-Driven Micro-Video Recommendation Dataset at Scale
venues/AAAI/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 发布十亿级含原始视频模态的微视频推荐数据集 MicroLens，并系统基准 IDRec/VIDRec/VideoRec 三类范式，揭示端到端视频编码优于冻结特征的关键结论。

venues/AAAI/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: Short Video Segment-level User Dynamic Interests Modeling in Personalized Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [SIGIR 2025][多模态推荐] 将短视频切分为5秒片段，用CLIP视觉+ID双模态跨注意力建模片段级动态兴趣，以段内排序损失解决标签缺失，在跳看预测与视频推荐两任务上大幅超越基线。

venues/AAAI/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: Controllable and Content-Based Recommendations
venues/AAAI/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [NeurIPS 2026][多模态推荐] 用多模态 LLM 将图像/音频/视频条目转述为文本画像，经标签监督与 InfoNCE 对齐冻结 CF 骨干，实现可读可编辑的文本瓶颈控制。

venues/AAAI/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: Mend the Measurement Gap: Latent User Preference Modeling for Short-Form Video Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [RecSys 2026][多模态推荐] 将异构行为反馈视为隐价值状态的噪声测量，用受限基线+因子化路由瓶颈解耦时长混杂，YouTube Shorts 线上主指标提升 2.67%

venues/AAAI/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: Leveraging Watch-time Feedback for Short-Video Recommendations: A Causal Labeling Framework
venues/AAAI/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [CIKM 2023][去偏公平与工业架构] 用分位数把观看时长转成 WPR 与二值标签，并在标注阶段按视频时长分组做因果去偏，离线全指标最优、线上观看时长 +2.23%。

venues/AAAI/2026/cold_start_rec/motorec_.title: Empowering Large Language Model for Sequential Recommendation via Multimodal Embeddings and Semantic IDs
venues/AAAI/2026/cold_start_rec/motorec_.description: [CIKM 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 揭示 LLM4SR 的嵌入坍缩与语义ID灾难性遗忘，用多模态嵌入+MMD重建+码本初始化破局，全库排序下 nDCG@5 提升 4.4%–10.5%。

venues/AAAI/2026/cold_start_rec/motorec_.title: Learning Decomposed Contextual Token Representations from Pretrained and Collaborative Signals for Generative Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2026/cold_start_rec/motorec_.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] DECOR 用冻结码本+可学协同嵌入分解融合、上下文 token 组合与可学 BOS 查询，缓解静态分词歧义与预训练语义丢失，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@10 最高提升 14%。

venues/AAAI/2026/cold_start_rec/motorec_.title: Hi-SAM: A Hierarchical Structure-Aware Multi-modal Framework for Large-Scale Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2026/cold_start_rec/motorec_.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 解耦语义分词器+分层记忆锚点Transformer，修复语义ID推荐中分词冗余与扁平架构失配，工业A/B响应率+6.55%

venues/AAAI/2026/cold_start_rec/motorec_.title: Well Begun is Half Done: Training-Free and Model-Agnostic Semantically Guaranteed User Representation Initialization for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2026/cold_start_rec/motorec_.description: [SIGIR 2026][多模态推荐] 用交互物品模态特征+聚类全局语义免训练初始化用户表征，弥合用户-物品语义鸿沟，六模型四数据集Recall@5最高提升36.4%。

venues/AAAI/2026/cold_start_rec/motorec_.title: Behavior Tokens Speak Louder: Disentangled Explainable Recommendation with Behavior Vocabulary
venues/AAAI/2026/cold_start_rec/motorec_.description: [AAAI 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用VQ-VAE将用户/物品行为离散化为宏观兴趣+微观意图的行为词表，经多级文本监督与语义对齐正则注入冻结LLM，零样本解释推荐SOTA

venues/AAAI/2026/collaborative_filtering.title: GREAT: Guiding Query Generation with a Trie for Recommending Related Search about Video at Kuaishou
venues/AAAI/2026/collaborative_filtering.description: [KDD 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义 ID] 用高质量查询构建 Trie 约束 LLM 训练与解码，实现短视频到查询的 I2Q 推荐，离线 Edit@1 最优、线上 CTR 与相关性双升。

venues/AAAI/2026/collaborative_filtering.title: HCMRM: A High-Consistency Multimodal Relevance Model for Search Ads
venues/AAAI/2026/collaborative_filtering.description: [WWW 2025][多模态推荐] 用视频关键词切分合成伪查询做三元组预训练，并以对称层次 Softmax 对齐四档相关性标签，快手搜索广告线上无关广告率降 6.1%、收入增 1.4%。

venues/AAAI/2026/collaborative_filtering.title: When & How to Write for Personalized Demand-aware Query Rewriting in Video Search
venues/AAAI/2026/collaborative_filtering.description: [SIGIR 2026][大语言模型推荐] 用后验行为挖掘「何时改写」样本、SFT+GRPO 对齐检索索引风格，并以并行轻量召回实现零感知延迟的个性化查询改写。

venues/AAAI/2026/collaborative_filtering.title: LLM-Based User Personas for Recommendations at Scale
venues/AAAI/2026/collaborative_filtering.description: [RecSys 2026][大语言模型推荐] 工业级实时生成自然语言用户兴趣画像，蒸馏+异步推理支撑十亿用户在线服务，A/B 测试观看时长 +0.04%

venues/AAAI/2026/collaborative_filtering.title: VK-LSVD: A Large-Scale Industrial Dataset for Short-Video Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2026/collaborative_filtering.description: [WWW 2026][序列与会话推荐] 发布 407 亿交互、千万用户、两千万短视频的工业级开放数据集，配全局时间切分与冷启动竞赛基准。

venues/AAAI/2026/collaborative_filtering.title: Recommendations with Sparse Comparison Data: Provably Fast Convergence for Nonconvex Matrix Factorization
venues/AAAI/2026/collaborative_filtering.description: [ICML 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 将成对比较反馈建模为低秩矩阵分解下的离散选择似然，证明稀疏数据下投影梯度下降在热启动邻域内指数收敛，样本复杂度近最优。

venues/AAAI/2026/collaborative_filtering.title: Does Weighting Improve Matrix Factorization for Recommender Systems?
venues/AAAI/2026/collaborative_filtering.description: [WWW 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 系统实证加权隐式反馈矩阵分解：大秩模型下不加权常持平或更优，并给出加权目标闭式解与预条件共轭梯度高效求解。

venues/AAAI/2026/collaborative_filtering.title: Personalized Denoising Implicit Feedback for Robust Recommender System
venues/AAAI/2026/collaborative_filtering.description: [WWW 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 揭示全局损失分布中正常/噪声交互严重重叠，提出基于用户个人损失分布的重采样去噪 PLD，BPR 下 Recall@20 最高提升 7.36%。

venues/AAAI/2026/collaborative_filtering.title: Generalizing Linear Autoencoder Recommenders with Decoupled Expected Quadratic Loss
venues/AAAI/2026/collaborative_filtering.description: [ICLR 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 将 EDLAE 目标推广为 DEQL，首次给出 b>0 闭式解并用 Miller 矩阵逆定理把复杂度从 O(n^4) 降到 O(n^3)，在 9 个基准上稳定超越 b=0 基线。

venues/AAAI/2026/collaborative_filtering.title: Incentivized Exploration with Stochastic Covariates: A Two-Stage Mechanism Design for Recommender System
venues/AAAI/2026/collaborative_filtering.description: [ICML 2026][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 面向在线随机用户协变量的激励相容探索，提出两阶段 RCB 算法（冷启动补贴 + 逆比例间隙采样），在满足 ε-DBIC 约束下达到 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{KdT})$ 遗憾。

venues/AAAI/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Empowering Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation with Hybrid Tokenization and Serial-Parallel Decoding
venues/AAAI/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [RecSys 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义 ID] 跨域共享-专属多塔 RQ-VAE 混合分词 + 两段式串并解码，Leave-One-Out 全库排序下精度 +1.5%、时延 -85.1%。

venues/AAAI/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: FeDecider: An LLM-Based Framework for Federated Cross-Domain Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [WWW 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 联邦跨域 LLM 推荐中，服务器只广播 LoRA 更新的方向分量以消除尺度噪声，客户端用可学习个性化权重做数据感知融合，Goodreads 平均 Hit@5 提升 3.8%。

venues/AAAI/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: ABXI: Invariant Interest Adaptation for Task-Guided Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [WWW 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用任务引导对齐消除预测错配，并以 dLoRA/iLoRA 双 LoRA 抽取域不变兴趣，三数据集 MRR 大幅超越 CDSR 基线。

venues/AAAI/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Bridge the Domains: Large Language Models Enhanced Cross-domain Sequential Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [SIGIR 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用 LLM 语义嵌入+分层画像桥接跨域物品与用户偏好，破解重叠困境与转移复杂性，三数据集 H@10 最高提升 31.7%。

venues/AAAI/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: A Dual-Expert Strategy Integrating LLMs to Mitigate Negative Transfer in Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [CIKM 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 用域门控双专家+物品级注意力掩码+双池负采样对比学习，抑制 LLM 跨域序列推荐中的负迁移，10 域上超越 26 个基线，线上 CTR 相对提升 47.6%。

venues/AAAI/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Long-Sequence Recommendation Models Need Decoupled Embeddings
venues/AAAI/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [ICLR 2025][序列与会话推荐] 揭示长序列推荐中注意力与表征共享嵌入导致的梯度支配与冲突，提出双嵌入表 DARE，AUC 最高提升 9‰ 并加速检索 50%。

venues/AAAI/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.title: STAR-Rec: Making Peace with Length Variance and Pattern Diversity in Sequential Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [SIGIR 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用偏好感知注意力与 SSM 双路径自适应融合 + 序列级 MoE，统一建模长度方差与行为模式多样性，Leave-One-Out 全库排序下 Recall@10 最高提升 2.15%。

venues/AAAI/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.title: BlossomRec: Block-level Fused Sparse Attention Mechanism for Sequential Recommendations
venues/AAAI/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [WWW 2026][序列与会话推荐] 双路块级稀疏注意力（LTIS 块选择 + STIS 幂律掩码）经门控融合，长序列训练提速 3.2×、显存降至 1/11，精度持平或超越 SASRec。

venues/AAAI/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Unleashing the Potential of Sparse Attention on Long-term Behaviors for CTR Prediction

venues/AAAI/2026/generative_rec/modeling.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 双分支扩散 Transformer 联合生成时尚单品图像与属性级文本，以结构化偏好加权采样建模用户，PFITB/GOR 双任务个性化指标显著领先且训练提速约 7 倍。

venues/AAAI/2026/generative_rec/multi_as.title: Universal Item Tokenization for Transferable Generative Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2026/generative_rec/multi_as.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用 MLLM+树状码本构建跨域通用物品分词器，结合内容重建与共现协同对齐，实现可迁移生成式推荐，全库排序下全面超越基线。

venues/AAAI/2026/generative_rec/multi_as.title: Progressive Semantic Residual Quantization for Multimodal-Joint Interest Modeling in Music Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2026/generative_rec/multi_as.description: [CIKM 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 提出前缀语义约束的渐进残差量化 PSRQ 与多码本交叉注意力 MCCA，缓解语义漂移与跨模态建模缺口，冷启动 AUC 显著提升并完成工业上线。

venues/AAAI/2026/generative_rec/multi_as.title: CARD: Non-Uniform Quantization of Visual Semantic Unit for Generative Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2026/generative_rec/multi_as.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 将文本/图像/协同信号渲染为统一视觉语义单元，并用可逆非均匀变换校正偏斜分布，提升码本利用率与生成式推荐精度。

venues/AAAI/2026/generative_rec/multi_as.title: Hi-SAM: A Hierarchical Structure-Aware Multi-modal Framework for Large-Scale Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2026/generative_rec/multi_as.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 解耦语义分词器+分层记忆锚点Transformer，修复语义ID推荐中分词冗余与扁平架构失配，工业A/B响应率+6.55%

venues/AAAI/2026/generative_rec/multi_as.title: SynGR: Unleashing the Potential of Cross-Modal Synergy for Generative Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2026/generative_rec/multi_as.description: [ICML 2026][生成式推荐] 用 PID 信息分解揭示多模态生成式推荐的协同信息缺失，提出显著性感知掩码+协同对比学习，Full-Ranking 下平均提升约 10%

venues/AAAI/2026/generative_rec/tokenize.title: Universal Item Tokenization for Transferable Generative Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2026/generative_rec/tokenize.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用 MLLM+树状码本构建跨域通用物品分词器，结合内容重建与共现协同对齐，实现可迁移生成式推荐，全库排序下全面超越基线。

venues/AAAI/2026/generative_rec/tokenize.title: From IDs to Semantics: A Generative Framework for Cross-Domain Recommendation with Adaptive Semantic Tokenization
venues/AAAI/2026/generative_rec/tokenize.description: [AAAI 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 用领域自适应语义ID分词+对称动态路由的生成式跨域推荐框架，Leave-Last-Out全库排序下全面超越SOTA。

venues/AAAI/2026/generative_rec/tokenize.title: Improving LLMs for Recommendation with Out-Of-Vocabulary Tokens
venues/AAAI/2026/generative_rec/tokenize.description: [arXiv 2024][LLM4Rec] 用元路径聚类生成 OOV 层级 token 构建用户/物品 META ID，兼顾记忆性与多样性，序列推荐 HR@10 最高提升 30%+。

venues/AAAI/2026/generative_rec/tokenize.title: Generative Recommender with End-to-End Learnable Item Tokenization
venues/AAAI/2026/generative_rec/tokenize.description: [SIGIR 2025][生成式推荐] 提出 ETEGRec 双编码器-解码器框架，用序列-物品对齐与偏好-语义对齐将 RQ-VAE 分词器与 T5 推荐器端到端联合优化，全库排序下 Recall@10 相对 LETTER 提升约 5%。

venues/AAAI/2026/generative_rec/tokenize.title: TokenRec: Learning to Tokenize ID for LLM-based Generative Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2026/generative_rec/tokenize.description: [TKDE 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用掩码K路向量量化把GNN协同表征压成LLM兼容离散token，并以生成式检索替代自回归解码，HR@20平均提升约19%、推理加速超10倍。

venues/AAAI/2026/graph_rec/task_aware_re.title: Modeling Stage-wise Evolution of User Interests for News Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2026/graph_rec/task_aware_re.description: [WWW 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用全局LightGCN+阶段时序子图LSTM/自注意力双分支建模新闻兴趣演化，Adressa AUC 0.7993 大幅超越SOTA。

venues/AAAI/2026/graph_rec/task_aware_re.title: CORONA: A Coarse-to-Fine Framework for Graph-based Recommendation with Large Language Models
venues/AAAI/2026/graph_rec/task_aware_re.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 LLM 做偏好/意图推理在交互图上逐级缩小候选子图，再由 GNN 精排，全库排序下 Recall 平均相对提升 18.6%。

venues/AAAI/2026/graph_rec/task_aware_re.title: RoTE: Coarse-to-Fine Multi-Level Rotary Time Embedding for Sequential Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2026/graph_rec/task_aware_re.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 将时间戳分解为年/月/日多粒度并借 RoPE 旋转注入 Q/K，即插即用提升 SASRec/RPG，NDCG@5 最高 +20.11%

venues/AAAI/2026/graph_rec/task_aware_re.title: CPMR: Context-Aware Incremental Sequential Recommendation with Pseudo-Multi-Task Learning
venues/AAAI/2026/graph_rec/task_aware_re.description: [CIKM 2023][序列与会话推荐] 提出伪多任务学习范式，用历史图与上下文图双通道演化用户/物品时序状态，在四个数据集上 MRR 平均提升 30.98%。

venues/AAAI/2026/graph_rec/task_aware_re.title: Behavior Importance-Aware Graph Neural Architecture Search for Cross-Domain Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2026/graph_rec/task_aware_re.description: [AAAI 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用一次性免重训超网为各域定制 GNN 架构，并以双层隐式梯度学习源域行为重要性权重，Amazon 与微信广告数据 AUC 最高提升 10.57%。

venues/AAAI/2026/llm_rec/align_3_gr_unif.title: Token-level Collaborative Alignment for LLM-based Generative Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2026/llm_rec/align_3_gr_unif.description: [WWW 2026][LLM4Rec] 将CF物品级logits投影为token级分布并与one-hot融合成软标签，以soft-NTP损失显式对齐LLM生成，即插即用提升多骨干推荐效果。

venues/AAAI/2026/llm_rec/align_3_gr_unif.title: Reason4Rec: Deliberative User Preference Alignment of Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2026/llm_rec/align_3_gr_unif.description: [TKDE 2026][大语言模型推荐] 提出审慎推荐任务与三专家多步推理框架，用评论监督偏好蒸馏-匹配-预测，评分预测与排序全面领先。

venues/AAAI/2026/llm_rec/align_3_gr_unif.title: Every Preference Has Its Strength: Injecting Ordinal Semantics into LLM-Based Recommenders
venues/AAAI/2026/llm_rec/align_3_gr_unif.description: [SIGIR 2026][LLM推荐] 将显式评分建模为LLM词表中的序数语义锚点，以强度感知对齐交互表征，在序列推荐Hit@1与成对偏好准确率上显著超越CF-LLM混合基线。

venues/AAAI/2026/llm_rec/align_3_gr_unif.title: L2Rec: Towards Dual-View Understanding of LLMs for Personalized Recommendation
venues/AAAI/2026/llm_rec/align_3_gr_unif.description: [SIGIR 2026][大语言模型推荐] 以参数级双视图 LoRA-MoE 替代输入/输出级融合，个性化路由对齐行为与语义视图，四数据集 N@10 提升 3.87%–8.02%，线上 CTR +9.24%。

venues/AAAI/2026/llm_rec/align_3_gr_unif.title: Training Large Recommendation Models via Graph-Language Token Alignment
venues/AAAI/2026/llm_rec/align_3_gr_unif.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 将 LightGCN 用户/物品节点经投影器对齐进 LLaMA-2 词表空间，用 GLLM logits 匹配层做端到端物品预测，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@10 最高提升 185%。

venues/AAAI/2026/llm_rec/contextualizing.title: Impact of Tone-Aware Explanations in Recommender Systems
venues/AAAI/2026/llm_rec/contextualizing.description: [TORS 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用 LLM 生成六种语气解释做在线成对用户研究，序数逻辑回归揭示语气对 10 项感知指标、领域与人格年龄的差异化影响。

venues/AAAI/2026/llm_rec/contextualizing.title: From Counterfactual Edits to Human Narratives: LLM-Driven Interpretations for Recommender System Explanations
venues/AAAI/2026/llm_rec/contextualizing.description: [CIKM 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用 LLM 将冗长反事实编辑列表摘要为高层偏好叙事，并以人类校准指标评估正确性/信息量/语言质量。

venues/AAAI/2026/llm_rec/contextualizing.title: The Utility of LLMs in Recommender Systems Explanation Evaluation
venues/AAAI/2026/llm_rec/contextualizing.description: [RecSys 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 系统评测 14 个 LLM 作为推荐解释评审员与 216 名人类评分的一致性，发现排序相关中等但绝对评分一致性低，并给出四条实用准则。

venues/AAAI/2026/llm_rec/contextualizing.title: Large Language Models as Narrative-Driven Recommenders
venues/AAAI/2026/llm_rec/contextualizing.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 系统评测 38 个 LLM 在 Reddit 叙事式电影推荐上的表现，发现零样本提示即可显著超越 doc2vec 基线 70%+，中型开源模型接近大型闭源模型。

venues/AAAI/2026/llm_rec/contextualizing.title: Effectiveness of LLMs in Temporal User Profiling for Recommendation

venues/AAAI/2026/rl_bandit_rec/preferenc.title: Interactive Visualization Recommendation with Hier-SUCB

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/generative_rec/gra.title: Token-level Collaborative Alignment for LLM-based Generative Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/generative_rec/gra.description: [WWW 2026][LLM4Rec] 将CF物品级logits投影为token级分布并与one-hot融合成软标签，以soft-NTP损失显式对齐LLM生成，即插即用提升多骨干推荐效果。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/generative_rec/gra.title: SynGR: Unleashing the Potential of Cross-Modal Synergy for Generative Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/generative_rec/gra.description: [ICML 2026][生成式推荐] 用 PID 信息分解揭示多模态生成式推荐的协同信息缺失，提出显著性感知掩码+协同对比学习，Full-Ranking 下平均提升约 10%

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/generative_rec/gra.title: RecBase: Generative Foundation Model Pretraining for Zero-Shot Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/generative_rec/gra.description: [EMNLP 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用课程学习增强的 RQ-VAE 将跨域物品统一离散为层级概念 ID，从零预训练 1.5B 自回归推荐基座，在 8 个未见数据集零样本 AUC 全面超越 7B LLM。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/generative_rec/gra.title: S$^2$GR: Stepwise Semantic-Guided Reasoning in Latent Space for Generative Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/generative_rec/gra.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐] 在每级 SID 码生成前插入受码本聚类语义对比监督的思考 token，实现逐步可验证潜在推理，工业短视频 A/B 显著提升时长。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/generative_rec/rec.title: LLM-RecG: A Semantic Bias-Aware Framework for Zero-Shot Sequential Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/generative_rec/rec.description: [RecSys 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 揭示 LLM 语义嵌入的域语义偏置，用域间紧致+域内多样双熵损失与源域序列模式注意力实现零样本跨域序列推荐，R@10 平均提升超 10%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/generative_rec/rec.title: RecGPT: A Foundation Model for Sequential Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/generative_rec/rec.description: [ACL/EMNLP 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 纯文本驱动+FSQ统一分词+混合双向因果注意力的序列推荐基础模型，零样本跨域显著超越10%数据微调的ID基线。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/generative_rec/rec.title: Generative Archetype-Grounded Item Representations for Sequential Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/generative_rec/rec.description: [WWW 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用 LLM 生成物品“目标人群原型”文本并单次前向抽取 prefill/decoding 双嵌入，再以行为关联分数调制排斥力做校准，Full-Ranking 下 HR@10 最高 +6.95%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/generative_rec/rec.title: GenRecEdit: Adapting Model Editing for Generative Recommendation with Cold-Start Items
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/generative_rec/rec.description: [SIGIR 2026][冷启动与长尾推荐] 将 NLP 模型编辑迁移至生成式推荐，用逐位置定位-编辑+One-One 触发注入冷启动物品 SID 模式，仅需重训 9.5% 时间即大幅缓解冷启动坍缩。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/generative_rec/rec.title: Universal Item Tokenization for Transferable Generative Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/generative_rec/rec.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用 MLLM+树状码本构建跨域通用物品分词器，结合内容重建与共现协同对齐，实现可迁移生成式推荐，全库排序下全面超越基线。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/generative_rec/rec.title: RecBase: Generative Foundation Model Pretraining for Zero-Shot Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/generative_rec/rec.description: [EMNLP 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用课程学习增强的 RQ-VAE 将跨域物品统一离散为层级概念 ID，从零预训练 1.5B 自回归推荐基座，在 8 个未见数据集零样本 AUC 全面超越 7B LLM。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/generative_rec/rec.title: LLM2Rec: Large Language Models Are Powerful Embedding Models for Sequential Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/generative_rec/rec.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 两阶段将 LLM 改造为融合协同信号与语义的物品嵌入模型，Full-Ranking 下域内平均提升约 15%、跨域仍稳定增益。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/generative_rec/rec.title: Order-agnostic Identifier for Large Language Model-based Generative Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/generative_rec/rec.description: [SIGIR 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 提出无序集合标识符范式，用CF+语义多token集合表示物品并同时生成，T5上Recall@10平均提升约50%，推理提速8-18倍。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/generative_rec/rec.title: Rethinking Item Tokenization in Generative Recommenders: From Fixed Atoms to Semantic Subwords
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/generative_rec/rec.description: [CIKM 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 指出固定长度SID复用于历史侧引发“物品内注意力过载”，提出历史侧语义子词重分词(IST)+行为共现增强(BCA)的非对称分词，三数据集三骨干全库排序NDCG@10最高+13.8%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/generative_rec/rec.title: Let It Go? Not Quite: Addressing Item Cold Start in Sequential Recommendations with Content-Based Initialization
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/generative_rec/rec.description: [RecSys 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 冻结内容嵌入+有界可训练 delta 校正，兼顾冷启动物品语义结构与热物品任务适配，三数据集冷启动 NDCG@10 最高提升 20.9%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/a_text_bas.title: Disentangling Likes and Dislikes in Personalized Generative Explainable Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/a_text_bas.description: [WWW 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用 LLM 重构正负观点分离的可解释推荐数据集，提出情感匹配与正负内容相似度指标，并证明将预测评分作为输入可显著提升情感感知解释生成。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/a_text_bas.title: Recommendation and Temptation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/a_text_bas.description: [RecSys 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 将用户选择解耦为 enrichment 与 temptation 双效用并引入站外选项，证明局部贪心最优并给出可估计算子，MovieLens 与仿真全面超越基线。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/a_text_bas.title: Review-driven Personalized Preference Reasoning with Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/a_text_bas.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用评论抽取偏好画像并蒸馏逐步推理，评分预测与重排双任务均超 CF 与 LLM 基线，解释性显著提升

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/a_text_bas.title: Why Not Together? A Multiple-Round Recommender System for Queries and Items
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/a_text_bas.description: [KDD 2025][序列与会话推荐] 提出 MAGUS 多轮查询-物品联合推荐框架，以词组合关系图桥接查询与物品，用标签传播在线吸收反馈，可插拔接入 12 种基座模型。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/a_text_bas.title: Empowering Retrieval-based Conversational Recommendation with Contrasting User Preferences
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/a_text_bas.description: [NAACL 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用 LLM 抽取并扩增 like/dislike 对比偏好，以三路相似度线性打分做稠密检索式对话推荐，INSPIRED 上 Recall@10 相对提升 99.72%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/copl_colla.title: RecLM: Recommendation Instruction Tuning
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/copl_colla.description: [ACL 2025][大语言模型推荐] 以两轮协同指令微调+RL画像精炼为LLM注入协同信号，作为即插即用画像增强器在零样本冷启动下带来最高 200%+ 的 Recall 提升。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/copl_colla.title: EasyRec: Simple yet Effective Language Models for Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/copl_colla.description: [EMNLP 2025][LLM4Rec] 用 LLM 生成用户/物品画像并以对比学习对齐协同信号，训练轻量文本编码器实现零样本推荐，Full-Ranking 下 Recall@20 最高提升 32%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/copl_colla.title: Rethinking LLM-Based Recommendations: A Personalized Query-Driven Parallel Integration
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/copl_colla.description: [ACL 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出 QUEREC 并行框架，用 LLM 零样本生成个性化用户查询与特征增强物品描述，与 CF 模型并行全库检索后自适应重排，Full-Ranking 下最高提升 57%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/copl_colla.title: CoLLM: Integrating Collaborative Embeddings into Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/copl_colla.description: [TKDE 2025][大语言模型推荐] 将传统协同过滤模型学到的用户/物品表征经 MLP 映射进 LLM 词嵌入空间，以两阶段调优兼顾暖启动与冷启动，AUC 相对 TALLRec 提升约 8%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/copl_colla.title: ProMax: Exploring the Potential of LLM-derived Profiles with Distribution Shaping for Recommender Systems
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/copl_colla.description: [SIGIR 2026][LLM推荐] 将 LLM 画像视为检索信号而非融合特征，用双路分布重塑（监督+自监督）引导基座模型，LightGCN 上 NDCG@10 最高提升 8.44%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/cove_compr.title: Can LLMs Outshine Conventional Recommenders? A Comparative Evaluation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/cove_compr.description: [NeurIPS 2025 DB Track][大语言模型推荐] RecBench 系统对比 17 个 LLM 与 DLRM 在 4 种物品表征、CTR/SeqRec 双任务上的精度-效率权衡，LLM 精度领先但推理慢千倍。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/cove_compr.title: The Future is Sparse: Embedding Compression for Scalable Retrieval in Recommender Systems
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/cove_compr.description: [RecSys 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用余弦重建的稀疏自编码器把稠密向量压成高维 k-稀疏向量，免重训骨干，12× 压缩仅损 1.35% CTR，线上显著优于同尺寸 Matryoshka。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/cove_compr.title: Empowering Compact LLMs with Fusion of Layer-wise Exits for Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/cove_compr.description: [ICDM 2026][LLM4Rec] 在紧凑 LLM 每层插入预测出口并用连续 ReLU 路由器自适应融合多层打分分布，target-k hinge 损失约束激活出口数，全库排序下精度超越大模型基线且延迟仅增 <1ms。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/cove_compr.title: Improving LLMs for Recommendation with Out-Of-Vocabulary Tokens
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/cove_compr.description: [arXiv 2024][LLM4Rec] 用元路径聚类生成 OOV 层级 token 构建用户/物品 META ID，兼顾记忆性与多样性，序列推荐 HR@10 最高提升 30%+。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/cove_compr.title: EAGER-LLM: Enhancing Large Language Models as Recommenders through Exogenous Behavior-Semantic Integration
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/cove_compr.description: [WWW 2025][大语言模型推荐] 以双源知识富集物品索引+非侵入多尺度对齐重建+退火适配器，将外源行为/语义信号注入 LLM 生成式推荐，Amazon 三数据集 Full-Ranking 下 Recall@10 最高提升 26.16%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/decoding_i.title: Lost in Sequence: Do Large Language Models Understand Sequential Recommendation?
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/decoding_i.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 揭示现有 LLM4Rec 模型无法捕捉交互序列顺序信息，提出冻结 LLM 与 CF-SRec、仅训练轻量 MLP 的蒸馏框架 LLM-SRec，在 Amazon 四数据集上 NDCG@10 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/decoding_i.title: Do Recommenders Need to Think in Words? Latent Reasoning for Efficient LLM-Based Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/decoding_i.description: [CIKM 2026][大语言模型推荐] 用训练期逐步头监督替代推理期 CoT/隐式推理，HR@10 相对提升 4.0–5.0% 且延迟降低 18.3×

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/decoding_i.title: Long-Sequence Recommendation Models Need Decoupled Embeddings
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/decoding_i.description: [ICLR 2025][序列与会话推荐] 揭示长序列推荐中注意力与表征共享嵌入导致的梯度支配与冲突，提出双嵌入表 DARE，AUC 最高提升 9‰ 并加速检索 50%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/decoding_i.title: LLM2Rec: Large Language Models Are Powerful Embedding Models for Sequential Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/decoding_i.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 两阶段将 LLM 改造为融合协同信号与语义的物品嵌入模型，Full-Ranking 下域内平均提升约 15%、跨域仍稳定增益。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/decoding_i.title: EARN: Efficient Inference Acceleration for LLM-based Generative Recommendation by Register Tokens
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/decoding_i.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 基于 LLMRec 注意力层间稀疏反转与双注意力汇现象，用首尾寄存器 token 压缩历史交互并在第 k 层后剪除 prompt，实现 3.79× 加速与 80.8% KV Cache 缩减且精度反超微调。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/easyrec_si.title: RecLM: Recommendation Instruction Tuning
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/easyrec_si.description: [ACL 2025][大语言模型推荐] 以两轮协同指令微调+RL画像精炼为LLM注入协同信号，作为即插即用画像增强器在零样本冷启动下带来最高 200%+ 的 Recall 提升。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/easyrec_si.title: Sparse Contrastive Learning for Content-Based Cold Item Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/easyrec_si.description: [SIGIR 2026][冷启动与长尾推荐] 抛弃 CF 对齐、纯内容空间 item-item 相似度建模，用 α-entmax 稀疏化 sampled softmax 并支持内容空间蒸馏，冷物品排序与曝光公平性双赢。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/easyrec_si.title: LLM2Rec: Large Language Models Are Powerful Embedding Models for Sequential Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/easyrec_si.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 两阶段将 LLM 改造为融合协同信号与语义的物品嵌入模型，Full-Ranking 下域内平均提升约 15%、跨域仍稳定增益。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/easyrec_si.title: DIAURec: Dual-Intent Space Representation Optimization for Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/easyrec_si.description: [SIGIR 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 以原型意图与分布意图重构表征，用对齐-均匀性+粗细粒度匹配联合优化，Amazon-book R@20 相对提升 10.6%

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/easyrec_si.title: DaRec: A Disentangled Alignment Framework for Large Language Model and Recommender System
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/easyrec_si.description: [ICDE 2025][大语言模型推荐] 从信息论证明零间隙对齐次优，提出解耦共享/特有表征+全局局部结构对齐的即插即用框架，全库排序下 Recall@20 最高提升 5.33%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/generative.title: Relevance Matters: A Multi-Task and Multi-Stage Large Language Model Approach for E-commerce Query Rewriting
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/generative.description: [ICDE 2026][LLM4Rec] 将相关性打标任务注入电商查询改写，多任务 SFT + 查询级归一化 GRPO 融合奖励对齐，离线召回 67.94%、线上 UCVR +0.181%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/generative.title: Bridging Language and Items for Retrieval and Recommendation: Benchmarking LLMs as Semantic Encoders
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/generative.description: [ACL 2026][大语言模型推荐] 构建 BLaIR 基准，用 11 个 LLM 作语义编码器评测序列推荐、协同过滤与复杂查询商品搜索，揭示其排名与 MTEB 几乎不相关。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/generative.title: LLM-based User-Product Relevance Evaluation for Dynamic Product Advertising
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/generative.description: [CIKM 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 用 SID 分组意图压缩 + 智能体指南蒸馏小模型，构建无查询的 DPA 召回离线相关性指标，与线上 CP/CR/CVR 强对齐。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/generative.title: SMART: LLM-Augmented Hybrid Retrieval for Dynamic Product Ads
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/generative.description: [RecSys 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 揭示规则查询擅长 BM25 重定向、LLM 查询擅长 ANN 拓客的检索分解，用输出审计门控仅路由 10% 用户，线上转化率 +27.6%

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/generative.title: Beyond Retrieval: Generating Narratives in Conversational Recommender Systems
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/generative.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 构建 REGEN 叙事数据集并提出 CF+内容嵌入经 Adapter 注入 LLM 的融合架构，在 Office/Clothing 两域上 BLEU/ROUGE/语义相似度较单模态提升 4–12%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/kerl_knowl.title: MOPI-HFRS: A Multi-objective Personalized Health-aware Food Recommendation System with LLM-enhanced Interpretation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/kerl_knowl.description: [KDD 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 构建首个融合 NHANES 医疗数据的健康感知食物推荐基准，用符号图结构学习 + Pareto 多目标优化平衡偏好/个性化健康/营养多样性，并以知识注入 LLM 生成可解释理由。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/kerl_knowl.title: From Raw Features to Effective Embeddings: A Three-Stage Approach for Multimodal Recipe Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/kerl_knowl.description: [SIGIR 2026][多模态推荐] 用 VLM/LLM 摘要 + LightGCN 传播 + 跨视图对比学习三阶段精炼食谱多模态特征，Full-Ranking 下 Recall@10 提升 7–15%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/kerl_knowl.title: Beyond Retrieval: Generating Narratives in Conversational Recommender Systems
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/kerl_knowl.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 构建 REGEN 叙事数据集并提出 CF+内容嵌入经 Adapter 注入 LLM 的融合架构，在 Office/Clothing 两域上 BLEU/ROUGE/语义相似度较单模态提升 4–12%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/kerl_knowl.title: Enriching Semantic Profiles into Knowledge Graph for Recommender Systems Using Large Language Models
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/kerl_knowl.description: [KDD 2026][LLM4Rec] 用 LLM 为 KG 全实体生成语义画像，以可逆加性注入+成对匹配对齐，Full-Ranking 下 Recall@40 最高提升 2.6%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/kerl_knowl.title: Comprehending Knowledge Graphs with Large Language Models for Recommender Systems
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/kerl_knowl.description: [SIGIR 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 用 LLM 理解 KG 局部子图并构建语义物品图做全局检索增强，离线预计算语义嵌入后接入 LightGCN，全库排序下全面超越 12 个基线。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/knowledge_.title: Mixture-of-Experts Knowledge Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Multi-Agent LLM-based Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/knowledge_.description: [KDD 2026][大语言模型推荐] 用 MoE 多粒度 KG 检索智能体按查询复杂度路由检索粒度，配合知识对齐与对比偏好优化，在 20 候选池协议下 Accuracy 相对提升 5.8%–20.4%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/knowledge_.title: EAGER-LLM: Enhancing Large Language Models as Recommenders through Exogenous Behavior-Semantic Integration
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/knowledge_.description: [WWW 2025][大语言模型推荐] 以双源知识富集物品索引+非侵入多尺度对齐重建+退火适配器，将外源行为/语义信号注入 LLM 生成式推荐，Amazon 三数据集 Full-Ranking 下 Recall@10 最高提升 26.16%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/knowledge_.title: Balancing Fine-tuning and RAG: A Hybrid Strategy for Dynamic LLM Recommendation Updates
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/knowledge_.description: [RecSys 2025][LLM4Rec] 以十亿用户短视频兴趣探索系统为案例，量化对比微调与RAG的更新代价/敏捷性，提出月度微调+周内RAG刷新的混合更新策略，线上A/B显著提升满意度。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/knowledge_.title: CORONA: A Coarse-to-Fine Framework for Graph-based Recommendation with Large Language Models
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/knowledge_.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 LLM 做偏好/意图推理在交互图上逐级缩小候选子图，再由 GNN 精排，全库排序下 Recall 平均相对提升 18.6%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/knowledge_.title: Bridging the User-side Knowledge Gap in Knowledge-aware Recommendations with Large Language Models
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/knowledge_.description: [AAAI 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 LLM 推断用户兴趣并结构化为 CIKG 异构图，配合兴趣重建与跨域对比学习去噪，在三个数据集全库排序下 R@100 最高提升 9.31%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/lamp_val_l.title: Bidding-Aware Retrieval for Multi-Stage Consistency in Online Advertising
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/lamp_val_l.description: [CIKM 2026][CTR预估与特征交叉] 将竞价信号注入召回打分，用单调性约束+多任务蒸馏+任务注意力精炼实现召回-精排 eCPM 一致性，线上收入 +4.32%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/lamp_val_l.title: RTBAgent: A LLM-based Agent System for Real-Time Bidding
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/lamp_val_l.description: [WWW 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 首个 LLM Agent 出价系统，用两步决策+多类记忆+专家策略工具在 iPinYou 上以调整因子方式超越规则/RL/扩散基线。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/lamp_val_l.title: Bid2X: Revealing Dynamics of Bidding Environment in Online Advertising from A Foundation Model Lens
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/lamp_val_l.description: [KDD 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 将自动出价环境建模重构为跨场景基础模型的下一token预测，用变量/时间双注意力+零膨胀投影，8数据集MAE全面领先，线上GMV+4.65%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/lamp_val_l.title: Truthful Aggregation of LLMs with an Application to Online Advertising
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/lamp_val_l.description: [arXiv 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] MOSAIC 用重要性采样+循环单调性支付实现 LLM 广告拍卖的真实报价与最优分布收敛，20 候选即近最优。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/lamp_val_l.title: DARA: Few-shot Budget Allocation in Online Advertising via In-Context Decision Making with RL-Finetuned LLMs
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/lamp_val_l.description: [WWW 2026][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 双阶段 LLM 智能体分离少样本规划与精细优化，配合动态参考策略 GRPO-Adaptive 微调，在真实与合成广告环境中显著降低边际 ROI 方差。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/maps_motiv.title: Similarity = Value? Consultation Value Assessment and Alignment for Personalized Search
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/maps_motiv.description: [ACL 2025][LLM4Rec] 指出语义相似度无法代理咨询价值，提出场景范围/后验行为/时间衰减三维价值评估与 CAI 对齐的 VAPS，检索排序双任务全面领先。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/maps_motiv.title: Towards Context-aware Reasoning-enhanced Generative Searching in E-commerce
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/maps_motiv.description: [WWW 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 将电商搜索异构上下文统一为JSON文本与残差K-Means语义ID，用SFT-RL自演化后训练与去偏R-GRPO提升生成式搜索排序，All-100K上HR@10相对提升6.24%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/maps_motiv.title: EAGER: Enrich-and-Align Generative Query Recommendation from Clicked Items in E-commerce Search
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/maps_motiv.description: [EMNLP 2026 Industry][LLM4Rec] 两阶段生成式 I2Q 查询推荐：课程化 SFT 扩意图覆盖 + GRPO 混合奖励对齐线上约束，线上 UCTR +0.83%、Pay Count +3.49%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/maps_motiv.title: AI Guided Accelerator For Search Experience
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/maps_motiv.description: [SIGIR 2025][序列与会话推荐] 挖掘电商查询转移链并做意图一致性过滤，再用 Solar-10B 指令微调生成多样化替代收敛查询，线上 CTR +32.2%、转化 +38.3%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/maps_motiv.title: LLM-based User-Product Relevance Evaluation for Dynamic Product Advertising
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/maps_motiv.description: [CIKM 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 用 SID 分组意图压缩 + 智能体指南蒸馏小模型，构建无查询的 DPA 召回离线相关性指标，与线上 CP/CR/CVR 强对齐。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/mira_empow.title: IntentLens: Grounding Underspecified Multimodal Queries for Recommendation via Tool-Augmented Reasoning
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/mira_empow.description: [NeurIPS 2026][多模态推荐] 用 MLLM 工具增强推理将欠指定图文查询接地为结构化意图，再以轻量双塔排序，构建两个新基准并显著超越 MLLM 与检索基线。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/mira_empow.title: Recommender AI Agent: Integrating Large Language Models for Interactive Recommendations
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/mira_empow.description: [TOIS 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 以 LLM 为大脑、传统推荐模型为工具，配合候选总线、长短期画像、计划优先执行与反思机制，在 Steam/MovieLens/Beauty 上显著超越 GPT-4 与 Chat-Rec。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/mira_empow.title: Harnessing Multimodal Large Language Models for Multimodal Sequential Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/mira_empow.description: [AAAI 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 MLLM 将商品图转为文本摘要，再以循环式提示推断动态用户偏好，SFT 微调 LLaVA 做多模态序列推荐，AUC 最高提升约 4.3%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/mira_empow.title: Muse: A Multimodal Conversational Recommendation Dataset with Scenario-Grounded User Profiles
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/mira_empow.description: [ACL 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 首个多模态对话推荐数据集，用场景锚定用户画像的多智能体框架合成 7K 段图文对话，并验证三种 MLLM 的可学习性。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/mira_empow.title: Intent Representation Learning with Large Language Model for Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/mira_empow.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 LLM 思维链抽取文本意图，与交互意图双塔对齐+动量蒸馏匹配，作为模型无关插件在三个数据集上稳定提升 Recall/NDCG。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/personax_a.title: Task-Aware Automated User Profile Generation for Recommendation Simulation Using Large Language Models
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/personax_a.description: [SIGIR 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出免训练三阶段画像生成框架 APG4RecSim，用语义合并+反事实因果映射将交互历史转为任务对齐画像，在判别/排序/评分三任务上取得最佳综合表现。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/personax_a.title: LettinGo: Explore User Profile Generation for Recommendation System
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/personax_a.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 用多LLM探索开放式用户画像、以下游推荐成败构造偏好对、DPO对齐画像生成器，Amazon Books Acc 66.3%→70.4%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/personax_a.title: HORIZON: A Benchmark for In-the-wild User Behaviour Modeling
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/personax_a.description: [ACL 2026 Findings][跨域与多场景推荐] 重构 Amazon Reviews 为 54M 用户跨域长程基准，提出时间-用户双轴四象限评估与 LLM 查询改写/长程建模任务，揭示 ID 模型在时间外推下崩塌。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/personax_a.title: Mixture of Sequence: Theme-Aware Mixture-of-Experts for Long-Sequence Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/personax_a.description: [WWW 2026][序列与会话推荐] 揭示长序列“会话跳跃”现象，用主题码本路由+多尺度专家融合做子序列抽取，AUC 平均提升 0.68% 且 FLOPs 更低

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/personax_a.title: Effectiveness of LLMs in Temporal User Profiling for Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/personax_a.description: [ICDM 2025 Workshop][LLM4Rec] 用 LLM 分别生成短期/长期自然语言画像，经 SBERT 编码与注意力融合做内容推荐，Movies&TV 上 Recall@10 相对提升 17%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/q_strum_de.title: CASTLE: Contrastive and Seed-Guided Training for Cold-Start Natural Language Search
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/q_strum_de.description: [CIKM 2026][冷启动与长尾推荐] 用预订会话对比房源对+用户调研种子查询联合生成合成查询与构造式相关性标签，KL 1.01 对齐真实用户，9.2× 优于基线。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/q_strum_de.title: Semantic Retrieval Augmented Contrastive Learning for Sequential Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/q_strum_de.description: [NeurIPS 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用 LLM 语义检索构建用户/物品候选池并配可学习样本合成器，替代随机增广与 K-Means 硬规则，全库排序下 HR@20 最高提升 11.82%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/q_strum_de.title: MVIGER: Multi-View Variational Integration of Complementary Knowledge for Generative Recommender
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/q_strum_de.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐] 将模板-索引组合视为隐变量视图，用可学习先验做变分集成，Full-Ranking 下 H@10 最高提升约 26%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/q_strum_de.title: UQABench: Evaluating User Embedding for Prompting LLMs in Personalized Question Answering
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/q_strum_de.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 提出首个标准化三阶段（预训练-微调-评测）用户嵌入软提示基准，用序列理解/行为预测/兴趣感知三类任务揭示嵌入式生成推荐与文本式相当且省 8-19× token。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/q_strum_de.title: Refining Text Generation for Realistic Conversational Recommendation via Direct Preference Optimization
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/q_strum_de.description: [EMNLP 2025][对话推荐与智能体] 用 DPO 对齐 LLM 生成的对话摘要与物品推荐信息，使评分器更准，Tabidachi 上 HR@1 提升 21.3%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/reclm_reco.title: Enhancing Collaborative Semantics of Language Model-Driven Recommendations via Graph-Aware Learning
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/reclm_reco.description: [TKDE 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用多跳提示+图感知对比学习把 GNN 聚合意图注入 LLM，在三个 Amazon/Yelp 数据集 Full-Ranking 下 HR@10 最高提升约 15%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/reclm_reco.title: AlphaFree: Recommendation Free from Users, IDs, and GNNs
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/reclm_reco.description: [WWW 2026][大语言模型推荐] 用语言表征替代ID、在线推断用户偏好、以相似物品增强+对比对齐替代GNN，实现无用户/无ID/无GNN的轻量推荐，内存降69%、冷启动提升26–38%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/reclm_reco.title: CORONA: A Coarse-to-Fine Framework for Graph-based Recommendation with Large Language Models
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/reclm_reco.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 LLM 做偏好/意图推理在交互图上逐级缩小候选子图，再由 GNN 精排，全库排序下 Recall 平均相对提升 18.6%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/reclm_reco.title: EasyRec: Simple yet Effective Language Models for Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/reclm_reco.description: [EMNLP 2025][LLM4Rec] 用 LLM 生成用户/物品画像并以对比学习对齐协同信号，训练轻量文本编码器实现零样本推荐，Full-Ranking 下 Recall@20 最高提升 32%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/reclm_reco.title: SGCL: Unifying Self-Supervised and Supervised Learning for Graph Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/reclm_reco.description: [RecSys 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 将 BPR 与 InfoNCE 合并为单一监督图对比损失，免增广免负采样，精度与训练效率双超 SGL/SimGCL。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/rethinking.title: RALLRec: Improving Retrieval Augmented Large Language Model Recommendation with Representation Learning
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/rethinking.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 用 LLM 生成物品详述并做文本-协同表征对比对齐，配合时间感知重排器提升 RAG 式 LLM 推荐的检索质量。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/rethinking.description: [WWW 2025][大语言模型推荐] 以双源知识富集物品索引+非侵入多尺度对齐重建+退火适配器，将外源行为/语义信号注入 LLM 生成式推荐，Amazon 三数据集 Full-Ranking 下 Recall@10 最高提升 26.16%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/rethinking.title: Can LLMs Outshine Conventional Recommenders? A Comparative Evaluation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/rethinking.description: [NeurIPS 2025 DB Track][大语言模型推荐] RecBench 系统对比 17 个 LLM 与 DLRM 在 4 种物品表征、CTR/SeqRec 双任务上的精度-效率权衡，LLM 精度领先但推理慢千倍。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/rethinking.title: Profiling What Matters: Context-Aware Item Profiles from Large-Scale Metadata for LLM Recommenders
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/rethinking.description: [CIKM 2026][大语言模型推荐] 将海量异构物品元数据结构化并训练轻量选择器，为每个用户-物品对动态生成上下文相关画像，显著提升 LLM 重排效果。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/rethinking.title: Towards Next-Generation Recommender Systems: A Benchmark for Personalized Recommendation Assistant with LLMs
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/rethinking.description: [WSDM 2026][大语言模型推荐] 构建 RecBench+ 约3万条复杂用户查询基准，覆盖显式/隐式/误导条件与画像偏好，系统评测7个LLM并揭示SFT+RFT两阶段微调最优。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/similarity.title: MAPS: Motivation-Aware Personalized Search via LLM-Driven Consultation Alignment

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/similarity.title: Towards Next-Generation Recommender Systems: A Benchmark for Personalized Recommendation Assistant with LLMs
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/similarity.description: [WSDM 2026][大语言模型推荐] 构建 RecBench+ 约3万条复杂用户查询基准，覆盖显式/隐式/误导条件与画像偏好，系统评测7个LLM并揭示SFT+RFT两阶段微调最优。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/similarity.description: [SIGIR 2025][序列与会话推荐] 挖掘电商查询转移链并做意图一致性过滤，再用 Solar-10B 指令微调生成多样化替代收敛查询，线上 CTR +32.2%、转化 +38.3%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/similarity.description: [CIKM 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 用 SID 分组意图压缩 + 智能体指南蒸馏小模型，构建无查询的 DPA 召回离线相关性指标，与线上 CP/CR/CVR 强对齐。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/similarity.description: [KDD 2026 TSMO][LLM4Rec] 用闭源LLM+蒸馏SLM生成替代/互补/主题三类隐式意图以扩展电商搜索召回，会话购买预测与LLM评审双轨评估，覆盖流量60%→80%、成本仅30%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/the_effici.title: A Thorough Performance Benchmarking on Lightweight Embedding-based Recommender Systems
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/the_effici.description: [TOIS 2025][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 统一协议横评 7 类轻量嵌入压缩方法，提出 MagPrune 强基线，并首次量化跨任务迁移性与树莓派端侧效率瓶颈。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/the_effici.title: Thoroughly Modeling Multi-domain Pre-trained Recommendation as Language
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/the_effici.description: [TOIS 2025][LLM4Rec] 将多域序列推荐彻底转为文本生成任务，用五项指标指导行为-文本双向适配，7 数据集微调与零样本均最优，NDCG@1 最高提升 23%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/the_effici.title: Reproducibility in Recommender Systems: A Survey
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/the_effici.description: [TORS 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 对 RecSys 可复现性赛道 2020–2025 年 51 篇论文的结构化元分析，揭示其方法论高度同质化、以“扩展”替代“严格复现”的实践落差。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/the_effici.title: Eval4DiRec: A Unified and Systematic Evaluation Framework for Diffusion-based Recommender Systems
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/the_effici.description: [TKDD 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 首个面向扩散推荐的开源统一评测框架，覆盖 5 场景 14 模型，标准化扩散推理配置并揭示噪声调度与步数的关键影响。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/the_effici.title: User Invariant Preference Learning for Multi-Behavior Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/the_effici.description: [TOIS 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用 IRM 范式 + VAE 从多行为交互中抽取用户不变偏好以抑制辅助行为噪声，Leave-One-Out + Full-Ranking 下 HR@10 最高提升 3.98%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/user_behav.title: Do LLMs Memorize Recommendation Datasets? A Preliminary Study on MovieLens-1M
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/user_behav.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用少样本提示探测 GPT/Llama 对 MovieLens-1M 的物品、用户与交互记忆覆盖率，揭示记忆量与推荐性能强相关且放大流行度偏置。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/user_behav.title: Generative Large Recommendation Models: Emerging Trends in LLMs for Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/user_behav.description: [WWW 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 系统梳理生成式大推荐模型范式：数据质量、缩放律、用户行为挖掘与训练推理效率四大议题及未来方向。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/user_behav.title: Scaling Recommender Transformers to One Billion Parameters
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/user_behav.description: [KDD 2026][序列与会话推荐] ARGUS 将自回归预训练解耦为反馈预测与下一物品预测双任务，把推荐 Transformer 编码器扩到 10 亿参数，线上听歌时长 +2.26%、点赞率 +6.37%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/user_behav.title: Can LLMs Outshine Conventional Recommenders? A Comparative Evaluation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/user_behav.description: [NeurIPS 2025 DB Track][大语言模型推荐] RecBench 系统对比 17 个 LLM 与 DLRM 在 4 种物品表征、CTR/SeqRec 双任务上的精度-效率权衡，LLM 精度领先但推理慢千倍。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/user_behav.title: SPRINT: Scalable and Predictive Intent Refinement for LLM-Enhanced Session-based Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/user_behav.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用全局意图池约束 LLM 生成、以预测-纠错回路校验意图，并蒸馏为轻量意图预测器，实现训练选择性调用 LLM、推理零 LLM 依赖的会话推荐。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/user_feedb.title: Balancing Fine-tuning and RAG: A Hybrid Strategy for Dynamic LLM Recommendation Updates
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/user_feedb.description: [RecSys 2025][LLM4Rec] 以十亿用户短视频兴趣探索系统为案例，量化对比微调与RAG的更新代价/敏捷性，提出月度微调+周内RAG刷新的混合更新策略，线上A/B显著提升满意度。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/user_feedb.title: Tree of Preferences for Diversified Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/user_feedb.description: [NeurIPS 2025][LLM4Rec] 用 LLM 构建粗到细偏好树挖掘欠探索兴趣并合成交互去偏，在 Twitter/Weibo/Amazon 上同时提升多样性与相关性。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/user_feedb.title: What Makes LLMs Effective Sequential Recommenders? A Study on Preference Intensity and Temporal Context
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/user_feedb.description: [ACL 2026][大语言模型推荐] 揭示二元偏好对齐丢失偏好强度与时序上下文，提出自适应奖励边际 RecPO，五数据集 HR@1 全面领先 S-DPO。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/user_feedb.title: ProMax: Exploring the Potential of LLM-derived Profiles with Distribution Shaping for Recommender Systems
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/user_feedb.description: [SIGIR 2026][LLM推荐] 将 LLM 画像视为检索信号而非融合特征，用双路分布重塑（监督+自监督）引导基座模型，LightGCN 上 NDCG@10 最高提升 8.44%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/user_feedb.title: Beyond Utility: Evaluating LLM as Recommender
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/llm_rec/user_feedb.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出含历史长度敏感性、候选位置偏差、画像生成与幻觉四维的 LLM 推荐多维评测框架，揭示 LLM 在重排与冷启动占优但位置偏差严重。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/multimodal_rec/icg.title: Personalized Image Generation for Recommendations Beyond Catalogs
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/multimodal_rec/icg.description: [RecSys 2025][多模态推荐] 用轻量条件扩散先验从隐式反馈采样用户个性化 CLIP 嵌入，冻结 SD+IP-Adapter 解码，免微调实现可扩展个性化图像生成。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/multimodal_rec/icg.title: Personalized Image Generation with Large Multimodal Models
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/multimodal_rec/icg.description: [WWW 2025][多模态推荐] Pigeon 用 LMM+掩码生成器从噪声历史图中抽取视觉偏好，两阶段偏好对齐（掩码重建+DPO）实现贴纸/海报个性化生成，个性化指标提升 7%~31%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/multimodal_rec/icg.title: Multimodal Large Language Models with Adaptive Preference Optimization for Sequential Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/multimodal_rec/icg.description: [SIGIR 2026][LLM4Rec] 面向 MLLM 序列推荐，用难度感知重加权 DPO + 高斯噪声正则分布优化，缓解样本难度失衡与跨模态语义偏差，三数据集 NDCG@3 提升 7.4%–11.0%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/multimodal_rec/icg.title: Dual-Diffusional Generative Fashion Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/multimodal_rec/icg.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 双分支扩散 Transformer 联合生成时尚单品图像与属性级文本，以结构化偏好加权采样建模用户，PFITB/GOR 双任务个性化指标显著领先且训练提速约 7 倍。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/multimodal_rec/icg.title: NoteLLM-2: Multimodal Large Representation Models for Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/multimodal_rec/icg.description: [KDD 2025][多模态推荐] 端到端微调 LLM+视觉编码器构建高效 MLRM，用 mICL 与门控后期融合缓解视觉忽视，I2I 全库召回 R@100 显著提升并落地线上 A/B。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/multimodal_rec/pre.title: NoteLLM-2: Multimodal Large Representation Models for Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/multimodal_rec/pre.description: [KDD 2025][多模态推荐] 端到端微调 LLM+视觉编码器构建高效 MLRM，用 mICL 与门控后期融合缓解视觉忽视，I2I 全库召回 R@100 显著提升并落地线上 A/B。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/multimodal_rec/pre.title: Personalized Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Foundation Models for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/multimodal_rec/pre.description: [WWW 2026][多模态推荐] 按兴趣分群并为每群挂载独立 PEFT 模块，使 CLIP 编码出用户条件化的物品表征，配合群内难负采样，NDCG@20 最高提升 15.3%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/multimodal_rec/pre.title: COHESION: Composite Graph Convolutional Network with Dual-Stage Fusion for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/multimodal_rec/pre.description: [SIGIR 2025][多模态推荐] 用行为模态早期精炼+晚期注意力融合的双阶段融合，配合异质/同质复合图与自适应BPR，在三个 Amazon 数据集上 R@20 相对提升 4.4%–6.1%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/multimodal_rec/pre.title: Do Recommender Systems Really Leverage Multimodal Content? A Comprehensive Analysis on Multimodal Representations for Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/multimodal_rec/pre.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 用受控噪声实验证明多模态增益源于语义而非模型容量，并以 LVLM 结构化提示生成「原生多模态」[EOS] 嵌入替代晚期融合，Borda 聚合排名第一。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/multimodal_rec/pre.title: Harnessing Multimodal Large Language Models for Multimodal Sequential Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/multimodal_rec/pre.description: [AAAI 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 MLLM 将商品图转为文本摘要，再以循环式提示推断动态用户偏好，SFT 微调 LLaVA 做多模态序列推荐，AUC 最高提升约 4.3%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/poi_spatiotemporal.title: SynthTRIPs: A Knowledge-Grounded Framework for Benchmark Query Generation for Personalized Tourism Recommenders
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/poi_spatiotemporal.description: [SIGIR 2025][LLM4Rec] 用 PersonaHub 人格 + 可持续性过滤器 + KB 接地，让 LLM 批量合成个性化城市游查询，4,604 条查询经 J-LLM 与双专家双轨验证。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/poi_spatiotemporal.title: SPOT-Trip: Dual-Preference Driven Out-of-Town Trip Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/poi_spatiotemporal.description: [NeurIPS 2025][时空轨迹与POI推荐] 首次形式化异地行程推荐，用知识图谱静态偏好+Neural ODE动态偏好解耦建模，F1最高提升17.01%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/poi_spatiotemporal.title: CoMaPOI: A Collaborative Multi-Agent Framework for Next POI Prediction Bridging the Gap Between Trajectory and Language
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/poi_spatiotemporal.description: [SIGIR 2025][时空轨迹与POI推荐] 用 Profiler/Forecaster/Predictor 三智能体把数值轨迹转语言画像、动态收缩候选集并反向推理微调，三数据集全指标提升 4%–12%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/poi_spatiotemporal.title: Adaptive Location Hierarchy Learning for Long-Tailed Mobility Prediction
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/poi_spatiotemporal.description: [WWW 2026][时空轨迹与POI推荐] 提出架构无关插件 ALOHA：LLM+CoT 自动构建城市定制四级语义层级，配合 Gumbel 扰动与节点自适应权重的层级损失，在 6 城数据集上对 RNN/GNN/Transformer/Diffusion 四类骨干一致提升，M@1 最高 +16.59%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/poi_spatiotemporal.title: Towards Full Candidate Interaction: A Comprehensive Comparison Network for Better Route Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2025/poi_spatiotemporal.description: [RecSys 2026][多任务学习与列表级重排] 提出比较优先范式，用非重叠路段构造显式比较张量并在成对空间直接推理，线上CR +1.2%、偏航率 -0.8%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/agent_conversation.title: Review-driven Personalized Preference Reasoning with Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/agent_conversation.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用评论抽取偏好画像并蒸馏逐步推理，评分预测与重排双任务均超 CF 与 LLM 基线，解释性显著提升

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/agent_conversation.title: ThinkRec: Thinking-based Recommendation via LLM
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/agent_conversation.description: [WWW 2026][大语言模型推荐] 以合成推理链激活 LLM 的 System 2 思维，并用实例级 LoRA 专家融合适配异构用户，AUC 平均提升 7.96%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/agent_conversation.title: When and How to Ask: Dynamic Preference Elicitation Strategies for Conversational Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/agent_conversation.description: [SIGIR 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出 InPE 标注数据集与 COPE 分层 MoE 架构，显式建模“何时问、怎么问”的阶段感知偏好引导策略，Recall@10 相对最优基线提升 14.6%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/agent_conversation.title: Reason4Rec: Deliberative User Preference Alignment of Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/agent_conversation.description: [TKDE 2026][大语言模型推荐] 提出审慎推荐任务与三专家多步推理框架，用评论监督偏好蒸馏-匹配-预测，评分预测与排序全面领先。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/agent_conversation.title: LLM-as-a-Judge for Reliable and Explainable Offline Evaluation in Top-K Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/agent_conversation.description: [KDD 2026][去偏公平与工业评测] 用 LLM 从用户文本行为构建语义偏好代理替代 holdout ID 匹配，以 reasoning-then-scoring 生成可解释 Top-K 评测，模型排序一致性较常规测试提升 40–150%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/agent_conversation.title: MemRec: Collaborative Memory-Augmented Agentic Recommender System
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/agent_conversation.description: [ACL 2026][LLM推荐] 将记忆管理从推理中架构解耦，用轻量 LM_Mem 在协同记忆图上做零样本规则剪枝与异步传播，仅向重型 LLM_Rec 注入蒸馏后的高信号协同上下文，四基准全库排序 H@1 最高 +28.98%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/agent_conversation.title: PCL: Prompt-based Continual Learning for User Modeling in Recommender Systems
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/agent_conversation.description: [WWW 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用位置级+上下文提示做持续用户建模，冻结骨干仅训提示，缓解灾难性遗忘，6/8 任务超越 MTL 上界。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/agent_conversation.title: Continual Graph Memory for Adaptive Recommendation under Intent Drift
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/agent_conversation.description: [EMNLP 2026 Findings][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 将知识图谱视为可写双记忆（语义图记忆+情景教训记忆），冻结参数下仅靠质量门控图编辑实现意图漂移自适应重排。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/agent_conversation.title: Personalized Recommendation Tool Learning via Autonomous Language Agents
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/agent_conversation.description: [RecSys 2026][LLM4Rec] 让 LLM 智能体做个性化工具选择、传统推荐模型做全库打分，以架构设计绕开幻觉与上下文长度限制，Full-Ranking 下 R@10 最高提升 68.8%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/agent_conversation.title: Hierarchical Long-Term Semantic Memory for LinkedIn's Hiring Agent
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/agent_conversation.description: [KDD 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] HLTM 用 schema 对齐的层级记忆树 + 多视图表示 + 无损增量索引，为 LinkedIn 招聘智能体实现低延迟、隐私隔离的长期个性化记忆，正确率提升 5%+、检索 F1 提升 10%+。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/agent_conversation.title: Reason4Rec: Deliberative User Preference Alignment of Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/agent_conversation.description: [TKDE 2026][大语言模型推荐] 提出审慎推荐任务与三专家多步推理框架，用评论监督偏好蒸馏-匹配-预测，评分预测与排序全面领先。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/agent_conversation.title: Personalized Recommendation Tool Learning via Autonomous Language Agents
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/agent_conversation.description: [RecSys 2026][LLM4Rec] 让 LLM 智能体做个性化工具选择、传统推荐模型做全库打分，以架构设计绕开幻觉与上下文长度限制，Full-Ranking 下 R@10 最高提升 68.8%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/agent_conversation.title: AgentRecBench: Benchmarking LLM Agent-based Personalized Recommender Systems
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/agent_conversation.description: [NeurIPS 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 首个 LLM 智能体推荐系统基准，构建 U-R-I 文本交互环境与三类场景，揭示结构化工作流智能体显著优于传统与朴素 Agent。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/agent_conversation.title: ReRec: Reasoning-Augmented LLM-based Recommendation Assistant via Reinforcement Fine-tuning
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/agent_conversation.description: [ACL 2026][大语言模型推荐] 用双图奖励塑形、推理感知优势估计与在线课程调度改造 RFT，使 3B LLM 在复杂查询推荐上大幅超越 GRPO 系基线并保留通用能力。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/agent_conversation.title: Ask to Be Sure: Informative Interactions for Confident Multi-Turn LLM Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/agent_conversation.description: [CIKM 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 以推荐列表采样熵的下降量作为信息增益奖励，免真值微调 LLM 多轮对话策略，INSPIRED/ReDial 上 Hit 与对话效率双升。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/agent_conversation.title: Reasoning over Semantic IDs Enhances Generative Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/agent_conversation.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 通过教师模型合成富化语料强化 SID-语言对齐，再用 GRPO 结果驱动强化学习激发 SID 推理，三数据集 Full-Ranking 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/agent_conversation.title: CROWN: A Novel Approach to Comprehending Users' Preferences for Accurate Personalized News Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/agent_conversation.description: [WWW 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 以类别引导意图解耦、标题-内容一致性加权与 GNN 混合用户表征，统一解决新闻推荐的多意图、读后偏好差异与冷启动三大难题。
