venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/debias_fairness_in.description: [NeurIPS 2025][LLM4Rec] 用 LLM 构建粗到细偏好树挖掘欠探索兴趣并合成交互去偏，在 Twitter/Weibo/Amazon 上同时提升多样性与相关性。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/debias_fairness_in.title: Towards Fair Large Language Model-based Recommender Systems without Costly Retraining
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/debias_fairness_in.description: [WWW 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 将 LLM-RS 去偏重构为免重训机器遗忘任务：可学习掩码定位致偏样本 + 影响函数一步参数修正，公平性提升同时精度不降、耗时降 96%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/debias_fairness_in.title: FACTER: Fairness-Aware Conformal Thresholding and Prompt Engineering for Enabling Fair LLM-Based Recommender Systems
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/debias_fairness_in.description: [arXiv 2025][去偏公平与可信推荐] 用保形分位数阈值+违规触发提示工程，在黑盒 LLM 推荐器上闭环降低人口统计偏见，MovieLens 违规数降 95.5% 且精度基本不掉。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/debias_fairness_in.title: Stairway to Fairness: Connecting Group and Individual Fairness
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/debias_fairness_in.description: [RecSys 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 首次用同一族度量（SD/Gini/Atk）在 3 数据集 8 组 LLMRec 运行上实证组公平与个体公平的错位，揭示组间公平掩盖组内与个体不公。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/debias_fairness_in.title: Unmasking Gender Bias in Recommendation Systems and Enhancing Category-Aware Fairness
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/debias_fairness_in.description: [WWW 2025][去偏公平与可信推荐] 提出6个类别感知的性别偏差度量（含排序折扣）与GBS聚合，并以类别覆盖差作正则项，在3数据集上偏差降50–77%而性能损失有限。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/debias_fairness_in.title: Consensus vs. Dissent: Dynamic LLM Modeling of Subjective Preferences in Group Recommenders
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/debias_fairness_in.description: [RecSys 2026][社交与群组推荐] 用人类问卷+DeepSeek-V3.1 蒸馏 CoT 微调 Llama/OLMo 作实时判断模型，动态挑选社会选择聚合策略，用户研究(n=284)中公平与共识得分最高。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/generative_rec/fro.title: Improving Sequential Recommendations via Bidirectional Temporal Data Augmentation with Pre-training
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/generative_rec/fro.description: [TKDE 2025][序列与会话推荐] BARec 用双向时序增强预训练生成保偏好伪先验物品，并以 KL 知识增强微调对齐原/增广序列分布，全库排序下 Beauty Recall@5 提升 16.6%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/generative_rec/fro.title: Collaborative Memory Augmentation for Generative Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/generative_rec/fro.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐] 为生成式推荐引入跨用户协同记忆库，用可学习查询token压缩序列、目标感知检索与门控交叉注意力融合，Full-Ranking下NDCG@5最高提升23.7%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/generative_rec/fro.title: One Sequential Recommendation Model Pretrained from Synthetic Priors Predicts Multiple Datasets
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/generative_rec/fro.description: [KDD 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用 hDCSBM 合成先验预训练 PFN，以支持集条件化实现免更新推理的序列推荐，五基准平均超最优基线 7.53%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/generative_rec/fro.title: Enhancing Time Awareness in Generative Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/generative_rec/fro.description: [EMNLP 2025 Findings][生成式推荐] 将绝对时间戳与目标相对间隔verbalize进提示，并叠加全局转移图与免训练趋势重排，Full-Ranking下R@5最高提升15.4%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/generative_rec/fro.title: FAVE: Flow-based Average Velocity Establishment for Sequential Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/generative_rec/fro.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用语义锚先验替代高斯噪声、以平均速度场实现单步流匹配生成推荐，全库排序下 N@20 相对提升 9.9%，推理提速 20 倍以上。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/generative_rec/wha.title: Beyond Retrieval: Generating Narratives in Conversational Recommender Systems
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/generative_rec/wha.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 构建 REGEN 叙事数据集并提出 CF+内容嵌入经 Adapter 注入 LLM 的融合架构，在 Office/Clothing 两域上 BLEU/ROUGE/语义相似度较单模态提升 4–12%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/generative_rec/wha.title: Reindex-Then-Adapt: Improving Large Language Models for Conversational Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/generative_rec/wha.description: [WSDM 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 将多 token 电影标题重索引为单 token，再用偏置/门控适配目标平台分布，Llama2-7b 上 H@10 相对提升 59.37%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/generative_rec/wha.title: News Without Borders: Domain Adaptation of Multilingual Sentence Embeddings for Cross-lingual News Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/generative_rec/wha.description: [ECIR 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 构建 PolyNews 多语新闻语料，以 DAE+MT 领域适配 LaBSE 得 NaSE，冻结嵌入+晚期点击融合在 ZS-XLT 冷启动新闻推荐上达 SOTA。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/generative_rec/wha.title: FLARE: Fusing Language Models and Collaborative Architectures for Recommender Enhancement
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/generative_rec/wha.description: [WWW 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用冻结 mT5+Perceiver 将文本注入 Bert4Rec，并以重调 Bert4Rec 基线、大词表评测与 Critiquing 任务重估 ID+文本增益。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/generative_rec/wha.title: Large Language Models as Narrative-Driven Recommenders
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/generative_rec/wha.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 系统评测 38 个 LLM 在 Reddit 叙事式电影推荐上的表现，发现零样本提示即可显著超越 doc2vec 基线 70%+，中型开源模型接近大型闭源模型。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/graph_rec/continua.title: Capturing User Interests from Data Streams for Continual Sequential Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/graph_rec/continua.description: [WSDM 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用线性注意力参数化记忆替代回放/正则，配合 Cauchy-Schwarz 归一化与共享兴趣池，在流式数据块上兼顾历史保留与新兴趣获取。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/graph_rec/continua.title: MemRec: Collaborative Memory-Augmented Agentic Recommender System
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/graph_rec/continua.description: [ACL 2026][LLM推荐] 将记忆管理从推理中架构解耦，用轻量 LM_Mem 在协同记忆图上做零样本规则剪枝与异步传播，仅向重型 LLM_Rec 注入蒸馏后的高信号协同上下文，四基准全库排序 H@1 最高 +28.98%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/graph_rec/continua.title: From Recall to Forgetting: Benchmarking Long-Term Memory for Personalized Agents
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/graph_rec/continua.description: [ACL 2026 Findings][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出 Memora 长周期记忆基准与 FAMA 遗忘感知指标，揭示 LLM 与记忆智能体在记忆突变下频繁复用失效记忆。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/graph_rec/continua.title: Continual Recommender Systems
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/graph_rec/continua.description: [CIKM 2025][序列与会话推荐] 系统梳理持续推荐的两大技术路线（经验回放与正则化），并延伸至资源受限与序列交互场景，给出可信性、基础模型与搜推统一三大开放方向。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/graph_rec/continua.title: ReRec: Reasoning-Augmented LLM-based Recommendation Assistant via Reinforcement Fine-tuning
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/graph_rec/continua.description: [ACL 2026][大语言模型推荐] 用双图奖励塑形、推理感知优势估计与在线课程调度改造 RFT，使 3B LLM 在复杂查询推荐上大幅超越 GRPO 系基线并保留通用能力。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/beyond_ret.title: Efficient Sequential Recommendation for Long Term User Interest Via Personalization
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/beyond_ret.description: [ICDM 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用可学习 token 将长历史分段压缩为个性化专家，配合定制注意力掩码与 KV 缓存，在 HSTU/HLLM 上以约 1/4 推理开销逼近全序列精度。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/beyond_ret.title: Towards Next-Generation Recommender Systems: A Benchmark for Personalized Recommendation Assistant with LLMs
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/beyond_ret.description: [WSDM 2026][大语言模型推荐] 构建 RecBench+ 约3万条复杂用户查询基准，覆盖显式/隐式/误导条件与画像偏好，系统评测7个LLM并揭示SFT+RFT两阶段微调最优。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/beyond_ret.title: UQABench: Evaluating User Embedding for Prompting LLMs in Personalized Question Answering
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/beyond_ret.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 提出首个标准化三阶段（预训练-微调-评测）用户嵌入软提示基准，用序列理解/行为预测/兴趣感知三类任务揭示嵌入式生成推荐与文本式相当且省 8-19× token。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/beyond_ret.title: Learning Universal User Representations Leveraging Cross-domain User Intent at Snapchat
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/beyond_ret.description: [SIGIR 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 将 Snapchat 多业务面事件拼接为统一序列训练 Transformer 用户塔，产出跨域通用用户表征，线上多场景 A/B 全面正向。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/beyond_ret.title: Scaling Recommender Transformers to One Billion Parameters
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/beyond_ret.description: [KDD 2026][序列与会话推荐] ARGUS 将自回归预训练解耦为反馈预测与下一物品预测双任务，把推荐 Transformer 编码器扩到 10 亿参数，线上听歌时长 +2.26%、点赞率 +6.37%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/bridging_l.title: Can LLMs Outshine Conventional Recommenders? A Comparative Evaluation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/bridging_l.description: [NeurIPS 2025 DB Track][大语言模型推荐] RecBench 系统对比 17 个 LLM 与 DLRM 在 4 种物品表征、CTR/SeqRec 双任务上的精度-效率权衡，LLM 精度领先但推理慢千倍。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/bridging_l.title: The Mental World of Large Language Models in Recommendation: A Benchmark on Association, Personalization, and Knowledgeability
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/bridging_l.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出 LRWorld 基准（38K 样本/23M tokens），从关联、个性化、知识性三尺度十因素 31 任务系统评测数十个 LLM，揭示其在神经嵌入检索上的致命短板。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/bridging_l.title: FLARE: Fusing Language Models and Collaborative Architectures for Recommender Enhancement
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/bridging_l.description: [WWW 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用冻结 mT5+Perceiver 将文本注入 Bert4Rec，并以重调 Bert4Rec 基线、大词表评测与 Critiquing 任务重估 ID+文本增益。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/bridging_l.title: Semantic IDs for Joint Generative Search and Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/bridging_l.description: [RecSys 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 系统对比任务专属与跨任务语义ID构建策略，发现多任务双塔嵌入+统一RQ-KMeans语义ID在联合搜索推荐中取得最佳权衡。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/bridging_l.title: Exploring the Upper Limits of Text-Based Collaborative Filtering Using Large Language Models: Discoveries and Insights
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/bridging_l.description: [CIKM 2025][LLM4Rec] 将 TCF 物品编码器从 125M 一路放大到 175B，系统检验缩放极限、通用表征、对 IDCF 的竞争力与零样本迁移四项命题。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/eager_enri.title: Towards Context-aware Reasoning-enhanced Generative Searching in E-commerce
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/eager_enri.description: [WWW 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 将电商搜索异构上下文统一为JSON文本与残差K-Means语义ID，用SFT-RL自演化后训练与去偏R-GRPO提升生成式搜索排序，All-100K上HR@10相对提升6.24%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/eager_enri.title: Improving Item Discoverability in e-Commerce Search via Related Intent Generation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/eager_enri.description: [KDD 2026 TSMO][LLM4Rec] 用闭源LLM+蒸馏SLM生成替代/互补/主题三类隐式意图以扩展电商搜索召回，会话购买预测与LLM评审双轨评估，覆盖流量60%→80%、成本仅30%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/eager_enri.title: AI Guided Accelerator For Search Experience
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/eager_enri.description: [SIGIR 2025][序列与会话推荐] 挖掘电商查询转移链并做意图一致性过滤，再用 Solar-10B 指令微调生成多样化替代收敛查询，线上 CTR +32.2%、转化 +38.3%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/eager_enri.title: GenFacet: End-to-End Generative Faceted Search via Multi-Task Preference Alignment in E-Commerce
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/eager_enri.description: [SIGIR 2026][大语言模型推荐] 将电商分面搜索重构为分面生成与查询改写两个耦合生成任务，经蒸馏+SFT+GRPO 对齐搜索效用，线上分面 CTR 相对提升 42.0%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/eager_enri.title: IntSR: An Integrated Generative Framework for Search and Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/eager_enri.description: [CIKM 2026][生成式推荐] 以 query 模态统一搜索/推荐与召回/排序四任务，提出 query 驱动解码器与时间对齐负采样，Amap 线上 GMV+9.34%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/graphlora_.title: Enhancing Collaborative Semantics of Language Model-Driven Recommendations via Graph-Aware Learning
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/graphlora_.description: [TKDE 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用多跳提示+图感知对比学习把 GNN 聚合意图注入 LLM，在三个 Amazon/Yelp 数据集 Full-Ranking 下 HR@10 最高提升约 15%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/graphlora_.title: An Automatic Graph Construction Framework based on Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/graphlora_.description: [KDD 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 用 LLM 逐点生成语义向量 + 残差量化抽取隐因子作额外节点，O(N) 构图并设计元路径聚合，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@10 最高提升 43.57%，华为广告 A/B 提升 RPM 2.69%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/graphlora_.title: Training Large Recommendation Models via Graph-Language Token Alignment
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/graphlora_.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 将 LightGCN 用户/物品节点经投影器对齐进 LLaMA-2 词表空间，用 GLLM logits 匹配层做端到端物品预测，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@10 最高提升 185%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/graphlora_.title: G-Refer: Graph Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Model for Explainable Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/graphlora_.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 用路径级+节点级混合图检索把协同过滤信号显式翻译为文本，经知识剪枝与 RAFT 微调驱动 LLM 生成可解释推荐，BERT-F1 最高提升 2.81%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/graphlora_.title: CORONA: A Coarse-to-Fine Framework for Graph-based Recommendation with Large Language Models
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/graphlora_.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 LLM 做偏好/意图推理在交互图上逐级缩小候选子图，再由 GNN 精排，全库排序下 Recall 平均相对提升 18.6%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/hsuga_llm_.title: Pre-train, Align, and Disentangle: Empowering Sequential Recommendation with Large Language Models
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/hsuga_llm_.description: [SIGIR 2025][LLM推荐] 用 MK-MMD 特征核做推荐锚定对齐，再以三专家频率门控解耦，Full-Ranking 下冷物品 HR@10 提升最高 462%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/hsuga_llm_.title: Bridge the Domains: Large Language Models Enhanced Cross-domain Sequential Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/hsuga_llm_.description: [SIGIR 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用 LLM 语义嵌入+分层画像桥接跨域物品与用户偏好，破解重叠困境与转移复杂性，三数据集 H@10 最高提升 31.7%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/hsuga_llm_.title: CoLLM: Integrating Collaborative Embeddings into Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/hsuga_llm_.description: [TKDE 2025][大语言模型推荐] 将传统协同过滤模型学到的用户/物品表征经 MLP 映射进 LLM 词嵌入空间，以两阶段调优兼顾暖启动与冷启动，AUC 相对 TALLRec 提升约 8%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/hsuga_llm_.title: LLM2Rec: Large Language Models Are Powerful Embedding Models for Sequential Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/hsuga_llm_.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 两阶段将 LLM 改造为融合协同信号与语义的物品嵌入模型，Full-Ranking 下域内平均提升约 15%、跨域仍稳定增益。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/hsuga_llm_.title: Fusion and Alignment Enhancement with Large Language Models for Tail-item Sequential Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/hsuga_llm_.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用自适应门控融合 ID/LLM 嵌入并以双层对齐+课程学习消除空间结构冲突，全库排序下尾部长尾 H@10 最高提升 427%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/memrec_col.title: HARP: Training-Free Dual-Profile Agentic Communication for LLM-Based Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/memrec_col.description: [NeurIPS 2026][大语言模型推荐] 将 LLM 推荐重构为四阶段智能体通信，用双画像、同质性门控检索与单次反思三个免训练算子补齐缺失环节，Hit@1 相对提升 6.9%–24.0%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/memrec_col.title: AgentCF++: Memory-enhanced LLM-based Agents for Popularity-aware Cross-domain Recommendations
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/memrec_col.description: [SIGIR 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 以双层记忆+两步融合+兴趣组共享记忆，令 LLM 用户智能体在跨域场景显式建模流行度影响，采样排序 MRR 平均超 AgentCF 14.6%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/memrec_col.title: AgentDR: Dynamic Recommendation with Implicit Item-Item Relations via LLM-based Agents
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/memrec_col.description: [WWW 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 将全库排序委托给传统推荐工具，用 LLM Agent 做个性化工具加权与替代/互补关系重排，全排序平均提升约两倍。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/memrec_col.title: Personalized Recommendation Tool Learning via Autonomous Language Agents
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/memrec_col.description: [RecSys 2026][LLM4Rec] 让 LLM 智能体做个性化工具选择、传统推荐模型做全库打分，以架构设计绕开幻觉与上下文长度限制，Full-Ranking 下 R@10 最高提升 68.8%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/memrec_col.title: A Survey on LLM-powered Agents for Recommender Systems
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/memrec_col.description: [ACL 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 系统综述 LLM Agent 推荐的三范式（推荐/交互/仿真）与四模块架构，梳理数据集与评测协议并指出统一评测缺失。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/one_pollut.title: Bias Beware: The Impact of Cognitive Biases on LLM-Driven Product Recommendations
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/one_pollut.description: [EMNLP 2025][去偏公平与可信推荐] 首次将人类认知偏差作为黑盒重排攻击注入商品描述，揭示 LLM 推荐器对 social proof 等偏差高度敏感且难以防御。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/one_pollut.title: You Don't Bring Me Flowers: Mitigating Unwanted Recommendations Through Conformal Risk Control
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/one_pollut.description: [RecSys 2025][社交与群组推荐] 用保形风险控制对任意排序器做后处理，以“重复安全内容替换”替代纯删除，在 KuaiRand 上可证明地把不想要内容比例压到用户指定 α 以下且保住 nDCG。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/one_pollut.title: ID-Free Not Risk-Free: LLM-Powered Agents Unveil Risks in ID-Free Recommender Systems
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/one_pollut.description: [SIGIR 2025][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 揭示无ID推荐器可被LLM多智能体改写文本攻击，提出TextSimu攻击与RewriteDetection检测，Hit@50最高提升数倍。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/one_pollut.title: Do LLM Recommenders Know When They're Hallucinating? Auditing Confidence Calibration in Catalog Faithfulness
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/one_pollut.description: [CIKM 2026][大语言模型推荐] 联合审计零样本 LLM 推荐的目录幻觉率与言语化置信度校准，揭示校准误差方向由目录而非模型决定，并给出匹配器验证协议。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/one_pollut.title: Diversity-aware Dual-promotion Poisoning Attack on Sequential Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/one_pollut.description: [SIGIR 2025][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 揭示攻击与推荐目标梯度冲突，提出双提升MSE攻击目标与多样性重排序列生成，在保推荐精度的同时显著提升目标物品曝光。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/rerec_reas.title: R$^2$ec: Towards Large Recommender Models with Reasoning
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/rerec_reas.description: [NeurIPS 2025][LLM4Rec] 双头架构统一推理生成与物品打分，RecPO 融合奖励 RL 联合优化，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@10 最高提升 72%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/rerec_reas.title: Think before Recommendation: Autonomous Reasoning-enhanced Recommender
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/rerec_reas.description: [NeurIPS 2025][LLM4Rec] 用纯 GRPO 强化学习替代教师蒸馏，让单个 LLM 自主习得「用户分析→物品分析→匹配→打分」推理链，评分预测 MAE 最高降 29.9%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/rerec_reas.title: HARPO: Hierarchical Agentic Reasoning for User-Aligned Conversational Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/rerec_reas.description: [ACL 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 将对话推荐重构为多维质量驱动的结构化决策，用分层偏好奖励引导树搜索推理，ReDial R@10 达 29.8%（+18.7%）。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/rerec_reas.title: Reason4Rec: Deliberative User Preference Alignment of Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/rerec_reas.description: [TKDE 2026][大语言模型推荐] 提出审慎推荐任务与三专家多步推理框架，用评论监督偏好蒸馏-匹配-预测，评分预测与排序全面领先。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/rerec_reas.title: Re2LLM: Reflective Reinforcement Large Language Model for Session-based Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/rerec_reas.description: [AAAI 2025][LLM4Rec] 用 LLM 自反思生成纠错提示构建知识库，再以 PPO 训练轻量检索智能体按会话选提示，冻结主干即超越全量训练基线。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/tatk_tripl.title: A Dual-Expert Strategy Integrating LLMs to Mitigate Negative Transfer in Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/tatk_tripl.description: [CIKM 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 用域门控双专家+物品级注意力掩码+双池负采样对比学习，抑制 LLM 跨域序列推荐中的负迁移，10 域上超越 26 个基线，线上 CTR 相对提升 47.6%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/tatk_tripl.title: R$^2$ec: Towards Large Recommender Models with Reasoning
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/tatk_tripl.description: [NeurIPS 2025][LLM4Rec] 双头架构统一推理生成与物品打分，RecPO 融合奖励 RL 联合优化，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@10 最高提升 72%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/tatk_tripl.title: Token-level Collaborative Alignment for LLM-based Generative Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/tatk_tripl.description: [WWW 2026][LLM4Rec] 将CF物品级logits投影为token级分布并与one-hot融合成软标签，以soft-NTP损失显式对齐LLM生成，即插即用提升多骨干推荐效果。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/tatk_tripl.title: Think before Recommendation: Autonomous Reasoning-enhanced Recommender
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/tatk_tripl.description: [NeurIPS 2025][LLM4Rec] 用纯 GRPO 强化学习替代教师蒸馏，让单个 LLM 自主习得「用户分析→物品分析→匹配→打分」推理链，评分预测 MAE 最高降 29.9%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/tatk_tripl.title: Lost in Sequence: Do Large Language Models Understand Sequential Recommendation?
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/tatk_tripl.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 揭示现有 LLM4Rec 模型无法捕捉交互序列顺序信息，提出冻结 LLM 与 CF-SRec、仅训练轻量 MLP 的蒸馏框架 LLM-SRec，在 Amazon 四数据集上 NDCG@10 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/what_makes.title: Every Preference Has Its Strength: Injecting Ordinal Semantics into LLM-Based Recommenders
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/what_makes.description: [SIGIR 2026][LLM推荐] 将显式评分建模为LLM词表中的序数语义锚点，以强度感知对齐交互表征，在序列推荐Hit@1与成对偏好准确率上显著超越CF-LLM混合基线。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/what_makes.title: Lost in Sequence: Do Large Language Models Understand Sequential Recommendation?
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/what_makes.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 揭示现有 LLM4Rec 模型无法捕捉交互序列顺序信息，提出冻结 LLM 与 CF-SRec、仅训练轻量 MLP 的蒸馏框架 LLM-SRec，在 Amazon 四数据集上 NDCG@10 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/what_makes.title: MoRE: A Mixture of Reflectors Framework for Large Language Model-Based Sequential Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/what_makes.description: [RecSys 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用显式/隐式/协同三视角离线反思 + 元反思器自改进与 Contextual Bandit 在线选视角，LLM 序列推荐全库候选下 NDCG@10 最高提升 10.1%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/what_makes.title: Reformulating Sequential Recommendation: Learning Dynamic User Interest with Content-enriched Language Modeling
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/what_makes.description: [DASFAA 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用知识提示+推理提示将序列推荐改写为文本生成任务，GPT-2 冻结主干下在三个数据集全排序协议上取得 Recall@5 相对提升约 5%–12%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/what_makes.title: Beyond Utility: Evaluating LLM as Recommender
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/llm_rec/what_makes.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出含历史长度敏感性、候选位置偏差、画像生成与幻觉四维的 LLM 推荐多维评测框架，揭示 LLM 在重排与冷启动占优但位置偏差严重。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/multimodal_rec/rea.title: Verifiable Reasoning for LLM-based Generative Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/multimodal_rec/rea.description: [SIGIR 2026][大语言模型推荐] 提出 reason-verify-recommend 范式，用混合验证器对隐空间推理逐步审计与修正，四数据集 Recall@10 最高提升约 47%

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/multimodal_rec/rea.title: Causal Deconfounding via Confounder Disentanglement for Dual-Target Cross-Domain Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/multimodal_rec/rea.description: [TOIS 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 显式解耦单域/跨域观测混杂因子，经后门调整保留正向效应并消除负向偏差，七数据集 HR@10 平均提升 6.17%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/multimodal_rec/rea.title: Reinforced Prompt Personalization for Recommendation with Large Language Models
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/multimodal_rec/rea.description: [TOIS 2025][LLM4Rec] 将提示词拆为四类句式模式，用多智能体强化学习为每个用户逐句选择并组合个性化提示，在三个数据集上 NDCG@10 相对任务级提示提升 107%–132%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/multimodal_rec/rea.title: Collab-Rec: An LLM-based Agentic Framework for Balancing Recommendations in Tourism
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/multimodal_rec/rea.description: [TORS 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 三角色 LLM 智能体 + 确定性 Moderator 多轮约束精炼，在 900 条旅游查询上兼顾约束满足与长尾多样性。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/multimodal_rec/rea.title: CoFiRec: Coarse-to-Fine Tokenization for Generative Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/multimodal_rec/rea.description: [RecSys 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 将物品元数据按类目→标题→描述→CF信号分层独立量化，自回归由粗到细解码，Leave-One-Out全库排序下平均超越SOTA约6.4%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/rl_bandit_rec/worl.title: Large Language Model driven Policy Exploration for Recommender Systems
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/rl_bandit_rec/worl.description: [WSDM 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用 LLM 蒸馏用户偏好离线预训练 A2C 推荐策略，并提出冻结+可学习双策略自适应在线适配，显著提升冷启动回报与长期收益。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/rl_bandit_rec/worl.title: LLM-Powered User Simulator for Recommender System
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/rl_bandit_rec/worl.description: [AAAI 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用 LLM 离线蒸馏物品优缺点关键词，构建关键词匹配+语义相似+序列统计三模型集成用户模拟器，为 RL 推荐提供可解释高保真环境。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/rl_bandit_rec/worl.title: Long-term User Engagement Optimization through Model-agnostic Downstream Rewards Learning
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/rl_bandit_rec/worl.description: [RecSys 2026][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 以 P2P 兔子洞深度、浅层关闭负奖励与新用例采纳三类下游奖励替代稀疏留存标签，在 Pinterest 多场景线上 A/B 中稳定提升会话与留存指标。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/rl_bandit_rec/worl.title: Beyond Static LLM Policies: Imitation-Enhanced Reinforcement Learning for Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/rl_bandit_rec/worl.description: [ICDM 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用 LLM 轨迹作次优示范，经对抗逆强化学习提取奖励并加权模仿，离线 RL 策略在 Steam/Amazon 上累积奖励较 BiLLP 提升 13%+。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/rl_bandit_rec/worl.title: Reward Balancing Revisited: Enhancing Offline Reinforcement Learning for Recommender Systems
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/rl_bandit_rec/worl.description: [WWW 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用扩散世界模型显式建模奖励不确定性，并以衰减加权的交互/熵双惩罚平衡多样性与长期收益，在三个真实数据集上刷新离线RL推荐SOTA。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/sequential_rec/two.title: What Makes LLMs Effective Sequential Recommenders? A Study on Preference Intensity and Temporal Context
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/sequential_rec/two.description: [ACL 2026][大语言模型推荐] 揭示二元偏好对齐丢失偏好强度与时序上下文，提出自适应奖励边际 RecPO，五数据集 HR@1 全面领先 S-DPO。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/sequential_rec/two.title: RoTE: Coarse-to-Fine Multi-Level Rotary Time Embedding for Sequential Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/sequential_rec/two.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 将时间戳分解为年/月/日多粒度并借 RoPE 旋转注入 Q/K，即插即用提升 SASRec/RPG，NDCG@5 最高 +20.11%

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/sequential_rec/two.title: Empowering Sequential Recommendation from Collaborative Signals and Semantic Relatedness
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/sequential_rec/two.description: [DASFAA 2024][序列与会话推荐] 双流 Transformer 分别编码 ID 与内容序列，用用户级/物品级分层对比对齐跨模态语义鸿沟，全库排序下 NDCG@10 最高提升 15.44%。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/sequential_rec/two.title: TruthSR: Trustworthy Sequential Recommender Systems via User-generated Multimodal Content
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/sequential_rec/two.description: [DASFAA 2025][多模态推荐] 用评论-图片跨模态一致性降噪 + 主观逻辑证据融合做可信序列推荐，四数据集 Full-Ranking 全面超越 MMSRec。

venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/sequential_rec/two.title: SIGMA: Selective Gated Mamba for Sequential Recommendation
venues/ACL_EMNLP/2026/sequential_rec/two.description: [AAAI 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用部分翻转双向 Mamba + 输入敏感稠密门控 + FE-GRU 解决 Mamba 单向性与短序列状态不稳问题，五数据集 Full-Ranking 上 HR@10 最高提升 8.82%。

venues/ACM_MM/2025/cold_start_rec/tackli.title: Device-Cloud Collaborative Correction for On-Device Recommendation
venues/ACM_MM/2025/cold_start_rec/tackli.description: [IJCAI 2025][序列与会话推荐] 端侧 TTT 自校正网络 + 云端全局校正网络，以 RNN 级开销逼近 Transformer 精度，UAUC 最高提升 4.56%。

venues/ACM_MM/2025/cold_start_rec/tackli.title: CHORD: Customizing Hybrid-precision On-device Model for Sequential Recommendation with Device-cloud Collaboration
venues/ACM_MM/2025/cold_start_rec/tackli.description: [ACM MM 2025][序列与会话推荐] 云端超网络按用户画像生成逐通道混合精度量化策略（2-bit 编码），端侧单次前向完成个性化适配与推理，精度反超全精度基线且传输降 173.8×。

venues/ACM_MM/2025/cold_start_rec/tackli.title: Paragon: Parameter Generation for Controllable Multi-Task Recommendation
venues/ACM_MM/2025/cold_start_rec/tackli.description: [RecSys 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用扩散模型按偏好权重条件生成适配器参数，免重训实现测试时可控多任务推荐，响应时间降低 94.6%+。

venues/ACM_MM/2025/cold_start_rec/tackli.title: Collaboration of Large Language Models and Small Recommendation Models for Device-Cloud Recommendation
venues/ACM_MM/2025/cold_start_rec/tackli.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 提出端云协同 LSC4Rec：云端 LLM 召回+设备端 SRM 实时重排，配合协同训练、分数融合与不一致度触发请求，Beauty 平均提升 16.18%。

venues/ACM_MM/2025/cold_start_rec/tackli.title: Forward Once for All: Structural Parameterized Adaptation for Efficient Cloud-coordinated On-device Recommendation
venues/ACM_MM/2025/cold_start_rec/tackli.description: [KDD 2025][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 用结构控制器+结构引导映射器为每台设备动态组装子网络，一次前向即完成端侧适配，兼顾隐私、带宽与算力。

venues/ACM_MM/2025/cross_domain_multi_sc.title: Exploring Preference-Guided Diffusion Model for Cross-Domain Recommendation
venues/ACM_MM/2025/cross_domain_multi_sc.description: [KDD 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用源域交互历史构造偏好引导信号，逐步注入扩散逆向过程生成目标域冷启动用户表征，三场景 MAE 最高降 32.60%。

venues/ACM_MM/2025/cross_domain_multi_sc.title: Just Ask for Music (JAM): Multimodal and Personalized Natural Language Music Recommendation
venues/ACM_MM/2025/cross_domain_multi_sc.description: [RecSys 2025][多模态推荐] 将查询建模为用户到物品的向量平移，用交叉注意力聚合音频/歌词/CF 多模态，在 JAMSessions 全库排序上 NDCG@10 相对 TalkRec 提升约 105%

venues/ACM_MM/2025/cross_domain_multi_sc.title: Distribution-Guided Auto-Encoder for User Multimodal Interest Cross Fusion
venues/ACM_MM/2025/cross_domain_multi_sc.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 以行为粒度做模态内/模态间交叉融合，并用兴趣分布解码器作自监督约束，工业 A/B 上 CTR +12.9%。

venues/ACM_MM/2025/cross_domain_multi_sc.title: Uncovering Cross-Domain Recommendation Ability of Large Language Models
venues/ACM_MM/2025/cross_domain_multi_sc.description: [WWW 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用源域购买序列+跨域引导提示驱动 LLM 零样本重排目标域候选，揭示域间隙与模型规模对跨域迁移的决定性影响。

venues/ACM_MM/2025/cross_domain_multi_sc.title: Harnessing Multimodal Large Language Models for Multimodal Sequential Recommendation

venues/ACM_MM/2025/debias_fairness_indus.title: Obliviate: Efficient Unlearning in Recommender Systems
