venues/ACM_MM/2026/multimodal_rec/beyond.title: WPGRec: Wavelet Packet Guided Graph Enhanced Sequential Recommendation
venues/ACM_MM/2026/multimodal_rec/beyond.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用平稳小波包变换生成等长平移不变子带，在子带内做 Chebyshev 图传播并以能量-谱平坦度门控融合，Full-Ranking 下稀疏数据集 HR@20 最高 +15.4%。

venues/ACM_MM/2026/multimodal_rec/beyond.title: LLM2Rec: Large Language Models Are Powerful Embedding Models for Sequential Recommendation
venues/ACM_MM/2026/multimodal_rec/beyond.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 两阶段将 LLM 改造为融合协同信号与语义的物品嵌入模型，Full-Ranking 下域内平均提升约 15%、跨域仍稳定增益。

venues/ACM_MM/2026/multimodal_rec/beyond.title: Empowering Sequential Recommendation from Collaborative Signals and Semantic Relatedness
venues/ACM_MM/2026/multimodal_rec/beyond.description: [DASFAA 2024][序列与会话推荐] 双流 Transformer 分别编码 ID 与内容序列，用用户级/物品级分层对比对齐跨模态语义鸿沟，全库排序下 NDCG@10 最高提升 15.44%。

venues/ACM_MM/2026/multimodal_rec/one_gr.title: MLLMRec: A Preference Reasoning Paradigm with Graph Refinement for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/ACM_MM/2026/multimodal_rec/one_gr.description: [SIGIR 2026][多模态推荐] 用 MLLM 推理用户偏好画像替代噪声聚合初始化，并以阈值去噪+共现增强精修物品图，三数据集 11/12 指标 SOTA。

venues/ACM_MM/2026/multimodal_rec/one_gr.title: COHESION: Composite Graph Convolutional Network with Dual-Stage Fusion for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/ACM_MM/2026/multimodal_rec/one_gr.description: [SIGIR 2025][多模态推荐] 用行为模态早期精炼+晚期注意力融合的双阶段融合，配合异质/同质复合图与自适应BPR，在三个 Amazon 数据集上 R@20 相对提升 4.4%–6.1%。

venues/ACM_MM/2026/multimodal_rec/one_gr.title: Beyond Graph Convolution: Multimodal Recommendation with Topology-aware MLPs
venues/ACM_MM/2026/multimodal_rec/one_gr.description: [AAAI 2025][多模态推荐] 用拓扑剪枝+邻域对齐损失替代GCN消息传递，以MLP建模多模态物品关系，全库排序下Recall@10最高提升7.53%

venues/ACM_MM/2026/multimodal_rec/one_gr.title: VI-MMRec: Similarity-Aware Training Cost-free Virtual User-Item Interactions for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/ACM_MM/2026/multimodal_rec/one_gr.description: [KDD 2026][多模态推荐] 用模态相似度构造虚拟交互矩阵并以统计权重融合，零训练开销即插即用地缓解多模态推荐数据稀疏，Full-Ranking 下 Recall@10 最高提升 22.25%。

venues/ACM_MM/2026/multimodal_rec/one_gr.title: Information-Guided Selective Modality-Interest Alignment for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/ACM_MM/2026/multimodal_rec/one_gr.description: [CIKM 2026][多模态推荐] 以互信息/条件熵分解为理论视角，用行为校准图精炼+兴趣对比+共享子空间选择性对齐，三数据集 Full-Ranking 全面 SOTA。

venues/CIKM/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: R4ec: A Reasoning, Reflection, and Refinement Framework for Recommendation Systems
venues/CIKM/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [RecSys 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用 actor/reflection 双小模型迭代反思精炼 LLM 知识，注入 CTR 主干，AUC 相对提升 2.5%+，线上收入 +2.2%。

venues/CIKM/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: R$^2$ec: Towards Large Recommender Models with Reasoning
venues/CIKM/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [NeurIPS 2025][LLM4Rec] 双头架构统一推理生成与物品打分，RecPO 融合奖励 RL 联合优化，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@10 最高提升 72%。

venues/CIKM/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: ThinkRec: Thinking-based Recommendation via LLM
venues/CIKM/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [WWW 2026][大语言模型推荐] 以合成推理链激活 LLM 的 System 2 思维，并用实例级 LoRA 专家融合适配异构用户，AUC 平均提升 7.96%。

venues/CIKM/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: AgentRecBench: Benchmarking LLM Agent-based Personalized Recommender Systems
venues/CIKM/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [NeurIPS 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 首个 LLM 智能体推荐系统基准，构建 U-R-I 文本交互环境与三类场景，揭示结构化工作流智能体显著优于传统与朴素 Agent。

venues/CIKM/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: Think before Recommendation: Autonomous Reasoning-enhanced Recommender
venues/CIKM/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [NeurIPS 2025][LLM4Rec] 用纯 GRPO 强化学习替代教师蒸馏，让单个 LLM 自主习得「用户分析→物品分析→匹配→打分」推理链，评分预测 MAE 最高降 29.9%。

venues/CIKM/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: On Mitigating Data Sparsity in Conversational Recommender Systems
venues/CIKM/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [CIKM 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] DACRS 用 LLM 两阶段对话增强 + KG 实体替换与相似度约束 + 对话引导注意力融合，缓解对话与实体双重稀疏，ReDial R@50 提升 11.46%。

venues/CIKM/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: Improving Conversational Recommendation with Contextual Adaptation of External Recommenders and LLM-based Reranking
venues/CIKM/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [ECIR 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用轻量实体级序列推荐器产出候选、LLM 做上下文适配重排，ReDial/INSPIRED 上 H@5 平均提升 54%/25%。

venues/CIKM/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: Bridging Conversational and Collaborative Signals for Conversational Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [WWW 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 构建 Reddit-ML32M 跨源数据集，用 SASRec 协同嵌入对 GPT-3.5 零样本推荐做相似度重排，H@5 提升 12.32%。

venues/CIKM/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: Enhancing Collaborative Semantics of Language Model-Driven Recommendations via Graph-Aware Learning
venues/CIKM/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [TKDE 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用多跳提示+图感知对比学习把 GNN 聚合意图注入 LLM，在三个 Amazon/Yelp 数据集 Full-Ranking 下 HR@10 最高提升约 15%。

venues/CIKM/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: RecQuest: Towards Estimating User Domain Knowledge in Conversational Recommender Systems
venues/CIKM/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [SIGIR 2026 (ICTIR)][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出游戏化数据采集协议 RecQuest 与知识估计新任务，用客观问卷替代自评建立 ground truth，并给出 LLM 零/少样本与微调基线。

venues/CIKM/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: Task-Aware Automated User Profile Generation for Recommendation Simulation Using Large Language Models
venues/CIKM/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [SIGIR 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出免训练三阶段画像生成框架 APG4RecSim，用语义合并+反事实因果映射将交互历史转为任务对齐画像，在判别/排序/评分三任务上取得最佳综合表现。

venues/CIKM/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: AgentRecBench: Benchmarking LLM Agent-based Personalized Recommender Systems
venues/CIKM/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [NeurIPS 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 首个 LLM 智能体推荐系统基准，构建 U-R-I 文本交互环境与三类场景，揭示结构化工作流智能体显著优于传统与朴素 Agent。

venues/CIKM/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: A Survey on LLM-powered Agents for Recommender Systems
venues/CIKM/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [ACL 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 系统综述 LLM Agent 推荐的三范式（推荐/交互/仿真）与四模块架构，梳理数据集与评测协议并指出统一评测缺失。

venues/CIKM/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: RecoWorld: Building Simulated Environments for Agentic Recommender Systems
venues/CIKM/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [WWW 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出双视角LLM仿真环境，用户模拟器在多轮交互中发出反思指令，驱动指令遵循推荐器优化留存，并给出三种历史建模方案与多智能体群体仿真蓝图。

venues/CIKM/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: RecUserSim: A Realistic and Diverse User Simulator for Evaluating Conversational Recommender Systems
venues/CIKM/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [WWW 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出四模块 LLM Agent 用户模拟器，以有限理性三层 Rating-Action-Response 机制实现真实角色扮演、多样人群覆盖与显式打分，并落地华为 Celia 餐饮助手。

venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/csrm_llm.title: Alibaba International E-commerce Product Search Competition DcuRAGONs Team Technical Report
venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/csrm_llm.description: [CIKM 2025][LLM4Rec] 以 Gemma-3-12B 为骨干，用翻译增强+任务自适应预训练+类别感知查询分组划分，在阿里国际电商多语言相关性竞赛夺冠（F1_avg≈89.1）。

venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/csrm_llm.title: Relevance Matters: A Multi-Task and Multi-Stage Large Language Model Approach for E-commerce Query Rewriting
venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/csrm_llm.description: [ICDE 2026][LLM4Rec] 将相关性打标任务注入电商查询改写，多任务 SFT + 查询级归一化 GRPO 融合奖励对齐，离线召回 67.94%、线上 UCVR +0.181%。

venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/csrm_llm.title: Improving Item Discoverability in e-Commerce Search via Related Intent Generation
venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/csrm_llm.description: [KDD 2026 TSMO][LLM4Rec] 用闭源LLM+蒸馏SLM生成替代/互补/主题三类隐式意图以扩展电商搜索召回，会话购买预测与LLM评审双轨评估，覆盖流量60%→80%、成本仅30%。

venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/csrm_llm.title: Scaling Multilingual Semantic Search in Uber Eats Delivery
venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/csrm_llm.description: [KDD 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 基于 gte-Qwen2 双塔统一多语言多垂类语义召回，InfoNCE+Triplet NCE 两阶段训练与 MRL 多维度服务，Store R@20 相对 Legacy 提升 88%。

venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/csrm_llm.title: SMART: LLM-Augmented Hybrid Retrieval for Dynamic Product Ads
venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/csrm_llm.description: [RecSys 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 揭示规则查询擅长 BM25 重定向、LLM 查询擅长 ANN 拓客的检索分解，用输出审计门控仅路由 10% 用户，线上转化率 +27.6%

venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/harnessi.title: Uncertainty-aware Generative Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/harnessi.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 将生成置信度与样本难度转化为GRPO奖励与梯度权重，并显式对齐置信度token，稳定训练并支持风险感知推荐。

venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/harnessi.title: LLM Reasoning for Cold-Start Item Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/harnessi.description: [WWW 2026][冷启动与长尾推荐] 在 Netflix 冷启动重排任务上系统对比结构化推理、软自洽与 SFT/GRPO 混合微调，推理微调模型在 Discovery 指标上超越线上生产排序模型最高 8%。

venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/harnessi.title: Sparse Contrastive Learning for Content-Based Cold Item Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/harnessi.description: [SIGIR 2026][冷启动与长尾推荐] 抛弃 CF 对齐、纯内容空间 item-item 相似度建模，用 α-entmax 稀疏化 sampled softmax 并支持内容空间蒸馏，冷物品排序与曝光公平性双赢。

venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/harnessi.title: Uncertainty Quantification and Decomposition for LLM-based Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/harnessi.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 用 Plackett-Luce 单次推理估计列表排序预测熵，并分解为推荐/提示不确定性，指导不确定性感知提示提升 N@20 约 17%。

venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/harnessi.title: Let It Go? Not Quite: Addressing Item Cold Start in Sequential Recommendations with Content-Based Initialization
venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/harnessi.description: [RecSys 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 冻结内容嵌入+有界可训练 delta 校正，兼顾冷启动物品语义结构与热物品任务适配，三数据集冷启动 NDCG@10 最高提升 20.9%。

venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/multi_mo.title: Efficient Multimodal Streaming Recommendation via Expandable Side Mixture-of-Experts
venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/multi_mo.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 冻结 BERT/ViT 主干，用可扩展侧调 MoE 增量吸收新时段知识并按利用率剪枝，在三个流式数据集上 HR@10 全面超越 SOTA 且显存/训练时间更省。

venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/multi_mo.title: Well Begun is Half Done: Training-Free and Model-Agnostic Semantically Guaranteed User Representation Initialization for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/multi_mo.description: [SIGIR 2026][多模态推荐] 用交互物品模态特征+聚类全局语义免训练初始化用户表征，弥合用户-物品语义鸿沟，六模型四数据集Recall@5最高提升36.4%。

venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/multi_mo.title: CAMMSR: Category-Guided Attentive Mixture of Experts for Multimodal Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/multi_mo.description: [ICDE 2026][多模态推荐] 用类别预测任务引导注意力 MoE 动态分配模态权重，并以模态交换对比学习对齐跨模态序列表征，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@5 最高提升 15.3%。

venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/multi_mo.title: PRISM: Personalized Recommendation via Information Synergy Module
venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/multi_mo.description: [WWW 2026][多模态推荐] 用 MoE 显式分解模态唯一/冗余/协同信息并以用户偏好动态重加权，即插即用提升三类序列骨干，Yelp N@10 超最强基线 10.91%。

venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/multi_mo.title: Multimodal Quantitative Language for Generative Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/multi_mo.description: [ICLR 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用 RQ-VAE 将多域多模态物品翻译为统一量化语言，配合多任务预训练微调实现知识迁移，全库排序下 NDCG@10 最高提升 14.82%。

venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/shallow_.title: Recommendation Is a Dish Better Served Warm
venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/shallow_.description: [RecSys 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 系统量化冷启动阈值：物品侧训练交互扫描+用户侧推理历史截断，揭示 6–15 条交互的冷热分界并批判 p-core 过滤的任意性。

venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/shallow_.title: Denoising Implicit Feedback for Cold-start Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/shallow_.description: [KDD 2026][冷启动与长尾推荐] 用内容相似热物品协同表征为冷物品生成置信加权伪标签，并以相对熵×冷启动状态估计样本不确定性做自适应软标签纠正，快手十亿级 A/B 全指标提升。

venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/shallow_.title: Personalized Diffusion Model Reshapes Cold-Start Bundle Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/shallow_.description: [WWW 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 用个性化条件扩散在分布空间生成捆绑包，配合解耦自注意力与KL正则，冷启动捆绑推荐全库排序Recall@20最高提升1155%。

venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/shallow_.title: Learning Sparse Representations of Multimodal Content for Enhanced Cold Item Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/shallow_.description: [RecSys 2026][冷启动与长尾推荐] 将多模态内容冷启动表征改为 top-K 稀疏嵌入，并用 α-entmax 预稀疏激活诱导锐化与去噪，冷启动 NDCG@20 提升 16.6%–75.5% 且存储更低。

venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/shallow_.title: On Inherited Popularity Bias in Cold-Start Item Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/cold_start_rec/shallow_.description: [RecSys 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 揭示生成式冷启动模型继承热模型流行度偏置，提出基于向量模长重标定的免训练后处理去偏方法，在三个多媒体数据集上显著提升物品公平性与曝光多样性。

venues/CIKM/2025/collaborative_filtering.title: Enhancing Graph Collaborative Filtering with FourierKAN Feature Transformation
venues/CIKM/2025/collaborative_filtering.description: [CIKM 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 用 Fourier KAN 替代 NGCF 中被误删的交互特征变换 W2，在 7:1:2 时间切分全库排序下 R@20 最高提升 7.8%，且可作即插即用骨干。

venues/CIKM/2025/collaborative_filtering.title: PULSE: Socially-Aware User Representation Modeling Toward Parameter-Efficient Graph Collaborative Filtering
venues/CIKM/2025/collaborative_filtering.description: [WWW 2026][社交与群组推荐] 用社区结构与社交邻居物品信号替代显式用户嵌入，参数降 50% 且 NDCG@20 提升 8-9%

venues/CIKM/2025/collaborative_filtering.title: Memory Is No Longer a Bottleneck: Memory-Efficient Graph Filtering for Scalable Collaborative Filtering
venues/CIKM/2025/collaborative_filtering.description: [TKDE 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用逐用户 Krylov 子空间替代全量物品相似度图，实现免训练多项式图滤波，内存降 5.74×、推理加速 26× 且精度反超 SOTA。

venues/CIKM/2025/collaborative_filtering.title: Graph Cross-Correlated Network for Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/collaborative_filtering.description: [TKDE 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 用非递归 PGR 保留各跳邻居纯语义，再以 HCC/ECC 显式建模用户-物品子图交叉相关项，全库排序下 NDCG@20 平均提升约 1.8%–2.9%。

venues/CIKM/2025/collaborative_filtering.title: ContextGNN: Beyond Two-Tower Recommendation Systems
venues/CIKM/2025/collaborative_filtering.description: [ICLR 2025][图神经网络推荐] 提出局部成对表征+全局双塔回退的混合GNN架构，在RelBench十个任务上平均MAP较最强成对基线提升20%。

venues/CIKM/2025/collaborative_filtering.title: Efficient Learning of Sparse Representations from Interactions
venues/CIKM/2025/collaborative_filtering.description: [WWW 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 在 ELSA 线性自编码器训练中渐进剪枝学习高维稀疏物品嵌入，实现最高 100× 压缩仅损 2.5% nDCG，并派生可解释语义分段。

venues/CIKM/2025/collaborative_filtering.title: Quantifying User Coherence: A Unified Framework for Analyzing Recommender Systems Across Domains
venues/CIKM/2025/collaborative_filtering.description: [WWW 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 提出 Mean Surprise 与 Mean Conditional Surprise 两个信息论度量刻画用户画像一致性，揭示复杂模型增益集中于高一致用户，并支撑分层评测与用户分群建模。

venues/CIKM/2025/collaborative_filtering.title: Orthogonal Low Rank Embedding Stabilization
venues/CIKM/2025/collaborative_filtering.description: [RecSys 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用低秩SVD+正交Procrustes把重训后的用户/物品嵌入对齐到固定参考空间，保内积无损，跨期余弦相似度从0.01升至0.82

venues/CIKM/2025/collaborative_filtering.title: User-Adaptive Meta-Learning for Cold-Start Medication Recommendation with Uncertainty Filtering
venues/CIKM/2025/collaborative_filtering.description: [ICDE 2026][冷启动与长尾推荐] 提出两级元自适应（自自适应+同伴自适应）与不确定性过滤的 MetaDrug，在 MIMIC-III/AKI 冷启动患者上 PRAUC 提升约 2.5%-6.2%。

venues/CIKM/2025/collaborative_filtering.title: RankGraph: Unified Heterogeneous Graph Learning for Cross-Domain Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/collaborative_filtering.description: [RecSys 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 构建跨产品异构异质图，用 GPU 加速 RGCN + 对比学习产出图 token 注入推荐基础模型，线上 CTR +0.92%、CVR +2.82%。

venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: CDC: Causal Domain Clustering for Multi-Domain Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [SIGIR 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用孤立/混合双亲和矩阵+因果发现系数自适应融合，联合优化目标域簇与训练源域集，50+域上DomainAUC提升4.14‰/6.76‰，线上eCPM+4.9%

venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Measure Domain's Gap: A Similar Domain Selection Principle for Multi-Domain Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [KDD 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用原型距离+bandit动态为每个域挑选相似域子集，解耦共享专家以缓解多域推荐负迁移，三数据集AUC稳定提升。

venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: FeDecider: An LLM-Based Framework for Federated Cross-Domain Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [WWW 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 联邦跨域 LLM 推荐中，服务器只广播 LoRA 更新的方向分量以消除尺度噪声，客户端用可学习个性化权重做数据感知融合，Goodreads 平均 Hit@5 提升 3.8%。

venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: A Unified Framework for Multi-Domain CTR Prediction via Large Language Models
venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [TOIS 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用 LLM 分层语义表征作跨域共享底座、可插拔 DSN 建模域特性，掩码损失解耦梯度，AUC 相对提升 24%–63% 并支持零样本新域。

venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: ABXI: Invariant Interest Adaptation for Task-Guided Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [WWW 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用任务引导对齐消除预测错配，并以 dLoRA/iLoRA 双 LoRA 抽取域不变兴趣，三数据集 MRR 大幅超越 CDSR 基线。

venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: The Future is Sparse: Embedding Compression for Scalable Retrieval in Recommender Systems
venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [RecSys 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用余弦重建的稀疏自编码器把稠密向量压成高维 k-稀疏向量，免重训骨干，12× 压缩仅损 1.35% CTR，线上显著优于同尺寸 Matryoshka。

venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: CORONA: A Coarse-to-Fine Framework for Graph-based Recommendation with Large Language Models
venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 LLM 做偏好/意图推理在交互图上逐级缩小候选子图，再由 GNN 精排，全库排序下 Recall 平均相对提升 18.6%。

venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Efficient Learning of Sparse Representations from Interactions
venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [WWW 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 在 ELSA 线性自编码器训练中渐进剪枝学习高维稀疏物品嵌入，实现最高 100× 压缩仅损 2.5% nDCG，并派生可解释语义分段。

venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Rethinking LLM-Based Recommendations: A Personalized Query-Driven Parallel Integration
venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [ACL 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出 QUEREC 并行框架，用 LLM 零样本生成个性化用户查询与特征增强物品描述，与 CF 模型并行全库检索后自适应重排，Full-Ranking 下最高提升 57%。

venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: An Automatic Graph Construction Framework based on Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [KDD 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 用 LLM 逐点生成语义向量 + 残差量化抽取隐因子作额外节点，O(N) 构图并设计元路径聚合，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@10 最高提升 43.57%，华为广告 A/B 提升 RPM 2.69%。

venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Reinforcing User Interest Evolution in Multi-Scenario Learning for recommender systems
venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [CIKM 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用 Double Q-learning 估计场景级行为置信度作为门控，加权三元组对比损失以抑制多场景负迁移，KuaiSAR 全库排序 N@20 提升约 3.3 倍。

venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: MVIGER: Multi-View Variational Integration of Complementary Knowledge for Generative Recommender
venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐] 将模板-索引组合视为隐变量视图，用可学习先验做变分集成，Full-Ranking 下 H@10 最高提升约 26%。

venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: PERSCEN: Learning Personalized Interaction Pattern and Scenario Preference for Multi-Scenario Matching
venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [KDD 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用用户专属特征图 + VQ 码本蒸馏场景感知偏好 + 渐进式 GLU 融合，在 KuaiRand/Alimama 四场景召回上全面超越 ADIN/SASS/M5。

venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: TBGRecall: A Generative Retrieval Model for E-commerce Recommendation Scenarios
venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [CIKM 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 提出 Next Session Prediction 会话级非自回归生成召回，配合 Session Mask、MSP/MoE 与部分增量训练，淘宝线上成交额 +2.16%。

venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Towards Personalized Federated Multi-Scenario Multi-Task Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [WSDM 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 首个联邦多场景多任务推荐框架 PF-MSMTrec，通过专家参数解耦、联邦批归一化与冲突协调缓解数据/模型/任务三级冲突，AliExpress 与 Tenrec 上 CTR/CTCVR AUC 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Time to Split: Exploring Data Splitting Strategies for Offline Evaluation of Sequential Recommenders
venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [RecSys 2025][序列与会话推荐] 系统对比 LOO 与全局时间切分及目标/验证变体，揭示 LOO 时序泄漏与排序失真，推荐 GTS+Last/Random/Successive 协议。

venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: RecFlow: An Industrial Full Flow Recommendation Dataset
venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [ICLR 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 首个覆盖工业六阶段漏斗全流程的推荐数据集，含1.9B阶段样本，揭示训练-服务分布偏移并验证阶段样本作为难负例与级联蒸馏的显著收益。

venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: RecNextEval: A Reference Implementation for Temporal Next-Batch Recommendation Evaluation
venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [SIGIR 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 提出滑动时间窗 next-batch 评估框架，强制全局时间线防泄漏并支持增量学习，含 Python 库与 Web UI。

venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Reinforcing User Interest Evolution in Multi-Scenario Learning for recommender systems
venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [CIKM 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用 Double Q-learning 估计场景级行为置信度作为门控，加权三元组对比损失以抑制多场景负迁移，KuaiSAR 全库排序 N@20 提升约 3.3 倍。

venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Trinity: A Scenario-Aware Recommendation Framework for Large-Scale Cold-Start Users
venues/CIKM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [WWW 2026][冷启动与长尾推荐] 面向十亿级产品迁移的“特征-架构-更新”三位一体冷启动框架，Copilot 新场景 AUC 0.564→0.726、COPC 0.13→0.95，线上时长 +5.61%。

venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: LFM4Ads: Large Foundation Model for Ads Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [CIKM 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 腾讯广告提出预训练-迁移范式，联合迁移用户/物品/交叉表征，以时间感知EMA聚合样本级CR解耦上游推理，三级粒度下游复用，离线AUC+0.0189、线上GMV+2.45%。

venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Bidding-Aware Retrieval for Multi-Stage Consistency in Online Advertising
venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [CIKM 2026][CTR预估与特征交叉] 将竞价信号注入召回打分，用单调性约束+多任务蒸馏+任务注意力精炼实现召回-精排 eCPM 一致性，线上收入 +4.32%。

venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: EGR: Embedding-Native Generative Retrieval with a Shared LLM
venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [RecSys 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用单一共享 LLM 同时编码物品与用户历史，以双对比损失联合训练，免量化免 grounding，线上 CVR +2.91%

venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: InteractRank: Personalized Web-Scale Search Pre-Ranking with Cross Interaction Features
venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [WWW 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 在双塔预排序点积之上叠加历史交互统计特征 IQP 与实时用户序列，以 1.1× FLOPs 实现线上 SIFR +6.5%、F1S +9.2%。

venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Unified Supervision for Walmart's Sponsored Search Retrieval via Joint Semantic Relevance and Behavioral Engagement Modeling
venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [SIGIR 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 以语义相关性为主监督、互动为相关项内偏好信号，融合交叉编码器分级标签、多通道检索先验与去偏互动构建统一双塔训练目标，离线 P@25 +10.5%、NDCG@25 +5.7%。

venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: CTR-Sink: Attention Sink for Language Models in Click-Through Rate Prediction
venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [KDD 2026][CTR预估与特征交叉] 在文本化行为序列中插入携带时间距离的 [SINK] 锚点并配合两阶段训练与 sink 间注意力增强，缓解语义碎片化，AUC 稳定提升 0.2–0.6%。

venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Mixture of Sequence: Theme-Aware Mixture-of-Experts for Long-Sequence Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [WWW 2026][序列与会话推荐] 揭示长序列“会话跳跃”现象，用主题码本路由+多尺度专家融合做子序列抽取，AUC 平均提升 0.68% 且 FLOPs 更低

venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Native Multimodal Representation Learning for Click-Through Rate Prediction in E-Commerce Scenarios
venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [CIKM 2026][多模态推荐] 揭示端到端联合训练在强预训练编码器上失效的根因（CTR 监督多模态不可解释+梯度不一致），提出 Mine-Then-Train 挖掘三元组微调编码器，线上 CTR +1.5%、RPM +0.5%。

venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: ELEC: Efficient Large Language Model-Empowered Click-Through Rate Prediction
venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [SIGIR 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 伪孪生增益/朴素双网络+分数级CLID与表示级MSE双蒸馏，在线仅跑表格DCNv2，AUC较FLIP提升0.0020/0.0034。

venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: GenCI: Generative Modeling of User Interest Shift via Cohort-based Intent Learning for CTR Prediction
venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [WWW 2026][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用RQ-VAE语义ID+NTP生成兴趣群组，再以分层候选感知注意力注入精排，弥合召回-排序意图鸿沟，三数据集AUC全面SOTA。

venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: SWaT: Statistical Modeling of Video Watch Time through User Behavior Analysis
venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [KDD 2025][CTR/CVR 预估与特征交叉] 将用户观看行为假设翻译为分桶二项/几何分布白盒统计模型，以软标签 BCE 训练，离线与线上 A/B 均稳定超越 WLR/TPM/CREAD。

venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Long-Term Interest Clock: Fine-Grained Time Perception in Streaming Recommendation System
venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [WWW 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用候选物品+当前时刻双查询从长期行为中检索子序列，并以时距感知注意力聚合，实现流式推荐细粒度时间感知，线上活跃天数+0.122%。

venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Leveraging Watch-time Feedback for Short-Video Recommendations: A Causal Labeling Framework
venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [CIKM 2023][去偏公平与工业架构] 用分位数把观看时长转成 WPR 与二值标签，并在标注阶段按视频时长分组做因果去偏，离线全指标最优、线上观看时长 +2.23%。

venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Comment Staytime Prediction with LLM-enhanced Comment Understanding
venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [WWW 2025][多模态推荐与内容理解] 首个评论区停留时长数据集 KuaiComt 与两阶段 LCU 框架：LLM 领域微调 + 评论排序辅助任务，离线全指标提升且线上停留时长 +1.27%。

venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Hierarchical Exponential-Gaussian Mixtures for Watch-Time Distribution Prediction
venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [ICDM 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用分层 skip-watch 分解与结构化初始化修复 EGMN 的方差坍缩与组件冗余，在固定骨干换头协议下提升 XAUC 与阈值事件预测，线上会话深度 +9.26%。

venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: SORT: A Systematically Optimized Ranking Transformer for Industrial-scale Recommenders
venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [CIKM 2026][多任务学习与列表级重排] 以请求为中心组织样本、局部注意力+查询剪枝、生成式预训练与稀疏MoE重构工业精排Transformer，线上GMV+8.65%且延迟降62%。

venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: SilverTorch: A Unified Model-based System to Democratize Large-Scale Recommendation on GPUs
venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [SIGIR 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 将 ANN 检索与特征过滤下沉为 PyTorch 模型层，GPU Bloom Index 与 Int8 融合 ANN 协同设计，吞吐提升 23.7×、成本效率提升 13.35×。

venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: OneTrans: Unified Feature Interaction and Sequence Modeling with One Transformer in Industrial Recommender
venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [WWW 2026][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用单一因果 Transformer 统一序列建模与特征交叉，配合金字塔剪枝与跨请求 KV 缓存，线上 GMV/u 提升 5.68%

venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: LO-FAR: A Cost-Aware Local Filter for Sparse Feature Ranking in Industrial Ad Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [RecSys 2026][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用CPU级逐特征独立局部估计器替代GPU重训式置换/门控重要性，在475个稀疏ID-list特征上以约2 CPU小时完成排序并保持下游NE增益。

venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: GRank: Towards Target-Aware and Streamlined Industrial Retrieval with a Generate-Rank Framework
venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [WWW 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用训练期目标注入把 Target-Aware 能力蒸馏进 MIPS 兼容生成器，再以轻量交叉注意力重排，免结构化索引实现 Recall@500 +30% 与 1.7× QPS。

venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: MAC: A Conversion Rate Prediction Benchmark Featuring Labels Under Multiple Attribution Mechanisms
venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [KDD 2026][CTR预估与特征交叉] 首个多归因机制CVR公开基准MAC与PyMAL库，提出MoAE模型，GAUC最高提升0.39pt。

venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Can Large Language Models Identify Meaningful Touchpoints in Conversion Attribution?
venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [CIKM 2026][CTR预估与特征交叉] 构建SILVA触点选择基准，揭示隐式触点语义鸿沟，系统评测8个LLM的成对/列表提示能力，并以LLM归因标签增强工业CVR训练获+0.35pp GAUC。

venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: On Predicting Post-Click Conversion Rate via Counterfactual Inference
venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [ICDM 2025][CTR/CVR 预估与特征交叉] 用 SCM 对未点击样本做 do(C=1) 反事实推断生成转化伪标签，全空间训练 CVR 模型，离线 AUC 平均 +1.01%，线上 CVR +17.35%。

venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Practical Multi-Task Learning for Rare Conversions in Ad Tech
venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [RecSys 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 以历史CVR统计自动划分软/硬转化任务，共享底层+双塔MTL提升稀有转化预估，离线AUC+0.69%、线上CPA降2%。

venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: ALM-MTA: Front-Door Causal Multi-Touch Attribution Method for Creator-Ecosystem Optimization
venues/CIKM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [ICLR 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 以前门识别+对抗代理中介实现大规模推荐系统多触点因果归因，离线 AUC 0.907、线上创作者 +0.6%。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Exploring the Potential of LLMs for Serendipity Evaluation in Recommender Systems
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [RecSys 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 用 LLM 模拟用户对推荐结果做惊喜度（serendipity）打分，在淘宝与 MovieLens 两个真实用户调研数据集上做元评估，最优配置 Pearson 相关达 21.5%，显著超越传统代理指标。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: LLM-as-a-Judge for Reliable and Explainable Offline Evaluation in Top-K Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [KDD 2026][去偏公平与工业评测] 用 LLM 从用户文本行为构建语义偏好代理替代 holdout ID 匹配，以 reasoning-then-scoring 生成可解释 Top-K 评测，模型排序一致性较常规测试提升 40–150%。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Beyond Utility: Evaluating LLM as Recommender
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出含历史长度敏感性、候选位置偏差、画像生成与幻觉四维的 LLM 推荐多维评测框架，揭示 LLM 在重排与冷启动占优但位置偏差严重。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Towards Next-Generation Recommender Systems: A Benchmark for Personalized Recommendation Assistant with LLMs
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [WSDM 2026][大语言模型推荐] 构建 RecBench+ 约3万条复杂用户查询基准，覆盖显式/隐式/误导条件与画像偏好，系统评测7个LLM并揭示SFT+RFT两阶段微调最优。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: EAGER-LLM: Enhancing Large Language Models as Recommenders through Exogenous Behavior-Semantic Integration
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [WWW 2025][大语言模型推荐] 以双源知识富集物品索引+非侵入多尺度对齐重建+退火适配器，将外源行为/语义信号注入 LLM 生成式推荐，Amazon 三数据集 Full-Ranking 下 Recall@10 最高提升 26.16%。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Taming Recommendation Bias with Causal Intervention on Evolving Personal Popularity
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [KDD 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 提出演化个人流行度度量与因果去混杂训练，并在推理期用移动平均趋势外推做干预，兼顾用户-物品演化一致性，Full-Ranking 下 Recall@20 最高提升 20.4%。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Unbiased Recommender Systems with Implicit Feedback
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [RecSys 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 博士论文愿景：以控制函数法纠偏排序位置偏差、以事后投影与消息传递加权纠偏 GNN 协同过滤的流行度偏差。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Graph Representation Learning via Causal Diffusion for Out-of-Distribution Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [WWW 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 用结构因果模型定位环境混杂因子，以变分推断+扩散模型学习环境不变图表征，OOD 场景最高提升 36.73%。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Breaking the Likelihood Trap: Consistent Generative Recommendation with Graph-structured Model
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用有向无环图解码器扩展非自回归生成空间，并以 Gumbel-Softmax 打通评估器梯度，破解似然陷阱，快手线上 Views +0.78%。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Rethinking Popularity Bias in Collaborative Filtering via Analytical Vector Decomposition
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [KDD 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 揭示 BPR 优化在嵌入空间刻出“流行度方向”的几何偏差，提出非对称方向分解校正 DDC，在 5 个骨干上 MRR@10 提升 6%–29% 且 AvgPop@10 降 21%–47%。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: You Don't Bring Me Flowers: Mitigating Unwanted Recommendations Through Conformal Risk Control
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [RecSys 2025][社交与群组推荐] 用保形风险控制对任意排序器做后处理，以“重复安全内容替换”替代纯删除，在 KuaiRand 上可证明地把不想要内容比例压到用户指定 α 以下且保住 nDCG。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: DLCRec: A Novel Approach for Managing Diversity in LLM-Based Recommender Systems
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [WSDM 2025][大语言模型推荐] 将多样性可控推荐拆解为类型预测/填充/物品预测三子任务级联，配合两类数据增广，在 Movie/Steam 上 MAE_Cov@10 大幅领先。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Content Fuzzing for Escaping Information Cocoons on Digital Social Media
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [ACL 2026 Findings][去偏公平与可信推荐] 以立场检测置信度为灰盒反馈，用 LLM 迭代改写帖子翻转机器立场标签，助创作者突破信息茧房，跨 3 数据集 4 模型平均逃逸率 40%–91%。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Datasets for Navigating Sensitive Topics in Recommendation Systems
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [WWW 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 构建 ML-DDD 与 AO3 两个带敏感内容警告标签的推荐数据集，提出 Warning Amplification 指标，发现个性化 CF 反而去放大敏感内容。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Rethinking Fairness in LLM-Based Recommender Systems: A Survey
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [EMNLP 2026 Findings][去偏公平与可信推荐] 首个 LLM4Rec 公平性综述，提出「偏置机制×公平目标」二维分类法，系统梳理数据集、评估协议、缓解策略与可信交叉议题。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Diversity-Augmented Negative Sampling for Implicit Collaborative Filtering
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [WWW 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用用户级缓存 + 多样性增强 k-DPP + mixup 合成负样本，解决两阶段负采样同质化问题，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@20 最高提升 8.76%。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Unbiased Collaborative Filtering with Fair Sampling
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [SIGIR 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 通过对称补充采样使每个用户/物品等概率成为正负样本，无需估计倾向分即可消除流行度偏置，全库排序下 Recall/NDCG 与 ARP 双优。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Generating Negative Samples for Multi-Modal Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [ACM MM 2025][多模态推荐] 用 MLLM 三步提示生成兼具凝聚力与难度的属性级负样本，并以因果学习解耦关键特征，全库排序下 Recall@10 最高提升 9.02%。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Towards Automatic Sampling of User Behaviors for Sequential Recommender Systems
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [IJCAI 2025][序列与会话推荐] 提出 AutoSAM，用轻量采样器+强化学习多目标奖励自适应丢弃低信息历史行为，在四个真实数据集全库排序下 NDCG@10 平均提升约 8%。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: SCONE: A Novel Stochastic Sampling to Generate Contrastive Views and Hard Negative Samples for Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [WSDM 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 用分数生成模型统一生成用户-物品特定对比视图与难负样本，6 数据集全库排序 Recall@20 最高提升 1.70%。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Learning Evolving Preferences: A Federated Continual Framework for User-Centric Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [WWW 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 联邦持续推荐框架 FCUCR：时间感知自蒸馏抗遗忘 + 跨用户原型迁移促协同，四数据集全库排序 HR@10 最高提升 44.0%。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: A Federated Framework for LLM-based Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [NAACL 2025 Findings][去偏公平与工业架构] FELLRec 用动态聚合+课程升温平衡客户端性能，并以分层卸载降低 LLM 联邦推荐端侧开销。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Personalized Recommendation Models in Federated Settings: A Survey
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [TKDE 2025][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 首篇以“个性化模型”为核心的 FedRecSys 综述，给出双层优化定义并系统梳理四类挑战与解法。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: SecEmb: Sparsity-Aware Secure Federated Learning of On-Device Recommender System with Large Embedding
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [ICML 2025][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 用 FSS 点函数对稀疏物品嵌入更新做无损安全聚合，通信降 90x、端侧计算降 70x 且不泄露评分物品索引。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Federated User Preference Modeling for Privacy-Preserving Cross-Domain Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [TMM 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用评论+潜在正物品挖掘综合偏好，再以 LDP 原型经联邦聚合跨域迁移，四组 CDR 任务 HR@10 平均提升约 13%。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: FairDgcl: Fairness-aware Recommendation with Dynamic Graph Contrastive Learning
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [TKDE 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 用对抗式视图生成器+判别器动态生成公平增强视图，在四个数据集上同时提升准确率与群体公平性。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: How Fair is Your Diffusion Recommender Model?
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [RecSys 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 首个针对 DiffRec/L-DiffRec 的公平性实证研究，在 ML1M/FTKY 上以 Full-Ranking 评估效用与消费者/提供者公平，揭示扩散模型放大偏见而 L-DiffRec 可缓解。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Towards Fair Large Language Model-based Recommender Systems without Costly Retraining
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [WWW 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 将 LLM-RS 去偏重构为免重训机器遗忘任务：可学习掩码定位致偏样本 + 影响函数一步参数修正，公平性提升同时精度不降、耗时降 96%。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Rethinking Fairness in LLM-Based Recommender Systems: A Survey
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [EMNLP 2026 Findings][去偏公平与可信推荐] 首个 LLM4Rec 公平性综述，提出「偏置机制×公平目标」二维分类法，系统梳理数据集、评估协议、缓解策略与可信交叉议题。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Pre-training for Recommendation Unlearning
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [SIGIR 2025][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 提出预训练式影响编码器 UnlearnRec，将遗忘请求映射为嵌入漂移，免重训实现高效图推荐遗忘，10x 加速且保持精度。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Exploiting Fine-Grained Skip Behaviors for Micro-Video Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [AAAI 2025][多模态推荐] 将短视频跳过行为细分为高正/低正/负三级，构建双层正图与分层 BPR 损失，两数据集八项指标全面超越 FRAME 等基线。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: When Top-ranked Recommendations Fail: Modeling Multi-Granular Negative Feedback for Explainable and Robust Video Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [AAAI 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 三智能体协同建模多粒度负反馈，S-GRPO 渐进奖励实现可解释视频推荐，线上快滑率降 9.4%

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Short Video Segment-level User Dynamic Interests Modeling in Personalized Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [SIGIR 2025][多模态推荐] 将短视频切分为5秒片段，用CLIP视觉+ID双模态跨注意力建模片段级动态兴趣，以段内排序损失解决标签缺失，在跳看预测与视频推荐两任务上大幅超越基线。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: FlowTime: Towards Continuous Generative Watch Time Prediction via Flow-based Personalized Priors
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 提出连续生成式回归新范式，用一步VAE+归一化流个性化先验建模多峰观看时长分布，KuaiRec MAE降0.676%、线上播放时长+1.044%。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: A Content-Driven Micro-Video Recommendation Dataset at Scale
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 发布十亿级含原始视频模态的微视频推荐数据集 MicroLens，并系统基准 IDRec/VIDRec/VideoRec 三类范式，揭示端到端视频编码优于冻结特征的关键结论。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Exploring Test-time Scaling via Prediction Merging on Large-Scale Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [SIGIR 2026][CTR预估与特征交叉] 提出预测合并式测试时缩放，用异构架构与同构随机种子生成多样 logit 并平均融合，三数据集八骨干上稳定超越参数缩放。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Do LLMs Memorize Recommendation Datasets? A Preliminary Study on MovieLens-1M
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用少样本提示探测 GPT/Llama 对 MovieLens-1M 的物品、用户与交互记忆覆盖率，揭示记忆量与推荐性能强相关且放大流行度偏置。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Unlocking Scaling Law in Industrial Recommendation Systems with a Three-step Paradigm based Large User Model
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [WSDM 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义 ID] 提出 LUM 三步范式（生成预训练→条件查询→判别式 DLRM 融合），以 next-condition-item 预测打通生成与判别，7B 参数下稳定扩展，线上 CTR +2.9%。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Large Language Model Simulator for Cold-Start Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [WSDM 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 用 LLM 模拟冷物品的用户交互行为，并以耦合漏斗（FAISS 过滤 + LLM 精炼）把十亿级候选压到数百，离线冷召回 NDCG 提升 37%+，线上冷启 GMV +16.9%。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Can LLMs Outshine Conventional Recommenders? A Comparative Evaluation
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [NeurIPS 2025 DB Track][大语言模型推荐] RecBench 系统对比 17 个 LLM 与 DLRM 在 4 种物品表征、CTR/SeqRec 双任务上的精度-效率权衡，LLM 精度领先但推理慢千倍。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Can Recommender Systems Teach Themselves? A Recursive Self-Improving Framework with Fidelity Control
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [ICML 2026][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 提出 RSIR 递归自我改进框架，用模型自生成序列+保真度质量控制稠密化稀疏交互，理论证明其等价于流形切向隐式正则，多骨干多数据集 Full-Ranking 下 NDCG/Recall 稳定提升 3%–14%。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Does Weighting Improve Matrix Factorization for Recommender Systems?
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [WWW 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 系统实证加权隐式反馈矩阵分解：大秩模型下不加权常持平或更优，并给出加权目标闭式解与预条件共轭梯度高效求解。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Request-Only Optimization for Recommendation Systems
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 以用户请求为训练样本单元，在数据源头去重用户特征，实现训练吞吐 2-6 倍提升并支撑 HSTU 生成式推荐规模化落地。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: On the Convergent Validity of Offline Evaluation Designs for Recommender Systems
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [RecSys 2026][去偏公平与工业评测] 以稠密真值反馈为参照，用 Kendall's τ 检验稀疏离线评测设计的收敛效度，发现无普适最优设计且 KuaiRec 上排序近乎反转。

venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: iAgent: LLM Agent as a Shield between User and Recommender Systems
venues/CIKM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [ACL 2025 Findings][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出 user-agent-platform 新范式，用个体指令感知 LLM Agent 在用户与平台间做重排护盾，四数据集平均提升 16.6%。

venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/asymmetr.title: Unlocking the Power of Diffusion Models in Sequential Recommendation: A Simple and Effective Approach
venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/asymmetr.description: [KDD 2025][序列与会话推荐] 揭示扩散序列推荐中的嵌入坍缩问题，提出逐 token 独立扩散+三阶段训练，六数据集 HR@20 平均提升 15.45%。

venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/asymmetr.title: Flow Matching based Sequential Recommender Model
venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/asymmetr.description: [IJCAI 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用直线流轨迹+无噪预测目标+ODE确定性采样替代扩散式序列推荐，四数据集全库排序平均提升6.53%

venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/asymmetr.title: Addressing Missing Data Issue for Diffusion-based Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/asymmetr.description: [SIGIR 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用双侧 Thompson 采样在引导序列中模拟缺失数据，以一致性正则化让扩散推荐模型外推抵抗真实缺失，YooChoose NDCG@20 提升 26.95%。

venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/asymmetr.title: SimDiffRec: Semantic Similarity-Guided Diffusion for Contrastive Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/asymmetr.description: [WSDM 2026][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 用语义相似物品均值替代高斯随机噪声做扩散增强，按去噪置信度选增强位置并配难负采样，五数据集 Full-Ranking 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/asymmetr.title: Preference Diffusion for Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/asymmetr.description: [ICLR 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 将 BPR 改写为对数似然排序目标并推导变分上界，为扩散推荐器注入多负样本偏好信号，Full-Ranking 下 R@5 最高提升 19.35%。

venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/das_dual.title: Rethinking Semantic ID Construction for Generative Recommendation: SimHash with Parallel Decoding and Semantic Alignment
venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/das_dual.description: [NeurIPS 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 揭示LSH分词劣势源于与自回归解码的结构错配，提出免训练SimHash+并行解码+语义对齐的FLASH，全库排序下NDCG@5最高提升14.46%。

venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/das_dual.title: Semantic IDs for Joint Generative Search and Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/das_dual.description: [RecSys 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 系统对比任务专属与跨任务语义ID构建策略，发现多任务双塔嵌入+统一RQ-KMeans语义ID在联合搜索推荐中取得最佳权衡。

venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/das_dual.title: DaRec: A Disentangled Alignment Framework for Large Language Model and Recommender System
venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/das_dual.description: [ICDE 2025][大语言模型推荐] 从信息论证明零间隙对齐次优，提出解耦共享/特有表征+全局局部结构对齐的即插即用框架，全库排序下 Recall@20 最高提升 5.33%。

venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/das_dual.title: Fusion and Alignment Enhancement with Large Language Models for Tail-item Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/das_dual.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用自适应门控融合 ID/LLM 嵌入并以双层对齐+课程学习消除空间结构冲突，全库排序下尾部长尾 H@10 最高提升 427%。

venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/das_dual.title: Generative Recommender with End-to-End Learnable Item Tokenization
venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/das_dual.description: [SIGIR 2025][生成式推荐] 提出 ETEGRec 双编码器-解码器框架，用序列-物品对齐与偏好-语义对齐将 RQ-VAE 分词器与 T5 推荐器端到端联合优化，全库排序下 Recall@10 相对 LETTER 提升约 5%。

venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/empoweri.title: LLM2Rec: Large Language Models Are Powerful Embedding Models for Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/empoweri.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 两阶段将 LLM 改造为融合协同信号与语义的物品嵌入模型，Full-Ranking 下域内平均提升约 15%、跨域仍稳定增益。

venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/empoweri.title: Pre-train, Align, and Disentangle: Empowering Sequential Recommendation with Large Language Models
venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/empoweri.description: [SIGIR 2025][LLM推荐] 用 MK-MMD 特征核做推荐锚定对齐，再以三专家频率门控解耦，Full-Ranking 下冷物品 HR@10 提升最高 462%。

venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/empoweri.title: Multi-Aspect Cross-modal Quantization for Generative Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/empoweri.description: [AAAI 2026][生成式推荐] 在 RQ-VAE 量化各层注入跨模态对比与重建对齐，并在 GR 训练中加隐式/显式对齐，Full-Ranking 下 HR@10 最高提升约 9.4%。

venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/empoweri.title: MoToRec: Sparse-Regularized Multimodal Tokenization for Cold-Start Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/empoweri.description: [AAAI 2026][冷启动与长尾推荐] 用稀疏正则化 RQ-VAE 将多模态特征离散化为组合语义码，配合稀有度放大与多源图编码，冷启动物品 N@20 最高提升 12.58%。

venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/empoweri.title: LSF-SR: Latent Semantic Fusion for Sequential Recommendation via Flow-based Conditional Variational Autoencoders
venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/empoweri.description: [CIKM 2026][序列推荐] 用归一化流增强的 CVAE 将 LLM 语义作为条件概率融合进 ID 协同嵌入，Full-Ranking 下 Recall@20 最高提升 12.98%。

venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/mtgr_ind.title: Scaling Recommender Transformers to One Billion Parameters
venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/mtgr_ind.description: [KDD 2026][序列与会话推荐] ARGUS 将自回归预训练解耦为反馈预测与下一物品预测双任务，把推荐 Transformer 编码器扩到 10 亿参数，线上听歌时长 +2.26%、点赞率 +6.37%。

venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/mtgr_ind.title: Unlocking Scaling Law in Industrial Recommendation Systems with a Three-step Paradigm based Large User Model
venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/mtgr_ind.description: [WSDM 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义 ID] 提出 LUM 三步范式（生成预训练→条件查询→判别式 DLRM 融合），以 next-condition-item 预测打通生成与判别，7B 参数下稳定扩展，线上 CTR +2.9%。

venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/mtgr_ind.title: EARN: Efficient Inference Acceleration for LLM-based Generative Recommendation by Register Tokens
venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/mtgr_ind.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 基于 LLMRec 注意力层间稀疏反转与双注意力汇现象，用首尾寄存器 token 压缩历史交互并在第 k 层后剪除 prompt，实现 3.79× 加速与 80.8% KV Cache 缩减且精度反超微调。

venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/mtgr_ind.title: Climber: Toward Efficient Scaling Laws for Large Recommendation Models
venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/mtgr_ind.description: [CIKM 2025][序列与会话推荐] 面向推荐场景改造 Transformer：多尺度子序列抽取降复杂度、自适应温度调制注意力，配合单用户多物品批处理与 KV 缓存，线上指标 +12.19%。

venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/mtgr_ind.title: Towards Generalizable and Efficient Large-Scale Generative Recommenders
venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/mtgr_ind.description: [RecSys 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 将生成式推荐骨干从2M扩至1B，用偏移幂律缩放律诊断任务天花板，并以MTP、采样softmax与语义塔解决缓存陈旧与冷启动，1M用户影子MRR全线提升。

venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/progress.title: Multi-Aspect Cross-modal Quantization for Generative Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/progress.description: [AAAI 2026][生成式推荐] 在 RQ-VAE 量化各层注入跨模态对比与重建对齐，并在 GR 训练中加隐式/显式对齐，Full-Ranking 下 HR@10 最高提升约 9.4%。

venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/progress.title: Hi-SAM: A Hierarchical Structure-Aware Multi-modal Framework for Large-Scale Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/progress.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 解耦语义分词器+分层记忆锚点Transformer，修复语义ID推荐中分词冗余与扁平架构失配，工业A/B响应率+6.55%

venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/progress.title: Just Ask for Music (JAM): Multimodal and Personalized Natural Language Music Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/progress.description: [RecSys 2025][多模态推荐] 将查询建模为用户到物品的向量平移，用交叉注意力聚合音频/歌词/CF 多模态，在 JAMSessions 全库排序上 NDCG@10 相对 TalkRec 提升约 105%

venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/progress.title: Distribution-Guided Auto-Encoder for User Multimodal Interest Cross Fusion
venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/progress.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 以行为粒度做模态内/模态间交叉融合，并用兴趣分布解码器作自监督约束，工业 A/B 上 CTR +12.9%。

venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/progress.title: Spectrum-based Modality Representation Fusion Graph Convolutional Network for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/progress.description: [WSDM 2025][多模态推荐] 将多模态特征投影至频域做滤波去噪与点积融合，配合模态专属/融合双图学习与模态感知偏好模块，在 Amazon 三数据集全库排序下 Recall@20 相对最优基线提升约 5%。

venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/tbgrecal.title: GenRec: A Preference-Oriented Generative Framework for Large-Scale Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/tbgrecal.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 以 Page-wise NTP 解一对多歧义、线性 Token Merger 压缩 2× 输入、GRPO-SR 混合奖励对齐偏好，京东线上点击 +9.5%、成交 +8.7%。

venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/tbgrecal.title: APAO: Bridging the Training-Inference Gap in Generative Recommendation via Adaptive Prefix-Aware Optimization
venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/tbgrecal.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 揭示 Beam Search 剪枝与 teacher-forcing 训练的前缀级不一致，用自适应最差前缀损失对齐训练与推理，全库排序下 Recall@20 最高提升 13.3%。

venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/tbgrecal.title: EAGER: Enrich-and-Align Generative Query Recommendation from Clicked Items in E-commerce Search
venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/tbgrecal.description: [EMNLP 2026 Industry][LLM4Rec] 两阶段生成式 I2Q 查询推荐：课程化 SFT 扩意图覆盖 + GRPO 混合奖励对齐线上约束，线上 UCTR +0.83%、Pay Count +3.49%。

venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/tbgrecal.title: One Sequential Recommendation Model Pretrained from Synthetic Priors Predicts Multiple Datasets
venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/tbgrecal.description: [KDD 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用 hDCSBM 合成先验预训练 PFN，以支持集条件化实现免更新推理的序列推荐，五基准平均超最优基线 7.53%。

venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/tbgrecal.title: Mixture of Sequence: Theme-Aware Mixture-of-Experts for Long-Sequence Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/generative_rec/tbgrecal.description: [WWW 2026][序列与会话推荐] 揭示长序列“会话跳跃”现象，用主题码本路由+多尺度专家融合做子序列抽取，AUC 平均提升 0.68% 且 FLOPs 更低

venues/CIKM/2025/graph_rec/enhancing_gra.title: Graph Spectral Filtering with Chebyshev Interpolation for Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/graph_rec/enhancing_gra.description: [SIGIR 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用切比雪夫插值逼近非线性图滤波器，直接以原始交互为信号，突破 LightGCN 的截断线性低通瓶颈，Full-Ranking 下全面 SOTA 且推理快 8.1 倍。

venues/CIKM/2025/graph_rec/enhancing_gra.title: A Node-Aware Dynamic Quantization Approach for Graph Collaborative Filtering
venues/CIKM/2025/graph_rec/enhancing_gra.description: [CIKM 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 提出节点感知动态量化 GNAQ，用参数共享学习每节点量化步长并以图消息传递更新，2-bit 下 Recall@10 平均提升 27.8%。

venues/CIKM/2025/graph_rec/enhancing_gra.title: Memory Is No Longer a Bottleneck: Memory-Efficient Graph Filtering for Scalable Collaborative Filtering
venues/CIKM/2025/graph_rec/enhancing_gra.description: [TKDE 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用逐用户 Krylov 子空间替代全量物品相似度图，实现免训练多项式图滤波，内存降 5.74×、推理加速 26× 且精度反超 SOTA。

venues/CIKM/2025/graph_rec/enhancing_gra.title: PULSE: Socially-Aware User Representation Modeling Toward Parameter-Efficient Graph Collaborative Filtering
venues/CIKM/2025/graph_rec/enhancing_gra.description: [WWW 2026][社交与群组推荐] 用社区结构与社交邻居物品信号替代显式用户嵌入，参数降 50% 且 NDCG@20 提升 8-9%

venues/CIKM/2025/graph_rec/enhancing_gra.title: How Do Graph Signals Affect Recommendation: Unveiling the Mystery of Low and High-Frequency Graph Signals
venues/CIKM/2025/graph_rec/enhancing_gra.description: [KDD 2026][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 理论证明同绝对值低频/高频图信号在推荐中等价，提出频率信号缩放器与空间翻转插件，在四个数据集全库排序下 Recall@20 最高提升约 3.0%。

venues/CIKM/2025/graph_rec/spark_adaptiv.title: RankGraph: Unified Heterogeneous Graph Learning for Cross-Domain Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/graph_rec/spark_adaptiv.description: [RecSys 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 构建跨产品异构异质图，用 GPU 加速 RGCN + 对比学习产出图 token 注入推荐基础模型，线上 CTR +0.92%、CVR +2.82%。

venues/CIKM/2025/graph_rec/spark_adaptiv.title: DCGL: Dual-Channel Graph Learning with Large Language Models for Knowledge-Aware Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/graph_rec/spark_adaptiv.description: [SIGIR 2026][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 双通道解耦 LLM 语义与 ID 行为信号，多级对比对齐 + 频率感知门控融合，四数据集全库排序全面超越 SOTA。

venues/CIKM/2025/graph_rec/spark_adaptiv.title: Fusion and Alignment Enhancement with Large Language Models for Tail-item Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/graph_rec/spark_adaptiv.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用自适应门控融合 ID/LLM 嵌入并以双层对齐+课程学习消除空间结构冲突，全库排序下尾部长尾 H@10 最高提升 427%。

venues/CIKM/2025/graph_rec/spark_adaptiv.title: Can Complementary Signals Bridge Similarity Islands? Manifold-Augmented Graph Embedding for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/graph_rec/spark_adaptiv.description: [NeurIPS 2026][多模态推荐] 提出 MAGE，用离线 Soft Conceptor 残差注入 + 在线非对称双流 GNN 桥接互补品“相似性孤岛”，四个 Amazon 数据集 Full-Ranking 全面领先。

venues/CIKM/2025/graph_rec/spark_adaptiv.title: Graph Cross-Correlated Network for Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/graph_rec/spark_adaptiv.description: [TKDE 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 用非递归 PGR 保留各跳邻居纯语义，再以 HCC/ECC 显式建模用户-物品子图交叉相关项，全库排序下 NDCG@20 平均提升约 1.8%–2.9%。

venues/CIKM/2025/graph_rec/ultra_fast_wa.title: Rankformer: A Graph Transformer for Recommendation based on Ranking Objective
venues/CIKM/2025/graph_rec/ultra_fast_wa.description: [WWW 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 从 BPR 梯度下降推导出图 Transformer 层，正负样本分离聚合+基准项+偏移项，线性加速后 4 数据集平均提升 4.48%

venues/CIKM/2025/graph_rec/ultra_fast_wa.title: Non-parametric Graph Convolution for Re-ranking in Recommendation Systems
venues/CIKM/2025/graph_rec/ultra_fast_wa.description: [RecSys 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 将图卷积从训练期搬到测试期，用相似用户/物品构造增强对并加权聚合打分，重排平均提升 8.1% 而额外开销仅 0.5%。

venues/CIKM/2025/graph_rec/ultra_fast_wa.title: Criteria-Aware Graph Filtering: Extremely Fast Yet Accurate Multi-Criteria Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/graph_rec/ultra_fast_wa.description: [WWW 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 免训练免矩阵分解的多准则图滤波推荐，按准则定制多项式低通滤波器并融合用户准则偏好，BA 数据集 0.2 秒推理、NDCG@5 最高提升 24%。

venues/CIKM/2025/graph_rec/ultra_fast_wa.title: Frequency-aware Graph Signal Processing for Collaborative Filtering
venues/CIKM/2025/graph_rec/ultra_fast_wa.description: [WWW 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用级联高通-低通滤波捕获独有/共性特征、并行低通滤波捕获高阶邻域，免训练线性组合在六个数据集上 Full-Ranking 提升 2-5%。

venues/CIKM/2025/graph_rec/ultra_fast_wa.title: Graph-Sequential Alignment and Uniformity: Toward Enhanced Recommendation Systems
venues/CIKM/2025/graph_rec/ultra_fast_wa.description: [WWW 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 以共享嵌入层联合训练 LightGCN 与 SASRec，用对齐-均匀性损失实现跨子模块知识迁移，Leave-One-Out 全库排序下 R@10 最高提升 13.4%。

venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/alibaba_interna.title: CSRM-LLM: Embracing Multilingual LLMs for Cold-Start Relevance Matching in Emerging E-commerce Markets
venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/alibaba_interna.description: [CIKM 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 多语言 LLM 联合翻译任务、检索式查询增强与多轮自蒸馏，解决新兴市场零标注相关性匹配，离线 F1 0.965、线上缺陷率降 45.8%。

venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/alibaba_interna.title: Generative Product Recommendations for Implicit Superlative Queries
venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/alibaba_interna.description: [ACL 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出 SUPERB 四级标注体系与深思式属性生成，用 LLM 列表级重排处理隐式最高级商品查询，nDCG@10 相对 BM25 提升约 18%。

venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/alibaba_interna.title: Relevance Matters: A Multi-Task and Multi-Stage Large Language Model Approach for E-commerce Query Rewriting
venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/alibaba_interna.description: [ICDE 2026][LLM4Rec] 将相关性打标任务注入电商查询改写，多任务 SFT + 查询级归一化 GRPO 融合奖励对齐，离线召回 67.94%、线上 UCVR +0.181%。

venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/alibaba_interna.title: PSCon: Product Search Through Conversations
venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/alibaba_interna.description: [SIGIR 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出人-人教练式采集协议构建双市场双语真实 CPS 数据集 PSCon，定义六子任务流水线并给出 Transformer 统一基准模型。

venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/alibaba_interna.title: Scaling Multilingual Semantic Search in Uber Eats Delivery
venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/alibaba_interna.description: [KDD 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 基于 gte-Qwen2 双塔统一多语言多垂类语义召回，InfoNCE+Triplet NCE 两阶段训练与 MRL 多维度服务，Store R@20 相对 Legacy 提升 88%。

venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/exploring_the_u.title: FLARE: Fusing Language Models and Collaborative Architectures for Recommender Enhancement
venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/exploring_the_u.description: [WWW 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用冻结 mT5+Perceiver 将文本注入 Bert4Rec，并以重调 Bert4Rec 基线、大词表评测与 Critiquing 任务重估 ID+文本增益。

venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/exploring_the_u.title: Language Representations Can be What Recommenders Need: Findings and Potentials
venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/exploring_the_u.description: [ICLR 2025 (Oral)][LLM4Rec] 揭示语言空间与推荐行为空间同构，提出纯语言表征的 AlphaRec，在 Amazon 三数据集 Full-Ranking 上超越 ID-based CF 6.8%–9.8%。

venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/exploring_the_u.title: Can LLMs Outshine Conventional Recommenders? A Comparative Evaluation
venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/exploring_the_u.description: [NeurIPS 2025 DB Track][大语言模型推荐] RecBench 系统对比 17 个 LLM 与 DLRM 在 4 种物品表征、CTR/SeqRec 双任务上的精度-效率权衡，LLM 精度领先但推理慢千倍。

venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/exploring_the_u.title: The Mental World of Large Language Models in Recommendation: A Benchmark on Association, Personalization, and Knowledgeability
venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/exploring_the_u.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出 LRWorld 基准（38K 样本/23M tokens），从关联、个性化、知识性三尺度十因素 31 任务系统评测数十个 LLM，揭示其在神经嵌入检索上的致命短板。

venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/exploring_the_u.title: Bridging Language and Items for Retrieval and Recommendation: Benchmarking LLMs as Semantic Encoders
venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/exploring_the_u.description: [ACL 2026][大语言模型推荐] 构建 BLaIR 基准，用 11 个 LLM 作语义编码器评测序列推荐、协同过滤与复杂查询商品搜索，揭示其排名与 MTEB 几乎不相关。

venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/llm_enhanced_li.title: LLM2Rec: Large Language Models Are Powerful Embedding Models for Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/llm_enhanced_li.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 两阶段将 LLM 改造为融合协同信号与语义的物品嵌入模型，Full-Ranking 下域内平均提升约 15%、跨域仍稳定增益。

venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/llm_enhanced_li.title: LSF-SR: Latent Semantic Fusion for Sequential Recommendation via Flow-based Conditional Variational Autoencoders
venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/llm_enhanced_li.description: [CIKM 2026][序列推荐] 用归一化流增强的 CVAE 将 LLM 语义作为条件概率融合进 ID 协同嵌入，Full-Ranking 下 Recall@20 最高提升 12.98%。

venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/llm_enhanced_li.title: Can LLMs Outshine Conventional Recommenders? A Comparative Evaluation
venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/llm_enhanced_li.description: [NeurIPS 2025 DB Track][大语言模型推荐] RecBench 系统对比 17 个 LLM 与 DLRM 在 4 种物品表征、CTR/SeqRec 双任务上的精度-效率权衡，LLM 精度领先但推理慢千倍。

venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/llm_enhanced_li.title: The Mental World of Large Language Models in Recommendation: A Benchmark on Association, Personalization, and Knowledgeability
venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/llm_enhanced_li.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出 LRWorld 基准（38K 样本/23M tokens），从关联、个性化、知识性三尺度十因素 31 任务系统评测数十个 LLM，揭示其在神经嵌入检索上的致命短板。

venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/llm_enhanced_li.title: EAGER-LLM: Enhancing Large Language Models as Recommenders through Exogenous Behavior-Semantic Integration
venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/llm_enhanced_li.description: [WWW 2025][大语言模型推荐] 以双源知识富集物品索引+非侵入多尺度对齐重建+退火适配器，将外源行为/语义信号注入 LLM 生成式推荐，Amazon 三数据集 Full-Ranking 下 Recall@10 最高提升 26.16%。

venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/prompt_tuning_a.title: LettinGo: Explore User Profile Generation for Recommendation System
venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/prompt_tuning_a.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 用多LLM探索开放式用户画像、以下游推荐成败构造偏好对、DPO对齐画像生成器，Amazon Books Acc 66.3%→70.4%。

venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/prompt_tuning_a.title: Towards Next-Generation Recommender Systems: A Benchmark for Personalized Recommendation Assistant with LLMs
venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/prompt_tuning_a.description: [WSDM 2026][大语言模型推荐] 构建 RecBench+ 约3万条复杂用户查询基准，覆盖显式/隐式/误导条件与画像偏好，系统评测7个LLM并揭示SFT+RFT两阶段微调最优。

venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/prompt_tuning_a.title: Task-Aware Automated User Profile Generation for Recommendation Simulation Using Large Language Models
venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/prompt_tuning_a.description: [SIGIR 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出免训练三阶段画像生成框架 APG4RecSim，用语义合并+反事实因果映射将交互历史转为任务对齐画像，在判别/排序/评分三任务上取得最佳综合表现。

venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/prompt_tuning_a.title: Pre-trained LLMs Meet Sequential Recommenders: Efficient User-Centric Knowledge Distillation
venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/prompt_tuning_a.description: [ECIR 2026][大语言模型推荐] 用预训练 LLM 生成文本用户画像并蒸馏进 SASRec/BERT4Rec 隐层，两阶段训练实现零推理开销的语义增强，Recall@10 最高提升 23.5%。

venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/prompt_tuning_a.title: Personalized Recommendation Tool Learning via Autonomous Language Agents
venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/prompt_tuning_a.description: [RecSys 2026][LLM4Rec] 让 LLM 智能体做个性化工具选择、传统推荐模型做全库打分，以架构设计绕开幻觉与上下文长度限制，Full-Ranking 下 R@10 最高提升 68.8%。

venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/self_surrogate_.title: The Mental World of Large Language Models in Recommendation: A Benchmark on Association, Personalization, and Knowledgeability
venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/self_surrogate_.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出 LRWorld 基准（38K 样本/23M tokens），从关联、个性化、知识性三尺度十因素 31 任务系统评测数十个 LLM，揭示其在神经嵌入检索上的致命短板。

venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/self_surrogate_.title: LLM2Rec: Large Language Models Are Powerful Embedding Models for Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/self_surrogate_.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 两阶段将 LLM 改造为融合协同信号与语义的物品嵌入模型，Full-Ranking 下域内平均提升约 15%、跨域仍稳定增益。

venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/self_surrogate_.description: [NeurIPS 2025 DB Track][大语言模型推荐] RecBench 系统对比 17 个 LLM 与 DLRM 在 4 种物品表征、CTR/SeqRec 双任务上的精度-效率权衡，LLM 精度领先但推理慢千倍。

venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/self_surrogate_.title: SelfDR: Self-Distillation from Reasoning for LLM-Based Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/self_surrogate_.description: [CIKM 2026][大语言模型推荐] 用下游推荐奖励训练同源 Reasoner 生成理由，构建推理增强教师，再自蒸馏出免推理的直接推荐学生，重排 HR@1 提升约 15%。

venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/self_surrogate_.title: TayFCS: Towards Light Feature Combination Selection for Deep Recommender Systems
venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/self_surrogate_.description: [KDD 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用泰勒展开+IME近似一次性梯度回传估计高阶组合重要性，再用LR滑窗剔除冗余，三数据集AUC显著提升且线上CVR+13.9%

venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/trawl_external_.title: EAGER-LLM: Enhancing Large Language Models as Recommenders through Exogenous Behavior-Semantic Integration
venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/trawl_external_.description: [WWW 2025][大语言模型推荐] 以双源知识富集物品索引+非侵入多尺度对齐重建+退火适配器，将外源行为/语义信号注入 LLM 生成式推荐，Amazon 三数据集 Full-Ranking 下 Recall@10 最高提升 26.16%。

venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/trawl_external_.title: Bridging the User-side Knowledge Gap in Knowledge-aware Recommendations with Large Language Models
venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/trawl_external_.description: [AAAI 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 LLM 推断用户兴趣并结构化为 CIKG 异构图，配合兴趣重建与跨域对比学习去噪，在三个数据集全库排序下 R@100 最高提升 9.31%。

venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/trawl_external_.title: Knowledge Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation for LLM-based Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/trawl_external_.description: [ACL 2025][LLM4Rec] 用跳场知识子图索引+流行度选择性检索+GNN软提示，将KG结构知识注入冻结LLM，MovieLens-1M ACC 相对提升58.6%且推理仅慢0.14s

venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/trawl_external_.title: Unleashing the Power of Large Language Model for Denoising Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/trawl_external_.description: [WWW 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] LLaRD 用 LLM 生成偏好知识与图 CoT 关系知识，再以信息瓶颈对齐去噪图，Full-Ranking 下 Recall@20 最高提升约 14%。

venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/trawl_external_.title: The Mental World of Large Language Models in Recommendation: A Benchmark on Association, Personalization, and Knowledgeability
venues/CIKM/2025/llm_rec/trawl_external_.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出 LRWorld 基准（38K 样本/23M tokens），从关联、个性化、知识性三尺度十因素 31 任务系统评测数十个 LLM，揭示其在神经嵌入检索上的致命短板。

venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/gr.title: NLGR: Utilizing Neighbor Lists for Generative Rerank in Personalized Recommendation Systems
venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/gr.description: [WWW 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用邻居列表相对奖励对齐评估器-生成器目标，并以采样式非自回归生成灵活跳转组合空间，美团线上 CTR +3.25%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/gr.title: DeGRe: Dense-supervised Generative Reranking for Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/gr.description: [KDD 2026][多任务学习与列表级重排] 离线束搜索挖掘前瞻序列+累积回归稠密监督蒸馏至轻量生成器，单次贪心解码逼近全局最优，线上GMV+3.75%

venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/gr.title: Bi-Level Optimization for Generative Recommendation: Bridging Tokenization and Generation
venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/gr.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 将分词器与推荐器建模为双层优化，用元学习+梯度手术让推荐损失直接监督RQ-VAE码本，Full-Ranking下全面超越TIGER/LETTER/ETEGRec。

venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/gr.title: Empowering Compact LLMs with Fusion of Layer-wise Exits for Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/gr.description: [ICDM 2026][LLM4Rec] 在紧凑 LLM 每层插入预测出口并用连续 ReLU 路由器自适应融合多层打分分布，target-k hinge 损失约束激活出口数，全库排序下精度超越大模型基线且延迟仅增 <1ms。

venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/gr.title: Breaking the Likelihood Trap: Consistent Generative Recommendation with Graph-structured Model
venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/gr.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用有向无环图解码器扩展非自回归生成空间，并以 Gumbel-Softmax 打通评估器梯度，破解似然陷阱，快手线上 Views +0.78%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/mp.title: Automated Information Flow Selection for Multi-scenario Multi-task Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/mp.description: [WSDM 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 用 LoRA 解耦四类场景-任务信息单元并以可学习掩码剪枝无效信息流，AUC 全面超越 HiNet/M3oE，线上 CVR 均涨 2.46%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/mp.title: Efficient Multi-task Prompt Tuning for Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/mp.description: [TOIS 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 提出两阶段 MPT-Rec：GAN 解耦任务共享/特有信息后冻结主干，仅用任务感知 Prompt 微调新任务，参数降至 10% 且性能保持 95%+。

venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/mp.title: Direct Routing Gradient (DRGrad): A Personalized Information Surgery for Multi-Task Learning (MTL) Recommendations
venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/mp.description: [AAAI 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用梯度余弦相似度做路由+Split-MMoE+PPNet个性化门控，在150亿样本工业数据上Click AUC提升0.0027且不增推理延迟。

venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/mp.title: Paragon: Parameter Generation for Controllable Multi-Task Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/mp.description: [RecSys 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用扩散模型按偏好权重条件生成适配器参数，免重训实现测试时可控多任务推荐，响应时间降低 94.6%+。

venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/mp.title: OneRank: Unified Transformer-Native Ranking Architecture for Multi-Task Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/mp.description: [KDD 2026][多任务学习与列表级重排] 将多任务推理内化进 Transformer 栈，用任务私有 token 通道 + 梯度截断 + 匹配式打分替代编码器-预测器分离，Shopee 离线与线上 A/B 全面领先。

venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/or.title: Bridging Behavior and Semantics for Time-aware Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/or.description: [SIGIR 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 用神经 ODE 解耦长短期行为、LLM 离散时间 token 反事实增强语义、门控自适应域迁移，1:999 采样排序下 MRR 最高提升 30.5%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/or.title: On Predicting Post-Click Conversion Rate via Counterfactual Inference
venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/or.description: [ICDM 2025][CTR/CVR 预估与特征交叉] 用 SCM 对未点击样本做 do(C=1) 反事实推断生成转化伪标签，全空间训练 CVR 模型，离线 AUC 平均 +1.01%，线上 CVR +17.35%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/or.title: MCLMR: A Model-Agnostic Causal Learning Framework for Multi-Behavior Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/or.description: [WWW 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 用后门干预+MoE自适应聚合+偏差感知对比学习，作为即插即用框架增强多行为推荐，三数据集全库排序显著提升。

venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/or.title: CPMR: Context-Aware Incremental Sequential Recommendation with Pseudo-Multi-Task Learning
venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/or.description: [CIKM 2023][序列与会话推荐] 提出伪多任务学习范式，用历史图与上下文图双通道演化用户/物品时序状态，在四个数据集上 MRR 平均提升 30.98%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/or.title: CTR-Sink: Attention Sink for Language Models in Click-Through Rate Prediction
venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/or.description: [KDD 2026][CTR预估与特征交叉] 在文本化行为序列中插入携带时间距离的 [SINK] 锚点并配合两阶段训练与 sink 间注意力增强，缓解语义碎片化，AUC 稳定提升 0.2–0.6%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/yo.title: NLGR: Utilizing Neighbor Lists for Generative Rerank in Personalized Recommendation Systems
venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/yo.description: [WWW 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用邻居列表相对奖励对齐评估器-生成器目标，并以采样式非自回归生成灵活跳转组合空间，美团线上 CTR +3.25%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/yo.title: Profiling What Matters: Context-Aware Item Profiles from Large-Scale Metadata for LLM Recommenders
venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/yo.description: [CIKM 2026][大语言模型推荐] 将海量异构物品元数据结构化并训练轻量选择器，为每个用户-物品对动态生成上下文相关画像，显著提升 LLM 重排效果。

venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/yo.title: The Recall Ceiling of LLM Recommendation Reranking
venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/yo.description: [CIKM 2026][LLM4Rec] 证明闭候选重排器 NDCG 受自身窗口召回率硬上界约束，Oracle 协议高估 92–95%，九类 LLM 与监督重排器在真实检索下均无法显著超越 CF。

venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/yo.title: DeGRe: Dense-supervised Generative Reranking for Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/yo.description: [KDD 2026][多任务学习与列表级重排] 离线束搜索挖掘前瞻序列+累积回归稠密监督蒸馏至轻量生成器，单次贪心解码逼近全局最优，线上GMV+3.75%

venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/yo.title: Comprehensive List Generation for Multi-Generator Reranking
venues/CIKM/2025/multi_task_reranking/yo.description: [SIGIR 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 提出多生成器-评估器重排框架与列表全面性指标，用 CLIG 自动学习互补生成器，离线 AUC 提升 0.9%、线上观看时长 +0.48%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/a_conten.title: VK-LSVD: A Large-Scale Industrial Dataset for Short-Video Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/a_conten.description: [WWW 2026][序列与会话推荐] 发布 407 亿交互、千万用户、两千万短视频的工业级开放数据集，配全局时间切分与冷启动竞赛基准。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/a_conten.title: Short Video Segment-level User Dynamic Interests Modeling in Personalized Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/a_conten.description: [SIGIR 2025][多模态推荐] 将短视频切分为5秒片段，用CLIP视觉+ID双模态跨注意力建模片段级动态兴趣，以段内排序损失解决标签缺失，在跳看预测与视频推荐两任务上大幅超越基线。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/a_conten.title: Binge Watch: Reproducible Multimodal Benchmark Datasets for Large-Scale Movie Recommendation on MovieLens-10M and 20M
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/a_conten.description: [RecSys 2026][多模态推荐] 为 ML-10M/20M 构建可复现多模态基准 M3L（剧情/海报/预告片文本-图像-视频-音频），保留>90%交互并验证音频模态的关键增益。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/a_conten.title: When Top-ranked Recommendations Fail: Modeling Multi-Granular Negative Feedback for Explainable and Robust Video Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/a_conten.description: [AAAI 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 三智能体协同建模多粒度负反馈，S-GRPO 渐进奖励实现可解释视频推荐，线上快滑率降 9.4%

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/a_conten.title: Comment Staytime Prediction with LLM-enhanced Comment Understanding
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/a_conten.description: [WWW 2025][多模态推荐与内容理解] 首个评论区停留时长数据集 KuaiComt 与两阶段 LCU 框架：LLM 领域微调 + 评论排序辅助任务，离线全指标提升且线上停留时长 +1.27%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/bilistin.title: Token-Efficient Item Representation via Images for LLM Recommender Systems
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/bilistin.description: [ICLR 2026][LLM4Rec] 用单张物品图像替代冗长文本描述作为 LLM 推荐输入，配合 RISA 对齐与 RERI 检索式推荐，在 Amazon 四域上兼顾效率与效果。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/bilistin.title: VL-CLIP: Enhancing Multimodal Recommendations via Visual Grounding and LLM-Augmented CLIP Embeddings
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/bilistin.description: [RecSys 2025][多模态推荐] 用 Grounding DINO 裁剪商品主体 + LLM 自反思改写商品描述，再微调 CLIP 双塔，Walmart 线上 CTR +18.6%、GMV +4.0%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/bilistin.title: JourneyFormer: Encoding Airbnb Guest Journey with Sequence Modeling
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/bilistin.description: [KDD 2026][序列与会话推荐] Airbnb 搜索排序的工业级序列建模方案，以频次分层长短期序列+统一ID嵌入+因果Transformer编码访客旅程，离线NDCG+1.48%、线上Bookers+0.55%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/bilistin.title: Tokens are All You Need: Dual-purpose Semantic IDs for Achieving LLM-Level I/O Efficiency in Recommendation Systems
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/bilistin.description: [RecSys 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用 RQ-VAE 语义ID 同时承担协同身份与内容重建双职责，以 SiDec 在线解码替代稠密向量 I/O，检索 HitRate@100 提升至 0.2910 且吞吐较原始稠密嵌入快 20.4%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/bilistin.title: EGR: Embedding-Native Generative Retrieval with a Shared LLM
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/bilistin.description: [RecSys 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用单一共享 LLM 同时编码物品与用户历史，以双对比损失联合训练，免量化免 grounding，线上 CVR +2.91%

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/distribu.title: CAMMSR: Category-Guided Attentive Mixture of Experts for Multimodal Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/distribu.description: [ICDE 2026][多模态推荐] 用类别预测任务引导注意力 MoE 动态分配模态权重，并以模态交换对比学习对齐跨模态序列表征，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@5 最高提升 15.3%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/distribu.title: Harnessing Multimodal Large Language Models for Multimodal Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/distribu.description: [AAAI 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 MLLM 将商品图转为文本摘要，再以循环式提示推断动态用户偏好，SFT 微调 LLaVA 做多模态序列推荐，AUC 最高提升约 4.3%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/distribu.title: Personalized Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Foundation Models for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/distribu.description: [WWW 2026][多模态推荐] 按兴趣分群并为每群挂载独立 PEFT 模块，使 CLIP 编码出用户条件化的物品表征，配合群内难负采样，NDCG@20 最高提升 15.3%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/distribu.title: Multi-Aspect Cross-modal Quantization for Generative Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/distribu.description: [AAAI 2026][生成式推荐] 在 RQ-VAE 量化各层注入跨模态对比与重建对齐，并在 GR 训练中加隐式/显式对齐，Full-Ranking 下 HR@10 最高提升约 9.4%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/distribu.title: COHESION: Composite Graph Convolutional Network with Dual-Stage Fusion for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/distribu.description: [SIGIR 2025][多模态推荐] 用行为模态早期精炼+晚期注意力融合的双阶段融合，配合异质/同质复合图与自适应BPR，在三个 Amazon 数据集上 R@20 相对提升 4.4%–6.1%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/do_recom.title: NoteLLM-2: Multimodal Large Representation Models for Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/do_recom.description: [KDD 2025][多模态推荐] 端到端微调 LLM+视觉编码器构建高效 MLRM，用 mICL 与门控后期融合缓解视觉忽视，I2I 全库召回 R@100 显著提升并落地线上 A/B。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/do_recom.title: Are Multimodal Embeddings Truly Beneficial for Recommendation? A Deep Dive into Whole vs. Individual Modalities
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/do_recom.description: [ECIR 2026][多模态推荐] 用模态剔除（常量/噪声替换）在14个模型上做受控实证，发现文本主导、图像近乎无效，简单融合基线增益源于架构伪影。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/do_recom.title: Structural and Disentangled Adaptation of Large Vision Language Models for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/do_recom.description: [SIGIR 2026][多模态推荐] 用模态内结构软教师对齐 LVLM 跨模态表征，并以专家化门控 LoRA 解耦梯度流，即插即用提升多模态与序列推荐，长尾增益最高 18.70%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/do_recom.title: Harnessing Multimodal Large Language Models for Multimodal Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/do_recom.description: [AAAI 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 MLLM 将商品图转为文本摘要，再以循环式提示推断动态用户偏好，SFT 微调 LLaVA 做多模态序列推荐，AUC 最高提升约 4.3%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/do_recom.title: VL-CLIP: Enhancing Multimodal Recommendations via Visual Grounding and LLM-Augmented CLIP Embeddings
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/do_recom.description: [RecSys 2025][多模态推荐] 用 Grounding DINO 裁剪商品主体 + LLM 自反思改写商品描述，再微调 CLIP 双塔，Walmart 线上 CTR +18.6%、GMV +4.0%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/efficien.title: CAMMSR: Category-Guided Attentive Mixture of Experts for Multimodal Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/efficien.description: [ICDE 2026][多模态推荐] 用类别预测任务引导注意力 MoE 动态分配模态权重，并以模态交换对比学习对齐跨模态序列表征，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@5 最高提升 15.3%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/efficien.title: Multi-modal Adaptive Mixture of Experts for Cold-start Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/efficien.description: [CIKM 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 用双层 MoE（模态专属专家+动态门控融合）替代拼接/平均融合，在 Amazon 三域冷启动全库排序上 Recall@10 最高提升 16.17%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/efficien.title: PRISM: Personalized Recommendation via Information Synergy Module
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/efficien.description: [WWW 2026][多模态推荐] 用 MoE 显式分解模态唯一/冗余/协同信息并以用户偏好动态重加权，即插即用提升三类序列骨干，Yelp N@10 超最强基线 10.91%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/efficien.title: Personalized Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Foundation Models for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/efficien.description: [WWW 2026][多模态推荐] 按兴趣分群并为每群挂载独立 PEFT 模块，使 CLIP 编码出用户条件化的物品表征，配合群内难负采样，NDCG@20 最高提升 15.3%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/efficien.title: Well Begun is Half Done: Training-Free and Model-Agnostic Semantically Guaranteed User Representation Initialization for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/efficien.description: [SIGIR 2026][多模态推荐] 用交互物品模态特征+聚类全局语义免训练初始化用户表征，弥合用户-物品语义鸿沟，六模型四数据集Recall@5最高提升36.4%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/hypercom.title: COHESION: Composite Graph Convolutional Network with Dual-Stage Fusion for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/hypercom.description: [SIGIR 2025][多模态推荐] 用行为模态早期精炼+晚期注意力融合的双阶段融合，配合异质/同质复合图与自适应BPR，在三个 Amazon 数据集上 R@20 相对提升 4.4%–6.1%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/hypercom.title: Beyond Graph Convolution: Multimodal Recommendation with Topology-aware MLPs
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/hypercom.description: [AAAI 2025][多模态推荐] 用拓扑剪枝+邻域对齐损失替代GCN消息传递，以MLP建模多模态物品关系，全库排序下Recall@10最高提升7.53%

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/hypercom.title: MENTOR: Multi-level Self-supervised Learning for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/hypercom.description: [AAAI 2025][多模态推荐] 以 ID 嵌入为锚做四级跨模态分布对齐，叠加特征掩码与图扰动自监督，Amazon 三集 Recall@20 最高提升 74.73%

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/hypercom.title: Spectrum-based Modality Representation Fusion Graph Convolutional Network for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/hypercom.description: [WSDM 2025][多模态推荐] 将多模态特征投影至频域做滤波去噪与点积融合，配合模态专属/融合双图学习与模态感知偏好模块，在 Amazon 三数据集全库排序下 Recall@20 相对最优基线提升约 5%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/hypercom.title: Modality Alignment with Multi-scale Bilateral Attention for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/hypercom.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 提出 MambaRec，用多尺度空洞卷积+双注意力做局部图文对齐、MMD+InfoNCE 做全局分布对齐，Amazon 三数据集 Recall@20 最高提升约 5.4%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/miss_mul.title: User Long-Term Multi-Interest Retrieval Model for Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/miss_mul.description: [RecSys 2025][序列与会话推荐] 以类别感知分层双兴趣学习与指针生成式类别→物品级联检索，将召回阶段行为序列扩展至千级，淘宝离线HR@2000达16.55%，线上点击+5.54%、订单+11.01%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/miss_mul.title: Hierarchical Time-Aware Mixture of Experts for Multi-Modal Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/miss_mul.description: [WWW 2025][多模态推荐] 用交互MoE过滤模态冗余、时序MoE注入显式时间戳，配合三项辅助任务，在四个Amazon数据集全库排序上NDCG@5最高提升20.9%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/miss_mul.title: HyFormer: Revisiting the Roles of Sequence Modeling and Feature Interaction in CTR Prediction
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/miss_mul.description: [SIGIR 2026][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用 Global Tokens 交替执行 Query Decoding 与 Query Boosting，统一长序列建模与特征交叉，AUC 提升 0.17% 且 FLOPs 仅 3.9T。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/miss_mul.title: GRank: Towards Target-Aware and Streamlined Industrial Retrieval with a Generate-Rank Framework
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/miss_mul.description: [WWW 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用训练期目标注入把 Target-Aware 能力蒸馏进 MIPS 兼容生成器，再以轻量交叉注意力重排，免结构化索引实现 Recall@500 +30% 与 1.7× QPS。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/miss_mul.title: Synergizing Implicit and Explicit User Interests: A Multi-Embedding Retrieval Framework at Pinterest
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/miss_mul.description: [KDD 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] Pinterest 工业级多嵌入召回框架，用可微聚类建模隐式兴趣、条件召回建模显式兴趣，线上 HF Repins +1.09%、A-Pincepts +0.81%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/modality.title: Structural and Disentangled Adaptation of Large Vision Language Models for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/modality.description: [SIGIR 2026][多模态推荐] 用模态内结构软教师对齐 LVLM 跨模态表征，并以专家化门控 LoRA 解耦梯度流，即插即用提升多模态与序列推荐，长尾增益最高 18.70%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/modality.title: Information-Guided Selective Modality-Interest Alignment for Multimodal Recommendation
