venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/modality.title: MENTOR: Multi-level Self-supervised Learning for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/modality.description: [AAAI 2025][多模态推荐] 以 ID 嵌入为锚做四级跨模态分布对齐，叠加特征掩码与图扰动自监督，Amazon 三集 Recall@20 最高提升 74.73%

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/modality.title: Hypercomplex Prompt-aware Multimodal Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/modality.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 用 Cayley-Dickson 超复数多分量嵌入 + 超复数乘法非线性融合 + Prompt 动态补偿，在四个 Amazon 数据集 Full-Ranking 下 Recall@20 最高提升约 13%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/modality.title: COHESION: Composite Graph Convolutional Network with Dual-Stage Fusion for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/modality.description: [SIGIR 2025][多模态推荐] 用行为模态早期精炼+晚期注意力融合的双阶段融合，配合异质/同质复合图与自适应BPR，在三个 Amazon 数据集上 R@20 相对提升 4.4%–6.1%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/qarm_qua.title: GALA: Generative Aligned Learning for Adaptive Multimodal Representation in the Taobao Shangou Recommender System
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/qarm_qua.description: [ICDE 2026][多模态推荐] 三阶段流水线：行为三元组预训练 + GRPO 生成式行为对齐 + 自适应门控融合，离线 AUC +0.12/+0.20，线上订单量 +0.55%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/qarm_qua.title: KuaiRecV2: Benchmarking Large-Scale Continual Learning for Diversified and Multi-task Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/qarm_qua.description: [NeurIPS 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 快手 30 天 4.84 亿交互动态物品池基准，统一评测持续学习、Token 级多样性与多任务检索。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/qarm_qua.title: Empowering Large Language Model for Sequential Recommendation via Multimodal Embeddings and Semantic IDs
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/qarm_qua.description: [CIKM 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 揭示 LLM4SR 的嵌入坍缩与语义ID灾难性遗忘，用多模态嵌入+MMD重建+码本初始化破局，全库排序下 nDCG@5 提升 4.4%–10.5%。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/qarm_qua.title: Mosaic: A Fleet of User Embedding Specialists for Recommendation at Meta
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/qarm_qua.description: [RecSys 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 以四类异构专家模型族构建用户表征舰队，配合 MRM 与余弦冗余损失最大化增量信息，并提出免日志 CoEval 评估，离线 NE 稳定下降、线上 A/B 显著提升。

venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/qarm_qua.title: Multi-modal Adaptive Mixture of Experts for Cold-start Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/multimodal_rec/qarm_qua.description: [CIKM 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 用双层 MoE（模态专属专家+动态门控融合）替代拼接/平均融合，在 Amazon 三域冷启动全库排序上 Recall@10 最高提升 16.17%。

venues/CIKM/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/.title: HSUGA: LLM-Enhanced Recommendation with Hierarchical Semantic Understanding and Group-Aware Alignment
venues/CIKM/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/.description: [ACL 2026 Findings][LLM4Rec] 用分阶段可编辑兴趣演化替代长序列一次性摘要，并按用户活跃度分组调节语义对齐强度，三数据集全库排序稳定提升。

venues/CIKM/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/.title: CoPL: Collaborative Preference Learning for Personalizing LLMs
venues/CIKM/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/.description: [ACL 2025][LLM4Rec] 用用户-回复二部图协同过滤学习用户表征，结合 MoLE 路由个性化奖励模型，并支持无优化未见用户适配，在 UltraFeedback-P 等基准上显著超越个性化奖励模型基线。

venues/CIKM/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/.title: Improving LLMs for Recommendation with Out-Of-Vocabulary Tokens
venues/CIKM/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/.description: [arXiv 2024][LLM4Rec] 用元路径聚类生成 OOV 层级 token 构建用户/物品 META ID，兼顾记忆性与多样性，序列推荐 HR@10 最高提升 30%+。

venues/CIKM/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/.title: CoLLM: Integrating Collaborative Embeddings into Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/.description: [TKDE 2025][大语言模型推荐] 将传统协同过滤模型学到的用户/物品表征经 MLP 映射进 LLM 词嵌入空间，以两阶段调优兼顾暖启动与冷启动，AUC 相对 TALLRec 提升约 8%。

venues/CIKM/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/.title: Generative Next POI Recommendation with Semantic ID
venues/CIKM/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/.description: [KDD 2025][时空轨迹与POI推荐] 用RQ-VAE将POI多源语义量化为层级语义ID并微调LLaMA3-8B生成下一POI，Acc@1最高提升16%，token开销降55%。

venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/energy_gu.title: Large Language Model driven Policy Exploration for Recommender Systems
venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/energy_gu.description: [WSDM 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用 LLM 蒸馏用户偏好离线预训练 A2C 推荐策略，并提出冻结+可学习双策略自适应在线适配，显著提升冷启动回报与长期收益。

venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/energy_gu.title: Beyond Static LLM Policies: Imitation-Enhanced Reinforcement Learning for Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/energy_gu.description: [ICDM 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用 LLM 轨迹作次优示范，经对抗逆强化学习提取奖励并加权模仿，离线 RL 策略在 Steam/Amazon 上累积奖励较 BiLLP 提升 13%+。

venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/energy_gu.title: On Efficiency-Effectiveness Trade-off of Diffusion-based Recommenders
venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/energy_gu.description: [NeurIPS 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用时间一致性正则平滑去噪函数实现一步生成，再用自适应偏好对齐修正轨迹偏差，兼顾扩散推荐效率与效果。

venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/energy_gu.title: Reward Balancing Revisited: Enhancing Offline Reinforcement Learning for Recommender Systems
venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/energy_gu.description: [WWW 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用扩散世界模型显式建模奖励不确定性，并以衰减加权的交互/熵双惩罚平衡多样性与长期收益，在三个真实数据集上刷新离线RL推荐SOTA。

venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/energy_gu.title: DARLR: Dual-Agent Offline Reinforcement Learning for Recommender Systems with Dynamic Reward
venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/energy_gu.description: [SIGIR 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 双智能体离线 RL 用选择器聚合相似用户动态重塑奖励与不确定性惩罚，四数据集累积奖励全面超越 ROLeR/DORL。

venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/expert_gu.title: AHBid: An Adaptable Hierarchical Bidding Framework for Cross-Channel Advertising
venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/expert_gu.description: [WWW 2026][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用扩散模型生成跨渠道预算/约束目标轨迹、结合约束执行与实时控制出价，离线与线上 A/B 收益提升 13.57%。

venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/expert_gu.title: Learning Personalized Ad Impact via Contextual Reinforcement Learning under Delayed Rewards
venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/expert_gu.description: [arXiv 2025][RL与动态探索推荐] 将自动出价建模为带延迟泊松奖励的CMDP，提出两阶段MLE与数据分割，实现个性化出价近最优遗憾界。

venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/expert_gu.title: An Adaptable Budget Planner for Enhancing Budget-Constrained Auto-Bidding in Online Advertising
venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/expert_gu.description: [KDD 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 将竞价周期切分为多阶段，用 in-context RL 逐 episode 调整预算分配，few-shot 适配新广告主，仿真与线上 A/B 均提升累计价值。

venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/expert_gu.title: HOBA: Hierarchical On-Policy Bidding Agents for Adaptive Online Advertising
venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/expert_gu.description: [KDD 2026][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 三层时间尺度解耦出价：LLM 小时级推理超参、SARSA 分钟级因果去偏选专家、专家池逐次拍卖执行，AuctionNet 与线上 A/B 双验证。

venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/expert_gu.title: Lightweight Auto-bidding based on Traffic Prediction in Live Advertising
venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/expert_gu.description: [KDD 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 直播广告场景下，用LightGBM预测全时段累计成本/点击，结合LP对偶最优出价公式与投影梯度下降求解对偶变量，实现秒级轻量自动出价，线上GMV+4.28%。

venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/kp_agent_.title: RTBAgent: A LLM-based Agent System for Real-Time Bidding
venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/kp_agent_.description: [WWW 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 首个 LLM Agent 出价系统，用两步决策+多类记忆+专家策略工具在 iPinYou 上以调整因子方式超越规则/RL/扩散基线。

venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/kp_agent_.title: Multi-objective Aligned Bidword Generation Model for E-commerce Search Advertising
venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/kp_agent_.description: [SIGIR 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用判别器提供相关性/真实性/CPM三维奖励，扩展MODPO做多目标偏好对齐，驱动LLM生成高商业价值竞价词，线上广告收入+2.13%。

venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/kp_agent_.title: AdTEC: A Unified Benchmark for Evaluating Text Quality in Search Engine Advertising
venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/kp_agent_.description: [NAACL 2025][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 首个公开的搜索广告文案质量多维评测基准，定义五任务并对比 PLM/LLM/人类评估者表现。

venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/kp_agent_.title: AgentSociety Challenge: Designing LLM Agents for User Modeling and Recommendation on Web Platforms
venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/kp_agent_.description: [WWW 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 首个 WWW LLM Agent 双赛道竞赛：Yelp/Amazon/Goodreads 三源数据 + 交互式模拟器，295 队参赛，Track1/2 最终阶段提升 9.1%/15.9%，并验证模拟 groundtruth 与真实分布强相关。

venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/kp_agent_.title: Middleman Bias in Advertising: Aligning Relevance of Keyphrase Recommendations with Search
venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/kp_agent_.description: [WWW 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 揭示广告关键词相关性过滤中的“中间人偏差”，用Search相关性判定重构训练标签，并以轻量Cross-Encoder在eBay线上取得CVR+11.6%的收益。

venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/maximum_i.title: Lost in Sequence: Do Large Language Models Understand Sequential Recommendation?
venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/maximum_i.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 揭示现有 LLM4Rec 模型无法捕捉交互序列顺序信息，提出冻结 LLM 与 CF-SRec、仅训练轻量 MLP 的蒸馏框架 LLM-SRec，在 Amazon 四数据集上 NDCG@10 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/maximum_i.title: Think before Recommendation: Autonomous Reasoning-enhanced Recommender
venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/maximum_i.description: [NeurIPS 2025][LLM4Rec] 用纯 GRPO 强化学习替代教师蒸馏，让单个 LLM 自主习得「用户分析→物品分析→匹配→打分」推理链，评分预测 MAE 最高降 29.9%。

venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/maximum_i.title: Empowering Compact LLMs with Fusion of Layer-wise Exits for Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/maximum_i.description: [ICDM 2026][LLM4Rec] 在紧凑 LLM 每层插入预测出口并用连续 ReLU 路由器自适应融合多层打分分布，target-k hinge 损失约束激活出口数，全库排序下精度超越大模型基线且延迟仅增 <1ms。

venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/maximum_i.title: LLM2Rec: Large Language Models Are Powerful Embedding Models for Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/maximum_i.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 两阶段将 LLM 改造为融合协同信号与语义的物品嵌入模型，Full-Ranking 下域内平均提升约 15%、跨域仍稳定增益。

venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/maximum_i.title: One Sequential Recommendation Model Pretrained from Synthetic Priors Predicts Multiple Datasets
venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/maximum_i.description: [KDD 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用 hDCSBM 合成先验预训练 PFN，以支持集条件化实现免更新推理的序列推荐，五基准平均超最优基线 7.53%。

venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/stratifie.title: DARLR: Dual-Agent Offline Reinforcement Learning for Recommender Systems with Dynamic Reward
venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/stratifie.description: [SIGIR 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 双智能体离线 RL 用选择器聚合相似用户动态重塑奖励与不确定性惩罚，四数据集累积奖励全面超越 ROLeR/DORL。

venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/stratifie.title: Long-term User Engagement Optimization through Model-agnostic Downstream Rewards Learning
venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/stratifie.description: [RecSys 2026][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 以 P2P 兔子洞深度、浅层关闭负奖励与新用例采纳三类下游奖励替代稀疏留存标签，在 Pinterest 多场景线上 A/B 中稳定提升会话与留存指标。

venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/stratifie.title: Reward Balancing Revisited: Enhancing Offline Reinforcement Learning for Recommender Systems
venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/stratifie.description: [WWW 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用扩散世界模型显式建模奖励不确定性，并以衰减加权的交互/熵双惩罚平衡多样性与长期收益，在三个真实数据集上刷新离线RL推荐SOTA。

venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/stratifie.title: Beyond Static LLM Policies: Imitation-Enhanced Reinforcement Learning for Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/stratifie.description: [ICDM 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用 LLM 轨迹作次优示范，经对抗逆强化学习提取奖励并加权模仿，离线 RL 策略在 Steam/Amazon 上累积奖励较 BiLLP 提升 13%+。

venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/stratifie.title: Large Language Model driven Policy Exploration for Recommender Systems
venues/CIKM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/stratifie.description: [WSDM 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用 LLM 蒸馏用户偏好离线预训练 A2C 推荐策略，并提出冻结+可学习双策略自适应在线适配，显著提升冷启动回报与长期收益。

venues/CIKM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.title: Latent Factor Modeling with Expert Network for Multi-Behavior Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.description: [TKDE 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用门控专家网络显式建模共享潜在因子，配合对比学习保证因子独立与一致，在三个多行为数据集 Full-Ranking 下 HR@10 最高提升 3.95%。

venues/CIKM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.title: Breaker: Removing Shortcut Cues with User Clustering for Single-slot Recommendation System
venues/CIKM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.description: [KDD 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 用用户表征聚类辅助任务+多塔簇专属偏好建模，破除单槽推荐中用户固有倾向的捷径偏置，离线Recall@1提升7%并上线美团支付。

venues/CIKM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.title: Beyond Item Dissimilarities: Diversifying by Intent in Recommender Systems
venues/CIKM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.description: [KDD 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用实时意图概率驱动整页贪心重排，以贝叶斯后验更新替代物品相似度，YouTube 线上 DAU +0.05%、用户享受度 +0.09%。

venues/CIKM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.title: Multi-Grained Preference Enhanced Transformer for Multi-Behavior Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.description: [KDD 2025][序列与会话推荐] M-GPT 用交互级图卷积建模跨类型行为依赖，并以多粒度多尺度注意力抽取行为感知偏好，Leave-One-Out 全库排序下 HR@5 相对提升 12.2%。

venues/CIKM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.title: MixRec: Heterogeneous Graph Collaborative Filtering
venues/CIKM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.description: [WSDM 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 参数化异质超图解耦多行为意图，配合节点/图级自适应对比学习，Leave-One-Out 全库排序下 HR@10 最高提升 9.8%。

venues/CIKM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.title: LLM2Rec: Large Language Models Are Powerful Embedding Models for Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 两阶段将 LLM 改造为融合协同信号与语义的物品嵌入模型，Full-Ranking 下域内平均提升约 15%、跨域仍稳定增益。

venues/CIKM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.title: Unleashing the Power of Large Language Model for Denoising Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.description: [WWW 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] LLaRD 用 LLM 生成偏好知识与图 CoT 关系知识，再以信息瓶颈对齐去噪图，Full-Ranking 下 Recall@20 最高提升约 14%。

venues/CIKM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.title: Unlocking the Power of Diffusion Models in Sequential Recommendation: A Simple and Effective Approach
venues/CIKM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.description: [KDD 2025][序列与会话推荐] 揭示扩散序列推荐中的嵌入坍缩问题，提出逐 token 独立扩散+三阶段训练，六数据集 HR@20 平均提升 15.45%。

venues/CIKM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.title: Fusion and Alignment Enhancement with Large Language Models for Tail-item Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用自适应门控融合 ID/LLM 嵌入并以双层对齐+课程学习消除空间结构冲突，全库排序下尾部长尾 H@10 最高提升 427%。

venues/CIKM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.title: Beyond Noisy Signals: Dual-Level Denoising for Multi-modal Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.description: [ACM MM 2026][多模态推荐] 图拉普拉斯低通滤波去特征噪声 + FFT 可学习频域滤波去序列噪声，四数据集 Full-Ranking 全面 SOTA，R@20 最高 +19.33%。

venues/CIKM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.title: SimDiffRec: Semantic Similarity-Guided Diffusion for Contrastive Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.description: [WSDM 2026][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 用语义相似物品均值替代高斯随机噪声做扩散增强，按去噪置信度选增强位置并配难负采样，五数据集 Full-Ranking 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/CIKM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.title: SGCL: Unifying Self-Supervised and Supervised Learning for Graph Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.description: [RecSys 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 将 BPR 与 InfoNCE 合并为单一监督图对比损失，免增广免负采样，精度与训练效率双超 SGL/SimGCL。

venues/CIKM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.title: NLGCL: Naturally Existing Neighbor Layers Graph Contrastive Learning for Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.description: [RecSys 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 用 GNN 相邻层天然异构节点作正样本对替代图增广，免视图构建，全库排序下 NDCG@10 最高提升 12.41% 且训练最快。

venues/CIKM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.title: Intent-aware Diffusion with Contrastive Learning for Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.description: [SIGIR 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用 K-means 意图原型引导条件扩散生成意图对齐正视图替代随机增强，在 5 个数据集 Full-Ranking 下 NDCG 平均提升 20.68%。

venues/CIKM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.title: SCONE: A Novel Stochastic Sampling to Generate Contrastive Views and Hard Negative Samples for Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.description: [WSDM 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 用分数生成模型统一生成用户-物品特定对比视图与难负样本，6 数据集全库排序 Recall@20 最高提升 1.70%。

venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/climber_.title: Scaling Recommender Transformers to One Billion Parameters
venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/climber_.description: [KDD 2026][序列与会话推荐] ARGUS 将自回归预训练解耦为反馈预测与下一物品预测双任务，把推荐 Transformer 编码器扩到 10 亿参数，线上听歌时长 +2.26%、点赞率 +6.37%。

venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/climber_.title: MixFormer: Co-Scaling Up Dense and Sequence in Industrial Recommenders
venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/climber_.description: [KDD 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用单一参数空间统一序列建模与稠密特征交叉，配合用户-物品解耦实现请求级复用，AUC 提升 1.28% 且 FLOPs 降 36%。

venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/climber_.title: Towards Generalizable and Efficient Large-Scale Generative Recommenders
venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/climber_.description: [RecSys 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 将生成式推荐骨干从2M扩至1B，用偏移幂律缩放律诊断任务天花板，并以MTP、采样softmax与语义塔解决缓存陈旧与冷启动，1M用户影子MRR全线提升。

venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/climber_.title: OneTrans: Unified Feature Interaction and Sequence Modeling with One Transformer in Industrial Recommender
venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/climber_.description: [WWW 2026][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用单一因果 Transformer 统一序列建模与特征交叉，配合金字塔剪枝与跨请求 KV 缓存，线上 GMV/u 提升 5.68%

venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/climber_.title: Efficient Sequential Recommendation for Long Term User Interest Via Personalization
venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/climber_.description: [ICDM 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用可学习 token 将长历史分段压缩为个性化专家，配合定制注意力掩码与 KV 缓存，在 HSTU/HLLM 上以约 1/4 推理开销逼近全序列精度。

venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/continua.title: Capturing User Interests from Data Streams for Continual Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/continua.description: [WSDM 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用线性注意力参数化记忆替代回放/正则，配合 Cauchy-Schwarz 归一化与共享兴趣池，在流式数据块上兼顾历史保留与新兴趣获取。

venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/continua.title: PCL: Prompt-based Continual Learning for User Modeling in Recommender Systems
venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/continua.description: [WWW 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用位置级+上下文提示做持续用户建模，冻结骨干仅训提示，缓解灾难性遗忘，6/8 任务超越 MTL 上界。

venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/continua.title: TRACER: Balancing Stability-Plasticity-Cognitivity Trilemma for LLM Enhanced Continual Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/continua.description: [CIKM 2026][大语言模型推荐] 揭示 LLM 增强持续推荐中的 SPC 三难困境，用 Procrustes 投影、置信门控凝聚与语义同步三模块协同破局，Full-Ranking 下 ACC 最高提升 14.38%。

venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/continua.title: Learning Evolving Preferences: A Federated Continual Framework for User-Centric Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/continua.description: [WWW 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 联邦持续推荐框架 FCUCR：时间感知自蒸馏抗遗忘 + 跨用户原型迁移促协同，四数据集全库排序 HR@10 最高提升 44.0%。

venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/continua.title: Efficient Sequential Recommendation for Long Term User Interest Via Personalization
venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/continua.description: [ICDM 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用可学习 token 将长历史分段压缩为个性化专家，配合定制注意力掩码与 KV 缓存，在 HSTU/HLLM 上以约 1/4 推理开销逼近全序列精度。

venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/cpmr_con.title: RoTE: Coarse-to-Fine Multi-Level Rotary Time Embedding for Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/cpmr_con.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 将时间戳分解为年/月/日多粒度并借 RoPE 旋转注入 Q/K，即插即用提升 SASRec/RPG，NDCG@5 最高 +20.11%

venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/cpmr_con.title: CMSL: Constructive Multi-Sequence Learning for Recommendation Systems
venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/cpmr_con.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 提出可学习多序列构造与线性注意力，缓解单序列上下文污染，Meta 四场景 NE 降 0.3%–0.6%。

venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/cpmr_con.title: Modeling Stage-wise Evolution of User Interests for News Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/cpmr_con.description: [WWW 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用全局LightGCN+阶段时序子图LSTM/自注意力双分支建模新闻兴趣演化，Adressa AUC 0.7993 大幅超越SOTA。

venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/cpmr_con.title: Towards Automatic Sampling of User Behaviors for Sequential Recommender Systems
venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/cpmr_con.description: [IJCAI 2025][序列与会话推荐] 提出 AutoSAM，用轻量采样器+强化学习多目标奖励自适应丢弃低信息历史行为，在四个真实数据集全库排序下 NDCG@10 平均提升约 8%。

venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/cpmr_con.title: Hierarchical Time-Aware Mixture of Experts for Multi-Modal Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/cpmr_con.description: [WWW 2025][多模态推荐] 用交互MoE过滤模态冗余、时序MoE注入显式时间戳，配合三项辅助任务，在四个Amazon数据集全库排序上NDCG@5最高提升20.9%。

venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/muffin_m.title: Wavelet Enhanced Adaptive Frequency Filter for Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/muffin_m.description: [AAAI 2026][序列推荐] 用上下文动态调制频域滤波器并叠加 Haar 小波高频增强，在 4 个基准 Full-Ranking 下 HR@20 最高提升 11.4%，长序列下训练开销低于 BSARec/SLIME4Rec。

venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/muffin_m.title: Exploiting Inter-Session Information with Frequency-enhanced Dual-Path Networks for Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/muffin_m.description: [AAAI 2026][序列与会话推荐] FreqRec 用可学习复数频域 MLP 双路建模跨会话群体节奏与用户局部高频，并加频域一致性损失，全库排序下 NDCG@10 最高提升 7.38%。

venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/muffin_m.title: FEDIN: Frequency-Enhanced Deep Interest Network for Click-Through Rate Prediction
venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/muffin_m.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 以目标条件化频谱熵观察为动机，用目标感知频谱滤波+时域双分支做CTR预估，三数据集GAUC/AUC全面SOTA。

venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/muffin_m.title: Frequency-aware Graph Signal Processing for Collaborative Filtering
venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/muffin_m.description: [WWW 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用级联高通-低通滤波捕获独有/共性特征、并行低通滤波捕获高阶邻域，免训练线性组合在六个数据集上 Full-Ranking 提升 2-5%。

venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/muffin_m.title: SIGMA: Selective Gated Mamba for Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/muffin_m.description: [AAAI 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用部分翻转双向 Mamba + 输入敏感稠密门控 + FE-GRU 解决 Mamba 单向性与短序列状态不稳问题，五数据集 Full-Ranking 上 HR@10 最高提升 8.82%。

venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/multi_it.title: A Contextual-Aware Position Encoding for Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/multi_it.description: [WWW 2025][序列与会话推荐] 首个为序列推荐定制的上下文感知位置编码 CAPE：用目标-上下文不相似度累加动态分配位置，配合门控融合异构特征，在 5 个骨干与工业 A/B 上稳定涨点。

venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/multi_it.title: BlossomRec: Block-level Fused Sparse Attention Mechanism for Sequential Recommendations
venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/multi_it.description: [WWW 2026][序列与会话推荐] 双路块级稀疏注意力（LTIS 块选择 + STIS 幂律掩码）经门控融合，长序列训练提速 3.2×、显存降至 1/11，精度持平或超越 SASRec。

venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/multi_it.title: Massive Memorization with Hundreds of Trillions of Parameters for Sequential Transducer Generative Recommenders
venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/multi_it.description: [ICLR 2026][序列与会话推荐] VISTA 将超长用户历史两阶段解耦：离线用准线性注意力压缩为数百种子嵌入并缓存，下游仅做候选-摘要注意力，工业上线推理 GPU 降 94%。

venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/multi_it.title: Long-Sequence Recommendation Models Need Decoupled Embeddings
venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/multi_it.description: [ICLR 2025][序列与会话推荐] 揭示长序列推荐中注意力与表征共享嵌入导致的梯度支配与冲突，提出双嵌入表 DARE，AUC 最高提升 9‰ 并加速检索 50%。

venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/multi_it.title: Temporal Linear Item-Item Model for Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/multi_it.description: [WSDM 2025][序列与会话推荐] 在闭式解线性 item-item 模型上引入时间间隔加权与趋势感知归一化，Full-Ranking 下平均 NDCG@10 提升 9.07%，训练快 6.9–57 倍。

venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/transact.title: InteractRank: Personalized Web-Scale Search Pre-Ranking with Cross Interaction Features
venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/transact.description: [WWW 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 在双塔预排序点积之上叠加历史交互统计特征 IQP 与实时用户序列，以 1.1× FLOPs 实现线上 SIFR +6.5%、F1S +9.2%。

venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/transact.title: HORIZON: A Benchmark for In-the-wild User Behaviour Modeling
venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/transact.description: [ACL 2026 Findings][跨域与多场景推荐] 重构 Amazon Reviews 为 54M 用户跨域长程基准，提出时间-用户双轴四象限评估与 LLM 查询改写/长程建模任务，揭示 ID 模型在时间外推下崩塌。

venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/transact.title: Decoupled Entity Representation Learning for Pinterest Ads Ranking
venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/transact.description: [RecSys 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 提出解耦式上游-下游实体表征框架 DERM，三塔+对比自监督+滑动平均聚合，离线 AUC 提升 0.19%、线上 CTR +1.38%、CPA -1.61%

venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/transact.title: User Long-Term Multi-Interest Retrieval Model for Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/transact.description: [RecSys 2025][序列与会话推荐] 以类别感知分层双兴趣学习与指针生成式类别→物品级联检索，将召回阶段行为序列扩展至千级，淘宝离线HR@2000达16.55%，线上点击+5.54%、订单+11.01%。

venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/transact.title: UniPinRec: Unifying Generative Retrieval and Ranking at Pinterest Scale
venues/CIKM/2025/sequential_rec/transact.description: [RecSys 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用 MAM 掩码动作建模 + 混合样本 + 跨阶段 KV 缓存复用，将生成式召回与排序全栈统一，线上延迟降 11.1%、QPS 升 63.6%。

venues/CIKM/2025/social_group_rec/commun.title: Score-based Generative Diffusion Models for Social Recommendations
venues/CIKM/2025/social_group_rec/commun.description: [TKDE 2025][社交与群组推荐] 用 SDE 扩散模型在隐空间直接生成协同一致的社交表征，配合课程训练与跨域对比学习，Full-Ranking 下 Recall@10 相对提升 1.85%–3.07%。

venues/CIKM/2025/social_group_rec/commun.title: PULSE: Socially-Aware User Representation Modeling Toward Parameter-Efficient Graph Collaborative Filtering
venues/CIKM/2025/social_group_rec/commun.description: [WWW 2026][社交与群组推荐] 用社区结构与社交邻居物品信号替代显式用户嵌入，参数降 50% 且 NDCG@20 提升 8-9%

venues/CIKM/2025/social_group_rec/commun.title: From Aggregation to Selection: User-Validated Distributed Social Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/social_group_rec/commun.description: [WWW 2026][社交与群组推荐] 将分布式社交推荐从模型聚合转为用户驱动的算法选择+验证者多数共识投票，提出 Acc@K 共识评测，四数据集 Acc@2 平均提升 4.51%。

venues/CIKM/2025/social_group_rec/commun.title: Graph Cross-Correlated Network for Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/social_group_rec/commun.description: [TKDE 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 用非递归 PGR 保留各跳邻居纯语义，再以 HCC/ECC 显式建模用户-物品子图交叉相关项，全库排序下 NDCG@20 平均提升约 1.8%–2.9%。

venues/CIKM/2025/social_group_rec/commun.title: Disentangled Modeling of Preferences and Social Influence for Group Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/social_group_rec/commun.description: [AAAI 2025][社交与群组推荐] 解耦用户偏好与社会影响的双通道(超)图传播，配合社交重要性引导的对比学习，缓解群组推荐的偏好偏差与数据稀疏。

venues/CIKM/2025/social_group_rec/hetero.title: Leveraging LLMs for Influence Path Planning in Proactive Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/social_group_rec/hetero.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 用提示工程驱动 LLM 零样本规划主动推荐影响路径，配合 LLM 用户模拟器与 SASRec 模拟器双轨评测，显著提升路径连贯性与用户接受度。

venues/CIKM/2025/social_group_rec/hetero.title: Learning Peer Influence Probabilities with Linear Contextual Bandits
venues/CIKM/2025/social_group_rec/hetero.description: [KDD 2026][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 将同伴影响力概率学习建模为双目标线性上下文 Bandit，刻画 Regret–RMSE 帕累托前沿并提出 InfluenceCB 以单参数 β 导航权衡。

venues/CIKM/2025/social_group_rec/hetero.title: Unbiased Collaborative Filtering with Fair Sampling
venues/CIKM/2025/social_group_rec/hetero.description: [SIGIR 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 通过对称补充采样使每个用户/物品等概率成为正负样本，无需估计倾向分即可消除流行度偏置，全库排序下 Recall/NDCG 与 ARP 双优。

venues/CIKM/2025/social_group_rec/hetero.title: Continuous-time Discrete-space Diffusion Model for Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/social_group_rec/hetero.description: [WSDM 2026][生成式推荐] 将推荐历史交互建模为连续时间离散空间（吸收态掩码）扩散，配合流行度感知噪声调度、一致性参数化与多跳对比引导，在三个数据集 Full-Ranking 下 Recall@10 相对提升 4.2%–5.2%。

venues/CIKM/2025/social_group_rec/hetero.title: Causality-aware Graph Aggregation Weight Estimator for Popularity Debiasing in Top-K Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2025/social_group_rec/hetero.description: [CIKM 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 将图聚合证明为后门调整，用 VAE 式编码器-解码器估计无偏聚合权重，配合动量更新，小众物品 Recall@20 提升约 20%。

venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: LLM-as-a-Judge for Reliable and Explainable Offline Evaluation in Top-K Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [KDD 2026][去偏公平与工业评测] 用 LLM 从用户文本行为构建语义偏好代理替代 holdout ID 匹配，以 reasoning-then-scoring 生成可解释 Top-K 评测，模型排序一致性较常规测试提升 40–150%。

venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: LLM-Powered User Simulator for Recommender System
venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [AAAI 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用 LLM 离线蒸馏物品优缺点关键词，构建关键词匹配+语义相似+序列统计三模型集成用户模拟器，为 RL 推荐提供可解释高保真环境。

venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: PUB: An LLM-Enhanced Personality-Driven User Behaviour Simulator for Recommender System Evaluation
venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [SIGIR 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用大五人格驱动 LLM Agent 生成合成交互日志，Jaccard 相似度 0.31 逼近真实序列，并复现 7 种推荐算法的 nDCG 排序趋势。

venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: On the Reliability of Sampling Strategies in Offline Recommender Evaluation
venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [RecSys 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 以全观测 KuaiRec 为真值，四维度（分辨率/保真度/鲁棒性/预测力）系统解耦曝光偏差与采样偏差，给出采样策略选择指南。

venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: Recommendation and Temptation
venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [RecSys 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 将用户选择解耦为 enrichment 与 temptation 双效用并引入站外选项，证明局部贪心最优并给出可估计算子，MovieLens 与仿真全面超越基线。

venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: Refining Text Generation for Realistic Conversational Recommendation via Direct Preference Optimization
venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [EMNLP 2025][对话推荐与智能体] 用 DPO 对齐 LLM 生成的对话摘要与物品推荐信息，使评分器更准，Tabidachi 上 HR@1 提升 21.3%。

venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: Interplay: Training Independent Simulators for Reference-Free Conversational Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [ECIR 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 训练独立用户/推荐双模拟器，以目标属性替代目标物品消除 oracle 泄漏，8B 模型 Recall@1 超 32B 基线 15 倍。

venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: USB-Rec: An Effective Framework for Improving Conversational Recommendation Capability of Large Language Model
venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [RecSys 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用带标签用户模拟器自动构造偏好对做 RL 训练，再在推理期用内部用户模拟器+树搜索自增强，iEval 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: Enhancing Personalized Multi-Turn Dialogue with Curiosity Reward
venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [NeurIPS 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 将用户模型信念增益作为 PBRS 内在奖励注入多轮 RLHF，使 LLM 主动探询用户属性，习题推荐成功率 54%→87.5%。

venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: HARPO: Hierarchical Agentic Reasoning for User-Aligned Conversational Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [ACL 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 将对话推荐重构为多维质量驱动的结构化决策，用分层偏好奖励引导树搜索推理，ReDial R@10 达 29.8%（+18.7%）。

venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: Contextualizing Recommendation Explanations with LLMs: A User Study
venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [ICWSM 2026][LLM4Rec] 预注册在线实验(N=759)+访谈(N=30)对比无解释/通用解释/情境化解释，情境化解释显著提升认知需求与观看意愿，但对功利/情感需求增益有限。

venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: The Utility of LLMs in Recommender Systems Explanation Evaluation
venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [RecSys 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 系统评测 14 个 LLM 作为推荐解释评审员与 216 名人类评分的一致性，发现排序相关中等但绝对评分一致性低，并给出四条实用准则。

venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: From Top-1 to Top-K: A Reproducibility Study and Benchmarking of Counterfactual Explanations for Recommender Systems
venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [SIGIR 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 统一复现11种反事实解释器，首次提出列表级Top-K评估协议与PN-R位置敏感指标，揭示显式格式下有效性-稀疏性权衡与图解释器可扩展性瓶颈。

venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: Large Language Models as Narrative-Driven Recommenders
venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 系统评测 38 个 LLM 在 Reddit 叙事式电影推荐上的表现，发现零样本提示即可显著超越 doc2vec 基线 70%+，中型开源模型接近大型闭源模型。

venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: Enhancing Recommendation Explanations through User-Centric Refinement
venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [ACL 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出 RefineX 多智能体推理期精炼框架，以 plan-then-refine 与分层反思将 PETER 解释在事实性/个性化/连贯性三维度大幅提升。

venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: STEP: Stepwise Curriculum Learning for Context-Knowledge Fusion in Conversational Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [CIKM 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用三阶段课程学习驱动 F-Former 对齐对话与知识图谱，再以双前缀提示注入冻结 PLM，ReDial R@1 提升 15.7%。

venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: Improving Conversational Recommendation with Contextual Adaptation of External Recommenders and LLM-based Reranking
venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [ECIR 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用轻量实体级序列推荐器产出候选、LLM 做上下文适配重排，ReDial/INSPIRED 上 H@5 平均提升 54%/25%。

venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: Beyond Retrieval: Generating Narratives in Conversational Recommender Systems
venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 构建 REGEN 叙事数据集并提出 CF+内容嵌入经 Adapter 注入 LLM 的融合架构，在 Office/Clothing 两域上 BLEU/ROUGE/语义相似度较单模态提升 4–12%。

venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: Bridging Conversational and Collaborative Signals for Conversational Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [WWW 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 构建 Reddit-ML32M 跨源数据集，用 SASRec 协同嵌入对 GPT-3.5 零样本推荐做相似度重排，H@5 提升 12.32%。

venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: RecQuest: Towards Estimating User Domain Knowledge in Conversational Recommender Systems
venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [SIGIR 2026 (ICTIR)][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出游戏化数据采集协议 RecQuest 与知识估计新任务，用客观问卷替代自评建立 ground truth，并给出 LLM 零/少样本与微调基线。

venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: Collaborative Retrieval for Large Language Model-based Conversational Recommender Systems
venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [WWW 2025][对话推荐与智能体] 用 EASE 协同检索 + 两步 LLM 反思重排为黑盒 LLM 注入 CF 知识，Reddit-v2/Redial 全库排序 Recall@20 显著超越 Zero-shot LLM。

venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: The Recall Ceiling of LLM Recommendation Reranking
venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [CIKM 2026][LLM4Rec] 证明闭候选重排器 NDCG 受自身窗口召回率硬上界约束，Oracle 协议高估 92–95%，九类 LLM 与监督重排器在真实检索下均无法显著超越 CF。

venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: Bridging Conversational and Collaborative Signals for Conversational Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [WWW 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 构建 Reddit-ML32M 跨源数据集，用 SASRec 协同嵌入对 GPT-3.5 零样本推荐做相似度重排，H@5 提升 12.32%。

venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: Improving Conversational Recommendation with Contextual Adaptation of External Recommenders and LLM-based Reranking
venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [ECIR 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用轻量实体级序列推荐器产出候选、LLM 做上下文适配重排，ReDial/INSPIRED 上 H@5 平均提升 54%/25%。

venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: Rethinking LLM-Based Recommendations: A Personalized Query-Driven Parallel Integration
venues/CIKM/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [ACL 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出 QUEREC 并行框架，用 LLM 零样本生成个性化用户查询与特征增强物品描述，与 CF 模型并行全库检索后自适应重排，Full-Ranking 下最高提升 57%。

venues/CIKM/2026/cold_start_rec/castle_c.title: Bridging Passive and Active: Enhancing Conversation Starter Recommendation via Active Expression Modeling
venues/CIKM/2026/cold_start_rec/castle_c.description: [SIGIR 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用对抗分布对齐+RQ-VAE语义离散化把用户主动查询引入对话开场白推荐，打破曝光-点击回音室，线上活跃天数+0.04%。

venues/CIKM/2026/cold_start_rec/castle_c.title: EAGER: Enrich-and-Align Generative Query Recommendation from Clicked Items in E-commerce Search
venues/CIKM/2026/cold_start_rec/castle_c.description: [EMNLP 2026 Industry][LLM4Rec] 两阶段生成式 I2Q 查询推荐：课程化 SFT 扩意图覆盖 + GRPO 混合奖励对齐线上约束，线上 UCTR +0.83%、Pay Count +3.49%。

venues/CIKM/2026/cold_start_rec/castle_c.title: SMART: LLM-Augmented Hybrid Retrieval for Dynamic Product Ads
venues/CIKM/2026/cold_start_rec/castle_c.description: [RecSys 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 揭示规则查询擅长 BM25 重定向、LLM 查询擅长 ANN 拓客的检索分解，用输出审计门控仅路由 10% 用户，线上转化率 +27.6%

venues/CIKM/2026/cold_start_rec/castle_c.title: GenFacet: End-to-End Generative Faceted Search via Multi-Task Preference Alignment in E-Commerce
venues/CIKM/2026/cold_start_rec/castle_c.description: [SIGIR 2026][大语言模型推荐] 将电商分面搜索重构为分面生成与查询改写两个耦合生成任务，经蒸馏+SFT+GRPO 对齐搜索效用，线上分面 CTR 相对提升 42.0%。

venues/CIKM/2026/cold_start_rec/castle_c.title: CroPS: Improving Dense Retrieval with Cross-Perspective Positive Samples in Short-Video Search
venues/CIKM/2026/cold_start_rec/castle_c.description: [AAAI 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用查询改写/推荐流/LLM 三源扩充正样本，配分层标签与 H-InfoNCE，快手搜索线上 CTR +0.87%、改写率 -0.65%

venues/CIKM/2026/collaborative_filtering.title: Graph Spectral Filtering with Chebyshev Interpolation for Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/collaborative_filtering.description: [SIGIR 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用切比雪夫插值逼近非线性图滤波器，直接以原始交互为信号，突破 LightGCN 的截断线性低通瓶颈，Full-Ranking 下全面 SOTA 且推理快 8.1 倍。

venues/CIKM/2026/collaborative_filtering.title: Beyond Instance-Level Alignment and Uniformity: Semantic Factor Learning for Collaborative Filtering
venues/CIKM/2026/collaborative_filtering.description: [KDD 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用批次内语义因子路由+匹配构造语义潜在正对，替代GCN邻域聚合，在四个稀疏数据集全库排序下NDCG@20最高提升6.24%。

venues/CIKM/2026/collaborative_filtering.title: SGCL: Unifying Self-Supervised and Supervised Learning for Graph Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/collaborative_filtering.description: [RecSys 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 将 BPR 与 InfoNCE 合并为单一监督图对比损失，免增广免负采样，精度与训练效率双超 SGL/SimGCL。

venues/CIKM/2026/collaborative_filtering.title: Diversity-Augmented Negative Sampling for Implicit Collaborative Filtering
venues/CIKM/2026/collaborative_filtering.description: [WWW 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用用户级缓存 + 多样性增强 k-DPP + mixup 合成负样本，解决两阶段负采样同质化问题，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@20 最高提升 8.76%。

venues/CIKM/2026/collaborative_filtering.title: PULSE: Socially-Aware User Representation Modeling Toward Parameter-Efficient Graph Collaborative Filtering
venues/CIKM/2026/collaborative_filtering.description: [WWW 2026][社交与群组推荐] 用社区结构与社交邻居物品信号替代显式用户嵌入，参数降 50% 且 NDCG@20 提升 8-9%

venues/CIKM/2026/collaborative_filtering.title: SORT: A Systematically Optimized Ranking Transformer for Industrial-scale Recommenders
venues/CIKM/2026/collaborative_filtering.description: [CIKM 2026][多任务学习与列表级重排] 以请求为中心组织样本、局部注意力+查询剪枝、生成式预训练与稀疏MoE重构工业精排Transformer，线上GMV+8.65%且延迟降62%。

venues/CIKM/2026/collaborative_filtering.title: Climber: Toward Efficient Scaling Laws for Large Recommendation Models
venues/CIKM/2026/collaborative_filtering.description: [CIKM 2025][序列与会话推荐] 面向推荐场景改造 Transformer：多尺度子序列抽取降复杂度、自适应温度调制注意力，配合单用户多物品批处理与 KV 缓存，线上指标 +12.19%。

venues/CIKM/2026/collaborative_filtering.title: OneTrans: Unified Feature Interaction and Sequence Modeling with One Transformer in Industrial Recommender
venues/CIKM/2026/collaborative_filtering.description: [WWW 2026][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用单一因果 Transformer 统一序列建模与特征交叉，配合金字塔剪枝与跨请求 KV 缓存，线上 GMV/u 提升 5.68%

venues/CIKM/2026/collaborative_filtering.title: RankMixer: Scaling Up Ranking Models in Industrial Recommenders
venues/CIKM/2026/collaborative_filtering.description: [CIKM 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用无参多头Token Mixing替代自注意力、Per-token FFN隔离特征子空间，配合ReLU路由稀疏MoE，在抖音万亿级数据上将MFU从4.5%提至45%，参数扩100倍而延迟不增。

venues/CIKM/2026/collaborative_filtering.title: OneRank: Unified Transformer-Native Ranking Architecture for Multi-Task Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/collaborative_filtering.description: [KDD 2026][多任务学习与列表级重排] 将多任务推理内化进 Transformer 栈，用任务私有 token 通道 + 梯度截断 + 匹配式打分替代编码器-预测器分离，Shopee 离线与线上 A/B 全面领先。

venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Revisiting Self-attention for Cross-domain Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [KDD 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 将跨域序列推荐重构为推荐损失与跨域注意力抑制的双目标帕累托优化，以即插即用方式改造自注意力，平均提升 Recall@10 达 9.8%/16.0%。

venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: LLM-EDT: Large Language Model Enhanced Cross-domain Sequential Recommendation with Dual-phase Training
venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [SIGIR 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 用可迁移物品增广+双阶段训练+域感知画像，缓解CDSR域不平衡与域迁移难题，全库排序下H@10最高提升26.96%

venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Bridge the Domains: Large Language Models Enhanced Cross-domain Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [SIGIR 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用 LLM 语义嵌入+分层画像桥接跨域物品与用户偏好，破解重叠困境与转移复杂性，三数据集 H@10 最高提升 31.7%。

venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: From IDs to Semantics: A Generative Framework for Cross-Domain Recommendation with Adaptive Semantic Tokenization
venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [AAAI 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 用领域自适应语义ID分词+对称动态路由的生成式跨域推荐框架，Leave-Last-Out全库排序下全面超越SOTA。

venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: ABXI: Invariant Interest Adaptation for Task-Guided Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [WWW 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用任务引导对齐消除预测错配，并以 dLoRA/iLoRA 双 LoRA 抽取域不变兴趣，三数据集 MRR 大幅超越 CDSR 基线。

venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Automated Prompting for Non-overlapping Cross-domain Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [TKDE 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用可学习连续 Prompt（域无关+域特定+冻结标签）替代域对齐约束，实现无重叠实体、仅隐式反馈的双目标跨域序列推荐，Movie-Book 上 HR@10 相对最优基线提升约 17.8%。

venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: MergeRec: Model Merging for Data-Isolated Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [KDD 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 提出数据隔离跨域序列推荐新设定，用任务向量模型合并+伪用户数据+推荐/蒸馏联合目标，Recall@10 平均提升 17.21%。

venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: ABXI: Invariant Interest Adaptation for Task-Guided Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [WWW 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用任务引导对齐消除预测错配，并以 dLoRA/iLoRA 双 LoRA 抽取域不变兴趣，三数据集 MRR 大幅超越 CDSR 基线。

venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: HORIZON: A Benchmark for In-the-wild User Behaviour Modeling
venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [ACL 2026 Findings][跨域与多场景推荐] 重构 Amazon Reviews 为 54M 用户跨域长程基准，提出时间-用户双轴四象限评估与 LLM 查询改写/长程建模任务，揭示 ID 模型在时间外推下崩塌。

venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: LLM2Rec: Large Language Models Are Powerful Embedding Models for Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 两阶段将 LLM 改造为融合协同信号与语义的物品嵌入模型，Full-Ranking 下域内平均提升约 15%、跨域仍稳定增益。

venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: FeDecider: An LLM-Based Framework for Federated Cross-Domain Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [WWW 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 联邦跨域 LLM 推荐中，服务器只广播 LoRA 更新的方向分量以消除尺度噪声，客户端用可学习个性化权重做数据感知融合，Goodreads 平均 Hit@5 提升 3.8%。

venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: From IDs to Semantics: A Generative Framework for Cross-Domain Recommendation with Adaptive Semantic Tokenization
venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [AAAI 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 用领域自适应语义ID分词+对称动态路由的生成式跨域推荐框架，Leave-Last-Out全库排序下全面超越SOTA。

venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Reasoning over Semantic IDs Enhances Generative Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 通过教师模型合成富化语料强化 SID-语言对齐，再用 GRPO 结果驱动强化学习激发 SID 推理，三数据集 Full-Ranking 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Empowering Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation with Hybrid Tokenization and Serial-Parallel Decoding
venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [RecSys 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义 ID] 跨域共享-专属多塔 RQ-VAE 混合分词 + 两段式串并解码，Leave-One-Out 全库排序下精度 +1.5%、时延 -85.1%。

venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Token-level Collaborative Alignment for LLM-based Generative Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [WWW 2026][LLM4Rec] 将CF物品级logits投影为token级分布并与one-hot融合成软标签，以soft-NTP损失显式对齐LLM生成，即插即用提升多骨干推荐效果。

venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation with Representation-Level User Transfer
venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [CIKM 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 仅通过用户表征级迁移实现跨域序列推荐，融合层注入源域用户向量，兼容纵向联邦与部分重叠用户，全库排序下 NDCG@10 提升 7.4–24.1%。

venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: HIT Model: A Hierarchical Interaction-Enhanced Two-Tower Model for Pre-Ranking Systems
venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [CIKM 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用双生成器预生成跨塔粗粒度向量+多头子空间细粒度匹配，在保持双塔预缓存效率下逼近全交互模型精度，腾讯线上GMV+1.66%。

venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Exploring Preference-Guided Diffusion Model for Cross-Domain Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [KDD 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用源域交互历史构造偏好引导信号，逐步注入扩散逆向过程生成目标域冷启动用户表征，三场景 MAE 最高降 32.60%。

venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: SOLARIS: Speculative Offloading of Latent-bAsed Representation for Inference Scaling
venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [SIGIR 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 借鉴投机解码思想，异步预计算基础模型用户-物品隐表征并分层补全覆盖，实现推理时知识蒸馏，Meta 广告线上收入 +0.67%。

venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Personalized Multi-Interest Modeling for Cross-Domain Recommendation to Cold-Start Users
venues/CIKM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [ICDE 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用归一化流增强神经过程，将单峰高斯先验转为多峰分布以建模用户多兴趣，并引入偏好池捕获跨用户共同偏好，五场景 MAE 平均降约 45%。

venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Bid2X: Revealing Dynamics of Bidding Environment in Online Advertising from A Foundation Model Lens
venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [KDD 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 将自动出价环境建模重构为跨场景基础模型的下一token预测，用变量/时间双注意力+零膨胀投影，8数据集MAE全面领先，线上GMV+4.65%。

venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.title: DARA: Few-shot Budget Allocation in Online Advertising via In-Context Decision Making with RL-Finetuned LLMs
venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [WWW 2026][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 双阶段 LLM 智能体分离少样本规划与精细优化，配合动态参考策略 GRPO-Adaptive 微调，在真实与合成广告环境中显著降低边际 ROI 方差。

venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.title: HIT Model: A Hierarchical Interaction-Enhanced Two-Tower Model for Pre-Ranking Systems
venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [CIKM 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用双生成器预生成跨塔粗粒度向量+多头子空间细粒度匹配，在保持双塔预缓存效率下逼近全交互模型精度，腾讯线上GMV+1.66%。

venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.title: RTBAgent: A LLM-based Agent System for Real-Time Bidding
venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [WWW 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 首个 LLM Agent 出价系统，用两步决策+多类记忆+专家策略工具在 iPinYou 上以调整因子方式超越规则/RL/扩散基线。

venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.title: BAT: Benchmark for Auto-bidding Task
venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [WWW 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 发布 Avito 双拍卖格式（VCG/FP）真实自动出价数据集，配套 ALM/TA-PID 等 5 个基线，覆盖预算平滑与 CPC 约束两类 RTB 任务。

venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.title: On Predicting Post-Click Conversion Rate via Counterfactual Inference
venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [ICDM 2025][CTR/CVR 预估与特征交叉] 用 SCM 对未点击样本做 do(C=1) 反事实推断生成转化伪标签，全空间训练 CVR 模型，离线 AUC 平均 +1.01%，线上 CVR +17.35%。

venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.title: See Beyond a Single View: Multi-Attribution Learning Leads to Better Conversion Rate Prediction
venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [CIKM 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 将多归因标签作为辅助任务联合学习，用笛卡尔积辅助训练增强监督信号，离线GAUC+0.51%、线上ROI+2.6%

venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Exploring the Potential of LLMs for Serendipity Evaluation in Recommender Systems
venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [RecSys 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 用 LLM 模拟用户对推荐结果做惊喜度（serendipity）打分，在淘宝与 MovieLens 两个真实用户调研数据集上做元评估，最优配置 Pearson 相关达 21.5%，显著超越传统代理指标。

venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.title: LLM-based User-Product Relevance Evaluation for Dynamic Product Advertising
venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [CIKM 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 用 SID 分组意图压缩 + 智能体指南蒸馏小模型，构建无查询的 DPA 召回离线相关性指标，与线上 CP/CR/CVR 强对齐。

venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Atomic Intent Reasoning: Bringing LLM Semantics to Industrial Cross-Domain Recommendations
venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [KDD 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 将 LLM 意图推理离线化为原子行为-意图对缓存，在线经意图树构建与目标感知检索实现约 400× 加速，快手 A/B 测试 GMV +3.446%。

venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Jointly Optimizing Debiased CTR and Uplift for Coupons Marketing: A Unified Causal Framework
venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [CIKM 2026][CTR预估与特征交叉] UniMVT 用 MoE 解耦混淆表征 + logit 空间单调线性假设，统一估计去偏 Base CTR 与多值券面额 Uplift，线上收入 +18.14%。

venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.title: CanniUplift: A Holistic Framework for Mitigating Seller and Incentive Cannibalization in E-commerce Uplift Modeling
venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [KDD 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 用平台级GMV一致性约束与核销路径分解，缓解多卖家电商uplift建模中的卖家级与激励级蚕食，线上ΔGMV相对提升4.08%。

venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.title: R&F-Inventory: A Large-Scale Dataset for Monotonic Inventory Estimation in Reach and Frequency Advertising
venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [SIGIR 2026][CTR预估与特征交叉] 首个公开的 R&F 合约库存预估数据集，以「定向-排期-频控」为上下文提供完整预算-效果曲线，定义单点预测与多维单调曲线重建两大基准任务。

venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Model Monotonicity in Autobidding Auctions: When Do Better Predictions Lead to Better Outcomes?
venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [ICML 2026][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用划分细化刻画模型改进，系统证明自动出价拍卖中仅三种设定保证平台指标单调，其余均可反例击穿。

venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Contextual Generative Auction with Permutation-level Externalities for Online Advertising
venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [KDD 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用自回归生成器直接生成广告位序列并建模排列级外部性，配合可微事后遗憾学习支付规则，淘宝线上 RPM +3.2%。

venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Counterfactual Inference under Thompson Sampling
venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [RecSys 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 推导 Thompson Sampling 下动作倾向性的精确可计算闭式解，使 IPS 类离线评估在 TS 策略下首次可行，OBP 仿真验证无偏收敛。

venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.title: On Predicting Post-Click Conversion Rate via Counterfactual Inference
venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [ICDM 2025][CTR/CVR 预估与特征交叉] 用 SCM 对未点击样本做 do(C=1) 反事实推断生成转化伪标签，全空间训练 CVR 模型，离线 AUC 平均 +1.01%，线上 CVR +17.35%。

venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.title: GenCI: Generative Modeling of User Interest Shift via Cohort-based Intent Learning for CTR Prediction
venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [WWW 2026][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用RQ-VAE语义ID+NTP生成兴趣群组，再以分层候选感知注意力注入精排，弥合召回-排序意图鸿沟，三数据集AUC全面SOTA。

venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.title: ORCA: Mitigating Over-Reliance for Multi-Task Dwell Time Prediction with Causal Decoupling
venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [CIKM 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用因果解耦显式建模并减去CTR对停留时间预测的负迁移，恢复中时长分桶语义，DT指标平均提升10.6%且不损CTR。

venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.title: MCLMR: A Model-Agnostic Causal Learning Framework for Multi-Behavior Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [WWW 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 用后门干预+MoE自适应聚合+偏差感知对比学习，作为即插即用框架增强多行为推荐，三数据集全库排序显著提升。

venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Climber: Toward Efficient Scaling Laws for Large Recommendation Models
venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [CIKM 2025][序列与会话推荐] 面向推荐场景改造 Transformer：多尺度子序列抽取降复杂度、自适应温度调制注意力，配合单用户多物品批处理与 KV 缓存，线上指标 +12.19%。

venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.title: MixFormer: Co-Scaling Up Dense and Sequence in Industrial Recommenders
venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [KDD 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用单一参数空间统一序列建模与稠密特征交叉，配合用户-物品解耦实现请求级复用，AUC 提升 1.28% 且 FLOPs 降 36%。

venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Beyond Dense Connectivity: Explicit Sparsity for Scalable Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [SIGIR 2026][CTR预估与特征交叉] 揭示稠密MLP隐式权重稀疏现象，提出 filter-then-fuse 多视图显式稀疏框架 SSR，在十亿级工业数据与三个公开集上以更低算力超越 RankMixer。

venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Unlocking Scaling Law in Industrial Recommendation Systems with a Three-step Paradigm based Large User Model
venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [WSDM 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义 ID] 提出 LUM 三步范式（生成预训练→条件查询→判别式 DLRM 融合），以 next-condition-item 预测打通生成与判别，7B 参数下稳定扩展，线上 CTR +2.9%。

venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Exploring Test-time Scaling via Prediction Merging on Large-Scale Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [SIGIR 2026][CTR预估与特征交叉] 提出预测合并式测试时缩放，用异构架构与同构随机种子生成多样 logit 并平均融合，三数据集八骨干上稳定超越参数缩放。

venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.title: Continual Recommender Systems
venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.description: [CIKM 2025][序列与会话推荐] 系统梳理持续推荐的两大技术路线（经验回放与正则化），并延伸至资源受限与序列交互场景，给出可信性、基础模型与搜推统一三大开放方向。

venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.title: TRACER: Balancing Stability-Plasticity-Cognitivity Trilemma for LLM Enhanced Continual Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.description: [CIKM 2026][大语言模型推荐] 揭示 LLM 增强持续推荐中的 SPC 三难困境，用 Procrustes 投影、置信门控凝聚与语义同步三模块协同破局，Full-Ranking 下 ACC 最高提升 14.38%。

venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.title: Capturing User Interests from Data Streams for Continual Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.description: [WSDM 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用线性注意力参数化记忆替代回放/正则，配合 Cauchy-Schwarz 归一化与共享兴趣池，在流式数据块上兼顾历史保留与新兴趣获取。

venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.title: Online Item Cold-Start Recommendation with Popularity-Aware Meta-Learning
venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.description: [KDD 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 按流行度固定切分元学习任务并配冷启动增强器，流式在线场景下冷启动召回相对 SOTA 提升 11%–74%。

venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.title: On the Role of Weight Decay in Collaborative Filtering: A Popularity Perspective
venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.description: [KDD 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 揭示权重衰减本质是将流行度编码进嵌入模长，提出 PRISM 初始化策略替代权重衰减，NDCG 最高提升 4.77% 且训练加速 38.48%。

venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.title: Exploring the Escalation of Source Bias in User, Data, and Recommender System Feedback Loop
venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.description: [SIGIR 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 揭示 AIGC 在用户-数据-系统反馈回路中被逐步放大的来源偏见，并提出基于 L1 损失的黑盒去偏方法维持内容生态平衡。

venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.title: Can LLMs Outshine Conventional Recommenders? A Comparative Evaluation
venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.description: [NeurIPS 2025 DB Track][大语言模型推荐] RecBench 系统对比 17 个 LLM 与 DLRM 在 4 种物品表征、CTR/SeqRec 双任务上的精度-效率权衡，LLM 精度领先但推理慢千倍。

venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.title: Uncertainty Quantification and Decomposition for LLM-based Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 用 Plackett-Luce 单次推理估计列表排序预测熵，并分解为推荐/提示不确定性，指导不确定性感知提示提升 N@20 约 17%。

venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.title: Effectiveness of LLMs in Temporal User Profiling for Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.description: [ICDM 2025 Workshop][LLM4Rec] 用 LLM 分别生成短期/长期自然语言画像，经 SBERT 编码与注意力融合做内容推荐，Movies&TV 上 Recall@10 相对提升 17%。

venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.title: AgentRecBench: Benchmarking LLM Agent-based Personalized Recommender Systems
venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.description: [NeurIPS 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 首个 LLM 智能体推荐系统基准，构建 U-R-I 文本交互环境与三类场景，揭示结构化工作流智能体显著优于传统与朴素 Agent。

venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.title: SMART: LLM-Augmented Hybrid Retrieval for Dynamic Product Ads
venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.description: [RecSys 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 揭示规则查询擅长 BM25 重定向、LLM 查询擅长 ANN 拓客的检索分解，用输出审计门控仅路由 10% 用户，线上转化率 +27.6%

venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.title: AI Guided Accelerator For Search Experience
venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.description: [SIGIR 2025][序列与会话推荐] 挖掘电商查询转移链并做意图一致性过滤，再用 Solar-10B 指令微调生成多样化替代收敛查询，线上 CTR +32.2%、转化 +38.3%。

venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.title: Improving Item Discoverability in e-Commerce Search via Related Intent Generation
venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.description: [KDD 2026 TSMO][LLM4Rec] 用闭源LLM+蒸馏SLM生成替代/互补/主题三类隐式意图以扩展电商搜索召回，会话购买预测与LLM评审双轨评估，覆盖流量60%→80%、成本仅30%。

venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.title: Relevance Matters: A Multi-Task and Multi-Stage Large Language Model Approach for E-commerce Query Rewriting
venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.description: [ICDE 2026][LLM4Rec] 将相关性打标任务注入电商查询改写，多任务 SFT + 查询级归一化 GRPO 融合奖励对齐，离线召回 67.94%、线上 UCVR +0.181%。

venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.title: MAPS: Motivation-Aware Personalized Search via LLM-Driven Consultation Alignment
venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.description: [ACL 2025][LLM推荐] 用 LLM+MoAE 将售前咨询动机与查询/商品/历史双向对齐，Commercial 与 Amazon 上排序 HR@10 提升约 20%/35%。

venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.title: RecGaze: The First Eye Tracking and User Interaction Dataset for Carousel Interfaces
venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.description: [SIGIR 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 首个轮播界面眼动+点击+光标+选择解释数据集，87用户3477次交互，揭示F型浏览与位置偏置。

venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.title: Following the Eye-Tracking Evidence: Established Web-Search Assumptions Fail in Carousel Interfaces
venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.description: [SIGIR 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 用 RecGaze 眼动数据系统证伪 F 型注意力、层级点击与标题导航等四条 Web 搜索假设，提出轮播界面特有的 L 型注视模式。

venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.title: From Click Modeling to Offline and Off-Policy Evaluation in Carousel Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.description: [RecSys 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 基于 RecGaze 眼动数据推翻轮播界面四大行为假设，提出以可观测变量为核心的点击模型设计框架、离散选择点击模型与 N2DCG 重构，并规划轮播专用 OPE 路线。

venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.title: WatchLens: A Configurable Platform for Online Video Recommendation Experiments
venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.description: [RecSys 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 开源视频推荐在线实验平台，解耦界面/内容池/双表面策略并原生记录曝光上下文，30人被试验证观看页策略对会话留存的影响。

venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.title: PinEqualizer: Full Funnel Content Exploration and Debiasing System at Pinterest
venues/CIKM/2026/debias_fairness_industr.description: [KDD 2026][冷启动与长尾推荐] 面向工业级搜索/推荐全漏斗的新内容冷启动系统，以去偏替代纯探索，配合三层可扩展度量框架，线上新鲜内容曝光提升350%。

venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/cross_co.title: From IDs to Semantics: A Generative Framework for Cross-Domain Recommendation with Adaptive Semantic Tokenization
venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/cross_co.description: [AAAI 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 用领域自适应语义ID分词+对称动态路由的生成式跨域推荐框架，Leave-Last-Out全库排序下全面超越SOTA。

venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/cross_co.title: Empowering Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation with Hybrid Tokenization and Serial-Parallel Decoding
venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/cross_co.description: [RecSys 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义 ID] 跨域共享-专属多塔 RQ-VAE 混合分词 + 两段式串并解码，Leave-One-Out 全库排序下精度 +1.5%、时延 -85.1%。

venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/cross_co.title: Universal Item Tokenization for Transferable Generative Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/cross_co.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用 MLLM+树状码本构建跨域通用物品分词器，结合内容重建与共现协同对齐，实现可迁移生成式推荐，全库排序下全面超越基线。

venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/cross_co.title: Tokenize Once, Recommend Anywhere: Unified Item Tokenization for Multi-domain LLM-based Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/cross_co.description: [AAAI 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 提出 TokenMoE+码本+互信息校准的统一物品分词框架 UniTok，单模型跨 10 域训练，NDCG@10 最高提升 51.89%，参数量降 9.63×。

venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/cross_co.title: Learning Decomposed Contextual Token Representations from Pretrained and Collaborative Signals for Generative Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/cross_co.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] DECOR 用冻结码本+可学协同嵌入分解融合、上下文 token 组合与可学 BOS 查询，缓解静态分词歧义与预训练语义丢失，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@10 最高提升 14%。

venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/decouple.title: RoTE: Coarse-to-Fine Multi-Level Rotary Time Embedding for Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/decouple.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 将时间戳分解为年/月/日多粒度并借 RoPE 旋转注入 Q/K，即插即用提升 SASRec/RPG，NDCG@5 最高 +20.11%

venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/decouple.title: Temporal Linear Item-Item Model for Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/decouple.description: [WSDM 2025][序列与会话推荐] 在闭式解线性 item-item 模型上引入时间间隔加权与趋势感知归一化，Full-Ranking 下平均 NDCG@10 提升 9.07%，训练快 6.9–57 倍。

venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/decouple.title: Enhancing Time Awareness in Generative Recommendation

venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/decouple.title: Time Matters: Enhancing Sequential Recommendations with Time-Guided Graph Neural ODEs
venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/decouple.description: [KDD 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用时间引导扩散补全稀疏用户时间图、图神经ODE对齐用户兴趣与物品演化，五数据集Recall@20最高提升46%。

venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/decouple.description: [TKDE 2025][序列与会话推荐] BARec 用双向时序增强预训练生成保偏好伪先验物品，并以 KL 知识增强微调对齐原/增广序列分布，全库排序下 Beauty Recall@5 提升 16.6%。

venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/faithful.title: What Makes a Good Semantic ID for Generative Recommendation? A Reproducibility Study
venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/faithful.description: [SIGIR-AP 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 统一协议下复现11种SID生成式推荐系统，揭示SID设计效果的非单调性：无普适最优设计、码本利用率与排序质量近乎零相关、骨干与码长扩展均非单调。

venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/faithful.title: SIDInspector: A Mapping-First Diagnostic Resource for Semantic-ID Tokenizers
venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/faithful.description: [CIKM 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 提出映射优先的 SID 分词器诊断资源，用 D1–D5 探针在生成器训练前分离容量、可寻址性与行为前缀对齐，并给出四类分词器工件画像。

venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/faithful.title: Reasoning over Semantic IDs Enhances Generative Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/faithful.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 通过教师模型合成富化语料强化 SID-语言对齐，再用 GRPO 结果驱动强化学习激发 SID 推理，三数据集 Full-Ranking 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/faithful.title: TRACER: Token ReAssignment for Concept ERasure in Generative Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/faithful.description: [NeurIPS 2026][生成式推荐] 首个面向生成式推荐的概念遗忘框架，用可微 token 重分配替代直接抑制共享 SID，在 Amazon 三域上遗忘 HR@5 较 PISCES 再降 20%+ 且保留 97% 效用。

venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/faithful.title: FORGE: Forming Semantic Identifiers for Generative Retrieval in Industrial Datasets
venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/faithful.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 系统化拆解 SID 构建全流程（多模态特征/量化编码/冲突后处理），提出免训练的 Embedding HitRate 与 Gini 系数代理指标，淘宝线上交易量 +0.35%。

venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/intsr_an.title: EAGER: Enrich-and-Align Generative Query Recommendation from Clicked Items in E-commerce Search
venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/intsr_an.description: [EMNLP 2026 Industry][LLM4Rec] 两阶段生成式 I2Q 查询推荐：课程化 SFT 扩意图覆盖 + GRPO 混合奖励对齐线上约束，线上 UCTR +0.83%、Pay Count +3.49%。

venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/intsr_an.title: Why Not Together? A Multiple-Round Recommender System for Queries and Items
venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/intsr_an.description: [KDD 2025][序列与会话推荐] 提出 MAGUS 多轮查询-物品联合推荐框架，以词组合关系图桥接查询与物品，用标签传播在线吸收反馈，可插拔接入 12 种基座模型。

venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/intsr_an.title: Balancing Fine-tuning and RAG: A Hybrid Strategy for Dynamic LLM Recommendation Updates
venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/intsr_an.description: [RecSys 2025][LLM4Rec] 以十亿用户短视频兴趣探索系统为案例，量化对比微调与RAG的更新代价/敏捷性，提出月度微调+周内RAG刷新的混合更新策略，线上A/B显著提升满意度。

venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/intsr_an.title: GenFacet: End-to-End Generative Faceted Search via Multi-Task Preference Alignment in E-Commerce
venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/intsr_an.description: [SIGIR 2026][大语言模型推荐] 将电商分面搜索重构为分面生成与查询改写两个耦合生成任务，经蒸馏+SFT+GRPO 对齐搜索效用，线上分面 CTR 相对提升 42.0%。

venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/intsr_an.title: Killing Two Birds with One Stone: Unifying Retrieval and Ranking with a Single Generative Recommendation Model
venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/intsr_an.description: [SIGIR 2025][生成式推荐] 将召回与排序统一为单生成模型的位置级序列生成任务，配合排序驱动增强器与梯度自适应加权实现协同与同步优化，全库排序下召回排序双提升。

venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/latent_r.title: S$^2$GR: Stepwise Semantic-Guided Reasoning in Latent Space for Generative Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/latent_r.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐] 在每级 SID 码生成前插入受码本聚类语义对比监督的思考 token，实现逐步可验证潜在推理，工业短视频 A/B 显著提升时长。

venues/CIKM/2026/generative_rec/latent_r.title: Do Recommenders Need to Think in Words? Latent Reasoning for Efficient LLM-Based Recommendation
