venues/CIKM/2026/graph_rec/beyond_observ.description: [RecSys 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用信息瓶颈原理重构多行为层次推荐，以 InfoNCE 保真、HSIC 压缩、可学习边丢弃去噪，全库排序下 HR@10 最高提升 15.08%。

venues/CIKM/2026/graph_rec/beyond_observ.title: Dual-Channel Multiplex Graph Neural Networks for Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/graph_rec/beyond_observ.description: [TKDE 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 双通道多路图网络显式建模行为模式、隐式挖掘关系链依赖，三数据集全指标平均提升 10%+

venues/CIKM/2026/graph_rec/beyond_observ.title: A Self-Supervised Mixture-of-Experts Framework for Multi-behavior Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/graph_rec/beyond_observ.description: [CIKM 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 揭示多行为推荐在已访问/未访问物品上的性能鸿沟，提出双专家 MoE + 专家自适应 SSL（访问过滤/新颖性推断对比 + 行为生成）框架，全库排序下 HR@20 最高提升 65.46%。

venues/CIKM/2026/graph_rec/beyond_observ.title: GCIB: Graph Contrastive Information Bottleneck for Multi-Behavior Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/graph_rec/beyond_observ.description: [ICML 2026][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 用图信息瓶颈在结构层剪枝辅助行为噪声边、用跨行为 InfoNCE 在特征层对齐目标语义，Leave-One-Out 全库排序下 NDCG@10 最高提升 37.2%。

venues/CIKM/2026/graph_rec/beyond_observ.title: MCLMR: A Model-Agnostic Causal Learning Framework for Multi-Behavior Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/graph_rec/beyond_observ.description: [WWW 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 用后门干预+MoE自适应聚合+偏差感知对比学习，作为即插即用框架增强多行为推荐，三数据集全库排序显著提升。

venues/CIKM/2026/graph_rec/do_all_nodes_.title: DCGL: Dual-Channel Graph Learning with Large Language Models for Knowledge-Aware Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/graph_rec/do_all_nodes_.description: [SIGIR 2026][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 双通道解耦 LLM 语义与 ID 行为信号，多级对比对齐 + 频率感知门控融合，四数据集全库排序全面超越 SOTA。

venues/CIKM/2026/graph_rec/do_all_nodes_.title: Graph Cross-Correlated Network for Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/graph_rec/do_all_nodes_.description: [TKDE 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 用非递归 PGR 保留各跳邻居纯语义，再以 HCC/ECC 显式建模用户-物品子图交叉相关项，全库排序下 NDCG@20 平均提升约 1.8%–2.9%。

venues/CIKM/2026/graph_rec/do_all_nodes_.title: NLGCL: Naturally Existing Neighbor Layers Graph Contrastive Learning for Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/graph_rec/do_all_nodes_.description: [RecSys 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 用 GNN 相邻层天然异构节点作正样本对替代图增广，免视图构建，全库排序下 NDCG@10 最高提升 12.41% 且训练最快。

venues/CIKM/2026/graph_rec/do_all_nodes_.title: A Node-Aware Dynamic Quantization Approach for Graph Collaborative Filtering
venues/CIKM/2026/graph_rec/do_all_nodes_.description: [CIKM 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 提出节点感知动态量化 GNAQ，用参数共享学习每节点量化步长并以图消息传递更新，2-bit 下 Recall@10 平均提升 27.8%。

venues/CIKM/2026/graph_rec/do_all_nodes_.title: SGCL: Unifying Self-Supervised and Supervised Learning for Graph Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/graph_rec/do_all_nodes_.description: [RecSys 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 将 BPR 与 InfoNCE 合并为单一监督图对比损失，免增广免负采样，精度与训练效率双超 SGL/SimGCL。

venues/CIKM/2026/graph_rec/neural_tree_c.title: SGCL: Unifying Self-Supervised and Supervised Learning for Graph Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/graph_rec/neural_tree_c.description: [RecSys 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 将 BPR 与 InfoNCE 合并为单一监督图对比损失，免增广免负采样，精度与训练效率双超 SGL/SimGCL。

venues/CIKM/2026/graph_rec/neural_tree_c.title: Graph Cross-Correlated Network for Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/graph_rec/neural_tree_c.description: [TKDE 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 用非递归 PGR 保留各跳邻居纯语义，再以 HCC/ECC 显式建模用户-物品子图交叉相关项，全库排序下 NDCG@20 平均提升约 1.8%–2.9%。

venues/CIKM/2026/graph_rec/neural_tree_c.title: Leveraging Member-Group Relations via Multi-View Graph Filtering for Effective Group Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/graph_rec/neural_tree_c.description: [WWW 2025][社交与群组推荐] 提出免训练多视图图滤波 Group-GF，用三张物品相似图与多项式滤波器聚合成员-群组关系，HR@10 最高提升 16.4% 且运行时间仅 1.55s。

venues/CIKM/2026/graph_rec/neural_tree_c.title: A Node-Aware Dynamic Quantization Approach for Graph Collaborative Filtering
venues/CIKM/2026/graph_rec/neural_tree_c.description: [CIKM 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 提出节点感知动态量化 GNAQ，用参数共享学习每节点量化步长并以图消息传递更新，2-bit 下 Recall@10 平均提升 27.8%。

venues/CIKM/2026/graph_rec/neural_tree_c.title: Criteria-Aware Graph Filtering: Extremely Fast Yet Accurate Multi-Criteria Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/graph_rec/neural_tree_c.description: [WWW 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 免训练免矩阵分解的多准则图滤波推荐，按准则定制多项式低通滤波器并融合用户准则偏好，BA 数据集 0.2 秒推理、NDCG@5 最高提升 24%。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/do_llm_recommen.title: Revisiting Generative vs. Dense Retrieval: A Static Value Prior Reverses the Gap
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/do_llm_recommen.description: [CIKM 2026][生成式推荐] 在受控 GR/DR 对比下揭示指标选择反转胜负，用免训练静态价值先验重排 DR 即反超 GR 最佳物品价值并保持召回领先。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/do_llm_recommen.title: Beyond Utility: Evaluating LLM as Recommender
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/do_llm_recommen.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出含历史长度敏感性、候选位置偏差、画像生成与幻觉四维的 LLM 推荐多维评测框架，揭示 LLM 在重排与冷启动占优但位置偏差严重。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/do_llm_recommen.title: The Recall Ceiling of LLM Recommendation Reranking
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/do_llm_recommen.description: [CIKM 2026][LLM4Rec] 证明闭候选重排器 NDCG 受自身窗口召回率硬上界约束，Oracle 协议高估 92–95%，九类 LLM 与监督重排器在真实检索下均无法显著超越 CF。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/do_llm_recommen.title: One Polluted Page Is Enough: Evaluating Web Content Pollution in LLM Recommenders
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/do_llm_recommen.description: [EMNLP 2026 Findings][LLM4Rec] 提出 FORGE 基准，在冻结检索包上本地改写真实品牌为虚假品牌，量化 12 个 LLM 推荐器被 GEO 网页污染欺骗的比率，并揭示推理与防御的反效果。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/do_llm_recommen.title: Reproducibility in Recommender Systems: A Survey
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/do_llm_recommen.description: [TORS 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 对 RecSys 可复现性赛道 2020–2025 年 51 篇论文的结构化元分析，揭示其方法论高度同质化、以“扩展”替代“严格复现”的实践落差。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/do_recommenders.title: ThinkRec: Thinking-based Recommendation via LLM
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/do_recommenders.description: [WWW 2026][大语言模型推荐] 以合成推理链激活 LLM 的 System 2 思维，并用实例级 LoRA 专家融合适配异构用户，AUC 平均提升 7.96%。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/do_recommenders.title: Latent Residual Reasoning for Ranking in Generative Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/do_recommenders.description: [CIKM 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 在冻结的生成式排序骨干上叠加 LoRA 与残差推理头，用多步隐空间加性修正精化候选打分，公开集 GAUC 提升 2.7%–4.3%，线上 PV-CTR +0.75%。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/do_recommenders.title: Decoding in Latent Spaces for Efficient Inference in LLM-based Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/do_recommenders.description: [EMNLP 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用训练样本末层隐状态聚合出物品潜在表征，以 L2 距离匹配替代自回归语言空间解码，推理提速 10 倍以上且性能不降反升。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/do_recommenders.title: R$^2$ec: Towards Large Recommender Models with Reasoning
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/do_recommenders.description: [NeurIPS 2025][LLM4Rec] 双头架构统一推理生成与物品打分，RecPO 融合奖励 RL 联合优化，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@10 最高提升 72%。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/do_recommenders.title: S$^2$GR: Stepwise Semantic-Guided Reasoning in Latent Space for Generative Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/do_recommenders.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐] 在每级 SID 码生成前插入受码本聚类语义对比监督的思考 token，实现逐步可验证潜在推理，工业短视频 A/B 显著提升时长。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/profiling_what_.title: Rethinking LLM-Based Recommendations: A Personalized Query-Driven Parallel Integration
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/profiling_what_.description: [ACL 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出 QUEREC 并行框架，用 LLM 零样本生成个性化用户查询与特征增强物品描述，与 CF 模型并行全库检索后自适应重排，Full-Ranking 下最高提升 57%。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/profiling_what_.title: The Mental World of Large Language Models in Recommendation: A Benchmark on Association, Personalization, and Knowledgeability
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/profiling_what_.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出 LRWorld 基准（38K 样本/23M tokens），从关联、个性化、知识性三尺度十因素 31 任务系统评测数十个 LLM，揭示其在神经嵌入检索上的致命短板。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/profiling_what_.title: Improving Conversational Recommendation with Contextual Adaptation of External Recommenders and LLM-based Reranking
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/profiling_what_.description: [ECIR 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用轻量实体级序列推荐器产出候选、LLM 做上下文适配重排，ReDial/INSPIRED 上 H@5 平均提升 54%/25%。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/profiling_what_.title: Review-driven Personalized Preference Reasoning with Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/profiling_what_.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用评论抽取偏好画像并蒸馏逐步推理，评分预测与重排双任务均超 CF 与 LLM 基线，解释性显著提升

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/profiling_what_.title: Towards Comprehensible Recommendation with Large Language Model Fine-tuning
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/profiling_what_.description: [CIKM 2026][LLM4Rec] 用 GRPO 两阶段对齐 LLM 生成协同视角的用户模式与推荐理由，并以推荐模型打分为奖励精炼，Full-Ranking 下 Recall@5 相对提升 14–18%。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/selfdr_self_dis.title: Think before Recommendation: Autonomous Reasoning-enhanced Recommender
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/selfdr_self_dis.description: [NeurIPS 2025][LLM4Rec] 用纯 GRPO 强化学习替代教师蒸馏，让单个 LLM 自主习得「用户分析→物品分析→匹配→打分」推理链，评分预测 MAE 最高降 29.9%。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/selfdr_self_dis.title: R$^2$ec: Towards Large Recommender Models with Reasoning
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/selfdr_self_dis.description: [NeurIPS 2025][LLM4Rec] 双头架构统一推理生成与物品打分，RecPO 融合奖励 RL 联合优化，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@10 最高提升 72%。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/selfdr_self_dis.title: ThinkRec: Thinking-based Recommendation via LLM
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/selfdr_self_dis.description: [WWW 2026][大语言模型推荐] 以合成推理链激活 LLM 的 System 2 思维，并用实例级 LoRA 专家融合适配异构用户，AUC 平均提升 7.96%。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/selfdr_self_dis.title: Active Large Language Model-based Knowledge Distillation for Session-based Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/selfdr_self_dis.description: [AAAI 2025][LLM4Rec] 用 max-min 主动学习从全量会话中挑出少量高增益实例喂给 GPT-4 教师蒸馏，500 条样本即超越全量 KD 与 10 倍参数教师。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/selfdr_self_dis.title: ReRec: Reasoning-Augmented LLM-based Recommendation Assistant via Reinforcement Fine-tuning
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/selfdr_self_dis.description: [ACL 2026][大语言模型推荐] 用双图奖励塑形、推理感知优势估计与在线课程调度改造 RFT，使 3B LLM 在复杂查询推荐上大幅超越 GRPO 系基线并保留通用能力。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/the_recall_ceil.title: Revisiting Generative vs. Dense Retrieval: A Static Value Prior Reverses the Gap
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/the_recall_ceil.description: [CIKM 2026][生成式推荐] 在受控 GR/DR 对比下揭示指标选择反转胜负，用免训练静态价值先验重排 DR 即反超 GR 最佳物品价值并保持召回领先。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/the_recall_ceil.title: Retrieval, Scoring, and Decoding Shape Performance and Stability in LLM-based Conversational Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/the_recall_ceil.description: [CIKM 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 在 ReDial 上系统解耦候选池规模、一阶段检索器与解码温度对 LLM 重排器的影响，揭示协议选择可移动 NDCG@10 超过模型差距。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/the_recall_ceil.title: RADAR: Recall Augmentation through Deferred Asynchronous Retrieval
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/the_recall_ceil.description: [RecSys 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用离线异步全复杂度精排模型对 50 倍候选池预打分并缓存 Top-200，线上绕过召回与粗排直接注入精排，Recall@200 翻倍、线上 +0.8%。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/the_recall_ceil.title: Comprehensive List Generation for Multi-Generator Reranking
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/the_recall_ceil.description: [SIGIR 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 提出多生成器-评估器重排框架与列表全面性指标，用 CLIG 自动学习互补生成器，离线 AUC 提升 0.9%、线上观看时长 +0.48%。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/the_recall_ceil.title: You Only Evaluate Once: A Tree-based Rerank Method at Meituan
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/the_recall_ceil.description: [CIKM 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用树状多尺度上下文提取+上下文缓存实现单阶段全排列重排，离线GAUC显著提升并落地美团外卖。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/think_to_person.title: AI Guided Accelerator For Search Experience
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/think_to_person.description: [SIGIR 2025][序列与会话推荐] 挖掘电商查询转移链并做意图一致性过滤，再用 Solar-10B 指令微调生成多样化替代收敛查询，线上 CTR +32.2%、转化 +38.3%。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/think_to_person.title: Towards Context-aware Reasoning-enhanced Generative Searching in E-commerce
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/think_to_person.description: [WWW 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 将电商搜索异构上下文统一为JSON文本与残差K-Means语义ID，用SFT-RL自演化后训练与去偏R-GRPO提升生成式搜索排序，All-100K上HR@10相对提升6.24%。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/think_to_person.title: Improving Item Discoverability in e-Commerce Search via Related Intent Generation
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/think_to_person.description: [KDD 2026 TSMO][LLM4Rec] 用闭源LLM+蒸馏SLM生成替代/互补/主题三类隐式意图以扩展电商搜索召回，会话购买预测与LLM评审双轨评估，覆盖流量60%→80%、成本仅30%。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/think_to_person.title: ItemRAG: Item-Based Retrieval-Augmented Generation for LLM-Based Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/think_to_person.description: [SIGIR 2026][大语言模型推荐] 将 RAG 从粗粒度用户历史检索转向细粒度物品级检索，融合共购与语义信息，标准与冷启动场景全面超越用户级 RAG 基线。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/think_to_person.title: A Generative Framework for Personalized Sticker Retrieval
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/think_to_person.description: [EMNLP 2025 Findings][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] PEARL 用用户组嵌入+LLM意图排序加权解码，实现微信表情包个性化生成式检索，离线 MRR@10 提升 15%、线上 CTR +7.12%。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/towards_compreh.title: Reason4Rec: Deliberative User Preference Alignment of Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/towards_compreh.description: [TKDE 2026][大语言模型推荐] 提出审慎推荐任务与三专家多步推理框架，用评论监督偏好蒸馏-匹配-预测，评分预测与排序全面领先。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/towards_compreh.title: EAGER-LLM: Enhancing Large Language Models as Recommenders through Exogenous Behavior-Semantic Integration
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/towards_compreh.description: [WWW 2025][大语言模型推荐] 以双源知识富集物品索引+非侵入多尺度对齐重建+退火适配器，将外源行为/语义信号注入 LLM 生成式推荐，Amazon 三数据集 Full-Ranking 下 Recall@10 最高提升 26.16%。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/towards_compreh.title: LLM2Rec: Large Language Models Are Powerful Embedding Models for Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/towards_compreh.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 两阶段将 LLM 改造为融合协同信号与语义的物品嵌入模型，Full-Ranking 下域内平均提升约 15%、跨域仍稳定增益。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/towards_compreh.title: Bridging the User-side Knowledge Gap in Knowledge-aware Recommendations with Large Language Models
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/towards_compreh.description: [AAAI 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 LLM 推断用户兴趣并结构化为 CIKG 异构图，配合兴趣重建与跨域对比学习去噪，在三个数据集全库排序下 R@100 最高提升 9.31%。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/towards_compreh.title: Review-driven Personalized Preference Reasoning with Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/towards_compreh.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用评论抽取偏好画像并蒸馏逐步推理，评分预测与重排双任务均超 CF 与 LLM 基线，解释性显著提升

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/tracer_balancin.title: Continual Recommender Systems
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/tracer_balancin.description: [CIKM 2025][序列与会话推荐] 系统梳理持续推荐的两大技术路线（经验回放与正则化），并延伸至资源受限与序列交互场景，给出可信性、基础模型与搜推统一三大开放方向。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/tracer_balancin.title: Capturing User Interests from Data Streams for Continual Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/tracer_balancin.description: [WSDM 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用线性注意力参数化记忆替代回放/正则，配合 Cauchy-Schwarz 归一化与共享兴趣池，在流式数据块上兼顾历史保留与新兴趣获取。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/tracer_balancin.title: TRACER: Token ReAssignment for Concept ERasure in Generative Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/tracer_balancin.description: [NeurIPS 2026][生成式推荐] 首个面向生成式推荐的概念遗忘框架，用可微 token 重分配替代直接抑制共享 SID，在 Amazon 三域上遗忘 HR@5 较 PISCES 再降 20%+ 且保留 97% 效用。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/tracer_balancin.title: Decomposing Staleness in Recommender Systems: A Dual-Filter Framework for Supersession and Decay
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/tracer_balancin.description: [CIKM 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 将推荐内容过时性拆解为“取代”与“衰减”双机制，用 LLM 蒸馏成对分类器与多模态流量比预测器做上游过滤，Google Discover 两年部署使过时举报降 54.9%。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/tracer_balancin.title: Learning Evolving Preferences: A Federated Continual Framework for User-Centric Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/tracer_balancin.description: [WWW 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 联邦持续推荐框架 FCUCR：时间感知自蒸馏抗遗忘 + 跨用户原型迁移促协同，四数据集全库排序 HR@10 最高提升 44.0%。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/training_free_l.title: LLM2Rec: Large Language Models Are Powerful Embedding Models for Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/training_free_l.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 两阶段将 LLM 改造为融合协同信号与语义的物品嵌入模型，Full-Ranking 下域内平均提升约 15%、跨域仍稳定增益。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/training_free_l.title: Can LLMs Outshine Conventional Recommenders? A Comparative Evaluation
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/training_free_l.description: [NeurIPS 2025 DB Track][大语言模型推荐] RecBench 系统对比 17 个 LLM 与 DLRM 在 4 种物品表征、CTR/SeqRec 双任务上的精度-效率权衡，LLM 精度领先但推理慢千倍。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/training_free_l.title: Rethinking LLM-Based Recommendations: A Personalized Query-Driven Parallel Integration
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/training_free_l.description: [ACL 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出 QUEREC 并行框架，用 LLM 零样本生成个性化用户查询与特征增强物品描述，与 CF 模型并行全库检索后自适应重排，Full-Ranking 下最高提升 57%。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/training_free_l.title: The Mental World of Large Language Models in Recommendation: A Benchmark on Association, Personalization, and Knowledgeability
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/training_free_l.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出 LRWorld 基准（38K 样本/23M tokens），从关联、个性化、知识性三尺度十因素 31 任务系统评测数十个 LLM，揭示其在神经嵌入检索上的致命短板。

venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/training_free_l.title: Bridging Conversational and Collaborative Signals for Conversational Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/llm_rec/training_free_l.description: [WWW 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 构建 Reddit-ML32M 跨源数据集，用 SASRec 协同嵌入对 GPT-3.5 零样本推荐做相似度重排，H@5 提升 12.32%。

venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/pe.title: Direct Routing Gradient (DRGrad): A Personalized Information Surgery for Multi-Task Learning (MTL) Recommendations
venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/pe.description: [AAAI 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用梯度余弦相似度做路由+Split-MMoE+PPNet个性化门控，在150亿样本工业数据上Click AUC提升0.0027且不增推理延迟。

venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/pe.title: Task-Blind No MORE: Multi-Task Information Flow in Unified Ranking Backbones
venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/pe.description: [CIKM 2026][多任务学习与列表级重排] 将多任务信息流下沉至统一排序主干，以共享/私有 Anchor Token 逐层共演化，离线七任务全胜、线上时长+3.0%、P99 延迟降约30%。

venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/pe.title: Efficient Multi-task Prompt Tuning for Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/pe.description: [TOIS 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 提出两阶段 MPT-Rec：GAN 解耦任务共享/特有信息后冻结主干，仅用任务感知 Prompt 微调新任务，参数降至 10% 且性能保持 95%+。

venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/pe.title: Automated Information Flow Selection for Multi-scenario Multi-task Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/pe.description: [WSDM 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 用 LoRA 解耦四类场景-任务信息单元并以可学习掩码剪枝无效信息流，AUC 全面超越 HiNet/M3oE，线上 CVR 均涨 2.46%。

venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/pe.title: CPMR: Context-Aware Incremental Sequential Recommendation with Pseudo-Multi-Task Learning
venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/pe.description: [CIKM 2023][序列与会话推荐] 提出伪多任务学习范式，用历史图与上下文图双通道演化用户/物品时序状态，在四个数据集上 MRR 平均提升 30.98%。

venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/re.title: Paragon: Parameter Generation for Controllable Multi-Task Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/re.description: [RecSys 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用扩散模型按偏好权重条件生成适配器参数，免重训实现测试时可控多任务推荐，响应时间降低 94.6%+。

venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/re.title: Goal-Conditioned Supervised Learning for Multi-Objective Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/re.description: [NeurIPS 2026][多任务学习与列表级重排] 将 GCSL 的标量目标扩展为多维向量目标，用 Transformer 编码器 + 交叉熵直接做多目标下一物品预测，无需复杂架构与权重调参，在 RetailRocket/Challenge15 上购买 HR@10 相对提升约 4-17%。

venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/re.title: Bi-Level Optimization for Generative Recommendation: Bridging Tokenization and Generation
venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/re.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 将分词器与推荐器建模为双层优化，用元学习+梯度手术让推荐损失直接监督RQ-VAE码本，Full-Ranking下全面超越TIGER/LETTER/ETEGRec。

venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/re.title: MergeRec: Model Merging for Data-Isolated Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/re.description: [KDD 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 提出数据隔离跨域序列推荐新设定，用任务向量模型合并+伪用户数据+推荐/蒸馏联合目标，Recall@10 平均提升 17.21%。

venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/re.title: CSMF: Cascaded Selective Mask Fine-Tuning for Multi-Objective Embedding-Based Retrieval
venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/re.description: [SIGIR 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 借鉴 PEFT 选择性掩码思想，按曝光→点击→转化级联顺序分阶段微调双塔召回，零参数增量实现多目标融合检索。

venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/se.title: Listwise Preference Diffusion Optimization for User Behavior Trajectories Prediction
venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/se.description: [NeurIPS 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 将 Plackett-Luce 列表级排序信号注入扩散 ELBO，实现多步用户行为轨迹的连贯生成，并提出 SeqMatch 轨迹级指标，Full-Ranking 下 SeqMatch@50 最高提升 36.8%。

venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/se.title: CAMMSR: Category-Guided Attentive Mixture of Experts for Multimodal Sequential Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/se.description: [ICDE 2026][多模态推荐] 用类别预测任务引导注意力 MoE 动态分配模态权重，并以模态交换对比学习对齐跨模态序列表征，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@5 最高提升 15.3%。

venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/se.title: Deep-learning Causal Retrieval Optimization for Efficient e-commerce Distribution in Pinterest
venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/se.description: [KDD 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 将购物候选生成器触发建模为因果决策，用 DR 多任务提升学习+随机 Holdout+线性回放，线上触发率降 85% 而购物会话持平。

venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/se.title: Native Multimodal Representation Learning for Click-Through Rate Prediction in E-Commerce Scenarios
venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/se.description: [CIKM 2026][多模态推荐] 揭示端到端联合训练在强预训练编码器上失效的根因（CTR 监督多模态不可解释+梯度不一致），提出 Mine-Then-Train 挖掘三元组微调编码器，线上 CTR +1.5%、RPM +0.5%。

venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/se.title: GALA: Generative Aligned Learning for Adaptive Multimodal Representation in the Taobao Shangou Recommender System
venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/se.description: [ICDE 2026][多模态推荐] 三阶段流水线：行为三元组预训练 + GRPO 生成式行为对齐 + 自适应门控融合，离线 AUC +0.12/+0.20，线上订单量 +0.55%。

venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/so.title: RankMixer: Scaling Up Ranking Models in Industrial Recommenders
venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/so.description: [CIKM 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用无参多头Token Mixing替代自注意力、Per-token FFN隔离特征子空间，配合ReLU路由稀疏MoE，在抖音万亿级数据上将MFU从4.5%提至45%，参数扩100倍而延迟不增。

venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/so.title: TransRetrieval: Scaling Up Transformer-Based Retrieval for Industrial Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/so.description: [CIKM 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用加权平均聚合+目标Token压缩+位置式域嵌入，让Transformer在召回阶段实现对数线性Scaling，线上收入+2.53%。

venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/so.title: Scaling Recommender Transformers to One Billion Parameters
venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/so.description: [KDD 2026][序列与会话推荐] ARGUS 将自回归预训练解耦为反馈预测与下一物品预测双任务，把推荐 Transformer 编码器扩到 10 亿参数，线上听歌时长 +2.26%、点赞率 +6.37%。

venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/so.title: OneTrans: Unified Feature Interaction and Sequence Modeling with One Transformer in Industrial Recommender
venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/so.description: [WWW 2026][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用单一因果 Transformer 统一序列建模与特征交叉，配合金字塔剪枝与跨请求 KV 缓存，线上 GMV/u 提升 5.68%

venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/so.title: HyFormer: Revisiting the Roles of Sequence Modeling and Feature Interaction in CTR Prediction
venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/so.description: [SIGIR 2026][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用 Global Tokens 交替执行 Query Decoding 与 Query Boosting，统一长序列建模与特征交叉，AUC 提升 0.17% 且 FLOPs 仅 3.9T。

venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/ta.title: OneRank: Unified Transformer-Native Ranking Architecture for Multi-Task Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/ta.description: [KDD 2026][多任务学习与列表级重排] 将多任务推理内化进 Transformer 栈，用任务私有 token 通道 + 梯度截断 + 匹配式打分替代编码器-预测器分离，Shopee 离线与线上 A/B 全面领先。

venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/ta.title: Lightweight Ranking Heads: Accelerating Multi-Task Experimentation in Production Recommender Systems
venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/ta.description: [RecSys 2026][多任务学习与列表级重排] 以 stop-gradient + 无状态日训的轻量头动态注入新任务，免骨干重训，将多任务实验周期从数周压缩至数天。

venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/ta.title: CPMR: Context-Aware Incremental Sequential Recommendation with Pseudo-Multi-Task Learning
venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/ta.description: [CIKM 2023][序列与会话推荐] 提出伪多任务学习范式，用历史图与上下文图双通道演化用户/物品时序状态，在四个数据集上 MRR 平均提升 30.98%。

venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/ta.title: Personalized Task Dependency Graphs for Mitigating Signal Erosion in Multi-Task Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/ta.description: [CIKM 2026][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用低秩个性化任务依赖图+硬因果掩码GCN替代刚性漏斗，缓解深层稀疏任务信号侵蚀，离线AUC最高+1.45%，线上CVR+1.2%。

venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/ta.title: UniPinRec: Unifying Generative Retrieval and Ranking at Pinterest Scale
venues/CIKM/2026/multi_task_reranking/ta.description: [RecSys 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用 MAM 掩码动作建模 + 混合样本 + 跨阶段 KV 缓存复用，将生成式召回与排序全栈统一，线上延迟降 11.1%、QPS 升 63.6%。

venues/CIKM/2026/multimodal_rec/bridge_b.title: TRU: Targeted Reverse Update for Efficient Multimodal Recommendation Unlearning
venues/CIKM/2026/multimodal_rec/bridge_b.description: [ACM MM 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 揭示多模态推荐遗忘中排序/模态/模块三层非均匀性，提出门控+分支缩放+参数组隔离的靶向反向更新，逼近重训练前沿且收敛更快。

venues/CIKM/2026/multimodal_rec/bridge_b.title: Can Complementary Signals Bridge Similarity Islands? Manifold-Augmented Graph Embedding for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/multimodal_rec/bridge_b.description: [NeurIPS 2026][多模态推荐] 提出 MAGE，用离线 Soft Conceptor 残差注入 + 在线非对称双流 GNN 桥接互补品“相似性孤岛”，四个 Amazon 数据集 Full-Ranking 全面领先。

venues/CIKM/2026/multimodal_rec/bridge_b.title: Structured Spectral Reasoning for Frequency-Adaptive Multimodal Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/multimodal_rec/bridge_b.description: [NeurIPS 2025][多模态推荐] 将多模态图信号分解为等能量频带，用频带掩码一致性训练、低秩超谱算子与谱对比正则实现频率自适应融合，全库排序下冷启动 Recall@20 提升约 10%。

venues/CIKM/2026/multimodal_rec/bridge_b.title: Structural and Disentangled Adaptation of Large Vision Language Models for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/multimodal_rec/bridge_b.description: [SIGIR 2026][多模态推荐] 用模态内结构软教师对齐 LVLM 跨模态表征，并以专家化门控 LoRA 解耦梯度流，即插即用提升多模态与序列推荐，长尾增益最高 18.70%。

venues/CIKM/2026/multimodal_rec/bridge_b.title: One Graph, Multiple Gains: Single High-Quality Item-Item Graph for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/multimodal_rec/bridge_b.description: [ACM MM 2026][多模态推荐] 构建一次高质量物品-物品图，经三元闭包重加权后复用于表征、交互图与优化三阶段，四数据集全指标SOTA且训练更快更省显存。

venues/CIKM/2026/multimodal_rec/informat.title: MENTOR: Multi-level Self-supervised Learning for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/multimodal_rec/informat.description: [AAAI 2025][多模态推荐] 以 ID 嵌入为锚做四级跨模态分布对齐，叠加特征掩码与图扰动自监督，Amazon 三集 Recall@20 最高提升 74.73%

venues/CIKM/2026/multimodal_rec/informat.title: COHESION: Composite Graph Convolutional Network with Dual-Stage Fusion for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/multimodal_rec/informat.description: [SIGIR 2025][多模态推荐] 用行为模态早期精炼+晚期注意力融合的双阶段融合，配合异质/同质复合图与自适应BPR，在三个 Amazon 数据集上 R@20 相对提升 4.4%–6.1%。

venues/CIKM/2026/multimodal_rec/informat.title: Modality Alignment with Multi-scale Bilateral Attention for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/multimodal_rec/informat.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 提出 MambaRec，用多尺度空洞卷积+双注意力做局部图文对齐、MMD+InfoNCE 做全局分布对齐，Amazon 三数据集 Recall@20 最高提升约 5.4%。

venues/CIKM/2026/multimodal_rec/informat.title: MLLMRec: A Preference Reasoning Paradigm with Graph Refinement for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/multimodal_rec/informat.description: [SIGIR 2026][多模态推荐] 用 MLLM 推理用户偏好画像替代噪声聚合初始化，并以阈值去噪+共现增强精修物品图，三数据集 11/12 指标 SOTA。

venues/CIKM/2026/multimodal_rec/informat.title: One Graph, Multiple Gains: Single High-Quality Item-Item Graph for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/multimodal_rec/informat.description: [ACM MM 2026][多模态推荐] 构建一次高质量物品-物品图，经三元闭包重加权后复用于表征、交互图与优化三阶段，四数据集全指标SOTA且训练更快更省显存。

venues/CIKM/2026/multimodal_rec/native_m.title: Diffusion-based Multi-modal Synergy Interest Network for Click-through Rate Prediction
venues/CIKM/2026/multimodal_rec/native_m.description: [SIGIR 2025][多模态推荐] 用 PLE 式共享/独有专家解耦模态知识、以扩散式多步跨模态去噪捕捉协同信号，FDAF 非侵入融合，四数据集 AUC 全面领先。

venues/CIKM/2026/multimodal_rec/native_m.title: IDProxy: CTR Prediction with Multimodal LLMs for Cold-Start Recommendation at Xiaohongshu
venues/CIKM/2026/multimodal_rec/native_m.description: [RecSys 2026][冷启动与长尾推荐] 用 MLLM 生成代理 ID 嵌入，经粗到细两阶段对齐工业 CTR 排序器，新笔记在线 AUC 提升约 2 倍于全局流量。

venues/CIKM/2026/multimodal_rec/native_m.title: Distribution-Guided Auto-Encoder for User Multimodal Interest Cross Fusion
venues/CIKM/2026/multimodal_rec/native_m.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 以行为粒度做模态内/模态间交叉融合，并用兴趣分布解码器作自监督约束，工业 A/B 上 CTR +12.9%。

venues/CIKM/2026/multimodal_rec/native_m.title: Personalized Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Foundation Models for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/CIKM/2026/multimodal_rec/native_m.description: [WWW 2026][多模态推荐] 按兴趣分群并为每群挂载独立 PEFT 模块，使 CLIP 编码出用户条件化的物品表征，配合群内难负采样，NDCG@20 最高提升 15.3%。

venues/CIKM/2026/multimodal_rec/native_m.title: STAIR: Manipulating Collaborative and Multimodal Information for E-Commerce Recommendation
