venues/DASFAA/2026/agent_conversational_.description: [AAAI 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 LLaMA2 先预测评分再以软评分嵌入引导解释生成，配合课程学习与无标注一致性自动评测，解释一致性提升 7.3%。

venues/DASFAA/2026/agent_conversational_.title: Think before Recommendation: Autonomous Reasoning-enhanced Recommender
venues/DASFAA/2026/agent_conversational_.description: [NeurIPS 2025][LLM4Rec] 用纯 GRPO 强化学习替代教师蒸馏，让单个 LLM 自主习得「用户分析→物品分析→匹配→打分」推理链，评分预测 MAE 最高降 29.9%。

venues/DASFAA/2026/agent_conversational_.title: Enhancing Recommendation Explanations through User-Centric Refinement
venues/DASFAA/2026/agent_conversational_.description: [ACL 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出 RefineX 多智能体推理期精炼框架，以 plan-then-refine 与分层反思将 PETER 解释在事实性/个性化/连贯性三维度大幅提升。

venues/DASFAA/2026/agent_conversational_.title: ReRec: Reasoning-Augmented LLM-based Recommendation Assistant via Reinforcement Fine-tuning
venues/DASFAA/2026/agent_conversational_.description: [ACL 2026][大语言模型推荐] 用双图奖励塑形、推理感知优势估计与在线课程调度改造 RFT，使 3B LLM 在复杂查询推荐上大幅超越 GRPO 系基线并保留通用能力。

venues/DASFAA/2026/llm_rec/dynamicpo_dyn.title: What Makes LLMs Effective Sequential Recommenders? A Study on Preference Intensity and Temporal Context
venues/DASFAA/2026/llm_rec/dynamicpo_dyn.description: [ACL 2026][大语言模型推荐] 揭示二元偏好对齐丢失偏好强度与时序上下文，提出自适应奖励边际 RecPO，五数据集 HR@1 全面领先 S-DPO。

venues/DASFAA/2026/llm_rec/dynamicpo_dyn.title: SPRec: Self-Play to Debias LLM-based Recommendation
venues/DASFAA/2026/llm_rec/dynamicpo_dyn.description: [WWW 2025][大语言模型推荐] 揭示 DPO 反向 KL 的 mode-seeking 本质放大流行度偏差，提出自对弈 SPRec 以模型自身输出作负样本自适应去偏，兼顾准确率与公平性。

venues/DASFAA/2026/llm_rec/dynamicpo_dyn.title: Preference is More Than Comparisons: Rethinking Dueling Bandits with Augmented Human Feedback
venues/DASFAA/2026/llm_rec/dynamicpo_dyn.description: [AAAI 2026][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用增强置信界把相似/依赖观测注入无模型 Dueling Bandit，给出样本复杂度与遗憾权衡，在推荐、多目标优化与 LLM 响应优化上显著降遗憾。

venues/DASFAA/2026/llm_rec/dynamicpo_dyn.title: Recommendation and Temptation
venues/DASFAA/2026/llm_rec/dynamicpo_dyn.description: [RecSys 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 将用户选择解耦为 enrichment 与 temptation 双效用并引入站外选项，证明局部贪心最优并给出可估计算子，MovieLens 与仿真全面超越基线。

venues/DASFAA/2026/llm_rec/dynamicpo_dyn.title: DLCRec: A Novel Approach for Managing Diversity in LLM-Based Recommender Systems
venues/DASFAA/2026/llm_rec/dynamicpo_dyn.description: [WSDM 2025][大语言模型推荐] 将多样性可控推荐拆解为类型预测/填充/物品预测三子任务级联，配合两类数据增广，在 Movie/Steam 上 MAE_Cov@10 大幅领先。

venues/DASFAA/2026/rl_bandit_rec/llm_enh.title: Beyond Static LLM Policies: Imitation-Enhanced Reinforcement Learning for Recommendation
venues/DASFAA/2026/rl_bandit_rec/llm_enh.description: [ICDM 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用 LLM 轨迹作次优示范，经对抗逆强化学习提取奖励并加权模仿，离线 RL 策略在 Steam/Amazon 上累积奖励较 BiLLP 提升 13%+。

venues/DASFAA/2026/rl_bandit_rec/llm_enh.title: LLM-Powered User Simulator for Recommender System
venues/DASFAA/2026/rl_bandit_rec/llm_enh.description: [AAAI 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用 LLM 离线蒸馏物品优缺点关键词，构建关键词匹配+语义相似+序列统计三模型集成用户模拟器，为 RL 推荐提供可解释高保真环境。

venues/DASFAA/2026/rl_bandit_rec/llm_enh.title: Beyond the Flat Sequence: Hierarchical and Preference-Aware Generative Recommendations
venues/DASFAA/2026/rl_bandit_rec/llm_enh.description: [WWW 2026][生成式推荐] 用会话层次预训练+偏好引导稀疏注意力打破 HSTU 扁平序列假设，APPGallery 全库 AUC 0.8929、线上 eCPM +1.99%

venues/DASFAA/2026/rl_bandit_rec/llm_enh.title: Large Language Model driven Policy Exploration for Recommender Systems
venues/DASFAA/2026/rl_bandit_rec/llm_enh.description: [WSDM 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用 LLM 蒸馏用户偏好离线预训练 A2C 推荐策略，并提出冻结+可学习双策略自适应在线适配，显著提升冷启动回报与长期收益。

venues/DASFAA/2026/rl_bandit_rec/llm_enh.title: Think before Recommendation: Autonomous Reasoning-enhanced Recommender
venues/DASFAA/2026/rl_bandit_rec/llm_enh.description: [NeurIPS 2025][LLM4Rec] 用纯 GRPO 强化学习替代教师蒸馏，让单个 LLM 自主习得「用户分析→物品分析→匹配→打分」推理链，评分预测 MAE 最高降 29.9%。

venues/ECIR/2025/cold_start_rec/news_wit.title: Revisiting Language Models in Neural News Recommender Systems
venues/ECIR/2025/cold_start_rec/news_wit.description: [ECIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 在 MIND 上统一复现 8 种 LM 作为新闻编码器，发现更大模型不必然更优，但显著利好冷启动用户。

venues/ECIR/2025/cold_start_rec/news_wit.title: FLARE: Fusing Language Models and Collaborative Architectures for Recommender Enhancement
venues/ECIR/2025/cold_start_rec/news_wit.description: [WWW 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用冻结 mT5+Perceiver 将文本注入 Bert4Rec，并以重调 Bert4Rec 基线、大词表评测与 Critiquing 任务重估 ID+文本增益。

venues/ECIR/2025/cold_start_rec/news_wit.title: EasyRec: Simple yet Effective Language Models for Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2025/cold_start_rec/news_wit.description: [EMNLP 2025][LLM4Rec] 用 LLM 生成用户/物品画像并以对比学习对齐协同信号，训练轻量文本编码器实现零样本推荐，Full-Ranking 下 Recall@20 最高提升 32%。

venues/ECIR/2025/cold_start_rec/news_wit.title: RecBase: Generative Foundation Model Pretraining for Zero-Shot Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2025/cold_start_rec/news_wit.description: [EMNLP 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用课程学习增强的 RQ-VAE 将跨域物品统一离散为层级概念 ID，从零预训练 1.5B 自回归推荐基座，在 8 个未见数据集零样本 AUC 全面超越 7B LLM。

venues/ECIR/2025/cold_start_rec/news_wit.title: GenRecEdit: Adapting Model Editing for Generative Recommendation with Cold-Start Items
venues/ECIR/2025/cold_start_rec/news_wit.description: [SIGIR 2026][冷启动与长尾推荐] 将 NLP 模型编辑迁移至生成式推荐，用逐位置定位-编辑+One-One 触发注入冷启动物品 SID 模式，仅需重训 9.5% 时间即大幅缓解冷启动坍缩。

venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: FACE: A General Framework for Mapping Collaborative Filtering Embeddings into LLM Tokens
venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [NeurIPS 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用解耦投影+RQ-VAE 将 CF 嵌入映射为冻结 LLM 词表中的离散 token，配合对比对齐实现免微调的语义可解释与性能增益。

venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: DaRec: A Disentangled Alignment Framework for Large Language Model and Recommender System
venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [ICDE 2025][大语言模型推荐] 从信息论证明零间隙对齐次优，提出解耦共享/特有表征+全局局部结构对齐的即插即用框架，全库排序下 Recall@20 最高提升 5.33%。

venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Fidelity-Aware Recommendation Explanations via Stochastic Path Integration
venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [AAAI 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 将路径积分归因引入推荐解释，用随机基线采样适配稀疏二值交互，在三种模型三数据集上刷新反事实保真度基准。

venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: CROWN: A Novel Approach to Comprehending Users' Preferences for Accurate Personalized News Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [WWW 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 以类别引导意图解耦、标题-内容一致性加权与 GNN 混合用户表征，统一解决新闻推荐的多意图、读后偏好差异与冷启动三大难题。

venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Can LLMs Outshine Conventional Recommenders? A Comparative Evaluation
venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [NeurIPS 2025 DB Track][大语言模型推荐] RecBench 系统对比 17 个 LLM 与 DLRM 在 4 种物品表征、CTR/SeqRec 双任务上的精度-效率权衡，LLM 精度领先但推理慢千倍。

venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Rethinking Popularity Bias in Collaborative Filtering via Analytical Vector Decomposition
venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [KDD 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 揭示 BPR 优化在嵌入空间刻出“流行度方向”的几何偏差，提出非对称方向分解校正 DDC，在 5 个骨干上 MRR@10 提升 6%–29% 且 AvgPop@10 降 21%–47%。

venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Parameter-Efficient Single Collaborative Branch for Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [RecSys 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用单支路权重共享替代用户/物品双塔，参数量减半，精度持平且覆盖率与流行度偏差显著改善。

venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Does Weighting Improve Matrix Factorization for Recommender Systems?
venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [WWW 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 系统实证加权隐式反馈矩阵分解：大秩模型下不加权常持平或更优，并给出加权目标闭式解与预条件共轭梯度高效求解。

venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: On Inherited Popularity Bias in Cold-Start Item Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [RecSys 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 揭示生成式冷启动模型继承热模型流行度偏置，提出基于向量模长重标定的免训练后处理去偏方法，在三个多媒体数据集上显著提升物品公平性与曝光多样性。

venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Biases in LLM-Generated Musical Taste Profiles for Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [RecSys 2025][LLM4Rec] 通过 64 人用户研究揭示 LLM 生成音乐品味画像存在流派/国别系统性偏差，且用户认同度与下游推荐指标仅弱相关。

venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Beyond Item Dissimilarities: Diversifying by Intent in Recommender Systems
venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [KDD 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用实时意图概率驱动整页贪心重排，以贝叶斯后验更新替代物品相似度，YouTube 线上 DAU +0.05%、用户享受度 +0.09%。

venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: DLCRec: A Novel Approach for Managing Diversity in LLM-Based Recommender Systems
venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [WSDM 2025][大语言模型推荐] 将多样性可控推荐拆解为类型预测/填充/物品预测三子任务级联，配合两类数据增广，在 Movie/Steam 上 MAE_Cov@10 大幅领先。

venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Tree of Preferences for Diversified Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [NeurIPS 2025][LLM4Rec] 用 LLM 构建粗到细偏好树挖掘欠探索兴趣并合成交互去偏，在 Twitter/Weibo/Amazon 上同时提升多样性与相关性。

venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Does Weighting Improve Matrix Factorization for Recommender Systems?
venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [WWW 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 系统实证加权隐式反馈矩阵分解：大秩模型下不加权常持平或更优，并给出加权目标闭式解与预条件共轭梯度高效求解。

venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Reformulating Sequential Recommendation: Learning Dynamic User Interest with Content-enriched Language Modeling
venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [DASFAA 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用知识提示+推理提示将序列推荐改写为文本生成任务，GPT-2 冻结主干下在三个数据集全排序协议上取得 Recall@5 相对提升约 5%–12%。

venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Bridging Jensen Gap for Max-Min Group Fairness Optimization in Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [ICLR 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 揭示MMF约束下小批量采样引发Jensen Gap，提出对偶重加权算法FairDual，在三个数据集六种骨干上同时提升准确率与公平性。

venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Towards Fair Large Language Model-based Recommender Systems without Costly Retraining
venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [WWW 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 将 LLM-RS 去偏重构为免重训机器遗忘任务：可学习掩码定位致偏样本 + 影响函数一步参数修正，公平性提升同时精度不降、耗时降 96%。

venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: GORACS: Group-level Optimal Transport-guided Coreset Selection for LLM-based Recommender Systems
venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用最优传输+梯度范数构造测试损失上界代理目标，配合贪心初始化-交换精炼两阶段算法做组级核心集选择，20%训练开销超越全量微调。

venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: How to Diversify any Personalized Recommender?
venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [ECIR 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 提出用户画像级预处理：用逻辑回归识别用户代表类别、userKNN 生成候选，再按 λ% 增删交互，使任意推荐器在保持精度的同时提升多样性与少数类曝光公平。

venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: FairDgcl: Fairness-aware Recommendation with Dynamic Graph Contrastive Learning
venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [TKDE 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 用对抗式视图生成器+判别器动态生成公平增强视图，在四个数据集上同时提升准确率与群体公平性。

venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Path-based summary explanations for graph recommenders (extended version)
venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [ICDE 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 首次提出路径解释的摘要化：用 Steiner Tree 与 Prize-Collecting Steiner Tree 将多条用户-物品解释路径压缩为连通子图，在可理解性、多样性、隐私与可扩展性上全面优于逐条路径基线。

venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: JobFormer: Skill-Aware Job Recommendation with Semantic-Enhanced Transformer
venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [TKDD 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用局部-全局注意力 Transformer 聚合邻居 JD 补全语义，并以技能分布引导两阶段召回+CTR排序，Recall@20 较 NRMS 提升 2.31%。

venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: From Top-1 to Top-K: A Reproducibility Study and Benchmarking of Counterfactual Explanations for Recommender Systems
venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [SIGIR 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 统一复现11种反事实解释器，首次提出列表级Top-K评估协议与PN-R位置敏感指标，揭示显式格式下有效性-稀疏性权衡与图解释器可扩展性瓶颈。

venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: G-Refer: Graph Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Model for Explainable Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 用路径级+节点级混合图检索把协同过滤信号显式翻译为文本，经知识剪枝与 RAFT 微调驱动 LLM 生成可解释推荐，BERT-F1 最高提升 2.81%。

venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Enriching Semantic Profiles into Knowledge Graph for Recommender Systems Using Large Language Models
venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [KDD 2026][LLM4Rec] 用 LLM 为 KG 全实体生成语义画像，以可逆加性注入+成对匹配对齐，Full-Ranking 下 Recall@40 最高提升 2.6%。

venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Bridging Jensen Gap for Max-Min Group Fairness Optimization in Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [ICLR 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 揭示MMF约束下小批量采样引发Jensen Gap，提出对偶重加权算法FairDual，在三个数据集六种骨干上同时提升准确率与公平性。

venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: FairSort: Learning to Fair Rank for Personalized Recommendations in Two-Sided Platforms
venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [TKDE 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 将重排视为“跑道”而非背包，用公平提升速度+二分搜索保证用户最低效用，实现双边公平与个性化推荐的三方权衡。

venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: A Reproducibility Study of Product-side Fairness in Bundle Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [RecSys 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 首个捆绑推荐商品侧公平性复现研究，揭示捆绑级与物品级曝光分布不一致、指标间结论分歧，并发现用户捆绑偏好越强曝光越公平。

venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: KuaiRecV2: Benchmarking Large-Scale Continual Learning for Diversified and Multi-task Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [NeurIPS 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 快手 30 天 4.84 亿交互动态物品池基准，统一评测持续学习、Token 级多样性与多任务检索。

venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Augmenting Sequential Recommendation with Balanced Relevance and Diversity
venues/ECIR/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [AAAI 2025][序列与会话推荐] 提出即插即用平衡增强插件 BASRec，以单序列随机算子+表征级 mixup 与跨序列非线性 mixup 兼顾相关性与多样性，全库排序下 SASRec 平均提升 33.8%。

venues/ECIR/2025/llm_rec/contextualizing.title: Evaluating Podcast Recommendations with Profile-Aware LLM-as-a-Judge
venues/ECIR/2025/llm_rec/contextualizing.description: [RecSys 2025][LLM4Rec] 用90天收听历史蒸馏自然语言用户画像，驱动零样本LLM做剧集级与模型级离线评判，47人用户研究中与人工判断高度一致。

venues/ECIR/2025/llm_rec/contextualizing.title: Biases in LLM-Generated Musical Taste Profiles for Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2025/llm_rec/contextualizing.description: [RecSys 2025][LLM4Rec] 通过 64 人用户研究揭示 LLM 生成音乐品味画像存在流派/国别系统性偏差，且用户认同度与下游推荐指标仅弱相关。

venues/ECIR/2025/llm_rec/contextualizing.title: Balancing Accuracy and Novelty with Sub-Item Popularity
venues/ECIR/2025/llm_rec/contextualizing.description: [RecSys 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 复用 RecJPQ 子 ID 分解在子码本粒度计算个性化流行度 sPPS，与 item 级 PPS 加权融合，在 NDCG 不降前提下显著提升个性化新颖度。

venues/ECIR/2025/llm_rec/contextualizing.title: Reformulating Sequential Recommendation: Learning Dynamic User Interest with Content-enriched Language Modeling
venues/ECIR/2025/llm_rec/contextualizing.description: [DASFAA 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用知识提示+推理提示将序列推荐改写为文本生成任务，GPT-2 冻结主干下在三个数据集全排序协议上取得 Recall@5 相对提升约 5%–12%。

venues/ECIR/2025/llm_rec/contextualizing.title: Uncovering Cross-Domain Recommendation Ability of Large Language Models
venues/ECIR/2025/llm_rec/contextualizing.description: [WWW 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用源域购买序列+跨域引导提示驱动 LLM 零样本重排目标域候选，揭示域间隙与模型规模对跨域迁移的决定性影响。

venues/ECIR/2025/llm_rec/revisiting_lang.title: Can LLMs Outshine Conventional Recommenders? A Comparative Evaluation
venues/ECIR/2025/llm_rec/revisiting_lang.description: [NeurIPS 2025 DB Track][大语言模型推荐] RecBench 系统对比 17 个 LLM 与 DLRM 在 4 种物品表征、CTR/SeqRec 双任务上的精度-效率权衡，LLM 精度领先但推理慢千倍。

venues/ECIR/2025/llm_rec/revisiting_lang.title: Enhancing News Recommendation with Hierarchical LLM Prompting
venues/ECIR/2025/llm_rec/revisiting_lang.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 用分层提示让 LLM 生成更丰富的新闻标题与实体，作为模型无关的数据增强模块，在 MIND 上以 AUC 68.88 超越 GLoCIM 等 SOTA。

venues/ECIR/2025/llm_rec/revisiting_lang.title: The Mental World of Large Language Models in Recommendation: A Benchmark on Association, Personalization, and Knowledgeability
venues/ECIR/2025/llm_rec/revisiting_lang.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出 LRWorld 基准（38K 样本/23M tokens），从关联、个性化、知识性三尺度十因素 31 任务系统评测数十个 LLM，揭示其在神经嵌入检索上的致命短板。

venues/ECIR/2025/llm_rec/revisiting_lang.title: LSNR: Learned Sparse News Recommendations with Attentive User Modeling
venues/ECIR/2025/llm_rec/revisiting_lang.description: [SIGIR-AP 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用独立编码+注意力聚合替代 STAR 的历史拼接，构建双通路稀疏用户向量，MIND NDCG@10 较 STAR 提升 11%，短历史场景反超稠密模型。

venues/ECIR/2025/llm_rec/revisiting_lang.title: ZoRRO: A Zero-Weight Personalized Recommender System for Scalable News Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2025/llm_rec/revisiting_lang.description: [SIGIR 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 零权重免训练新闻推荐框架，以时间衰减×表征相似度打分，离线全库排序超越 NRMS，线上 CTR 逼近 SOTA 且推理快 600 倍。

venues/ECIR/2025/llm_rec/text2playlist_g.title: Semantic IDs for Music Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2025/llm_rec/text2playlist_g.description: [RecSys 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用 RQ-VAE 残差量化生成音乐语义 ID 替代逐曲嵌入，参数量降 75%–99% 而精度不降，线上多样性显著提升。

venues/ECIR/2025/llm_rec/text2playlist_g.title: Contextualizing Spotify's Audiobook List Recommendations with Descriptive Shelves
venues/ECIR/2025/llm_rec/text2playlist_g.description: [ECIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 LLM 抽取十类书目描述符并生成多样化描述性货架标题，两轮线上 A/B 测试验证发现性与互动指标提升。

venues/ECIR/2025/llm_rec/text2playlist_g.title: Beyond the past: Leveraging Audio and Human Memory for Sequential Music Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2025/llm_rec/text2playlist_g.description: [RecSys 2025][多模态推荐] 用音频编码器预测新歌的 ACT-R 类激活值，将记忆式重复建模扩展到未听歌曲，NDCG_Exp 相对 PISA 提升约 40%，RepBias 降至 0.09%。

venues/ECIR/2025/llm_rec/text2playlist_g.title: Balancing Accuracy and Novelty with Sub-Item Popularity
venues/ECIR/2025/llm_rec/text2playlist_g.description: [RecSys 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 复用 RecJPQ 子 ID 分解在子码本粒度计算个性化流行度 sPPS，与 item 级 PPS 加权融合，在 NDCG 不降前提下显著提升个性化新颖度。

venues/ECIR/2025/llm_rec/text2playlist_g.title: Just Ask for Music (JAM): Multimodal and Personalized Natural Language Music Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2025/llm_rec/text2playlist_g.description: [RecSys 2025][多模态推荐] 将查询建模为用户到物品的向量平移，用交叉注意力聚合音频/歌词/CF 多模态，在 JAMSessions 全库排序上 NDCG@10 相对 TalkRec 提升约 105%

venues/ECIR/2025/sequential_rec/saferec_.title: GLINT-RU: Gated Lightweight Intelligent Recurrent Units for Sequential Recommender Systems
venues/ECIR/2025/sequential_rec/saferec_.description: [KDD 2025][序列与会话推荐] 单层并行专家混合（密集选择GRU+线性注意力）+门控MLP的高效序列推荐，Leave-One-Out全库排序下精度与推理速度双超SOTA。

venues/ECIR/2025/sequential_rec/saferec_.title: A Dual-Expert Strategy Integrating LLMs to Mitigate Negative Transfer in Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2025/sequential_rec/saferec_.description: [CIKM 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 用域门控双专家+物品级注意力掩码+双池负采样对比学习，抑制 LLM 跨域序列推荐中的负迁移，10 域上超越 26 个基线，线上 CTR 相对提升 47.6%。

venues/ECIR/2025/sequential_rec/saferec_.title: Scaling Recommender Transformers to One Billion Parameters
venues/ECIR/2025/sequential_rec/saferec_.description: [KDD 2026][序列与会话推荐] ARGUS 将自回归预训练解耦为反馈预测与下一物品预测双任务，把推荐 Transformer 编码器扩到 10 亿参数，线上听歌时长 +2.26%、点赞率 +6.37%。

venues/ECIR/2025/sequential_rec/saferec_.title: Revisiting Self-attention for Cross-domain Sequential Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2025/sequential_rec/saferec_.description: [KDD 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 将跨域序列推荐重构为推荐损失与跨域注意力抑制的双目标帕累托优化，以即插即用方式改造自注意力，平均提升 Recall@10 达 9.8%/16.0%。

venues/ECIR/2025/sequential_rec/saferec_.title: RecBase: Generative Foundation Model Pretraining for Zero-Shot Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2025/sequential_rec/saferec_.description: [EMNLP 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用课程学习增强的 RQ-VAE 将跨域物品统一离散为层级概念 ID，从零预训练 1.5B 自回归推荐基座，在 8 个未见数据集零样本 AUC 全面超越 7B LLM。

venues/ECIR/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: Bridging Conversational and Collaborative Signals for Conversational Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [WWW 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 构建 Reddit-ML32M 跨源数据集，用 SASRec 协同嵌入对 GPT-3.5 零样本推荐做相似度重排，H@5 提升 12.32%。

venues/ECIR/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: Reindex-Then-Adapt: Improving Large Language Models for Conversational Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [WSDM 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 将多 token 电影标题重索引为单 token，再用偏置/门控适配目标平台分布，Llama2-7b 上 H@10 相对提升 59.37%。

venues/ECIR/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: Beyond Retrieval: Generating Narratives in Conversational Recommender Systems
venues/ECIR/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 构建 REGEN 叙事数据集并提出 CF+内容嵌入经 Adapter 注入 LLM 的融合架构，在 Office/Clothing 两域上 BLEU/ROUGE/语义相似度较单模态提升 4–12%。

venues/ECIR/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: Collaborative Retrieval for Large Language Model-based Conversational Recommender Systems
venues/ECIR/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [WWW 2025][对话推荐与智能体] 用 EASE 协同检索 + 两步 LLM 反思重排为黑盒 LLM 注入 CF 知识，Reddit-v2/Redial 全库排序 Recall@20 显著超越 Zero-shot LLM。

venues/ECIR/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: LLM2Rec: Large Language Models Are Powerful Embedding Models for Sequential Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 两阶段将 LLM 改造为融合协同信号与语义的物品嵌入模型，Full-Ranking 下域内平均提升约 15%、跨域仍稳定增益。

venues/ECIR/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: Refining Text Generation for Realistic Conversational Recommendation via Direct Preference Optimization
venues/ECIR/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [EMNLP 2025][对话推荐与智能体] 用 DPO 对齐 LLM 生成的对话摘要与物品推荐信息，使评分器更准，Tabidachi 上 HR@1 提升 21.3%。

venues/ECIR/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: A LLM-based Controllable, Scalable, Human-Involved User Simulator Framework for Conversational Recommender Systems
venues/ECIR/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [WWW 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 以插件管理器分阶段管控 LLM 用户模拟器，通过记忆隔离与偏好二分抑制数据泄漏，在 ReDial/OpenDialKG/MovieLens 上显著提升 CRS 评估可信度。

venues/ECIR/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: USB-Rec: An Effective Framework for Improving Conversational Recommendation Capability of Large Language Model
venues/ECIR/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [RecSys 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用带标签用户模拟器自动构造偏好对做 RL 训练，再在推理期用内部用户模拟器+树搜索自增强，iEval 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/ECIR/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: Ask to Be Sure: Informative Interactions for Confident Multi-Turn LLM Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [CIKM 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 以推荐列表采样熵的下降量作为信息增益奖励，免真值微调 LLM 多轮对话策略，INSPIRED/ReDial 上 Hit 与对话效率双升。

venues/ECIR/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: RecUserSim: A Realistic and Diverse User Simulator for Evaluating Conversational Recommender Systems
venues/ECIR/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [WWW 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出四模块 LLM Agent 用户模拟器，以有限理性三层 Rating-Action-Response 机制实现真实角色扮演、多样人群覆盖与显式打分，并落地华为 Celia 餐饮助手。

venues/ECIR/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: A LLM-based Controllable, Scalable, Human-Involved User Simulator Framework for Conversational Recommender Systems
venues/ECIR/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [WWW 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 以插件管理器分阶段管控 LLM 用户模拟器，通过记忆隔离与偏好二分抑制数据泄漏，在 ReDial/OpenDialKG/MovieLens 上显著提升 CRS 评估可信度。

venues/ECIR/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: Limitations of Current Evaluation Practices for Conversational Recommender Systems and the Potential of User Simulation
venues/ECIR/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [SIGIR-AP 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 批判静态数据集与 Recall@N 评估失真，提出奖励/成本效用框架与 RDL 指标，并用 LLM 用户模拟器替代真人评估。

venues/ECIR/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: RecUserSim: A Realistic and Diverse User Simulator for Evaluating Conversational Recommender Systems
venues/ECIR/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [WWW 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出四模块 LLM Agent 用户模拟器，以有限理性三层 Rating-Action-Response 机制实现真实角色扮演、多样人群覆盖与显式打分，并落地华为 Celia 餐饮助手。

venues/ECIR/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: Interplay: Training Independent Simulators for Reference-Free Conversational Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [ECIR 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 训练独立用户/推荐双模拟器，以目标属性替代目标物品消除 oracle 泄漏，8B 模型 Recall@1 超 32B 基线 15 倍。

venues/ECIR/2026/agent_conversational_re.title: Towards Personalized Conversational Sales Agents: Contextual User Profiling for Strategic Action
venues/ECIR/2026/agent_conversational_re.description: [ACL 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出 CSALES 对话销售任务与 CSUSER 真实画像用户模拟器，CSI 智能体通过上下文画像驱动统一动作空间，SR 提升约 15-20pt、SWR 提升约 5-10pt。

venues/ECIR/2026/collaborative_filtering.title: Criteria-Aware Graph Filtering: Extremely Fast Yet Accurate Multi-Criteria Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2026/collaborative_filtering.description: [WWW 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 免训练免矩阵分解的多准则图滤波推荐，按准则定制多项式低通滤波器并融合用户准则偏好，BA 数据集 0.2 秒推理、NDCG@5 最高提升 24%。

venues/ECIR/2026/collaborative_filtering.title: Memory Is No Longer a Bottleneck: Memory-Efficient Graph Filtering for Scalable Collaborative Filtering
venues/ECIR/2026/collaborative_filtering.description: [TKDE 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用逐用户 Krylov 子空间替代全量物品相似度图，实现免训练多项式图滤波，内存降 5.74×、推理加速 26× 且精度反超 SOTA。

venues/ECIR/2026/collaborative_filtering.title: FLARE: Fusing Language Models and Collaborative Architectures for Recommender Enhancement
venues/ECIR/2026/collaborative_filtering.description: [WWW 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用冻结 mT5+Perceiver 将文本注入 Bert4Rec，并以重调 Bert4Rec 基线、大词表评测与 Critiquing 任务重估 ID+文本增益。

venues/ECIR/2026/collaborative_filtering.title: Can LLMs Outshine Conventional Recommenders? A Comparative Evaluation
venues/ECIR/2026/collaborative_filtering.description: [NeurIPS 2025 DB Track][大语言模型推荐] RecBench 系统对比 17 个 LLM 与 DLRM 在 4 种物品表征、CTR/SeqRec 双任务上的精度-效率权衡，LLM 精度领先但推理慢千倍。

venues/ECIR/2026/collaborative_filtering.title: Recommendations with Sparse Comparison Data: Provably Fast Convergence for Nonconvex Matrix Factorization
venues/ECIR/2026/collaborative_filtering.description: [ICML 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 将成对比较反馈建模为低秩矩阵分解下的离散选择似然，证明稀疏数据下投影梯度下降在热启动邻域内指数收敛，样本复杂度近最优。

venues/ECIR/2026/debias_fairness_industr.title: Stairway to Fairness: Connecting Group and Individual Fairness
venues/ECIR/2026/debias_fairness_industr.description: [RecSys 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 首次用同一族度量（SD/Gini/Atk）在 3 数据集 8 组 LLMRec 运行上实证组公平与个体公平的错位，揭示组间公平掩盖组内与个体不公。

venues/ECIR/2026/debias_fairness_industr.title: Joint Evaluation of Fairness and Relevance in Recommender Systems with Pareto Frontier
venues/ECIR/2026/debias_fairness_industr.description: [WWW 2025][去偏公平与工业评测] 提出 DPFR：以测试集构造相关性-公平性帕累托前沿，用模型得分到前沿的欧氏距离作为联合评测指标，揭示现有联合指标排序与帕累托最优解不一致。

venues/ECIR/2026/debias_fairness_industr.title: A Reproducibility Study of Product-side Fairness in Bundle Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2026/debias_fairness_industr.description: [RecSys 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 首个捆绑推荐商品侧公平性复现研究，揭示捆绑级与物品级曝光分布不一致、指标间结论分歧，并发现用户捆绑偏好越强曝光越公平。

venues/ECIR/2026/debias_fairness_industr.title: Post-hoc Provider Fairness Adaptation via Hierarchical Exposure Alignment
venues/ECIR/2026/debias_fairness_industr.description: [SIGIR 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 冻结基座+轻量公平适配器，用分层曝光对齐(HEFA)与可微NDCG联合优化，实现即插即用的提供方曝光公平。

venues/ECIR/2026/debias_fairness_industr.title: Equity vs. Equality: Optimizing Ranking Fairness for Tailored Provider Needs
venues/ECIR/2026/debias_fairness_industr.description: [SIGIR 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 提出以增益为基的公平框架与 EquityRank 梯度重排算法，按提供者异质偏好分配曝光与销量收益，离线/在线仿真均取得更优效果-公平权衡。

venues/ECIR/2026/debias_fairness_industr.title: ZoRRO: A Zero-Weight Personalized Recommender System for Scalable News Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2026/debias_fairness_industr.description: [SIGIR 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 零权重免训练新闻推荐框架，以时间衰减×表征相似度打分，离线全库排序超越 NRMS，线上 CTR 逼近 SOTA 且推理快 600 倍。

venues/ECIR/2026/debias_fairness_industr.title: D-RDW: Diversity-Driven Random Walks for News Recommender Systems
venues/ECIR/2026/debias_fairness_industr.description: [RecSys 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 将规范目标分布(NTD)作为线性约束嵌入随机游走采样，实现可解释、低能耗的新闻多样化重排，能耗降低一个数量级。

venues/ECIR/2026/debias_fairness_industr.title: Opening the Black Box: Interpretable Remedies for Popularity Bias in Recommender Systems
venues/ECIR/2026/debias_fairness_industr.description: [RecSys 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 用稀疏自编码器定位流行度神经元并做激活转向，在 ML-1M/Last.fm 上以极小精度损失换取显著曝光公平提升。

venues/ECIR/2026/debias_fairness_industr.title: CROWN: A Novel Approach to Comprehending Users' Preferences for Accurate Personalized News Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2026/debias_fairness_industr.description: [WWW 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 以类别引导意图解耦、标题-内容一致性加权与 GNN 混合用户表征，统一解决新闻推荐的多意图、读后偏好差异与冷启动三大难题。

venues/ECIR/2026/debias_fairness_industr.title: Revisiting Language Models in Neural News Recommender Systems
venues/ECIR/2026/debias_fairness_industr.description: [ECIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 在 MIND 上统一复现 8 种 LM 作为新闻编码器，发现更大模型不必然更优，但显著利好冷启动用户。

venues/ECIR/2026/generative_rec/efficien.title: Not All Branches Are Equal: Adaptive Semantic ID Construction for Generative Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2026/generative_rec/efficien.description: [RecSys 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义 ID] 将语义 ID 重构为树路径，用轮廓系数自适应分支+概率质量约束构建 AST，五域 Amazon 全库排序平均相对提升 13.08%

venues/ECIR/2026/generative_rec/efficien.title: MERGE: Next-Generation Item Indexing Paradigm for Large-Scale Streaming Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2026/generative_rec/efficien.description: [CIKM 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义 ID] 以并查集动态生成聚类替代 VQ 盲分配，配合占用监控与由细到粗合并构建分层码本，工业 A/B 显著提升曝光多样性与互动。

venues/ECIR/2026/generative_rec/efficien.title: Revisiting Generative vs. Dense Retrieval: A Static Value Prior Reverses the Gap
venues/ECIR/2026/generative_rec/efficien.description: [CIKM 2026][生成式推荐] 在受控 GR/DR 对比下揭示指标选择反转胜负，用免训练静态价值先验重排 DR 即反超 GR 最佳物品价值并保持召回领先。

venues/ECIR/2026/generative_rec/efficien.title: You Only Evaluate Once: A Tree-based Rerank Method at Meituan
venues/ECIR/2026/generative_rec/efficien.description: [CIKM 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用树状多尺度上下文提取+上下文缓存实现单阶段全排列重排，离线GAUC显著提升并落地美团外卖。

venues/ECIR/2026/generative_rec/efficien.title: EGR: Embedding-Native Generative Retrieval with a Shared LLM
venues/ECIR/2026/generative_rec/efficien.description: [RecSys 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用单一共享 LLM 同时编码物品与用户历史，以双对比损失联合训练，免量化免 grounding，线上 CVR +2.91%

venues/ECIR/2026/llm_rec/pre_trained_llm.title: Lost in Sequence: Do Large Language Models Understand Sequential Recommendation?
venues/ECIR/2026/llm_rec/pre_trained_llm.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 揭示现有 LLM4Rec 模型无法捕捉交互序列顺序信息，提出冻结 LLM 与 CF-SRec、仅训练轻量 MLP 的蒸馏框架 LLM-SRec，在 Amazon 四数据集上 NDCG@10 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/ECIR/2026/llm_rec/pre_trained_llm.title: EAGER-LLM: Enhancing Large Language Models as Recommenders through Exogenous Behavior-Semantic Integration
venues/ECIR/2026/llm_rec/pre_trained_llm.description: [WWW 2025][大语言模型推荐] 以双源知识富集物品索引+非侵入多尺度对齐重建+退火适配器，将外源行为/语义信号注入 LLM 生成式推荐，Amazon 三数据集 Full-Ranking 下 Recall@10 最高提升 26.16%。

venues/ECIR/2026/llm_rec/pre_trained_llm.title: DELRec: Distilling Sequential Pattern to Enhance LLMs-based Sequential Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2026/llm_rec/pre_trained_llm.description: [ICDE 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用软提示两阶段蒸馏传统序列模型的时间感知与推荐模式，再微调 LLM 做序列推荐，四数据集 HR/NDCG 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/ECIR/2026/llm_rec/pre_trained_llm.title: Reformulating Sequential Recommendation: Learning Dynamic User Interest with Content-enriched Language Modeling
venues/ECIR/2026/llm_rec/pre_trained_llm.description: [DASFAA 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用知识提示+推理提示将序列推荐改写为文本生成任务，GPT-2 冻结主干下在三个数据集全排序协议上取得 Recall@5 相对提升约 5%–12%。

venues/ECIR/2026/llm_rec/pre_trained_llm.title: LLM2Rec: Large Language Models Are Powerful Embedding Models for Sequential Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2026/llm_rec/pre_trained_llm.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 两阶段将 LLM 改造为融合协同信号与语义的物品嵌入模型，Full-Ranking 下域内平均提升约 15%、跨域仍稳定增益。

venues/ECIR/2026/llm_rec/scinup_natural_.title: Scholar Inbox: Personalized Paper Recommendations for Scientists
venues/ECIR/2026/llm_rec/scinup_natural_.description: [ACL/EMNLP 2025 Demo][冷启动与长尾推荐] 面向科研论文的开放获取推荐平台，以显式点赞/点踩训练加权逻辑回归，结合 Scholar Maps 与主动学习破解冷启动，在 80 万评分数据集上 GTE-Large 达 AUC 86.75。

venues/ECIR/2026/llm_rec/scinup_natural_.title: DataRec: A Python Library for Standardized and Reproducible Data Management in Recommender Systems
venues/ECIR/2026/llm_rec/scinup_natural_.description: [SIGIR 2025][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 基于 55 篇顶会论文调研构建的统一数据管理库，提供可复现的过滤/划分/版本校验与跨框架导出，覆盖 18 个内置数据集。

venues/ECIR/2026/llm_rec/scinup_natural_.title: Whose Name Comes Up? II: Benchmarking and Intervention-Based Auditing of LLM-Based Scholar Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2026/llm_rec/scinup_natural_.description: [KDD 2026][LLM4Rec] 提出 LLMScholarBench，联合审计 22 个 LLM 在 5 类学者推荐任务、3 类推理期干预下的技术质量与社会代表性权衡。

venues/ECIR/2026/llm_rec/scinup_natural_.title: ProMax: Exploring the Potential of LLM-derived Profiles with Distribution Shaping for Recommender Systems
venues/ECIR/2026/llm_rec/scinup_natural_.description: [SIGIR 2026][LLM推荐] 将 LLM 画像视为检索信号而非融合特征，用双路分布重塑（监督+自监督）引导基座模型，LightGCN 上 NDCG@10 最高提升 8.44%。

venues/ECIR/2026/llm_rec/scinup_natural_.title: Can LLMs Outshine Conventional Recommenders? A Comparative Evaluation
venues/ECIR/2026/llm_rec/scinup_natural_.description: [NeurIPS 2025 DB Track][大语言模型推荐] RecBench 系统对比 17 个 LLM 与 DLRM 在 4 种物品表征、CTR/SeqRec 双任务上的精度-效率权衡，LLM 精度领先但推理慢千倍。

venues/ECIR/2026/multimodal_rec/are_mult.title: Do Recommender Systems Really Leverage Multimodal Content? A Comprehensive Analysis on Multimodal Representations for Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2026/multimodal_rec/are_mult.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 用受控噪声实验证明多模态增益源于语义而非模型容量，并以 LVLM 结构化提示生成「原生多模态」[EOS] 嵌入替代晚期融合，Borda 聚合排名第一。

venues/ECIR/2026/multimodal_rec/are_mult.title: NoteLLM-2: Multimodal Large Representation Models for Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2026/multimodal_rec/are_mult.description: [KDD 2025][多模态推荐] 端到端微调 LLM+视觉编码器构建高效 MLRM，用 mICL 与门控后期融合缓解视觉忽视，I2I 全库召回 R@100 显著提升并落地线上 A/B。

venues/ECIR/2026/multimodal_rec/are_mult.title: Harnessing Multimodal Large Language Models for Multimodal Sequential Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2026/multimodal_rec/are_mult.description: [AAAI 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 MLLM 将商品图转为文本摘要，再以循环式提示推断动态用户偏好，SFT 微调 LLaVA 做多模态序列推荐，AUC 最高提升约 4.3%。

venues/ECIR/2026/multimodal_rec/are_mult.title: Personalized Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Foundation Models for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2026/multimodal_rec/are_mult.description: [WWW 2026][多模态推荐] 按兴趣分群并为每群挂载独立 PEFT 模块，使 CLIP 编码出用户条件化的物品表征，配合群内难负采样，NDCG@20 最高提升 15.3%。

venues/ECIR/2026/multimodal_rec/are_mult.title: Binge Watch: Reproducible Multimodal Benchmark Datasets for Large-Scale Movie Recommendation on MovieLens-10M and 20M
venues/ECIR/2026/multimodal_rec/are_mult.description: [RecSys 2026][多模态推荐] 为 ML-10M/20M 构建可复现多模态基准 M3L（剧情/海报/预告片文本-图像-视频-音频），保留>90%交互并验证音频模态的关键增益。

venues/ECIR/2026/self_supervised_denoisi.title: Unleashing the Power of Large Language Model for Denoising Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2026/self_supervised_denoisi.description: [WWW 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] LLaRD 用 LLM 生成偏好知识与图 CoT 关系知识，再以信息瓶颈对齐去噪图，Full-Ranking 下 Recall@20 最高提升约 14%。

venues/ECIR/2026/self_supervised_denoisi.title: Denoising Implicit Feedback for Cold-start Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2026/self_supervised_denoisi.description: [KDD 2026][冷启动与长尾推荐] 用内容相似热物品协同表征为冷物品生成置信加权伪标签，并以相对熵×冷启动状态估计样本不确定性做自适应软标签纠正，快手十亿级 A/B 全指标提升。

venues/ECIR/2026/self_supervised_denoisi.title: Empowering Denoising Sequential Recommendation with Large Language Model Embeddings
venues/ECIR/2026/self_supervised_denoisi.description: [CIKM 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 用 LLM 语义嵌入与协同嵌入做跨模态兴趣对齐，缓解冷门物品过度去噪，四数据集全排序 HR/NDCG 显著提升。

venues/ECIR/2026/self_supervised_denoisi.title: Generative Large Recommendation Models: Emerging Trends in LLMs for Recommendation
venues/ECIR/2026/self_supervised_denoisi.description: [WWW 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 系统梳理生成式大推荐模型范式：数据质量、缩放律、用户行为挖掘与训练推理效率四大议题及未来方向。

venues/ECIR/2026/self_supervised_denoisi.title: On Efficiency-Effectiveness Trade-off of Diffusion-based Recommenders
venues/ECIR/2026/self_supervised_denoisi.description: [NeurIPS 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用时间一致性正则平滑去噪函数实现一步生成，再用自适应偏好对齐修正轨迹偏差，兼顾扩散推荐效率与效果。

venues/ICDE/2025/cold_start_rec/all_in_o.title: Recommendation Is a Dish Better Served Warm
venues/ICDE/2025/cold_start_rec/all_in_o.description: [RecSys 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 系统量化冷启动阈值：物品侧训练交互扫描+用户侧推理历史截断，揭示 6–15 条交互的冷热分界并批判 p-core 过滤的任意性。

venues/ICDE/2025/cold_start_rec/all_in_o.title: On Inherited Popularity Bias in Cold-Start Item Recommendation
venues/ICDE/2025/cold_start_rec/all_in_o.description: [RecSys 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 揭示生成式冷启动模型继承热模型流行度偏置，提出基于向量模长重标定的免训练后处理去偏方法，在三个多媒体数据集上显著提升物品公平性与曝光多样性。

venues/ICDE/2025/cold_start_rec/all_in_o.title: Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation with Representation-Level User Transfer
venues/ICDE/2025/cold_start_rec/all_in_o.description: [CIKM 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 仅通过用户表征级迁移实现跨域序列推荐，融合层注入源域用户向量，兼容纵向联邦与部分重叠用户，全库排序下 NDCG@10 提升 7.4–24.1%。

venues/ICDE/2025/cold_start_rec/all_in_o.title: Personalized Diffusion Model Reshapes Cold-Start Bundle Recommendation
venues/ICDE/2025/cold_start_rec/all_in_o.description: [WWW 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 用个性化条件扩散在分布空间生成捆绑包，配合解耦自注意力与KL正则，冷启动捆绑推荐全库排序Recall@20最高提升1155%。

venues/ICDE/2025/cold_start_rec/all_in_o.title: MixRec: Heterogeneous Graph Collaborative Filtering
venues/ICDE/2025/cold_start_rec/all_in_o.description: [WSDM 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 参数化异质超图解耦多行为意图，配合节点/图级自适应对比学习，Leave-One-Out 全库排序下 HR@10 最高提升 9.8%。

venues/ICDE/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Exploring Preference-Guided Diffusion Model for Cross-Domain Recommendation
venues/ICDE/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [KDD 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用源域交互历史构造偏好引导信号，逐步注入扩散逆向过程生成目标域冷启动用户表征，三场景 MAE 最高降 32.60%。

venues/ICDE/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation with Representation-Level User Transfer
venues/ICDE/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [CIKM 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 仅通过用户表征级迁移实现跨域序列推荐，融合层注入源域用户向量，兼容纵向联邦与部分重叠用户，全库排序下 NDCG@10 提升 7.4–24.1%。

venues/ICDE/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Automated Prompting for Non-overlapping Cross-domain Sequential Recommendation
venues/ICDE/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [TKDE 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用可学习连续 Prompt（域无关+域特定+冻结标签）替代域对齐约束，实现无重叠实体、仅隐式反馈的双目标跨域序列推荐，Movie-Book 上 HR@10 相对最优基线提升约 17.8%。

venues/ICDE/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Uncovering Cross-Domain Recommendation Ability of Large Language Models
venues/ICDE/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [WWW 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用源域购买序列+跨域引导提示驱动 LLM 零样本重排目标域候选，揭示域间隙与模型规模对跨域迁移的决定性影响。

venues/ICDE/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: CoLLM: Integrating Collaborative Embeddings into Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/ICDE/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [TKDE 2025][大语言模型推荐] 将传统协同过滤模型学到的用户/物品表征经 MLP 映射进 LLM 词嵌入空间，以两阶段调优兼顾暖启动与冷启动，AUC 相对 TALLRec 提升约 8%。

venues/ICDE/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Middleman Bias in Advertising: Aligning Relevance of Keyphrase Recommendations with Search
venues/ICDE/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [WWW 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 揭示广告关键词相关性过滤中的“中间人偏差”，用Search相关性判定重构训练标签，并以轻量Cross-Encoder在eBay线上取得CVR+11.6%的收益。

venues/ICDE/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: SMART: LLM-Augmented Hybrid Retrieval for Dynamic Product Ads
venues/ICDE/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [RecSys 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 揭示规则查询擅长 BM25 重定向、LLM 查询擅长 ANN 拓客的检索分解，用输出审计门控仅路由 10% 用户，线上转化率 +27.6%

venues/ICDE/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Training Large Recommendation Models via Graph-Language Token Alignment
venues/ICDE/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 将 LightGCN 用户/物品节点经投影器对齐进 LLaMA-2 词表空间，用 GLLM logits 匹配层做端到端物品预测，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@10 最高提升 185%。

venues/ICDE/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Generative Product Recommendations for Implicit Superlative Queries
venues/ICDE/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [ACL 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出 SUPERB 四级标注体系与深思式属性生成，用 LLM 列表级重排处理隐式最高级商品查询，nDCG@10 相对 BM25 提升约 18%。

venues/ICDE/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Scaling Multilingual Semantic Search in Uber Eats Delivery
venues/ICDE/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [KDD 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 基于 gte-Qwen2 双塔统一多语言多垂类语义召回，InfoNCE+Triplet NCE 两阶段训练与 MRL 多维度服务，Store R@20 相对 Legacy 提升 88%。

venues/ICDE/2025/graph_rec/path_based_su.title: From Top-1 to Top-K: A Reproducibility Study and Benchmarking of Counterfactual Explanations for Recommender Systems
venues/ICDE/2025/graph_rec/path_based_su.description: [SIGIR 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 统一复现11种反事实解释器，首次提出列表级Top-K评估协议与PN-R位置敏感指标，揭示显式格式下有效性-稀疏性权衡与图解释器可扩展性瓶颈。

venues/ICDE/2025/graph_rec/path_based_su.title: G-Refer: Graph Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Model for Explainable Recommendation
venues/ICDE/2025/graph_rec/path_based_su.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 用路径级+节点级混合图检索把协同过滤信号显式翻译为文本，经知识剪枝与 RAFT 微调驱动 LLM 生成可解释推荐，BERT-F1 最高提升 2.81%。

venues/ICDE/2025/graph_rec/path_based_su.title: Comprehending Knowledge Graphs with Large Language Models for Recommender Systems
venues/ICDE/2025/graph_rec/path_based_su.description: [SIGIR 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 用 LLM 理解 KG 局部子图并构建语义物品图做全局检索增强，离线预计算语义嵌入后接入 LightGCN，全库排序下全面超越 12 个基线。

venues/ICDE/2025/graph_rec/path_based_su.title: Reasoning over User Preferences: Knowledge Graph-Augmented LLMs for Explainable Conversational Recommendations
venues/ICDE/2025/graph_rec/path_based_su.description: [ICDM 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] COMPASS 用图实体描述预训练+知识感知指令微调，让 LLM 生成可解释文本偏好摘要并以门控注入现有 CRS，ReDial/INSPIRED 上 HR@10 最高提升 44.76%。

venues/ICDE/2025/graph_rec/path_based_su.title: Enhancing Recommendation Explanations through User-Centric Refinement
venues/ICDE/2025/graph_rec/path_based_su.description: [ACL 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出 RefineX 多智能体推理期精炼框架，以 plan-then-refine 与分层反思将 PETER 解释在事实性/个性化/连贯性三维度大幅提升。

venues/ICDE/2025/llm_rec/darec_a_disenta.title: FACE: A General Framework for Mapping Collaborative Filtering Embeddings into LLM Tokens
venues/ICDE/2025/llm_rec/darec_a_disenta.description: [NeurIPS 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用解耦投影+RQ-VAE 将 CF 嵌入映射为冻结 LLM 词表中的离散 token，配合对比对齐实现免微调的语义可解释与性能增益。

venues/ICDE/2025/llm_rec/darec_a_disenta.title: L2Rec: Towards Dual-View Understanding of LLMs for Personalized Recommendation
venues/ICDE/2025/llm_rec/darec_a_disenta.description: [SIGIR 2026][大语言模型推荐] 以参数级双视图 LoRA-MoE 替代输入/输出级融合，个性化路由对齐行为与语义视图，四数据集 N@10 提升 3.87%–8.02%，线上 CTR +9.24%。

venues/ICDE/2025/llm_rec/darec_a_disenta.title: EasyRec: Simple yet Effective Language Models for Recommendation
venues/ICDE/2025/llm_rec/darec_a_disenta.description: [EMNLP 2025][LLM4Rec] 用 LLM 生成用户/物品画像并以对比学习对齐协同信号，训练轻量文本编码器实现零样本推荐，Full-Ranking 下 Recall@20 最高提升 32%。

venues/ICDE/2025/llm_rec/darec_a_disenta.title: Pre-train, Align, and Disentangle: Empowering Sequential Recommendation with Large Language Models
venues/ICDE/2025/llm_rec/darec_a_disenta.description: [SIGIR 2025][LLM推荐] 用 MK-MMD 特征核做推荐锚定对齐，再以三专家频率门控解耦，Full-Ranking 下冷物品 HR@10 提升最高 462%。

venues/ICDE/2025/llm_rec/darec_a_disenta.title: LLM2Rec: Large Language Models Are Powerful Embedding Models for Sequential Recommendation
venues/ICDE/2025/llm_rec/darec_a_disenta.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 两阶段将 LLM 改造为融合协同信号与语义的物品嵌入模型，Full-Ranking 下域内平均提升约 15%、跨域仍稳定增益。

venues/ICDE/2025/llm_rec/delrec_distilli.title: Lost in Sequence: Do Large Language Models Understand Sequential Recommendation?
venues/ICDE/2025/llm_rec/delrec_distilli.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 揭示现有 LLM4Rec 模型无法捕捉交互序列顺序信息，提出冻结 LLM 与 CF-SRec、仅训练轻量 MLP 的蒸馏框架 LLM-SRec，在 Amazon 四数据集上 NDCG@10 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/ICDE/2025/llm_rec/delrec_distilli.title: LLM2Rec: Large Language Models Are Powerful Embedding Models for Sequential Recommendation
venues/ICDE/2025/llm_rec/delrec_distilli.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 两阶段将 LLM 改造为融合协同信号与语义的物品嵌入模型，Full-Ranking 下域内平均提升约 15%、跨域仍稳定增益。

venues/ICDE/2025/llm_rec/delrec_distilli.title: Bridge the Domains: Large Language Models Enhanced Cross-domain Sequential Recommendation
venues/ICDE/2025/llm_rec/delrec_distilli.description: [SIGIR 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用 LLM 语义嵌入+分层画像桥接跨域物品与用户偏好，破解重叠困境与转移复杂性，三数据集 H@10 最高提升 31.7%。

venues/ICDE/2025/llm_rec/delrec_distilli.title: Pre-trained LLMs Meet Sequential Recommenders: Efficient User-Centric Knowledge Distillation
venues/ICDE/2025/llm_rec/delrec_distilli.description: [ECIR 2026][大语言模型推荐] 用预训练 LLM 生成文本用户画像并蒸馏进 SASRec/BERT4Rec 隐层，两阶段训练实现零推理开销的语义增强，Recall@10 最高提升 23.5%。

venues/ICDE/2025/llm_rec/delrec_distilli.title: SLMRec: Distilling Large Language Models into Small for Sequential Recommendation
venues/ICDE/2025/llm_rec/delrec_distilli.description: [ICLR 2025][LLM4Rec] 发现 LLM 中间层冗余，用逐层分块特征蒸馏将 8 层教师压缩为 4 层学生，仅 13% 参数达 6.6x/8.0x 加速且性能不降。

venues/ICDE/2025/llm_rec/making_large_la.title: Knowledge Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation for LLM-based Recommendation
venues/ICDE/2025/llm_rec/making_large_la.description: [ACL 2025][LLM4Rec] 用跳场知识子图索引+流行度选择性检索+GNN软提示，将KG结构知识注入冻结LLM，MovieLens-1M ACC 相对提升58.6%且推理仅慢0.14s

venues/ICDE/2025/llm_rec/making_large_la.title: Reasoning over User Preferences: Knowledge Graph-Augmented LLMs for Explainable Conversational Recommendations
venues/ICDE/2025/llm_rec/making_large_la.description: [ICDM 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] COMPASS 用图实体描述预训练+知识感知指令微调，让 LLM 生成可解释文本偏好摘要并以门控注入现有 CRS，ReDial/INSPIRED 上 HR@10 最高提升 44.76%。

venues/ICDE/2025/llm_rec/making_large_la.title: Comprehending Knowledge Graphs with Large Language Models for Recommender Systems
venues/ICDE/2025/llm_rec/making_large_la.description: [SIGIR 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 用 LLM 理解 KG 局部子图并构建语义物品图做全局检索增强，离线预计算语义嵌入后接入 LightGCN，全库排序下全面超越 12 个基线。

venues/ICDE/2025/llm_rec/making_large_la.title: EAGER-LLM: Enhancing Large Language Models as Recommenders through Exogenous Behavior-Semantic Integration
venues/ICDE/2025/llm_rec/making_large_la.description: [WWW 2025][大语言模型推荐] 以双源知识富集物品索引+非侵入多尺度对齐重建+退火适配器，将外源行为/语义信号注入 LLM 生成式推荐，Amazon 三数据集 Full-Ranking 下 Recall@10 最高提升 26.16%。

venues/ICDE/2025/llm_rec/making_large_la.title: Filling the Gaps: Selective Knowledge Augmentation for LLM Recommenders
venues/ICDE/2025/llm_rec/making_large_la.description: [SIGIR 2026][大语言模型推荐] 提出 CKP 比较式知识探测量化 LLM 对物品的协同知识缺口，仅对知识贫乏物品选择性注入属性与参考物品，免训练提升 Recall@1 与长尾覆盖。

venues/ICDE/2026/cold_start_rec/user_ada.title: Improving Rare Medication Recommendation with Counterfactual Data Augmentation and Large Language Models
venues/ICDE/2026/cold_start_rec/user_ada.description: [RecSys 2026][大语言模型推荐] 用 LLM 反事实数据增强 + 病历摘要指令微调 + 逐药自回归生成，缓解罕见药长尾失效，Group-1 Jaccard 最高 +30.2%。

venues/ICDE/2026/cold_start_rec/user_ada.title: Fine-grained List-wise Alignment for Generative Medication Recommendation
venues/ICDE/2026/cold_start_rec/user_ada.description: [NeurIPS 2025][LLM推荐] 将用药推荐重构为逐药序列决策，提出逐步GRPO与势函数奖励塑形实现细粒度信用分配，在MIMIC-III上Jaccard达0.4836并支持安全-精度可控权衡。

venues/ICDE/2026/cold_start_rec/user_ada.title: Personalized Multi-Interest Modeling for Cross-Domain Recommendation to Cold-Start Users
venues/ICDE/2026/cold_start_rec/user_ada.description: [ICDE 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用归一化流增强神经过程，将单峰高斯先验转为多峰分布以建模用户多兴趣，并引入偏好池捕获跨用户共同偏好，五场景 MAE 平均降约 45%。

venues/ICDE/2026/cold_start_rec/user_ada.title: Online Item Cold-Start Recommendation with Popularity-Aware Meta-Learning
venues/ICDE/2026/cold_start_rec/user_ada.description: [KDD 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 按流行度固定切分元学习任务并配冷启动增强器，流式在线场景下冷启动召回相对 SOTA 提升 11%–74%。

venues/ICDE/2026/cold_start_rec/user_ada.title: Harnessing Light for Cold-Start Recommendations: Leveraging Epistemic Uncertainty to Enhance Performance in User-Item Interactions
venues/ICDE/2026/cold_start_rec/user_ada.description: [CIKM 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 用集成 CVAE 生成暖化嵌入，并以 Sinkhorn 散度版 PaiDE 估计认知不确定性做优化，在冷启动 CTR 上稳定超越 CVAR 等基线。

venues/ICDE/2026/llm_rec/relevance_matte.title: SMART: LLM-Augmented Hybrid Retrieval for Dynamic Product Ads
venues/ICDE/2026/llm_rec/relevance_matte.description: [RecSys 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 揭示规则查询擅长 BM25 重定向、LLM 查询擅长 ANN 拓客的检索分解，用输出审计门控仅路由 10% 用户，线上转化率 +27.6%

venues/ICDE/2026/llm_rec/relevance_matte.title: Multi-objective Aligned Bidword Generation Model for E-commerce Search Advertising
venues/ICDE/2026/llm_rec/relevance_matte.description: [SIGIR 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用判别器提供相关性/真实性/CPM三维奖励，扩展MODPO做多目标偏好对齐，驱动LLM生成高商业价值竞价词，线上广告收入+2.13%。

venues/ICDE/2026/llm_rec/relevance_matte.title: AI Guided Accelerator For Search Experience
venues/ICDE/2026/llm_rec/relevance_matte.description: [SIGIR 2025][序列与会话推荐] 挖掘电商查询转移链并做意图一致性过滤，再用 Solar-10B 指令微调生成多样化替代收敛查询，线上 CTR +32.2%、转化 +38.3%。

venues/ICDE/2026/llm_rec/relevance_matte.title: SPEAR: Selection-aware Personalized End-to-end Adaptive Rewriting and Retrieval for Community Search
venues/ICDE/2026/llm_rec/relevance_matte.description: [RecSys 2026][大语言模型推荐] 以梯度隔离双嵌入+乘性门控+动态改写选择器统一查询改写与检索，离线点击召回@10提升99.5%，线上QVCTR+0.259%。

venues/ICDE/2026/llm_rec/relevance_matte.title: LLM-based User-Product Relevance Evaluation for Dynamic Product Advertising
venues/ICDE/2026/llm_rec/relevance_matte.description: [CIKM 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 用 SID 分组意图压缩 + 智能体指南蒸馏小模型，构建无查询的 DPA 召回离线相关性指标，与线上 CP/CR/CVR 强对齐。

venues/ICDE/2026/multimodal_rec/cammsr_c.title: PRISM: Personalized Recommendation via Information Synergy Module
venues/ICDE/2026/multimodal_rec/cammsr_c.description: [WWW 2026][多模态推荐] 用 MoE 显式分解模态唯一/冗余/协同信息并以用户偏好动态重加权，即插即用提升三类序列骨干，Yelp N@10 超最强基线 10.91%。

venues/ICDE/2026/multimodal_rec/cammsr_c.title: Harnessing Multimodal Large Language Models for Multimodal Sequential Recommendation
venues/ICDE/2026/multimodal_rec/cammsr_c.description: [AAAI 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 MLLM 将商品图转为文本摘要，再以循环式提示推断动态用户偏好，SFT 微调 LLaVA 做多模态序列推荐，AUC 最高提升约 4.3%。

venues/ICDE/2026/multimodal_rec/cammsr_c.title: Efficient Multimodal Streaming Recommendation via Expandable Side Mixture-of-Experts
venues/ICDE/2026/multimodal_rec/cammsr_c.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 冻结 BERT/ViT 主干，用可扩展侧调 MoE 增量吸收新时段知识并按利用率剪枝，在三个流式数据集上 HR@10 全面超越 SOTA 且显存/训练时间更省。

venues/ICDE/2026/multimodal_rec/cammsr_c.title: Distribution-Guided Auto-Encoder for User Multimodal Interest Cross Fusion
venues/ICDE/2026/multimodal_rec/cammsr_c.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 以行为粒度做模态内/模态间交叉融合，并用兴趣分布解码器作自监督约束，工业 A/B 上 CTR +12.9%。

venues/ICDE/2026/multimodal_rec/cammsr_c.title: Hierarchical Time-Aware Mixture of Experts for Multi-Modal Sequential Recommendation
venues/ICDE/2026/multimodal_rec/cammsr_c.description: [WWW 2025][多模态推荐] 用交互MoE过滤模态冗余、时序MoE注入显式时间戳，配合三项辅助任务，在四个Amazon数据集全库排序上NDCG@5最高提升20.9%。

venues/ICDE/2026/multimodal_rec/gala_gen.title: CAMMSR: Category-Guided Attentive Mixture of Experts for Multimodal Sequential Recommendation
venues/ICDE/2026/multimodal_rec/gala_gen.description: [ICDE 2026][多模态推荐] 用类别预测任务引导注意力 MoE 动态分配模态权重，并以模态交换对比学习对齐跨模态序列表征，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@5 最高提升 15.3%。

venues/ICDE/2026/multimodal_rec/gala_gen.title: Multimodal Quantitative Language for Generative Recommendation
venues/ICDE/2026/multimodal_rec/gala_gen.description: [ICLR 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用 RQ-VAE 将多域多模态物品翻译为统一量化语言，配合多任务预训练微调实现知识迁移，全库排序下 NDCG@10 最高提升 14.82%。

venues/ICDE/2026/multimodal_rec/gala_gen.title: Efficient and Effective Adaptation of Multimodal Foundation Models in Sequential Recommendation
venues/ICDE/2026/multimodal_rec/gala_gen.description: [TKDE 2025][多模态推荐] IISAN-Versa 用解耦 PEFT + 组 LayerDrop + 维度变换层，统一适配对称/非对称多模态基础模型，缓存隐藏态后 GPU 显存降 12–15 倍、训练提速 16–20 倍，MicroLens 达 SOTA。

venues/ICDE/2026/multimodal_rec/gala_gen.title: Multimodal Large Language Models with Adaptive Preference Optimization for Sequential Recommendation
venues/ICDE/2026/multimodal_rec/gala_gen.description: [SIGIR 2026][LLM4Rec] 面向 MLLM 序列推荐，用难度感知重加权 DPO + 高斯噪声正则分布优化，缓解样本难度失衡与跨模态语义偏差，三数据集 NDCG@3 提升 7.4%–11.0%。

venues/ICDE/2026/multimodal_rec/gala_gen.title: Well Begun is Half Done: Training-Free and Model-Agnostic Semantically Guaranteed User Representation Initialization for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/ICDE/2026/multimodal_rec/gala_gen.description: [SIGIR 2026][多模态推荐] 用交互物品模态特征+聚类全局语义免训练初始化用户表征，弥合用户-物品语义鸿沟，六模型四数据集Recall@5最高提升36.4%。

venues/ICDM/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: Enhancing Recommendation Explanations through User-Centric Refinement
venues/ICDM/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [ACL 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出 RefineX 多智能体推理期精炼框架，以 plan-then-refine 与分层反思将 PETER 解释在事实性/个性化/连贯性三维度大幅提升。

venues/ICDM/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: FLARE: Fusing Language Models and Collaborative Architectures for Recommender Enhancement
venues/ICDM/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [WWW 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用冻结 mT5+Perceiver 将文本注入 Bert4Rec，并以重调 Bert4Rec 基线、大词表评测与 Critiquing 任务重估 ID+文本增益。

venues/ICDM/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: Explainable CTR Prediction via LLM Reasoning
venues/ICDM/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [WSDM 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用 PPO 双奖励（LC 用户意图对齐 + IC 与 ID-CTR 模型对齐）把 LLM 解释生成嵌入 CTR 流程，免解释数据集，AUC 最高提升 18.2%。

venues/ICDM/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: Coherency Improved Explainable Recommendation via Large Language Model
venues/ICDM/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [AAAI 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 LLaMA2 先预测评分再以软评分嵌入引导解释生成，配合课程学习与无标注一致性自动评测，解释一致性提升 7.3%。

venues/ICDM/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: The Utility of LLMs in Recommender Systems Explanation Evaluation
venues/ICDM/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [RecSys 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 系统评测 14 个 LLM 作为推荐解释评审员与 216 名人类评分的一致性，发现排序相关中等但绝对评分一致性低，并给出四条实用准则。

venues/ICDM/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: ProPerSim: Developing Proactive and Personalized AI Assistants through User-Assistant Simulation
venues/ICDM/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [ICLR 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出 ProPerSim 仿真任务与 ProPerAssistant 基线，用 LLM 用户智能体+四维评分准则+DPO 偏好学习，让助手在时机与内容上同时个性化，14 天内平均满意度从 2.2 升至 3.3/4。

venues/ICDM/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: Simulating Before Planning: Constructing Intrinsic User World Model for User-Tailored Dialogue Policy Planning
venues/ICDM/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [SIGIR 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用扩散模型刻画用户画像、布朗桥预判用户反馈，构建内在用户世界模型以定制对话策略，P4G/ESConv 上 SR 显著提升。

venues/ICDM/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: Bootstrapping Conversational Recommendation Agents At Spotify: Synthetic Data Generation and Self-Improvement Loops
venues/ICDM/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [RecSys 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用多轮合成对话+方差归因自改进循环冷启动对话推荐智能体，线上A/B提升14%收听与5%周活。

venues/ICDM/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: RecoWorld: Building Simulated Environments for Agentic Recommender Systems
venues/ICDM/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [WWW 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出双视角LLM仿真环境，用户模拟器在多轮交互中发出反思指令，驱动指令遵循推荐器优化留存，并给出三种历史建模方案与多智能体群体仿真蓝图。

venues/ICDM/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: A Survey on LLM-powered Agents for Recommender Systems
venues/ICDM/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [ACL 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 系统综述 LLM Agent 推荐的三范式（推荐/交互/仿真）与四模块架构，梳理数据集与评测协议并指出统一评测缺失。

venues/ICDM/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: Search-Based Interaction For Conversation Recommendation via Generative Reward Model Based Simulated User
venues/ICDM/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [SIGIR 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用生成式奖励模型构建无标签模拟用户，通过属性评论与生成式打分驱动束搜索交互，INSPIRED 上 Recall@10 相对最优基线提升 83%。

venues/ICDM/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: Reason4Rec: Deliberative User Preference Alignment of Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/ICDM/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [TKDE 2026][大语言模型推荐] 提出审慎推荐任务与三专家多步推理框架，用评论监督偏好蒸馏-匹配-预测，评分预测与排序全面领先。

venues/ICDM/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: Review-driven Personalized Preference Reasoning with Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/ICDM/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用评论抽取偏好画像并蒸馏逐步推理，评分预测与重排双任务均超 CF 与 LLM 基线，解释性显著提升

venues/ICDM/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: STEP: Stepwise Curriculum Learning for Context-Knowledge Fusion in Conversational Recommendation
venues/ICDM/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [CIKM 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用三阶段课程学习驱动 F-Former 对齐对话与知识图谱，再以双前缀提示注入冻结 PLM，ReDial R@1 提升 15.7%。

venues/ICDM/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: RecQuest: Towards Estimating User Domain Knowledge in Conversational Recommender Systems
venues/ICDM/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [SIGIR 2026 (ICTIR)][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出游戏化数据采集协议 RecQuest 与知识估计新任务，用客观问卷替代自评建立 ground truth，并给出 LLM 零/少样本与微调基线。

venues/ICDM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: From IDs to Semantics: A Generative Framework for Cross-Domain Recommendation with Adaptive Semantic Tokenization
venues/ICDM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [AAAI 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 用领域自适应语义ID分词+对称动态路由的生成式跨域推荐框架，Leave-Last-Out全库排序下全面超越SOTA。

venues/ICDM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: ABXI: Invariant Interest Adaptation for Task-Guided Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation
venues/ICDM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [WWW 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用任务引导对齐消除预测错配，并以 dLoRA/iLoRA 双 LoRA 抽取域不变兴趣，三数据集 MRR 大幅超越 CDSR 基线。

venues/ICDM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: A Unified Framework for Adaptive Representation Enhancement and Inversed Learning in Cross-Domain Recommendation
venues/ICDM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [DASFAA 2024][跨域与多场景推荐] 解耦共享/专属表征，用 LightGCN 域内增强 + 自注意力跨域自适应融合 + GRL 逆向约束，全库排序下 Recall@20 最高提升 8.31%。

venues/ICDM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: FeDecider: An LLM-Based Framework for Federated Cross-Domain Recommendation

venues/ICDM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: LLM-EDT: Large Language Model Enhanced Cross-domain Sequential Recommendation with Dual-phase Training
venues/ICDM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [SIGIR 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 用可迁移物品增广+双阶段训练+域感知画像，缓解CDSR域不平衡与域迁移难题，全库排序下H@10最高提升26.96%

venues/ICDM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Counterfactual Inference under Thompson Sampling
venues/ICDM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [RecSys 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 推导 Thompson Sampling 下动作倾向性的精确可计算闭式解，使 IPS 类离线评估在 TS 策略下首次可行，OBP 仿真验证无偏收敛。

venues/ICDM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Can Large Language Models Identify Meaningful Touchpoints in Conversion Attribution?
venues/ICDM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [CIKM 2026][CTR预估与特征交叉] 构建SILVA触点选择基准，揭示隐式触点语义鸿沟，系统评测8个LLM的成对/列表提示能力，并以LLM归因标签增强工业CVR训练获+0.35pp GAUC。

venues/ICDM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: See Beyond a Single View: Multi-Attribution Learning Leads to Better Conversion Rate Prediction
venues/ICDM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [CIKM 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 将多归因标签作为辅助任务联合学习，用笛卡尔积辅助训练增强监督信号，离线GAUC+0.51%、线上ROI+2.6%

venues/ICDM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: MCLMR: A Model-Agnostic Causal Learning Framework for Multi-Behavior Recommendation
venues/ICDM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [WWW 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 用后门干预+MoE自适应聚合+偏差感知对比学习，作为即插即用框架增强多行为推荐，三数据集全库排序显著提升。

venues/ICDM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: GenCI: Generative Modeling of User Interest Shift via Cohort-based Intent Learning for CTR Prediction
venues/ICDM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [WWW 2026][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用RQ-VAE语义ID+NTP生成兴趣群组，再以分层候选感知注意力注入精排，弥合召回-排序意图鸿沟，三数据集AUC全面SOTA。

venues/ICDM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: ERASE -- A Real-World Aligned Benchmark for Unlearning in Recommender Systems

venues/ICDM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: LettinGo: Explore User Profile Generation for Recommendation System

venues/ICDM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Obliviate: Efficient Unlearning in Recommender Systems
venues/ICDM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [ICML 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 两阶段低秩适配器+局部校准的推荐系统机器遗忘框架，20%删除率下兼顾遗忘完整性与效用，比全量重训快约 3 倍。

venues/ICDM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: ClusterRAG: Cluster-Based Collaborative Filtering for Personalized Retrieval-Augmented Generation
venues/ICDM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [ACL 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用 HDBSCAN 将用户按画像嵌入聚类，簇内 ColBERTv2 排序选近邻，簇-文档两级检索融合协同画像做个性化 RAG，LaMP 全任务最优。

venues/ICDM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: TRACER: Token ReAssignment for Concept ERasure in Generative Recommendation
venues/ICDM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [NeurIPS 2026][生成式推荐] 首个面向生成式推荐的概念遗忘框架，用可微 token 重分配替代直接抑制共享 SID，在 Amazon 三域上遗忘 HR@5 较 PISCES 再降 20%+ 且保留 97% 效用。

venues/ICDM/2025/llm_rec/effectiveness_o.title: Do LLMs Memorize Recommendation Datasets? A Preliminary Study on MovieLens-1M
venues/ICDM/2025/llm_rec/effectiveness_o.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用少样本提示探测 GPT/Llama 对 MovieLens-1M 的物品、用户与交互记忆覆盖率，揭示记忆量与推荐性能强相关且放大流行度偏置。

venues/ICDM/2025/llm_rec/effectiveness_o.title: Lost in Sequence: Do Large Language Models Understand Sequential Recommendation?
venues/ICDM/2025/llm_rec/effectiveness_o.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 揭示现有 LLM4Rec 模型无法捕捉交互序列顺序信息，提出冻结 LLM 与 CF-SRec、仅训练轻量 MLP 的蒸馏框架 LLM-SRec，在 Amazon 四数据集上 NDCG@10 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/ICDM/2025/llm_rec/effectiveness_o.title: SPRINT: Scalable and Predictive Intent Refinement for LLM-Enhanced Session-based Recommendation
venues/ICDM/2025/llm_rec/effectiveness_o.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用全局意图池约束 LLM 生成、以预测-纠错回路校验意图，并蒸馏为轻量意图预测器，实现训练选择性调用 LLM、推理零 LLM 依赖的会话推荐。

venues/ICDM/2025/llm_rec/effectiveness_o.title: Reformulating Sequential Recommendation: Learning Dynamic User Interest with Content-enriched Language Modeling
venues/ICDM/2025/llm_rec/effectiveness_o.description: [DASFAA 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用知识提示+推理提示将序列推荐改写为文本生成任务，GPT-2 冻结主干下在三个数据集全排序协议上取得 Recall@5 相对提升约 5%–12%。

venues/ICDM/2025/llm_rec/effectiveness_o.title: Beyond Utility: Evaluating LLM as Recommender
venues/ICDM/2025/llm_rec/effectiveness_o.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出含历史长度敏感性、候选位置偏差、画像生成与幻觉四维的 LLM 推荐多维评测框架，揭示 LLM 在重排与冷启动占优但位置偏差严重。

venues/ICDM/2025/llm_rec/scaling_multimo.title: Multimodal Quantitative Language for Generative Recommendation
venues/ICDM/2025/llm_rec/scaling_multimo.description: [ICLR 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用 RQ-VAE 将多域多模态物品翻译为统一量化语言，配合多任务预训练微调实现知识迁移，全库排序下 NDCG@10 最高提升 14.82%。

venues/ICDM/2025/llm_rec/scaling_multimo.title: Muse: A Multimodal Conversational Recommendation Dataset with Scenario-Grounded User Profiles
venues/ICDM/2025/llm_rec/scaling_multimo.description: [ACL 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 首个多模态对话推荐数据集，用场景锚定用户画像的多智能体框架合成 7K 段图文对话，并验证三种 MLLM 的可学习性。

venues/ICDM/2025/llm_rec/scaling_multimo.title: Multimodal Large Language Models with Adaptive Preference Optimization for Sequential Recommendation
venues/ICDM/2025/llm_rec/scaling_multimo.description: [SIGIR 2026][LLM4Rec] 面向 MLLM 序列推荐，用难度感知重加权 DPO + 高斯噪声正则分布优化，缓解样本难度失衡与跨模态语义偏差，三数据集 NDCG@3 提升 7.4%–11.0%。

venues/ICDM/2025/llm_rec/scaling_multimo.title: NoteLLM-2: Multimodal Large Representation Models for Recommendation

venues/ICDM/2025/llm_rec/scaling_multimo.title: Beyond Static LLM Policies: Imitation-Enhanced Reinforcement Learning for Recommendation

venues/ICDM/2025/multimodal_rec/fuse_fai.title: IntentLens: Grounding Underspecified Multimodal Queries for Recommendation via Tool-Augmented Reasoning

venues/ICDM/2025/multimodal_rec/fuse_fai.title: CAMMSR: Category-Guided Attentive Mixture of Experts for Multimodal Sequential Recommendation

venues/ICDM/2025/multimodal_rec/fuse_fai.title: Muse: A Multimodal Conversational Recommendation Dataset with Scenario-Grounded User Profiles

venues/ICDM/2025/multimodal_rec/fuse_fai.title: Personalized Image Generation with Large Multimodal Models

venues/ICDM/2026/generative_rec/controll.description: [KDD 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 提出 RPG 用多 token 并行预测 + 图约束解码，将语义 ID 长度扩至 64，NDCG@10 平均超生成式基线 12.6% 且推理更省。

venues/ICDM/2026/generative_rec/controll.title: Empowering Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation with Hybrid Tokenization and Serial-Parallel Decoding
venues/ICDM/2026/generative_rec/controll.description: [RecSys 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义 ID] 跨域共享-专属多塔 RQ-VAE 混合分词 + 两段式串并解码，Leave-One-Out 全库排序下精度 +1.5%、时延 -85.1%。

venues/ICDM/2026/generative_rec/controll.title: GenRec: A Preference-Oriented Generative Framework for Large-Scale Recommendation
venues/ICDM/2026/generative_rec/controll.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 以 Page-wise NTP 解一对多歧义、线性 Token Merger 压缩 2× 输入、GRPO-SR 混合奖励对齐偏好，京东线上点击 +9.5%、成交 +8.7%。

venues/ICDM/2026/generative_rec/controll.title: Learning from Unreachable Rewards: Hint-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning for Generative Recommendation
venues/ICDM/2026/generative_rec/controll.description: [CIKM 2026][生成式推荐] 用 SFT 检查点诊断语义 ID 前缀树可达性，对不可达样本注入最短目标前缀提示并以提示感知信用分解（前缀 SFT + 后缀 GRPO）恢复学习信号，零优势组从 70%+ 降至 20% 以下。

venues/ICDM/2026/generative_rec/controll.title: RecGPT: A Foundation Model for Sequential Recommendation
venues/ICDM/2026/generative_rec/controll.description: [ACL/EMNLP 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 纯文本驱动+FSQ统一分词+混合双向因果注意力的序列推荐基础模型，零样本跨域显著超越10%数据微调的ID基线。

venues/ICDM/2026/generative_rec/hyprq_va.title: Diffusion Generative Recommendation with Continuous Tokens
venues/ICDM/2026/generative_rec/hyprq_va.description: [WWW 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用 σ-VAE 连续分词器替代量化码本，并以条件扩散+离散散度损失生成用户偏好，四数据集 Full-Ranking 上 HR@10 平均超 TIGER 11.76%。

venues/ICDM/2026/generative_rec/hyprq_va.title: Distinguished Quantized Guidance for Diffusion-based Sequence Recommendation
venues/ICDM/2026/generative_rec/hyprq_va.description: [WWW 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用语义码本量化序列增强扩散引导，并以对比差异最大化抑制流行度偏置生成，四数据集全库排序全面领先。

venues/ICDM/2026/generative_rec/hyprq_va.title: Understanding Generative Recommendation with Semantic IDs from a Model-scaling View
venues/ICDM/2026/generative_rec/hyprq_va.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐] 揭示 SID 式生成推荐在编码器/量化器/RS 三轴扩展均快速饱和，归因于 SID 语义容量瓶颈，并证明 Text-based GR 具备更优扩展性且 CF 能力随规模提升。

venues/ICDM/2026/generative_rec/hyprq_va.title: Reformulating Sequential Recommendation: Learning Dynamic User Interest with Content-enriched Language Modeling
venues/ICDM/2026/generative_rec/hyprq_va.description: [DASFAA 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用知识提示+推理提示将序列推荐改写为文本生成任务，GPT-2 冻结主干下在三个数据集全排序协议上取得 Recall@5 相对提升约 5%–12%。

venues/ICDM/2026/generative_rec/hyprq_va.title: Rethinking Item Tokenization in Generative Recommenders: From Fixed Atoms to Semantic Subwords
venues/ICDM/2026/generative_rec/hyprq_va.description: [CIKM 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 指出固定长度SID复用于历史侧引发“物品内注意力过载”，提出历史侧语义子词重分词(IST)+行为共现增强(BCA)的非对称分词，三数据集三骨干全库排序NDCG@10最高+13.8%。

venues/ICDM/2026/llm_rec/autoresearch_at.title: RecEvolve: A Knowledge-Driven Autonomous Agent System for Recommender Systems
venues/ICDM/2026/llm_rec/autoresearch_at.description: [RecSys 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 将双塔召回模型的架构搜索全生命周期交给多智能体闭环，41 次生产级训练换来 NDCG@50 相对 +19.9%、线上满意度 +3.77%，并意外暴露奖励黑客漏洞。

venues/ICDM/2026/llm_rec/autoresearch_at.title: Soft Curriculum Learning for Optimizing Fresh and Generalized Recommendations
venues/ICDM/2026/llm_rec/autoresearch_at.description: [RecSys 2026][冷启动与长尾推荐] 用损失退火与图内权重替代刚性数据过滤，在连续训练中打破流行度反馈环，线上冷启动互动 +5.70%、满意度 +0.54% 且吞吐无损。

venues/ICDM/2026/llm_rec/autoresearch_at.title: Self-Evolving Recommendation System: End-To-End Autonomous Model Optimization With LLM Agents
venues/ICDM/2026/llm_rec/autoresearch_at.description: [RecSys 2026][LLM4Rec] 用 Gemini 双智能体（快循环提名+慢循环上线）自动改写优化器/架构/奖励函数，在 YouTube 线上 A/B 取得显著北极星指标提升。

venues/ICDM/2026/llm_rec/autoresearch_at.title: Mosaic: A Fleet of User Embedding Specialists for Recommendation at Meta
venues/ICDM/2026/llm_rec/autoresearch_at.description: [RecSys 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 以四类异构专家模型族构建用户表征舰队，配合 MRM 与余弦冗余损失最大化增量信息，并提出免日志 CoEval 评估，离线 NE 稳定下降、线上 A/B 显著提升。

venues/ICDM/2026/llm_rec/autoresearch_at.title: Balancing Fine-tuning and RAG: A Hybrid Strategy for Dynamic LLM Recommendation Updates
venues/ICDM/2026/llm_rec/autoresearch_at.description: [RecSys 2025][LLM4Rec] 以十亿用户短视频兴趣探索系统为案例，量化对比微调与RAG的更新代价/敏捷性，提出月度微调+周内RAG刷新的混合更新策略，线上A/B显著提升满意度。

venues/ICDM/2026/llm_rec/empowering_comp.title: LLM2Rec: Large Language Models Are Powerful Embedding Models for Sequential Recommendation
venues/ICDM/2026/llm_rec/empowering_comp.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 两阶段将 LLM 改造为融合协同信号与语义的物品嵌入模型，Full-Ranking 下域内平均提升约 15%、跨域仍稳定增益。

venues/ICDM/2026/llm_rec/empowering_comp.title: Fusion and Alignment Enhancement with Large Language Models for Tail-item Sequential Recommendation
venues/ICDM/2026/llm_rec/empowering_comp.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用自适应门控融合 ID/LLM 嵌入并以双层对齐+课程学习消除空间结构冲突，全库排序下尾部长尾 H@10 最高提升 427%。

venues/ICDM/2026/llm_rec/empowering_comp.title: Can LLMs Outshine Conventional Recommenders? A Comparative Evaluation
venues/ICDM/2026/llm_rec/empowering_comp.description: [NeurIPS 2025 DB Track][大语言模型推荐] RecBench 系统对比 17 个 LLM 与 DLRM 在 4 种物品表征、CTR/SeqRec 双任务上的精度-效率权衡，LLM 精度领先但推理慢千倍。

venues/ICDM/2026/llm_rec/empowering_comp.title: Lost in Sequence: Do Large Language Models Understand Sequential Recommendation?
venues/ICDM/2026/llm_rec/empowering_comp.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 揭示现有 LLM4Rec 模型无法捕捉交互序列顺序信息，提出冻结 LLM 与 CF-SRec、仅训练轻量 MLP 的蒸馏框架 LLM-SRec，在 Amazon 四数据集上 NDCG@10 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/ICDM/2026/llm_rec/empowering_comp.title: EAGER-LLM: Enhancing Large Language Models as Recommenders through Exogenous Behavior-Semantic Integration
venues/ICDM/2026/llm_rec/empowering_comp.description: [WWW 2025][大语言模型推荐] 以双源知识富集物品索引+非侵入多尺度对齐重建+退火适配器，将外源行为/语义信号注入 LLM 生成式推荐，Amazon 三数据集 Full-Ranking 下 Recall@10 最高提升 26.16%。

venues/ICDM/2026/llm_rec/memory_has_geom.title: Large Memory Network for Recommendation
venues/ICDM/2026/llm_rec/memory_has_geom.description: [WWW 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用百万级全局共享记忆块压缩用户历史行为，以乘积量化双轴激活实现 O(√n d) 检索，抖音电商搜索 AUC +4.68%、订单/人 +0.87%。

venues/ICDM/2026/llm_rec/memory_has_geom.title: MemRec: Collaborative Memory-Augmented Agentic Recommender System
venues/ICDM/2026/llm_rec/memory_has_geom.description: [ACL 2026][LLM推荐] 将记忆管理从推理中架构解耦，用轻量 LM_Mem 在协同记忆图上做零样本规则剪枝与异步传播，仅向重型 LLM_Rec 注入蒸馏后的高信号协同上下文，四基准全库排序 H@1 最高 +28.98%。

venues/ICDM/2026/llm_rec/memory_has_geom.title: Closing the Long-Short View Gap in Sequential Recommendation without Cached History
venues/ICDM/2026/llm_rec/memory_has_geom.description: [CIKM 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用角度相似度打分+softmax1 修正长视训练几何缺陷，再仅微调 Bias/LayerNorm 实现无缓存短视推理，短窗下反超全序列基线。

venues/ICDM/2026/llm_rec/memory_has_geom.title: RoTE: Coarse-to-Fine Multi-Level Rotary Time Embedding for Sequential Recommendation
venues/ICDM/2026/llm_rec/memory_has_geom.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 将时间戳分解为年/月/日多粒度并借 RoPE 旋转注入 Q/K，即插即用提升 SASRec/RPG，NDCG@5 最高 +20.11%

venues/ICDM/2026/llm_rec/memory_has_geom.title: From Recall to Forgetting: Benchmarking Long-Term Memory for Personalized Agents
venues/ICDM/2026/llm_rec/memory_has_geom.description: [ACL 2026 Findings][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出 Memora 长周期记忆基准与 FAMA 遗忘感知指标，揭示 LLM 与记忆智能体在记忆突变下频繁复用失效记忆。

venues/ICDM/2026/sequential_rec/hierarch.title: FlowTime: Towards Continuous Generative Watch Time Prediction via Flow-based Personalized Priors
venues/ICDM/2026/sequential_rec/hierarch.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 提出连续生成式回归新范式，用一步VAE+归一化流个性化先验建模多峰观看时长分布，KuaiRec MAE降0.676%、线上播放时长+1.044%。

venues/ICDM/2026/sequential_rec/hierarch.title: Multi-modal Adaptive Mixture of Experts for Cold-start Recommendation
venues/ICDM/2026/sequential_rec/hierarch.description: [CIKM 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 用双层 MoE（模态专属专家+动态门控融合）替代拼接/平均融合，在 Amazon 三域冷启动全库排序上 Recall@10 最高提升 16.17%。

venues/ICDM/2026/sequential_rec/hierarch.title: SWaT: Statistical Modeling of Video Watch Time through User Behavior Analysis
venues/ICDM/2026/sequential_rec/hierarch.description: [KDD 2025][CTR/CVR 预估与特征交叉] 将用户观看行为假设翻译为分桶二项/几何分布白盒统计模型，以软标签 BCE 训练，离线与线上 A/B 均稳定超越 WLR/TPM/CREAD。

venues/ICDM/2026/sequential_rec/hierarch.title: Efficient Multimodal Streaming Recommendation via Expandable Side Mixture-of-Experts
venues/ICDM/2026/sequential_rec/hierarch.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 冻结 BERT/ViT 主干，用可扩展侧调 MoE 增量吸收新时段知识并按利用率剪枝，在三个流式数据集上 HR@10 全面超越 SOTA 且显存/训练时间更省。

venues/ICDM/2026/sequential_rec/hierarch.title: Personalized Diffusion Model Reshapes Cold-Start Bundle Recommendation
venues/ICDM/2026/sequential_rec/hierarch.description: [WWW 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 用个性化条件扩散在分布空间生成捆绑包，配合解耦自注意力与KL正则，冷启动捆绑推荐全库排序Recall@20最高提升1155%。

venues/ICDM/2026/sequential_rec/revisiti.title: Unleashing the Potential of Sparse Attention on Long-term Behaviors for CTR Prediction
venues/ICDM/2026/sequential_rec/revisiti.description: [WWW 2026][CTR预估与特征交叉] 面向长行为序列 CTR 的个性化时间分块 + 三分支稀疏注意力 SparseCTR，AUC 相对提升 8.49%，线上 CTR +1.72%。

venues/ICDM/2026/sequential_rec/revisiti.title: Lost in Sequence: Do Large Language Models Understand Sequential Recommendation?

venues/ICDM/2026/sequential_rec/revisiti.title: Rethinking Item Tokenization in Generative Recommenders: From Fixed Atoms to Semantic Subwords
venues/ICDM/2026/sequential_rec/revisiti.description: [CIKM 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 指出固定长度SID复用于历史侧引发“物品内注意力过载”，提出历史侧语义子词重分词(IST)+行为共现增强(BCA)的非对称分词，三数据集三骨干全库排序NDCG@10最高+13.8%。

venues/ICDM/2026/sequential_rec/revisiti.title: MoRE: A Mixture of Reflectors Framework for Large Language Model-Based Sequential Recommendation
venues/ICDM/2026/sequential_rec/revisiti.description: [RecSys 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用显式/隐式/协同三视角离线反思 + 元反思器自改进与 Contextual Bandit 在线选视角，LLM 序列推荐全库候选下 NDCG@10 最高提升 10.1%。

venues/ICDM/2026/sequential_rec/revisiti.title: Residual Dominance as a Structural Account of Last-Item Reliance in Causal Self-Attention Recommenders
venues/ICDM/2026/sequential_rec/revisiti.description: [RecSys 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用范数分解揭示残差连接主导同位置信息保留，并以推理期残差缩放诊断因果自注意力推荐器的末项依赖机制。

venues/ICDM/2026/sequential_rec/user_rep.title: HORIZON: A Benchmark for In-the-wild User Behaviour Modeling
venues/ICDM/2026/sequential_rec/user_rep.description: [ACL 2026 Findings][跨域与多场景推荐] 重构 Amazon Reviews 为 54M 用户跨域长程基准，提出时间-用户双轴四象限评估与 LLM 查询改写/长程建模任务，揭示 ID 模型在时间外推下崩塌。

venues/ICDM/2026/sequential_rec/user_rep.title: Towards Generalizable and Efficient Large-Scale Generative Recommenders
venues/ICDM/2026/sequential_rec/user_rep.description: [RecSys 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 将生成式推荐骨干从2M扩至1B，用偏移幂律缩放律诊断任务天花板，并以MTP、采样softmax与语义塔解决缓存陈旧与冷启动，1M用户影子MRR全线提升。

venues/ICDM/2026/sequential_rec/user_rep.title: SPRINT: Scalable and Predictive Intent Refinement for LLM-Enhanced Session-based Recommendation
venues/ICDM/2026/sequential_rec/user_rep.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用全局意图池约束 LLM 生成、以预测-纠错回路校验意图，并蒸馏为轻量意图预测器，实现训练选择性调用 LLM、推理零 LLM 依赖的会话推荐。

venues/ICDM/2026/sequential_rec/user_rep.title: PANTHER: Generative Pretraining Beyond Language for Sequential User Behavior Modeling
venues/ICDM/2026/sequential_rec/user_rep.description: [NeurIPS 2025][序列与会话推荐] 将支付交易视为行为 token 做生成式预训练，SPRM 卷积+原型交叉注意力捕捉周期模式，用户画像对比学习，微信支付线上欺诈召回 +38.6%。

venues/ICDM/2026/sequential_rec/user_rep.title: Learning Universal User Representations Leveraging Cross-domain User Intent at Snapchat

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/agent_conv.title: A Survey on LLM-powered Agents for Recommender Systems

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/agent_conv.title: Personalized Recommendation Tool Learning via Autonomous Language Agents
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/agent_conv.description: [RecSys 2026][LLM4Rec] 让 LLM 智能体做个性化工具选择、传统推荐模型做全库打分，以架构设计绕开幻觉与上下文长度限制，Full-Ranking 下 R@10 最高提升 68.8%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/agent_conv.title: RecoWorld: Building Simulated Environments for Agentic Recommender Systems
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/agent_conv.description: [WWW 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出双视角LLM仿真环境，用户模拟器在多轮交互中发出反思指令，驱动指令遵循推荐器优化留存，并给出三种历史建模方案与多智能体群体仿真蓝图。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/agent_conv.title: Recommender AI Agent: Integrating Large Language Models for Interactive Recommendations
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/agent_conv.description: [TOIS 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 以 LLM 为大脑、传统推荐模型为工具，配合候选总线、长短期画像、计划优先执行与反思机制，在 Steam/MovieLens/Beauty 上显著超越 GPT-4 与 Chat-Rec。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/agent_conv.title: Agentic Feedback Loop Modeling Improves Recommendation and User Simulation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/agent_conv.description: [SIGIR 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用记忆驱动的推荐智能体-用户智能体多轮反馈闭环，同时提升下一物品推荐与用户行为模拟，并验证不放大流行度/位置偏差。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/agent_conv.title: ProPerSim: Developing Proactive and Personalized AI Assistants through User-Assistant Simulation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/agent_conv.description: [ICLR 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出 ProPerSim 仿真任务与 ProPerAssistant 基线，用 LLM 用户智能体+四维评分准则+DPO 偏好学习，让助手在时机与内容上同时个性化，14 天内平均满意度从 2.2 升至 3.3/4。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/agent_conv.title: Ask to Be Sure: Informative Interactions for Confident Multi-Turn LLM Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/agent_conv.description: [CIKM 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 以推荐列表采样熵的下降量作为信息增益奖励，免真值微调 LLM 多轮对话策略，INSPIRED/ReDial 上 Hit 与对话效率双升。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/agent_conv.title: Simulating Before Planning: Constructing Intrinsic User World Model for User-Tailored Dialogue Policy Planning

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/generative.description: [IJCAI 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 将生成式检索重构为“起草-验证”双阶段单模型范式，以混合稀疏-稠密表征与复合损失统一召回与排序，工业搜索延迟降至70ms。
