venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/fa.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 两阶段将 LLM 改造为融合协同信号与语义的物品嵌入模型，Full-Ranking 下域内平均提升约 15%、跨域仍稳定增益。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/fa.title: Pre-train, Align, and Disentangle: Empowering Sequential Recommendation with Large Language Models
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/fa.description: [SIGIR 2025][LLM推荐] 用 MK-MMD 特征核做推荐锚定对齐，再以三专家频率门控解耦，Full-Ranking 下冷物品 HR@10 提升最高 462%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/fi.title: Improving Rare Medication Recommendation with Counterfactual Data Augmentation and Large Language Models
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/fi.description: [RecSys 2026][大语言模型推荐] 用 LLM 反事实数据增强 + 病历摘要指令微调 + 逐药自回归生成，缓解罕见药长尾失效，Group-1 Jaccard 最高 +30.2%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/fi.title: User-Adaptive Meta-Learning for Cold-Start Medication Recommendation with Uncertainty Filtering
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/fi.description: [ICDE 2026][冷启动与长尾推荐] 提出两级元自适应（自自适应+同伴自适应）与不确定性过滤的 MetaDrug，在 MIMIC-III/AKI 冷启动患者上 PRAUC 提升约 2.5%-6.2%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/fi.title: Beyond Static Best-of-N: Bayesian List-wise Alignment for LLM-based Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/fi.description: [SIGIR 2026][LLM4Rec] 用贝叶斯后验融合静态先验与在线 rollout 证据，构建自演化 BoN 目标，突破静态对齐的性能上界，NDCG@5 相对提升 23.1%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/fi.title: Token-level Collaborative Alignment for LLM-based Generative Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/fi.description: [WWW 2026][LLM4Rec] 将CF物品级logits投影为token级分布并与one-hot融合成软标签，以soft-NTP损失显式对齐LLM生成，即插即用提升多骨干推荐效果。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/fi.title: Generative Data Transformation: From Mixed to Unified Data
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/fi.description: [WWW 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 提出数据侧范式 Taesar，用三模型对比解码把跨域混合序列重生成纯目标域序列，免改架构即插即用，Books HR@10 提升 29.4%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/im.title: TokenRec: Learning to Tokenize ID for LLM-based Generative Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/im.description: [TKDE 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用掩码K路向量量化把GNN协同表征压成LLM兼容离散token，并以生成式检索替代自回归解码，HR@20平均提升约19%、推理加速超10倍。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/im.title: The Mental World of Large Language Models in Recommendation: A Benchmark on Association, Personalization, and Knowledgeability
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/im.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出 LRWorld 基准（38K 样本/23M tokens），从关联、个性化、知识性三尺度十因素 31 任务系统评测数十个 LLM，揭示其在神经嵌入检索上的致命短板。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/im.title: Tokenize Once, Recommend Anywhere: Unified Item Tokenization for Multi-domain LLM-based Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/im.description: [AAAI 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 提出 TokenMoE+码本+互信息校准的统一物品分词框架 UniTok，单模型跨 10 域训练，NDCG@10 最高提升 51.89%，参数量降 9.63×。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/im.title: Do LLMs Memorize Recommendation Datasets? A Preliminary Study on MovieLens-1M
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/im.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用少样本提示探测 GPT/Llama 对 MovieLens-1M 的物品、用户与交互记忆覆盖率，揭示记忆量与推荐性能强相关且放大流行度偏置。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/im.title: Can LLMs Outshine Conventional Recommenders? A Comparative Evaluation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/im.description: [NeurIPS 2025 DB Track][大语言模型推荐] RecBench 系统对比 17 个 LLM 与 DLRM 在 4 种物品表征、CTR/SeqRec 双任务上的精度-效率权衡，LLM 精度领先但推理慢千倍。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/la.title: LLM2Rec: Large Language Models Are Powerful Embedding Models for Sequential Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/la.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 两阶段将 LLM 改造为融合协同信号与语义的物品嵌入模型，Full-Ranking 下域内平均提升约 15%、跨域仍稳定增益。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/la.title: L2Rec: Towards Dual-View Understanding of LLMs for Personalized Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/la.description: [SIGIR 2026][大语言模型推荐] 以参数级双视图 LoRA-MoE 替代输入/输出级融合，个性化路由对齐行为与语义视图，四数据集 N@10 提升 3.87%–8.02%，线上 CTR +9.24%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/la.title: Enhancing Collaborative Semantics of Language Model-Driven Recommendations via Graph-Aware Learning
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/la.description: [TKDE 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用多跳提示+图感知对比学习把 GNN 聚合意图注入 LLM，在三个 Amazon/Yelp 数据集 Full-Ranking 下 HR@10 最高提升约 15%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/la.title: RecLM: Recommendation Instruction Tuning
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/la.description: [ACL 2025][大语言模型推荐] 以两轮协同指令微调+RL画像精炼为LLM注入协同信号，作为即插即用画像增强器在零样本冷启动下带来最高 200%+ 的 Recall 提升。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/la.title: Exploring the Upper Limits of Text-Based Collaborative Filtering Using Large Language Models: Discoveries and Insights
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/la.description: [CIKM 2025][LLM4Rec] 将 TCF 物品编码器从 125M 一路放大到 175B，系统检验缩放极限、通用表征、对 IDCF 的竞争力与零样本迁移四项命题。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/r_.title: Think before Recommendation: Autonomous Reasoning-enhanced Recommender
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/r_.description: [NeurIPS 2025][LLM4Rec] 用纯 GRPO 强化学习替代教师蒸馏，让单个 LLM 自主习得「用户分析→物品分析→匹配→打分」推理链，评分预测 MAE 最高降 29.9%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/r_.title: ReRec: Reasoning-Augmented LLM-based Recommendation Assistant via Reinforcement Fine-tuning
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/r_.description: [ACL 2026][大语言模型推荐] 用双图奖励塑形、推理感知优势估计与在线课程调度改造 RFT，使 3B LLM 在复杂查询推荐上大幅超越 GRPO 系基线并保留通用能力。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/r_.title: RecRec: Latent Interests Recursive Reasoning for Sequential Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/r_.description: [RecSys 2026][序列与会话推荐] 解耦推理态与预测态、以 R 个潜在兴趣做递归推理的免 RL 序列推荐框架，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@10 最高提升 14.8%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/r_.title: LLM Reasoning for Cold-Start Item Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/r_.description: [WWW 2026][冷启动与长尾推荐] 在 Netflix 冷启动重排任务上系统对比结构化推理、软自洽与 SFT/GRPO 混合微调，推理微调模型在 Discovery 指标上超越线上生产排序模型最高 8%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/r_.title: AgentDR: Dynamic Recommendation with Implicit Item-Item Relations via LLM-based Agents
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/r_.description: [WWW 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 将全库排序委托给传统推荐工具，用 LLM Agent 做个性化工具加权与替代/互补关系重排，全排序平均提升约两倍。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/sl.title: Lost in Sequence: Do Large Language Models Understand Sequential Recommendation?
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/sl.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 揭示现有 LLM4Rec 模型无法捕捉交互序列顺序信息，提出冻结 LLM 与 CF-SRec、仅训练轻量 MLP 的蒸馏框架 LLM-SRec，在 Amazon 四数据集上 NDCG@10 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/sl.title: Do LLMs Memorize Recommendation Datasets? A Preliminary Study on MovieLens-1M
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/sl.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用少样本提示探测 GPT/Llama 对 MovieLens-1M 的物品、用户与交互记忆覆盖率，揭示记忆量与推荐性能强相关且放大流行度偏置。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/sl.title: DELRec: Distilling Sequential Pattern to Enhance LLMs-based Sequential Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/sl.description: [ICDE 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用软提示两阶段蒸馏传统序列模型的时间感知与推荐模式，再微调 LLM 做序列推荐，四数据集 HR/NDCG 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/sl.title: Large Language Model Simulator for Cold-Start Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/sl.description: [WSDM 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 用 LLM 模拟冷物品的用户交互行为，并以耦合漏斗（FAISS 过滤 + LLM 精炼）把十亿级候选压到数百，离线冷召回 NDCG 提升 37%+，线上冷启 GMV +16.9%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/sl.title: A Contextual-Aware Position Encoding for Sequential Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/sl.description: [WWW 2025][序列与会话推荐] 首个为序列推荐定制的上下文感知位置编码 CAPE：用目标-上下文不相似度累加动态分配位置，配合门控融合异构特征，在 5 个骨干与工业 A/B 上稳定涨点。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/th.title: R$^2$ec: Towards Large Recommender Models with Reasoning
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/th.description: [NeurIPS 2025][LLM4Rec] 双头架构统一推理生成与物品打分，RecPO 融合奖励 RL 联合优化，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@10 最高提升 72%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/th.title: Review-driven Personalized Preference Reasoning with Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/th.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用评论抽取偏好画像并蒸馏逐步推理，评分预测与重排双任务均超 CF 与 LLM 基线，解释性显著提升

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/th.title: ReRec: Reasoning-Augmented LLM-based Recommendation Assistant via Reinforcement Fine-tuning
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/th.description: [ACL 2026][大语言模型推荐] 用双图奖励塑形、推理感知优势估计与在线课程调度改造 RFT，使 3B LLM 在复杂查询推荐上大幅超越 GRPO 系基线并保留通用能力。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/th.title: RecRec: Latent Interests Recursive Reasoning for Sequential Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/th.description: [RecSys 2026][序列与会话推荐] 解耦推理态与预测态、以 R 个潜在兴趣做递归推理的免 RL 序列推荐框架，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@10 最高提升 14.8%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/th.title: SelfDR: Self-Distillation from Reasoning for LLM-Based Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/th.description: [CIKM 2026][大语言模型推荐] 用下游推荐奖励训练同源 Reasoner 生成理由，构建推理增强教师，再自蒸馏出免推理的直接推荐学生，重排 HR@1 提升约 15%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/tr.title: DLCRec: A Novel Approach for Managing Diversity in LLM-Based Recommender Systems
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/tr.description: [WSDM 2025][大语言模型推荐] 将多样性可控推荐拆解为类型预测/填充/物品预测三子任务级联，配合两类数据增广，在 Movie/Steam 上 MAE_Cov@10 大幅领先。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/tr.title: Bridging Semantic Understanding and Popularity Bias with LLMs
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/tr.description: [WWW 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 将流行度偏差拆解为物品侧与用户侧语义，用结构化指令提示引导 RecLLM 双侧去偏，在 LtC/MRMC 与 MRR/F1 上同时超越多样性提示基线。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/tr.title: User Feedback Alignment for LLM-powered Exploration in Large-scale Recommendation Systems
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/tr.description: [ACL 2025 Industry][LLM4Rec] 解耦新颖性与用户对齐双 LLM，用集体隐式反馈训练对齐模型做 best-of-n 选择，线上同时提升新颖曝光与满意度。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/tr.title: How to Diversify any Personalized Recommender?
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/tr.description: [ECIR 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 提出用户画像级预处理：用逻辑回归识别用户代表类别、userKNN 生成候选，再按 λ% 增删交互，使任意推荐器在保持精度的同时提升多样性与少数类曝光公平。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/tr.title: Augmenting Sequential Recommendation with Balanced Relevance and Diversity
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/llm_rec/tr.description: [AAAI 2025][序列与会话推荐] 提出即插即用平衡增强插件 BASRec，以单序列随机算子+表征级 mixup 与跨序列非线性 mixup 兼顾相关性与多样性，全库排序下 SASRec 平均提升 33.8%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/multimodal.title: Spectrum-based Modality Representation Fusion Graph Convolutional Network for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/multimodal.description: [WSDM 2025][多模态推荐] 将多模态特征投影至频域做滤波去噪与点积融合，配合模态专属/融合双图学习与模态感知偏好模块，在 Amazon 三数据集全库排序下 Recall@20 相对最优基线提升约 5%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/multimodal.title: COHESION: Composite Graph Convolutional Network with Dual-Stage Fusion for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/multimodal.description: [SIGIR 2025][多模态推荐] 用行为模态早期精炼+晚期注意力融合的双阶段融合，配合异质/同质复合图与自适应BPR，在三个 Amazon 数据集上 R@20 相对提升 4.4%–6.1%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/multimodal.title: TimeMM: Time-as-Operator Spectral Filtering for Dynamic Multimodal Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/multimodal.description: [SIGIR 2026][多模态推荐] 将交互新近度映射为时间核加权图算子族，隐式实现免特征分解的多尺度谱滤波，配合自适应算子混合与模态路由，全库排序下 R@20 相对提升 3%–10%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/multimodal.title: Hypercomplex Prompt-aware Multimodal Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/multimodal.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 用 Cayley-Dickson 超复数多分量嵌入 + 超复数乘法非线性融合 + Prompt 动态补偿，在四个 Amazon 数据集 Full-Ranking 下 Recall@20 最高提升约 13%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/multimodal.title: MLLMRec: A Preference Reasoning Paradigm with Graph Refinement for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/multimodal.description: [SIGIR 2026][多模态推荐] 用 MLLM 推理用户偏好画像替代噪声聚合初始化，并以阈值去噪+共现增强精修物品图，三数据集 11/12 指标 SOTA。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/multimodal.title: Impression-Aware Recommender Systems
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/multimodal.description: [TORS 2025][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 首篇曝光感知推荐系统(IARS)系统性综述，提出统一理论框架与三维分类体系，厘清模型、数据集与评估协议。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/multimodal.title: Formalizing Multimedia Recommendation through Multimodal Deep Learning
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/multimodal.description: [TORS 2025][多模态推荐] 首次将多媒体推荐对齐多模态深度学习五步流水线，提出 Which/How/When 三问形式化 Schema，并在 Elliot 上统一复现 10 个模型、兼顾精度与超越精度指标。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/multimodal.title: Do We Really Need Specialization? Evaluating Generalist Text Embeddings for Zero-Shot Recommendation and Search
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/multimodal.description: [RecSys 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 实证通用文本嵌入(GTE)零样本即超越领域微调模型，并以PCA有效维度揭示空间利用率与压缩收益。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/multimodal.title: Point of Interest Recommendation: Pitfalls and Viable Solutions
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/multimodal.description: [TORS 2026][时空轨迹与POI推荐] 系统梳理POI推荐在数据集、算法与评估三维度的20项陷阱，并提出六方向研究议程与陷阱-方案映射表

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/multimodal.title: CPGRec+: A Balance-oriented Framework for Personalized Video Game Recommendations
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/multimodal.description: [TOIS 2026][图神经网络推荐] 以 Fisher 分布符号边重加权缓解过平滑、LLM 生成偏好描述精炼表征，在 Steam 双数据集上兼顾精度与多样性。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/poi_spatio.title: TripTailor: A Real-World Benchmark for Personalized Travel Planning
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/poi_spatio.description: [ACL 2025 Findings][时空轨迹与POI本地生活推荐] 构建50万真实POI与近4000条真人行程的个性化旅行规划基准，提出可行性/合理性/个性化三维评估与奖励模型对比框架，揭示SOTA LLM行程超越真人比例不足10%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/poi_spatio.title: Generative Next POI Recommendation with Semantic ID
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/poi_spatio.description: [KDD 2025][时空轨迹与POI推荐] 用RQ-VAE将POI多源语义量化为层级语义ID并微调LLaMA3-8B生成下一POI，Acc@1最高提升16%，token开销降55%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/poi_spatio.title: SynthTRIPs: A Knowledge-Grounded Framework for Benchmark Query Generation for Personalized Tourism Recommenders
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/poi_spatio.description: [SIGIR 2025][LLM4Rec] 用 PersonaHub 人格 + 可持续性过滤器 + KB 接地，让 LLM 批量合成个性化城市游查询，4,604 条查询经 J-LLM 与双专家双轨验证。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/poi_spatio.title: SEP-GCN: Leveraging Similar Edge Pairs with Temporal and Spatial Contexts for Location-Based Recommender Systems
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/poi_spatio.description: [SIGIR-ICTIR 2025][时空轨迹与POI推荐] 以时空相似交互边对构建边级相似图并注入LightGCN传播，在NYC/Gowalla/Brightkite全库排序上Recall@20最高提升14.89%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/poi_spatio.title: Iterative Semantic Reasoning from Individual to Group Interests for Generative Recommendation with LLMs
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/poi_spatio.description: [WWW 2026][LLM4Rec] 用 LLM 双向 CoT 推理物品/用户语义，构建个体显式兴趣图与相似用户群隐式兴趣图，并以对比蒸馏迭代对齐，直接推荐 H@10 最高提升 24.57%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/rl_bandit_.title: Expert-Guided Diffusion Planner for Auto-bidding
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/rl_bandit_.description: [CIKM 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用专家轨迹引导条件扩散规划器生成出价序列，配合混合强制训练与跳步采样，线上转化+11.29%、收入+12.36%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/rl_bandit_.title: AHBid: An Adaptable Hierarchical Bidding Framework for Cross-Channel Advertising
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/rl_bandit_.description: [WWW 2026][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用扩散模型生成跨渠道预算/约束目标轨迹、结合约束执行与实时控制出价，离线与线上 A/B 收益提升 13.57%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/rl_bandit_.title: Contextual Generative Auction with Permutation-level Externalities for Online Advertising
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/rl_bandit_.description: [KDD 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用自回归生成器直接生成广告位序列并建模排列级外部性，配合可微事后遗憾学习支付规则，淘宝线上 RPM +3.2%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/rl_bandit_.title: HOBA: Hierarchical On-Policy Bidding Agents for Adaptive Online Advertising
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/rl_bandit_.description: [KDD 2026][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 三层时间尺度解耦出价：LLM 小时级推理超参、SARSA 分钟级因果去偏选专家、专家池逐次拍卖执行，AuctionNet 与线上 A/B 双验证。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/rl_bandit_.title: Lightweight Auto-bidding based on Traffic Prediction in Live Advertising
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/rl_bandit_.description: [KDD 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 直播广告场景下，用LightGBM预测全时段累计成本/点击，结合LP对偶最优出价公式与投影梯度下降求解对偶变量，实现秒级轻量自动出价，线上GMV+4.28%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/rl_bandit_.title: What Makes LLMs Effective Sequential Recommenders? A Study on Preference Intensity and Temporal Context
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/rl_bandit_.description: [ACL 2026][大语言模型推荐] 揭示二元偏好对齐丢失偏好强度与时序上下文，提出自适应奖励边际 RecPO，五数据集 HR@1 全面领先 S-DPO。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/rl_bandit_.title: Long-term User Engagement Optimization through Model-agnostic Downstream Rewards Learning
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/rl_bandit_.description: [RecSys 2026][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 以 P2P 兔子洞深度、浅层关闭负奖励与新用例采纳三类下游奖励替代稀疏留存标签，在 Pinterest 多场景线上 A/B 中稳定提升会话与留存指标。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/rl_bandit_.title: Beyond the Flat Sequence: Hierarchical and Preference-Aware Generative Recommendations
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/rl_bandit_.description: [WWW 2026][生成式推荐] 用会话层次预训练+偏好引导稀疏注意力打破 HSTU 扁平序列假设，APPGallery 全库 AUC 0.8929、线上 eCPM +1.99%

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/rl_bandit_.title: Preference Diffusion for Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/rl_bandit_.description: [ICLR 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 将 BPR 改写为对数似然排序目标并推导变分上界，为扩散推荐器注入多负样本偏好信号，Full-Ranking 下 R@5 最高提升 19.35%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/rl_bandit_.title: Tail-Aware Data Augmentation for Long-Tail Sequential Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/rl_bandit_.description: [WWW 2026][冷启动与长尾推荐] 用线性物品相似度构建候选集，设计 T-Substitute/T-Insert 两个尾部感知算子并在表征层 Mixup，实现头部与尾部双赢的长尾序列推荐数据增强。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/rl_bandit_.title: ReRec: Reasoning-Augmented LLM-based Recommendation Assistant via Reinforcement Fine-tuning
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/rl_bandit_.description: [ACL 2026][大语言模型推荐] 用双图奖励塑形、推理感知优势估计与在线课程调度改造 RFT，使 3B LLM 在复杂查询推荐上大幅超越 GRPO 系基线并保留通用能力。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/rl_bandit_.title: NR4DER: Neural Re-ranking for Diversified Exercise Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/rl_bandit_.description: [SIGIR 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用 mLSTM 难度过滤 + 活跃学生序列增强 + 神经重排，兼顾长尾学生与个性化学习节奏的习题推荐。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/rl_bandit_.title: Think before Recommendation: Autonomous Reasoning-enhanced Recommender
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/rl_bandit_.description: [NeurIPS 2025][LLM4Rec] 用纯 GRPO 强化学习替代教师蒸馏，让单个 LLM 自主习得「用户分析→物品分析→匹配→打分」推理链，评分预测 MAE 最高降 29.9%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/rl_bandit_.title: Large Language Model driven Policy Exploration for Recommender Systems
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/rl_bandit_.description: [WSDM 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用 LLM 蒸馏用户偏好离线预训练 A2C 推荐策略，并提出冻结+可学习双策略自适应在线适配，显著提升冷启动回报与长期收益。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/rl_bandit_.title: SelfDR: Self-Distillation from Reasoning for LLM-Based Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/rl_bandit_.description: [CIKM 2026][大语言模型推荐] 用下游推荐奖励训练同源 Reasoner 生成理由，构建推理增强教师，再自蒸馏出免推理的直接推荐学生，重排 HR@1 提升约 15%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.title: LLM2Rec: Large Language Models Are Powerful Embedding Models for Sequential Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 两阶段将 LLM 改造为融合协同信号与语义的物品嵌入模型，Full-Ranking 下域内平均提升约 15%、跨域仍稳定增益。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.title: BlossomRec: Block-level Fused Sparse Attention Mechanism for Sequential Recommendations
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.description: [WWW 2026][序列与会话推荐] 双路块级稀疏注意力（LTIS 块选择 + STIS 幂律掩码）经门控融合，长序列训练提速 3.2×、显存降至 1/11，精度持平或超越 SASRec。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.title: Unleashing the Potential of Sparse Attention on Long-term Behaviors for CTR Prediction
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.description: [WWW 2026][CTR预估与特征交叉] 面向长行为序列 CTR 的个性化时间分块 + 三分支稀疏注意力 SparseCTR，AUC 相对提升 8.49%，线上 CTR +1.72%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.title: AlphaFuse: Learn ID Embeddings for Sequential Recommendation in Null Space of Language Embeddings
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.description: [SIGIR 2025][序列与会话推荐] 将语言嵌入 SVD 分解为语义丰富行空间与语义稀疏零空间，在裁剪后的零空间内学习 ID 嵌入，无需适配器即插即用地融合语义与协同信号。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.title: Closing the Long-Short View Gap in Sequential Recommendation without Cached History
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.description: [CIKM 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用角度相似度打分+softmax1 修正长视训练几何缺陷，再仅微调 Bias/LayerNorm 实现无缓存短视推理，短窗下反超全序列基线。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.title: Generative Archetype-Grounded Item Representations for Sequential Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.description: [WWW 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用 LLM 生成物品“目标人群原型”文本并单次前向抽取 prefill/decoding 双嵌入，再以行为关联分数调制排斥力做校准，Full-Ranking 下 HR@10 最高 +6.95%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.title: Collaborative Memory Augmentation for Generative Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐] 为生成式推荐引入跨用户协同记忆库，用可学习查询token压缩序列、目标感知检索与门控交叉注意力融合，Full-Ranking下NDCG@5最高提升23.7%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.title: Learning Decomposed Contextual Token Representations from Pretrained and Collaborative Signals for Generative Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] DECOR 用冻结码本+可学协同嵌入分解融合、上下文 token 组合与可学 BOS 查询，缓解静态分词歧义与预训练语义丢失，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@10 最高提升 14%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.title: Unleashing the Potential of Sparse Attention on Long-term Behaviors for CTR Prediction
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.description: [WWW 2026][CTR预估与特征交叉] 面向长行为序列 CTR 的个性化时间分块 + 三分支稀疏注意力 SparseCTR，AUC 相对提升 8.49%，线上 CTR +1.72%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.title: RecBase: Generative Foundation Model Pretraining for Zero-Shot Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.description: [EMNLP 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用课程学习增强的 RQ-VAE 将跨域物品统一离散为层级概念 ID，从零预训练 1.5B 自回归推荐基座，在 8 个未见数据集零样本 AUC 全面超越 7B LLM。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.title: Contrastive Representation for Interactive Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.description: [AAAI 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用偏好排序对比学习(PRCL)为 DRL 交互推荐提炼状态表征，冷启动下样本效率显著提升。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.title: LLM2Rec: Large Language Models Are Powerful Embedding Models for Sequential Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 两阶段将 LLM 改造为融合协同信号与语义的物品嵌入模型，Full-Ranking 下域内平均提升约 15%、跨域仍稳定增益。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.title: Future Sight and Tough Fights: Revolutionizing Sequential Recommendation with FENRec
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.description: [AAAI 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用时间相关软标签挖掘未来交互、用锚-负混合构造持久困难负样本，四数据集全库排序平均提升 6.16%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.title: SimDiffRec: Semantic Similarity-Guided Diffusion for Contrastive Sequential Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.description: [WSDM 2026][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 用语义相似物品均值替代高斯随机噪声做扩散增强，按去噪置信度选增强位置并配难负采样，五数据集 Full-Ranking 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.title: Empowering Sequential Recommendation from Collaborative Signals and Semantic Relatedness
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.description: [DASFAA 2024][序列与会话推荐] 双流 Transformer 分别编码 ID 与内容序列，用用户级/物品级分层对比对齐跨模态语义鸿沟，全库排序下 NDCG@10 最高提升 15.44%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.title: Rethinking Convolutional Networks for Attribute-Aware Sequential Recommendation

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.title: Hyena Operator for Fast Sequential Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.description: [WWW 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用 Legendre 正交多项式参数化 Hyena 长卷积核，线性复杂度建模超长用户序列，XLong 上 NDCG@10 提升 17.65% 且训练最高 6× 加速。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.title: STAR-Rec: Making Peace with Length Variance and Pattern Diversity in Sequential Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.description: [SIGIR 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用偏好感知注意力与 SSM 双路径自适应融合 + 序列级 MoE，统一建模长度方差与行为模式多样性，Leave-One-Out 全库排序下 Recall@10 最高提升 2.15%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.title: A Contextual-Aware Position Encoding for Sequential Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.description: [WWW 2025][序列与会话推荐] 首个为序列推荐定制的上下文感知位置编码 CAPE：用目标-上下文不相似度累加动态分配位置，配合门控融合异构特征，在 5 个骨干与工业 A/B 上稳定涨点。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.title: FEDIN: Frequency-Enhanced Deep Interest Network for Click-Through Rate Prediction
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2025/sequential.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 以目标条件化频谱熵观察为动机，用目标感知频谱滤波+时域双分支做CTR预估，三数据集GAUC/AUC全面SOTA。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/agent_conv.title: $τ$-Rec: A Verifiable Benchmark for Agentic Recommender Systems
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/agent_conv.description: [RecSys 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用可验证目录谓词奖励、reveal-tagged 信息揭示机制与 pass^k 可靠性指标替代 LLM-as-judge，揭示智能体推荐在隐藏约束下的可靠性悬崖。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/agent_conv.title: A Survey on LLM-powered Agents for Recommender Systems
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/agent_conv.description: [ACL 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 系统综述 LLM Agent 推荐的三范式（推荐/交互/仿真）与四模块架构，梳理数据集与评测协议并指出统一评测缺失。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/agent_conv.title: AgentRecBench: Benchmarking LLM Agent-based Personalized Recommender Systems
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/agent_conv.description: [NeurIPS 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 首个 LLM 智能体推荐系统基准，构建 U-R-I 文本交互环境与三类场景，揭示结构化工作流智能体显著优于传统与朴素 Agent。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/agent_conv.title: Bootstrapping Conversational Recommendation Agents At Spotify: Synthetic Data Generation and Self-Improvement Loops
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/agent_conv.description: [RecSys 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用多轮合成对话+方差归因自改进循环冷启动对话推荐智能体，线上A/B提升14%收听与5%周活。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/agent_conv.title: Personalized Recommendation Tool Learning via Autonomous Language Agents
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/agent_conv.description: [RecSys 2026][LLM4Rec] 让 LLM 智能体做个性化工具选择、传统推荐模型做全库打分，以架构设计绕开幻觉与上下文长度限制，Full-Ranking 下 R@10 最高提升 68.8%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/agent_conv.title: Enhancing Personalized Multi-Turn Dialogue with Curiosity Reward
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/agent_conv.description: [NeurIPS 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 将用户模型信念增益作为 PBRS 内在奖励注入多轮 RLHF，使 LLM 主动探询用户属性，习题推荐成功率 54%→87.5%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/agent_conv.title: RecUserSim: A Realistic and Diverse User Simulator for Evaluating Conversational Recommender Systems
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/agent_conv.description: [WWW 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出四模块 LLM Agent 用户模拟器，以有限理性三层 Rating-Action-Response 机制实现真实角色扮演、多样人群覆盖与显式打分，并落地华为 Celia 餐饮助手。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/agent_conv.title: Temporal-Aware User Behaviour Simulation with Large Language Models for Recommender Systems
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/agent_conv.description: [CIKM 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用动态画像更新、时序模式抽取与自适应聚合构建 LLM 用户模拟器，在 ML-1M 上 nDCG@5 相对 RecAgent 提升约 27.8%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/agent_conv.title: AgentRecBench: Benchmarking LLM Agent-based Personalized Recommender Systems
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/agent_conv.description: [NeurIPS 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 首个 LLM 智能体推荐系统基准，构建 U-R-I 文本交互环境与三类场景，揭示结构化工作流智能体显著优于传统与朴素 Agent。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/agent_conv.title: Interplay: Training Independent Simulators for Reference-Free Conversational Recommendation

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/llm_rec/pr.title: One Model for All: Large Language Models are Domain-Agnostic Recommendation Systems
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/llm_rec/pr.description: [TOIS 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 LLM 编码跨域混合标题序列实现域无关推荐，采样 1000 负例评测，SPIAO 上较最优基线相对提升约 19%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/llm_rec/pr.title: Enhancing Item-level Bundle Representation for Bundle Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/llm_rec/pr.description: [TORS 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用 B-U-I 高阶关联与预训练伪交互增强捆绑包物品级表征，全库排序下平均提升 7.5%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/llm_rec/pr.title: Mitigating Popularity Bias in Recommendation with Global Listwise Learning and Progressive Bi-Weighting
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/llm_rec/pr.description: [TOIS 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 用 IPS 加权多项似然实现列表级全局无偏学习，并以 Bi-Weighting 平滑倾向估计与渐进式去偏，六数据集 Recall@20 平均提升 9.43%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/llm_rec/pr.title: RecRanker: Instruction Tuning Large Language Model as Ranker for Top-k Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/llm_rec/pr.description: [TOIS 2025][大语言模型推荐] 以自适应用户采样、位置偏移与检索信号增强构建三类排序指令微调 LLM 重排器，并提出混合排序集成，Leave-One-Out 全库排序下 HR/NDCG 最高提升 213%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/llm_rec/pr.title: Balancing Embedding Spectrum for Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/llm_rec/pr.description: [TORS 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 从谱分析视角揭示成对学习中的嵌入坍缩，提出 DirectSpec 全通滤波直接均衡奇异值谱，MF/LightGCN 上 nDCG@10 最高提升 52.6%/42.4%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/llm_rec/re.title: Exploring Feature-based Knowledge Distillation for Recommender System: A Frequency Perspective
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/llm_rec/re.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 从频域视角揭示特征蒸馏等权缺陷，提出轻量图滤波重加权 FreqD，全库排序下 Recall@20 最高提升 18.2%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/llm_rec/re.title: Zero-shot Cross-domain Knowledge Distillation: A Case study on YouTube Music
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/llm_rec/re.description: [RecSys 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用 YouTube 视频大教师零样本蒸馏到低流量 YouTube Music 双排序模型，离线 AUC 微增但线上新发内容互动 +11.39%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/llm_rec/re.title: Preference-Consistent Knowledge Distillation for Recommender System
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/llm_rec/re.description: [TKDE 2025][大语言模型推荐] 揭示特征蒸馏中投影器导致的偏好不一致现象，提出成对/列表两种正则项约束投影器，全库排序下 NDCG@20 最高提升 20%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/llm_rec/re.title: Active Large Language Model-based Knowledge Distillation for Session-based Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/llm_rec/re.description: [AAAI 2025][LLM4Rec] 用 max-min 主动学习从全量会话中挑出少量高增益实例喂给 GPT-4 教师蒸馏，500 条样本即超越全量 KD 与 10 倍参数教师。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/llm_rec/re.title: NLGR: Utilizing Neighbor Lists for Generative Rerank in Personalized Recommendation Systems
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/llm_rec/re.description: [WWW 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用邻居列表相对奖励对齐评估器-生成器目标，并以采样式非自回归生成灵活跳转组合空间，美团线上 CTR +3.25%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/llm_rec/to.title: LaViC: Adapting Large Vision-Language Models to Visually-Aware Conversational Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/llm_rec/to.description: [KDD 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用视觉知识自蒸馏把商品图压成5个[CLS] token，再做推荐提示微调，在新建Reddit-Amazon三域上HR@1最高提升54.2%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/llm_rec/to.title: VL-CLIP: Enhancing Multimodal Recommendations via Visual Grounding and LLM-Augmented CLIP Embeddings
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/llm_rec/to.description: [RecSys 2025][多模态推荐] 用 Grounding DINO 裁剪商品主体 + LLM 自反思改写商品描述，再微调 CLIP 双塔，Walmart 线上 CTR +18.6%、GMV +4.0%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/llm_rec/to.title: NoteLLM-2: Multimodal Large Representation Models for Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/llm_rec/to.description: [KDD 2025][多模态推荐] 端到端微调 LLM+视觉编码器构建高效 MLRM，用 mICL 与门控后期融合缓解视觉忽视，I2I 全库召回 R@100 显著提升并落地线上 A/B。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/llm_rec/to.title: Text-Guided Visual Representation Learning for Robust Multimodal E-Commerce Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/llm_rec/to.description: [KDD 2026][多模态推荐] 以结构化元数据初始化语义查询、双流解耦视觉证据并用可靠性双门控校准，在 134K 全库 I2I 检索上 H@100 相对提升 6.04%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/llm_rec/to.title: Learning Sparse Representations of Multimodal Content for Enhanced Cold Item Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/llm_rec/to.description: [RecSys 2026][冷启动与长尾推荐] 将多模态内容冷启动表征改为 top-K 稀疏嵌入，并用 α-entmax 预稀疏激活诱导锐化与去噪，冷启动 NDCG@20 提升 16.6%–75.5% 且存储更低。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multi_task.title: RecSoup: Efficient Model Merging Approach for Controllable Multi-Objective Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multi_task.description: [CIKM 2026][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用剪枝+可学习门控做任务向量合并，实现推理时可控多目标推荐，HV 提升 8.5% 且延迟快 165–228 倍。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multi_task.title: CSMF: Cascaded Selective Mask Fine-Tuning for Multi-Objective Embedding-Based Retrieval
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multi_task.description: [SIGIR 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 借鉴 PEFT 选择性掩码思想，按曝光→点击→转化级联顺序分阶段微调双塔召回，零参数增量实现多目标融合检索。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multi_task.title: Choosing the Best of Both Worlds: Diverse and Novel Recommendations through Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multi_task.description: [WSDM 2022][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用标量化多目标 RL 头正则化序列推荐主干，同时优化准确率/多样性/新颖性，聚合覆盖度提升约 20% 且准确率不降。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multi_task.title: MPFormer: Adaptive Framework for Industrial Multi-Task Personalized Sequential Retriever
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multi_task.description: [CIKM 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用目标条件化 Transformer 统一多目标召回，并以排序分数监督动态配额分配，在快手 4 亿 DAU 上实现 +0.43% 总时长与 66.7% 推理资源节省。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multi_task.title: CPMR: Context-Aware Incremental Sequential Recommendation with Pseudo-Multi-Task Learning
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multi_task.description: [CIKM 2023][序列与会话推荐] 提出伪多任务学习范式，用历史图与上下文图双通道演化用户/物品时序状态，在四个数据集上 MRR 平均提升 30.98%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multi_task.title: Comprehensive List Generation for Multi-Generator Reranking
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multi_task.description: [SIGIR 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 提出多生成器-评估器重排框架与列表全面性指标，用 CLIG 自动学习互补生成器，离线 AUC 提升 0.9%、线上观看时长 +0.48%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multi_task.title: NLGR: Utilizing Neighbor Lists for Generative Rerank in Personalized Recommendation Systems
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multi_task.description: [WWW 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用邻居列表相对奖励对齐评估器-生成器目标，并以采样式非自回归生成灵活跳转组合空间，美团线上 CTR +3.25%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multi_task.title: DeGRe: Dense-supervised Generative Reranking for Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multi_task.description: [KDD 2026][多任务学习与列表级重排] 离线束搜索挖掘前瞻序列+累积回归稠密监督蒸馏至轻量生成器，单次贪心解码逼近全局最优，线上GMV+3.75%

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multi_task.title: Not All Candidates are Created Equal: A Heterogeneity-Aware Approach to Pre-ranking in Recommender Systems
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multi_task.description: [WWW 2026][多任务学习与列表级重排] 针对粗排异构候选的梯度冲突与算力错配，提出 GHCL 分组对比损失与难度感知双模型路由，AUC 全面超越 SOTA 且线上降本 6%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multi_task.title: Beyond Utility: Evaluating LLM as Recommender
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multi_task.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出含历史长度敏感性、候选位置偏差、画像生成与幻觉四维的 LLM 推荐多维评测框架，揭示 LLM 在重排与冷启动占优但位置偏差严重。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multimodal.title: Beyond Graph Convolution: Multimodal Recommendation with Topology-aware MLPs
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multimodal.description: [AAAI 2025][多模态推荐] 用拓扑剪枝+邻域对齐损失替代GCN消息传递，以MLP建模多模态物品关系，全库排序下Recall@10最高提升7.53%

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multimodal.title: Hypercomplex Prompt-aware Multimodal Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multimodal.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 用 Cayley-Dickson 超复数多分量嵌入 + 超复数乘法非线性融合 + Prompt 动态补偿，在四个 Amazon 数据集 Full-Ranking 下 Recall@20 最高提升约 13%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multimodal.title: COHESION: Composite Graph Convolutional Network with Dual-Stage Fusion for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multimodal.description: [SIGIR 2025][多模态推荐] 用行为模态早期精炼+晚期注意力融合的双阶段融合，配合异质/同质复合图与自适应BPR，在三个 Amazon 数据集上 R@20 相对提升 4.4%–6.1%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multimodal.title: SPARK: Adaptive Low-Rank Knowledge Graph Modeling in Hybrid Geometric Spaces for Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multimodal.description: [CIKM 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 用 Tucker 低秩去噪 KG、SVD 初始化双曲/欧氏并行 GNN，并按物品流行度自适应融合多源信号，长尾推荐 R@10 最高提升 10.8%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multimodal.title: Structural and Disentangled Adaptation of Large Vision Language Models for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multimodal.description: [SIGIR 2026][多模态推荐] 用模态内结构软教师对齐 LVLM 跨模态表征，并以专家化门控 LoRA 解耦梯度流，即插即用提升多模态与序列推荐，长尾增益最高 18.70%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multimodal.title: NoteLLM-2: Multimodal Large Representation Models for Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multimodal.description: [KDD 2025][多模态推荐] 端到端微调 LLM+视觉编码器构建高效 MLRM，用 mICL 与门控后期融合缓解视觉忽视，I2I 全库召回 R@100 显著提升并落地线上 A/B。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multimodal.title: When Top-ranked Recommendations Fail: Modeling Multi-Granular Negative Feedback for Explainable and Robust Video Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multimodal.description: [AAAI 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 三智能体协同建模多粒度负反馈，S-GRPO 渐进奖励实现可解释视频推荐，线上快滑率降 9.4%

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multimodal.title: Efficient and Effective Adaptation of Multimodal Foundation Models in Sequential Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multimodal.description: [TKDE 2025][多模态推荐] IISAN-Versa 用解耦 PEFT + 组 LayerDrop + 维度变换层，统一适配对称/非对称多模态基础模型，缓存隐藏态后 GPU 显存降 12–15 倍、训练提速 16–20 倍，MicroLens 达 SOTA。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multimodal.title: Multi-modal Adaptive Mixture of Experts for Cold-start Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multimodal.description: [CIKM 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 用双层 MoE（模态专属专家+动态门控融合）替代拼接/平均融合，在 Amazon 三域冷启动全库排序上 Recall@10 最高提升 16.17%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multimodal.title: A Content-Driven Micro-Video Recommendation Dataset at Scale
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multimodal.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 发布十亿级含原始视频模态的微视频推荐数据集 MicroLens，并系统基准 IDRec/VIDRec/VideoRec 三类范式，揭示端到端视频编码优于冻结特征的关键结论。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multimodal.title: MLLMRec: A Preference Reasoning Paradigm with Graph Refinement for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multimodal.description: [SIGIR 2026][多模态推荐] 用 MLLM 推理用户偏好画像替代噪声聚合初始化，并以阈值去噪+共现增强精修物品图，三数据集 11/12 指标 SOTA。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multimodal.title: Intent Representation Learning with Large Language Model for Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multimodal.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 LLM 思维链抽取文本意图，与交互意图双塔对齐+动量蒸馏匹配，作为模型无关插件在三个数据集上稳定提升 Recall/NDCG。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multimodal.title: CAMMSR: Category-Guided Attentive Mixture of Experts for Multimodal Sequential Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multimodal.description: [ICDE 2026][多模态推荐] 用类别预测任务引导注意力 MoE 动态分配模态权重，并以模态交换对比学习对齐跨模态序列表征，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@5 最高提升 15.3%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multimodal.title: MIRA: Empowering One-Touch AI Services on Smartphones with MLLM-based Instruction Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multimodal.description: [ACL 2025 Industry][LLM4Rec] 用结构化推理+模板检索增强+前缀树约束解码，把长按图文触发对象映射到预定义手机AI指令，F1较SFT提升约60%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multimodal.title: Harnessing Multimodal Large Language Models for Multimodal Sequential Recommendation
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/multimodal.description: [AAAI 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 MLLM 将商品图转为文本摘要，再以循环式提示推断动态用户偏好，SFT 微调 LLaVA 做多模态序列推荐，AUC 最高提升约 4.3%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/rl_bandit_.title: FairSort: Learning to Fair Rank for Personalized Recommendations in Two-Sided Platforms
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/rl_bandit_.description: [TKDE 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 将重排视为“跑道”而非背包，用公平提升速度+二分搜索保证用户最低效用，实现双边公平与个性化推荐的三方权衡。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/rl_bandit_.title: Off-Policy Evaluation and Learning for Matching Markets
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/rl_bandit_.description: [RecSys 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 面向双向匹配市场提出 DiPS/DPR 两阶段奖励 OPE 估计器，利用一阶段 scout 信号降方差，合成+Wantedly 真实 A/B 日志验证 MSE 与策略选择显著优于 DM/IPS/DR。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/rl_bandit_.title: Equity vs. Equality: Optimizing Ranking Fairness for Tailored Provider Needs
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/rl_bandit_.description: [SIGIR 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 提出以增益为基的公平框架与 EquityRank 梯度重排算法，按提供者异质偏好分配曝光与销量收益，离线/在线仿真均取得更优效果-公平权衡。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/rl_bandit_.title: Measuring Individual User Fairness with User Similarity and Effectiveness Disparity
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/rl_bandit_.description: [ECIR 2026][去偏公平与可信推荐] 提出 PUF 指标，用用户相似度加权有效性差异，首次同时刻画个体公平的两大要素，4 数据集 7 推荐器验证其敏感性与计算效率。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/rl_bandit_.title: Stratified Expert Cloning for Retention-Aware Recommendation at Scale
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/rl_bandit_.description: [CIKM 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用分层专家行为克隆替代 RL 探索，配合动作熵正则与自适应专家选择，在快手双平台 A/B 中提升活跃天数 0.098%/0.122%。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/rl_bandit_.title: Preference is More Than Comparisons: Rethinking Dueling Bandits with Augmented Human Feedback
venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/rl_bandit_.description: [AAAI 2026][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用增强置信界把相似/依赖观测注入无模型 Dueling Bandit，给出样本复杂度与遗憾权衡，在推荐、多目标优化与 LLM 响应优化上显著降遗憾。

venues/ICLR_NeurIPS_ICML/2026/rl_bandit_.title: Exploitation Over Exploration: Unmasking the Bias in Linear Bandit Recommender Offline Evaluation

venues/KDD/2025/cross_domain_multi_scena.title: A Dual-Expert Strategy Integrating LLMs to Mitigate Negative Transfer in Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/agent0_leveragin.description: [RecSys 2026][LLM4Rec] 让 LLM 智能体做个性化工具选择、传统推荐模型做全库打分，以架构设计绕开幻觉与上下文长度限制，Full-Ranking 下 R@10 最高提升 68.8%。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/agent0_leveragin.title: AgentRecBench: Benchmarking LLM Agent-based Personalized Recommender Systems
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/agent0_leveragin.description: [NeurIPS 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 首个 LLM 智能体推荐系统基准，构建 U-R-I 文本交互环境与三类场景，揭示结构化工作流智能体显著优于传统与朴素 Agent。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/agent0_leveragin.title: A Survey on LLM-powered Agents for Recommender Systems
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/agent0_leveragin.description: [ACL 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 系统综述 LLM Agent 推荐的三范式（推荐/交互/仿真）与四模块架构，梳理数据集与评测协议并指出统一评测缺失。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/agent0_leveragin.title: Recommender AI Agent: Integrating Large Language Models for Interactive Recommendations
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/agent0_leveragin.description: [TOIS 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 以 LLM 为大脑、传统推荐模型为工具，配合候选总线、长短期画像、计划优先执行与反思机制，在 Steam/MovieLens/Beauty 上显著超越 GPT-4 与 Chat-Rec。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/agent0_leveragin.title: Enhancing Recommendation Explanations through User-Centric Refinement
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/agent0_leveragin.description: [ACL 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出 RefineX 多智能体推理期精炼框架，以 plan-then-refine 与分层反思将 PETER 解释在事实性/个性化/连贯性三维度大幅提升。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/collaboration_of.title: CHORD: Customizing Hybrid-precision On-device Model for Sequential Recommendation with Device-cloud Collaboration
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/collaboration_of.description: [ACM MM 2025][序列与会话推荐] 云端超网络按用户画像生成逐通道混合精度量化策略（2-bit 编码），端侧单次前向完成个性化适配与推理，精度反超全精度基线且传输降 173.8×。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/collaboration_of.title: RecGPT-Mobile: On-Device Large Language Models for User Intent Understanding in Taobao Feed Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/collaboration_of.description: [SIGIR 2026][大语言模型推荐] 将 Qwen3-0.6B 量化后部署于手机端，用意图漂移触发机制按需推理生成下一搜索意图，线上 GMV +2.5%

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/collaboration_of.title: CoLLM: Integrating Collaborative Embeddings into Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/collaboration_of.description: [TKDE 2025][大语言模型推荐] 将传统协同过滤模型学到的用户/物品表征经 MLP 映射进 LLM 词嵌入空间，以两阶段调优兼顾暖启动与冷启动，AUC 相对 TALLRec 提升约 8%。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/collaboration_of.title: A Federated Framework for LLM-based Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/collaboration_of.description: [NAACL 2025 Findings][去偏公平与工业架构] FELLRec 用动态聚合+课程升温平衡客户端性能，并以分层卸载降低 LLM 联邦推荐端侧开销。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/collaboration_of.title: Device-Cloud Collaborative Correction for On-Device Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/collaboration_of.description: [IJCAI 2025][序列与会话推荐] 端侧 TTT 自校正网络 + 云端全局校正网络，以 RNN 级开销逼近 Transformer 精度，UAUC 最高提升 4.56%。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/earn_efficient_i.title: Massive Memorization with Hundreds of Trillions of Parameters for Sequential Transducer Generative Recommenders
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/earn_efficient_i.description: [ICLR 2026][序列与会话推荐] VISTA 将超长用户历史两阶段解耦：离线用准线性注意力压缩为数百种子嵌入并缓存，下游仅做候选-摘要注意力，工业上线推理 GPU 降 94%。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/earn_efficient_i.title: Modular Representation Compression: Adapting LLMs for Efficient and Effective Recommendations
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/earn_efficient_i.description: [SIGIR 2026][大语言模型推荐] 揭示 LLM 中间层表征优势 (MRA) 并用模块化解耦压缩修复，128 维表征在 CTR/重排/召回全面超越基线，线上 eCPM +2.82%

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/earn_efficient_i.title: Lost in Sequence: Do Large Language Models Understand Sequential Recommendation?
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/earn_efficient_i.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 揭示现有 LLM4Rec 模型无法捕捉交互序列顺序信息，提出冻结 LLM 与 CF-SRec、仅训练轻量 MLP 的蒸馏框架 LLM-SRec，在 Amazon 四数据集上 NDCG@10 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/earn_efficient_i.title: Collaborative Memory Augmentation for Generative Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/earn_efficient_i.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐] 为生成式推荐引入跨用户协同记忆库，用可学习查询token压缩序列、目标感知检索与门控交叉注意力融合，Full-Ranking下NDCG@5最高提升23.7%。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/earn_efficient_i.title: Decoding in Latent Spaces for Efficient Inference in LLM-based Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/earn_efficient_i.description: [EMNLP 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用训练样本末层隐状态聚合出物品潜在表征，以 L2 距离匹配替代自回归语言空间解码，推理提速 10 倍以上且性能不降反升。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/exploring_featur.title: Preference-Consistent Knowledge Distillation for Recommender System
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/exploring_featur.description: [TKDE 2025][大语言模型推荐] 揭示特征蒸馏中投影器导致的偏好不一致现象，提出成对/列表两种正则项约束投影器，全库排序下 NDCG@20 最高提升 20%。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/exploring_featur.title: Rejuvenating Cross-Entropy Loss in Knowledge Distillation for Recommender Systems
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/exploring_featur.description: [ICLR 2026][LLM4Rec] 揭示CE蒸馏损失与NDCG的闭包假设矛盾，提出师生协同子集拆分与自适应加权的RCE-KD，全库排序下NDCG@20最高提升11.76%。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/exploring_featur.title: D2K: Turning Historical Data into Retrievable Knowledge for Recommender Systems
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/exploring_featur.description: [WWW 2025][大语言模型推荐] 将历史日志转为用户-物品-上下文三元知识库，Transformer 编码 + 个性化适配注入任意 CTR 模型，AUC 相对提升 1.35%–2.90%。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/exploring_featur.title: Continual Recommender Systems
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/exploring_featur.description: [CIKM 2025][序列与会话推荐] 系统梳理持续推荐的两大技术路线（经验回放与正则化），并延伸至资源受限与序列交互场景，给出可信性、基础模型与搜推统一三大开放方向。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/exploring_featur.title: Balancing Fine-tuning and RAG: A Hybrid Strategy for Dynamic LLM Recommendation Updates
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/exploring_featur.description: [RecSys 2025][LLM4Rec] 以十亿用户短视频兴趣探索系统为案例，量化对比微调与RAG的更新代价/敏捷性，提出月度微调+周内RAG刷新的混合更新策略，线上A/B显著提升满意度。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/goracs_group_lev.title: Beyond Utility: Evaluating LLM as Recommender
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/goracs_group_lev.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出含历史长度敏感性、候选位置偏差、画像生成与幻觉四维的 LLM 推荐多维评测框架，揭示 LLM 在重排与冷启动占优但位置偏差严重。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/goracs_group_lev.title: Exact and Efficient Unlearning for Large Language Model-based Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/goracs_group_lev.description: [TKDE 2025][LLM4Rec] 首个面向 LLMRec 的精确遗忘框架 APA：语义分片训练子 LoRA、仅重训受影响分片，并以样本自适应参数级聚合实现单次推理，遗忘提速约 4 倍且 AUC 反超全量重训。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/goracs_group_lev.title: Training seeds and model-selection stability in recommender-system evaluation
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/goracs_group_lev.description: [RecSys 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 固定数据划分与超参、仅变训练种子，从用户级指标敏感性、验证选模稳定性、验证-测试一致性与推荐列表一致性四层量化种子噪声，主张种子应纳入评估协议。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/goracs_group_lev.title: Can LLMs Outshine Conventional Recommenders? A Comparative Evaluation
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/goracs_group_lev.description: [NeurIPS 2025 DB Track][大语言模型推荐] RecBench 系统对比 17 个 LLM 与 DLRM 在 4 种物品表征、CTR/SeqRec 双任务上的精度-效率权衡，LLM 精度领先但推理慢千倍。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/goracs_group_lev.title: Do LLMs Memorize Recommendation Datasets? A Preliminary Study on MovieLens-1M
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/goracs_group_lev.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用少样本提示探测 GPT/Llama 对 MovieLens-1M 的物品、用户与交互记忆覆盖率，揭示记忆量与推荐性能强相关且放大流行度偏置。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/lettingo_explore.title: ProEx: A Unified Framework Leveraging Large Language Model with Profile Extrapolation for Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/lettingo_explore.description: [KDD 2026][大语言模型推荐] 用四步 CoT 为每个用户/物品生成多面画像并做环境不变性融合，在三个数据集上对 6 个基模型平均提升 5%+。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/lettingo_explore.title: ProMax: Exploring the Potential of LLM-derived Profiles with Distribution Shaping for Recommender Systems
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/lettingo_explore.description: [SIGIR 2026][LLM推荐] 将 LLM 画像视为检索信号而非融合特征，用双路分布重塑（监督+自监督）引导基座模型，LightGCN 上 NDCG@10 最高提升 8.44%。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/lettingo_explore.title: Enriching Semantic Profiles into Knowledge Graph for Recommender Systems Using Large Language Models
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/lettingo_explore.description: [KDD 2026][LLM4Rec] 用 LLM 为 KG 全实体生成语义画像，以可逆加性注入+成对匹配对齐，Full-Ranking 下 Recall@40 最高提升 2.6%。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/lettingo_explore.title: Towards Next-Generation Recommender Systems: A Benchmark for Personalized Recommendation Assistant with LLMs
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/lettingo_explore.description: [WSDM 2026][大语言模型推荐] 构建 RecBench+ 约3万条复杂用户查询基准，覆盖显式/隐式/误导条件与画像偏好，系统评测7个LLM并揭示SFT+RFT两阶段微调最优。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/lettingo_explore.title: Prompt Tuning as User Inherent Profile Inference Machine
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/lettingo_explore.description: [CIKM 2025][LLM4Rec] 将用户潜在画像建模为可训练软提示，用因果掩码+EM 推断、码本量化成协同 ID，AUC 最高相对提升 4.77%，已上线华为应用市场。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/llm2rec_large_la.title: Lost in Sequence: Do Large Language Models Understand Sequential Recommendation?
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/llm2rec_large_la.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 揭示现有 LLM4Rec 模型无法捕捉交互序列顺序信息，提出冻结 LLM 与 CF-SRec、仅训练轻量 MLP 的蒸馏框架 LLM-SRec，在 Amazon 四数据集上 NDCG@10 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/llm2rec_large_la.title: Fusion and Alignment Enhancement with Large Language Models for Tail-item Sequential Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/llm2rec_large_la.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用自适应门控融合 ID/LLM 嵌入并以双层对齐+课程学习消除空间结构冲突，全库排序下尾部长尾 H@10 最高提升 427%。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/llm2rec_large_la.title: Empowering Sequential Recommendation from Collaborative Signals and Semantic Relatedness
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/llm2rec_large_la.description: [DASFAA 2024][序列与会话推荐] 双流 Transformer 分别编码 ID 与内容序列，用用户级/物品级分层对比对齐跨模态语义鸿沟，全库排序下 NDCG@10 最高提升 15.44%。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/llm2rec_large_la.title: Can LLMs Outshine Conventional Recommenders? A Comparative Evaluation
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/llm2rec_large_la.description: [NeurIPS 2025 DB Track][大语言模型推荐] RecBench 系统对比 17 个 LLM 与 DLRM 在 4 种物品表征、CTR/SeqRec 双任务上的精度-效率权衡，LLM 精度领先但推理慢千倍。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/llm2rec_large_la.title: Language Representations Can be What Recommenders Need: Findings and Potentials
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/llm2rec_large_la.description: [ICLR 2025 (Oral)][LLM4Rec] 揭示语言空间与推荐行为空间同构，提出纯语言表征的 AlphaRec，在 Amazon 三数据集 Full-Ranking 上超越 ID-based CF 6.8%–9.8%。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/lost_in_sequence.title: DELRec: Distilling Sequential Pattern to Enhance LLMs-based Sequential Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/lost_in_sequence.description: [ICDE 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用软提示两阶段蒸馏传统序列模型的时间感知与推荐模式，再微调 LLM 做序列推荐，四数据集 HR/NDCG 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/lost_in_sequence.title: Pre-trained LLMs Meet Sequential Recommenders: Efficient User-Centric Knowledge Distillation
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/lost_in_sequence.description: [ECIR 2026][大语言模型推荐] 用预训练 LLM 生成文本用户画像并蒸馏进 SASRec/BERT4Rec 隐层，两阶段训练实现零推理开销的语义增强，Recall@10 最高提升 23.5%。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/lost_in_sequence.title: LLM2Rec: Large Language Models Are Powerful Embedding Models for Sequential Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/lost_in_sequence.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 两阶段将 LLM 改造为融合协同信号与语义的物品嵌入模型，Full-Ranking 下域内平均提升约 15%、跨域仍稳定增益。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/lost_in_sequence.title: SLMRec: Distilling Large Language Models into Small for Sequential Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/lost_in_sequence.description: [ICLR 2025][LLM4Rec] 发现 LLM 中间层冗余，用逐层分块特征蒸馏将 8 层教师压缩为 4 层学生，仅 13% 参数达 6.6x/8.0x 加速且性能不降。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/lost_in_sequence.title: Reformulating Sequential Recommendation: Learning Dynamic User Interest with Content-enriched Language Modeling
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/lost_in_sequence.description: [DASFAA 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用知识提示+推理提示将序列推荐改写为文本生成任务，GPT-2 冻结主干下在三个数据集全排序协议上取得 Recall@5 相对提升约 5%–12%。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/the_mental_world.title: Can LLMs Outshine Conventional Recommenders? A Comparative Evaluation
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/the_mental_world.description: [NeurIPS 2025 DB Track][大语言模型推荐] RecBench 系统对比 17 个 LLM 与 DLRM 在 4 种物品表征、CTR/SeqRec 双任务上的精度-效率权衡，LLM 精度领先但推理慢千倍。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/the_mental_world.title: Bridging Language and Items for Retrieval and Recommendation: Benchmarking LLMs as Semantic Encoders
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/the_mental_world.description: [ACL 2026][大语言模型推荐] 构建 BLaIR 基准，用 11 个 LLM 作语义编码器评测序列推荐、协同过滤与复杂查询商品搜索，揭示其排名与 MTEB 几乎不相关。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/the_mental_world.title: FLARE: Fusing Language Models and Collaborative Architectures for Recommender Enhancement
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/the_mental_world.description: [WWW 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用冻结 mT5+Perceiver 将文本注入 Bert4Rec，并以重调 Bert4Rec 基线、大词表评测与 Critiquing 任务重估 ID+文本增益。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/the_mental_world.title: Do LLMs Memorize Recommendation Datasets? A Preliminary Study on MovieLens-1M
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/the_mental_world.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用少样本提示探测 GPT/Llama 对 MovieLens-1M 的物品、用户与交互记忆覆盖率，揭示记忆量与推荐性能强相关且放大流行度偏置。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/the_mental_world.title: Beyond Utility: Evaluating LLM as Recommender
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/the_mental_world.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出含历史长度敏感性、候选位置偏差、画像生成与幻觉四维的 LLM 推荐多维评测框架，揭示 LLM 在重排与冷启动占优但位置偏差严重。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/uqabench_evaluat.title: Multi-Grained Patch Training for Efficient LLM-based Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/uqabench_evaluat.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用层次化 item/session patch 压缩长交互历史，两阶段训练让 LLM 理解压缩表征，同 token 预算下 HR@20 最高提升 72%。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/uqabench_evaluat.title: Towards Next-Generation Recommender Systems: A Benchmark for Personalized Recommendation Assistant with LLMs
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/uqabench_evaluat.description: [WSDM 2026][大语言模型推荐] 构建 RecBench+ 约3万条复杂用户查询基准，覆盖显式/隐式/误导条件与画像偏好，系统评测7个LLM并揭示SFT+RFT两阶段微调最优。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/uqabench_evaluat.title: Long-Sequence Recommendation Models Need Decoupled Embeddings
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/uqabench_evaluat.description: [ICLR 2025][序列与会话推荐] 揭示长序列推荐中注意力与表征共享嵌入导致的梯度支配与冲突，提出双嵌入表 DARE，AUC 最高提升 9‰ 并加速检索 50%。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/uqabench_evaluat.title: Empowering Compact LLMs with Fusion of Layer-wise Exits for Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/uqabench_evaluat.description: [ICDM 2026][LLM4Rec] 在紧凑 LLM 每层插入预测出口并用连续 ReLU 路由器自适应融合多层打分分布，target-k hinge 损失约束激活出口数，全库排序下精度超越大模型基线且延迟仅增 <1ms。

venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/uqabench_evaluat.title: LLM2Rec: Large Language Models Are Powerful Embedding Models for Sequential Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/llm_rec/uqabench_evaluat.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 两阶段将 LLM 改造为融合协同信号与语义的物品嵌入模型，Full-Ranking 下域内平均提升约 15%、跨域仍稳定增益。

venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/bey.title: Bid Farewell to Seesaw: Towards Accurate Long-tail Session-based Recommendation via Dual Constraints of Hybrid Intents
venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/bey.description: [AAAI 2026][序列与会话推荐] 提出混合意图学习与意图约束损失的双约束即插即用框架 HID，在三个数据集上同时提升会话推荐准确率与长尾覆盖，打破 see-saw 困境。

venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/bey.title: How to Diversify any Personalized Recommender?
venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/bey.description: [ECIR 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 提出用户画像级预处理：用逻辑回归识别用户代表类别、userKNN 生成候选，再按 λ% 增删交互，使任意推荐器在保持精度的同时提升多样性与少数类曝光公平。

venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/bey.title: Mixture of Sequence: Theme-Aware Mixture-of-Experts for Long-Sequence Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/bey.description: [WWW 2026][序列与会话推荐] 揭示长序列“会话跳跃”现象，用主题码本路由+多尺度专家融合做子序列抽取，AUC 平均提升 0.68% 且 FLOPs 更低

venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/bey.title: A Self-Supervised Mixture-of-Experts Framework for Multi-behavior Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/bey.description: [CIKM 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 揭示多行为推荐在已访问/未访问物品上的性能鸿沟，提出双专家 MoE + 专家自适应 SSL（访问过滤/新颖性推断对比 + 行为生成）框架，全库排序下 HR@20 最高提升 65.46%。

venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/bey.title: CROWN: A Novel Approach to Comprehending Users' Preferences for Accurate Personalized News Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/bey.description: [WWW 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 以类别引导意图解耦、标题-内容一致性加权与 GNN 混合用户表征，统一解决新闻推荐的多意图、读后偏好差异与冷启动三大难题。

venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/bre.title: Talos: Optimizing Top-$K$ Accuracy in Recommender Systems
venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/bre.description: [WWW 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用量化阈值把 Top-K 截断改写为分数-阈值比较，配合采样分位回归与约束项，直接优化 Precision@K/Recall@K 并具备 DRO 鲁棒性。

venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/bre.title: From Pairwise to Ranking: Climbing the Ladder to Ideal Collaborative Filtering with Pseudo-Ranking
venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/bre.description: [AAAI 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用噪声注入构造伪排序并以多序分类排序损失替代成对损失，在四个数据集 Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@10 最高提升 38.9%。

venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/bre.title: Learning Recommender Systems with Soft Target: A Decoupled Perspective
venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/bre.description: [DASFAA 2024][协同过滤与双塔召回] 将 Softmax 软标签目标解耦为目标置信度与未观测项兴趣分布两项，配合 K-means 邻居标签传播生成软标签，在四个骨干模型三个数据集上稳定提升。

venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/bre.title: The Recall Ceiling of LLM Recommendation Reranking
venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/bre.description: [CIKM 2026][LLM4Rec] 证明闭候选重排器 NDCG 受自身窗口召回率硬上界约束，Oracle 协议高估 92–95%，九类 LLM 与监督重排器在真实检索下均无法显著超越 CF。

venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/bre.title: Improving Minimax Group Fairness in Sequential Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/bre.description: [ECIR 2025][去偏公平与可信推荐] 将 CVaR-DRO 首次引入 SASRec 序列推荐，无需组标注即可提升小众/短序列用户的最差组 NDCG@20，Retailrocket 整体提升约 6%。

venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/com.title: Hierarchical Graph Information Bottleneck for Multi-Behavior Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/com.description: [RecSys 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用信息瓶颈原理重构多行为层次推荐，以 InfoNCE 保真、HSIC 压缩、可学习边丢弃去噪，全库排序下 HR@10 最高提升 15.08%。

venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/com.title: Dual-Channel Multiplex Graph Neural Networks for Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/com.description: [TKDE 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 双通道多路图网络显式建模行为模式、隐式挖掘关系链依赖，三数据集全指标平均提升 10%+

venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/com.title: Efficient Multi-task Prompt Tuning for Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/com.description: [TOIS 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 提出两阶段 MPT-Rec：GAN 解耦任务共享/特有信息后冻结主干，仅用任务感知 Prompt 微调新任务，参数降至 10% 且性能保持 95%+。

venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/com.title: Towards Personalized Federated Multi-Scenario Multi-Task Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/com.description: [WSDM 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 首个联邦多场景多任务推荐框架 PF-MSMTrec，通过专家参数解耦、联邦批归一化与冲突协调缓解数据/模型/任务三级冲突，AliExpress 与 Tenrec 上 CTR/CTCVR AUC 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/com.title: CPMR: Context-Aware Incremental Sequential Recommendation with Pseudo-Multi-Task Learning
venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/com.description: [CIKM 2023][序列与会话推荐] 提出伪多任务学习范式，用历史图与上下文图双通道演化用户/物品时序状态，在四个数据集上 MRR 平均提升 30.98%。

venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/mop.title: KERL: Knowledge-Enhanced Personalized Recipe Recommendation using Large Language Models
venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/mop.description: [ACL 2025][LLM4Rec] 用 FoodKG 子图作上下文 + 多 LoRA 适配器，统一完成约束食谱推荐、烹饪步骤生成与微量营养素估计，KGQA 基准 F1 达 0.973。

venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/mop.title: Eating for a Sustainable Planet: Personalized Sustainable Diet Recommendation via Constraint-Aware Decision-Making Modeling
venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/mop.description: [ICML 2026][冷启动与长尾推荐] 将可持续饮食推荐重构为约束感知决策问题，用可学习用户约束阈值替代偏好建模，在自建 SusDiet 上兼顾偏好精度与四维可持续性。

venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/mop.title: Bites of Tomorrow: Personalized Recommendations for a Healthier and Greener Plate
venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/mop.description: [AAAI 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 提出绿色食品推荐任务 GRAPE，用双注意力建模用户对可持续指标的动态偏好，并以两种 Green Loss 在保精度前提下提升推荐列表绿色度。

venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/mop.title: Review-driven Personalized Preference Reasoning with Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/mop.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用评论抽取偏好画像并蒸馏逐步推理，评分预测与重排双任务均超 CF 与 LLM 基线，解释性显著提升

venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/mop.title: HARPO: Hierarchical Agentic Reasoning for User-Aligned Conversational Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/multi_task_reranking/mop.description: [ACL 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 将对话推荐重构为多维质量驱动的结构化决策，用分层偏好奖励引导树搜索推理，ReDial R@10 达 29.8%（+18.7%）。

venues/KDD/2025/multimodal_rec/findrec_s.title: PRISM: Personalized Recommendation via Information Synergy Module
venues/KDD/2025/multimodal_rec/findrec_s.description: [WWW 2026][多模态推荐] 用 MoE 显式分解模态唯一/冗余/协同信息并以用户偏好动态重加权，即插即用提升三类序列骨干，Yelp N@10 超最强基线 10.91%。

venues/KDD/2025/multimodal_rec/findrec_s.title: Efficient Multimodal Streaming Recommendation via Expandable Side Mixture-of-Experts
venues/KDD/2025/multimodal_rec/findrec_s.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 冻结 BERT/ViT 主干，用可扩展侧调 MoE 增量吸收新时段知识并按利用率剪枝，在三个流式数据集上 HR@10 全面超越 SOTA 且显存/训练时间更省。

venues/KDD/2025/multimodal_rec/findrec_s.title: TimeMM: Time-as-Operator Spectral Filtering for Dynamic Multimodal Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/multimodal_rec/findrec_s.description: [SIGIR 2026][多模态推荐] 将交互新近度映射为时间核加权图算子族，隐式实现免特征分解的多尺度谱滤波，配合自适应算子混合与模态路由，全库排序下 R@20 相对提升 3%–10%。

venues/KDD/2025/multimodal_rec/findrec_s.title: Multi-modal Adaptive Mixture of Experts for Cold-start Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/multimodal_rec/findrec_s.description: [CIKM 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 用双层 MoE（模态专属专家+动态门控融合）替代拼接/平均融合，在 Amazon 三域冷启动全库排序上 Recall@10 最高提升 16.17%。

venues/KDD/2025/multimodal_rec/findrec_s.title: Beyond Graph Convolution: Multimodal Recommendation with Topology-aware MLPs
venues/KDD/2025/multimodal_rec/findrec_s.description: [AAAI 2025][多模态推荐] 用拓扑剪枝+邻域对齐损失替代GCN消息传递，以MLP建模多模态物品关系，全库排序下Recall@10最高提升7.53%

venues/KDD/2025/multimodal_rec/mdvt_enha.title: VI-MMRec: Similarity-Aware Training Cost-free Virtual User-Item Interactions for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/multimodal_rec/mdvt_enha.description: [KDD 2026][多模态推荐] 用模态相似度构造虚拟交互矩阵并以统计权重融合，零训练开销即插即用地缓解多模态推荐数据稀疏，Full-Ranking 下 Recall@10 最高提升 22.25%。

venues/KDD/2025/multimodal_rec/mdvt_enha.title: I$^3$-MRec: Invariant Learning with Information Bottleneck for Incomplete Modality Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/multimodal_rec/mdvt_enha.description: [ACM MM 2025][多模态推荐] 将各模态视为独立语义环境做 IRM 不变学习，并用 IB 压缩模态特有信息，在模态缺失场景下 Full-Ranking Recall@20 稳定提升 2%–4%。

venues/KDD/2025/multimodal_rec/mdvt_enha.title: Personalized Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Foundation Models for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/multimodal_rec/mdvt_enha.description: [WWW 2026][多模态推荐] 按兴趣分群并为每群挂载独立 PEFT 模块，使 CLIP 编码出用户条件化的物品表征，配合群内难负采样，NDCG@20 最高提升 15.3%。

venues/KDD/2025/multimodal_rec/mdvt_enha.title: Efficient Multimodal Streaming Recommendation via Expandable Side Mixture-of-Experts
venues/KDD/2025/multimodal_rec/mdvt_enha.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 冻结 BERT/ViT 主干，用可扩展侧调 MoE 增量吸收新时段知识并按利用率剪枝，在三个流式数据集上 HR@10 全面超越 SOTA 且显存/训练时间更省。

venues/KDD/2025/multimodal_rec/mdvt_enha.title: Well Begun is Half Done: Training-Free and Model-Agnostic Semantically Guaranteed User Representation Initialization for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/multimodal_rec/mdvt_enha.description: [SIGIR 2026][多模态推荐] 用交互物品模态特征+聚类全局语义免训练初始化用户表征，弥合用户-物品语义鸿沟，六模型四数据集Recall@5最高提升36.4%。

venues/KDD/2025/multimodal_rec/notellm_2.title: Do Recommender Systems Really Leverage Multimodal Content? A Comprehensive Analysis on Multimodal Representations for Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/multimodal_rec/notellm_2.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 用受控噪声实验证明多模态增益源于语义而非模型容量，并以 LVLM 结构化提示生成「原生多模态」[EOS] 嵌入替代晚期融合，Borda 聚合排名第一。

venues/KDD/2025/multimodal_rec/notellm_2.title: Are Multimodal Embeddings Truly Beneficial for Recommendation? A Deep Dive into Whole vs. Individual Modalities
venues/KDD/2025/multimodal_rec/notellm_2.description: [ECIR 2026][多模态推荐] 用模态剔除（常量/噪声替换）在14个模型上做受控实证，发现文本主导、图像近乎无效，简单融合基线增益源于架构伪影。

venues/KDD/2025/multimodal_rec/notellm_2.title: Harnessing Multimodal Large Language Models for Multimodal Sequential Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/multimodal_rec/notellm_2.description: [AAAI 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 MLLM 将商品图转为文本摘要，再以循环式提示推断动态用户偏好，SFT 微调 LLaVA 做多模态序列推荐，AUC 最高提升约 4.3%。

venues/KDD/2025/multimodal_rec/notellm_2.title: Multimodal Large Language Models with Adaptive Preference Optimization for Sequential Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/multimodal_rec/notellm_2.description: [SIGIR 2026][LLM4Rec] 面向 MLLM 序列推荐，用难度感知重加权 DPO + 高斯噪声正则分布优化，缓解样本难度失衡与跨模态语义偏差，三数据集 NDCG@3 提升 7.4%–11.0%。

venues/KDD/2025/multimodal_rec/notellm_2.title: Efficient and Effective Adaptation of Multimodal Foundation Models in Sequential Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/multimodal_rec/notellm_2.description: [TKDE 2025][多模态推荐] IISAN-Versa 用解耦 PEFT + 组 LayerDrop + 维度变换层，统一适配对称/非对称多模态基础模型，缓存隐藏态后 GPU 显存降 12–15 倍、训练提速 16–20 倍，MicroLens 达 SOTA。

venues/KDD/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/g.title: Understanding Generative Recommendation with Semantic IDs from a Model-scaling View
venues/KDD/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/g.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐] 揭示 SID 式生成推荐在编码器/量化器/RS 三轴扩展均快速饱和，归因于 SID 语义容量瓶颈，并证明 Text-based GR 具备更优扩展性且 CF 能力随规模提升。

venues/KDD/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/g.title: Think2Go: Generative Next POI Recommendation with LLM Reasoning
venues/KDD/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/g.description: [KDD 2026][时空轨迹与POI推荐] 统一SFT与RL推理的生成式Next-POI框架，用KDE时空认知不确定性与难度感知奖励差校准优势函数，Acc@1较GNPR提升5.8–7.5%。

venues/KDD/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/g.title: Multi-Aspect Cross-modal Quantization for Generative Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/g.description: [AAAI 2026][生成式推荐] 在 RQ-VAE 量化各层注入跨模态对比与重建对齐，并在 GR 训练中加隐式/显式对齐，Full-Ranking 下 HR@10 最高提升约 9.4%。

venues/KDD/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/g.title: SPRIG: Semantic-ID-enhanced Paths for Knowledge Graph-based Generative Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/g.description: [CIKM 2026][生成式推荐] 将内容派生的分层语义 ID 注入知识图谱路径语言建模，以 768 个共享码替代逐物品词表，nDCG@10 较 KGGLM 提升 44%/58% 且参数与算力更低。

venues/KDD/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/g.title: Distinguished Quantized Guidance for Diffusion-based Sequence Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/g.description: [WWW 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用语义码本量化序列增强扩散引导，并以对比差异最大化抑制流行度偏置生成，四数据集全库排序全面领先。

venues/KDD/2025/rl_bandit_rec/a_unified_.title: Incentivized Exploration with Stochastic Covariates: A Two-Stage Mechanism Design for Recommender System
venues/KDD/2025/rl_bandit_rec/a_unified_.description: [ICML 2026][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 面向在线随机用户协变量的激励相容探索，提出两阶段 RCB 算法（冷启动补贴 + 逆比例间隙采样），在满足 ε-DBIC 约束下达到 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{KdT})$ 遗憾。

venues/KDD/2025/rl_bandit_rec/a_unified_.title: Identifying Offline Metrics that Predict Online Impact: A Pragmatic Strategy for Real-World Recommender Systems
venues/KDD/2025/rl_bandit_rec/a_unified_.description: [RecSys 2025][CTR/CVR 预估与特征交叉] 用帕累托前沿近似单模型多偏好分流，在 OTTO 线上实验验证 Recall@20→CTR、OD@20→CVR、乘积→销量 的离线-在线对齐关系。

venues/KDD/2025/rl_bandit_rec/a_unified_.title: Uncertainty-Aware Adaptive Recommendation across User Lifecycle
venues/KDD/2025/rl_bandit_rec/a_unified_.description: [KDD 2026][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用 EPE Critic 与经验贝叶斯先验方差量化逐样本认知不确定性，对低活跃用户风险规避降权、高活跃用户 UCB 探索加成，14 天线上 A/B 验证留存与多样性双收益。

venues/KDD/2025/rl_bandit_rec/a_unified_.title: Heterogeneous Multi-treatment Uplift Modeling for Trade-off Optimization in Short-Video Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/rl_bandit_rec/a_unified_.description: [KDD 2026][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用异构多处理增益建模+在线动态权重，个性化权衡短视频消费与商业化指标，快手全量部署

venues/KDD/2025/rl_bandit_rec/a_unified_.title: GraphEx: A Graph-based Extraction Method for Advertiser Keyphrase Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/rl_bandit_rec/a_unified_.description: [ICDE 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用二分图从商品标题抽取关键词排列，绕开点击数据偏差，CPU 毫秒级推理，线上广告收入提升 8.3%。

venues/KDD/2025/rl_bandit_rec/an_adaptab.title: DARA: Few-shot Budget Allocation in Online Advertising via In-Context Decision Making with RL-Finetuned LLMs
venues/KDD/2025/rl_bandit_rec/an_adaptab.description: [WWW 2026][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 双阶段 LLM 智能体分离少样本规划与精细优化，配合动态参考策略 GRPO-Adaptive 微调，在真实与合成广告环境中显著降低边际 ROI 方差。

venues/KDD/2025/rl_bandit_rec/an_adaptab.title: AHBid: An Adaptable Hierarchical Bidding Framework for Cross-Channel Advertising
