venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/glint_ru_.description: [RecSys 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用对比熵惊讶度动态切分长交互序列为变长行为块，在 FLOPs 匹配下 NDCG@10 最高提升 21.1%，实现更优效率-精度前沿。

venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/multi_gra.title: RoTE: Coarse-to-Fine Multi-Level Rotary Time Embedding for Sequential Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/multi_gra.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 将时间戳分解为年/月/日多粒度并借 RoPE 旋转注入 Q/K，即插即用提升 SASRec/RPG，NDCG@5 最高 +20.11%

venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/multi_gra.title: SIGMA: Selective Gated Mamba for Sequential Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/multi_gra.description: [AAAI 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用部分翻转双向 Mamba + 输入敏感稠密门控 + FE-GRU 解决 Mamba 单向性与短序列状态不稳问题，五数据集 Full-Ranking 上 HR@10 最高提升 8.82%。

venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/multi_gra.title: Empowering Sequential Recommendation from Collaborative Signals and Semantic Relatedness
venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/multi_gra.description: [DASFAA 2024][序列与会话推荐] 双流 Transformer 分别编码 ID 与内容序列，用用户级/物品级分层对比对齐跨模态语义鸿沟，全库排序下 NDCG@10 最高提升 15.44%。

venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/multi_gra.title: CPMR: Context-Aware Incremental Sequential Recommendation with Pseudo-Multi-Task Learning
venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/multi_gra.description: [CIKM 2023][序列与会话推荐] 提出伪多任务学习范式，用历史图与上下文图双通道演化用户/物品时序状态，在四个数据集上 MRR 平均提升 30.98%。

venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/multi_gra.title: Bridge the Domains: Large Language Models Enhanced Cross-domain Sequential Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/multi_gra.description: [SIGIR 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用 LLM 语义嵌入+分层画像桥接跨域物品与用户偏好，破解重叠困境与转移复杂性，三数据集 H@10 最高提升 31.7%。

venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/time_matt.title: RoTE: Coarse-to-Fine Multi-Level Rotary Time Embedding for Sequential Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/time_matt.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 将时间戳分解为年/月/日多粒度并借 RoPE 旋转注入 Q/K，即插即用提升 SASRec/RPG，NDCG@5 最高 +20.11%

venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/time_matt.title: Decoupled Temporal Encoding for Generative Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/time_matt.description: [CIKM 2026][生成式推荐] 将宏观时间动态与微观序列顺序解耦的双模块位置编码，工业数据集 GAUC +1.16pt，线上 CTR +1.8%、RPM +3.0%，延迟仅 +0.3%。

venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/time_matt.title: Temporal Linear Item-Item Model for Sequential Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/time_matt.description: [WSDM 2025][序列与会话推荐] 在闭式解线性 item-item 模型上引入时间间隔加权与趋势感知归一化，Full-Ranking 下平均 NDCG@10 提升 9.07%，训练快 6.9–57 倍。

venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/time_matt.title: Modeling Stage-wise Evolution of User Interests for News Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/time_matt.description: [WWW 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用全局LightGCN+阶段时序子图LSTM/自注意力双分支建模新闻兴趣演化，Adressa AUC 0.7993 大幅超越SOTA。

venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/time_matt.title: Not Just What, But When: Integrating Irregular Intervals to LLM for Sequential Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/time_matt.description: [RecSys 2025][序列与会话推荐] 将不规则时间间隔经 MLP 编码与 Interval-Infused Attention 注入 LLaMA-2，配合选项化提示，在 3 个 Amazon 数据集上 HR@1 平均提升 4.4%，并提出“间隔冷启动”新评测视角。

venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/unlocking.title: SimDiffRec: Semantic Similarity-Guided Diffusion for Contrastive Sequential Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/unlocking.description: [WSDM 2026][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 用语义相似物品均值替代高斯随机噪声做扩散增强，按去噪置信度选增强位置并配难负采样，五数据集 Full-Ranking 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/unlocking.title: Empowering Denoising Sequential Recommendation with Large Language Model Embeddings
venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/unlocking.description: [CIKM 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 用 LLM 语义嵌入与协同嵌入做跨模态兴趣对齐，缓解冷门物品过度去噪，四数据集全排序 HR/NDCG 显著提升。

venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/unlocking.title: LLM2Rec: Large Language Models Are Powerful Embedding Models for Sequential Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/unlocking.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 两阶段将 LLM 改造为融合协同信号与语义的物品嵌入模型，Full-Ranking 下域内平均提升约 15%、跨域仍稳定增益。

venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/unlocking.title: Distinguished Quantized Guidance for Diffusion-based Sequence Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/unlocking.description: [WWW 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用语义码本量化序列增强扩散引导，并以对比差异最大化抑制流行度偏置生成，四数据集全库排序全面领先。

venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/unlocking.title: Addressing Missing Data Issue for Diffusion-based Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/unlocking.description: [SIGIR 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用双侧 Thompson 采样在引导序列中模拟缺失数据，以一致性正则化让扩散推荐模型外推抵抗真实缺失，YooChoose NDCG@20 提升 26.95%。

venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/why_not_t.title: Balancing Fine-tuning and RAG: A Hybrid Strategy for Dynamic LLM Recommendation Updates
venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/why_not_t.description: [RecSys 2025][LLM4Rec] 以十亿用户短视频兴趣探索系统为案例，量化对比微调与RAG的更新代价/敏捷性，提出月度微调+周内RAG刷新的混合更新策略，线上A/B显著提升满意度。

venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/why_not_t.title: Think before Recommendation: Autonomous Reasoning-enhanced Recommender
venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/why_not_t.description: [NeurIPS 2025][LLM4Rec] 用纯 GRPO 强化学习替代教师蒸馏，让单个 LLM 自主习得「用户分析→物品分析→匹配→打分」推理链，评分预测 MAE 最高降 29.9%。

venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/why_not_t.title: Towards Next-Generation Recommender Systems: A Benchmark for Personalized Recommendation Assistant with LLMs
venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/why_not_t.description: [WSDM 2026][大语言模型推荐] 构建 RecBench+ 约3万条复杂用户查询基准，覆盖显式/隐式/误导条件与画像偏好，系统评测7个LLM并揭示SFT+RFT两阶段微调最优。

venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/why_not_t.title: Review-driven Personalized Preference Reasoning with Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/why_not_t.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用评论抽取偏好画像并蒸馏逐步推理，评分预测与重排双任务均超 CF 与 LLM 基线，解释性显著提升

venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/why_not_t.title: IntSR: An Integrated Generative Framework for Search and Recommendation
venues/KDD/2025/sequential_rec/why_not_t.description: [CIKM 2026][生成式推荐] 以 query 模态统一搜索/推荐与召回/排序四任务，提出 query 驱动解码器与时间对齐负采样，Amap 线上 GMV+9.34%。

venues/KDD/2026/agent_conversational_rec.title: From Recall to Forgetting: Benchmarking Long-Term Memory for Personalized Agents
venues/KDD/2026/agent_conversational_rec.description: [ACL 2026 Findings][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出 Memora 长周期记忆基准与 FAMA 遗忘感知指标，揭示 LLM 与记忆智能体在记忆突变下频繁复用失效记忆。

venues/KDD/2026/agent_conversational_rec.title: Improving Item Discoverability in e-Commerce Search via Related Intent Generation
venues/KDD/2026/agent_conversational_rec.description: [KDD 2026 TSMO][LLM4Rec] 用闭源LLM+蒸馏SLM生成替代/互补/主题三类隐式意图以扩展电商搜索召回，会话购买预测与LLM评审双轨评估，覆盖流量60%→80%、成本仅30%。

venues/KDD/2026/agent_conversational_rec.title: Personalized Recommendation Tool Learning via Autonomous Language Agents
venues/KDD/2026/agent_conversational_rec.description: [RecSys 2026][LLM4Rec] 让 LLM 智能体做个性化工具选择、传统推荐模型做全库打分，以架构设计绕开幻觉与上下文长度限制，Full-Ranking 下 R@10 最高提升 68.8%。

venues/KDD/2026/agent_conversational_rec.title: AgentDR: Dynamic Recommendation with Implicit Item-Item Relations via LLM-based Agents
venues/KDD/2026/agent_conversational_rec.description: [WWW 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 将全库排序委托给传统推荐工具，用 LLM Agent 做个性化工具加权与替代/互补关系重排，全排序平均提升约两倍。

venues/KDD/2026/agent_conversational_rec.title: Do LLMs Memorize Recommendation Datasets? A Preliminary Study on MovieLens-1M
venues/KDD/2026/agent_conversational_rec.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用少样本提示探测 GPT/Llama 对 MovieLens-1M 的物品、用户与交互记忆覆盖率，揭示记忆量与推荐性能强相关且放大流行度偏置。

venues/KDD/2026/agent_conversational_rec.title: Toward Holistic Evaluation of Recommender Systems Powered by Generative Models
venues/KDD/2026/agent_conversational_rec.description: [SIGIR 2025][去偏公平与工业评测] 提出 Gen-RecSys 评估挑战二分法与 WH-六问 + 三维目标(D1–D5)整体评估框架，用场景化案例揭示传统 NDCG 无法覆盖的幻觉、偏见与政策合规风险。

venues/KDD/2026/agent_conversational_rec.title: Datasets for Navigating Sensitive Topics in Recommendation Systems
venues/KDD/2026/agent_conversational_rec.description: [WWW 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 构建 ML-DDD 与 AO3 两个带敏感内容警告标签的推荐数据集，提出 Warning Amplification 指标，发现个性化 CF 反而去放大敏感内容。

venues/KDD/2026/agent_conversational_rec.title: Prompt-Unknown Promotion Attacks against LLM-based Sequential Recommender Systems
venues/KDD/2026/agent_conversational_rec.description: [SIGIR 2026][LLM推荐] 在系统提示词与受害模型均不可见的全黑盒设定下，用进化式提示蒸馏+代理模型+文本与行为双投毒实现长尾商品推广攻击，Beauty 上 HR@10 提升约 3.9 倍。

venues/KDD/2026/agent_conversational_rec.title: Improving Conversational Recommendation with Contextual Adaptation of External Recommenders and LLM-based Reranking
venues/KDD/2026/agent_conversational_rec.description: [ECIR 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用轻量实体级序列推荐器产出候选、LLM 做上下文适配重排，ReDial/INSPIRED 上 H@5 平均提升 54%/25%。

venues/KDD/2026/agent_conversational_rec.title: Privacy Risks of LLM-Empowered Recommender Systems: An Inversion Attack Perspective
venues/KDD/2026/agent_conversational_rec.description: [RecSys 2025][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 首次系统研究 LLM 推荐系统的 logits 反演攻击，提出相似度引导精炼，可恢复 65% 交互物品与 87% 年龄性别。

venues/KDD/2026/cold_start_rec/denoising.title: Shallow AutoEncoding Recommender with Cold Start Handling via Side Features
venues/KDD/2026/cold_start_rec/denoising.description: [CIKM 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 将用户/物品侧特征拼入 EASE 输入矩阵，并用内容相似度矩阵作冷物品权重先验，闭式解统一处理双冷启动。

venues/KDD/2026/cold_start_rec/denoising.title: Post-Training Denoising of User Profiles with LLMs in Collaborative Filtering Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/cold_start_rec/denoising.description: [ECIR 2026][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 用 LLM 零样本/少样本提示在推理前清洗用户画像，无需重训 CF 模型即获最高 13% NDCG/HR 提升。

venues/KDD/2026/cold_start_rec/denoising.title: On Inherited Popularity Bias in Cold-Start Item Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/cold_start_rec/denoising.description: [RecSys 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 揭示生成式冷启动模型继承热模型流行度偏置，提出基于向量模长重标定的免训练后处理去偏方法，在三个多媒体数据集上显著提升物品公平性与曝光多样性。

venues/KDD/2026/cold_start_rec/denoising.title: Empowering Denoising Sequential Recommendation with Large Language Model Embeddings
venues/KDD/2026/cold_start_rec/denoising.description: [CIKM 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 用 LLM 语义嵌入与协同嵌入做跨模态兴趣对齐，缓解冷门物品过度去噪，四数据集全排序 HR/NDCG 显著提升。

venues/KDD/2026/cold_start_rec/denoising.title: Unleashing the Power of Large Language Model for Denoising Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/cold_start_rec/denoising.description: [WWW 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] LLaRD 用 LLM 生成偏好知识与图 CoT 关系知识，再以信息瓶颈对齐去噪图，Full-Ranking 下 Recall@20 最高提升约 14%。

venues/KDD/2026/cold_start_rec/pinequali.title: Item-centric Exploration for Cold Start Problem
venues/KDD/2026/cold_start_rec/pinequali.description: [RecSys 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 提出以物品为中心的 Beta 后验过滤控制，在排序后剔除“错配受众”曝光，线上探索曝光降 20% 而满意度升 50%、可推荐语料扩 10%。

venues/KDD/2026/cold_start_rec/pinequali.title: InteractRank: Personalized Web-Scale Search Pre-Ranking with Cross Interaction Features
venues/KDD/2026/cold_start_rec/pinequali.description: [WWW 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 在双塔预排序点积之上叠加历史交互统计特征 IQP 与实时用户序列，以 1.1× FLOPs 实现线上 SIFR +6.5%、F1S +9.2%。

venues/KDD/2026/cold_start_rec/pinequali.title: SocRipple: A Two-Stage Framework for Cold-Start Video Recommendations
venues/KDD/2026/cold_start_rec/pinequali.description: [RecSys 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 社交种子+嵌入KNN涟漪扩散的两阶段冷启视频召回框架，Recall@200 提升至 12.8–13.2%，线上冷启曝光 +36% 且互动率持平。

venues/KDD/2026/cold_start_rec/pinequali.title: TransAct V2: Lifelong User Action Sequence Modeling on Pinterest Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/cold_start_rec/pinequali.description: [CIKM 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用 NN 检索压缩终身序列 + 下一动作对比损失 + Triton 融合推理，Pinterest 线上 Repin +6.35%、Hide -12.80%。

venues/KDD/2026/cold_start_rec/pinequali.title: GenPage: Towards End-to-End Generative Homepage Construction at Netflix
venues/KDD/2026/cold_start_rec/pinequali.description: [RecSys 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义 ID] 用单个 Transformer 将用户上下文 token 化后自回归生成整页多行首页，WBC/RL 后训练，线上 +0.24% 核心参与度且延迟降 20%。

venues/KDD/2026/collaborative_filtering/.title: Memory Is No Longer a Bottleneck: Memory-Efficient Graph Filtering for Scalable Collaborative Filtering
venues/KDD/2026/collaborative_filtering/.description: [TKDE 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用逐用户 Krylov 子空间替代全量物品相似度图，实现免训练多项式图滤波，内存降 5.74×、推理加速 26× 且精度反超 SOTA。

venues/KDD/2026/collaborative_filtering/.title: SGCL: Unifying Self-Supervised and Supervised Learning for Graph Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/collaborative_filtering/.description: [RecSys 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 将 BPR 与 InfoNCE 合并为单一监督图对比损失，免增广免负采样，精度与训练效率双超 SGL/SimGCL。

venues/KDD/2026/collaborative_filtering/.title: RaDAR: Relation-aware Diffusion-Asymmetric Graph Contrastive Learning for Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/collaborative_filtering/.description: [WWW 2026][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 以 VGAE 生成视图与关系感知去噪视图构成双视图，叠加扩散引导增广与非对称对比目标，在 Full-Ranking 下 Recall@20 相对 SOTA 提升 3.8%–4.7%。

venues/KDD/2026/collaborative_filtering/.title: Enhancing Graph Contrastive Learning with Reliable and Informative Augmentation for Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/collaborative_filtering/.description: [KDD 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 用端到端多级向量量化学习离散码，将码作为虚拟邻居与语义正样本构建三重对比视图，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@10 最高提升 17.5%。

venues/KDD/2026/collaborative_filtering/.title: NLGCL: Naturally Existing Neighbor Layers Graph Contrastive Learning for Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/collaborative_filtering/.description: [RecSys 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 用 GNN 相邻层天然异构节点作正样本对替代图增广，免视图构建，全库排序下 NDCG@10 最高提升 12.41% 且训练最快。

venues/KDD/2026/collaborative_filtering/.title: Large Language Models Enhanced Hyperbolic Space Recommender Systems
venues/KDD/2026/collaborative_filtering/.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] HyperLLM 用 LLM 生成层级标签与偏好摘要，经元优化两阶段训练将结构/语义层级信息注入双曲推荐，Recall@20 最高提升 41.7%。

venues/KDD/2026/collaborative_filtering/.title: Leveraging Geometric Insights in Hyperbolic Triplet Loss for Improved Recommendations
venues/KDD/2026/collaborative_filtering/.description: [RecSys 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 洛伦兹双曲三元组损失 TriplH，以物品-物品项自适应间隔替代固定 margin，兼顾精度、去流行度偏差与 3 倍推理加速。

venues/KDD/2026/collaborative_filtering/.title: Review-Based Hyperbolic Cross-Domain Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/collaborative_filtering/.description: [WSDM 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 将评论文本嵌入双曲空间做跨域推荐，用度数归一化与尺度对齐避免域对齐引发的层级坍塌，NDCG@10 较 SER 提升约 10.4%。

venues/KDD/2026/collaborative_filtering/.title: HypRQ-VAE: Hyperbolic Item Indexing for Long-Tail-Aware Generative Recommender Systems
venues/KDD/2026/collaborative_filtering/.description: [ICDM 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 将 RQ-VAE 语义 ID 量化搬进 Poincaré 双曲球，用 Möbius 加减替代欧氏残差，长尾 Hit@10 提升 52.7%，全库排序验证。

venues/KDD/2026/collaborative_filtering/.title: Interactive Visualization Recommendation with Hier-SUCB
venues/KDD/2026/collaborative_filtering/.description: [WWW 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 将可视化推荐建模为带可学习偏置项的分层上下文组合半臂老虎机，把遗憾界从 $O(\sqrt{T\ln^3(nm^2T\ln T)})$降至$O(\sqrt{T\ln^3(m^2T\ln T)})$，在 Plot.ly 上 80/160 轮超越离线 SOTA。

venues/KDD/2026/collaborative_filtering/.title: Improving Item Discoverability in e-Commerce Search via Related Intent Generation

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/collabora.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 两阶段将 LLM 改造为融合协同信号与语义的物品嵌入模型，Full-Ranking 下域内平均提升约 15%、跨域仍稳定增益。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/collabora.title: DP-Rec: Towards Dynamic Patching for Efficient Long-Sequence Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/collabora.description: [RecSys 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用对比熵惊讶度动态切分长交互序列为变长行为块，在 FLOPs 匹配下 NDCG@10 最高提升 21.1%，实现更优效率-精度前沿。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/flowtime_.title: Multi-Aspect Cross-modal Quantization for Generative Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/flowtime_.description: [AAAI 2026][生成式推荐] 在 RQ-VAE 量化各层注入跨模态对比与重建对齐，并在 GR 训练中加隐式/显式对齐，Full-Ranking 下 HR@10 最高提升约 9.4%。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/flowtime_.title: Effectiveness of LLMs in Temporal User Profiling for Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/flowtime_.description: [ICDM 2025 Workshop][LLM4Rec] 用 LLM 分别生成短期/长期自然语言画像，经 SBERT 编码与注意力融合做内容推荐，Movies&TV 上 Recall@10 相对提升 17%。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/flowtime_.title: Decoupled Temporal Encoding for Generative Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/flowtime_.description: [CIKM 2026][生成式推荐] 将宏观时间动态与微观序列顺序解耦的双模块位置编码，工业数据集 GAUC +1.16pt，线上 CTR +1.8%、RPM +3.0%，延迟仅 +0.3%。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/flowtime_.title: Mend the Measurement Gap: Latent User Preference Modeling for Short-Form Video Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/flowtime_.description: [RecSys 2026][多模态推荐] 将异构行为反馈视为隐价值状态的噪声测量，用受限基线+因子化路由瓶颈解耦时长混杂，YouTube Shorts 线上主指标提升 2.67%

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/flowtime_.title: CAMMSR: Category-Guided Attentive Mixture of Experts for Multimodal Sequential Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/flowtime_.description: [ICDE 2026][多模态推荐] 用类别预测任务引导注意力 MoE 动态分配模态权重，并以模态交换对比学习对齐跨模态序列表征，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@5 最高提升 15.3%。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/forge_for.title: What Makes a Good Semantic ID for Generative Recommendation? A Reproducibility Study
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/forge_for.description: [SIGIR-AP 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 统一协议下复现11种SID生成式推荐系统，揭示SID设计效果的非单调性：无普适最优设计、码本利用率与排序质量近乎零相关、骨干与码长扩展均非单调。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/forge_for.title: Revisiting Generative vs. Dense Retrieval: A Static Value Prior Reverses the Gap
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/forge_for.description: [CIKM 2026][生成式推荐] 在受控 GR/DR 对比下揭示指标选择反转胜负，用免训练静态价值先验重排 DR 即反超 GR 最佳物品价值并保持召回领先。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/forge_for.title: SIDInspector: A Mapping-First Diagnostic Resource for Semantic-ID Tokenizers
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/forge_for.description: [CIKM 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 提出映射优先的 SID 分词器诊断资源，用 D1–D5 探针在生成器训练前分离容量、可寻址性与行为前缀对齐，并给出四类分词器工件画像。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/forge_for.title: Mitigating Collaborative Semantic ID Staleness in Generative Retrieval
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/forge_for.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 提出模型无关的 SID 对齐更新，将刷新后的协同语义 ID 双部图匹配映射回旧词表，实现热启动微调，Recall@500 提升且训练算力降 8-9 倍。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/forge_for.title: Faithful Evaluation of Semantic-ID Tokenizers for Generative Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/forge_for.description: [CIKM 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 揭示SID碰撞导致SID级指标虚高至103.36%，提出碰撞校正评估CCE与零碰撞重分配ZCR，翻转多个Tokenizer排序。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/hi_sam_a_.title: Multi-Aspect Cross-modal Quantization for Generative Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/hi_sam_a_.description: [AAAI 2026][生成式推荐] 在 RQ-VAE 量化各层注入跨模态对比与重建对齐，并在 GR 训练中加隐式/显式对齐，Full-Ranking 下 HR@10 最高提升约 9.4%。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/hi_sam_a_.title: Progressive Semantic Residual Quantization for Multimodal-Joint Interest Modeling in Music Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/hi_sam_a_.description: [CIKM 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 提出前缀语义约束的渐进残差量化 PSRQ 与多码本交叉注意力 MCCA，缓解语义漂移与跨模态建模缺口，冷启动 AUC 显著提升并完成工业上线。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/hi_sam_a_.title: MoToRec: Sparse-Regularized Multimodal Tokenization for Cold-Start Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/hi_sam_a_.description: [AAAI 2026][冷启动与长尾推荐] 用稀疏正则化 RQ-VAE 将多模态特征离散化为组合语义码，配合稀有度放大与多源图编码，冷启动物品 N@20 最高提升 12.58%。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/hi_sam_a_.title: Universal Item Tokenization for Transferable Generative Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/hi_sam_a_.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用 MLLM+树状码本构建跨域通用物品分词器，结合内容重建与共现协同对齐，实现可迁移生成式推荐，全库排序下全面超越基线。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/hi_sam_a_.title: Do Recommender Systems Really Leverage Multimodal Content? A Comprehensive Analysis on Multimodal Representations for Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/hi_sam_a_.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 用受控噪声实验证明多模态增益源于语义而非模型容量，并以 LVLM 结构化提示生成「原生多模态」[EOS] 嵌入替代晚期融合，Borda 聚合排名第一。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/hierarchi.title: Learning from Unreachable Rewards: Hint-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning for Generative Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/hierarchi.description: [CIKM 2026][生成式推荐] 用 SFT 检查点诊断语义 ID 前缀树可达性，对不可达样本注入最短目标前缀提示并以提示感知信用分解（前缀 SFT + 后缀 GRPO）恢复学习信号，零优势组从 70%+ 降至 20% 以下。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/hierarchi.title: Bi-Level Optimization for Generative Recommendation: Bridging Tokenization and Generation
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/hierarchi.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 将分词器与推荐器建模为双层优化，用元学习+梯度手术让推荐损失直接监督RQ-VAE码本，Full-Ranking下全面超越TIGER/LETTER/ETEGRec。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/hierarchi.title: Rethinking Item Tokenization in Generative Recommenders: From Fixed Atoms to Semantic Subwords
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/hierarchi.description: [CIKM 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 指出固定长度SID复用于历史侧引发“物品内注意力过载”，提出历史侧语义子词重分词(IST)+行为共现增强(BCA)的非对称分词，三数据集三骨干全库排序NDCG@10最高+13.8%。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/hierarchi.title: Learning Decomposed Contextual Token Representations from Pretrained and Collaborative Signals for Generative Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/hierarchi.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] DECOR 用冻结码本+可学协同嵌入分解融合、上下文 token 组合与可学 BOS 查询，缓解静态分词歧义与预训练语义丢失，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@10 最高提升 14%。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/hierarchi.title: Token-level Collaborative Alignment for LLM-based Generative Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/hierarchi.description: [WWW 2026][LLM4Rec] 将CF物品级logits投影为token级分布并与one-hot融合成软标签，以soft-NTP损失显式对齐LLM生成，即插即用提升多骨干推荐效果。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/pcr_ca_pa.title: Bridging Textual-Collaborative Gap through Semantic Codes for Sequential Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/pcr_ca_pa.description: [KDD 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用多视图文本量化语义码作桥梁，以码为 Query 交叉注意力融合文本，配合双重掩码自监督，Full-Ranking 下 R@10 最高提升 20.1%。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/pcr_ca_pa.title: Multi-Aspect Cross-modal Quantization for Generative Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/pcr_ca_pa.description: [AAAI 2026][生成式推荐] 在 RQ-VAE 量化各层注入跨模态对比与重建对齐，并在 GR 训练中加隐式/显式对齐，Full-Ranking 下 HR@10 最高提升约 9.4%。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/pcr_ca_pa.title: Deep Multiple Quantization Network on Long Behavior Sequence for Click-Through Rate Prediction
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/pcr_ca_pa.description: [SIGIR 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用多码本量化将超长行为序列端到端压缩为约百个兴趣簇码字，配合 HSTU 簇间交互与候选感知注意力，消除两阶段检索的相关性分布偏差，线上 CTR +3.5%、RPM +2.0%。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/pcr_ca_pa.title: L2Rec: Towards Dual-View Understanding of LLMs for Personalized Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/pcr_ca_pa.description: [SIGIR 2026][大语言模型推荐] 以参数级双视图 LoRA-MoE 替代输入/输出级融合，个性化路由对齐行为与语义视图，四数据集 N@10 提升 3.87%–8.02%，线上 CTR +9.24%。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/pcr_ca_pa.title: Native Multimodal Representation Learning for Click-Through Rate Prediction in E-Commerce Scenarios
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/pcr_ca_pa.description: [CIKM 2026][多模态推荐] 揭示端到端联合训练在强预训练编码器上失效的根因（CTR 监督多模态不可解释+梯度不一致），提出 Mine-Then-Train 挖掘三元组微调编码器，线上 CTR +1.5%、RPM +0.5%。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/reasoning.title: S$^2$GR: Stepwise Semantic-Guided Reasoning in Latent Space for Generative Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/reasoning.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐] 在每级 SID 码生成前插入受码本聚类语义对比监督的思考 token，实现逐步可验证潜在推理，工业短视频 A/B 显著提升时长。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/reasoning.title: Token-level Collaborative Alignment for LLM-based Generative Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/reasoning.description: [WWW 2026][LLM4Rec] 将CF物品级logits投影为token级分布并与one-hot融合成软标签，以soft-NTP损失显式对齐LLM生成，即插即用提升多骨干推荐效果。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/reasoning.title: SPRIG: Semantic-ID-enhanced Paths for Knowledge Graph-based Generative Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/reasoning.description: [CIKM 2026][生成式推荐] 将内容派生的分层语义 ID 注入知识图谱路径语言建模，以 768 个共享码替代逐物品词表，nDCG@10 较 KGGLM 提升 44%/58% 且参数与算力更低。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/reasoning.title: FedCGR: Federated Cross-Domain Generative Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/reasoning.description: [CIKM 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 以固定 SID 词表为跨域通信接口，用可靠性感知 CF 残差与原型个性化聚合解决联邦生成式 CDR 的语义瓶颈与负迁移，全库排序下显著超越联邦生成基线。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/reasoning.title: Think2Go: Generative Next POI Recommendation with LLM Reasoning
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/reasoning.description: [KDD 2026][时空轨迹与POI推荐] 统一SFT与RL推理的生成式Next-POI框架，用KDE时空认知不确定性与难度感知奖励差校准优势函数，Acc@1较GNPR提升5.8–7.5%。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/s_2_gr_st.title: Reasoning over Semantic IDs Enhances Generative Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/s_2_gr_st.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 通过教师模型合成富化语料强化 SID-语言对齐，再用 GRPO 结果驱动强化学习激发 SID 推理，三数据集 Full-Ranking 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/s_2_gr_st.title: SPRIG: Semantic-ID-enhanced Paths for Knowledge Graph-based Generative Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/s_2_gr_st.description: [CIKM 2026][生成式推荐] 将内容派生的分层语义 ID 注入知识图谱路径语言建模，以 768 个共享码替代逐物品词表，nDCG@10 较 KGGLM 提升 44%/58% 且参数与算力更低。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/s_2_gr_st.title: Latent Residual Reasoning for Ranking in Generative Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/s_2_gr_st.description: [CIKM 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 在冻结的生成式排序骨干上叠加 LoRA 与残差推理头，用多步隐空间加性修正精化候选打分，公开集 GAUC 提升 2.7%–4.3%，线上 PV-CTR +0.75%。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/s_2_gr_st.title: Addressing Cross-Stage Decoupling of Semantic and Collaborative Signals in Generative Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/s_2_gr_st.description: [RecSys 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 提出 SCRec，通过协同增强分词、语义引导生成与双曲流形对齐三模块双向补全语义与协同信号，在 Amazon 三数据集 Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@10 相对提升 18.7%–26.6%。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/s_2_gr_st.title: MGFRec: Towards Reinforced Reasoning Recommendation with Multiple Groundings and Feedback
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/s_2_gr_st.description: [KDD 2026][大语言模型推荐] 将单步 grounding 扩展为多轮物品空间接地并引入用户 Agent 反馈，用 GRPO 训练 LLM 推理推荐，Full-Ranking 下 H@5 最高提升约 8.8%。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/uncertain.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 揭示 Beam Search 剪枝与 teacher-forcing 训练的前缀级不一致，用自适应最差前缀损失对齐训练与推理，全库排序下 Recall@20 最高提升 13.3%。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/uncertain.title: Harnessing Light for Cold-Start Recommendations: Leveraging Epistemic Uncertainty to Enhance Performance in User-Item Interactions
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/uncertain.description: [CIKM 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 用集成 CVAE 生成暖化嵌入，并以 Sinkhorn 散度版 PaiDE 估计认知不确定性做优化，在冷启动 CTR 上稳定超越 CVAR 等基线。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/uncertain.title: GFlowGR: Fine-tuning Generative Recommendation Frameworks with Generative Flow Networks
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/uncertain.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐] 将生成式推荐重构为集合级序列生成，用 GFlowNets 微调使生成概率正比于行为感知奖励，缓解曝光偏差，淘宝线上年收入相对提升 0.4%。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/uncertain.title: Inductive Generative Recommendation via Retrieval-based Speculation
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/uncertain.description: [AAAI 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义 ID] 将投机解码的草稿-验证范式迁移至生成式推荐，用归纳式检索器起草候选、GR 模型做目标感知验证，使语义 ID 生成模型具备新物品推荐能力。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/uncertain.description: [CIKM 2026][生成式推荐] 用 SFT 检查点诊断语义 ID 前缀树可达性，对不可达样本注入最短目标前缀提示并以提示感知信用分解（前缀 SFT + 后缀 GRPO）恢复学习信号，零优势组从 70%+ 降至 20% 以下。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/understan.title: Order-agnostic Identifier for Large Language Model-based Generative Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/understan.description: [SIGIR 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 提出无序集合标识符范式，用CF+语义多token集合表示物品并同时生成，T5上Recall@10平均提升约50%，推理提速8-18倍。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/understan.title: CARD: Non-Uniform Quantization of Visual Semantic Unit for Generative Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/understan.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 将文本/图像/协同信号渲染为统一视觉语义单元，并用可逆非均匀变换校正偏斜分布，提升码本利用率与生成式推荐精度。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/understan.description: [AAAI 2026][生成式推荐] 在 RQ-VAE 量化各层注入跨模态对比与重建对齐，并在 GR 训练中加隐式/显式对齐，Full-Ranking 下 HR@10 最高提升约 9.4%。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/understan.description: [RecSys 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 系统对比任务专属与跨任务语义ID构建策略，发现多任务双塔嵌入+统一RQ-KMeans语义ID在联合搜索推荐中取得最佳权衡。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/vectorizi.title: GRank: Towards Target-Aware and Streamlined Industrial Retrieval with a Generate-Rank Framework
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/vectorizi.description: [WWW 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用训练期目标注入把 Target-Aware 能力蒸馏进 MIPS 兼容生成器，再以轻量交叉注意力重排，免结构化索引实现 Recall@500 +30% 与 1.7× QPS。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/vectorizi.title: RankMixer: Scaling Up Ranking Models in Industrial Recommenders
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/vectorizi.description: [CIKM 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用无参多头Token Mixing替代自注意力、Per-token FFN隔离特征子空间，配合ReLU路由稀疏MoE，在抖音万亿级数据上将MFU从4.5%提至45%，参数扩100倍而延迟不增。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/vectorizi.title: Beyond Item IDs: Scaling Short-Form-Video Recommendation via Semantic-Native Long Sequence Modeling
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/vectorizi.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用深度截断 Bi-gram 语义 ID 替代正交 Video ID，并以无参时间折叠压缩 Transformer 将序列扩至 2000，线上满意观看时长 +1.42%。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/vectorizi.title: DualGR: Generative Retrieval with Long and Short-Term Interests Modeling
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/vectorizi.description: [WWW 2026][生成式推荐] 双分支长短期路由+桶内搜索式SID解码+曝光感知NTP损失，快手双列场景在线HR@1000达19.53%，A/B视频播放+0.527%。

venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/vectorizi.title: GenRec: A Preference-Oriented Generative Framework for Large-Scale Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/generative_rec/vectorizi.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 以 Page-wise NTP 解一对多歧义、线性 Token Merger 压缩 2× 输入、GRPO-SR 混合奖励对齐偏好，京东线上点击 +9.5%、成交 +8.7%。

venues/KDD/2026/graph_rec/how_do_graph_s.title: Graph Spectral Filtering with Chebyshev Interpolation for Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/graph_rec/how_do_graph_s.description: [SIGIR 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用切比雪夫插值逼近非线性图滤波器，直接以原始交互为信号，突破 LightGCN 的截断线性低通瓶颈，Full-Ranking 下全面 SOTA 且推理快 8.1 倍。

venues/KDD/2026/graph_rec/how_do_graph_s.title: Collaborative Filtering Meets Spectrum Shift: Connecting User-Item Interaction with Graph-Structured Side Information
venues/KDD/2026/graph_rec/how_do_graph_s.description: [KDD 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 揭示增广图频谱右移现象，提出仅含平移/缩放两因子的 SSC 校正，即插即用提升 LightGCN/JGCF 最高 23%，零额外开销。

venues/KDD/2026/graph_rec/how_do_graph_s.title: Frequency-aware Graph Signal Processing for Collaborative Filtering
venues/KDD/2026/graph_rec/how_do_graph_s.description: [WWW 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用级联高通-低通滤波捕获独有/共性特征、并行低通滤波捕获高阶邻域，免训练线性组合在六个数据集上 Full-Ranking 提升 2-5%。

venues/KDD/2026/graph_rec/how_do_graph_s.title: Enhancing Graph Collaborative Filtering with FourierKAN Feature Transformation
venues/KDD/2026/graph_rec/how_do_graph_s.description: [CIKM 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 用 Fourier KAN 替代 NGCF 中被误删的交互特征变换 W2，在 7:1:2 时间切分全库排序下 R@20 最高提升 7.8%，且可作即插即用骨干。

venues/KDD/2026/graph_rec/how_do_graph_s.title: PULSE: Socially-Aware User Representation Modeling Toward Parameter-Efficient Graph Collaborative Filtering
venues/KDD/2026/graph_rec/how_do_graph_s.description: [WWW 2026][社交与群组推荐] 用社区结构与社交邻居物品信号替代显式用户嵌入，参数降 50% 且 NDCG@20 提升 8-9%

venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/copersona_collab.title: Multifaceted User Modeling in Recommendation: A Federated Foundation Models Approach
venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/copersona_collab.description: [AAAI 2025][序列与会话推荐] 联邦场景下用组门控网络将用户分层路由到组级 FFN，配合用户私有 FFN 实现多面向个性化，CTR 任务 AUC 最高提升 1.16%。

venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/copersona_collab.title: PersonaX: A Recommendation Agent Oriented User Modeling Framework for Long Behavior Sequence
venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/copersona_collab.description: [ACL Findings 2025][LLM4Rec] 面向推荐智能体的离线多画像用户建模框架，用聚类+原型-多样性均衡采样压缩长行为序列，30-50%数据即超越全量基线并大幅降低在线延迟。

venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/copersona_collab.title: Customized Retrieval-Augmented Generation with LLM for Debiasing Recommendation Unlearning
venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/copersona_collab.description: [ICDM 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 将推荐遗忘重构为 RAG 检索端过滤问题，用三种检索策略实现用户级原子遗忘，平均加速 4.5× 且保留约 90% 原模型效用。

venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/copersona_collab.title: CoPL: Collaborative Preference Learning for Personalizing LLMs
venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/copersona_collab.description: [ACL 2025][LLM4Rec] 用用户-回复二部图协同过滤学习用户表征，结合 MoLE 路由个性化奖励模型，并支持无优化未见用户适配，在 UltraFeedback-P 等基准上显著超越个性化奖励模型基线。

venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/copersona_collab.title: PERSCEN: Learning Personalized Interaction Pattern and Scenario Preference for Multi-Scenario Matching
venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/copersona_collab.description: [KDD 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用用户专属特征图 + VQ 码本蒸馏场景感知偏好 + 渐进式 GLU 融合，在 KuaiRand/Alimama 四场景召回上全面超越 ADIN/SASS/M5。

venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/enriching_semant.title: Heterogeneous User Modeling for LLM-based Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/enriching_semant.description: [RecSys 2025][LLM4Rec] 用压缩提示+[USER]锚点token将跨域异构行为压成单一用户表征，并以域重要性平滑加权缓解域跷跷板，六域全库排序R@10最高提升约30%。

venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/enriching_semant.title: LettinGo: Explore User Profile Generation for Recommendation System
venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/enriching_semant.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 用多LLM探索开放式用户画像、以下游推荐成败构造偏好对、DPO对齐画像生成器，Amazon Books Acc 66.3%→70.4%。

venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/enriching_semant.title: ProMax: Exploring the Potential of LLM-derived Profiles with Distribution Shaping for Recommender Systems
venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/enriching_semant.description: [SIGIR 2026][LLM推荐] 将 LLM 画像视为检索信号而非融合特征，用双路分布重塑（监督+自监督）引导基座模型，LightGCN 上 NDCG@10 最高提升 8.44%。

venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/enriching_semant.title: The Mental World of Large Language Models in Recommendation: A Benchmark on Association, Personalization, and Knowledgeability
venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/enriching_semant.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出 LRWorld 基准（38K 样本/23M tokens），从关联、个性化、知识性三尺度十因素 31 任务系统评测数十个 LLM，揭示其在神经嵌入检索上的致命短板。

venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/enriching_semant.title: EAGER-LLM: Enhancing Large Language Models as Recommenders through Exogenous Behavior-Semantic Integration
venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/enriching_semant.description: [WWW 2025][大语言模型推荐] 以双源知识富集物品索引+非侵入多尺度对齐重建+退火适配器，将外源行为/语义信号注入 LLM 生成式推荐，Amazon 三数据集 Full-Ranking 下 Recall@10 最高提升 26.16%。

venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/improving_item_d.title: EAGER: Enrich-and-Align Generative Query Recommendation from Clicked Items in E-commerce Search
venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/improving_item_d.description: [EMNLP 2026 Industry][LLM4Rec] 两阶段生成式 I2Q 查询推荐：课程化 SFT 扩意图覆盖 + GRPO 混合奖励对齐线上约束，线上 UCTR +0.83%、Pay Count +3.49%。

venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/improving_item_d.title: GenFacet: End-to-End Generative Faceted Search via Multi-Task Preference Alignment in E-Commerce
venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/improving_item_d.description: [SIGIR 2026][大语言模型推荐] 将电商分面搜索重构为分面生成与查询改写两个耦合生成任务，经蒸馏+SFT+GRPO 对齐搜索效用，线上分面 CTR 相对提升 42.0%。

venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/improving_item_d.title: AI Guided Accelerator For Search Experience
venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/improving_item_d.description: [SIGIR 2025][序列与会话推荐] 挖掘电商查询转移链并做意图一致性过滤，再用 Solar-10B 指令微调生成多样化替代收敛查询，线上 CTR +32.2%、转化 +38.3%。

venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/improving_item_d.title: ItemRAG: Item-Based Retrieval-Augmented Generation for LLM-Based Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/improving_item_d.description: [SIGIR 2026][大语言模型推荐] 将 RAG 从粗粒度用户历史检索转向细粒度物品级检索，融合共购与语义信息，标准与冷启动场景全面超越用户级 RAG 基线。

venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/improving_item_d.title: Think-to-Personalize: Unifying Reasoning and Retrieval for User-Centric Personalized Dense Retrieval
venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/improving_item_d.description: [CIKM 2026][LLM推荐] 用 SFT+GRPO 两阶段让 LLM 显式推理用户历史生成意图增强查询并统一编码，Full-Ranking 下 Broad/LongTail 召回显著提升，线上订单量 +0.46%

venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/mgfrec_towards_r.title: R4ec: A Reasoning, Reflection, and Refinement Framework for Recommendation Systems
venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/mgfrec_towards_r.description: [RecSys 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用 actor/reflection 双小模型迭代反思精炼 LLM 知识，注入 CTR 主干，AUC 相对提升 2.5%+，线上收入 +2.2%。

venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/mgfrec_towards_r.title: Reason4Rec: Deliberative User Preference Alignment of Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/mgfrec_towards_r.description: [TKDE 2026][大语言模型推荐] 提出审慎推荐任务与三专家多步推理框架，用评论监督偏好蒸馏-匹配-预测，评分预测与排序全面领先。

venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/mgfrec_towards_r.title: ThinkRec: Thinking-based Recommendation via LLM
venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/mgfrec_towards_r.description: [WWW 2026][大语言模型推荐] 以合成推理链激活 LLM 的 System 2 思维，并用实例级 LoRA 专家融合适配异构用户，AUC 平均提升 7.96%。

venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/mgfrec_towards_r.title: AgentDR: Dynamic Recommendation with Implicit Item-Item Relations via LLM-based Agents
venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/mgfrec_towards_r.description: [WWW 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 将全库排序委托给传统推荐工具，用 LLM Agent 做个性化工具加权与替代/互补关系重排，全排序平均提升约两倍。

venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/mgfrec_towards_r.title: R$^2$ec: Towards Large Recommender Models with Reasoning
venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/mgfrec_towards_r.description: [NeurIPS 2025][LLM4Rec] 双头架构统一推理生成与物品打分，RecPO 融合奖励 RL 联合优化，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@10 最高提升 72%。

venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/mixture_of_exper.title: Knowledge Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation for LLM-based Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/mixture_of_exper.description: [ACL 2025][LLM4Rec] 用跳场知识子图索引+流行度选择性检索+GNN软提示，将KG结构知识注入冻结LLM，MovieLens-1M ACC 相对提升58.6%且推理仅慢0.14s

venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/mixture_of_exper.title: EAGER-LLM: Enhancing Large Language Models as Recommenders through Exogenous Behavior-Semantic Integration
venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/mixture_of_exper.description: [WWW 2025][大语言模型推荐] 以双源知识富集物品索引+非侵入多尺度对齐重建+退火适配器，将外源行为/语义信号注入 LLM 生成式推荐，Amazon 三数据集 Full-Ranking 下 Recall@10 最高提升 26.16%。

venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/mixture_of_exper.title: Balancing Fine-tuning and RAG: A Hybrid Strategy for Dynamic LLM Recommendation Updates
venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/mixture_of_exper.description: [RecSys 2025][LLM4Rec] 以十亿用户短视频兴趣探索系统为案例，量化对比微调与RAG的更新代价/敏捷性，提出月度微调+周内RAG刷新的混合更新策略，线上A/B显著提升满意度。

venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/mixture_of_exper.title: Comprehending Knowledge Graphs with Large Language Models for Recommender Systems
venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/mixture_of_exper.description: [SIGIR 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 用 LLM 理解 KG 局部子图并构建语义物品图做全局检索增强，离线预计算语义嵌入后接入 LightGCN，全库排序下全面超越 12 个基线。

venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/mixture_of_exper.title: Enhancing Collaborative Semantics of Language Model-Driven Recommendations via Graph-Aware Learning
venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/mixture_of_exper.description: [TKDE 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用多跳提示+图感知对比学习把 GNN 聚合意图注入 LLM，在三个 Amazon/Yelp 数据集 Full-Ranking 下 HR@10 最高提升约 15%。

venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/proex_a_unified_.title: LettinGo: Explore User Profile Generation for Recommendation System
venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/proex_a_unified_.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 用多LLM探索开放式用户画像、以下游推荐成败构造偏好对、DPO对齐画像生成器，Amazon Books Acc 66.3%→70.4%。

venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/proex_a_unified_.title: ProMax: Exploring the Potential of LLM-derived Profiles with Distribution Shaping for Recommender Systems
venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/proex_a_unified_.description: [SIGIR 2026][LLM推荐] 将 LLM 画像视为检索信号而非融合特征，用双路分布重塑（监督+自监督）引导基座模型，LightGCN 上 NDCG@10 最高提升 8.44%。

venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/proex_a_unified_.title: ThinkRec: Thinking-based Recommendation via LLM
venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/proex_a_unified_.description: [WWW 2026][大语言模型推荐] 以合成推理链激活 LLM 的 System 2 思维，并用实例级 LoRA 专家融合适配异构用户，AUC 平均提升 7.96%。

venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/proex_a_unified_.title: Review-driven Personalized Preference Reasoning with Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/proex_a_unified_.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用评论抽取偏好画像并蒸馏逐步推理，评分预测与重排双任务均超 CF 与 LLM 基线，解释性显著提升

venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/proex_a_unified_.title: Enriching Semantic Profiles into Knowledge Graph for Recommender Systems Using Large Language Models
venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/proex_a_unified_.description: [KDD 2026][LLM4Rec] 用 LLM 为 KG 全实体生成语义画像，以可逆加性注入+成对匹配对齐，Full-Ranking 下 Recall@40 最高提升 2.6%。

venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/whose_name_comes.title: Beyond Utility: Evaluating LLM as Recommender
venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/whose_name_comes.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出含历史长度敏感性、候选位置偏差、画像生成与幻觉四维的 LLM 推荐多维评测框架，揭示 LLM 在重排与冷启动占优但位置偏差严重。

venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/whose_name_comes.title: LLM-as-a-Judge for Evaluating System Responses in Conversational Music Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/whose_name_comes.description: [RecSys 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 首个以 400 条专家标注实证 LLM-as-a-Judge 在对话音乐推荐响应评估中与人类判断的对齐度，并给出条件化与规模选择指南。

venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/whose_name_comes.title: Towards Next-Generation Recommender Systems: A Benchmark for Personalized Recommendation Assistant with LLMs
venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/whose_name_comes.description: [WSDM 2026][大语言模型推荐] 构建 RecBench+ 约3万条复杂用户查询基准，覆盖显式/隐式/误导条件与画像偏好，系统评测7个LLM并揭示SFT+RFT两阶段微调最优。

venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/whose_name_comes.title: Balancing Fine-tuning and RAG: A Hybrid Strategy for Dynamic LLM Recommendation Updates
venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/whose_name_comes.description: [RecSys 2025][LLM4Rec] 以十亿用户短视频兴趣探索系统为案例，量化对比微调与RAG的更新代价/敏捷性，提出月度微调+周内RAG刷新的混合更新策略，线上A/B显著提升满意度。

venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/whose_name_comes.title: SciNUP: Natural Language User Interest Profiles for Scientific Literature Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/llm_rec/whose_name_comes.description: [ECIR 2026][大语言模型推荐] 构建千名作者的自然语言兴趣画像学术推荐基准，系统对比稀疏/稠密/LLM重排，RRF 融合达 NDCG@10 0.4481。

venues/KDD/2026/multi_task_reranking/deg.title: GReF: A Unified Generative Framework for Efficient Reranking via Ordered Multi-token Prediction
venues/KDD/2026/multi_task_reranking/deg.description: [CIKM 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用双向编码器+动态匹配自回归解码器统一生成式重排，Rerank-DPO 端到端对齐用户偏好，OMTP 多token并行解码将延迟压至 12.97ms，快手线上转发+2.98%。

venues/KDD/2026/multi_task_reranking/deg.title: NLGR: Utilizing Neighbor Lists for Generative Rerank in Personalized Recommendation Systems
venues/KDD/2026/multi_task_reranking/deg.description: [WWW 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用邻居列表相对奖励对齐评估器-生成器目标，并以采样式非自回归生成灵活跳转组合空间，美团线上 CTR +3.25%。

venues/KDD/2026/multi_task_reranking/deg.title: Hierarchical Residual Policy Optimization for Generative Recommendations
venues/KDD/2026/multi_task_reranking/deg.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 将物品级反馈分解为 SID 前缀残差信用，用 RRPO 做保守 token 级策略优化，KuaiSim 会话回报 10.53 vs 8.14，线上 IAA Target Cost 最高 +3.49%。

venues/KDD/2026/multi_task_reranking/deg.title: Breaking the Likelihood Trap: Consistent Generative Recommendation with Graph-structured Model
venues/KDD/2026/multi_task_reranking/deg.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用有向无环图解码器扩展非自回归生成空间，并以 Gumbel-Softmax 打通评估器梯度，破解似然陷阱，快手线上 Views +0.78%。

venues/KDD/2026/multi_task_reranking/deg.title: APAO: Bridging the Training-Inference Gap in Generative Recommendation via Adaptive Prefix-Aware Optimization
venues/KDD/2026/multi_task_reranking/deg.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 揭示 Beam Search 剪枝与 teacher-forcing 训练的前缀级不一致，用自适应最差前缀损失对齐训练与推理，全库排序下 Recall@20 最高提升 13.3%。

venues/KDD/2026/multi_task_reranking/one.title: Task-Blind No MORE: Multi-Task Information Flow in Unified Ranking Backbones
venues/KDD/2026/multi_task_reranking/one.description: [CIKM 2026][多任务学习与列表级重排] 将多任务信息流下沉至统一排序主干，以共享/私有 Anchor Token 逐层共演化，离线七任务全胜、线上时长+3.0%、P99 延迟降约30%。

venues/KDD/2026/multi_task_reranking/one.title: OneTrans: Unified Feature Interaction and Sequence Modeling with One Transformer in Industrial Recommender
venues/KDD/2026/multi_task_reranking/one.description: [WWW 2026][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用单一因果 Transformer 统一序列建模与特征交叉，配合金字塔剪枝与跨请求 KV 缓存，线上 GMV/u 提升 5.68%

venues/KDD/2026/multi_task_reranking/one.title: Scaling Recommender Transformers to One Billion Parameters
venues/KDD/2026/multi_task_reranking/one.description: [KDD 2026][序列与会话推荐] ARGUS 将自回归预训练解耦为反馈预测与下一物品预测双任务，把推荐 Transformer 编码器扩到 10 亿参数，线上听歌时长 +2.26%、点赞率 +6.37%。

venues/KDD/2026/multi_task_reranking/one.title: MPFormer: Adaptive Framework for Industrial Multi-Task Personalized Sequential Retriever
venues/KDD/2026/multi_task_reranking/one.description: [CIKM 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用目标条件化 Transformer 统一多目标召回，并以排序分数监督动态配额分配，在快手 4 亿 DAU 上实现 +0.43% 总时长与 66.7% 推理资源节省。

venues/KDD/2026/multi_task_reranking/one.title: Towards Generalizable and Efficient Large-Scale Generative Recommenders
venues/KDD/2026/multi_task_reranking/one.description: [RecSys 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 将生成式推荐骨干从2M扩至1B，用偏移幂律缩放律诊断任务天花板，并以MTP、采样softmax与语义塔解决缓存陈旧与冷启动，1M用户影子MRR全线提升。

venues/KDD/2026/multi_task_reranking/per.title: CanniUplift: A Holistic Framework for Mitigating Seller and Incentive Cannibalization in E-commerce Uplift Modeling
venues/KDD/2026/multi_task_reranking/per.description: [KDD 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 用平台级GMV一致性约束与核销路径分解，缓解多卖家电商uplift建模中的卖家级与激励级蚕食，线上ΔGMV相对提升4.08%。

venues/KDD/2026/multi_task_reranking/per.title: Off-Policy Evaluation and Learning for Matching Markets
venues/KDD/2026/multi_task_reranking/per.description: [RecSys 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 面向双向匹配市场提出 DiPS/DPR 两阶段奖励 OPE 估计器，利用一阶段 scout 信号降方差，合成+Wantedly 真实 A/B 日志验证 MSE 与策略选择显著优于 DM/IPS/DR。

venues/KDD/2026/multi_task_reranking/per.title: Agentic Personalisation of Cross-Channel Marketing Experiences
venues/KDD/2026/multi_task_reranking/per.description: [RecSys 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用 DiD 因果估计 + Thompson 采样构建模块化营销智能体，在 640 万用户线上 RCT 中显著提升漏斗事件与 GMV。

venues/KDD/2026/multi_task_reranking/per.title: Unmasking Gender Bias in Recommendation Systems and Enhancing Category-Aware Fairness
venues/KDD/2026/multi_task_reranking/per.description: [WWW 2025][去偏公平与可信推荐] 提出6个类别感知的性别偏差度量（含排序折扣）与GBS聚合，并以类别覆盖差作正则项，在3数据集上偏差降50–77%而性能损失有限。

venues/KDD/2026/multi_task_reranking/per.title: Heterogeneous Multi-treatment Uplift Modeling for Trade-off Optimization in Short-Video Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/multi_task_reranking/per.description: [KDD 2026][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用异构多处理增益建模+在线动态权重，个性化权衡短视频消费与商业化指标，快手全量部署

venues/KDD/2026/multimodal_rec/text_guid.title: VL-CLIP: Enhancing Multimodal Recommendations via Visual Grounding and LLM-Augmented CLIP Embeddings
venues/KDD/2026/multimodal_rec/text_guid.description: [RecSys 2025][多模态推荐] 用 Grounding DINO 裁剪商品主体 + LLM 自反思改写商品描述，再微调 CLIP 双塔，Walmart 线上 CTR +18.6%、GMV +4.0%。

venues/KDD/2026/multimodal_rec/text_guid.title: NoteLLM-2: Multimodal Large Representation Models for Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/multimodal_rec/text_guid.description: [KDD 2025][多模态推荐] 端到端微调 LLM+视觉编码器构建高效 MLRM，用 mICL 与门控后期融合缓解视觉忽视，I2I 全库召回 R@100 显著提升并落地线上 A/B。

venues/KDD/2026/multimodal_rec/text_guid.title: Token-Efficient Item Representation via Images for LLM Recommender Systems
venues/KDD/2026/multimodal_rec/text_guid.description: [ICLR 2026][LLM4Rec] 用单张物品图像替代冗长文本描述作为 LLM 推荐输入，配合 RISA 对齐与 RERI 检索式推荐，在 Amazon 四域上兼顾效率与效果。

venues/KDD/2026/multimodal_rec/text_guid.title: Do Recommender Systems Really Leverage Multimodal Content? A Comprehensive Analysis on Multimodal Representations for Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/multimodal_rec/text_guid.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 用受控噪声实验证明多模态增益源于语义而非模型容量，并以 LVLM 结构化提示生成「原生多模态」[EOS] 嵌入替代晚期融合，Borda 聚合排名第一。

venues/KDD/2026/multimodal_rec/text_guid.title: LaViC: Adapting Large Vision-Language Models to Visually-Aware Conversational Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/multimodal_rec/text_guid.description: [KDD 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用视觉知识自蒸馏把商品图压成5个[CLS] token，再做推荐提示微调，在新建Reddit-Amazon三域上HR@1最高提升54.2%。

venues/KDD/2026/multimodal_rec/uninote_a.title: EGR: Embedding-Native Generative Retrieval with a Shared LLM
venues/KDD/2026/multimodal_rec/uninote_a.description: [RecSys 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用单一共享 LLM 同时编码物品与用户历史，以双对比损失联合训练，免量化免 grounding，线上 CVR +2.91%

venues/KDD/2026/multimodal_rec/uninote_a.title: NoteLLM-2: Multimodal Large Representation Models for Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/multimodal_rec/uninote_a.description: [KDD 2025][多模态推荐] 端到端微调 LLM+视觉编码器构建高效 MLRM，用 mICL 与门控后期融合缓解视觉忽视，I2I 全库召回 R@100 显著提升并落地线上 A/B。

venues/KDD/2026/multimodal_rec/uninote_a.title: Do Recommender Systems Really Leverage Multimodal Content? A Comprehensive Analysis on Multimodal Representations for Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/multimodal_rec/uninote_a.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 用受控噪声实验证明多模态增益源于语义而非模型容量，并以 LVLM 结构化提示生成「原生多模态」[EOS] 嵌入替代晚期融合，Borda 聚合排名第一。

venues/KDD/2026/multimodal_rec/uninote_a.title: Learning Sparse Representations of Multimodal Content for Enhanced Cold Item Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/multimodal_rec/uninote_a.description: [RecSys 2026][冷启动与长尾推荐] 将多模态内容冷启动表征改为 top-K 稀疏嵌入，并用 α-entmax 预稀疏激活诱导锐化与去噪，冷启动 NDCG@20 提升 16.6%–75.5% 且存储更低。

venues/KDD/2026/multimodal_rec/uninote_a.title: Efficient and Effective Adaptation of Multimodal Foundation Models in Sequential Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/multimodal_rec/uninote_a.description: [TKDE 2025][多模态推荐] IISAN-Versa 用解耦 PEFT + 组 LayerDrop + 维度变换层，统一适配对称/非对称多模态基础模型，缓存隐藏态后 GPU 显存降 12–15 倍、训练提速 16–20 倍，MicroLens 达 SOTA。

venues/KDD/2026/multimodal_rec/vi_mmrec_.title: Well Begun is Half Done: Training-Free and Model-Agnostic Semantically Guaranteed User Representation Initialization for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/multimodal_rec/vi_mmrec_.description: [SIGIR 2026][多模态推荐] 用交互物品模态特征+聚类全局语义免训练初始化用户表征，弥合用户-物品语义鸿沟，六模型四数据集Recall@5最高提升36.4%。

venues/KDD/2026/multimodal_rec/vi_mmrec_.title: Efficient Multimodal Streaming Recommendation via Expandable Side Mixture-of-Experts
venues/KDD/2026/multimodal_rec/vi_mmrec_.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 冻结 BERT/ViT 主干，用可扩展侧调 MoE 增量吸收新时段知识并按利用率剪枝，在三个流式数据集上 HR@10 全面超越 SOTA 且显存/训练时间更省。

venues/KDD/2026/multimodal_rec/vi_mmrec_.title: Personalized Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Foundation Models for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/multimodal_rec/vi_mmrec_.description: [WWW 2026][多模态推荐] 按兴趣分群并为每群挂载独立 PEFT 模块，使 CLIP 编码出用户条件化的物品表征，配合群内难负采样，NDCG@20 最高提升 15.3%。

venues/KDD/2026/multimodal_rec/vi_mmrec_.title: One Graph, Multiple Gains: Single High-Quality Item-Item Graph for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/multimodal_rec/vi_mmrec_.description: [ACM MM 2026][多模态推荐] 构建一次高质量物品-物品图，经三元闭包重加权后复用于表征、交互图与优化三阶段，四数据集全指标SOTA且训练更快更省显存。

venues/KDD/2026/multimodal_rec/vi_mmrec_.title: I$^3$-MRec: Invariant Learning with Information Bottleneck for Incomplete Modality Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/multimodal_rec/vi_mmrec_.description: [ACM MM 2025][多模态推荐] 将各模态视为独立语义环境做 IRM 不变学习，并用 IB 压缩模态特有信息，在模态缺失场景下 Full-Ranking Recall@20 稳定提升 2%–4%。

venues/KDD/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/c.title: CoMaPOI: A Collaborative Multi-Agent Framework for Next POI Prediction Bridging the Gap Between Trajectory and Language
venues/KDD/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/c.description: [SIGIR 2025][时空轨迹与POI推荐] 用 Profiler/Forecaster/Predictor 三智能体把数值轨迹转语言画像、动态收缩候选集并反向推理微调，三数据集全指标提升 4%–12%。

venues/KDD/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/c.title: Graph Representation Learning via Causal Diffusion for Out-of-Distribution Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/c.description: [WWW 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 用结构因果模型定位环境混杂因子，以变分推断+扩散模型学习环境不变图表征，OOD 场景最高提升 36.73%。

venues/KDD/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/c.title: Generative Spatiotemporal Intent Sequence Recommendation via Implicit Reasoning in Amap
venues/KDD/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/c.description: [RecSys 2026][时空轨迹与POI本地生活推荐] 将LLM显式CoT压缩为隐式潜token并配合时空反事实DPO，在Amap工业数据与线上A/B中实现低延迟意图序列生成。

venues/KDD/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/c.title: Predicting User Behavior in Smart Spaces with LLM-Enhanced Logs and Personalized Prompts
venues/KDD/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/c.description: [AAAI 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 LLM 语义增强智能空间事件日志 + 个性化图软提示，在智能车/智能家居四数据集上显著提升下一行为预测，稀有事件 H@1 提升超 40%。

venues/KDD/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/c.title: From Time and Place to Preference: LLM-Driven Geo-Temporal Context in Recommendations
venues/KDD/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/c.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用 LLM 从时间戳+粗粒度位置生成地理-时间上下文嵌入，以特征融合或辅助对齐损失注入 SASRec，并提出轻量信息量诊断测试。

venues/KDD/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/t.title: Reasoning over Semantic IDs Enhances Generative Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/t.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 通过教师模型合成富化语料强化 SID-语言对齐，再用 GRPO 结果驱动强化学习激发 SID 推理，三数据集 Full-Ranking 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/KDD/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/t.title: RecRec: Latent Interests Recursive Reasoning for Sequential Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/t.description: [RecSys 2026][序列与会话推荐] 解耦推理态与预测态、以 R 个潜在兴趣做递归推理的免 RL 序列推荐框架，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@10 最高提升 14.8%。

venues/KDD/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/t.title: Factorized Latent Reasoning for LLM-based Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/t.description: [SIGIR 2026][大语言模型推荐] 将 LLM 隐式推理拆为 K 个解耦偏好因子并配 GRPO 对齐，全库约束解码下 N@5 最高提升 10.26%

venues/KDD/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/t.title: S$^2$GR: Stepwise Semantic-Guided Reasoning in Latent Space for Generative Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/t.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐] 在每级 SID 码生成前插入受码本聚类语义对比监督的思考 token，实现逐步可验证潜在推理，工业短视频 A/B 显著提升时长。

venues/KDD/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/t.title: ThinkRec: Thinking-based Recommendation via LLM
venues/KDD/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/t.description: [WWW 2026][大语言模型推荐] 以合成推理链激活 LLM 的 System 2 思维，并用实例级 LoRA 专家融合适配异构用户，AUC 平均提升 7.96%。

venues/KDD/2026/rl_bandit_rec/heterogene.title: Leveraging Watch-time Feedback for Short-Video Recommendations: A Causal Labeling Framework
venues/KDD/2026/rl_bandit_rec/heterogene.description: [CIKM 2023][去偏公平与工业架构] 用分位数把观看时长转成 WPR 与二值标签，并在标注阶段按视频时长分组做因果去偏，离线全指标最优、线上观看时长 +2.23%。

venues/KDD/2026/rl_bandit_rec/heterogene.title: Online Item Cold-Start Recommendation with Popularity-Aware Meta-Learning
venues/KDD/2026/rl_bandit_rec/heterogene.description: [KDD 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 按流行度固定切分元学习任务并配冷启动增强器，流式在线场景下冷启动召回相对 SOTA 提升 11%–74%。

venues/KDD/2026/rl_bandit_rec/heterogene.title: Multi-Objective Ranking for Live-Streaming: Balancing Fresh and Delayed Signals with Segment-Aware Targeting
venues/KDD/2026/rl_bandit_rec/heterogene.description: [RecSys 2026][多任务学习与列表级重排] Twitch 直播精排用延迟窗口+新鲜/延迟双模型分离+分段推理加权+MMoE，DAV +0.09%、D 段 ARPU +0.56%。

venues/KDD/2026/rl_bandit_rec/heterogene.title: SWaT: Statistical Modeling of Video Watch Time through User Behavior Analysis
venues/KDD/2026/rl_bandit_rec/heterogene.description: [KDD 2025][CTR/CVR 预估与特征交叉] 将用户观看行为假设翻译为分桶二项/几何分布白盒统计模型，以软标签 BCE 训练，离线与线上 A/B 均稳定超越 WLR/TPM/CREAD。

venues/KDD/2026/rl_bandit_rec/heterogene.title: MPFormer: Adaptive Framework for Industrial Multi-Task Personalized Sequential Retriever
venues/KDD/2026/rl_bandit_rec/heterogene.description: [CIKM 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用目标条件化 Transformer 统一多目标召回，并以排序分数监督动态配额分配，在快手 4 亿 DAU 上实现 +0.43% 总时长与 66.7% 推理资源节省。

venues/KDD/2026/rl_bandit_rec/hoba_hiera.title: AHBid: An Adaptable Hierarchical Bidding Framework for Cross-Channel Advertising
venues/KDD/2026/rl_bandit_rec/hoba_hiera.description: [WWW 2026][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用扩散模型生成跨渠道预算/约束目标轨迹、结合约束执行与实时控制出价，离线与线上 A/B 收益提升 13.57%。

venues/KDD/2026/rl_bandit_rec/hoba_hiera.title: RTBAgent: A LLM-based Agent System for Real-Time Bidding
venues/KDD/2026/rl_bandit_rec/hoba_hiera.description: [WWW 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 首个 LLM Agent 出价系统，用两步决策+多类记忆+专家策略工具在 iPinYou 上以调整因子方式超越规则/RL/扩散基线。

venues/KDD/2026/rl_bandit_rec/hoba_hiera.title: DARA: Few-shot Budget Allocation in Online Advertising via In-Context Decision Making with RL-Finetuned LLMs
venues/KDD/2026/rl_bandit_rec/hoba_hiera.description: [WWW 2026][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 双阶段 LLM 智能体分离少样本规划与精细优化，配合动态参考策略 GRPO-Adaptive 微调，在真实与合成广告环境中显著降低边际 ROI 方差。

venues/KDD/2026/rl_bandit_rec/hoba_hiera.title: Expert-Guided Diffusion Planner for Auto-bidding
venues/KDD/2026/rl_bandit_rec/hoba_hiera.description: [CIKM 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用专家轨迹引导条件扩散规划器生成出价序列，配合混合强制训练与跳步采样，线上转化+11.29%、收入+12.36%。

venues/KDD/2026/rl_bandit_rec/hoba_hiera.title: An Adaptable Budget Planner for Enhancing Budget-Constrained Auto-Bidding in Online Advertising
venues/KDD/2026/rl_bandit_rec/hoba_hiera.description: [KDD 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 将竞价周期切分为多阶段，用 in-context RL 逐 episode 调整预算分配，few-shot 适配新广告主，仿真与线上 A/B 均提升累计价值。

venues/KDD/2026/rl_bandit_rec/learning_p.title: Incentivized Exploration with Stochastic Covariates: A Two-Stage Mechanism Design for Recommender System
venues/KDD/2026/rl_bandit_rec/learning_p.description: [ICML 2026][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 面向在线随机用户协变量的激励相容探索，提出两阶段 RCB 算法（冷启动补贴 + 逆比例间隙采样），在满足 ε-DBIC 约束下达到 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{KdT})$ 遗憾。

venues/KDD/2026/rl_bandit_rec/learning_p.title: Exploitation Over Exploration: Unmasking the Bias in Linear Bandit Recommender Offline Evaluation
venues/KDD/2026/rl_bandit_rec/learning_p.description: [RecSys 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 大规模实证揭示线性 Bandit 离线回放评估系统性偏袒纯利用策略，贪心模型在 89% 数据集上不劣于探索变体。

venues/KDD/2026/rl_bandit_rec/learning_p.title: Counterfactual Inference under Thompson Sampling
venues/KDD/2026/rl_bandit_rec/learning_p.description: [RecSys 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 推导 Thompson Sampling 下动作倾向性的精确可计算闭式解，使 IPS 类离线评估在 TS 策略下首次可行，OBP 仿真验证无偏收敛。

venues/KDD/2026/rl_bandit_rec/learning_p.title: Heterogeneous Influence Maximization in User Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/rl_bandit_rec/learning_p.description: [CIKM 2025][社交与群组推荐] 将异质传播概率与 RR 集影响力最大化引入好友邀请推荐，HeteroIR/HeteroIM 在 NSpread/Recall/NDCG 全面领先并落地腾讯游戏 A/B 提升 8.5%/10%。

venues/KDD/2026/rl_bandit_rec/learning_p.description: [CIKM 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 将图聚合证明为后门调整，用 VAE 式编码器-解码器估计无偏聚合权重，配合动量更新，小众物品 Recall@20 提升约 20%。

venues/KDD/2026/rl_bandit_rec/uncertaint.title: Uncertainty Quantification and Decomposition for LLM-based Recommendation
venues/KDD/2026/rl_bandit_rec/uncertaint.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 用 Plackett-Luce 单次推理估计列表排序预测熵，并分解为推荐/提示不确定性，指导不确定性感知提示提升 N@20 约 17%。

venues/KDD/2026/rl_bandit_rec/uncertaint.description: [RecSys 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 提出以物品为中心的 Beta 后验过滤控制，在排序后剔除“错配受众”曝光，线上探索曝光降 20% 而满意度升 50%、可推荐语料扩 10%。

venues/KDD/2026/self_supervised_denoisin.title: Multi-Modal Multi-Behavior Sequential Recommendation with Conditional Diffusion-Based Feature Denoising

venues/KDD/2026/sequential_rec/fuxi_effi.title: Efficient Sequential Recommendation for Long Term User Interest Via Personalization

venues/KDD/2026/sequential_rec/journeyfo.title: Harnessing the Power of Interleaving and Counterfactual Evaluation for Airbnb Search Ranking

venues/RecSys/2025/agent_conversational_.title: Ask to Be Sure: Informative Interactions for Confident Multi-Turn LLM Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2025/agent_conversational_.description: [CIKM 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 以推荐列表采样熵的下降量作为信息增益奖励，免真值微调 LLM 多轮对话策略，INSPIRED/ReDial 上 Hit 与对话效率双升。

venues/RecSys/2025/cold_start_rec/do_we_.title: A Bi-Step Grounding Paradigm for Large Language Models in Recommendation Systems

venues/RecSys/2025/cold_start_rec/do_we_.title: TF-DCon: Leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) to Empower Training-Free Dataset Condensation for Content-Based Recommendation

venues/RecSys/2025/multi_task_reranking/.description: [WSDM 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 用 LoRA 解耦四类场景-任务信息单元并以可学习掩码剪枝无效信息流，AUC 全面超越 HiNet/M3oE，线上 CVR 均涨 2.46%。

venues/RecSys/2025/multi_task_reranking/.title: Direct Routing Gradient (DRGrad): A Personalized Information Surgery for Multi-Task Learning (MTL) Recommendations
venues/RecSys/2025/multi_task_reranking/.description: [AAAI 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用梯度余弦相似度做路由+Split-MMoE+PPNet个性化门控，在150亿样本工业数据上Click AUC提升0.0027且不增推理延迟。

venues/RecSys/2025/multi_task_reranking/.title: See Beyond a Single View: Multi-Attribution Learning Leads to Better Conversion Rate Prediction
venues/RecSys/2025/multi_task_reranking/.description: [CIKM 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 将多归因标签作为辅助任务联合学习，用笛卡尔积辅助训练增强监督信号，离线GAUC+0.51%、线上ROI+2.6%

venues/RecSys/2025/multi_task_reranking/.title: On Predicting Post-Click Conversion Rate via Counterfactual Inference
venues/RecSys/2025/multi_task_reranking/.description: [ICDM 2025][CTR/CVR 预估与特征交叉] 用 SCM 对未点击样本做 do(C=1) 反事实推断生成转化伪标签，全空间训练 CVR 模型，离线 AUC 平均 +1.01%，线上 CVR +17.35%。

venues/RecSys/2025/multi_task_reranking/.title: Cold-Starting Podcast Ads and Promotions with Multi-Task Learning on Spotify
venues/RecSys/2025/multi_task_reranking/.description: [WSDM 2026][多任务学习与列表级重排] Spotify 用单一 5 任务 MTL 模型统一播客广告与推广定向，靠非对称损失掩码与源平衡采样实现跨渠道迁移，线上 eCPS 降 22%、i2s 升 18–24%。

venues/RecSys/2025/multi_task_reranking/.title: Counterfactual Multi-task Learning for Delayed Conversion Modeling in E-commerce Sales Pre-Promotion
venues/RecSys/2025/multi_task_reranking/.description: [SIGIR 2026][CTR/CVR 预估与特征交叉] 面向大促预热期“集中式延迟转化”的因果多任务 CVR 模型，联合直接/延迟转化建模、个性化门控迁移与 ATC 反事实正则，离线 AUC 显著超越延迟反馈基线并落地线上 A/B。

venues/RecSys/2025/multi_task_reranking/.title: Scenario-Wise Rec: A Multi-Scenario Recommendation Benchmark
venues/RecSys/2025/multi_task_reranking/.description: [CIKM 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 首个多场景推荐统一基准，整合 6 个公开数据集与 12 个 MSR 模型，统一数据处理/训练/评测管线并附工业广告数据验证。

venues/RecSys/2025/multi_task_reranking/.title: The Recall Ceiling of LLM Recommendation Reranking
venues/RecSys/2025/multi_task_reranking/.description: [CIKM 2026][LLM4Rec] 证明闭候选重排器 NDCG 受自身窗口召回率硬上界约束，Oracle 协议高估 92–95%，九类 LLM 与监督重排器在真实检索下均无法显著超越 CF。

venues/RecSys/2025/multi_task_reranking/.title: GRank: Towards Target-Aware and Streamlined Industrial Retrieval with a Generate-Rank Framework
venues/RecSys/2025/multi_task_reranking/.description: [WWW 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用训练期目标注入把 Target-Aware 能力蒸馏进 MIPS 兼容生成器，再以轻量交叉注意力重排，免结构化索引实现 Recall@500 +30% 与 1.7× QPS。

venues/RecSys/2025/multi_task_reranking/.title: Non-parametric Graph Convolution for Re-ranking in Recommendation Systems
venues/RecSys/2025/multi_task_reranking/.description: [RecSys 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 将图卷积从训练期搬到测试期，用相似用户/物品构造增强对并加权聚合打分，重排平均提升 8.1% 而额外开销仅 0.5%。

venues/RecSys/2025/multi_task_reranking/.title: Revisiting Generative vs. Dense Retrieval: A Static Value Prior Reverses the Gap
venues/RecSys/2025/multi_task_reranking/.description: [CIKM 2026][生成式推荐] 在受控 GR/DR 对比下揭示指标选择反转胜负，用免训练静态价值先验重排 DR 即反超 GR 最佳物品价值并保持召回领先。

venues/RecSys/2025/multi_task_reranking/.title: PI2I: A Personalized Item-Based Collaborative Filtering Retrieval Framework
venues/RecSys/2025/multi_task_reranking/.description: [WWW 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 放宽 I2I 截断保召回、Trigger-Target 负采样对齐离线在线、目标注意力精排打分，淘宝线上成交率 +1.05%

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/aps_ex.title: On the Convergent Validity of Offline Evaluation Designs for Recommender Systems
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/aps_ex.description: [RecSys 2026][去偏公平与工业评测] 以稠密真值反馈为参照，用 Kendall's τ 检验稀疏离线评测设计的收敛效度，发现无普适最优设计且 KuaiRec 上排序近乎反转。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/aps_ex.title: Interactive Visualization Recommendation with Hier-SUCB
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/aps_ex.description: [WWW 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 将可视化推荐建模为带可学习偏置项的分层上下文组合半臂老虎机，把遗憾界从 $O(\sqrt{T\ln^3(nm^2T\ln T)})$降至$O(\sqrt{T\ln^3(m^2T\ln T)})$，在 Plot.ly 上 80/160 轮超越离线 SOTA。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/aps_ex.title: SplitLight: An Exploratory Toolkit for Recommender Systems Datasets and Splits
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/aps_ex.description: [SIGIR 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 开源数据集与划分审计工具箱，量化时间泄漏、冷启动暴露、重复消费与分布漂移，揭示预处理决策可使 NDCG@10 变动 1.2%–60%。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/aps_ex.title: DataRec: A Python Library for Standardized and Reproducible Data Management in Recommender Systems
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/aps_ex.description: [SIGIR 2025][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 基于 55 篇顶会论文调研构建的统一数据管理库，提供可复现的过滤/划分/版本校验与跨框架导出，覆盖 18 个内置数据集。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/aps_ex.title: Recommendation Is a Dish Better Served Warm
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/aps_ex.description: [RecSys 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 系统量化冷启动阈值：物品侧训练交互扫描+用户侧推理历史截断，揭示 6–15 条交互的冷热分界并批判 p-core 过滤的任意性。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/beyond.title: Balancing Accuracy and Novelty with Sub-Item Popularity
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/beyond.description: [RecSys 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 复用 RecJPQ 子 ID 分解在子码本粒度计算个性化流行度 sPPS，与 item 级 PPS 加权融合，在 NDCG 不降前提下显著提升个性化新颖度。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/beyond.title: Semantic IDs for Music Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/beyond.description: [RecSys 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用 RQ-VAE 残差量化生成音乐语义 ID 替代逐曲嵌入，参数量降 75%–99% 而精度不降，线上多样性显著提升。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/beyond.title: A Contextual-Aware Position Encoding for Sequential Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/beyond.description: [WWW 2025][序列与会话推荐] 首个为序列推荐定制的上下文感知位置编码 CAPE：用目标-上下文不相似度累加动态分配位置，配合门控融合异构特征，在 5 个骨干与工业 A/B 上稳定涨点。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/beyond.title: Yambda-5B — A Large-Scale Multi-modal Dataset for Ranking And Retrieval
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/beyond.description: [RecSys 2025][多模态推荐] 发布 Yandex Music 4.79B 交互工业级数据集，含音频嵌入与 is_organic 标志，提出 Global Temporal Split 评测协议并给出 6 类基线基准。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/beyond.title: Mixture of Sequence: Theme-Aware Mixture-of-Experts for Long-Sequence Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/beyond.description: [WWW 2026][序列与会话推荐] 揭示长序列“会话跳跃”现象，用主题码本路由+多尺度专家融合做子序列抽取，AUC 平均提升 0.68% 且 FLOPs 更低

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/image_.title: IntentLens: Grounding Underspecified Multimodal Queries for Recommendation via Tool-Augmented Reasoning
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/image_.description: [NeurIPS 2026][多模态推荐] 用 MLLM 工具增强推理将欠指定图文查询接地为结构化意图，再以轻量双塔排序，构建两个新基准并显著超越 MLLM 与检索基线。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/image_.title: VL-CLIP: Enhancing Multimodal Recommendations via Visual Grounding and LLM-Augmented CLIP Embeddings
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/image_.description: [RecSys 2025][多模态推荐] 用 Grounding DINO 裁剪商品主体 + LLM 自反思改写商品描述，再微调 CLIP 双塔，Walmart 线上 CTR +18.6%、GMV +4.0%。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/image_.title: GALA: Generative Aligned Learning for Adaptive Multimodal Representation in the Taobao Shangou Recommender System
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/image_.description: [ICDE 2026][多模态推荐] 三阶段流水线：行为三元组预训练 + GRPO 生成式行为对齐 + 自适应门控融合，离线 AUC +0.12/+0.20，线上订单量 +0.55%。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/image_.title: Native Multimodal Representation Learning for Click-Through Rate Prediction in E-Commerce Scenarios
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/image_.description: [CIKM 2026][多模态推荐] 揭示端到端联合训练在强预训练编码器上失效的根因（CTR 监督多模态不可解释+梯度不一致），提出 Mine-Then-Train 挖掘三元组微调编码器，线上 CTR +1.5%、RPM +0.5%。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/image_.title: Failure Prediction in Conversational Recommendation Systems
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/image_.description: [RecSys 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出监督式对话性能预测任务，用AE与L1收缩多轮预测器区分系统失败与目录失败，揭示目录缺失场景下预测精度显著下降。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/improv.title: VL-CLIP: Enhancing Multimodal Recommendations via Visual Grounding and LLM-Augmented CLIP Embeddings
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/improv.description: [RecSys 2025][多模态推荐] 用 Grounding DINO 裁剪商品主体 + LLM 自反思改写商品描述，再微调 CLIP 双塔，Walmart 线上 CTR +18.6%、GMV +4.0%。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/improv.title: Token-Efficient Item Representation via Images for LLM Recommender Systems
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/improv.description: [ICLR 2026][LLM4Rec] 用单张物品图像替代冗长文本描述作为 LLM 推荐输入，配合 RISA 对齐与 RERI 检索式推荐，在 Amazon 四域上兼顾效率与效果。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/improv.title: LaViC: Adapting Large Vision-Language Models to Visually-Aware Conversational Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/improv.description: [KDD 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用视觉知识自蒸馏把商品图压成5个[CLS] token，再做推荐提示微调，在新建Reddit-Amazon三域上HR@1最高提升54.2%。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/improv.title: Text-Guided Visual Representation Learning for Robust Multimodal E-Commerce Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/improv.description: [KDD 2026][多模态推荐] 以结构化元数据初始化语义查询、双流解耦视觉证据并用可靠性双门控校准，在 134K 全库 I2I 检索上 H@100 相对提升 6.04%。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/improv.title: Image-Seeking Intent Prediction for Cross-Device Product Search
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/improv.description: [RecSys GenAIECommerce 2025][多模态推荐] 用语音查询+商品摘要预测图像意图，以可微精度损失抑制误触发，离线 Precision 达 78.5。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/just_a.title: Efficient Multimodal Streaming Recommendation via Expandable Side Mixture-of-Experts
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/just_a.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 冻结 BERT/ViT 主干，用可扩展侧调 MoE 增量吸收新时段知识并按利用率剪枝，在三个流式数据集上 HR@10 全面超越 SOTA 且显存/训练时间更省。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/just_a.title: Yambda-5B — A Large-Scale Multi-modal Dataset for Ranking And Retrieval
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/just_a.description: [RecSys 2025][多模态推荐] 发布 Yandex Music 4.79B 交互工业级数据集，含音频嵌入与 is_organic 标志，提出 Global Temporal Split 评测协议并给出 6 类基线基准。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/just_a.title: Progressive Semantic Residual Quantization for Multimodal-Joint Interest Modeling in Music Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/just_a.description: [CIKM 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 提出前缀语义约束的渐进残差量化 PSRQ 与多码本交叉注意力 MCCA，缓解语义漂移与跨模态建模缺口，冷启动 AUC 显著提升并完成工业上线。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/just_a.title: Leveraging Multimodal Data and Side Users for Diffusion Cross-Domain Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/just_a.description: [ACM MM 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用 MLLM 抽取多模态特征做初步对齐，再以边侧用户+重叠用户两阶段扩散生成目标域冷启动用户向量，Amazon 三任务 MAE 最高降 13.6%。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/just_a.title: Bridging Conversational and Collaborative Signals for Conversational Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/just_a.description: [WWW 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 构建 Reddit-ML32M 跨源数据集，用 SASRec 协同嵌入对 GPT-3.5 零样本推荐做相似度重排，H@5 提升 12.32%。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/llm_po.title: LLM-Based User Personas for Recommendations at Scale
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/llm_po.description: [RecSys 2026][大语言模型推荐] 工业级实时生成自然语言用户兴趣画像，蒸馏+异步推理支撑十亿用户在线服务，A/B 测试观看时长 +0.04%

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/llm_po.title: A General Framework for Multimodal LLM-Based Multimedia Understanding in Large-Scale Recommendation Systems
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/llm_po.description: [SIGIR 2026][多模态推荐] 用 1.5B LLaMA2+BLIP-2 将图像转字幕并 token 化为类别特征注入 DLRM 精排，离线 AUC +0.35%、线上 +0.02%，延迟中性。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/llm_po.title: A Content-Driven Micro-Video Recommendation Dataset at Scale
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/llm_po.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 发布十亿级含原始视频模态的微视频推荐数据集 MicroLens，并系统基准 IDRec/VIDRec/VideoRec 三类范式，揭示端到端视频编码优于冻结特征的关键结论。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/llm_po.title: VL-CLIP: Enhancing Multimodal Recommendations via Visual Grounding and LLM-Augmented CLIP Embeddings
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/llm_po.description: [RecSys 2025][多模态推荐] 用 Grounding DINO 裁剪商品主体 + LLM 自反思改写商品描述，再微调 CLIP 双塔，Walmart 线上 CTR +18.6%、GMV +4.0%。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/llm_po.title: NoteLLM-2: Multimodal Large Representation Models for Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/llm_po.description: [KDD 2025][多模态推荐] 端到端微调 LLM+视觉编码器构建高效 MLRM，用 mICL 与门控后期融合缓解视觉忽视，I2I 全库召回 R@100 显著提升并落地线上 A/B。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/person.title: ICG: Improving Cover Image Generation via MLLM-based Prompting and Personalized Preference Alignment
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/person.description: [EMNLP 2025][多模态推荐] 用 MLLM 元令牌+双路适配器把个性化上下文注入扩散模型，并以多奖励对齐实现无标签封面生成，下游 MMGCN 推荐 NDCG@10 提升 19.1%。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/person.title: Personalized Image Generation with Large Multimodal Models
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/person.description: [WWW 2025][多模态推荐] Pigeon 用 LMM+掩码生成器从噪声历史图中抽取视觉偏好，两阶段偏好对齐（掩码重建+DPO）实现贴纸/海报个性化生成，个性化指标提升 7%~31%。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/person.title: Dual-Diffusional Generative Fashion Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/person.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 双分支扩散 Transformer 联合生成时尚单品图像与属性级文本，以结构化偏好加权采样建模用户，PFITB/GOR 双任务个性化指标显著领先且训练提速约 7 倍。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/person.title: Scaling Recommender Transformers to One Billion Parameters
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/person.description: [KDD 2026][序列与会话推荐] ARGUS 将自回归预训练解耦为反馈预测与下一物品预测双任务，把推荐 Transformer 编码器扩到 10 亿参数，线上听歌时长 +2.26%、点赞率 +6.37%。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/person.title: Breaking the Likelihood Trap: Consistent Generative Recommendation with Graph-structured Model
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/person.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用有向无环图解码器扩展非自回归生成空间，并以 Gumbel-Softmax 打通评估器梯度，破解似然陷阱，快手线上 Views +0.78%。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/vl_cli.title: NoteLLM-2: Multimodal Large Representation Models for Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/vl_cli.description: [KDD 2025][多模态推荐] 端到端微调 LLM+视觉编码器构建高效 MLRM，用 mICL 与门控后期融合缓解视觉忽视，I2I 全库召回 R@100 显著提升并落地线上 A/B。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/vl_cli.title: Text-Guided Visual Representation Learning for Robust Multimodal E-Commerce Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/vl_cli.description: [KDD 2026][多模态推荐] 以结构化元数据初始化语义查询、双流解耦视觉证据并用可靠性双门控校准，在 134K 全库 I2I 检索上 H@100 相对提升 6.04%。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/vl_cli.title: Do Recommender Systems Really Leverage Multimodal Content? A Comprehensive Analysis on Multimodal Representations for Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/vl_cli.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 用受控噪声实验证明多模态增益源于语义而非模型容量，并以 LVLM 结构化提示生成「原生多模态」[EOS] 嵌入替代晚期融合，Borda 聚合排名第一。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/vl_cli.title: LaViC: Adapting Large Vision-Language Models to Visually-Aware Conversational Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/vl_cli.description: [KDD 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用视觉知识自蒸馏把商品图压成5个[CLS] token，再做推荐提示微调，在新建Reddit-Amazon三域上HR@1最高提升54.2%。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/vl_cli.title: Token-Efficient Item Representation via Images for LLM Recommender Systems
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/vl_cli.description: [ICLR 2026][LLM4Rec] 用单张物品图像替代冗长文本描述作为 LLM 推荐输入，配合 RISA 对齐与 RERI 检索式推荐，在 Amazon 四域上兼顾效率与效果。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/yambda.title: VK-LSVD: A Large-Scale Industrial Dataset for Short-Video Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/yambda.description: [WWW 2026][序列与会话推荐] 发布 407 亿交互、千万用户、两千万短视频的工业级开放数据集，配全局时间切分与冷启动竞赛基准。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/yambda.title: Just Ask for Music (JAM): Multimodal and Personalized Natural Language Music Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/yambda.description: [RecSys 2025][多模态推荐] 将查询建模为用户到物品的向量平移，用交叉注意力聚合音频/歌词/CF 多模态，在 JAMSessions 全库排序上 NDCG@10 相对 TalkRec 提升约 105%

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/yambda.title: Semantic IDs for Music Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/yambda.description: [RecSys 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用 RQ-VAE 残差量化生成音乐语义 ID 替代逐曲嵌入，参数量降 75%–99% 而精度不降，线上多样性显著提升。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/yambda.title: Scaling Recommender Transformers to One Billion Parameters
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/yambda.description: [KDD 2026][序列与会话推荐] ARGUS 将自回归预训练解耦为反馈预测与下一物品预测双任务，把推荐 Transformer 编码器扩到 10 亿参数，线上听歌时长 +2.26%、点赞率 +6.37%。

venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/yambda.title: Can LLMs Outshine Conventional Recommenders? A Comparative Evaluation
venues/RecSys/2025/multimodal_rec/yambda.description: [NeurIPS 2025 DB Track][大语言模型推荐] RecBench 系统对比 17 个 LLM 与 DLRM 在 4 种物品表征、CTR/SeqRec 双任务上的精度-效率权衡，LLM 精度领先但推理慢千倍。

venues/RecSys/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_re.title: Taming Recommendation Bias with Causal Intervention on Evolving Personal Popularity
venues/RecSys/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_re.description: [KDD 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 提出演化个人流行度度量与因果去混杂训练，并在推理期用移动平均趋势外推做干预，兼顾用户-物品演化一致性，Full-Ranking 下 Recall@20 最高提升 20.4%。

venues/RecSys/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_re.title: Identifying and Upweighting Power-Niche Users to Mitigate Popularity Bias in Recommendations
venues/RecSys/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_re.description: [WWW 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 识别高活跃-小众偏好用户并对其在BPR损失中双重加权，在三个基准上实现性能与流行度去偏的帕累托双赢。

venues/RecSys/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_re.title: Unbiased Collaborative Filtering with Fair Sampling
venues/RecSys/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_re.description: [SIGIR 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 通过对称补充采样使每个用户/物品等概率成为正负样本，无需估计倾向分即可消除流行度偏置，全库排序下 Recall/NDCG 与 ARP 双优。

venues/RecSys/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_re.title: Unbiased Recommender Systems with Implicit Feedback
venues/RecSys/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_re.description: [RecSys 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 博士论文愿景：以控制函数法纠偏排序位置偏差、以事后投影与消息传递加权纠偏 GNN 协同过滤的流行度偏差。

venues/RecSys/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_re.title: On Inherited Popularity Bias in Cold-Start Item Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_re.description: [RecSys 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 揭示生成式冷启动模型继承热模型流行度偏置，提出基于向量模长重标定的免训练后处理去偏方法，在三个多媒体数据集上显著提升物品公平性与曝光多样性。

venues/RecSys/2025/rl_bandit_rec/exploit.title: Incentivized Exploration with Stochastic Covariates: A Two-Stage Mechanism Design for Recommender System
venues/RecSys/2025/rl_bandit_rec/exploit.description: [ICML 2026][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 面向在线随机用户协变量的激励相容探索，提出两阶段 RCB 算法（冷启动补贴 + 逆比例间隙采样），在满足 ε-DBIC 约束下达到 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{KdT})$ 遗憾。

venues/RecSys/2025/rl_bandit_rec/exploit.title: Revisiting Clustering of Neural Bandits: Selective Reinitialization for Mitigating Loss of Plasticity
venues/RecSys/2025/rl_bandit_rec/exploit.description: [KDD 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 针对神经聚类 Bandit 的可塑性丧失问题，提出选择性重初始化框架 SeRe，配合自适应变点检测，在六个推荐数据集上最多降低 12.82% 累积遗憾。

venues/RecSys/2025/rl_bandit_rec/exploit.title: Interactive Visualization Recommendation with Hier-SUCB
venues/RecSys/2025/rl_bandit_rec/exploit.description: [WWW 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 将可视化推荐建模为带可学习偏置项的分层上下文组合半臂老虎机，把遗憾界从 $O(\sqrt{T\ln^3(nm^2T\ln T)})$降至$O(\sqrt{T\ln^3(m^2T\ln T)})$，在 Plot.ly 上 80/160 轮超越离线 SOTA。

venues/RecSys/2025/rl_bandit_rec/exploit.title: Preference is More Than Comparisons: Rethinking Dueling Bandits with Augmented Human Feedback
venues/RecSys/2025/rl_bandit_rec/exploit.description: [AAAI 2026][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用增强置信界把相似/依赖观测注入无模型 Dueling Bandit，给出样本复杂度与遗憾权衡，在推荐、多目标优化与 LLM 响应优化上显著降遗憾。

venues/RecSys/2025/rl_bandit_rec/exploit.title: Neural Combinatorial Clustered Bandits for Recommendation Systems
venues/RecSys/2025/rl_bandit_rec/exploit.description: [AAAI 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用双神经网络+上下文聚类替代组合老虎机的精确优化 oracle，实现 $\tilde{O}(\tilde{d}\sqrt{T})$ 遗憾并显著降低推荐累积遗憾。

venues/RecSys/2025/rl_bandit_rec/off_pol.title: Meta Off-Policy Estimation
venues/RecSys/2025/rl_bandit_rec/off_pol.description: [RecSys 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 将多个 OPE 估计器视为相关研究做固定效应元分析，用 BLUE 闭式解融合并给出保守置信区间，OBD 上方差降超 50%。

venues/RecSys/2025/rl_bandit_rec/off_pol.title: Unbiased Collaborative Filtering with Fair Sampling
venues/RecSys/2025/rl_bandit_rec/off_pol.description: [SIGIR 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 通过对称补充采样使每个用户/物品等概率成为正负样本，无需估计倾向分即可消除流行度偏置，全库排序下 Recall/NDCG 与 ARP 双优。

venues/RecSys/2025/rl_bandit_rec/off_pol.title: Beyond Match Maximization and Fairness: Retention-Optimized Two-Sided Matching
venues/RecSys/2025/rl_bandit_rec/off_pol.description: [ICLR 2026][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 将双边匹配推荐重构为留存最大化问题，用凹性 Jensen 下界把 NP-hard 排序松弛为 O(NlogN) 的 argsort 打分，在合成与真实约会平台数据上以约 70% 匹配量取得最高留存率。

venues/RecSys/2025/rl_bandit_rec/off_pol.title: Counterfactual Inference under Thompson Sampling
venues/RecSys/2025/rl_bandit_rec/off_pol.description: [RecSys 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 推导 Thompson Sampling 下动作倾向性的精确可计算闭式解，使 IPS 类离线评估在 TS 策略下首次可行，OBP 仿真验证无偏收敛。

venues/RecSys/2025/rl_bandit_rec/off_pol.title: Additive Control Variates Dominate Self-Normalisation in Off-Policy Evaluation
venues/RecSys/2025/rl_bandit_rec/off_pol.description: [SIGIR 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 证明最优加性基线 β*-IPS 在 MSE 上渐近严格优于 SNIPS，并给出精确方差差解析式与排序场景 β*⊥⊥-IPM 扩展。

venues/RecSys/2025/self_supervised_denoi.title: Enhancing Graph Contrastive Learning with Reliable and Informative Augmentation for Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2025/self_supervised_denoi.description: [KDD 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 用端到端多级向量量化学习离散码，将码作为虚拟邻居与语义正样本构建三重对比视图，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@10 最高提升 17.5%。

venues/RecSys/2025/self_supervised_denoi.title: Squeeze and Excitation: A Weighted Graph Contrastive Learning for Collaborative Filtering
venues/RecSys/2025/self_supervised_denoi.description: [SIGIR 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 仅扰动末层GCN视图并用SENet动态加权特征，在三个数据集上实现最高24.45%的NDCG@20提升。

venues/RecSys/2025/self_supervised_denoi.title: SGCL: Unifying Self-Supervised and Supervised Learning for Graph Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2025/self_supervised_denoi.description: [RecSys 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 将 BPR 与 InfoNCE 合并为单一监督图对比损失，免增广免负采样，精度与训练效率双超 SGL/SimGCL。

venues/RecSys/2025/self_supervised_denoi.title: RaDAR: Relation-aware Diffusion-Asymmetric Graph Contrastive Learning for Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2025/self_supervised_denoi.description: [WWW 2026][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 以 VGAE 生成视图与关系感知去噪视图构成双视图，叠加扩散引导增广与非对称对比目标，在 Full-Ranking 下 Recall@20 相对 SOTA 提升 3.8%–4.7%。

venues/RecSys/2025/self_supervised_denoi.title: Generative Data Augmentation in Graph Contrastive Learning for Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2025/self_supervised_denoi.description: [CIKM 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 用 VAE 式生成器自适应生成噪声替代固定随机扰动构造对比视图，并引入物品互补矩阵，在三个稀疏数据集上 Full-Ranking 提升约 3–6%。

venues/RecSys/2025/self_supervised_denoi.title: NLGCL: Naturally Existing Neighbor Layers Graph Contrastive Learning for Recommendation

venues/RecSys/2025/self_supervised_denoi.title: Squeeze and Excitation: A Weighted Graph Contrastive Learning for Collaborative Filtering
venues/RecSys/2025/self_supervised_denoi.description: [SIGIR 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 仅扰动末层GCN视图并用SENet动态加权特征，在三个数据集上实现最高24.45%的NDCG@20提升。

venues/RecSys/2025/self_supervised_denoi.title: Generative Data Augmentation in Graph Contrastive Learning for Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2025/self_supervised_denoi.description: [CIKM 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 用 VAE 式生成器自适应生成噪声替代固定随机扰动构造对比视图，并引入物品互补矩阵，在三个稀疏数据集上 Full-Ranking 提升约 3–6%。

venues/RecSys/2025/self_supervised_denoi.title: RecLM: Recommendation Instruction Tuning
venues/RecSys/2025/self_supervised_denoi.description: [ACL 2025][大语言模型推荐] 以两轮协同指令微调+RL画像精炼为LLM注入协同信号，作为即插即用画像增强器在零样本冷启动下带来最高 200%+ 的 Recall 提升。

venues/RecSys/2025/self_supervised_denoi.title: A Unified Framework for Adaptive Representation Enhancement and Inversed Learning in Cross-Domain Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2025/self_supervised_denoi.description: [DASFAA 2024][跨域与多场景推荐] 解耦共享/专属表征，用 LightGCN 域内增强 + 自注意力跨域自适应融合 + GRL 逆向约束，全库排序下 Recall@20 最高提升 8.31%。

venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/esasre.title: Do Sequential Recommendation Benchmarks Really Require Higher-Order Sequence Modelling?
venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/esasre.description: [RecSys 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用两个不学高阶序列表征的近期加权成对探针（SeqRules/PCTM）在 eSASRec 协议下反超 Transformer，质疑主流基准的容量测量效度。

venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/esasre.title: Scaling Recommender Transformers to One Billion Parameters
venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/esasre.description: [KDD 2026][序列与会话推荐] ARGUS 将自回归预训练解耦为反馈预测与下一物品预测双任务，把推荐 Transformer 编码器扩到 10 亿参数，线上听歌时长 +2.26%、点赞率 +6.37%。
