venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/esasre.title: TransRetrieval: Scaling Up Transformer-Based Retrieval for Industrial Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/esasre.description: [CIKM 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用加权平均聚合+目标Token压缩+位置式域嵌入，让Transformer在召回阶段实现对数线性Scaling，线上收入+2.53%。

venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/esasre.title: OneRank: Unified Transformer-Native Ranking Architecture for Multi-Task Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/esasre.description: [KDD 2026][多任务学习与列表级重排] 将多任务推理内化进 Transformer 栈，用任务私有 token 通道 + 梯度截断 + 匹配式打分替代编码器-预测器分离，Shopee 离线与线上 A/B 全面领先。

venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/more_a.title: Lost in Sequence: Do Large Language Models Understand Sequential Recommendation?

venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/more_a.title: Reformulating Sequential Recommendation: Learning Dynamic User Interest with Content-enriched Language Modeling
venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/more_a.description: [DASFAA 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用知识提示+推理提示将序列推荐改写为文本生成任务，GPT-2 冻结主干下在三个数据集全排序协议上取得 Recall@5 相对提升约 5%–12%。

venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/more_a.title: LLM2Rec: Large Language Models Are Powerful Embedding Models for Sequential Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/more_a.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 两阶段将 LLM 改造为融合协同信号与语义的物品嵌入模型，Full-Ranking 下域内平均提升约 15%、跨域仍稳定增益。

venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/more_a.title: What Makes LLMs Effective Sequential Recommenders? A Study on Preference Intensity and Temporal Context
venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/more_a.description: [ACL 2026][大语言模型推荐] 揭示二元偏好对齐丢失偏好强度与时序上下文，提出自适应奖励边际 RecPO，五数据集 HR@1 全面领先 S-DPO。

venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/more_a.title: Efficient Sequential Recommendation for Long Term User Interest Via Personalization

venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/not_ju.title: Recommendation Is a Dish Better Served Warm
venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/not_ju.description: [RecSys 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 系统量化冷启动阈值：物品侧训练交互扫描+用户侧推理历史截断，揭示 6–15 条交互的冷热分界并批判 p-core 过滤的任意性。

venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/not_ju.title: Time Matters: Enhancing Sequential Recommendations with Time-Guided Graph Neural ODEs
venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/not_ju.description: [KDD 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用时间引导扩散补全稀疏用户时间图、图神经ODE对齐用户兴趣与物品演化，五数据集Recall@20最高提升46%。

venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/not_ju.title: RoTE: Coarse-to-Fine Multi-Level Rotary Time Embedding for Sequential Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/not_ju.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 将时间戳分解为年/月/日多粒度并借 RoPE 旋转注入 Q/K，即插即用提升 SASRec/RPG，NDCG@5 最高 +20.11%

venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/not_ju.title: A Contextual-Aware Position Encoding for Sequential Recommendation

venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/time_t.title: Pay Attention to Sequence Split: Uncovering the Impacts of Sub-Sequence Splitting on Sequential Recommendation Models

venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/time_t.title: RecNextEval: A Reference Implementation for Temporal Next-Batch Recommendation Evaluation

venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/time_t.title: SplitLight: An Exploratory Toolkit for Recommender Systems Datasets and Splits
venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/time_t.description: [SIGIR 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 开源数据集与划分审计工具箱，量化时间泄漏、冷启动暴露、重复消费与分布漂移，揭示预处理决策可使 NDCG@10 变动 1.2%–60%。

venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/time_t.title: Beyond Utility: Evaluating LLM as Recommender
venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/time_t.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出含历史长度敏感性、候选位置偏差、画像生成与幻觉四维的 LLM 推荐多维评测框架，揭示 LLM 在重排与冷启动占优但位置偏差严重。

venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/time_t.title: Lost in Sequence: Do Large Language Models Understand Sequential Recommendation?
venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/time_t.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 揭示现有 LLM4Rec 模型无法捕捉交互序列顺序信息，提出冻结 LLM 与 CF-SRec、仅训练轻量 MLP 的蒸馏框架 LLM-SRec，在 Amazon 四数据集上 NDCG@10 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/user_l.title: MISS: Multi-Modal Tree Indexing and Searching with Lifelong Sequential Behavior for Retrieval Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/user_l.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 用多模态嵌入构建树索引，并以 Co-GSU/MM-GSU 双视角检索终身行为，快手线上召回@800 相对提升 37.9%。

venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/user_l.title: Mixture of Sequence: Theme-Aware Mixture-of-Experts for Long-Sequence Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/user_l.description: [WWW 2026][序列与会话推荐] 揭示长序列“会话跳跃”现象，用主题码本路由+多尺度专家融合做子序列抽取，AUC 平均提升 0.68% 且 FLOPs 更低

venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/user_l.title: Pyramid Mixer: Multi-dimensional Multi-period Interest Modeling for Sequential Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/user_l.description: [SIGIR 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用纯 MLP 金字塔 Mixer 做跨行为/跨特征/跨周期三维兴趣建模，离线全库排序超越 SASRec/MLP4Rec，抖音线上停留时长 +0.106%。

venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/user_l.title: Unleashing the Potential of Sparse Attention on Long-term Behaviors for CTR Prediction
venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/user_l.description: [WWW 2026][CTR预估与特征交叉] 面向长行为序列 CTR 的个性化时间分块 + 三分支稀疏注意力 SparseCTR，AUC 相对提升 8.49%，线上 CTR +1.72%。

venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/user_l.title: Massive Memorization with Hundreds of Trillions of Parameters for Sequential Transducer Generative Recommenders
venues/RecSys/2025/sequential_rec/user_l.description: [ICLR 2026][序列与会话推荐] VISTA 将超长用户历史两阶段解耦：离线用准线性注意力压缩为数百种子嵌入并缓存，下游仅做候选-摘要注意力，工业上线推理 GPU 降 94%。

venues/RecSys/2025/social_group_rec/a_mu.title: Toward Holistic Evaluation of Recommender Systems Powered by Generative Models
venues/RecSys/2025/social_group_rec/a_mu.description: [SIGIR 2025][去偏公平与工业评测] 提出 Gen-RecSys 评估挑战二分法与 WH-六问 + 三维目标(D1–D5)整体评估框架，用场景化案例揭示传统 NDCG 无法覆盖的幻觉、偏见与政策合规风险。

venues/RecSys/2025/social_group_rec/a_mu.title: A Standardized Re-evaluation of Conversational Recommender Systems on the ReDial Dataset
venues/RecSys/2025/social_group_rec/a_mu.description: [SIGIR 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 统一复现 7 个 CRS 模型，揭示 Recall@1 复现粒度鸿沟、约 50% 精度来自重复捷径、增益多源于 LLM 骨干而非架构创新。

venues/RecSys/2025/social_group_rec/a_mu.title: Normative Alignment of Recommender Systems via Internal Label Shift
venues/RecSys/2025/social_group_rec/a_mu.description: [RecSys 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 将编辑/公平目标建模为属性层内部标签偏移，用免重训的闭式重加权实现系统级规范对齐，KL 大幅下降且 AUC 基本无损。

venues/RecSys/2025/social_group_rec/a_mu.title: Consistent Explainers or Unreliable Narrators? Understanding LLM-generated Group Recommendations
venues/RecSys/2025/social_group_rec/a_mu.description: [RecSys 2025][社交与群组推荐] 用社会选择聚合策略作多基线对4个LLM的群组推荐与解释做一致性审计，发现推荐近似ADD、解释常称平均但夹带未定义流行度/相似度/多样性。

venues/RecSys/2025/social_group_rec/a_mu.title: Have We Really Understood Collaborative Information? An Empirical Investigation
venues/RecSys/2025/social_group_rec/a_mu.description: [WSDM 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 以物品共现路径长度量化协作信息为0/1/2-hop协作关系，系统实证其在六个基准上的分布、对12种推荐算法的影响与预测依赖，揭示模型强于简单CR、弱于复杂CR的核心规律。

venues/RecSys/2025/social_group_rec/cons.title: The Utility of LLMs in Recommender Systems Explanation Evaluation
venues/RecSys/2025/social_group_rec/cons.description: [RecSys 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 系统评测 14 个 LLM 作为推荐解释评审员与 216 名人类评分的一致性，发现排序相关中等但绝对评分一致性低，并给出四条实用准则。

venues/RecSys/2025/social_group_rec/cons.description: [ICWSM 2026][LLM4Rec] 预注册在线实验(N=759)+访谈(N=30)对比无解释/通用解释/情境化解释，情境化解释显著提升认知需求与观看意愿，但对功利/情感需求增益有限。

venues/RecSys/2025/social_group_rec/cons.title: From Counterfactual Edits to Human Narratives: LLM-Driven Interpretations for Recommender System Explanations
venues/RecSys/2025/social_group_rec/cons.description: [CIKM 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用 LLM 将冗长反事实编辑列表摘要为高层偏好叙事，并以人类校准指标评估正确性/信息量/语言质量。

venues/RecSys/2025/social_group_rec/cons.title: Consensus vs. Dissent: Dynamic LLM Modeling of Subjective Preferences in Group Recommenders
venues/RecSys/2025/social_group_rec/cons.description: [RecSys 2026][社交与群组推荐] 用人类问卷+DeepSeek-V3.1 蒸馏 CoT 微调 Llama/OLMo 作实时判断模型，动态挑选社会选择聚合策略，用户研究(n=284)中公平与共识得分最高。

venues/RecSys/2025/social_group_rec/you_.title: Content-Agnostic Moderation for Stance-Neutral Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2025/social_group_rec/you_.description: [CIKM 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 提出不依赖内容特征的立场中立化后处理审核，用双聚类离散化打散用户-物品共簇，仿真闭环中显著降低立场偏度且 CTR 仅降约 11%。

venues/RecSys/2025/social_group_rec/you_.title: Recommendation and Temptation
venues/RecSys/2025/social_group_rec/you_.description: [RecSys 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 将用户选择解耦为 enrichment 与 temptation 双效用并引入站外选项，证明局部贪心最优并给出可估计算子，MovieLens 与仿真全面超越基线。

venues/RecSys/2025/social_group_rec/you_.title: TruthSR: Trustworthy Sequential Recommender Systems via User-generated Multimodal Content
venues/RecSys/2025/social_group_rec/you_.description: [DASFAA 2025][多模态推荐] 用评论-图片跨模态一致性降噪 + 主观逻辑证据融合做可信序列推荐，四数据集 Full-Ranking 全面超越 MMSRec。

venues/RecSys/2025/social_group_rec/you_.title: iAgent: LLM Agent as a Shield between User and Recommender Systems
venues/RecSys/2025/social_group_rec/you_.description: [ACL 2025 Findings][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出 user-agent-platform 新范式，用个体指令感知 LLM Agent 在用户与平台间做重排护盾，四数据集平均提升 16.6%。

venues/RecSys/2025/social_group_rec/you_.title: On Inherited Popularity Bias in Cold-Start Item Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2025/social_group_rec/you_.description: [RecSys 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 揭示生成式冷启动模型继承热模型流行度偏置，提出基于向量模长重标定的免训练后处理去偏方法，在三个多媒体数据集上显著提升物品公平性与曝光多样性。

venues/RecSys/2026/agent_conversational_.description: [ICDM 2025 (Demo)][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 双模式智能体 Copilot：PersoAgent 做上下文人格抽取与社区推荐，Analytic Tools 用 Phi-4-mini+TF-IDF 主动学习闭环做可解释人格分类，UniEval 四维均分 0.84–1.0。

venues/RecSys/2026/agent_conversational_.title: LLM-as-a-Judge for Reliable and Explainable Offline Evaluation in Top-K Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/agent_conversational_.description: [KDD 2026][去偏公平与工业评测] 用 LLM 从用户文本行为构建语义偏好代理替代 holdout ID 匹配，以 reasoning-then-scoring 生成可解释 Top-K 评测，模型排序一致性较常规测试提升 40–150%。

venues/RecSys/2026/agent_conversational_.title: HARP: Training-Free Dual-Profile Agentic Communication for LLM-Based Recommendation

venues/RecSys/2026/agent_conversational_.title: Beyond the past: Leveraging Audio and Human Memory for Sequential Music Recommendation

venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/hypoth.description: [SIGIR 2026][大语言模型推荐] 将电商分面搜索重构为分面生成与查询改写两个耦合生成任务，经蒸馏+SFT+GRPO 对齐搜索效用，线上分面 CTR 相对提升 42.0%。

venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/hypoth.title: ItemRAG: Item-Based Retrieval-Augmented Generation for LLM-Based Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/hypoth.description: [SIGIR 2026][大语言模型推荐] 将 RAG 从粗粒度用户历史检索转向细粒度物品级检索，融合共购与语义信息，标准与冷启动场景全面超越用户级 RAG 基线。

venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/not_al.title: Topology-Aware Tokenization for Generative Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/not_al.description: [RecSys 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 揭示 RQ-VAE 语义 ID 量化中的拓扑失真问题，提出由粗到细的三级拓扑蒸馏 TopoTok，在 Amazon 三数据集 Full-Ranking 下 Recall@5 最高提升 9.42%。

venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/not_al.title: Efficient Optimization of Hierarchical Identifiers for Generative Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/not_al.description: [ECIR 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 复现SEATER并指出其平衡k-ary树构建是训练瓶颈，提出贪心/混合聚类将建树时间降至2%/5-8%且检索质量持平甚至更优。

venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/not_al.title: Understanding Generative Recommendation with Semantic IDs from a Model-scaling View
venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/not_al.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐] 揭示 SID 式生成推荐在编码器/量化器/RS 三轴扩展均快速饱和，归因于 SID 语义容量瓶颈，并证明 Text-based GR 具备更优扩展性且 CF 能力随规模提升。

venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/not_al.title: SPRIG: Semantic-ID-enhanced Paths for Knowledge Graph-based Generative Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/not_al.description: [CIKM 2026][生成式推荐] 将内容派生的分层语义 ID 注入知识图谱路径语言建模，以 768 个共享码替代逐物品词表，nDCG@10 较 KGGLM 提升 44%/58% 且参数与算力更低。

venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/not_al.title: Rethinking Semantic ID Construction for Generative Recommendation: SimHash with Parallel Decoding and Semantic Alignment
venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/not_al.description: [NeurIPS 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 揭示LSH分词劣势源于与自回归解码的结构错配，提出免训练SimHash+并行解码+语义对齐的FLASH，全库排序下NDCG@5最高提升14.46%。

venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/tokens.title: TokenRec: Learning to Tokenize ID for LLM-based Generative Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/tokens.description: [TKDE 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用掩码K路向量量化把GNN协同表征压成LLM兼容离散token，并以生成式检索替代自回归解码，HR@20平均提升约19%、推理加速超10倍。

venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/tokens.title: Semantic IDs for Joint Generative Search and Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/tokens.description: [RecSys 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 系统对比任务专属与跨任务语义ID构建策略，发现多任务双塔嵌入+统一RQ-KMeans语义ID在联合搜索推荐中取得最佳权衡。

venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/tokens.title: Beyond Item IDs: Scaling Short-Form-Video Recommendation via Semantic-Native Long Sequence Modeling
venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/tokens.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用深度截断 Bi-gram 语义 ID 替代正交 Video ID，并以无参时间折叠压缩 Transformer 将序列扩至 2000，线上满意观看时长 +1.42%。

venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/tokens.title: Generating Long Semantic IDs in Parallel for Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/tokens.description: [KDD 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 提出 RPG 用多 token 并行预测 + 图约束解码，将语义 ID 长度扩至 64，NDCG@10 平均超生成式基线 12.6% 且推理更省。

venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/tokens.title: Order-agnostic Identifier for Large Language Model-based Generative Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/tokens.description: [SIGIR 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 提出无序集合标识符范式，用CF+语义多token集合表示物品并同时生成，T5上Recall@10平均提升约50%，推理提速8-18倍。

venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/topolo.title: Not All Branches Are Equal: Adaptive Semantic ID Construction for Generative Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/topolo.description: [RecSys 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义 ID] 将语义 ID 重构为树路径，用轮廓系数自适应分支+概率质量约束构建 AST，五域 Amazon 全库排序平均相对提升 13.08%

venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/topolo.title: Rethinking Item Tokenization in Generative Recommenders: From Fixed Atoms to Semantic Subwords
venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/topolo.description: [CIKM 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 指出固定长度SID复用于历史侧引发“物品内注意力过载”，提出历史侧语义子词重分词(IST)+行为共现增强(BCA)的非对称分词，三数据集三骨干全库排序NDCG@10最高+13.8%。

venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/topolo.title: TokenRec: Learning to Tokenize ID for LLM-based Generative Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/topolo.description: [TKDE 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用掩码K路向量量化把GNN协同表征压成LLM兼容离散token，并以生成式检索替代自回归解码，HR@20平均提升约19%、推理加速超10倍。

venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/topolo.title: Learning Decomposed Contextual Token Representations from Pretrained and Collaborative Signals for Generative Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/topolo.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] DECOR 用冻结码本+可学协同嵌入分解融合、上下文 token 组合与可学 BOS 查询，缓解静态分词歧义与预训练语义丢失，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@10 最高提升 14%。

venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/topolo.title: Order-agnostic Identifier for Large Language Model-based Generative Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/topolo.description: [SIGIR 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 提出无序集合标识符范式，用CF+语义多token集合表示物品并同时生成，T5上Recall@10平均提升约50%，推理提速8-18倍。

venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/toward.title: Scaling Recommender Transformers to One Billion Parameters
venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/toward.description: [KDD 2026][序列与会话推荐] ARGUS 将自回归预训练解耦为反馈预测与下一物品预测双任务，把推荐 Transformer 编码器扩到 10 亿参数，线上听歌时长 +2.26%、点赞率 +6.37%。

venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/toward.title: Climber: Toward Efficient Scaling Laws for Large Recommendation Models
venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/toward.description: [CIKM 2025][序列与会话推荐] 面向推荐场景改造 Transformer：多尺度子序列抽取降复杂度、自适应温度调制注意力，配合单用户多物品批处理与 KV 缓存，线上指标 +12.19%。

venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/toward.title: KuaiRecV2: Benchmarking Large-Scale Continual Learning for Diversified and Multi-task Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/toward.description: [NeurIPS 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 快手 30 天 4.84 亿交互动态物品池基准，统一评测持续学习、Token 级多样性与多任务检索。

venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/toward.title: GenRec: A Preference-Oriented Generative Framework for Large-Scale Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/toward.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 以 Page-wise NTP 解一对多歧义、线性 Token Merger 压缩 2× 输入、GRPO-SR 混合奖励对齐偏好，京东线上点击 +9.5%、成交 +8.7%。

venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/toward.title: Rethinking Item Tokenization in Generative Recommenders: From Fixed Atoms to Semantic Subwords
venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/toward.description: [CIKM 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 指出固定长度SID复用于历史侧引发“物品内注意力过载”，提出历史侧语义子词重分词(IST)+行为共现增强(BCA)的非对称分词，三数据集三骨干全库排序NDCG@10最高+13.8%。

venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/unirec.title: From IDs to Semantics: A Generative Framework for Cross-Domain Recommendation with Adaptive Semantic Tokenization
venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/unirec.description: [AAAI 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 用领域自适应语义ID分词+对称动态路由的生成式跨域推荐框架，Leave-Last-Out全库排序下全面超越SOTA。

venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/unirec.title: RecBase: Generative Foundation Model Pretraining for Zero-Shot Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/unirec.description: [EMNLP 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用课程学习增强的 RQ-VAE 将跨域物品统一离散为层级概念 ID，从零预训练 1.5B 自回归推荐基座，在 8 个未见数据集零样本 AUC 全面超越 7B LLM。

venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/unirec.title: TokenRec: Learning to Tokenize ID for LLM-based Generative Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/unirec.description: [TKDE 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用掩码K路向量量化把GNN协同表征压成LLM兼容离散token，并以生成式检索替代自回归解码，HR@20平均提升约19%、推理加速超10倍。

venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/unirec.title: Universal Item Tokenization for Transferable Generative Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/unirec.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用 MLLM+树状码本构建跨域通用物品分词器，结合内容重建与共现协同对齐，实现可迁移生成式推荐，全库排序下全面超越基线。

venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/unirec.title: Bridging Language and Items for Retrieval and Recommendation: Benchmarking LLMs as Semantic Encoders
venues/RecSys/2026/generative_rec/unirec.description: [ACL 2026][大语言模型推荐] 构建 BLaIR 基准，用 11 个 LLM 作语义编码器评测序列推荐、协同过滤与复杂查询商品搜索，揭示其排名与 MTEB 几乎不相关。

venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/deepaffinity_.title: What Makes LLMs Effective Sequential Recommenders? A Study on Preference Intensity and Temporal Context
venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/deepaffinity_.description: [ACL 2026][大语言模型推荐] 揭示二元偏好对齐丢失偏好强度与时序上下文，提出自适应奖励边际 RecPO，五数据集 HR@1 全面领先 S-DPO。

venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/deepaffinity_.title: Tail-Aware Data Augmentation for Long-Tail Sequential Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/deepaffinity_.description: [WWW 2026][冷启动与长尾推荐] 用线性物品相似度构建候选集，设计 T-Substitute/T-Insert 两个尾部感知算子并在表征层 Mixup，实现头部与尾部双赢的长尾序列推荐数据增强。

venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/deepaffinity_.title: Modeling Stage-wise Evolution of User Interests for News Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/deepaffinity_.description: [WWW 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用全局LightGCN+阶段时序子图LSTM/自注意力双分支建模新闻兴趣演化，Adressa AUC 0.7993 大幅超越SOTA。

venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/deepaffinity_.title: Listwise Preference Diffusion Optimization for User Behavior Trajectories Prediction
venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/deepaffinity_.description: [NeurIPS 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 将 Plackett-Luce 列表级排序信号注入扩散 ELBO，实现多步用户行为轨迹的连贯生成，并提出 SeqMatch 轨迹级指标，Full-Ranking 下 SeqMatch@50 最高提升 36.8%。

venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/deepaffinity_.title: Effectiveness of LLMs in Temporal User Profiling for Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/deepaffinity_.description: [ICDM 2025 Workshop][LLM4Rec] 用 LLM 分别生成短期/长期自然语言画像，经 SBERT 编码与注意力融合做内容推荐，Movies&TV 上 Recall@10 相对提升 17%。

venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/improving_rar.title: Fine-grained List-wise Alignment for Generative Medication Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/improving_rar.description: [NeurIPS 2025][LLM推荐] 将用药推荐重构为逐药序列决策，提出逐步GRPO与势函数奖励塑形实现细粒度信用分配，在MIMIC-III上Jaccard达0.4836并支持安全-精度可控权衡。

venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/improving_rar.title: User-Adaptive Meta-Learning for Cold-Start Medication Recommendation with Uncertainty Filtering
venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/improving_rar.description: [ICDE 2026][冷启动与长尾推荐] 提出两级元自适应（自自适应+同伴自适应）与不确定性过滤的 MetaDrug，在 MIMIC-III/AKI 冷启动患者上 PRAUC 提升约 2.5%-6.2%。

venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/improving_rar.title: Reasoning over Semantic IDs Enhances Generative Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/improving_rar.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 通过教师模型合成富化语料强化 SID-语言对齐，再用 GRPO 结果驱动强化学习激发 SID 推理，三数据集 Full-Ranking 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/improving_rar.title: Explainable CTR Prediction via LLM Reasoning
venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/improving_rar.description: [WSDM 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用 PPO 双奖励（LC 用户意图对齐 + IC 与 ID-CTR 模型对齐）把 LLM 解释生成嵌入 CTR 流程，免解释数据集，AUC 最高提升 18.2%。

venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/improving_rar.title: DELRec: Distilling Sequential Pattern to Enhance LLMs-based Sequential Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/improving_rar.description: [ICDE 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用软提示两阶段蒸馏传统序列模型的时间感知与推荐模式，再微调 LLM 做序列推荐，四数据集 HR/NDCG 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/llm_based_use.title: LLM-Powered Nuanced Video Attribute Annotation for Enhanced Recommendations
venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/llm_based_use.description: [RecSys 2025][多模态推荐] 用 Gemini 多模态 LLM 做短视频“氛围”属性标注，经金/银集评估与蒸馏扩量，接入个性化受限召回，线上参与度 +0.49%。

venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/llm_based_use.title: RECAP: Feedback-Driven Streaming Semantic User Profiles for Short-Video Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/llm_based_use.description: [RecSys 2026][LLM4Rec] 将流式结构化用户画像视为有界记忆状态，用 LLM 语义差分+确定性状态机维护，并以 LLM 判官清洗隐式反馈、双塔评估器打分作 GRPO 奖励闭环优化画像更新器。

venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/llm_based_use.title: Balancing Fine-tuning and RAG: A Hybrid Strategy for Dynamic LLM Recommendation Updates
venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/llm_based_use.description: [RecSys 2025][LLM4Rec] 以十亿用户短视频兴趣探索系统为案例，量化对比微调与RAG的更新代价/敏捷性，提出月度微调+周内RAG刷新的混合更新策略，线上A/B显著提升满意度。

venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/llm_based_use.title: LWGR: Lagrangian-Constrained Personalized World Knowledge for Generative Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/llm_based_use.description: [SIGIR 2026][大语言模型推荐] 用并行码本生成用户个性化软指令抽取 LLM 世界知识，并以拉格朗日原始-对偶约束控制知识融合，Full-Ranking 下最高相对提升 11.23%，线上广告收入 +1.35%

venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/llm_based_use.title: Iterative Semantic Reasoning from Individual to Group Interests for Generative Recommendation with LLMs
venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/llm_based_use.description: [WWW 2026][LLM4Rec] 用 LLM 双向 CoT 推理物品/用户语义，构建个体显式兴趣图与相似用户群隐式兴趣图，并以对比蒸馏迭代对齐，直接推荐 H@10 最高提升 24.57%。

venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/llm_reasoning.title: ReRec: Reasoning-Augmented LLM-based Recommendation Assistant via Reinforcement Fine-tuning
venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/llm_reasoning.description: [ACL 2026][大语言模型推荐] 用双图奖励塑形、推理感知优势估计与在线课程调度改造 RFT，使 3B LLM 在复杂查询推荐上大幅超越 GRPO 系基线并保留通用能力。

venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/llm_reasoning.title: Reason4Rec: Deliberative User Preference Alignment of Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/llm_reasoning.description: [TKDE 2026][大语言模型推荐] 提出审慎推荐任务与三专家多步推理框架，用评论监督偏好蒸馏-匹配-预测，评分预测与排序全面领先。

venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/llm_reasoning.title: R4ec: A Reasoning, Reflection, and Refinement Framework for Recommendation Systems
venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/llm_reasoning.description: [RecSys 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用 actor/reflection 双小模型迭代反思精炼 LLM 知识，注入 CTR 主干，AUC 相对提升 2.5%+，线上收入 +2.2%。

venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/llm_reasoning.title: ThinkRec: Thinking-based Recommendation via LLM
venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/llm_reasoning.description: [WWW 2026][大语言模型推荐] 以合成推理链激活 LLM 的 System 2 思维，并用实例级 LoRA 专家融合适配异构用户，AUC 平均提升 7.96%。

venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/llm_reasoning.title: $τ$-Rec: A Verifiable Benchmark for Agentic Recommender Systems
venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/llm_reasoning.description: [RecSys 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用可验证目录谓词奖励、reveal-tagged 信息揭示机制与 pass^k 可靠性指标替代 LLM-as-judge，揭示智能体推荐在隐藏约束下的可靠性悬崖。

venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/pairwise_rank.title: Retrieval, Scoring, and Decoding Shape Performance and Stability in LLM-based Conversational Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/pairwise_rank.description: [CIKM 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 在 ReDial 上系统解耦候选池规模、一阶段检索器与解码温度对 LLM 重排器的影响，揭示协议选择可移动 NDCG@10 超过模型差距。

venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/pairwise_rank.title: The Recall Ceiling of LLM Recommendation Reranking
venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/pairwise_rank.description: [CIKM 2026][LLM4Rec] 证明闭候选重排器 NDCG 受自身窗口召回率硬上界约束，Oracle 协议高估 92–95%，九类 LLM 与监督重排器在真实检索下均无法显著超越 CF。

venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/pairwise_rank.title: DeGRe: Dense-supervised Generative Reranking for Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/pairwise_rank.description: [KDD 2026][多任务学习与列表级重排] 离线束搜索挖掘前瞻序列+累积回归稠密监督蒸馏至轻量生成器，单次贪心解码逼近全局最优，线上GMV+3.75%

venues/RecSys/2026/llm_rec/pairwise_rank.title: MARM: Unlocking the Future of Recommendation Systems through Memory Augmentation and Scalable Complexity

venues/RecSys/2026/multi_task_reranking/.description: [CIKM 2026][多任务学习与列表级重排] 将多任务信息流下沉至统一排序主干，以共享/私有 Anchor Token 逐层共演化，离线七任务全胜、线上时长+3.0%、P99 延迟降约30%。

venues/RecSys/2026/multi_task_reranking/.title: Towards Generalizable and Efficient Large-Scale Generative Recommenders
venues/RecSys/2026/multi_task_reranking/.description: [RecSys 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 将生成式推荐骨干从2M扩至1B，用偏移幂律缩放律诊断任务天花板，并以MTP、采样softmax与语义塔解决缓存陈旧与冷启动，1M用户影子MRR全线提升。

venues/RecSys/2026/multi_task_reranking/.title: KuaiRecV2: Benchmarking Large-Scale Continual Learning for Diversified and Multi-task Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/multi_task_reranking/.description: [NeurIPS 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 快手 30 天 4.84 亿交互动态物品池基准，统一评测持续学习、Token 级多样性与多任务检索。

venues/RecSys/2026/multi_task_reranking/.title: KuaiLive: A Real-time Interactive Dataset for Live Streaming Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/multi_task_reranking/.description: [SIGIR 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 首个含直播间生命周期与多行为实时交互的快手直播推荐数据集，构建 Top-K/CTR 基准并揭示主播长尾公平性挑战。

venues/RecSys/2026/multi_task_reranking/.title: Foresight Prediction Enhanced Live-Streaming Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/multi_task_reranking/.description: [WSDM 2026][序列与会话推荐] 将直播切片经 LLM 语义量化成 Sid 序列，用 Transformer 编解码预测下一段内容，作为前瞻特征注入多任务精排，线上曝光 +0.46%、送礼 +2.48%。

venues/RecSys/2026/multi_task_reranking/.title: Heterogeneous Multi-treatment Uplift Modeling for Trade-off Optimization in Short-Video Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/multi_task_reranking/.description: [KDD 2026][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用异构多处理增益建模+在线动态权重，个性化权衡短视频消费与商业化指标，快手全量部署

venues/RecSys/2026/multi_task_reranking/.title: Pyramid Mixer: Multi-dimensional Multi-period Interest Modeling for Sequential Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/multi_task_reranking/.description: [SIGIR 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用纯 MLP 金字塔 Mixer 做跨行为/跨特征/跨周期三维兴趣建模，离线全库排序超越 SASRec/MLP4Rec，抖音线上停留时长 +0.106%。

venues/RecSys/2026/multi_task_reranking/.title: Mend the Measurement Gap: Latent User Preference Modeling for Short-Form Video Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/multi_task_reranking/.description: [RecSys 2026][多模态推荐] 将异构行为反馈视为隐价值状态的噪声测量，用受限基线+因子化路由瓶颈解耦时长混杂，YouTube Shorts 线上主指标提升 2.67%

venues/RecSys/2026/multi_task_reranking/.title: One Pass, Any Order: Position-Invariant Listwise Reranking for LLM-Based Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/multi_task_reranking/.description: [SIGIR 2026][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用结构化注意力掩码+共享位置框架在架构层消除候选顺序依赖，单次前向实现近完美排列不变性，nDCG 仅微降。

venues/RecSys/2026/multi_task_reranking/.title: What Makes LLMs Effective Sequential Recommenders? A Study on Preference Intensity and Temporal Context
venues/RecSys/2026/multi_task_reranking/.description: [ACL 2026][大语言模型推荐] 揭示二元偏好对齐丢失偏好强度与时序上下文，提出自适应奖励边际 RecPO，五数据集 HR@1 全面领先 S-DPO。

venues/RecSys/2026/multi_task_reranking/.title: Beyond Utility: Evaluating LLM as Recommender
venues/RecSys/2026/multi_task_reranking/.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出含历史长度敏感性、候选位置偏差、画像生成与幻觉四维的 LLM 推荐多维评测框架，揭示 LLM 在重排与冷启动占优但位置偏差严重。

venues/RecSys/2026/multi_task_reranking/.title: Every Preference Has Its Strength: Injecting Ordinal Semantics into LLM-Based Recommenders
venues/RecSys/2026/multi_task_reranking/.description: [SIGIR 2026][LLM推荐] 将显式评分建模为LLM词表中的序数语义锚点，以强度感知对齐交互表征，在序列推荐Hit@1与成对偏好准确率上显著超越CF-LLM混合基线。

venues/RecSys/2026/multi_task_reranking/.title: Comprehensive List Generation for Multi-Generator Reranking
venues/RecSys/2026/multi_task_reranking/.description: [SIGIR 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 提出多生成器-评估器重排框架与列表全面性指标，用 CLIG 自动学习互补生成器，离线 AUC 提升 0.9%、线上观看时长 +0.48%。

venues/RecSys/2026/multi_task_reranking/.title: Think When Needed: Model-Aware Reasoning Routing for LLM-based Ranking
venues/RecSys/2026/multi_task_reranking/.description: [SIGIR 2026][大语言模型推荐] 提出轻量即插即用的模型感知推理路由器，在生成前逐实例决定 Think/Non-Think，以 Pareto 前沿策略在降 token 的同时提升排序效用。

venues/RecSys/2026/multi_task_reranking/.title: RouteRec: Behavior-Guided Sparse Routing for Sequential Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/multi_task_reranking/.description: [CIKM 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用会话行为线索（节奏/焦点/记忆/流行度）驱动分层稀疏 MoE 路由，六数据集 18 指标平均排名 1.61 显著优于次优 4.11。

venues/RecSys/2026/multi_task_reranking/.title: TripTailor: A Real-World Benchmark for Personalized Travel Planning
venues/RecSys/2026/multi_task_reranking/.description: [ACL 2025 Findings][时空轨迹与POI本地生活推荐] 构建50万真实POI与近4000条真人行程的个性化旅行规划基准，提出可行性/合理性/个性化三维评估与奖励模型对比框架，揭示SOTA LLM行程超越真人比例不足10%。

venues/RecSys/2026/multi_task_reranking/.title: SEP-GCN: Leveraging Similar Edge Pairs with Temporal and Spatial Contexts for Location-Based Recommender Systems
venues/RecSys/2026/multi_task_reranking/.description: [SIGIR-ICTIR 2025][时空轨迹与POI推荐] 以时空相似交互边对构建边级相似图并注入LightGCN传播，在NYC/Gowalla/Brightkite全库排序上Recall@20最高提升14.89%。

venues/RecSys/2026/multi_task_reranking/.title: From Overlooked to Explored: Recovering Item Relations via Mixture of Perspectives for Sequential Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/multi_task_reranking/.description: [CIKM 2026][序列推荐] 揭示自注意力相似性偏置导致异构关系被系统性忽略，提出 K 个视角透镜（亲和/对比双视图）校准注意力，7 个基准全库排序平均提升 3–11%。

venues/RecSys/2026/multimodal_rec/binge_.title: A Content-Driven Micro-Video Recommendation Dataset at Scale
venues/RecSys/2026/multimodal_rec/binge_.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 发布十亿级含原始视频模态的微视频推荐数据集 MicroLens，并系统基准 IDRec/VIDRec/VideoRec 三类范式，揭示端到端视频编码优于冻结特征的关键结论。

venues/RecSys/2026/multimodal_rec/binge_.title: VK-LSVD: A Large-Scale Industrial Dataset for Short-Video Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/multimodal_rec/binge_.description: [WWW 2026][序列与会话推荐] 发布 407 亿交互、千万用户、两千万短视频的工业级开放数据集，配全局时间切分与冷启动竞赛基准。

venues/RecSys/2026/multimodal_rec/binge_.title: Are Multimodal Embeddings Truly Beneficial for Recommendation? A Deep Dive into Whole vs. Individual Modalities
venues/RecSys/2026/multimodal_rec/binge_.description: [ECIR 2026][多模态推荐] 用模态剔除（常量/噪声替换）在14个模型上做受控实证，发现文本主导、图像近乎无效，简单融合基线增益源于架构伪影。

venues/RecSys/2026/multimodal_rec/binge_.title: NoteLLM-2: Multimodal Large Representation Models for Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/multimodal_rec/binge_.description: [KDD 2025][多模态推荐] 端到端微调 LLM+视觉编码器构建高效 MLRM，用 mICL 与门控后期融合缓解视觉忽视，I2I 全库召回 R@100 显著提升并落地线上 A/B。

venues/RecSys/2026/multimodal_rec/binge_.title: Do Recommender Systems Really Leverage Multimodal Content? A Comprehensive Analysis on Multimodal Representations for Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/multimodal_rec/binge_.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 用受控噪声实验证明多模态增益源于语义而非模型容量，并以 LVLM 结构化提示生成「原生多模态」[EOS] 嵌入替代晚期融合，Borda 聚合排名第一。

venues/RecSys/2026/multimodal_rec/mend_t.title: Short Video Segment-level User Dynamic Interests Modeling in Personalized Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/multimodal_rec/mend_t.description: [SIGIR 2025][多模态推荐] 将短视频切分为5秒片段，用CLIP视觉+ID双模态跨注意力建模片段级动态兴趣，以段内排序损失解决标签缺失，在跳看预测与视频推荐两任务上大幅超越基线。

venues/RecSys/2026/multimodal_rec/mend_t.title: When Top-ranked Recommendations Fail: Modeling Multi-Granular Negative Feedback for Explainable and Robust Video Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/multimodal_rec/mend_t.description: [AAAI 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 三智能体协同建模多粒度负反馈，S-GRPO 渐进奖励实现可解释视频推荐，线上快滑率降 9.4%

venues/RecSys/2026/multimodal_rec/mend_t.title: FlowTime: Towards Continuous Generative Watch Time Prediction via Flow-based Personalized Priors
venues/RecSys/2026/multimodal_rec/mend_t.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 提出连续生成式回归新范式，用一步VAE+归一化流个性化先验建模多峰观看时长分布，KuaiRec MAE降0.676%、线上播放时长+1.044%。

venues/RecSys/2026/multimodal_rec/mend_t.title: A Content-Driven Micro-Video Recommendation Dataset at Scale
venues/RecSys/2026/multimodal_rec/mend_t.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 发布十亿级含原始视频模态的微视频推荐数据集 MicroLens，并系统基准 IDRec/VIDRec/VideoRec 三类范式，揭示端到端视频编码优于冻结特征的关键结论。

venues/RecSys/2026/multimodal_rec/mend_t.title: Exploiting Fine-Grained Skip Behaviors for Micro-Video Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/multimodal_rec/mend_t.description: [AAAI 2025][多模态推荐] 将短视频跳过行为细分为高正/低正/负三级，构建双层正图与分层 BPR 损失，两数据集八项指标全面超越 FRAME 等基线。

venues/RecSys/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_re.title: S$^2$GR: Stepwise Semantic-Guided Reasoning in Latent Space for Generative Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_re.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐] 在每级 SID 码生成前插入受码本聚类语义对比监督的思考 token，实现逐步可验证潜在推理，工业短视频 A/B 显著提升时长。

venues/RecSys/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_re.title: Think2Go: Generative Next POI Recommendation with LLM Reasoning
venues/RecSys/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_re.description: [KDD 2026][时空轨迹与POI推荐] 统一SFT与RL推理的生成式Next-POI框架，用KDE时空认知不确定性与难度感知奖励差校准优势函数，Acc@1较GNPR提升5.8–7.5%。

venues/RecSys/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_re.title: RecRec: Latent Interests Recursive Reasoning for Sequential Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_re.description: [RecSys 2026][序列与会话推荐] 解耦推理态与预测态、以 R 个潜在兴趣做递归推理的免 RL 序列推荐框架，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@10 最高提升 14.8%。

venues/RecSys/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_re.title: Atomic Intent Reasoning: Bringing LLM Semantics to Industrial Cross-Domain Recommendations
venues/RecSys/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_re.description: [KDD 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 将 LLM 意图推理离线化为原子行为-意图对缓存，在线经意图树构建与目标感知检索实现约 400× 加速，快手 A/B 测试 GMV +3.446%。

venues/RecSys/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_re.title: Towards Context-aware Reasoning-enhanced Generative Searching in E-commerce
venues/RecSys/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_re.description: [WWW 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 将电商搜索异构上下文统一为JSON文本与残差K-Means语义ID，用SFT-RL自演化后训练与去偏R-GRPO提升生成式搜索排序，All-100K上HR@10相对提升6.24%。

venues/RecSys/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_re.title: Leave No One Behind: Fairness-Aware Cross-Domain Recommender Systems for Non-Overlapping Users
venues/RecSys/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_re.description: [RecSys 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 为无源域数据的非重叠用户生成虚拟源域画像，双注意力+限制器实现模型无关的跨域公平性纠偏，UGF最高降94.13%且整体精度不降。

venues/RecSys/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_re.title: SPOT-Trip: Dual-Preference Driven Out-of-Town Trip Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_re.description: [NeurIPS 2025][时空轨迹与POI推荐] 首次形式化异地行程推荐，用知识图谱静态偏好+Neural ODE动态偏好解耦建模，F1最高提升17.01%。

venues/RecSys/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_re.title: FairSort: Learning to Fair Rank for Personalized Recommendations in Two-Sided Platforms
venues/RecSys/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_re.description: [TKDE 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 将重排视为“跑道”而非背包，用公平提升速度+二分搜索保证用户最低效用，实现双边公平与个性化推荐的三方权衡。

venues/RecSys/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_re.title: Post-hoc Provider Fairness Adaptation via Hierarchical Exposure Alignment
venues/RecSys/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_re.description: [SIGIR 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 冻结基座+轻量公平适配器，用分层曝光对齐(HEFA)与可微NDCG联合优化，实现即插即用的提供方曝光公平。

venues/RecSys/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_re.title: Adaptive Location Hierarchy Learning for Long-Tailed Mobility Prediction
venues/RecSys/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_re.description: [WWW 2026][时空轨迹与POI推荐] 提出架构无关插件 ALOHA：LLM+CoT 自动构建城市定制四级语义层级，配合 Gumbel 扰动与节点自适应权重的层级损失，在 6 城数据集上对 RNN/GNN/Transformer/Diffusion 四类骨干一致提升，M@1 最高 +16.59%。

venues/RecSys/2026/rl_bandit_rec/long_te.title: ProRL: Effective Reinforcement Learning for Proactive Recommendation via Rectified Policy Gradient Estimation
venues/RecSys/2026/rl_bandit_rec/long_te.description: [ICML 2026][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 揭示主动推荐中策略梯度的长度捷径与高方差缺陷，提出逐步奖励中心化与位置特定优势估计，三数据集全面超越 SOTA。

venues/RecSys/2026/rl_bandit_rec/long_te.title: Beyond Static LLM Policies: Imitation-Enhanced Reinforcement Learning for Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/rl_bandit_rec/long_te.description: [ICDM 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用 LLM 轨迹作次优示范，经对抗逆强化学习提取奖励并加权模仿，离线 RL 策略在 Steam/Amazon 上累积奖励较 BiLLP 提升 13%+。

venues/RecSys/2026/rl_bandit_rec/long_te.title: Reward Balancing Revisited: Enhancing Offline Reinforcement Learning for Recommender Systems
venues/RecSys/2026/rl_bandit_rec/long_te.description: [WWW 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用扩散世界模型显式建模奖励不确定性，并以衰减加权的交互/熵双惩罚平衡多样性与长期收益，在三个真实数据集上刷新离线RL推荐SOTA。

venues/RecSys/2026/rl_bandit_rec/long_te.title: Recommendation and Temptation
venues/RecSys/2026/rl_bandit_rec/long_te.description: [RecSys 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 将用户选择解耦为 enrichment 与 temptation 双效用并引入站外选项，证明局部贪心最优并给出可估计算子，MovieLens 与仿真全面超越基线。

venues/RecSys/2026/rl_bandit_rec/long_te.title: Value Function Decomposition in Markov Recommendation Process
venues/RecSys/2026/rl_bandit_rec/long_te.description: [WWW 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 将标准 TD 损失分解为策略随机与用户环境随机两个子目标，实现更快收敛、更强探索鲁棒性的长期价值估计。

venues/RecSys/2026/sequential_rec/do_seq.title: SLMRec: Distilling Large Language Models into Small for Sequential Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/sequential_rec/do_seq.description: [ICLR 2025][LLM4Rec] 发现 LLM 中间层冗余，用逐层分块特征蒸馏将 8 层教师压缩为 4 层学生，仅 13% 参数达 6.6x/8.0x 加速且性能不降。

venues/RecSys/2026/sequential_rec/do_seq.title: Time to Split: Exploring Data Splitting Strategies for Offline Evaluation of Sequential Recommenders
venues/RecSys/2026/sequential_rec/do_seq.description: [RecSys 2025][序列与会话推荐] 系统对比 LOO 与全局时间切分及目标/验证变体，揭示 LOO 时序泄漏与排序失真，推荐 GTS+Last/Random/Successive 协议。

venues/RecSys/2026/sequential_rec/do_seq.title: Pay Attention to Sequence Split: Uncovering the Impacts of Sub-Sequence Splitting on Sequential Recommendation Models
venues/RecSys/2026/sequential_rec/do_seq.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 揭示子序列切分(SSS)在数据读取阶段被隐性使用导致模型评估失真，系统分析SSS生效条件与数据分布重塑机理。

venues/RecSys/2026/sequential_rec/do_seq.title: Lost in Sequence: Do Large Language Models Understand Sequential Recommendation?
venues/RecSys/2026/sequential_rec/do_seq.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 揭示现有 LLM4Rec 模型无法捕捉交互序列顺序信息，提出冻结 LLM 与 CF-SRec、仅训练轻量 MLP 的蒸馏框架 LLM-SRec，在 Amazon 四数据集上 NDCG@10 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/RecSys/2026/sequential_rec/do_seq.title: Massive Memorization with Hundreds of Trillions of Parameters for Sequential Transducer Generative Recommenders
venues/RecSys/2026/sequential_rec/do_seq.description: [ICLR 2026][序列与会话推荐] VISTA 将超长用户历史两阶段解耦：离线用准线性注意力压缩为数百种子嵌入并缓存，下游仅做候选-摘要注意力，工业上线推理 GPU 降 94%。

venues/RecSys/2026/sequential_rec/dp_rec.title: RoTE: Coarse-to-Fine Multi-Level Rotary Time Embedding for Sequential Recommendation
venues/RecSys/2026/sequential_rec/dp_rec.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 将时间戳分解为年/月/日多粒度并借 RoPE 旋转注入 Q/K，即插即用提升 SASRec/RPG，NDCG@5 最高 +20.11%

venues/RecSys/2026/sequential_rec/dp_rec.title: Mixture of Sequence: Theme-Aware Mixture-of-Experts for Long-Sequence Recommendation

venues/SIGIR/2025/cross_domain_multi_sce.title: From IDs to Semantics: A Generative Framework for Cross-Domain Recommendation with Adaptive Semantic Tokenization

venues/SIGIR/2025/graph_rec/comprehendin.title: Bridging the User-side Knowledge Gap in Knowledge-aware Recommendations with Large Language Models
venues/SIGIR/2025/graph_rec/comprehendin.description: [AAAI 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 LLM 推断用户兴趣并结构化为 CIKG 异构图，配合兴趣重建与跨域对比学习去噪，在三个数据集全库排序下 R@100 最高提升 9.31%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/graph_rec/comprehendin.title: Enhancing Collaborative Semantics of Language Model-Driven Recommendations via Graph-Aware Learning
venues/SIGIR/2025/graph_rec/comprehendin.description: [TKDE 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用多跳提示+图感知对比学习把 GNN 聚合意图注入 LLM，在三个 Amazon/Yelp 数据集 Full-Ranking 下 HR@10 最高提升约 15%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/graph_rec/comprehendin.title: SPRIG: Semantic-ID-enhanced Paths for Knowledge Graph-based Generative Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/graph_rec/comprehendin.description: [CIKM 2026][生成式推荐] 将内容派生的分层语义 ID 注入知识图谱路径语言建模，以 768 个共享码替代逐物品词表，nDCG@10 较 KGGLM 提升 44%/58% 且参数与算力更低。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/adore_autonomo.title: From Reasoning LLMs to BERT: A Two-Stage Distillation Framework for Search Relevance
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/adore_autonomo.description: [WWW 2026][LLM4Rec] 美团搜索广告两阶段框架：领域自适应推理LLM做教师标注，CRSD自蒸馏将推理能力内化进6层BERT，线上AdCTR+0.91%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/adore_autonomo.title: TaoSR-AGRL: Adaptive Guided Reinforcement Learning Framework for E-commerce Search Relevance
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/adore_autonomo.description: [WWW 2026][LLM4Rec] 用规则感知稠密奖励塑形与自适应引导回放缓解 GRPO 奖励稀疏，淘宝搜索相关性 Macro-F1 提升 2.28pt 并上线。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/adore_autonomo.title: SMART: LLM-Augmented Hybrid Retrieval for Dynamic Product Ads
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/adore_autonomo.description: [RecSys 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 揭示规则查询擅长 BM25 重定向、LLM 查询擅长 ANN 拓客的检索分解，用输出审计门控仅路由 10% 用户，线上转化率 +27.6%

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/adore_autonomo.title: Relevance Matters: A Multi-Task and Multi-Stage Large Language Model Approach for E-commerce Query Rewriting
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/adore_autonomo.description: [ICDE 2026][LLM4Rec] 将相关性打标任务注入电商查询改写，多任务 SFT + 查询级归一化 GRPO 融合奖励对齐，离线召回 67.94%、线上 UCVR +0.181%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/adore_autonomo.title: EAGER: Enrich-and-Align Generative Query Recommendation from Clicked Items in E-commerce Search
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/adore_autonomo.description: [EMNLP 2026 Industry][LLM4Rec] 两阶段生成式 I2Q 查询推荐：课程化 SFT 扩意图覆盖 + GRPO 混合奖励对齐线上约束，线上 UCTR +0.83%、Pay Count +3.49%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/corona_a_coars.title: Enhancing Collaborative Semantics of Language Model-Driven Recommendations via Graph-Aware Learning
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/corona_a_coars.description: [TKDE 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用多跳提示+图感知对比学习把 GNN 聚合意图注入 LLM，在三个 Amazon/Yelp 数据集 Full-Ranking 下 HR@10 最高提升约 15%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/corona_a_coars.title: RecLM: Recommendation Instruction Tuning
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/corona_a_coars.description: [ACL 2025][大语言模型推荐] 以两轮协同指令微调+RL画像精炼为LLM注入协同信号，作为即插即用画像增强器在零样本冷启动下带来最高 200%+ 的 Recall 提升。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/corona_a_coars.title: An Automatic Graph Construction Framework based on Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/corona_a_coars.description: [KDD 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 用 LLM 逐点生成语义向量 + 残差量化抽取隐因子作额外节点，O(N) 构图并设计元路径聚合，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@10 最高提升 43.57%，华为广告 A/B 提升 RPM 2.69%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/corona_a_coars.title: Knowledge Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation for LLM-based Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/corona_a_coars.description: [ACL 2025][LLM4Rec] 用跳场知识子图索引+流行度选择性检索+GNN软提示，将KG结构知识注入冻结LLM，MovieLens-1M ACC 相对提升58.6%且推理仅慢0.14s

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/corona_a_coars.title: AlphaFree: Recommendation Free from Users, IDs, and GNNs
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/corona_a_coars.description: [WWW 2026][大语言模型推荐] 用语言表征替代ID、在线推断用户偏好、以相似物品增强+对比对齐替代GNN，实现无用户/无ID/无GNN的轻量推荐，内存降69%、冷启动提升26–38%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/do_llms_memori.title: Can LLMs Outshine Conventional Recommenders? A Comparative Evaluation
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/do_llms_memori.description: [NeurIPS 2025 DB Track][大语言模型推荐] RecBench 系统对比 17 个 LLM 与 DLRM 在 4 种物品表征、CTR/SeqRec 双任务上的精度-效率权衡，LLM 精度领先但推理慢千倍。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/do_llms_memori.title: The Mental World of Large Language Models in Recommendation: A Benchmark on Association, Personalization, and Knowledgeability
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/do_llms_memori.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出 LRWorld 基准（38K 样本/23M tokens），从关联、个性化、知识性三尺度十因素 31 任务系统评测数十个 LLM，揭示其在神经嵌入检索上的致命短板。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/do_llms_memori.title: Generative Large Recommendation Models: Emerging Trends in LLMs for Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/do_llms_memori.description: [WWW 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 系统梳理生成式大推荐模型范式：数据质量、缩放律、用户行为挖掘与训练推理效率四大议题及未来方向。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/do_llms_memori.title: Lost in Sequence: Do Large Language Models Understand Sequential Recommendation?
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/do_llms_memori.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 揭示现有 LLM4Rec 模型无法捕捉交互序列顺序信息，提出冻结 LLM 与 CF-SRec、仅训练轻量 MLP 的蒸馏框架 LLM-SRec，在 Amazon 四数据集上 NDCG@10 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/do_llms_memori.title: Beyond Utility: Evaluating LLM as Recommender
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/do_llms_memori.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出含历史长度敏感性、候选位置偏差、画像生成与幻觉四维的 LLM 推荐多维评测框架，揭示 LLM 在重排与冷启动占优但位置偏差严重。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/efficiency_unl.title: TokenRec: Learning to Tokenize ID for LLM-based Generative Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/efficiency_unl.description: [TKDE 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用掩码K路向量量化把GNN协同表征压成LLM兼容离散token，并以生成式检索替代自回归解码，HR@20平均提升约19%、推理加速超10倍。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/efficiency_unl.title: SOLARIS: Speculative Offloading of Latent-bAsed Representation for Inference Scaling
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/efficiency_unl.description: [SIGIR 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 借鉴投机解码思想，异步预计算基础模型用户-物品隐表征并分层补全覆盖，实现推理时知识蒸馏，Meta 广告线上收入 +0.67%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/efficiency_unl.title: EAGER-LLM: Enhancing Large Language Models as Recommenders through Exogenous Behavior-Semantic Integration
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/efficiency_unl.description: [WWW 2025][大语言模型推荐] 以双源知识富集物品索引+非侵入多尺度对齐重建+退火适配器，将外源行为/语义信号注入 LLM 生成式推荐，Amazon 三数据集 Full-Ranking 下 Recall@10 最高提升 26.16%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/efficiency_unl.title: Improving LLMs for Recommendation with Out-Of-Vocabulary Tokens
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/efficiency_unl.description: [arXiv 2024][LLM4Rec] 用元路径聚类生成 OOV 层级 token 构建用户/物品 META ID，兼顾记忆性与多样性，序列推荐 HR@10 最高提升 30%+。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/efficiency_unl.title: Efficient Inference for Large Language Model-based Generative Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/efficiency_unl.description: [ICLR 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义 ID] 将投机解码引入 LLM 生成式推荐，提出 N-to-K 验证下的 AtSpeed-S/R 对齐目标与松弛采样验证，实现近 2×–2.5× 无损/近似无损加速。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/improving_llm_.title: ThinkRec: Thinking-based Recommendation via LLM
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/improving_llm_.description: [WWW 2026][大语言模型推荐] 以合成推理链激活 LLM 的 System 2 思维，并用实例级 LoRA 专家融合适配异构用户，AUC 平均提升 7.96%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/improving_llm_.title: Review-driven Personalized Preference Reasoning with Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/improving_llm_.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用评论抽取偏好画像并蒸馏逐步推理，评分预测与重排双任务均超 CF 与 LLM 基线，解释性显著提升

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/improving_llm_.title: Think before Recommendation: Autonomous Reasoning-enhanced Recommender
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/improving_llm_.description: [NeurIPS 2025][LLM4Rec] 用纯 GRPO 强化学习替代教师蒸馏，让单个 LLM 自主习得「用户分析→物品分析→匹配→打分」推理链，评分预测 MAE 最高降 29.9%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/improving_llm_.title: Reasoning over User Preferences: Knowledge Graph-Augmented LLMs for Explainable Conversational Recommendations

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/improving_llm_.title: Reason4Rec: Deliberative User Preference Alignment of Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/improving_llm_.description: [TKDE 2026][大语言模型推荐] 提出审慎推荐任务与三专家多步推理框架，用评论监督偏好蒸馏-匹配-预测，评分预测与排序全面领先。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/intent_represe.title: DIAURec: Dual-Intent Space Representation Optimization for Recommendation

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/large_language.title: Review-Based Hyperbolic Cross-Domain Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/large_language.description: [WSDM 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 将评论文本嵌入双曲空间做跨域推荐，用度数归一化与尺度对齐避免域对齐引发的层级坍塌，NDCG@10 较 SER 提升约 10.4%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/large_language.description: [RecSys 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 洛伦兹双曲三元组损失 TriplH，以物品-物品项自适应间隔替代固定 margin，兼顾精度、去流行度偏差与 3 倍推理加速。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/large_language.title: HypRQ-VAE: Hyperbolic Item Indexing for Long-Tail-Aware Generative Recommender Systems
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/large_language.description: [ICDM 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 将 RQ-VAE 语义 ID 量化搬进 Poincaré 双曲球，用 Möbius 加减替代欧氏残差，长尾 Hit@10 提升 52.7%，全库排序验证。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/large_language.description: [WWW 2025][大语言模型推荐] 以双源知识富集物品索引+非侵入多尺度对齐重建+退火适配器，将外源行为/语义信号注入 LLM 生成式推荐，Amazon 三数据集 Full-Ranking 下 Recall@10 最高提升 26.16%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/msl_not_all_to.description: [NeurIPS 2025 DB Track][大语言模型推荐] RecBench 系统对比 17 个 LLM 与 DLRM 在 4 种物品表征、CTR/SeqRec 双任务上的精度-效率权衡，LLM 精度领先但推理慢千倍。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/msl_not_all_to.title: Revisiting Language Models in Neural News Recommender Systems
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/msl_not_all_to.description: [ECIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 在 MIND 上统一复现 8 种 LM 作为新闻编码器，发现更大模型不必然更优，但显著利好冷启动用户。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/msl_not_all_to.title: Token-level Collaborative Alignment for LLM-based Generative Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/msl_not_all_to.description: [WWW 2026][LLM4Rec] 将CF物品级logits投影为token级分布并与one-hot融合成软标签，以soft-NTP损失显式对齐LLM生成，即插即用提升多骨干推荐效果。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/multi_grained_.title: Fusion and Alignment Enhancement with Large Language Models for Tail-item Sequential Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/multi_grained_.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用自适应门控融合 ID/LLM 嵌入并以双层对齐+课程学习消除空间结构冲突，全库排序下尾部长尾 H@10 最高提升 427%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/multi_grained_.title: Generative Archetype-Grounded Item Representations for Sequential Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/multi_grained_.description: [WWW 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用 LLM 生成物品“目标人群原型”文本并单次前向抽取 prefill/decoding 双嵌入，再以行为关联分数调制排斥力做校准，Full-Ranking 下 HR@10 最高 +6.95%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/multi_grained_.title: UQABench: Evaluating User Embedding for Prompting LLMs in Personalized Question Answering
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/multi_grained_.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 提出首个标准化三阶段（预训练-微调-评测）用户嵌入软提示基准，用序列理解/行为预测/兴趣感知三类任务揭示嵌入式生成推荐与文本式相当且省 8-19× token。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/pre_train_alig.title: LLM2Rec: Large Language Models Are Powerful Embedding Models for Sequential Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/pre_train_alig.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 两阶段将 LLM 改造为融合协同信号与语义的物品嵌入模型，Full-Ranking 下域内平均提升约 15%、跨域仍稳定增益。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/pre_train_alig.title: Empowering Large Language Model for Sequential Recommendation via Multimodal Embeddings and Semantic IDs
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/pre_train_alig.description: [CIKM 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 揭示 LLM4SR 的嵌入坍缩与语义ID灾难性遗忘，用多模态嵌入+MMD重建+码本初始化破局，全库排序下 nDCG@5 提升 4.4%–10.5%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/pre_train_alig.title: Lost in Sequence: Do Large Language Models Understand Sequential Recommendation?
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/pre_train_alig.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 揭示现有 LLM4Rec 模型无法捕捉交互序列顺序信息，提出冻结 LLM 与 CF-SRec、仅训练轻量 MLP 的蒸馏框架 LLM-SRec，在 Amazon 四数据集上 NDCG@10 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/pre_train_alig.title: Empowering Compact LLMs with Fusion of Layer-wise Exits for Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/pre_train_alig.description: [ICDM 2026][LLM4Rec] 在紧凑 LLM 每层插入预测出口并用连续 ReLU 路由器自适应融合多层打分分布，target-k hinge 损失约束激活出口数，全库排序下精度超越大模型基线且延迟仅增 <1ms。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/pre_train_alig.title: HSUGA: LLM-Enhanced Recommendation with Hierarchical Semantic Understanding and Group-Aware Alignment
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/pre_train_alig.description: [ACL 2026 Findings][LLM4Rec] 用分阶段可编辑兴趣演化替代长序列一次性摘要，并按用户活跃度分组调节语义对齐强度，三数据集全库排序稳定提升。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/process_superv.title: Token-level Collaborative Alignment for LLM-based Generative Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/process_superv.description: [WWW 2026][LLM4Rec] 将CF物品级logits投影为token级分布并与one-hot融合成软标签，以soft-NTP损失显式对齐LLM生成，即插即用提升多骨干推荐效果。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/process_superv.title: GFlowGR: Fine-tuning Generative Recommendation Frameworks with Generative Flow Networks
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/process_superv.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐] 将生成式推荐重构为集合级序列生成，用 GFlowNets 微调使生成概率正比于行为感知奖励，缓解曝光偏差，淘宝线上年收入相对提升 0.4%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/process_superv.title: Bi-Level Optimization for Generative Recommendation: Bridging Tokenization and Generation
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/process_superv.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 将分词器与推荐器建模为双层优化，用元学习+梯度手术让推荐损失直接监督RQ-VAE码本，Full-Ranking下全面超越TIGER/LETTER/ETEGRec。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/process_superv.title: Towards Fair Large Language Model-based Recommender Systems without Costly Retraining
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/process_superv.description: [WWW 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 将 LLM-RS 去偏重构为免重训机器遗忘任务：可学习掩码定位致偏样本 + 影响函数一步参数修正，公平性提升同时精度不降、耗时降 96%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/process_superv.title: Hierarchical Residual Policy Optimization for Generative Recommendations
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/process_superv.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 将物品级反馈分解为 SID 前缀残差信用，用 RRPO 做保守 token 级策略优化，KuaiSim 会话回报 10.53 vs 8.14，线上 IAA Target Cost 最高 +3.49%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/review_driven_.title: Think before Recommendation: Autonomous Reasoning-enhanced Recommender
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/review_driven_.description: [NeurIPS 2025][LLM4Rec] 用纯 GRPO 强化学习替代教师蒸馏，让单个 LLM 自主习得「用户分析→物品分析→匹配→打分」推理链，评分预测 MAE 最高降 29.9%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/review_driven_.title: Reason4Rec: Deliberative User Preference Alignment of Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/review_driven_.description: [TKDE 2026][大语言模型推荐] 提出审慎推荐任务与三专家多步推理框架，用评论监督偏好蒸馏-匹配-预测，评分预测与排序全面领先。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/review_driven_.title: Improving LLM-powered Recommendations with Personalized Information
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/review_driven_.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 将用户偏好与物品感知两条 CoT 显式抽取并注入 CRM 召回与 LLM 重排，Leave-One-Out 全库排序下 Hit@10 最高提升约 11%，并显著降低位置偏差。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/review_driven_.title: Reasoning over User Preferences: Knowledge Graph-Augmented LLMs for Explainable Conversational Recommendations
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/review_driven_.description: [ICDM 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] COMPASS 用图实体描述预训练+知识感知指令微调，让 LLM 生成可解释文本偏好摘要并以门控注入现有 CRS，ReDial/INSPIRED 上 HR@10 最高提升 44.76%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/review_driven_.title: ProEx: A Unified Framework Leveraging Large Language Model with Profile Extrapolation for Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/review_driven_.description: [KDD 2026][大语言模型推荐] 用四步 CoT 为每个用户/物品生成多面画像并做环境不变性融合，在三个数据集上对 6 个基模型平均提升 5%+。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/synthtrips_a_k.title: TripTailor: A Real-World Benchmark for Personalized Travel Planning
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/synthtrips_a_k.description: [ACL 2025 Findings][时空轨迹与POI本地生活推荐] 构建50万真实POI与近4000条真人行程的个性化旅行规划基准，提出可行性/合理性/个性化三维评估与奖励模型对比框架，揭示SOTA LLM行程超越真人比例不足10%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/synthtrips_a_k.title: SPOT-Trip: Dual-Preference Driven Out-of-Town Trip Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/synthtrips_a_k.description: [NeurIPS 2025][时空轨迹与POI推荐] 首次形式化异地行程推荐，用知识图谱静态偏好+Neural ODE动态偏好解耦建模，F1最高提升17.01%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/synthtrips_a_k.title: LWGR: Lagrangian-Constrained Personalized World Knowledge for Generative Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/synthtrips_a_k.description: [SIGIR 2026][大语言模型推荐] 用并行码本生成用户个性化软指令抽取 LLM 世界知识，并以拉格朗日原始-对偶约束控制知识融合，Full-Ranking 下最高相对提升 11.23%，线上广告收入 +1.35%

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/synthtrips_a_k.title: LLM-Based User Personas for Recommendations at Scale
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/synthtrips_a_k.description: [RecSys 2026][大语言模型推荐] 工业级实时生成自然语言用户兴趣画像，蒸馏+异步推理支撑十亿用户在线服务，A/B 测试观看时长 +0.04%

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/synthtrips_a_k.title: Towards Next-Generation Recommender Systems: A Benchmark for Personalized Recommendation Assistant with LLMs
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/synthtrips_a_k.description: [WSDM 2026][大语言模型推荐] 构建 RecBench+ 约3万条复杂用户查询基准，覆盖显式/隐式/误导条件与画像偏好，系统评测7个LLM并揭示SFT+RFT两阶段微调最优。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/you_are_what_y.title: PALATE: Pretrained Autoregressive LATent Embeddings
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/you_are_what_y.description: [GRAIL@CIKM 2026][生成式推荐] 用GPT式自回归模型对消费者门店互动序列建模，导出末词元隐状态为冻结256维用户嵌入，供DCNv2广告排序器跨场景复用，离线AUC+0.59%/+0.57%，线上收入+0.79%/+0.94%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/you_are_what_y.title: MerRec: A Large-scale Multipurpose Mercari Dataset for Consumer-to-Consumer Recommendation Systems
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/you_are_what_y.description: [KDD 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 首个大规模 C2C 推荐数据集 MerRec（5.56M 用户/83M 商品/1.27B 交互），并配套三塔 Mercatran 模型与四任务基准。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/you_are_what_y.title: Global-Distribution Aware Scenario-Specific Variational Representation Learning Framework
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/you_are_what_y.description: [CIKM 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用变分推断为每个场景下的用户/物品学习分布表征，并以全局行为模式与物品属性构造先验，缓解稀疏场景表征欠学习，即插即用提升 PEPNet/MARIA。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/you_are_what_y.title: DeepAffinity: Long-Term Aspect Preference Prediction in eCommerce using Small Language Models
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/you_are_what_y.description: [RecSys 2026][LLM4Rec] 用 135M 小模型+结构化字符串化+多任务预测头，从时序行为预测品牌/尺码/颜色等商品属性偏好，Fashion 微 F1 0.34 超 Gemini 零样本与 3B SFT。

venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/you_are_what_y.title: TBGRecall: A Generative Retrieval Model for E-commerce Recommendation Scenarios
venues/SIGIR/2025/llm_rec/you_are_what_y.description: [CIKM 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 提出 Next Session Prediction 会话级非自回归生成召回，配合 Session Mask、MSP/MoE 与部分增量训练，淘宝线上成交额 +2.16%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/c.title: NLGR: Utilizing Neighbor Lists for Generative Rerank in Personalized Recommendation Systems
venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/c.description: [WWW 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用邻居列表相对奖励对齐评估器-生成器目标，并以采样式非自回归生成灵活跳转组合空间，美团线上 CTR +3.25%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/c.title: GoalRank: Group-Relative Optimization for a Large Ranking Model
venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/c.description: [ICLR 2026][多任务学习与列表级重排] 证明单生成器排序器近似误差严格优于多生成器-评估器，提出组相对优化训练大排序模型，离线 H@6 最高 +25.4%，线上全量部署。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/c.title: GReF: A Unified Generative Framework for Efficient Reranking via Ordered Multi-token Prediction
venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/c.description: [CIKM 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用双向编码器+动态匹配自回归解码器统一生成式重排，Rerank-DPO 端到端对齐用户偏好，OMTP 多token并行解码将延迟压至 12.97ms，快手线上转发+2.98%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/c.title: The Recall Ceiling of LLM Recommendation Reranking
venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/c.description: [CIKM 2026][LLM4Rec] 证明闭候选重排器 NDCG 受自身窗口召回率硬上界约束，Oracle 协议高估 92–95%，九类 LLM 与监督重排器在真实检索下均无法显著超越 CF。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/c.title: ORBIT: Open Recommendation Benchmark for Reproducible Research with Hidden Tests
venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/c.description: [NeurIPS 2025][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 统一可复现推荐基准，含5个公开数据集标准化划分与ClueWeb-Reco隐私安全网页推荐隐藏测试集，评测12个模型并引入LLM-QueryGen基线。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/c.title: Unifying Search and Recommendation in LLMs via Gradient Multi-Subspace Tuning
venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/c.description: [SIGIR 2026][大语言模型推荐] 用梯度多子空间分解+零空间投影替代 LoRA，在统一 S&R 生成式建模中消解任务梯度冲突并保住通用知识，Qilin/Amazon 上大幅超越 SOTA。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/c.title: Goal-Conditioned Supervised Learning for Multi-Objective Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/c.description: [NeurIPS 2026][多任务学习与列表级重排] 将 GCSL 的标量目标扩展为多维向量目标，用 Transformer 编码器 + 交叉熵直接做多目标下一物品预测，无需复杂架构与权重调参，在 RetailRocket/Challenge15 上购买 HR@10 相对提升约 4-17%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/c.title: RecSoup: Efficient Model Merging Approach for Controllable Multi-Objective Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/c.description: [CIKM 2026][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用剪枝+可学习门控做任务向量合并，实现推理时可控多目标推荐，HV 提升 8.5% 且延迟快 165–228 倍。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/c.title: A Hybrid Cross-Stage Coordination Pre-ranking Model for Online Recommendation Systems
venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/c.description: [WWW 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 提出 HCCP 粗排模型，融合上游召回与下游精排多级未曝光样本，用 Margin InfoNCE 联合优化一致性与长尾精度，JD 线上 UCVR+14.9%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/c.title: Customized Retrieval-Augmented Generation with LLM for Debiasing Recommendation Unlearning
venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/c.description: [ICDM 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 将推荐遗忘重构为 RAG 检索端过滤问题，用三种检索策略实现用户级原子遗忘，平均加速 4.5× 且保留约 90% 原模型效用。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/n.title: Maximum In-Support Return Modeling for Dynamic Recommendation with Language Model Prior
venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/n.description: [CIKM 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 将轨迹拼接从训练期移至动作推理期，用 expectile 回归估计最大在支撑回报并自适应截断历史，配合 LLM 先验初始化 DT，在 5 个离线数据集与 VirtualTB 仿真上全面超越 EDT4Rec。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/n.title: Personalized Exercise Recommendation with Semantically-Grounded Knowledge Tracing
venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/n.description: [ICLR/NeurIPS/ICML 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] ExRec 用 LLM 自动标注知识点+对比学习语义表征+KT 校准，并以 KT 模型做 Model-Based Value Estimation 稳定 Q-learning，在四个教育推荐任务上显著提升知识状态增益。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/n.title: ReRec: Reasoning-Augmented LLM-based Recommendation Assistant via Reinforcement Fine-tuning
venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/n.description: [ACL 2026][大语言模型推荐] 用双图奖励塑形、推理感知优势估计与在线课程调度改造 RFT，使 3B LLM 在复杂查询推荐上大幅超越 GRPO 系基线并保留通用能力。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/n.title: KuaiRecV2: Benchmarking Large-Scale Continual Learning for Diversified and Multi-task Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/n.description: [NeurIPS 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 快手 30 天 4.84 亿交互动态物品池基准，统一评测持续学习、Token 级多样性与多任务检索。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/n.title: Soft Curriculum Learning for Optimizing Fresh and Generalized Recommendations
venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/n.description: [RecSys 2026][冷启动与长尾推荐] 用损失退火与图内权重替代刚性数据过滤，在连续训练中打破流行度反馈环，线上冷启动互动 +5.70%、满意度 +0.54% 且吞吐无损。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/t.title: From Pairwise to Ranking: Climbing the Ladder to Ideal Collaborative Filtering with Pseudo-Ranking
venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/t.description: [AAAI 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用噪声注入构造伪排序并以多序分类排序损失替代成对损失，在四个数据集 Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@10 最高提升 38.9%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/t.title: Bradley-Terry Rankings for Recommender Systems Across Dataset Taxonomies
venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/t.description: [KDD 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 用 Bradley-Terry 概率排序替代指标均值聚合，在 14 算法×89 数据集上给出数据集感知的推荐算法排名与免运行预测。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/t.title: NLGR: Utilizing Neighbor Lists for Generative Rerank in Personalized Recommendation Systems
venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/t.description: [WWW 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用邻居列表相对奖励对齐评估器-生成器目标，并以采样式非自回归生成灵活跳转组合空间，美团线上 CTR +3.25%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/t.title: Can Recommender Systems Teach Themselves? A Recursive Self-Improving Framework with Fidelity Control
venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/t.description: [ICML 2026][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 提出 RSIR 递归自我改进框架，用模型自生成序列+保真度质量控制稠密化稀疏交互，理论证明其等价于流形切向隐式正则，多骨干多数据集 Full-Ranking 下 NDCG/Recall 稳定提升 3%–14%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/t.title: Rankformer: A Graph Transformer for Recommendation based on Ranking Objective
venues/SIGIR/2025/multi_task_reranking/t.description: [WWW 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 从 BPR 梯度下降推导出图 Transformer 层，正负样本分离聚合+基准项+偏移项，线性加速后 4 数据集平均提升 4.48%

venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/cohesio.title: Spectrum-based Modality Representation Fusion Graph Convolutional Network for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/cohesio.description: [WSDM 2025][多模态推荐] 将多模态特征投影至频域做滤波去噪与点积融合，配合模态专属/融合双图学习与模态感知偏好模块，在 Amazon 三数据集全库排序下 Recall@20 相对最优基线提升约 5%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/cohesio.title: Hypercomplex Prompt-aware Multimodal Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/cohesio.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 用 Cayley-Dickson 超复数多分量嵌入 + 超复数乘法非线性融合 + Prompt 动态补偿，在四个 Amazon 数据集 Full-Ranking 下 Recall@20 最高提升约 13%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/cohesio.title: MENTOR: Multi-level Self-supervised Learning for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/cohesio.description: [AAAI 2025][多模态推荐] 以 ID 嵌入为锚做四级跨模态分布对齐，叠加特征掩码与图扰动自监督，Amazon 三集 Recall@20 最高提升 74.73%

venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/cohesio.title: One Graph, Multiple Gains: Single High-Quality Item-Item Graph for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/cohesio.description: [ACM MM 2026][多模态推荐] 构建一次高质量物品-物品图，经三元闭包重加权后复用于表征、交互图与优化三阶段，四数据集全指标SOTA且训练更快更省显存。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/cohesio.title: Beyond Graph Convolution: Multimodal Recommendation with Topology-aware MLPs
venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/cohesio.description: [AAAI 2025][多模态推荐] 用拓扑剪枝+邻域对齐损失替代GCN消息传递，以MLP建模多模态物品关系，全库排序下Recall@10最高提升7.53%

venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/diffusi.title: Native Multimodal Representation Learning for Click-Through Rate Prediction in E-Commerce Scenarios
venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/diffusi.description: [CIKM 2026][多模态推荐] 揭示端到端联合训练在强预训练编码器上失效的根因（CTR 监督多模态不可解释+梯度不一致），提出 Mine-Then-Train 挖掘三元组微调编码器，线上 CTR +1.5%、RPM +0.5%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/diffusi.title: Distribution-Guided Auto-Encoder for User Multimodal Interest Cross Fusion
venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/diffusi.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 以行为粒度做模态内/模态间交叉融合，并用兴趣分布解码器作自监督约束，工业 A/B 上 CTR +12.9%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/diffusi.title: PRISM: Personalized Recommendation via Information Synergy Module
venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/diffusi.description: [WWW 2026][多模态推荐] 用 MoE 显式分解模态唯一/冗余/协同信息并以用户偏好动态重加权，即插即用提升三类序列骨干，Yelp N@10 超最强基线 10.91%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/diffusi.title: Modeling Long-term User Behaviors with Diffusion-driven Multi-interest Network for CTR Prediction
venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/diffusi.description: [RecSys 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用目标正交分解构造兴趣通道做多兴趣抽取，再用条件扩散生成增强兴趣，工业 A/B 上 CTR +1.52%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/diffusi.title: Multi-Modal Multi-Behavior Sequential Recommendation with Conditional Diffusion-Based Feature Denoising
venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/diffusi.description: [SIGIR 2025][多模态推荐] 用条件扩散分别对模态与行为特征去噪，并以多专家网络解耦共性/特性兴趣，在 Rec-Tmal/Kuaishou 上 HR@10 提升约 4-8%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/disenta.title: Generating with Fairness: A Modality-Diffused Counterfactual Framework for Incomplete Multimodal Recommendations
venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/disenta.description: [WWW 2025][多模态推荐] 用模态感知扩散补全缺失模态，并以反事实推断剥离可见性偏差，在三个数据集上同时提升准确率与公平性。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/disenta.title: I$^3$-MRec: Invariant Learning with Information Bottleneck for Incomplete Modality Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/disenta.description: [ACM MM 2025][多模态推荐] 将各模态视为独立语义环境做 IRM 不变学习，并用 IB 压缩模态特有信息，在模态缺失场景下 Full-Ranking Recall@20 稳定提升 2%–4%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/disenta.title: PRISM: Personalized Recommendation via Information Synergy Module
venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/disenta.description: [WWW 2026][多模态推荐] 用 MoE 显式分解模态唯一/冗余/协同信息并以用户偏好动态重加权，即插即用提升三类序列骨干，Yelp N@10 超最强基线 10.91%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/disenta.title: Spectrum-based Modality Representation Fusion Graph Convolutional Network for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/disenta.description: [WSDM 2025][多模态推荐] 将多模态特征投影至频域做滤波去噪与点积融合，配合模态专属/融合双图学习与模态感知偏好模块，在 Amazon 三数据集全库排序下 Recall@20 相对最优基线提升约 5%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/disenta.title: VI-MMRec: Similarity-Aware Training Cost-free Virtual User-Item Interactions for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/disenta.description: [KDD 2026][多模态推荐] 用模态相似度构造虚拟交互矩阵并以统计权重融合，零训练开销即插即用地缓解多模态推荐数据稀疏，Full-Ranking 下 Recall@10 最高提升 22.25%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/multi_m.title: TruthSR: Trustworthy Sequential Recommender Systems via User-generated Multimodal Content
venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/multi_m.description: [DASFAA 2025][多模态推荐] 用评论-图片跨模态一致性降噪 + 主观逻辑证据融合做可信序列推荐，四数据集 Full-Ranking 全面超越 MMSRec。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/multi_m.title: Beyond Noisy Signals: Dual-Level Denoising for Multi-modal Sequential Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/multi_m.description: [ACM MM 2026][多模态推荐] 图拉普拉斯低通滤波去特征噪声 + FFT 可学习频域滤波去序列噪声，四数据集 Full-Ranking 全面 SOTA，R@20 最高 +19.33%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/multi_m.title: Hierarchical Time-Aware Mixture of Experts for Multi-Modal Sequential Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/multi_m.description: [WWW 2025][多模态推荐] 用交互MoE过滤模态冗余、时序MoE注入显式时间戳，配合三项辅助任务，在四个Amazon数据集全库排序上NDCG@5最高提升20.9%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/multi_m.title: Harnessing Multimodal Large Language Models for Multimodal Sequential Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/multi_m.description: [AAAI 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 MLLM 将商品图转为文本摘要，再以循环式提示推断动态用户偏好，SFT 微调 LLaVA 做多模态序列推荐，AUC 最高提升约 4.3%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/multi_m.title: Intent-aware Diffusion with Contrastive Learning for Sequential Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/multi_m.description: [SIGIR 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用 K-means 意图原型引导条件扩散生成意图对齐正视图替代随机增强，在 5 个数据集 Full-Ranking 下 NDCG 平均提升 20.68%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/short_v.title: A Content-Driven Micro-Video Recommendation Dataset at Scale
venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/short_v.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 发布十亿级含原始视频模态的微视频推荐数据集 MicroLens，并系统基准 IDRec/VIDRec/VideoRec 三类范式，揭示端到端视频编码优于冻结特征的关键结论。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/short_v.title: VK-LSVD: A Large-Scale Industrial Dataset for Short-Video Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/short_v.description: [WWW 2026][序列与会话推荐] 发布 407 亿交互、千万用户、两千万短视频的工业级开放数据集，配全局时间切分与冷启动竞赛基准。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/short_v.title: Mend the Measurement Gap: Latent User Preference Modeling for Short-Form Video Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/short_v.description: [RecSys 2026][多模态推荐] 将异构行为反馈视为隐价值状态的噪声测量，用受限基线+因子化路由瓶颈解耦时长混杂，YouTube Shorts 线上主指标提升 2.67%

venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/short_v.title: Efficient Multimodal Streaming Recommendation via Expandable Side Mixture-of-Experts
venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/short_v.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 冻结 BERT/ViT 主干，用可扩展侧调 MoE 增量吸收新时段知识并按利用率剪枝，在三个流式数据集上 HR@10 全面超越 SOTA 且显存/训练时间更省。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/short_v.title: When Top-ranked Recommendations Fail: Modeling Multi-Granular Negative Feedback for Explainable and Robust Video Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/short_v.description: [AAAI 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 三智能体协同建模多粒度负反馈，S-GRPO 渐进奖励实现可解释视频推荐，线上快滑率降 9.4%

venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/u_stick.title: PerSRV: Personalized Sticker Retrieval with Vision-Language Model
venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/u_stick.description: [WWW 2025][多模态推荐] 用 SFT-LLaVA 生成贴纸语义、三路众包效用分与 CLIP 风格聚类，实现召回+个性化排序的贴纸检索，WeChat 数据 M-MRR@20 提升 8.95%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/u_stick.title: A Generative Framework for Personalized Sticker Retrieval
venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/u_stick.description: [EMNLP 2025 Findings][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] PEARL 用用户组嵌入+LLM意图排序加权解码，实现微信表情包个性化生成式检索，离线 MRR@10 提升 15%、线上 CTR +7.12%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/u_stick.title: DV365: Extremely Long User History Modeling at Instagram
venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/u_stick.description: [KDD 2025][序列与会话推荐] 以离线用户嵌入替代端到端长序列建模，用多切片+漏斗摘要将 4 万~7 万条历史压缩为 58×256 嵌入，15 个下游模型 NE 平均提升 0.4%+。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/u_stick.title: Datasets for Navigating Sensitive Topics in Recommendation Systems
venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/u_stick.description: [WWW 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 构建 ML-DDD 与 AO3 两个带敏感内容警告标签的推荐数据集，提出 Warning Amplification 指标，发现个性化 CF 反而去放大敏感内容。

venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/u_stick.title: Personalized Image Generation with Large Multimodal Models
venues/SIGIR/2025/multimodal_rec/u_stick.description: [WWW 2025][多模态推荐] Pigeon 用 LMM+掩码生成器从噪声历史图中抽取视觉偏好，两阶段偏好对齐（掩码重建+DPO）实现贴纸/海报个性化生成，个性化指标提升 7%~31%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec.title: A Survey on LLM-powered Agents for Recommender Systems
venues/SIGIR/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec.description: [ACL 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 系统综述 LLM Agent 推荐的三范式（推荐/交互/仿真）与四模块架构，梳理数据集与评测协议并指出统一评测缺失。

venues/SIGIR/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec.title: Temporal-Aware User Behaviour Simulation with Large Language Models for Recommender Systems
venues/SIGIR/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec.description: [CIKM 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用动态画像更新、时序模式抽取与自适应聚合构建 LLM 用户模拟器，在 ML-1M 上 nDCG@5 相对 RecAgent 提升约 27.8%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec.title: AgentRecBench: Benchmarking LLM Agent-based Personalized Recommender Systems
venues/SIGIR/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec.description: [NeurIPS 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 首个 LLM 智能体推荐系统基准，构建 U-R-I 文本交互环境与三类场景，揭示结构化工作流智能体显著优于传统与朴素 Agent。

venues/SIGIR/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec.title: Think2Go: Generative Next POI Recommendation with LLM Reasoning
venues/SIGIR/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec.description: [KDD 2026][时空轨迹与POI推荐] 统一SFT与RL推理的生成式Next-POI框架，用KDE时空认知不确定性与难度感知奖励差校准优势函数，Acc@1较GNPR提升5.8–7.5%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec.title: CTR-Sink: Attention Sink for Language Models in Click-Through Rate Prediction
venues/SIGIR/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec.description: [KDD 2026][CTR预估与特征交叉] 在文本化行为序列中插入携带时间距离的 [SINK] 锚点并配合两阶段训练与 sink 间注意力增强，缓解语义碎片化，AUC 稳定提升 0.2–0.6%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec.title: ContextGNN: Beyond Two-Tower Recommendation Systems
venues/SIGIR/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec.description: [ICLR 2025][图神经网络推荐] 提出局部成对表征+全局双塔回退的混合GNN架构，在RelBench十个任务上平均MAP较最强成对基线提升20%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec.title: Enhancing Collaborative Semantics of Language Model-Driven Recommendations via Graph-Aware Learning
venues/SIGIR/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec.description: [TKDE 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用多跳提示+图感知对比学习把 GNN 聚合意图注入 LLM，在三个 Amazon/Yelp 数据集 Full-Ranking 下 HR@10 最高提升约 15%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec.title: Graph Cross-Correlated Network for Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec.description: [TKDE 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 用非递归 PGR 保留各跳邻居纯语义，再以 HCC/ECC 显式建模用户-物品子图交叉相关项，全库排序下 NDCG@20 平均提升约 1.8%–2.9%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec.title: AlphaFree: Recommendation Free from Users, IDs, and GNNs
venues/SIGIR/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec.description: [WWW 2026][大语言模型推荐] 用语言表征替代ID、在线推断用户偏好、以相似物品增强+对比对齐替代GNN，实现无用户/无ID/无GNN的轻量推荐，内存降69%、冷启动提升26–38%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec.title: CORONA: A Coarse-to-Fine Framework for Graph-based Recommendation with Large Language Models
venues/SIGIR/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 LLM 做偏好/意图推理在交互图上逐级缩小候选子图，再由 GNN 精排，全库排序下 Recall 平均相对提升 18.6%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/rl_bandit_rec/darlr_du.title: Reward Balancing Revisited: Enhancing Offline Reinforcement Learning for Recommender Systems
venues/SIGIR/2025/rl_bandit_rec/darlr_du.description: [WWW 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用扩散世界模型显式建模奖励不确定性，并以衰减加权的交互/熵双惩罚平衡多样性与长期收益，在三个真实数据集上刷新离线RL推荐SOTA。

venues/SIGIR/2025/rl_bandit_rec/darlr_du.title: Large Language Model driven Policy Exploration for Recommender Systems
venues/SIGIR/2025/rl_bandit_rec/darlr_du.description: [WSDM 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用 LLM 蒸馏用户偏好离线预训练 A2C 推荐策略，并提出冻结+可学习双策略自适应在线适配，显著提升冷启动回报与长期收益。

venues/SIGIR/2025/rl_bandit_rec/darlr_du.title: Beyond Static LLM Policies: Imitation-Enhanced Reinforcement Learning for Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/rl_bandit_rec/darlr_du.description: [ICDM 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用 LLM 轨迹作次优示范，经对抗逆强化学习提取奖励并加权模仿，离线 RL 策略在 Steam/Amazon 上累积奖励较 BiLLP 提升 13%+。

venues/SIGIR/2025/rl_bandit_rec/darlr_du.title: Stratified Expert Cloning for Retention-Aware Recommendation at Scale
venues/SIGIR/2025/rl_bandit_rec/darlr_du.description: [CIKM 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用分层专家行为克隆替代 RL 探索，配合动作熵正则与自适应专家选择，在快手双平台 A/B 中提升活跃天数 0.098%/0.122%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/rl_bandit_rec/darlr_du.title: Energy-Guided Diffusion Sampling for Long-Term User Behavior Prediction in Reinforcement Learning-based Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2025/rl_bandit_rec/darlr_du.description: [CIKM 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用扩散策略替代行为克隆以提升离线RL4RS策略表达能力，并以Q值能量引导采样降低随机性，六数据集与仿真环境全面领先。

venues/SIGIR/2025/rl_bandit_rec/enhancin.title: Adaptive Autoguidance for Item-Side Fairness in Diffusion Recommender Systems
venues/SIGIR/2025/rl_bandit_rec/enhancin.description: [SIGIR 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 用可学习逐步引导权重替代固定自引导，配合流行度正则，在扩散推荐中实现物品侧公平与精度近无损的平衡。

venues/SIGIR/2025/rl_bandit_rec/enhancin.title: Think before Recommendation: Autonomous Reasoning-enhanced Recommender
venues/SIGIR/2025/rl_bandit_rec/enhancin.description: [NeurIPS 2025][LLM4Rec] 用纯 GRPO 强化学习替代教师蒸馏，让单个 LLM 自主习得「用户分析→物品分析→匹配→打分」推理链，评分预测 MAE 最高降 29.9%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/rl_bandit_rec/enhancin.title: Unbiased Collaborative Filtering with Fair Sampling
venues/SIGIR/2025/rl_bandit_rec/enhancin.description: [SIGIR 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 通过对称补充采样使每个用户/物品等概率成为正负样本，无需估计倾向分即可消除流行度偏置，全库排序下 Recall/NDCG 与 ARP 双优。

venues/SIGIR/2025/rl_bandit_rec/enhancin.title: DARLR: Dual-Agent Offline Reinforcement Learning for Recommender Systems with Dynamic Reward
venues/SIGIR/2025/rl_bandit_rec/enhancin.description: [SIGIR 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 双智能体离线 RL 用选择器聚合相似用户动态重塑奖励与不确定性惩罚，四数据集累积奖励全面超越 ROLeR/DORL。

venues/SIGIR/2025/rl_bandit_rec/enhancin.title: Item-centric Exploration for Cold Start Problem
venues/SIGIR/2025/rl_bandit_rec/enhancin.description: [RecSys 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 提出以物品为中心的 Beta 后验过滤控制，在排序后剔除“错配受众”曝光，线上探索曝光降 20% 而满意度升 50%、可推荐语料扩 10%。

venues/SIGIR/2025/self_supervised_denois.title: NLGCL: Naturally Existing Neighbor Layers Graph Contrastive Learning for Recommendation
