venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/lwgr_lagrangia.title: EAGER-LLM: Enhancing Large Language Models as Recommenders through Exogenous Behavior-Semantic Integration
venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/lwgr_lagrangia.description: [WWW 2025][大语言模型推荐] 以双源知识富集物品索引+非侵入多尺度对齐重建+退火适配器，将外源行为/语义信号注入 LLM 生成式推荐，Amazon 三数据集 Full-Ranking 下 Recall@10 最高提升 26.16%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/lwgr_lagrangia.title: LLM-Based User Personas for Recommendations at Scale
venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/lwgr_lagrangia.description: [RecSys 2026][大语言模型推荐] 工业级实时生成自然语言用户兴趣画像，蒸馏+异步推理支撑十亿用户在线服务，A/B 测试观看时长 +0.04%

venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/lwgr_lagrangia.title: Generative Large Recommendation Models: Emerging Trends in LLMs for Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/lwgr_lagrangia.description: [WWW 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 系统梳理生成式大推荐模型范式：数据质量、缩放律、用户行为挖掘与训练推理效率四大议题及未来方向。

venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/lwgr_lagrangia.title: Empowering Compact LLMs with Fusion of Layer-wise Exits for Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/lwgr_lagrangia.description: [ICDM 2026][LLM4Rec] 在紧凑 LLM 每层插入预测出口并用连续 ReLU 路由器自适应融合多层打分分布，target-k hinge 损失约束激活出口数，全库排序下精度超越大模型基线且延迟仅增 <1ms。

venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/lwgr_lagrangia.title: Unifying Search and Recommendation in LLMs via Gradient Multi-Subspace Tuning
venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/lwgr_lagrangia.description: [SIGIR 2026][大语言模型推荐] 用梯度多子空间分解+零空间投影替代 LoRA，在统一 S&R 生成式建模中消解任务梯度冲突并保住通用知识，Qilin/Amazon 上大幅超越 SOTA。

venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/modular_repres.title: EARN: Efficient Inference Acceleration for LLM-based Generative Recommendation by Register Tokens
venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/modular_repres.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 基于 LLMRec 注意力层间稀疏反转与双注意力汇现象，用首尾寄存器 token 压缩历史交互并在第 k 层后剪除 prompt，实现 3.79× 加速与 80.8% KV Cache 缩减且精度反超微调。

venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/modular_repres.title: CoVE: Compressed Vocabulary Expansion Makes Better LLM-based Recommender Systems
venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/modular_repres.description: [ACL 2025 Findings][LLM4Rec] 将物品映射为扩展词表唯一 token，用 logits 直接打分替代文本生成，并以哈希压缩嵌入表，实现最高 62% 精度提升与约 100× 推理加速。

venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/modular_repres.title: Decoding in Latent Spaces for Efficient Inference in LLM-based Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/modular_repres.description: [EMNLP 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用训练样本末层隐状态聚合出物品潜在表征，以 L2 距离匹配替代自回归语言空间解码，推理提速 10 倍以上且性能不降反升。

venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/modular_repres.title: Efficiency Unleashed: Inference Acceleration for LLM-based Recommender Systems with Speculative Decoding
venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/modular_repres.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 将检索式推测解码引入 LLM 离线知识生成，用定制检索池与松弛验证实现 3-5× 无损加速，线上省 67% 算力。

venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/modular_repres.title: SLMRec: Distilling Large Language Models into Small for Sequential Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/modular_repres.description: [ICLR 2025][LLM4Rec] 发现 LLM 中间层冗余，用逐层分块特征蒸馏将 8 层教师压缩为 4 层学生，仅 13% 参数达 6.6x/8.0x 加速且性能不降。

venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/multimodal_lar.title: Harnessing Multimodal Large Language Models for Multimodal Sequential Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/multimodal_lar.description: [AAAI 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 MLLM 将商品图转为文本摘要，再以循环式提示推断动态用户偏好，SFT 微调 LLaVA 做多模态序列推荐，AUC 最高提升约 4.3%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/multimodal_lar.title: NoteLLM-2: Multimodal Large Representation Models for Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/multimodal_lar.description: [KDD 2025][多模态推荐] 端到端微调 LLM+视觉编码器构建高效 MLRM，用 mICL 与门控后期融合缓解视觉忽视，I2I 全库召回 R@100 显著提升并落地线上 A/B。

venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/multimodal_lar.title: MLLMRec: A Preference Reasoning Paradigm with Graph Refinement for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/multimodal_lar.description: [SIGIR 2026][多模态推荐] 用 MLLM 推理用户偏好画像替代噪声聚合初始化，并以阈值去噪+共现增强精修物品图，三数据集 11/12 指标 SOTA。

venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/multimodal_lar.title: Structural and Disentangled Adaptation of Large Vision Language Models for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/multimodal_lar.description: [SIGIR 2026][多模态推荐] 用模态内结构软教师对齐 LVLM 跨模态表征，并以专家化门控 LoRA 解耦梯度流，即插即用提升多模态与序列推荐，长尾增益最高 18.70%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/multimodal_lar.title: Efficient and Effective Adaptation of Multimodal Foundation Models in Sequential Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/multimodal_lar.description: [TKDE 2025][多模态推荐] IISAN-Versa 用解耦 PEFT + 组 LayerDrop + 维度变换层，统一适配对称/非对称多模态基础模型，缓存隐藏态后 GPU 显存降 12–15 倍、训练提速 16–20 倍，MicroLens 达 SOTA。

venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/promax_explori.title: LettinGo: Explore User Profile Generation for Recommendation System
venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/promax_explori.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 用多LLM探索开放式用户画像、以下游推荐成败构造偏好对、DPO对齐画像生成器，Amazon Books Acc 66.3%→70.4%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/promax_explori.title: DIAURec: Dual-Intent Space Representation Optimization for Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/promax_explori.description: [SIGIR 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 以原型意图与分布意图重构表征，用对齐-均匀性+粗细粒度匹配联合优化，Amazon-book R@20 相对提升 10.6%

venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/promax_explori.title: ProEx: A Unified Framework Leveraging Large Language Model with Profile Extrapolation for Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/promax_explori.description: [KDD 2026][大语言模型推荐] 用四步 CoT 为每个用户/物品生成多面画像并做环境不变性融合，在三个数据集上对 6 个基模型平均提升 5%+。

venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/promax_explori.title: Enriching Semantic Profiles into Knowledge Graph for Recommender Systems Using Large Language Models
venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/promax_explori.description: [KDD 2026][LLM4Rec] 用 LLM 为 KG 全实体生成语义画像，以可逆加性注入+成对匹配对齐，Full-Ranking 下 Recall@40 最高提升 2.6%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/promax_explori.title: RALLRec: Improving Retrieval Augmented Large Language Model Recommendation with Representation Learning
venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/promax_explori.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 用 LLM 生成物品详述并做文本-协同表征对比对齐，配合时间感知重排器提升 RAG 式 LLM 推荐的检索质量。

venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/prompt_unknown.title: Diversity-aware Dual-promotion Poisoning Attack on Sequential Recommendation

venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/unifying_searc.description: [TOIS 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 提出两阶段 MPT-Rec：GAN 解耦任务共享/特有信息后冻结主干，仅用任务感知 Prompt 微调新任务，参数降至 10% 且性能保持 95%+。

venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/unifying_searc.title: CSMF: Cascaded Selective Mask Fine-Tuning for Multi-Objective Embedding-Based Retrieval
venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/unifying_searc.description: [SIGIR 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 借鉴 PEFT 选择性掩码思想，按曝光→点击→转化级联顺序分阶段微调双塔召回，零参数增量实现多目标融合检索。

venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/unifying_searc.title: LWGR: Lagrangian-Constrained Personalized World Knowledge for Generative Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/unifying_searc.description: [SIGIR 2026][大语言模型推荐] 用并行码本生成用户个性化软指令抽取 LLM 世界知识，并以拉格朗日原始-对偶约束控制知识融合，Full-Ranking 下最高相对提升 11.23%，线上广告收入 +1.35%

venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/verifiable_rea.title: Reproducibility in Recommender Systems: A Survey
venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/verifiable_rea.description: [TORS 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 对 RecSys 可复现性赛道 2020–2025 年 51 篇论文的结构化元分析，揭示其方法论高度同质化、以“扩展”替代“严格复现”的实践落差。

venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/verifiable_rea.title: FELLAS: Enhancing Federated Sequential Recommendation with LLM as External Services
venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/verifiable_rea.description: [TOIS 2025][大语言模型推荐] 将 LLM 作为外部服务为联邦序列推荐提供物品级与序列级表征，配合 dX-privacy 扰动与对比学习，在 Full-Ranking 下显著超越 FedSeqRec 并逼近集中式训练。

venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/verifiable_rea.title: Thoroughly Modeling Multi-domain Pre-trained Recommendation as Language
venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/verifiable_rea.description: [TOIS 2025][LLM4Rec] 将多域序列推荐彻底转为文本生成任务，用五项指标指导行为-文本双向适配，7 数据集微调与零样本均最优，NDCG@1 最高提升 23%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/verifiable_rea.title: The Efficiency vs. Accuracy Trade-off: Optimizing RAG-Enhanced LLM Recommender Systems Using Multi-Head Early Exit
venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/verifiable_rea.description: [ACL/EMNLP 2025][LLM4Rec] 用 GCN 检索器替代 LLM embedder 加速 RAG，并以多头早退动态终止 LLM 推理，在 5 个 CTR 数据集上兼顾 AUC 与吞吐。

venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/verifiable_rea.title: A Survey on Intent-aware Recommender Systems
venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/verifiable_rea.description: [TORS 2025][序列与会话推荐] 系统梳理意图感知推荐(IARS)的三大技术路线与评估实践，指出离线精度导向、可复现性不足与显式意图建模缺失三大空白。

venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/when_how_to_wr.title: RECAP: Feedback-Driven Streaming Semantic User Profiles for Short-Video Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/when_how_to_wr.description: [RecSys 2026][LLM4Rec] 将流式结构化用户画像视为有界记忆状态，用 LLM 语义差分+确定性状态机维护，并以 LLM 判官清洗隐式反馈、双塔评估器打分作 GRPO 奖励闭环优化画像更新器。

venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/when_how_to_wr.title: CroPS: Improving Dense Retrieval with Cross-Perspective Positive Samples in Short-Video Search
venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/when_how_to_wr.description: [AAAI 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用查询改写/推荐流/LLM 三源扩充正样本，配分层标签与 H-InfoNCE，快手搜索线上 CTR +0.87%、改写率 -0.65%

venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/when_how_to_wr.title: GREAT: Guiding Query Generation with a Trie for Recommending Related Search about Video at Kuaishou
venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/when_how_to_wr.description: [KDD 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义 ID] 用高质量查询构建 Trie 约束 LLM 训练与解码，实现短视频到查询的 I2Q 推荐，离线 Edit@1 最优、线上 CTR 与相关性双升。

venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/when_how_to_wr.title: Make It Long, Keep It Fast: End-to-End 10K Long User Behavior Sequence Modeling for Billion-Scale Douyin Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/when_how_to_wr.description: [WWW 2026][序列与会话推荐] 以单查询目标-历史交叉注意力(STCA)将长序列建模降至 O(L)，配合请求级批处理(RLB)与稀疏训练稠密推理，在抖音十亿级流量实现 10K 序列端到端排序。

venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/when_how_to_wr.title: Beyond Item IDs: Scaling Short-Form-Video Recommendation via Semantic-Native Long Sequence Modeling
venues/SIGIR/2026/llm_rec/when_how_to_wr.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用深度截断 Bi-gram 语义 ID 替代正交 Video ID，并以无参时间折叠压缩 Transformer 将序列扩至 2000，线上满意观看时长 +1.42%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/e.title: SORT: A Systematically Optimized Ranking Transformer for Industrial-scale Recommenders
venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/e.description: [CIKM 2026][多任务学习与列表级重排] 以请求为中心组织样本、局部注意力+查询剪枝、生成式预训练与稀疏MoE重构工业精排Transformer，线上GMV+8.65%且延迟降62%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/e.title: Real-time Indexing for Large-scale Recommendation by Streaming Vector Quantization Retriever
venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/e.description: [KDD 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用流式 VQ 码本替代 HNSW/DR 静态索引，实现实时挂载、索引均衡与可修复，抖音全量上线显著提升用户参与。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/e.title: Massive Memorization with Hundreds of Trillions of Parameters for Sequential Transducer Generative Recommenders
venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/e.description: [ICLR 2026][序列与会话推荐] VISTA 将超长用户历史两阶段解耦：离线用准线性注意力压缩为数百种子嵌入并缓存，下游仅做候选-摘要注意力，工业上线推理 GPU 降 94%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/e.title: InteractRank: Personalized Web-Scale Search Pre-Ranking with Cross Interaction Features
venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/e.description: [WWW 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 在双塔预排序点积之上叠加历史交互统计特征 IQP 与实时用户序列，以 1.1× FLOPs 实现线上 SIFR +6.5%、F1S +9.2%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/e.title: OneTrans: Unified Feature Interaction and Sequence Modeling with One Transformer in Industrial Recommender
venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/e.description: [WWW 2026][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用单一因果 Transformer 统一序列建模与特征交叉，配合金字塔剪枝与跨请求 KV 缓存，线上 GMV/u 提升 5.68%

venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/o.title: Position Bias Undermines Preference Consistency in Listwise LLM-Based Reranking
venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/o.description: [RecSys 2026][多任务学习与列表级重排] 将 LLM 列表重排的候选置换视为诱导偏好系统，提出 PPI/GPI/LOC 三层一致性度量，揭示有效性、曝光均衡与置换一致性三者可背离。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/o.title: A Contextual-Aware Position Encoding for Sequential Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/o.description: [WWW 2025][序列与会话推荐] 首个为序列推荐定制的上下文感知位置编码 CAPE：用目标-上下文不相似度累加动态分配位置，配合门控融合异构特征，在 5 个骨干与工业 A/B 上稳定涨点。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/o.title: Retrieval, Scoring, and Decoding Shape Performance and Stability in LLM-based Conversational Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/o.description: [CIKM 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 在 ReDial 上系统解耦候选池规模、一阶段检索器与解码温度对 LLM 重排器的影响，揭示协议选择可移动 NDCG@10 超过模型差距。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/o.title: Beyond Utility: Evaluating LLM as Recommender
venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/o.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出含历史长度敏感性、候选位置偏差、画像生成与幻觉四维的 LLM 推荐多维评测框架，揭示 LLM 在重排与冷启动占优但位置偏差严重。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/o.title: NLGR: Utilizing Neighbor Lists for Generative Rerank in Personalized Recommendation Systems
venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/o.description: [WWW 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用邻居列表相对奖励对齐评估器-生成器目标，并以采样式非自回归生成灵活跳转组合空间，美团线上 CTR +3.25%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/t.title: Beyond Static Best-of-N: Bayesian List-wise Alignment for LLM-based Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/t.description: [SIGIR 2026][LLM4Rec] 用贝叶斯后验融合静态先验与在线 rollout 证据，构建自演化 BoN 目标，突破静态对齐的性能上界，NDCG@5 相对提升 23.1%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/t.title: LLM-Based User Personas for Recommendations at Scale
venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/t.description: [RecSys 2026][大语言模型推荐] 工业级实时生成自然语言用户兴趣画像，蒸馏+异步推理支撑十亿用户在线服务，A/B 测试观看时长 +0.04%

venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/t.title: MPFormer: Adaptive Framework for Industrial Multi-Task Personalized Sequential Retriever
venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/t.description: [CIKM 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用目标条件化 Transformer 统一多目标召回，并以排序分数监督动态配额分配，在快手 4 亿 DAU 上实现 +0.43% 总时长与 66.7% 推理资源节省。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/t.title: Reason4Rec: Deliberative User Preference Alignment of Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/t.description: [TKDE 2026][大语言模型推荐] 提出审慎推荐任务与三专家多步推理框架，用评论监督偏好蒸馏-匹配-预测，评分预测与排序全面领先。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/t.title: Align$^3$GR: Unified Multi-Level Alignment for LLM-based Generative Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/t.description: [AAAI 2026][LLM4Rec] 提出 token/行为/偏好三级对齐框架，双端 SCID 分词 + 渐进式 SP/RF-DPO，Instruments 上 R@10 提升 17.8%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/u.title: Identifying Offline Metrics that Predict Online Impact: A Pragmatic Strategy for Real-World Recommender Systems
venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/u.description: [RecSys 2025][CTR/CVR 预估与特征交叉] 用帕累托前沿近似单模型多偏好分流，在 OTTO 线上实验验证 Recall@20→CTR、OD@20→CVR、乘积→销量 的离线-在线对齐关系。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/u.title: Post-hoc Provider Fairness Adaptation via Hierarchical Exposure Alignment
venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/u.description: [SIGIR 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 冻结基座+轻量公平适配器，用分层曝光对齐(HEFA)与可微NDCG联合优化，实现即插即用的提供方曝光公平。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/u.title: ORBIT: Open Recommendation Benchmark for Reproducible Research with Hidden Tests
venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/u.description: [NeurIPS 2025][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 统一可复现推荐基准，含5个公开数据集标准化划分与ClueWeb-Reco隐私安全网页推荐隐藏测试集，评测12个模型并引入LLM-QueryGen基线。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/u.title: Equity vs. Equality: Optimizing Ranking Fairness for Tailored Provider Needs
venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/u.description: [SIGIR 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 提出以增益为基的公平框架与 EquityRank 梯度重排算法，按提供者异质偏好分配曝光与销量收益，离线/在线仿真均取得更优效果-公平权衡。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/u.title: A Hybrid Cross-Stage Coordination Pre-ranking Model for Online Recommendation Systems
venues/SIGIR/2026/multi_task_reranking/u.description: [WWW 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 提出 HCCP 粗排模型，融合上游召回与下游精排多级未曝光样本，用 Margin InfoNCE 联合优化一致性与长尾精度，JD 线上 UCVR+14.9%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/a_gener.title: NoteLLM-2: Multimodal Large Representation Models for Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/a_gener.description: [KDD 2025][多模态推荐] 端到端微调 LLM+视觉编码器构建高效 MLRM，用 mICL 与门控后期融合缓解视觉忽视，I2I 全库召回 R@100 显著提升并落地线上 A/B。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/a_gener.title: Harnessing Multimodal Large Language Models for Multimodal Sequential Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/a_gener.description: [AAAI 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 MLLM 将商品图转为文本摘要，再以循环式提示推断动态用户偏好，SFT 微调 LLaVA 做多模态序列推荐，AUC 最高提升约 4.3%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/a_gener.title: Do Recommender Systems Really Leverage Multimodal Content? A Comprehensive Analysis on Multimodal Representations for Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/a_gener.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 用受控噪声实验证明多模态增益源于语义而非模型容量，并以 LVLM 结构化提示生成「原生多模态」[EOS] 嵌入替代晚期融合，Borda 聚合排名第一。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/a_gener.title: LLM-Based User Personas for Recommendations at Scale
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/a_gener.description: [RecSys 2026][大语言模型推荐] 工业级实时生成自然语言用户兴趣画像，蒸馏+异步推理支撑十亿用户在线服务，A/B 测试观看时长 +0.04%

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/a_gener.title: Well Begun is Half Done: Training-Free and Model-Agnostic Semantically Guaranteed User Representation Initialization for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/a_gener.description: [SIGIR 2026][多模态推荐] 用交互物品模态特征+聚类全局语义免训练初始化用户表征，弥合用户-物品语义鸿沟，六模型四数据集Recall@5最高提升36.4%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/from_ra.title: GALA: Generative Aligned Learning for Adaptive Multimodal Representation in the Taobao Shangou Recommender System
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/from_ra.description: [ICDE 2026][多模态推荐] 三阶段流水线：行为三元组预训练 + GRPO 生成式行为对齐 + 自适应门控融合，离线 AUC +0.12/+0.20，线上订单量 +0.55%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/from_ra.title: KERL: Knowledge-Enhanced Personalized Recipe Recommendation using Large Language Models
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/from_ra.description: [ACL 2025][LLM4Rec] 用 FoodKG 子图作上下文 + 多 LoRA 适配器，统一完成约束食谱推荐、烹饪步骤生成与微量营养素估计，KGQA 基准 F1 达 0.973。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/from_ra.title: Learning Sparse Representations of Multimodal Content for Enhanced Cold Item Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/from_ra.description: [RecSys 2026][冷启动与长尾推荐] 将多模态内容冷启动表征改为 top-K 稀疏嵌入，并用 α-entmax 预稀疏激活诱导锐化与去噪，冷启动 NDCG@20 提升 16.6%–75.5% 且存储更低。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/from_ra.title: Personalized Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Foundation Models for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/from_ra.description: [WWW 2026][多模态推荐] 按兴趣分群并为每群挂载独立 PEFT 模块，使 CLIP 编码出用户条件化的物品表征，配合群内难负采样，NDCG@20 最高提升 15.3%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/from_ra.title: NoteLLM-2: Multimodal Large Representation Models for Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/from_ra.description: [KDD 2025][多模态推荐] 端到端微调 LLM+视觉编码器构建高效 MLRM，用 mICL 与门控后期融合缓解视觉忽视，I2I 全库召回 R@100 显著提升并落地线上 A/B。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/mllmrec.title: One Graph, Multiple Gains: Single High-Quality Item-Item Graph for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/mllmrec.description: [ACM MM 2026][多模态推荐] 构建一次高质量物品-物品图，经三元闭包重加权后复用于表征、交互图与优化三阶段，四数据集全指标SOTA且训练更快更省显存。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/mllmrec.title: Beyond Graph Convolution: Multimodal Recommendation with Topology-aware MLPs
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/mllmrec.description: [AAAI 2025][多模态推荐] 用拓扑剪枝+邻域对齐损失替代GCN消息传递，以MLP建模多模态物品关系，全库排序下Recall@10最高提升7.53%

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/mllmrec.title: Multimodal Large Language Models with Adaptive Preference Optimization for Sequential Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/mllmrec.description: [SIGIR 2026][LLM4Rec] 面向 MLLM 序列推荐，用难度感知重加权 DPO + 高斯噪声正则分布优化，缓解样本难度失衡与跨模态语义偏差，三数据集 NDCG@3 提升 7.4%–11.0%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/mllmrec.title: Harnessing Multimodal Large Language Models for Multimodal Sequential Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/mllmrec.description: [AAAI 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 MLLM 将商品图转为文本摘要，再以循环式提示推断动态用户偏好，SFT 微调 LLaVA 做多模态序列推荐，AUC 最高提升约 4.3%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/mllmrec.title: I$^3$-MRec: Invariant Learning with Information Bottleneck for Incomplete Modality Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/mllmrec.description: [ACM MM 2025][多模态推荐] 将各模态视为独立语义环境做 IRM 不变学习，并用 IB 压缩模态特有信息，在模态缺失场景下 Full-Ranking Recall@20 稳定提升 2%–4%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/multi_m.title: Beyond Graph Convolution: Multimodal Recommendation with Topology-aware MLPs
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/multi_m.description: [AAAI 2025][多模态推荐] 用拓扑剪枝+邻域对齐损失替代GCN消息传递，以MLP建模多模态物品关系，全库排序下Recall@10最高提升7.53%

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/multi_m.title: Linear Item-Item Model with Neural Knowledge for Session-based Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/multi_m.description: [SIGIR 2025][序列与会话推荐] 将神经会话模型的转移知识蒸馏为物品-物品矩阵正则项，与线性自蒸馏相似度统一闭式求解，R@20 最高提升 14.78% 且推理 FLOPs 降低 813 倍。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/multi_m.title: RecBase: Generative Foundation Model Pretraining for Zero-Shot Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/multi_m.description: [EMNLP 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用课程学习增强的 RQ-VAE 将跨域物品统一离散为层级概念 ID，从零预训练 1.5B 自回归推荐基座，在 8 个未见数据集零样本 AUC 全面超越 7B LLM。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/multi_m.title: Generative Data Augmentation in Graph Contrastive Learning for Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/multi_m.description: [CIKM 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 用 VAE 式生成器自适应生成噪声替代固定随机扰动构造对比视图，并引入物品互补矩阵，在三个稀疏数据集上 Full-Ranking 提升约 3–6%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/multi_m.title: MixRec: Heterogeneous Graph Collaborative Filtering
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/multi_m.description: [WSDM 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 参数化异质超图解耦多行为意图，配合节点/图级自适应对比学习，Leave-One-Out 全库排序下 HR@10 最高提升 9.8%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/robust_.title: Training-free Graph-based Imputation of Missing Modalities in Multimodal Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/robust_.description: [TKDE 2026][多模态推荐] 将缺失模态重铸为物品-物品共购图上的图特征插值，提出四种免训练传播式填补算子，可即插即用并保持甚至扩大多模态与传统推荐的性能差距。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/robust_.title: COHESION: Composite Graph Convolutional Network with Dual-Stage Fusion for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/robust_.description: [SIGIR 2025][多模态推荐] 用行为模态早期精炼+晚期注意力融合的双阶段融合，配合异质/同质复合图与自适应BPR，在三个 Amazon 数据集上 R@20 相对提升 4.4%–6.1%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/robust_.title: Beyond Graph Convolution: Multimodal Recommendation with Topology-aware MLPs
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/robust_.description: [AAAI 2025][多模态推荐] 用拓扑剪枝+邻域对齐损失替代GCN消息传递，以MLP建模多模态物品关系，全库排序下Recall@10最高提升7.53%

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/robust_.title: Generating with Fairness: A Modality-Diffused Counterfactual Framework for Incomplete Multimodal Recommendations
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/robust_.description: [WWW 2025][多模态推荐] 用模态感知扩散补全缺失模态，并以反事实推断剥离可见性偏差，在三个数据集上同时提升准确率与公平性。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/robust_.title: Hypercomplex Prompt-aware Multimodal Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/robust_.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 用 Cayley-Dickson 超复数多分量嵌入 + 超复数乘法非线性融合 + Prompt 动态补偿，在四个 Amazon 数据集 Full-Ranking 下 Recall@20 最高提升约 13%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/structu.title: Do Recommender Systems Really Leverage Multimodal Content? A Comprehensive Analysis on Multimodal Representations for Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/structu.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 用受控噪声实验证明多模态增益源于语义而非模型容量，并以 LVLM 结构化提示生成「原生多模态」[EOS] 嵌入替代晚期融合，Borda 聚合排名第一。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/structu.title: NoteLLM-2: Multimodal Large Representation Models for Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/structu.description: [KDD 2025][多模态推荐] 端到端微调 LLM+视觉编码器构建高效 MLRM，用 mICL 与门控后期融合缓解视觉忽视，I2I 全库召回 R@100 显著提升并落地线上 A/B。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/structu.title: Modality Alignment with Multi-scale Bilateral Attention for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/structu.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 提出 MambaRec，用多尺度空洞卷积+双注意力做局部图文对齐、MMD+InfoNCE 做全局分布对齐，Amazon 三数据集 Recall@20 最高提升约 5.4%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/structu.title: Multimodal Large Language Models with Adaptive Preference Optimization for Sequential Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/structu.description: [SIGIR 2026][LLM4Rec] 面向 MLLM 序列推荐，用难度感知重加权 DPO + 高斯噪声正则分布优化，缓解样本难度失衡与跨模态语义偏差，三数据集 NDCG@3 提升 7.4%–11.0%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/structu.title: Efficient and Effective Adaptation of Multimodal Foundation Models in Sequential Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/structu.description: [TKDE 2025][多模态推荐] IISAN-Versa 用解耦 PEFT + 组 LayerDrop + 维度变换层，统一适配对称/非对称多模态基础模型，缓存隐藏态后 GPU 显存降 12–15 倍、训练提速 16–20 倍，MicroLens 达 SOTA。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/timemm_.title: Hierarchical Time-Aware Mixture of Experts for Multi-Modal Sequential Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/timemm_.description: [WWW 2025][多模态推荐] 用交互MoE过滤模态冗余、时序MoE注入显式时间戳，配合三项辅助任务，在四个Amazon数据集全库排序上NDCG@5最高提升20.9%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/timemm_.title: Structured Spectral Reasoning for Frequency-Adaptive Multimodal Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/timemm_.description: [NeurIPS 2025][多模态推荐] 将多模态图信号分解为等能量频带，用频带掩码一致性训练、低秩超谱算子与谱对比正则实现频率自适应融合，全库排序下冷启动 Recall@20 提升约 10%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/timemm_.title: MLLMRec: A Preference Reasoning Paradigm with Graph Refinement for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/timemm_.description: [SIGIR 2026][多模态推荐] 用 MLLM 推理用户偏好画像替代噪声聚合初始化，并以阈值去噪+共现增强精修物品图，三数据集 11/12 指标 SOTA。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/timemm_.title: WPGRec: Wavelet Packet Guided Graph Enhanced Sequential Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/timemm_.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用平稳小波包变换生成等长平移不变子带，在子带内做 Chebyshev 图传播并以能量-谱平坦度门控融合，Full-Ranking 下稀疏数据集 HR@20 最高 +15.4%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/timemm_.title: Efficient Multimodal Streaming Recommendation via Expandable Side Mixture-of-Experts
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/timemm_.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 冻结 BERT/ViT 主干，用可扩展侧调 MoE 增量吸收新时段知识并按利用率剪枝，在三个流式数据集上 HR@10 全面超越 SOTA 且显存/训练时间更省。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/well_be.title: Personalized Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Foundation Models for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/well_be.description: [WWW 2026][多模态推荐] 按兴趣分群并为每群挂载独立 PEFT 模块，使 CLIP 编码出用户条件化的物品表征，配合群内难负采样，NDCG@20 最高提升 15.3%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/well_be.title: Multimodal Quantitative Language for Generative Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/well_be.description: [ICLR 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用 RQ-VAE 将多域多模态物品翻译为统一量化语言，配合多任务预训练微调实现知识迁移，全库排序下 NDCG@10 最高提升 14.82%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/well_be.title: Multi-modal Adaptive Mixture of Experts for Cold-start Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/well_be.description: [CIKM 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 用双层 MoE（模态专属专家+动态门控融合）替代拼接/平均融合，在 Amazon 三域冷启动全库排序上 Recall@10 最高提升 16.17%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/well_be.title: VI-MMRec: Similarity-Aware Training Cost-free Virtual User-Item Interactions for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/well_be.description: [KDD 2026][多模态推荐] 用模态相似度构造虚拟交互矩阵并以统计权重融合，零训练开销即插即用地缓解多模态推荐数据稀疏，Full-Ranking 下 Recall@10 最高提升 22.25%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/well_be.title: Efficient Multimodal Streaming Recommendation via Expandable Side Mixture-of-Experts
venues/SIGIR/2026/multimodal_rec/well_be.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 冻结 BERT/ViT 主干，用可扩展侧调 MoE 增量吸收新时段知识并按利用率剪枝，在三个流式数据集上 HR@10 全面超越 SOTA 且显存/训练时间更省。

venues/SIGIR/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_rec.title: SPARK: Adaptive Low-Rank Knowledge Graph Modeling in Hybrid Geometric Spaces for Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_rec.description: [CIKM 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 用 Tucker 低秩去噪 KG、SVD 初始化双曲/欧氏并行 GNN，并按物品流行度自适应融合多源信号，长尾推荐 R@10 最高提升 10.8%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_rec.title: Learning Sparse Representations of Multimodal Content for Enhanced Cold Item Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_rec.description: [RecSys 2026][冷启动与长尾推荐] 将多模态内容冷启动表征改为 top-K 稀疏嵌入，并用 α-entmax 预稀疏激活诱导锐化与去噪，冷启动 NDCG@20 提升 16.6%–75.5% 且存储更低。

venues/SIGIR/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_rec.title: Location Matters: Leveraging Multi-Resolution Geo-Embeddings for Housing Search
venues/SIGIR/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_rec.description: [RecSys 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 将 H3 多分辨率六边形网格与城市嵌入注入双塔对比学习，缓解房源地理稀疏，离线重排模拟租金转化提升 85%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_rec.title: From Time and Place to Preference: LLM-Driven Geo-Temporal Context in Recommendations
venues/SIGIR/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_rec.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用 LLM 从时间戳+粗粒度位置生成地理-时间上下文嵌入，以特征融合或辅助对齐损失注入 SASRec，并提出轻量信息量诊断测试。

venues/SIGIR/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_rec.title: SituRecBench: Evaluating Frontier Models as Situated Recommendation Assistants in 3D Environments
venues/SIGIR/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_rec.description: [NeurIPS 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 构建 UE5 三维购物环境与共享第一人称视角的交互式基准，统一评测 VLM 助手的对话质量、推荐效用与导航有效性。

venues/SIGIR/2026/self_supervised_denois.title: Generative Data Augmentation in Graph Contrastive Learning for Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/self_supervised_denois.description: [CIKM 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 用 VAE 式生成器自适应生成噪声替代固定随机扰动构造对比视图，并引入物品互补矩阵，在三个稀疏数据集上 Full-Ranking 提升约 3–6%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/self_supervised_denois.title: SimDiffRec: Semantic Similarity-Guided Diffusion for Contrastive Sequential Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/self_supervised_denois.description: [WSDM 2026][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 用语义相似物品均值替代高斯随机噪声做扩散增强，按去噪置信度选增强位置并配难负采样，五数据集 Full-Ranking 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/SIGIR/2026/self_supervised_denois.title: Data Augmentation as Free Lunch: Exploring the Test-Time Augmentation for Sequential Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/self_supervised_denois.description: [SIGIR 2025][序列与会话推荐] 将数据增强从训练期迁移到推理期，提出 TNoise 与 TMask 两个免训练、免参数的测试时增强算子，在 Full-Ranking 协议下平均提升 14%–30%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/self_supervised_denois.title: Intent-aware Diffusion with Contrastive Learning for Sequential Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/self_supervised_denois.description: [SIGIR 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用 K-means 意图原型引导条件扩散生成意图对齐正视图替代随机增强，在 5 个数据集 Full-Ranking 下 NDCG 平均提升 20.68%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/self_supervised_denois.title: Improving Sequential Recommendations via Bidirectional Temporal Data Augmentation with Pre-training
venues/SIGIR/2026/self_supervised_denois.description: [TKDE 2025][序列与会话推荐] BARec 用双向时序增强预训练生成保偏好伪先验物品，并以 KL 知识增强微调对齐原/增广序列分布，全库排序下 Beauty Recall@5 提升 16.6%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/self_supervised_denois.title: SCONE: A Novel Stochastic Sampling to Generate Contrastive Views and Hard Negative Samples for Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/self_supervised_denois.description: [WSDM 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 用分数生成模型统一生成用户-物品特定对比视图与难负样本，6 数据集全库排序 Recall@20 最高提升 1.70%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/self_supervised_denois.title: Diversity-Augmented Negative Sampling for Implicit Collaborative Filtering
venues/SIGIR/2026/self_supervised_denois.description: [WWW 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用用户级缓存 + 多样性增强 k-DPP + mixup 合成负样本，解决两阶段负采样同质化问题，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@20 最高提升 8.76%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/self_supervised_denois.title: Semantic Retrieval Augmented Contrastive Learning for Sequential Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/self_supervised_denois.description: [NeurIPS 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用 LLM 语义检索构建用户/物品候选池并配可学习样本合成器，替代随机增广与 K-Means 硬规则，全库排序下 HR@20 最高提升 11.82%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/self_supervised_denois.title: Personalized Diffusion Model Reshapes Cold-Start Bundle Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/self_supervised_denois.description: [WWW 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 用个性化条件扩散在分布空间生成捆绑包，配合解耦自注意力与KL正则，冷启动捆绑推荐全库排序Recall@20最高提升1155%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/self_supervised_denois.title: NLGCL: Naturally Existing Neighbor Layers Graph Contrastive Learning for Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/self_supervised_denois.description: [RecSys 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 用 GNN 相邻层天然异构节点作正样本对替代图增广，免视图构建，全库排序下 NDCG@10 最高提升 12.41% 且训练最快。

venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/beyond_.title: Tokens are All You Need: Dual-purpose Semantic IDs for Achieving LLM-Level I/O Efficiency in Recommendation Systems
venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/beyond_.description: [RecSys 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用 RQ-VAE 语义ID 同时承担协同身份与内容重建双职责，以 SiDec 在线解码替代稠密向量 I/O，检索 HitRate@100 提升至 0.2910 且吞吐较原始稠密嵌入快 20.4%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/beyond_.title: Make It Long, Keep It Fast: End-to-End 10K Long User Behavior Sequence Modeling for Billion-Scale Douyin Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/beyond_.description: [WWW 2026][序列与会话推荐] 以单查询目标-历史交叉注意力(STCA)将长序列建模降至 O(L)，配合请求级批处理(RLB)与稀疏训练稠密推理，在抖音十亿级流量实现 10K 序列端到端排序。

venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/beyond_.title: VK-LSVD: A Large-Scale Industrial Dataset for Short-Video Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/beyond_.description: [WWW 2026][序列与会话推荐] 发布 407 亿交互、千万用户、两千万短视频的工业级开放数据集，配全局时间切分与冷启动竞赛基准。

venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/beyond_.title: Closing the Long-Short View Gap in Sequential Recommendation without Cached History
venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/beyond_.description: [CIKM 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用角度相似度打分+softmax1 修正长视训练几何缺陷，再仅微调 Bias/LayerNorm 实现无缓存短视推理，短窗下反超全序列基线。

venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/beyond_.title: SequenceO1: End-to-End Ultra-Long (100K) Sequence Modeling in Recommendation with Low-Rank Caching
venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/beyond_.description: [RecSys 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用可学习原型压缩 100K 历史为定长 sketch 并缓存复用，端到端精排训练/推理 FLOPs 降 49.9×/63.9×，线上 Finish +2.33%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/case_ca.title: Time-Interval-Aware Disentangled Expert Modeling for Next-Basket Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/case_ca.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] TIDE 用 Hawkes 增强傅里叶时间编码刻画物品级非单调补货周期，并以双专家解耦习惯与探索意图，Leave-One-Out 全库排序下 R@10 最高提升 18.4%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/case_ca.title: Temporal Linear Item-Item Model for Sequential Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/case_ca.description: [WSDM 2025][序列与会话推荐] 在闭式解线性 item-item 模型上引入时间间隔加权与趋势感知归一化，Full-Ranking 下平均 NDCG@10 提升 9.07%，训练快 6.9–57 倍。

venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/case_ca.title: Decoupled Temporal Encoding for Generative Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/case_ca.description: [CIKM 2026][生成式推荐] 将宏观时间动态与微观序列顺序解耦的双模块位置编码，工业数据集 GAUC +1.16pt，线上 CTR +1.8%、RPM +3.0%，延迟仅 +0.3%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/case_ca.title: Deep-learning Causal Retrieval Optimization for Efficient e-commerce Distribution in Pinterest
venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/case_ca.description: [KDD 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 将购物候选生成器触发建模为因果决策，用 DR 多任务提升学习+随机 Holdout+线性回放，线上触发率降 85% 而购物会话持平。

venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/case_ca.title: Massive Memorization with Hundreds of Trillions of Parameters for Sequential Transducer Generative Recommenders
venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/case_ca.description: [ICLR 2026][序列与会话推荐] VISTA 将超长用户历史两阶段解耦：离线用准线性注意力压缩为数百种子嵌入并缓存，下游仅做候选-摘要注意力，工业上线推理 GPU 降 94%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/cmsl_co.title: CPMR: Context-Aware Incremental Sequential Recommendation with Pseudo-Multi-Task Learning
