venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/rote_co.description: [RecSys 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用对比熵惊讶度动态切分长交互序列为变长行为块，在 FLOPs 匹配下 NDCG@10 最高提升 21.1%，实现更优效率-精度前沿。

venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/sprint_.title: Bid Farewell to Seesaw: Towards Accurate Long-tail Session-based Recommendation via Dual Constraints of Hybrid Intents
venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/sprint_.description: [AAAI 2026][序列与会话推荐] 提出混合意图学习与意图约束损失的双约束即插即用框架 HID，在三个数据集上同时提升会话推荐准确率与长尾覆盖，打破 see-saw 困境。

venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/sprint_.title: Effectiveness of LLMs in Temporal User Profiling for Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/sprint_.description: [ICDM 2025 Workshop][LLM4Rec] 用 LLM 分别生成短期/长期自然语言画像，经 SBERT 编码与注意力融合做内容推荐，Movies&TV 上 Recall@10 相对提升 17%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/sprint_.title: Intent Representation Learning with Large Language Model for Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/sprint_.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 LLM 思维链抽取文本意图，与交互意图双塔对齐+动量蒸馏匹配，作为模型无关插件在三个数据集上稳定提升 Recall/NDCG。

venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/sprint_.title: Lost in Sequence: Do Large Language Models Understand Sequential Recommendation?
venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/sprint_.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 揭示现有 LLM4Rec 模型无法捕捉交互序列顺序信息，提出冻结 LLM 与 CF-SRec、仅训练轻量 MLP 的蒸馏框架 LLM-SRec，在 Amazon 四数据集上 NDCG@10 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/sprint_.title: Mixture of Sequence: Theme-Aware Mixture-of-Experts for Long-Sequence Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/sprint_.description: [WWW 2026][序列与会话推荐] 揭示长序列“会话跳跃”现象，用主题码本路由+多尺度专家融合做子序列抽取，AUC 平均提升 0.68% 且 FLOPs 更低

venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/time_in.title: CASE: Cadence-Aware Set Encoding for Large-Scale Next Basket Repurchase Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/time_in.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 以日历时间二值信号+共享多尺度时序卷积建模物品复购节奏，再用 ISAB 建模跨物品依赖，在四个杂货数据集与千万级生产系统上取得显著提升。

venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/time_in.title: Time Matters: Enhancing Sequential Recommendations with Time-Guided Graph Neural ODEs
venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/time_in.description: [KDD 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用时间引导扩散补全稀疏用户时间图、图神经ODE对齐用户兴趣与物品演化，五数据集Recall@20最高提升46%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/time_in.title: Decoupled Temporal Encoding for Generative Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/time_in.description: [CIKM 2026][生成式推荐] 将宏观时间动态与微观序列顺序解耦的双模块位置编码，工业数据集 GAUC +1.16pt，线上 CTR +1.8%、RPM +3.0%，延迟仅 +0.3%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/time_in.title: RoTE: Coarse-to-Fine Multi-Level Rotary Time Embedding for Sequential Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/time_in.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 将时间戳分解为年/月/日多粒度并借 RoPE 旋转注入 Q/K，即插即用提升 SASRec/RPG，NDCG@5 最高 +20.11%

venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/time_in.title: Temporal Linear Item-Item Model for Sequential Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/time_in.description: [WSDM 2025][序列与会话推荐] 在闭式解线性 item-item 模型上引入时间间隔加权与趋势感知归一化，Full-Ranking 下平均 NDCG@10 提升 9.07%，训练快 6.9–57 倍。

venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/wpgrec_.title: Wavelet Enhanced Adaptive Frequency Filter for Sequential Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/wpgrec_.description: [AAAI 2026][序列推荐] 用上下文动态调制频域滤波器并叠加 Haar 小波高频增强，在 4 个基准 Full-Ranking 下 HR@20 最高提升 11.4%，长序列下训练开销低于 BSARec/SLIME4Rec。

venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/wpgrec_.title: Beyond Noisy Signals: Dual-Level Denoising for Multi-modal Sequential Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/wpgrec_.description: [ACM MM 2026][多模态推荐] 图拉普拉斯低通滤波去特征噪声 + FFT 可学习频域滤波去序列噪声，四数据集 Full-Ranking 全面 SOTA，R@20 最高 +19.33%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/wpgrec_.title: TimeMM: Time-as-Operator Spectral Filtering for Dynamic Multimodal Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/wpgrec_.description: [SIGIR 2026][多模态推荐] 将交互新近度映射为时间核加权图算子族，隐式实现免特征分解的多尺度谱滤波，配合自适应算子混合与模态路由，全库排序下 R@20 相对提升 3%–10%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/wpgrec_.title: Exploiting Inter-Session Information with Frequency-enhanced Dual-Path Networks for Sequential Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/wpgrec_.description: [AAAI 2026][序列与会话推荐] FreqRec 用可学习复数频域 MLP 双路建模跨会话群体节奏与用户局部高频，并加频域一致性损失，全库排序下 NDCG@10 最高提升 7.38%。

venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/wpgrec_.title: RoTE: Coarse-to-Fine Multi-Level Rotary Time Embedding for Sequential Recommendation
venues/SIGIR/2026/sequential_rec/wpgrec_.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 将时间戳分解为年/月/日多粒度并借 RoPE 旋转注入 Q/K，即插即用提升 SASRec/RPG，NDCG@5 最高 +20.11%

venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/agent_conversationa.title: UserSimCRS v2: Simulation-Based Evaluation for Conversational Recommender Systems
venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/agent_conversationa.description: [ECIR 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 升级对话推荐用户模拟评测工具包，引入 LLM 模拟器、统一数据格式与 LLM-as-a-Judge 指标，案例揭示模拟器间系统排序显著分歧。

venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/agent_conversationa.title: A LLM-based Controllable, Scalable, Human-Involved User Simulator Framework for Conversational Recommender Systems
venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/agent_conversationa.description: [WWW 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 以插件管理器分阶段管控 LLM 用户模拟器，通过记忆隔离与偏好二分抑制数据泄漏，在 ReDial/OpenDialKG/MovieLens 上显著提升 CRS 评估可信度。

venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/agent_conversationa.title: Towards Personalized Conversational Sales Agents: Contextual User Profiling for Strategic Action
venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/agent_conversationa.description: [ACL 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出 CSALES 对话销售任务与 CSUSER 真实画像用户模拟器，CSI 智能体通过上下文画像驱动统一动作空间，SR 提升约 15-20pt、SWR 提升约 5-10pt。

venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/agent_conversationa.title: RecUserSim: A Realistic and Diverse User Simulator for Evaluating Conversational Recommender Systems
venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/agent_conversationa.description: [WWW 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出四模块 LLM Agent 用户模拟器，以有限理性三层 Rating-Action-Response 机制实现真实角色扮演、多样人群覆盖与显式打分，并落地华为 Celia 餐饮助手。

venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/agent_conversationa.title: Interplay: Training Independent Simulators for Reference-Free Conversational Recommendation
venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/agent_conversationa.description: [ECIR 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 训练独立用户/推荐双模拟器，以目标属性替代目标物品消除 oracle 泄漏，8B 模型 Recall@1 超 32B 基线 15 倍。

venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/cross_domain_multi_.title: Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation with Representation-Level User Transfer
venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/cross_domain_multi_.description: [CIKM 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 仅通过用户表征级迁移实现跨域序列推荐，融合层注入源域用户向量，兼容纵向联邦与部分重叠用户，全库排序下 NDCG@10 提升 7.4–24.1%。

venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/cross_domain_multi_.title: DARLR: Dual-Agent Offline Reinforcement Learning for Recommender Systems with Dynamic Reward
venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/cross_domain_multi_.description: [SIGIR 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 双智能体离线 RL 用选择器聚合相似用户动态重塑奖励与不确定性惩罚，四数据集累积奖励全面超越 ROLeR/DORL。

venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/cross_domain_multi_.title: Revisiting Self-attention for Cross-domain Sequential Recommendation
venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/cross_domain_multi_.description: [KDD 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 将跨域序列推荐重构为推荐损失与跨域注意力抑制的双目标帕累托优化，以即插即用方式改造自注意力，平均提升 Recall@10 达 9.8%/16.0%。

venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/cross_domain_multi_.title: ABXI: Invariant Interest Adaptation for Task-Guided Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation
venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/cross_domain_multi_.description: [WWW 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用任务引导对齐消除预测错配，并以 dLoRA/iLoRA 双 LoRA 抽取域不变兴趣，三数据集 MRR 大幅超越 CDSR 基线。

venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/cross_domain_multi_.title: Choosing the Best of Both Worlds: Diverse and Novel Recommendations through Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning
venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/cross_domain_multi_.description: [WSDM 2022][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用标量化多目标 RL 头正则化序列推荐主干，同时优化准确率/多样性/新颖性，聚合覆盖度提升约 20% 且准确率不降。

venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/debias_fairness_ind.title: Opening the Black Box: Interpretable Remedies for Popularity Bias in Recommender Systems
venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/debias_fairness_ind.description: [RecSys 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 用稀疏自编码器定位流行度神经元并做激活转向，在 ML-1M/Last.fm 上以极小精度损失换取显著曝光公平提升。

venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/debias_fairness_ind.title: Unbiased Collaborative Filtering with Fair Sampling
venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/debias_fairness_ind.description: [SIGIR 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 通过对称补充采样使每个用户/物品等概率成为正负样本，无需估计倾向分即可消除流行度偏置，全库排序下 Recall/NDCG 与 ARP 双优。

venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/debias_fairness_ind.title: Uncertainty Calibration for Counterfactual Propensity Estimation in Recommendation
venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/debias_fairness_ind.description: [TKDE 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 揭示倾向分估计严重失准问题，提出以ECE为质量度量的模型无关校准框架，理论证明校准倾向分降低IPS偏差，在Coat/Yahoo/KuaiRand上显著提升CVR去偏效果。

venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/debias_fairness_ind.title: Why is Normalization Necessary for Linear Recommenders?
venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/debias_fairness_ind.description: [SIGIR 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 理论剖析线性自编码器归一化对流行度/邻域偏差的作用，提出数据自适应归一化 DAN，六数据集全库排序下长尾最高提升 128.57%。

venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/debias_fairness_ind.title: Taming Recommendation Bias with Causal Intervention on Evolving Personal Popularity
venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/debias_fairness_ind.description: [KDD 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 提出演化个人流行度度量与因果去混杂训练，并在推理期用移动平均趋势外推做干预，兼顾用户-物品演化一致性，Full-Ranking 下 Recall@20 最高提升 20.4%。

venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/debias_fairness_ind.title: HyFormer: Revisiting the Roles of Sequence Modeling and Feature Interaction in CTR Prediction
venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/debias_fairness_ind.description: [SIGIR 2026][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用 Global Tokens 交替执行 Query Decoding 与 Query Boosting，统一长序列建模与特征交叉，AUC 提升 0.17% 且 FLOPs 仅 3.9T。

venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/debias_fairness_ind.title: EAGER: Enrich-and-Align Generative Query Recommendation from Clicked Items in E-commerce Search
venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/debias_fairness_ind.description: [EMNLP 2026 Industry][LLM4Rec] 两阶段生成式 I2Q 查询推荐：课程化 SFT 扩意图覆盖 + GRPO 混合奖励对齐线上约束，线上 UCTR +0.83%、Pay Count +3.49%。

venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/debias_fairness_ind.title: IntSR: An Integrated Generative Framework for Search and Recommendation
venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/debias_fairness_ind.description: [CIKM 2026][生成式推荐] 以 query 模态统一搜索/推荐与召回/排序四任务，提出 query 驱动解码器与时间对齐负采样，Amap 线上 GMV+9.34%。

venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/debias_fairness_ind.title: SORT: A Systematically Optimized Ranking Transformer for Industrial-scale Recommenders
venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/debias_fairness_ind.description: [CIKM 2026][多任务学习与列表级重排] 以请求为中心组织样本、局部注意力+查询剪枝、生成式预训练与稀疏MoE重构工业精排Transformer，线上GMV+8.65%且延迟降62%。

venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/debias_fairness_ind.title: Scaling Recommender Transformers to One Billion Parameters
venues/SIGIR-AP/2025/debias_fairness_ind.description: [KDD 2026][序列与会话推荐] ARGUS 将自回归预训练解耦为反馈预测与下一物品预测双任务，把推荐 Transformer 编码器扩到 10 亿参数，线上听歌时长 +2.26%、点赞率 +6.37%。

venues/SIGIR-AP/2026/collaborative_filte.title: Revisiting Language Models in Neural News Recommender Systems
venues/SIGIR-AP/2026/collaborative_filte.description: [ECIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 在 MIND 上统一复现 8 种 LM 作为新闻编码器，发现更大模型不必然更优，但显著利好冷启动用户。

venues/SIGIR-AP/2026/collaborative_filte.title: Learning Sparse Representations of Multimodal Content for Enhanced Cold Item Recommendation
venues/SIGIR-AP/2026/collaborative_filte.description: [RecSys 2026][冷启动与长尾推荐] 将多模态内容冷启动表征改为 top-K 稀疏嵌入，并用 α-entmax 预稀疏激活诱导锐化与去噪，冷启动 NDCG@20 提升 16.6%–75.5% 且存储更低。

venues/SIGIR-AP/2026/collaborative_filte.title: Enhancing News Recommendation with Hierarchical LLM Prompting
venues/SIGIR-AP/2026/collaborative_filte.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 用分层提示让 LLM 生成更丰富的新闻标题与实体，作为模型无关的数据增强模块，在 MIND 上以 AUC 68.88 超越 GLoCIM 等 SOTA。

venues/SIGIR-AP/2026/collaborative_filte.title: BlossomRec: Block-level Fused Sparse Attention Mechanism for Sequential Recommendations
venues/SIGIR-AP/2026/collaborative_filte.description: [WWW 2026][序列与会话推荐] 双路块级稀疏注意力（LTIS 块选择 + STIS 幂律掩码）经门控融合，长序列训练提速 3.2×、显存降至 1/11，精度持平或超越 SASRec。

venues/SIGIR-AP/2026/collaborative_filte.title: Efficient Learning of Sparse Representations from Interactions
venues/SIGIR-AP/2026/collaborative_filte.description: [WWW 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 在 ELSA 线性自编码器训练中渐进剪枝学习高维稀疏物品嵌入，实现最高 100× 压缩仅损 2.5% nDCG，并派生可解释语义分段。

venues/SIGIR-AP/2026/generative_rec/what.title: FORGE: Forming Semantic Identifiers for Generative Retrieval in Industrial Datasets
venues/SIGIR-AP/2026/generative_rec/what.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 系统化拆解 SID 构建全流程（多模态特征/量化编码/冲突后处理），提出免训练的 Embedding HitRate 与 Gini 系数代理指标，淘宝线上交易量 +0.35%。

venues/SIGIR-AP/2026/generative_rec/what.title: Differentiable Semantic ID for Generative Recommendation
venues/SIGIR-AP/2026/generative_rec/what.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用 Gumbel 噪声+不确定性衰减实现可微语义ID联合训练，Leave-One-Out 全库排序下 R@10 相对 TIGER 提升约 12%。

venues/SIGIR-AP/2026/generative_rec/what.title: Faithful Evaluation of Semantic-ID Tokenizers for Generative Recommendation
venues/SIGIR-AP/2026/generative_rec/what.description: [CIKM 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 揭示SID碰撞导致SID级指标虚高至103.36%，提出碰撞校正评估CCE与零碰撞重分配ZCR，翻转多个Tokenizer排序。

venues/SIGIR-AP/2026/generative_rec/what.title: Semantic IDs for Joint Generative Search and Recommendation
venues/SIGIR-AP/2026/generative_rec/what.description: [RecSys 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 系统对比任务专属与跨任务语义ID构建策略，发现多任务双塔嵌入+统一RQ-KMeans语义ID在联合搜索推荐中取得最佳权衡。

venues/SIGIR-AP/2026/generative_rec/what.title: Empowering Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation with Hybrid Tokenization and Serial-Parallel Decoding
venues/SIGIR-AP/2026/generative_rec/what.description: [RecSys 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义 ID] 跨域共享-专属多塔 RQ-VAE 混合分词 + 两段式串并解码，Leave-One-Out 全库排序下精度 +1.5%、时延 -85.1%。

venues/TKDD/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: LettinGo: Explore User Profile Generation for Recommendation System
venues/TKDD/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 用多LLM探索开放式用户画像、以下游推荐成败构造偏好对、DPO对齐画像生成器，Amazon Books Acc 66.3%→70.4%。

venues/TKDD/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Enriching Semantic Profiles into Knowledge Graph for Recommender Systems Using Large Language Models
venues/TKDD/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [KDD 2026][LLM4Rec] 用 LLM 为 KG 全实体生成语义画像，以可逆加性注入+成对匹配对齐，Full-Ranking 下 Recall@40 最高提升 2.6%。

venues/TKDD/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Scaling Transformers for Discriminative Recommendation via Generative Pretraining
venues/TKDD/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [KDD 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用生成式预训练初始化判别式排序模型并冻结稀疏Embedding，破解CTR/CVR过拟合，使稠密参数从13K扩到0.3B仍遵循幂律提升。

venues/TKDD/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Personalized Recommendation Tool Learning via Autonomous Language Agents
venues/TKDD/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [RecSys 2026][LLM4Rec] 让 LLM 智能体做个性化工具选择、传统推荐模型做全库打分，以架构设计绕开幻觉与上下文长度限制，Full-Ranking 下 R@10 最高提升 68.8%。

venues/TKDD/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: FeDecider: An LLM-Based Framework for Federated Cross-Domain Recommendation
venues/TKDD/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [WWW 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 联邦跨域 LLM 推荐中，服务器只广播 LoRA 更新的方向分量以消除尺度噪声，客户端用可学习个性化权重做数据感知融合，Goodreads 平均 Hit@5 提升 3.8%。

venues/TKDD/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Impacts of Mainstream-Driven Algorithms on Recommendations for Children Across Domains: A Reproducibility Study
venues/TKDD/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [RecSys 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 跨电影/音乐/图书三域复现儿童与主流用户偏好偏差，并引入流行度偏差指标，揭示推荐算法对儿童群体的域特异性失效。

venues/TKDD/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Reducing Symbiosis Bias Through Better A/B Tests of Recommendation Algorithms
venues/TKDD/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [WWW 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 揭示推荐算法共享训练数据导致的共生偏差，理论建模并仿真对比三种实验设计，用国家级分流实验验证偏差存在。

venues/TKDD/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Unbiased Collaborative Filtering with Fair Sampling
venues/TKDD/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [SIGIR 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 通过对称补充采样使每个用户/物品等概率成为正负样本，无需估计倾向分即可消除流行度偏置，全库排序下 Recall/NDCG 与 ARP 双优。

venues/TKDD/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Diversity-Augmented Negative Sampling for Implicit Collaborative Filtering
venues/TKDD/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [WWW 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用用户级缓存 + 多样性增强 k-DPP + mixup 合成负样本，解决两阶段负采样同质化问题，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@20 最高提升 8.76%。

venues/TKDD/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Quantifying User Coherence: A Unified Framework for Analyzing Recommender Systems Across Domains
venues/TKDD/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [WWW 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 提出 Mean Surprise 与 Mean Conditional Surprise 两个信息论度量刻画用户画像一致性，揭示复杂模型增益集中于高一致用户，并支撑分层评测与用户分群建模。

venues/TKDD/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Balancing Embedding Spectrum for Recommendation
venues/TKDD/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [TORS 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 从谱分析视角揭示成对学习中的嵌入坍缩，提出 DirectSpec 全通滤波直接均衡奇异值谱，MF/LightGCN 上 nDCG@10 最高提升 52.6%/42.4%。

venues/TKDD/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Extending MovieLens-32M to Provide New Evaluation Objectives
venues/TKDD/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [SIGIR 2025][去偏公平与工业评测] 用 TREC 池化法为 ML-32M 构建 51 用户偏好型 qrels，揭示传统 train/test 评测的流行度偏置并给出新评测目标。

venues/TKDD/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Causal-Invariant Cross-Domain Out-of-Distribution Recommendation
venues/TKDD/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [TOIS 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 统一建模跨域与单域双重分布偏移，用双层因果结构与 LLM 引导混杂因子发现实现跨域 OOD 推荐，HR@10 平均提升 6.34%。

venues/TKDD/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.title: RecRanker: Instruction Tuning Large Language Model as Ranker for Top-k Recommendation
venues/TKDD/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [TOIS 2025][大语言模型推荐] 以自适应用户采样、位置偏移与检索信号增强构建三类排序指令微调 LLM 重排器，并提出混合排序集成，Leave-One-Out 全库排序下 HR/NDCG 最高提升 213%。

venues/TKDD/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Coherence-guided Preference Disentanglement for Cross-domain Recommendations
venues/TKDD/2026/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [TOIS 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用全局-局部图 + 一致性约束抽取跨域共享物品属性，并以流行度加权 Softmax 将共享用户偏好解耦为兴趣/从众，六组双目标 CDR 任务 HR@10 最高提升约 37%。

venues/TKDD/2026/generative_rec/eval4dir.title: Diffusion Recommender Models and the Illusion of Progress: A Concerning Study of Reproducibility and a Conceptual Mismatch
venues/TKDD/2026/generative_rec/eval4dir.description: [TORS 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 复现 9 个 SIGIR'23-24 扩散推荐模型，仅 25% 结果可复现，调优简单基线全面反超，并揭示 DDPM 与 top-n 推荐任务的概念错配。

venues/TKDD/2026/generative_rec/eval4dir.title: Reproducibility in Recommender Systems: A Survey
venues/TKDD/2026/generative_rec/eval4dir.description: [TORS 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 对 RecSys 可复现性赛道 2020–2025 年 51 篇论文的结构化元分析，揭示其方法论高度同质化、以“扩展”替代“严格复现”的实践落差。

venues/TKDD/2026/generative_rec/eval4dir.title: The Efficiency vs. Accuracy Trade-off: Optimizing RAG-Enhanced LLM Recommender Systems Using Multi-Head Early Exit
venues/TKDD/2026/generative_rec/eval4dir.description: [ACL/EMNLP 2025][LLM4Rec] 用 GCN 检索器替代 LLM embedder 加速 RAG，并以多头早退动态终止 LLM 推理，在 5 个 CTR 数据集上兼顾 AUC 与吞吐。

venues/TKDD/2026/generative_rec/eval4dir.title: A Survey on Intent-aware Recommender Systems
venues/TKDD/2026/generative_rec/eval4dir.description: [TORS 2025][序列与会话推荐] 系统梳理意图感知推荐(IARS)的三大技术路线与评估实践，指出离线精度导向、可复现性不足与显式意图建模缺失三大空白。

venues/TKDD/2026/generative_rec/eval4dir.title: Impression-Aware Recommender Systems
venues/TKDD/2026/generative_rec/eval4dir.description: [TORS 2025][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 首篇曝光感知推荐系统(IARS)系统性综述，提出统一理论框架与三维分类体系，厘清模型、数据集与评估协议。

venues/TKDE/2025/collaborative_filtering.title: SGCL: Unifying Self-Supervised and Supervised Learning for Graph Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/collaborative_filtering.description: [RecSys 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 将 BPR 与 InfoNCE 合并为单一监督图对比损失，免增广免负采样，精度与训练效率双超 SGL/SimGCL。

venues/TKDE/2025/collaborative_filtering.title: Squeeze and Excitation: A Weighted Graph Contrastive Learning for Collaborative Filtering
venues/TKDE/2025/collaborative_filtering.description: [SIGIR 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 仅扰动末层GCN视图并用SENet动态加权特征，在三个数据集上实现最高24.45%的NDCG@20提升。

venues/TKDE/2025/collaborative_filtering.title: Intent-guided Heterogeneous Graph Contrastive Learning for Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/collaborative_filtering.description: [TKDE 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 用元路径意图构建双对比学习视图，并以信息瓶颈掩码自编码器去噪，六数据集全库排序 Recall@20 最高提升 12.4%。

venues/TKDE/2025/collaborative_filtering.title: MixRec: Heterogeneous Graph Collaborative Filtering
venues/TKDE/2025/collaborative_filtering.description: [WSDM 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 参数化异质超图解耦多行为意图，配合节点/图级自适应对比学习，Leave-One-Out 全库排序下 HR@10 最高提升 9.8%。

venues/TKDE/2025/collaborative_filtering.title: NLGCL: Naturally Existing Neighbor Layers Graph Contrastive Learning for Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/collaborative_filtering.description: [RecSys 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 用 GNN 相邻层天然异构节点作正样本对替代图增广，免视图构建，全库排序下 NDCG@10 最高提升 12.41% 且训练最快。

venues/TKDE/2025/collaborative_filtering.title: MixRec: Heterogeneous Graph Collaborative Filtering
venues/TKDE/2025/collaborative_filtering.description: [WSDM 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 参数化异质超图解耦多行为意图，配合节点/图级自适应对比学习，Leave-One-Out 全库排序下 HR@10 最高提升 9.8%。

venues/TKDE/2025/collaborative_filtering.title: A Self-Supervised Mixture-of-Experts Framework for Multi-behavior Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/collaborative_filtering.description: [CIKM 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 揭示多行为推荐在已访问/未访问物品上的性能鸿沟，提出双专家 MoE + 专家自适应 SSL（访问过滤/新颖性推断对比 + 行为生成）框架，全库排序下 HR@20 最高提升 65.46%。

venues/TKDE/2025/collaborative_filtering.title: Factorized Latent Reasoning for LLM-based Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/collaborative_filtering.description: [SIGIR 2026][大语言模型推荐] 将 LLM 隐式推理拆为 K 个解耦偏好因子并配 GRPO 对齐，全库约束解码下 N@5 最高提升 10.26%

venues/TKDE/2025/collaborative_filtering.title: Hierarchical Graph Information Bottleneck for Multi-Behavior Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/collaborative_filtering.description: [RecSys 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用信息瓶颈原理重构多行为层次推荐，以 InfoNCE 保真、HSIC 压缩、可学习边丢弃去噪，全库排序下 HR@10 最高提升 15.08%。

venues/TKDE/2025/collaborative_filtering.title: Personalized Federated Collaborative Filtering: A Variational AutoEncoder Approach
venues/TKDE/2025/collaborative_filtering.description: [AAAI 2025][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 将 FedCF 重构为 VAE 任务，用门控双编码器分离共享/个性化知识，HR@20 较 FedRAP 提升约 97%。

venues/TKDE/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation with Representation-Level User Transfer
venues/TKDE/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [CIKM 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 仅通过用户表征级迁移实现跨域序列推荐，融合层注入源域用户向量，兼容纵向联邦与部分重叠用户，全库排序下 NDCG@10 提升 7.4–24.1%。

venues/TKDE/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: ABXI: Invariant Interest Adaptation for Task-Guided Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [WWW 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用任务引导对齐消除预测错配，并以 dLoRA/iLoRA 双 LoRA 抽取域不变兴趣，三数据集 MRR 大幅超越 CDSR 基线。

venues/TKDE/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Uncovering Cross-Domain Recommendation Ability of Large Language Models
venues/TKDE/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [WWW 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用源域购买序列+跨域引导提示驱动 LLM 零样本重排目标域候选，揭示域间隙与模型规模对跨域迁移的决定性影响。

venues/TKDE/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: MergeRec: Model Merging for Data-Isolated Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [KDD 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 提出数据隔离跨域序列推荐新设定，用任务向量模型合并+伪用户数据+推荐/蒸馏联合目标，Recall@10 平均提升 17.21%。

venues/TKDE/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Revisiting Self-attention for Cross-domain Sequential Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [KDD 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 将跨域序列推荐重构为推荐损失与跨域注意力抑制的双目标帕累托优化，以即插即用方式改造自注意力，平均提升 Recall@10 达 9.8%/16.0%。

venues/TKDE/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: FairFS: Addressing Deep Feature Selection Biases for Recommender System
venues/TKDE/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [WWW 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 识别深度特征选择的三类偏差（层偏差/基线偏差/近似偏差），以平滑基线与聚合近似实现无偏特征重要性估计，AUC 提升最高 0.35%。

venues/TKDE/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: TayFCS: Towards Light Feature Combination Selection for Deep Recommender Systems
venues/TKDE/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [KDD 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用泰勒展开+IME近似一次性梯度回传估计高阶组合重要性，再用LR滑窗剔除冗余，三数据集AUC显著提升且线上CVR+13.9%

venues/TKDE/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Can LLMs Outshine Conventional Recommenders? A Comparative Evaluation
venues/TKDE/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [NeurIPS 2025 DB Track][大语言模型推荐] RecBench 系统对比 17 个 LLM 与 DLRM 在 4 种物品表征、CTR/SeqRec 双任务上的精度-效率权衡，LLM 精度领先但推理慢千倍。

venues/TKDE/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: LLM2Rec: Large Language Models Are Powerful Embedding Models for Sequential Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 两阶段将 LLM 改造为融合协同信号与语义的物品嵌入模型，Full-Ranking 下域内平均提升约 15%、跨域仍稳定增益。

venues/TKDE/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Learning Sparse Representations of Multimodal Content for Enhanced Cold Item Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [RecSys 2026][冷启动与长尾推荐] 将多模态内容冷启动表征改为 top-K 稀疏嵌入，并用 α-entmax 预稀疏激活诱导锐化与去噪，冷启动 NDCG@20 提升 16.6%–75.5% 且存储更低。

venues/TKDE/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Accurate and Diverse Recommendations via Propensity-Weighted Linear Autoencoders
venues/TKDE/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [SIGIR-AP 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 用对数 Sigmoid 重定义 IPS 倾向分，避免幂律对热门物品过度惩罚，在 EASE 类线性自编码器上以闭式解实现覆盖率大幅提升且精度不降。

venues/TKDE/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: On Predicting Post-Click Conversion Rate via Counterfactual Inference
venues/TKDE/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [ICDM 2025][CTR/CVR 预估与特征交叉] 用 SCM 对未点击样本做 do(C=1) 反事实推断生成转化伪标签，全空间训练 CVR 模型，离线 AUC 平均 +1.01%，线上 CVR +17.35%。

venues/TKDE/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Unbiased Collaborative Filtering with Fair Sampling
venues/TKDE/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [SIGIR 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 通过对称补充采样使每个用户/物品等概率成为正负样本，无需估计倾向分即可消除流行度偏置，全库排序下 Recall/NDCG 与 ARP 双优。

venues/TKDE/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Additive Control Variates Dominate Self-Normalisation in Off-Policy Evaluation
venues/TKDE/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [SIGIR 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 证明最优加性基线 β*-IPS 在 MSE 上渐近严格优于 SNIPS，并给出精确方差差解析式与排序场景 β*⊥⊥-IPM 扩展。

venues/TKDE/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: On the Reliability of Sampling Strategies in Offline Recommender Evaluation
venues/TKDE/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [RecSys 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 以全观测 KuaiRec 为真值，四维度（分辨率/保真度/鲁棒性/预测力）系统解耦曝光偏差与采样偏差，给出采样策略选择指南。

venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Data Augmentation as Free Lunch: Exploring the Test-Time Augmentation for Sequential Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [SIGIR 2025][序列与会话推荐] 将数据增强从训练期迁移到推理期，提出 TNoise 与 TMask 两个免训练、免参数的测试时增强算子，在 Full-Ranking 协议下平均提升 14%–30%。

venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Exploring Test-time Scaling via Prediction Merging on Large-Scale Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [SIGIR 2026][CTR预估与特征交叉] 提出预测合并式测试时缩放，用异构架构与同构随机种子生成多样 logit 并平均融合，三数据集八骨干上稳定超越参数缩放。

venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Temporal Linear Item-Item Model for Sequential Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [WSDM 2025][序列与会话推荐] 在闭式解线性 item-item 模型上引入时间间隔加权与趋势感知归一化，Full-Ranking 下平均 NDCG@10 提升 9.07%，训练快 6.9–57 倍。

venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Cross-Domain Causal Preference Learning for Out-of-Distribution Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [DASFAA 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用域对抗抽取域共享偏好、DAG 学习潜属性因果结构，缓解目标域稀疏下的 OOD 泛化，OOD 测试 HR@10 提升约 2-6%。

venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Scaling Recommender Transformers to One Billion Parameters
venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [KDD 2026][序列与会话推荐] ARGUS 将自回归预训练解耦为反馈预测与下一物品预测双任务，把推荐 Transformer 编码器扩到 10 亿参数，线上听歌时长 +2.26%、点赞率 +6.37%。

venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Improving Recommendation Fairness via Graph Structure and Representation Augmentation
venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [CIKM 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 用双先验假设定位敏感边与敏感特征，做图剪枝+特征掩码双增广，HSIC去偏+对比学习保效用，ML-1M 上 DP@10 降 3.4%、EO@10 降 7.6%。

venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: How Fair is Your Diffusion Recommender Model?
venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [RecSys 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 首个针对 DiffRec/L-DiffRec 的公平性实证研究，在 ML1M/FTKY 上以 Full-Ranking 评估效用与消费者/提供者公平，揭示扩散模型放大偏见而 L-DiffRec 可缓解。

venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Towards Fair Large Language Model-based Recommender Systems without Costly Retraining
venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [WWW 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 将 LLM-RS 去偏重构为免重训机器遗忘任务：可学习掩码定位致偏样本 + 影响函数一步参数修正，公平性提升同时精度不降、耗时降 96%。

venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Generative Data Augmentation in Graph Contrastive Learning for Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [CIKM 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 用 VAE 式生成器自适应生成噪声替代固定随机扰动构造对比视图，并引入物品互补矩阵，在三个稀疏数据集上 Full-Ranking 提升约 3–6%。

venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Towards Robust Recommendation: A Review and an Adversarial Robustness Evaluation Library
venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [TKDE 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 系统综述推荐系统对抗/非对抗鲁棒性，提出 ShillingREC 评测库统一攻击与防御模型评估。

venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Equity vs. Equality: Optimizing Ranking Fairness for Tailored Provider Needs
venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [SIGIR 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 提出以增益为基的公平框架与 EquityRank 梯度重排算法，按提供者异质偏好分配曝光与销量收益，离线/在线仿真均取得更优效果-公平权衡。

venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: A Reproducibility Study of Product-side Fairness in Bundle Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [RecSys 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 首个捆绑推荐商品侧公平性复现研究，揭示捆绑级与物品级曝光分布不一致、指标间结论分歧，并发现用户捆绑偏好越强曝光越公平。

venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Joint Evaluation of Fairness and Relevance in Recommender Systems with Pareto Frontier
venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [WWW 2025][去偏公平与工业评测] 提出 DPFR：以测试集构造相关性-公平性帕累托前沿，用模型得分到前沿的欧氏距离作为联合评测指标，揭示现有联合指标排序与帕累托最优解不一致。

venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Post-hoc Provider Fairness Adaptation via Hierarchical Exposure Alignment
venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [SIGIR 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 冻结基座+轻量公平适配器，用分层曝光对齐(HEFA)与可微NDCG联合优化，实现即插即用的提供方曝光公平。

venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Measuring Individual User Fairness with User Similarity and Effectiveness Disparity
venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [ECIR 2026][去偏公平与可信推荐] 提出 PUF 指标，用用户相似度加权有效性差异，首次同时刻画个体公平的两大要素，4 数据集 7 推荐器验证其敏感性与计算效率。

venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: A Survey of Personalized Federated Foundation Models for Privacy-Preserving Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [IJCAI-ECAI 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 综述提出“主动语义保人格”范式，用几何正交约束与语义感知聚合解耦全局知识与用户人格，并给出五类开放问题与未来路线。

venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Learning Evolving Preferences: A Federated Continual Framework for User-Centric Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [WWW 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 联邦持续推荐框架 FCUCR：时间感知自蒸馏抗遗忘 + 跨用户原型迁移促协同，四数据集全库排序 HR@10 最高提升 44.0%。

venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Federated Continual Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [CIKM 2025][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 提出 FCRec 新任务与 F3CRec 框架，客户端自适应回放+服务端物品级时序均值，在四个数据集三个 FedRec 骨干上 N@20 平均提升 5.6%–32.1%。

venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: A Federated Framework for LLM-based Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [NAACL 2025 Findings][去偏公平与工业架构] FELLRec 用动态聚合+课程升温平衡客户端性能，并以分层卸载降低 LLM 联邦推荐端侧开销。

venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Federated User Preference Modeling for Privacy-Preserving Cross-Domain Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [TMM 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用评论+潜在正物品挖掘综合偏好，再以 LDP 原型经联邦聚合跨域迁移，四组 CDR 任务 HR@10 平均提升约 13%。

venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Improving LLMs for Recommendation with Out-Of-Vocabulary Tokens
venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [arXiv 2024][LLM4Rec] 用元路径聚类生成 OOV 层级 token 构建用户/物品 META ID，兼顾记忆性与多样性，序列推荐 HR@10 最高提升 30%+。

venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: FLARE: Fusing Language Models and Collaborative Architectures for Recommender Enhancement
venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [WWW 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用冻结 mT5+Perceiver 将文本注入 Bert4Rec，并以重调 Bert4Rec 基线、大词表评测与 Critiquing 任务重估 ID+文本增益。

venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Can LLMs Outshine Conventional Recommenders? A Comparative Evaluation
venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [NeurIPS 2025 DB Track][大语言模型推荐] RecBench 系统对比 17 个 LLM 与 DLRM 在 4 种物品表征、CTR/SeqRec 双任务上的精度-效率权衡，LLM 精度领先但推理慢千倍。

venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Knowledge Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation for LLM-based Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [ACL 2025][LLM4Rec] 用跳场知识子图索引+流行度选择性检索+GNN软提示，将KG结构知识注入冻结LLM，MovieLens-1M ACC 相对提升58.6%且推理仅慢0.14s

venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: The Mental World of Large Language Models in Recommendation: A Benchmark on Association, Personalization, and Knowledgeability
venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出 LRWorld 基准（38K 样本/23M tokens），从关联、个性化、知识性三尺度十因素 31 任务系统评测数十个 LLM，揭示其在神经嵌入检索上的致命短板。

venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: FairDgcl: Fairness-aware Recommendation with Dynamic Graph Contrastive Learning
venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [TKDE 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 用对抗式视图生成器+判别器动态生成公平增强视图，在四个数据集上同时提升准确率与群体公平性。

venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Privacy Risks of LLM-Empowered Recommender Systems: An Inversion Attack Perspective
venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [RecSys 2025][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 首次系统研究 LLM 推荐系统的 logits 反演攻击，提出相似度引导精炼，可恢复 65% 交互物品与 87% 年龄性别。

venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Reference Recommendation based Membership Inference Attack against Hybrid-based Recommender Systems
venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [AAAI 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 针对混合推荐系统提出参考推荐相对成员度量 MIA，仅需两次黑盒查询，ASR 达 0.93 且比影子训练快 93 倍。

venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Spattack: Subgroup Poisoning Attacks on Federated Recommender Systems
venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [WWW 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 首个联邦推荐子群投毒攻击：近似-提升范式+对比排斥与自适应加权，0.1%恶意客户端即达100% ER@5且几乎不伤非目标群。

venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Data Watermarking for Sequential Recommender Systems
venues/TKDE/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [KDD 2025][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 首次定义序列推荐数据集/单用户双场景数据水印，用感受野约束插入连续物品序列，5 模型 3 数据集上水印 NDCG 近 1.0 且效用无损。

venues/TKDE/2025/generative_rec/tokenrec.title: Order-agnostic Identifier for Large Language Model-based Generative Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/generative_rec/tokenrec.description: [SIGIR 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 提出无序集合标识符范式，用CF+语义多token集合表示物品并同时生成，T5上Recall@10平均提升约50%，推理提速8-18倍。

venues/TKDE/2025/generative_rec/tokenrec.title: Improving LLMs for Recommendation with Out-Of-Vocabulary Tokens
venues/TKDE/2025/generative_rec/tokenrec.description: [arXiv 2024][LLM4Rec] 用元路径聚类生成 OOV 层级 token 构建用户/物品 META ID，兼顾记忆性与多样性，序列推荐 HR@10 最高提升 30%+。

venues/TKDE/2025/generative_rec/tokenrec.title: Tokens are All You Need: Dual-purpose Semantic IDs for Achieving LLM-Level I/O Efficiency in Recommendation Systems
venues/TKDE/2025/generative_rec/tokenrec.description: [RecSys 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用 RQ-VAE 语义ID 同时承担协同身份与内容重建双职责，以 SiDec 在线解码替代稠密向量 I/O，检索 HitRate@100 提升至 0.2910 且吞吐较原始稠密嵌入快 20.4%。

venues/TKDE/2025/generative_rec/tokenrec.title: Diffusion Generative Recommendation with Continuous Tokens
venues/TKDE/2025/generative_rec/tokenrec.description: [WWW 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用 σ-VAE 连续分词器替代量化码本，并以条件扩散+离散散度损失生成用户偏好，四数据集 Full-Ranking 上 HR@10 平均超 TIGER 11.76%。

venues/TKDE/2025/generative_rec/tokenrec.title: Learning Decomposed Contextual Token Representations from Pretrained and Collaborative Signals for Generative Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/generative_rec/tokenrec.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] DECOR 用冻结码本+可学协同嵌入分解融合、上下文 token 组合与可学 BOS 查询，缓解静态分词歧义与预训练语义丢失，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@10 最高提升 14%。

venues/TKDE/2025/graph_rec/dual_channel_.title: Graph Cross-Correlated Network for Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/graph_rec/dual_channel_.description: [TKDE 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 用非递归 PGR 保留各跳邻居纯语义，再以 HCC/ECC 显式建模用户-物品子图交叉相关项，全库排序下 NDCG@20 平均提升约 1.8%–2.9%。

venues/TKDE/2025/graph_rec/dual_channel_.title: ContextGNN: Beyond Two-Tower Recommendation Systems
venues/TKDE/2025/graph_rec/dual_channel_.description: [ICLR 2025][图神经网络推荐] 提出局部成对表征+全局双塔回退的混合GNN架构，在RelBench十个任务上平均MAP较最强成对基线提升20%。

venues/TKDE/2025/graph_rec/dual_channel_.title: Hierarchical Graph Information Bottleneck for Multi-Behavior Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/graph_rec/dual_channel_.description: [RecSys 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用信息瓶颈原理重构多行为层次推荐，以 InfoNCE 保真、HSIC 压缩、可学习边丢弃去噪，全库排序下 HR@10 最高提升 15.08%。

venues/TKDE/2025/graph_rec/dual_channel_.title: MixRec: Heterogeneous Graph Collaborative Filtering
venues/TKDE/2025/graph_rec/dual_channel_.description: [WSDM 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 参数化异质超图解耦多行为意图，配合节点/图级自适应对比学习，Leave-One-Out 全库排序下 HR@10 最高提升 9.8%。

venues/TKDE/2025/graph_rec/dual_channel_.title: RecLM: Recommendation Instruction Tuning
venues/TKDE/2025/graph_rec/dual_channel_.description: [ACL 2025][大语言模型推荐] 以两轮协同指令微调+RL画像精炼为LLM注入协同信号，作为即插即用画像增强器在零样本冷启动下带来最高 200%+ 的 Recall 提升。

venues/TKDE/2025/graph_rec/graph_cross_c.title: ContextGNN: Beyond Two-Tower Recommendation Systems
venues/TKDE/2025/graph_rec/graph_cross_c.description: [ICLR 2025][图神经网络推荐] 提出局部成对表征+全局双塔回退的混合GNN架构，在RelBench十个任务上平均MAP较最强成对基线提升20%。

venues/TKDE/2025/graph_rec/graph_cross_c.title: PULSE: Socially-Aware User Representation Modeling Toward Parameter-Efficient Graph Collaborative Filtering
venues/TKDE/2025/graph_rec/graph_cross_c.description: [WWW 2026][社交与群组推荐] 用社区结构与社交邻居物品信号替代显式用户嵌入，参数降 50% 且 NDCG@20 提升 8-9%

venues/TKDE/2025/graph_rec/graph_cross_c.title: Leveraging Member-Group Relations via Multi-View Graph Filtering for Effective Group Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/graph_rec/graph_cross_c.description: [WWW 2025][社交与群组推荐] 提出免训练多视图图滤波 Group-GF，用三张物品相似图与多项式滤波器聚合成员-群组关系，HR@10 最高提升 16.4% 且运行时间仅 1.55s。

venues/TKDE/2025/graph_rec/graph_cross_c.title: Dual-Channel Multiplex Graph Neural Networks for Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/graph_rec/graph_cross_c.description: [TKDE 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 双通道多路图网络显式建模行为模式、隐式挖掘关系链依赖，三数据集全指标平均提升 10%+

venues/TKDE/2025/graph_rec/graph_cross_c.title: RankGraph: Unified Heterogeneous Graph Learning for Cross-Domain Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/graph_rec/graph_cross_c.description: [RecSys 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 构建跨产品异构异质图，用 GPU 加速 RGCN + 对比学习产出图 token 注入推荐基础模型，线上 CTR +0.92%、CVR +2.82%。

venues/TKDE/2025/graph_rec/intent_guided.title: MixRec: Heterogeneous Graph Collaborative Filtering
venues/TKDE/2025/graph_rec/intent_guided.description: [WSDM 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 参数化异质超图解耦多行为意图，配合节点/图级自适应对比学习，Leave-One-Out 全库排序下 HR@10 最高提升 9.8%。

venues/TKDE/2025/graph_rec/intent_guided.title: Intent Propagation Contrastive Collaborative Filtering
venues/TKDE/2025/graph_rec/intent_guided.description: [TKDE 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 双螺旋消息传播融合高阶关系与意图解耦，对比学习对齐结构/意图视图，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG 平均提升 9.36%

venues/TKDE/2025/graph_rec/intent_guided.title: Contrastive Representation for Interactive Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/graph_rec/intent_guided.description: [AAAI 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用偏好排序对比学习(PRCL)为 DRL 交互推荐提炼状态表征，冷启动下样本效率显著提升。

venues/TKDE/2025/graph_rec/intent_guided.title: Intent-aware Diffusion with Contrastive Learning for Sequential Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/graph_rec/intent_guided.description: [SIGIR 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用 K-means 意图原型引导条件扩散生成意图对齐正视图替代随机增强，在 5 个数据集 Full-Ranking 下 NDCG 平均提升 20.68%。

venues/TKDE/2025/graph_rec/intent_guided.title: Refining Contrastive Learning and Homography Relations for Multi-Modal Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/graph_rec/intent_guided.description: [ACM MM 2025][多模态推荐] 用元网络+正交约束精炼多模态对比学习，并补建用户兴趣图与物品共现图，全库排序下 R@20 最高提升约 9.8%。

venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/collm_integrati.title: EAGER-LLM: Enhancing Large Language Models as Recommenders through Exogenous Behavior-Semantic Integration
venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/collm_integrati.description: [WWW 2025][大语言模型推荐] 以双源知识富集物品索引+非侵入多尺度对齐重建+退火适配器，将外源行为/语义信号注入 LLM 生成式推荐，Amazon 三数据集 Full-Ranking 下 Recall@10 最高提升 26.16%。

venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/collm_integrati.title: Large Language Model Simulator for Cold-Start Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/collm_integrati.description: [WSDM 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 用 LLM 模拟冷物品的用户交互行为，并以耦合漏斗（FAISS 过滤 + LLM 精炼）把十亿级候选压到数百，离线冷召回 NDCG 提升 37%+，线上冷启 GMV +16.9%。

venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/collm_integrati.title: LLM2Rec: Large Language Models Are Powerful Embedding Models for Sequential Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/collm_integrati.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 两阶段将 LLM 改造为融合协同信号与语义的物品嵌入模型，Full-Ranking 下域内平均提升约 15%、跨域仍稳定增益。

venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/collm_integrati.title: Can LLMs Outshine Conventional Recommenders? A Comparative Evaluation
venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/collm_integrati.description: [NeurIPS 2025 DB Track][大语言模型推荐] RecBench 系统对比 17 个 LLM 与 DLRM 在 4 种物品表征、CTR/SeqRec 双任务上的精度-效率权衡，LLM 精度领先但推理慢千倍。

venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/collm_integrati.title: Generative Large Recommendation Models: Emerging Trends in LLMs for Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/collm_integrati.description: [WWW 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 系统梳理生成式大推荐模型范式：数据质量、缩放律、用户行为挖掘与训练推理效率四大议题及未来方向。

venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/enhancing_colla.title: RecLM: Recommendation Instruction Tuning
venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/enhancing_colla.description: [ACL 2025][大语言模型推荐] 以两轮协同指令微调+RL画像精炼为LLM注入协同信号，作为即插即用画像增强器在零样本冷启动下带来最高 200%+ 的 Recall 提升。

venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/enhancing_colla.title: CORONA: A Coarse-to-Fine Framework for Graph-based Recommendation with Large Language Models
venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/enhancing_colla.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 LLM 做偏好/意图推理在交互图上逐级缩小候选子图，再由 GNN 精排，全库排序下 Recall 平均相对提升 18.6%。

venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/enhancing_colla.title: G-Refer: Graph Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Model for Explainable Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/enhancing_colla.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 用路径级+节点级混合图检索把协同过滤信号显式翻译为文本，经知识剪枝与 RAFT 微调驱动 LLM 生成可解释推荐，BERT-F1 最高提升 2.81%。

venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/enhancing_colla.title: An Automatic Graph Construction Framework based on Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/enhancing_colla.description: [KDD 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 用 LLM 逐点生成语义向量 + 残差量化抽取隐因子作额外节点，O(N) 构图并设计元路径聚合，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@10 最高提升 43.57%，华为广告 A/B 提升 RPM 2.69%。

venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/enhancing_colla.title: Language Representations Can be What Recommenders Need: Findings and Potentials
venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/enhancing_colla.description: [ICLR 2025 (Oral)][LLM4Rec] 揭示语言空间与推荐行为空间同构，提出纯语言表征的 AlphaRec，在 Amazon 三数据集 Full-Ranking 上超越 ID-based CF 6.8%–9.8%。

venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/exact_and_effic.title: Do LLMs Memorize Recommendation Datasets? A Preliminary Study on MovieLens-1M
venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/exact_and_effic.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用少样本提示探测 GPT/Llama 对 MovieLens-1M 的物品、用户与交互记忆覆盖率，揭示记忆量与推荐性能强相关且放大流行度偏置。

venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/exact_and_effic.title: Customized Retrieval-Augmented Generation with LLM for Debiasing Recommendation Unlearning
venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/exact_and_effic.description: [ICDM 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 将推荐遗忘重构为 RAG 检索端过滤问题，用三种检索策略实现用户级原子遗忘，平均加速 4.5× 且保留约 90% 原模型效用。

venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/exact_and_effic.title: Obliviate: Efficient Unlearning in Recommender Systems
venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/exact_and_effic.description: [ICML 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 两阶段低秩适配器+局部校准的推荐系统机器遗忘框架，20%删除率下兼顾遗忘完整性与效用，比全量重训快约 3 倍。

venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/exact_and_effic.title: RALLRec: Improving Retrieval Augmented Large Language Model Recommendation with Representation Learning
venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/exact_and_effic.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 用 LLM 生成物品详述并做文本-协同表征对比对齐，配合时间感知重排器提升 RAG 式 LLM 推荐的检索质量。

venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/exact_and_effic.title: ERASE -- A Real-World Aligned Benchmark for Unlearning in Recommender Systems
venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/exact_and_effic.description: [SIGIR 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 面向真实场景的推荐系统机器遗忘基准，覆盖 CF/SBR/NBR 三任务、七种遗忘算法、九数据集九模型，揭示近似遗忘的鲁棒性与效率短板。

venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/preference_cons.title: Exploring Feature-based Knowledge Distillation for Recommender System: A Frequency Perspective
venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/preference_cons.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 从频域视角揭示特征蒸馏等权缺陷，提出轻量图滤波重加权 FreqD，全库排序下 Recall@20 最高提升 18.2%。

venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/preference_cons.title: D2K: Turning Historical Data into Retrievable Knowledge for Recommender Systems
venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/preference_cons.description: [WWW 2025][大语言模型推荐] 将历史日志转为用户-物品-上下文三元知识库，Transformer 编码 + 个性化适配注入任意 CTR 模型，AUC 相对提升 1.35%–2.90%。

venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/preference_cons.title: Can Recommender Systems Teach Themselves? A Recursive Self-Improving Framework with Fidelity Control
venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/preference_cons.description: [ICML 2026][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 提出 RSIR 递归自我改进框架，用模型自生成序列+保真度质量控制稠密化稀疏交互，理论证明其等价于流形切向隐式正则，多骨干多数据集 Full-Ranking 下 NDCG/Recall 稳定提升 3%–14%。

venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/preference_cons.title: Active Large Language Model-based Knowledge Distillation for Session-based Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/preference_cons.description: [AAAI 2025][LLM4Rec] 用 max-min 主动学习从全量会话中挑出少量高增益实例喂给 GPT-4 教师蒸馏，500 条样本即超越全量 KD 与 10 倍参数教师。

venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/preference_cons.title: Pre-train and Fine-tune: Recommenders as Large Models
venues/TKDE/2025/llm_rec/preference_cons.description: [WWW 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 以信息瓶颈理论解释推荐模型微调，提出即插即用的信息感知自适应核 IAK，冻结十亿参数预训练推荐大模型，仅用一周域内数据微调即获 CTR-AUC 平均 +0.26%~+1.28% 与线上 GMV +0.74%。

venues/TKDE/2025/multimodal_rec/efficien.title: NoteLLM-2: Multimodal Large Representation Models for Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/multimodal_rec/efficien.description: [KDD 2025][多模态推荐] 端到端微调 LLM+视觉编码器构建高效 MLRM，用 mICL 与门控后期融合缓解视觉忽视，I2I 全库召回 R@100 显著提升并落地线上 A/B。

venues/TKDE/2025/multimodal_rec/efficien.title: Multimodal Large Language Models with Adaptive Preference Optimization for Sequential Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/multimodal_rec/efficien.description: [SIGIR 2026][LLM4Rec] 面向 MLLM 序列推荐，用难度感知重加权 DPO + 高斯噪声正则分布优化，缓解样本难度失衡与跨模态语义偏差，三数据集 NDCG@3 提升 7.4%–11.0%。

venues/TKDE/2025/multimodal_rec/efficien.title: Personalized Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Foundation Models for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/multimodal_rec/efficien.description: [WWW 2026][多模态推荐] 按兴趣分群并为每群挂载独立 PEFT 模块，使 CLIP 编码出用户条件化的物品表征，配合群内难负采样，NDCG@20 最高提升 15.3%。

venues/TKDE/2025/multimodal_rec/efficien.title: GALA: Generative Aligned Learning for Adaptive Multimodal Representation in the Taobao Shangou Recommender System
venues/TKDE/2025/multimodal_rec/efficien.description: [ICDE 2026][多模态推荐] 三阶段流水线：行为三元组预训练 + GRPO 生成式行为对齐 + 自适应门控融合，离线 AUC +0.12/+0.20，线上订单量 +0.55%。

venues/TKDE/2025/multimodal_rec/efficien.title: Structural and Disentangled Adaptation of Large Vision Language Models for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/multimodal_rec/efficien.description: [SIGIR 2026][多模态推荐] 用模态内结构软教师对齐 LVLM 跨模态表征，并以专家化门控 LoRA 解耦梯度流，即插即用提升多模态与序列推荐，长尾增益最高 18.70%。

venues/TKDE/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/.title: Personalized Recommendation Models in Federated Settings: A Survey
venues/TKDE/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/.description: [TKDE 2025][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 首篇以“个性化模型”为核心的 FedRecSys 综述，给出双层优化定义并系统梳理四类挑战与解法。

venues/TKDE/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/.title: Privacy Risks of LLM-Empowered Recommender Systems: An Inversion Attack Perspective
venues/TKDE/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/.description: [RecSys 2025][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 首次系统研究 LLM 推荐系统的 logits 反演攻击，提出相似度引导精炼，可恢复 65% 交互物品与 87% 年龄性别。

venues/TKDE/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/.title: A Federated Framework for LLM-based Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/.description: [NAACL 2025 Findings][去偏公平与工业架构] FELLRec 用动态聚合+课程升温平衡客户端性能，并以分层卸载降低 LLM 联邦推荐端侧开销。

venues/TKDE/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/.title: A Survey of Personalized Federated Foundation Models for Privacy-Preserving Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/.description: [IJCAI-ECAI 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 综述提出“主动语义保人格”范式，用几何正交约束与语义感知聚合解耦全局知识与用户人格，并给出五类开放问题与未来路线。

venues/TKDE/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/.title: RecPS: Privacy Risk Scoring for Recommender Systems
venues/TKDE/2025/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/.description: [RecSys 2025][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 基于差分隐私推导交互级隐私分数，用 RecLiRA 成员推断攻击估计 TPR/FPR，指导细粒度交互移除以兼顾隐私与效用。

venues/TKDE/2025/sequential_rec/explaina.title: Think before Recommendation: Autonomous Reasoning-enhanced Recommender
venues/TKDE/2025/sequential_rec/explaina.description: [NeurIPS 2025][LLM4Rec] 用纯 GRPO 强化学习替代教师蒸馏，让单个 LLM 自主习得「用户分析→物品分析→匹配→打分」推理链，评分预测 MAE 最高降 29.9%。

venues/TKDE/2025/sequential_rec/explaina.title: RecRec: Latent Interests Recursive Reasoning for Sequential Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/sequential_rec/explaina.description: [RecSys 2026][序列与会话推荐] 解耦推理态与预测态、以 R 个潜在兴趣做递归推理的免 RL 序列推荐框架，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@10 最高提升 14.8%。

venues/TKDE/2025/sequential_rec/explaina.title: ReRec: Reasoning-Augmented LLM-based Recommendation Assistant via Reinforcement Fine-tuning
venues/TKDE/2025/sequential_rec/explaina.description: [ACL 2026][大语言模型推荐] 用双图奖励塑形、推理感知优势估计与在线课程调度改造 RFT，使 3B LLM 在复杂查询推荐上大幅超越 GRPO 系基线并保留通用能力。

venues/TKDE/2025/sequential_rec/explaina.title: ProRL: Effective Reinforcement Learning for Proactive Recommendation via Rectified Policy Gradient Estimation
venues/TKDE/2025/sequential_rec/explaina.description: [ICML 2026][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 揭示主动推荐中策略梯度的长度捷径与高方差缺陷，提出逐步奖励中心化与位置特定优势估计，三数据集全面超越 SOTA。

venues/TKDE/2025/sequential_rec/explaina.title: R$^2$ec: Towards Large Recommender Models with Reasoning
venues/TKDE/2025/sequential_rec/explaina.description: [NeurIPS 2025][LLM4Rec] 双头架构统一推理生成与物品打分，RecPO 融合奖励 RL 联合优化，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@10 最高提升 72%。

venues/TKDE/2025/sequential_rec/improvin.title: Temporal Linear Item-Item Model for Sequential Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/sequential_rec/improvin.description: [WSDM 2025][序列与会话推荐] 在闭式解线性 item-item 模型上引入时间间隔加权与趋势感知归一化，Full-Ranking 下平均 NDCG@10 提升 9.07%，训练快 6.9–57 倍。

venues/TKDE/2025/sequential_rec/improvin.title: RoTE: Coarse-to-Fine Multi-Level Rotary Time Embedding for Sequential Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/sequential_rec/improvin.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 将时间戳分解为年/月/日多粒度并借 RoPE 旋转注入 Q/K，即插即用提升 SASRec/RPG，NDCG@5 最高 +20.11%

venues/TKDE/2025/sequential_rec/improvin.title: Rethinking Convolutional Networks for Attribute-Aware Sequential Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/sequential_rec/improvin.description: [IJCAI 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用金字塔式降尺度卷积替代自注意力聚合属性感知序列，线性复杂度下在四个 Amazon 数据集上 HR@10 最高提升 4.08%。

venues/TKDE/2025/sequential_rec/improvin.title: Tail-Aware Data Augmentation for Long-Tail Sequential Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/sequential_rec/improvin.description: [WWW 2026][冷启动与长尾推荐] 用线性物品相似度构建候选集，设计 T-Substitute/T-Insert 两个尾部感知算子并在表征层 Mixup，实现头部与尾部双赢的长尾序列推荐数据增强。

venues/TKDE/2025/sequential_rec/improvin.title: Lost in Sequence: Do Large Language Models Understand Sequential Recommendation?
venues/TKDE/2025/sequential_rec/improvin.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 揭示现有 LLM4Rec 模型无法捕捉交互序列顺序信息，提出冻结 LLM 与 CF-SRec、仅训练轻量 MLP 的蒸馏框架 LLM-SRec，在 Amazon 四数据集上 NDCG@10 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/TKDE/2025/sequential_rec/pattern_.title: CSRec: Rethinking Sequential Recommendation from A Causal Perspective
venues/TKDE/2025/sequential_rec/pattern_.description: [SIGIR 2025][序列与会话推荐] 将序列推荐重构为因果干预下的决策接受概率建模，用递归约束隔离系统影响，AHR@0.2 提升约 1.5–3 倍。

venues/TKDE/2025/sequential_rec/pattern_.title: DELRec: Distilling Sequential Pattern to Enhance LLMs-based Sequential Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/sequential_rec/pattern_.description: [ICDE 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用软提示两阶段蒸馏传统序列模型的时间感知与推荐模式，再微调 LLM 做序列推荐，四数据集 HR/NDCG 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/TKDE/2025/sequential_rec/pattern_.title: TruthSR: Trustworthy Sequential Recommender Systems via User-generated Multimodal Content
venues/TKDE/2025/sequential_rec/pattern_.description: [DASFAA 2025][多模态推荐] 用评论-图片跨模态一致性降噪 + 主观逻辑证据融合做可信序列推荐，四数据集 Full-Ranking 全面超越 MMSRec。

venues/TKDE/2025/sequential_rec/pattern_.title: Improving Sequential Recommenders through Counterfactual Augmentation of System Exposure
venues/TKDE/2025/sequential_rec/pattern_.description: [SIGIR 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用 Decision Transformer 建模全量曝光序列，并以随机/自改进反事实增广+用户模拟器挖掘未曝光兴趣，KuaiRand 上 Recall@20 相对提升约 87%。

venues/TKDE/2025/sequential_rec/pattern_.title: Accurate and Diverse Recommendations via Propensity-Weighted Linear Autoencoders
venues/TKDE/2025/sequential_rec/pattern_.description: [SIGIR-AP 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 用对数 Sigmoid 重定义 IPS 倾向分，避免幂律对热门物品过度惩罚，在 EASE 类线性自编码器上以闭式解实现覆盖率大幅提升且精度不降。

venues/TKDE/2025/social_group_rec/score_.title: Preference Diffusion for Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/social_group_rec/score_.description: [ICLR 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 将 BPR 改写为对数似然排序目标并推导变分上界，为扩散推荐器注入多负样本偏好信号，Full-Ranking 下 R@5 最高提升 19.35%。

venues/TKDE/2025/social_group_rec/score_.title: Community-Aware Social Community Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/social_group_rec/score_.description: [CIKM 2025][社交与群组推荐] 提出 CASO，用模块度最大化、社交紧密度聚合与协同编码三路解耦用户表征，并以 HSIC 互斥与 KL 社区检测损失优化，在 6 个真实社交网络上 Full-Ranking 全面超越 9 个基线。

venues/TKDE/2025/social_group_rec/score_.title: PULSE: Socially-Aware User Representation Modeling Toward Parameter-Efficient Graph Collaborative Filtering
venues/TKDE/2025/social_group_rec/score_.description: [WWW 2026][社交与群组推荐] 用社区结构与社交邻居物品信号替代显式用户嵌入，参数降 50% 且 NDCG@20 提升 8-9%

venues/TKDE/2025/social_group_rec/score_.title: Personalized Diffusion Model Reshapes Cold-Start Bundle Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2025/social_group_rec/score_.description: [WWW 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 用个性化条件扩散在分布空间生成捆绑包，配合解耦自注意力与KL正则，冷启动捆绑推荐全库排序Recall@20最高提升1155%。

venues/TKDE/2025/social_group_rec/score_.title: Asymmetric Diffusion Recommendation Model
venues/TKDE/2025/social_group_rec/score_.description: [CIKM 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用特征丢弃替代高斯噪声做离散前向、在隐空间做非对称反向去噪，抖音音乐全量A/B活跃天数+0.131%。

venues/TKDE/2026/collaborative_filtering.title: Graph Spectral Filtering with Chebyshev Interpolation for Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2026/collaborative_filtering.description: [SIGIR 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用切比雪夫插值逼近非线性图滤波器，直接以原始交互为信号，突破 LightGCN 的截断线性低通瓶颈，Full-Ranking 下全面 SOTA 且推理快 8.1 倍。

venues/TKDE/2026/collaborative_filtering.title: Criteria-Aware Graph Filtering: Extremely Fast Yet Accurate Multi-Criteria Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2026/collaborative_filtering.description: [WWW 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 免训练免矩阵分解的多准则图滤波推荐，按准则定制多项式低通滤波器并融合用户准则偏好，BA 数据集 0.2 秒推理、NDCG@5 最高提升 24%。

venues/TKDE/2026/collaborative_filtering.title: Leveraging Member-Group Relations via Multi-View Graph Filtering for Effective Group Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2026/collaborative_filtering.description: [WWW 2025][社交与群组推荐] 提出免训练多视图图滤波 Group-GF，用三张物品相似图与多项式滤波器聚合成员-群组关系，HR@10 最高提升 16.4% 且运行时间仅 1.55s。

venues/TKDE/2026/collaborative_filtering.title: Beyond Instance-Level Alignment and Uniformity: Semantic Factor Learning for Collaborative Filtering
venues/TKDE/2026/collaborative_filtering.description: [KDD 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用批次内语义因子路由+匹配构造语义潜在正对，替代GCN邻域聚合，在四个稀疏数据集全库排序下NDCG@20最高提升6.24%。

venues/TKDE/2026/collaborative_filtering.title: PULSE: Socially-Aware User Representation Modeling Toward Parameter-Efficient Graph Collaborative Filtering
venues/TKDE/2026/collaborative_filtering.description: [WWW 2026][社交与群组推荐] 用社区结构与社交邻居物品信号替代显式用户嵌入，参数降 50% 且 NDCG@20 提升 8-9%

venues/TKDE/2026/llm_rec/reason4rec_deli.title: ThinkRec: Thinking-based Recommendation via LLM
venues/TKDE/2026/llm_rec/reason4rec_deli.description: [WWW 2026][大语言模型推荐] 以合成推理链激活 LLM 的 System 2 思维，并用实例级 LoRA 专家融合适配异构用户，AUC 平均提升 7.96%。

venues/TKDE/2026/llm_rec/reason4rec_deli.title: Review-driven Personalized Preference Reasoning with Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2026/llm_rec/reason4rec_deli.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用评论抽取偏好画像并蒸馏逐步推理，评分预测与重排双任务均超 CF 与 LLM 基线，解释性显著提升

venues/TKDE/2026/llm_rec/reason4rec_deli.title: MGFRec: Towards Reinforced Reasoning Recommendation with Multiple Groundings and Feedback
venues/TKDE/2026/llm_rec/reason4rec_deli.description: [KDD 2026][大语言模型推荐] 将单步 grounding 扩展为多轮物品空间接地并引入用户 Agent 反馈，用 GRPO 训练 LLM 推理推荐，Full-Ranking 下 H@5 最高提升约 8.8%。

venues/TKDE/2026/llm_rec/reason4rec_deli.title: HARPO: Hierarchical Agentic Reasoning for User-Aligned Conversational Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2026/llm_rec/reason4rec_deli.description: [ACL 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 将对话推荐重构为多维质量驱动的结构化决策，用分层偏好奖励引导树搜索推理，ReDial R@10 达 29.8%（+18.7%）。

venues/TKDE/2026/llm_rec/reason4rec_deli.title: R4ec: A Reasoning, Reflection, and Refinement Framework for Recommendation Systems
venues/TKDE/2026/llm_rec/reason4rec_deli.description: [RecSys 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用 actor/reflection 双小模型迭代反思精炼 LLM 知识，注入 CTR 主干，AUC 相对提升 2.5%+，线上收入 +2.2%。

venues/TKDE/2026/multimodal_rec/tackling.title: Spectrum-based Modality Representation Fusion Graph Convolutional Network for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2026/multimodal_rec/tackling.description: [WSDM 2025][多模态推荐] 将多模态特征投影至频域做滤波去噪与点积融合，配合模态专属/融合双图学习与模态感知偏好模块，在 Amazon 三数据集全库排序下 Recall@20 相对最优基线提升约 5%。

venues/TKDE/2026/multimodal_rec/tackling.title: Disentangling and Generating Modalities for Recommendation in Missing Modality Scenarios
venues/TKDE/2026/multimodal_rec/tackling.description: [SIGIR 2025][多模态推荐] 将模态特征解耦为通用/特有分量并用互信息损失分离，再以跨模态对齐特征与用户模态偏好生成缺失模态，缺失场景全库排序 R@20 相对提升 4.7%–8.2%。

venues/TKDE/2026/multimodal_rec/tackling.title: I$^3$-MRec: Invariant Learning with Information Bottleneck for Incomplete Modality Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2026/multimodal_rec/tackling.description: [ACM MM 2025][多模态推荐] 将各模态视为独立语义环境做 IRM 不变学习，并用 IB 压缩模态特有信息，在模态缺失场景下 Full-Ranking Recall@20 稳定提升 2%–4%。

venues/TKDE/2026/multimodal_rec/tackling.title: PRISM: Personalized Recommendation via Information Synergy Module
venues/TKDE/2026/multimodal_rec/tackling.description: [WWW 2026][多模态推荐] 用 MoE 显式分解模态唯一/冗余/协同信息并以用户偏好动态重加权，即插即用提升三类序列骨干，Yelp N@10 超最强基线 10.91%。

venues/TKDE/2026/multimodal_rec/tackling.title: Harnessing Multimodal Large Language Models for Multimodal Sequential Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2026/multimodal_rec/tackling.description: [AAAI 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 MLLM 将商品图转为文本摘要，再以循环式提示推断动态用户偏好，SFT 微调 LLaVA 做多模态序列推荐，AUC 最高提升约 4.3%。

venues/TKDE/2026/multimodal_rec/training.title: Robust Multimodal Recommendation via Graph Retrieval-Enhanced Modality Completion
venues/TKDE/2026/multimodal_rec/training.description: [SIGIR 2026][多模态推荐] 用模态感知子图检索替代 K 跳邻居聚合，配合图 Transformer 与稀疏路由码本补全缺失模态，40% 缺失率下 Recall@20 相对提升 4.2%–5.1%。

venues/TKDE/2026/multimodal_rec/training.title: STAIR: Manipulating Collaborative and Multimodal Information for E-Commerce Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2026/multimodal_rec/training.description: [AAAI 2025][多模态推荐] 揭示电商场景模态信息弱于协同信号，提出逐步图卷积沿维度分配层权重实现协同-模态共存，并以反向逐步卷积约束更新缓解模态遗忘，三数据集全排序提升2-6%且开销近LightGCN。

venues/TKDE/2026/multimodal_rec/training.title: Generating with Fairness: A Modality-Diffused Counterfactual Framework for Incomplete Multimodal Recommendations
venues/TKDE/2026/multimodal_rec/training.description: [WWW 2025][多模态推荐] 用模态感知扩散补全缺失模态，并以反事实推断剥离可见性偏差，在三个数据集上同时提升准确率与公平性。

venues/TKDE/2026/multimodal_rec/training.title: I$^3$-MRec: Invariant Learning with Information Bottleneck for Incomplete Modality Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2026/multimodal_rec/training.description: [ACM MM 2025][多模态推荐] 将各模态视为独立语义环境做 IRM 不变学习，并用 IB 压缩模态特有信息，在模态缺失场景下 Full-Ranking Recall@20 稳定提升 2%–4%。

venues/TKDE/2026/multimodal_rec/training.title: MLLMRec: A Preference Reasoning Paradigm with Graph Refinement for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2026/multimodal_rec/training.description: [SIGIR 2026][多模态推荐] 用 MLLM 推理用户偏好画像替代噪声聚合初始化，并以阈值去噪+共现增强精修物品图，三数据集 11/12 指标 SOTA。

venues/TKDE/2026/sequential_rec/an_adapt.title: A Contextual-Aware Position Encoding for Sequential Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2026/sequential_rec/an_adapt.description: [WWW 2025][序列与会话推荐] 首个为序列推荐定制的上下文感知位置编码 CAPE：用目标-上下文不相似度累加动态分配位置，配合门控融合异构特征，在 5 个骨干与工业 A/B 上稳定涨点。

venues/TKDE/2026/sequential_rec/an_adapt.title: CPMR: Context-Aware Incremental Sequential Recommendation with Pseudo-Multi-Task Learning
venues/TKDE/2026/sequential_rec/an_adapt.description: [CIKM 2023][序列与会话推荐] 提出伪多任务学习范式，用历史图与上下文图双通道演化用户/物品时序状态，在四个数据集上 MRR 平均提升 30.98%。

venues/TKDE/2026/sequential_rec/an_adapt.title: Efficient Sequential Recommendation for Long Term User Interest Via Personalization
venues/TKDE/2026/sequential_rec/an_adapt.description: [ICDM 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用可学习 token 将长历史分段压缩为个性化专家，配合定制注意力掩码与 KV 缓存，在 HSTU/HLLM 上以约 1/4 推理开销逼近全序列精度。

venues/TKDE/2026/sequential_rec/an_adapt.title: A Situation-aware Enhancer for Personalized Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2026/sequential_rec/an_adapt.description: [DASFAA 2024][协同过滤与双塔召回] 将情境视为交互前置条件，用可插拔双塔增强器 SARE 建模个性化情境感知与偏好影响，在 MIND/KuaiRand 上显著超越骨干与 SOTA。

venues/TKDE/2026/sequential_rec/an_adapt.title: RoTE: Coarse-to-Fine Multi-Level Rotary Time Embedding for Sequential Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2026/sequential_rec/an_adapt.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 将时间戳分解为年/月/日多粒度并借 RoPE 旋转注入 Q/K，即插即用提升 SASRec/RPG，NDCG@5 最高 +20.11%

venues/TKDE/2026/sequential_rec/mida_mul.title: Multi-Grained Patch Training for Efficient LLM-based Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2026/sequential_rec/mida_mul.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用层次化 item/session patch 压缩长交互历史，两阶段训练让 LLM 理解压缩表征，同 token 预算下 HR@20 最高提升 72%。

venues/TKDE/2026/sequential_rec/mida_mul.title: Rethinking Item Tokenization in Generative Recommenders: From Fixed Atoms to Semantic Subwords
venues/TKDE/2026/sequential_rec/mida_mul.description: [CIKM 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 指出固定长度SID复用于历史侧引发“物品内注意力过载”，提出历史侧语义子词重分词(IST)+行为共现增强(BCA)的非对称分词，三数据集三骨干全库排序NDCG@10最高+13.8%。

venues/TKDE/2026/sequential_rec/mida_mul.title: Collaborative Memory Augmentation for Generative Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2026/sequential_rec/mida_mul.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐] 为生成式推荐引入跨用户协同记忆库，用可学习查询token压缩序列、目标感知检索与门控交叉注意力融合，Full-Ranking下NDCG@5最高提升23.7%。

venues/TKDE/2026/sequential_rec/mida_mul.title: LLM2Rec: Large Language Models Are Powerful Embedding Models for Sequential Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2026/sequential_rec/mida_mul.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 两阶段将 LLM 改造为融合协同信号与语义的物品嵌入模型，Full-Ranking 下域内平均提升约 15%、跨域仍稳定增益。

venues/TKDE/2026/sequential_rec/mida_mul.title: L2Rec: Towards Dual-View Understanding of LLMs for Personalized Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2026/sequential_rec/mida_mul.description: [SIGIR 2026][大语言模型推荐] 以参数级双视图 LoRA-MoE 替代输入/输出级融合，个性化路由对齐行为与语义视图，四数据集 N@10 提升 3.87%–8.02%，线上 CTR +9.24%。

venues/TKDE/2026/social_group_rec/quanti.title: Collaborative Filtering Meets Spectrum Shift: Connecting User-Item Interaction with Graph-Structured Side Information
venues/TKDE/2026/social_group_rec/quanti.description: [KDD 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 揭示增广图频谱右移现象，提出仅含平移/缩放两因子的 SSC 校正，即插即用提升 LightGCN/JGCF 最高 23%，零额外开销。

venues/TKDE/2026/social_group_rec/quanti.title: Community-Aware Social Community Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2026/social_group_rec/quanti.description: [CIKM 2025][社交与群组推荐] 提出 CASO，用模块度最大化、社交紧密度聚合与协同编码三路解耦用户表征，并以 HSIC 互斥与 KL 社区检测损失优化，在 6 个真实社交网络上 Full-Ranking 全面超越 9 个基线。

venues/TKDE/2026/social_group_rec/quanti.title: Squeeze and Excitation: A Weighted Graph Contrastive Learning for Collaborative Filtering
venues/TKDE/2026/social_group_rec/quanti.description: [SIGIR 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 仅扰动末层GCN视图并用SENet动态加权特征，在三个数据集上实现最高24.45%的NDCG@20提升。

venues/TKDE/2026/social_group_rec/quanti.title: Invariance Matters: Empowering Social Recommendation via Graph Invariant Learning
venues/TKDE/2026/social_group_rec/quanti.description: [SIGIR 2025][社交与群组推荐] 用图不变学习替代社交图硬过滤：多环境生成器+不变风险最小化+对抗环境探索，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@20 较 GBSR 提升 5.4%–8.7%。

venues/TKDE/2026/social_group_rec/quanti.title: RaDAR: Relation-aware Diffusion-Asymmetric Graph Contrastive Learning for Recommendation
venues/TKDE/2026/social_group_rec/quanti.description: [WWW 2026][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 以 VGAE 生成视图与关系感知去噪视图构成双视图，叠加扩散引导增广与非对称对比目标，在 Full-Ranking 下 Recall@20 相对 SOTA 提升 3.8%–4.7%。

venues/TMM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scena.title: FeDecider: An LLM-Based Framework for Federated Cross-Domain Recommendation
venues/TMM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scena.description: [WWW 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 联邦跨域 LLM 推荐中，服务器只广播 LoRA 更新的方向分量以消除尺度噪声，客户端用可学习个性化权重做数据感知融合，Goodreads 平均 Hit@5 提升 3.8%。

venues/TMM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scena.title: Personalized Recommendation Models in Federated Settings: A Survey
venues/TMM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scena.description: [TKDE 2025][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 首篇以“个性化模型”为核心的 FedRecSys 综述，给出双层优化定义并系统梳理四类挑战与解法。

venues/TMM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scena.title: Learning Evolving Preferences: A Federated Continual Framework for User-Centric Recommendation
venues/TMM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scena.description: [WWW 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 联邦持续推荐框架 FCUCR：时间感知自蒸馏抗遗忘 + 跨用户原型迁移促协同，四数据集全库排序 HR@10 最高提升 44.0%。

venues/TMM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scena.title: Federated Continual Recommendation
venues/TMM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scena.description: [CIKM 2025][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 提出 FCRec 新任务与 F3CRec 框架，客户端自适应回放+服务端物品级时序均值，在四个数据集三个 FedRec 骨干上 N@20 平均提升 5.6%–32.1%。

venues/TMM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scena.title: Personalized Federated Collaborative Filtering: A Variational AutoEncoder Approach
venues/TMM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scena.description: [AAAI 2025][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 将 FedCF 重构为 VAE 任务，用门控双编码器分离共享/个性化知识，HR@20 较 FedRAP 提升约 97%。

venues/TMM/2025/multimodal_rec/knowledge.title: Sparse Contrastive Learning for Content-Based Cold Item Recommendation
venues/TMM/2025/multimodal_rec/knowledge.description: [SIGIR 2026][冷启动与长尾推荐] 抛弃 CF 对齐、纯内容空间 item-item 相似度建模，用 α-entmax 稀疏化 sampled softmax 并支持内容空间蒸馏，冷物品排序与曝光公平性双赢。

venues/TMM/2025/multimodal_rec/knowledge.title: Learning Sparse Representations of Multimodal Content for Enhanced Cold Item Recommendation
venues/TMM/2025/multimodal_rec/knowledge.description: [RecSys 2026][冷启动与长尾推荐] 将多模态内容冷启动表征改为 top-K 稀疏嵌入，并用 α-entmax 预稀疏激活诱导锐化与去噪，冷启动 NDCG@20 提升 16.6%–75.5% 且存储更低。

venues/TMM/2025/multimodal_rec/knowledge.title: Contrastive Representation for Interactive Recommendation
venues/TMM/2025/multimodal_rec/knowledge.description: [AAAI 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用偏好排序对比学习(PRCL)为 DRL 交互推荐提炼状态表征，冷启动下样本效率显著提升。

venues/TMM/2025/multimodal_rec/knowledge.title: NLGCL: Naturally Existing Neighbor Layers Graph Contrastive Learning for Recommendation
venues/TMM/2025/multimodal_rec/knowledge.description: [RecSys 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 用 GNN 相邻层天然异构节点作正样本对替代图增广，免视图构建，全库排序下 NDCG@10 最高提升 12.41% 且训练最快。

venues/TMM/2025/multimodal_rec/knowledge.title: A Content-Driven Micro-Video Recommendation Dataset at Scale
venues/TMM/2025/multimodal_rec/knowledge.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 发布十亿级含原始视频模态的微视频推荐数据集 MicroLens，并系统基准 IDRec/VIDRec/VideoRec 三类范式，揭示端到端视频编码优于冻结特征的关键结论。

venues/TMM/2026/multimodal_rec/cross_mod.title: Lightweight Embeddings with Graph Rewiring for Collaborative Filtering
venues/TMM/2026/multimodal_rec/cross_mod.description: [TOIS 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 量化组合码本+图重连剪枝，在严格存储预算下兼顾 GNN 推荐精度与边缘端推理效率，iFashion 存储降 97.7%。

venues/TMM/2026/multimodal_rec/cross_mod.title: Formalizing Multimedia Recommendation through Multimodal Deep Learning
venues/TMM/2026/multimodal_rec/cross_mod.description: [TORS 2025][多模态推荐] 首次将多媒体推荐对齐多模态深度学习五步流水线，提出 Which/How/When 三问形式化 Schema，并在 Elliot 上统一复现 10 个模型、兼顾精度与超越精度指标。

venues/TMM/2026/multimodal_rec/cross_mod.title: Causality-Inspired Fair Representation Learning for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/TMM/2026/multimodal_rec/cross_mod.description: [TOIS 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 因果启发的模态解耦与公平/不公平关系挖掘，实现多模态推荐的反事实公平，公平性显著优于 SOTA 且精度可比。

venues/TMM/2026/multimodal_rec/cross_mod.title: Thoroughly Modeling Multi-domain Pre-trained Recommendation as Language
venues/TMM/2026/multimodal_rec/cross_mod.description: [TOIS 2025][LLM4Rec] 将多域序列推荐彻底转为文本生成任务，用五项指标指导行为-文本双向适配，7 数据集微调与零样本均最优，NDCG@1 最高提升 23%。

venues/TMM/2026/multimodal_rec/cross_mod.title: Learning Robust Sequential Recommenders through Confident Soft Labels
venues/TMM/2026/multimodal_rec/cross_mod.description: [TOIS 2025][序列推荐] 用模型级/数据级/训练级三种教师模块生成高置信软标签，与 one-hot 联合训练学生序列推荐器，全库排序下 Recall@10 最高提升约 11%。

venues/TOIS/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: A Survey on LLM-powered Agents for Recommender Systems
venues/TOIS/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [ACL 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 系统综述 LLM Agent 推荐的三范式（推荐/交互/仿真）与四模块架构，梳理数据集与评测协议并指出统一评测缺失。

venues/TOIS/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: Personalized Recommendation Tool Learning via Autonomous Language Agents
venues/TOIS/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [RecSys 2026][LLM4Rec] 让 LLM 智能体做个性化工具选择、传统推荐模型做全库打分，以架构设计绕开幻觉与上下文长度限制，Full-Ranking 下 R@10 最高提升 68.8%。

venues/TOIS/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: AgentRecBench: Benchmarking LLM Agent-based Personalized Recommender Systems
venues/TOIS/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [NeurIPS 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 首个 LLM 智能体推荐系统基准，构建 U-R-I 文本交互环境与三类场景，揭示结构化工作流智能体显著优于传统与朴素 Agent。

venues/TOIS/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: AgentDR: Dynamic Recommendation with Implicit Item-Item Relations via LLM-based Agents
venues/TOIS/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [WWW 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 将全库排序委托给传统推荐工具，用 LLM Agent 做个性化工具加权与替代/互补关系重排，全排序平均提升约两倍。

venues/TOIS/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: RecoWorld: Building Simulated Environments for Agentic Recommender Systems
venues/TOIS/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [WWW 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出双视角LLM仿真环境，用户模拟器在多轮交互中发出反思指令，驱动指令遵循推荐器优化留存，并给出三种历史建模方案与多智能体群体仿真蓝图。

venues/TOIS/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: A LLM-based Controllable, Scalable, Human-Involved User Simulator Framework for Conversational Recommender Systems
venues/TOIS/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [WWW 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 以插件管理器分阶段管控 LLM 用户模拟器，通过记忆隔离与偏好二分抑制数据泄漏，在 ReDial/OpenDialKG/MovieLens 上显著提升 CRS 评估可信度。

venues/TOIS/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: Temporal-Aware User Behaviour Simulation with Large Language Models for Recommender Systems
venues/TOIS/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [CIKM 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用动态画像更新、时序模式抽取与自适应聚合构建 LLM 用户模拟器，在 ML-1M 上 nDCG@5 相对 RecAgent 提升约 27.8%。

venues/TOIS/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: RecUserSim: A Realistic and Diverse User Simulator for Evaluating Conversational Recommender Systems
venues/TOIS/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [WWW 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出四模块 LLM Agent 用户模拟器，以有限理性三层 Rating-Action-Response 机制实现真实角色扮演、多样人群覆盖与显式打分，并落地华为 Celia 餐饮助手。

venues/TOIS/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: AgentSociety Challenge: Designing LLM Agents for User Modeling and Recommendation on Web Platforms
venues/TOIS/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [WWW 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 首个 WWW LLM Agent 双赛道竞赛：Yelp/Amazon/Goodreads 三源数据 + 交互式模拟器，295 队参赛，Track1/2 最终阶段提升 9.1%/15.9%，并验证模拟 groundtruth 与真实分布强相关。

venues/TOIS/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: Task-Aware Automated User Profile Generation for Recommendation Simulation Using Large Language Models
venues/TOIS/2025/agent_conversational_re.description: [SIGIR 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出免训练三阶段画像生成框架 APG4RecSim，用语义合并+反事实因果映射将交互历史转为任务对齐画像，在判别/排序/评分三任务上取得最佳综合表现。

venues/TOIS/2025/agent_conversational_re.title: Thoroughly Modeling Multi-domain Pre-trained Recommendation as Language
