venues/WSDM/2025/cold_start_rec/large_la.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用少样本提示探测 GPT/Llama 对 MovieLens-1M 的物品、用户与交互记忆覆盖率，揭示记忆量与推荐性能强相关且放大流行度偏置。

venues/WSDM/2025/collaborative_filtering.title: Graph Spectral Filtering with Chebyshev Interpolation for Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/collaborative_filtering.description: [SIGIR 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用切比雪夫插值逼近非线性图滤波器，直接以原始交互为信号，突破 LightGCN 的截断线性低通瓶颈，Full-Ranking 下全面 SOTA 且推理快 8.1 倍。

venues/WSDM/2025/collaborative_filtering.title: Continuous-time Discrete-space Diffusion Model for Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/collaborative_filtering.description: [WSDM 2026][生成式推荐] 将推荐历史交互建模为连续时间离散空间（吸收态掩码）扩散，配合流行度感知噪声调度、一致性参数化与多跳对比引导，在三个数据集 Full-Ranking 下 Recall@10 相对提升 4.2%–5.2%。

venues/WSDM/2025/collaborative_filtering.title: Collaborative Diffusion Model for Recommender System
venues/WSDM/2025/collaborative_filtering.description: [WWW 2025][生成式推荐] 将评论词转为伪用户，在扩散去噪过程中聚合真实/伪邻居偏好信息，缓解个性化信息流失，三数据集 R@20 全面领先。

venues/WSDM/2025/collaborative_filtering.title: On Efficiency-Effectiveness Trade-off of Diffusion-based Recommenders
venues/WSDM/2025/collaborative_filtering.description: [NeurIPS 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用时间一致性正则平滑去噪函数实现一步生成，再用自适应偏好对齐修正轨迹偏差，兼顾扩散推荐效率与效果。

venues/WSDM/2025/collaborative_filtering.title: S2CDR: Smoothing-Sharpening Process Model for Cross-Domain Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/collaborative_filtering.description: [WWW 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 用无噪声热方程平滑+锐化ODE替代扩散模型做跨域冷启动，免训练即在三场景六跨域对上 HR/NDCG 平均提升 7.07%/7.42%

venues/WSDM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Large Language Models Enhanced Hyperbolic Space Recommender Systems
venues/WSDM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] HyperLLM 用 LLM 生成层级标签与偏好摘要，经元优化两阶段训练将结构/语义层级信息注入双曲推荐，Recall@20 最高提升 41.7%。

venues/WSDM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Breaking Information Cocoons: A Hyperbolic Framework for Balancing Exploration and Exploitation in Recommender Systems
venues/WSDM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [KDD 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 洛伦兹双曲空间对齐 LLM 语义与协同信号，并用 Dasgupta 代价驱动的无超参层次聚类实现用户可调探索-利用权衡，效用最高 +5.49%、多样性 +11.39%。

venues/WSDM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: A Contrastive Framework with User, Item and Review Alignment for Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [WSDM 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 将评论从“特征”升级为“对比信号”，用评论增广+三方对齐双对比任务缓解稀疏与评论缺失，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@5 最高提升 7.7%。

venues/WSDM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Automated Prompting for Non-overlapping Cross-domain Sequential Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [TKDE 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用可学习连续 Prompt（域无关+域特定+冻结标签）替代域对齐约束，实现无重叠实体、仅隐式反馈的双目标跨域序列推荐，Movie-Book 上 HR@10 相对最优基线提升约 17.8%。

venues/WSDM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Leveraging Geometric Insights in Hyperbolic Triplet Loss for Improved Recommendations
venues/WSDM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [RecSys 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 洛伦兹双曲三元组损失 TriplH，以物品-物品项自适应间隔替代固定 margin，兼顾精度、去流行度偏差与 3 倍推理加速。

venues/WSDM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Automated Information Flow Selection for Multi-scenario Multi-task Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [WSDM 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 用 LoRA 解耦四类场景-任务信息单元并以可学习掩码剪枝无效信息流，AUC 全面超越 HiNet/M3oE，线上 CVR 均涨 2.46%。

venues/WSDM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Efficient Multi-task Prompt Tuning for Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [TOIS 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 提出两阶段 MPT-Rec：GAN 解耦任务共享/特有信息后冻结主干，仅用任务感知 Prompt 微调新任务，参数降至 10% 且性能保持 95%+。

venues/WSDM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Direct Routing Gradient (DRGrad): A Personalized Information Surgery for Multi-Task Learning (MTL) Recommendations
venues/WSDM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [AAAI 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用梯度余弦相似度做路由+Split-MMoE+PPNet个性化门控，在150亿样本工业数据上Click AUC提升0.0027且不增推理延迟。

venues/WSDM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: MPFormer: Adaptive Framework for Industrial Multi-Task Personalized Sequential Retriever
venues/WSDM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [CIKM 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用目标条件化 Transformer 统一多目标召回，并以排序分数监督动态配额分配，在快手 4 亿 DAU 上实现 +0.43% 总时长与 66.7% 推理资源节省。

venues/WSDM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Combinatorial Optimization Perspective based Framework for Multi-behavior Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [KDD 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 将多行为融合视为组合优化问题施加三阶段约束，并用分布拟合多专家网络抑制负迁移，三数据集 HR@10 最高提升 49.91%。

venues/WSDM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Curr-RLCER: Curriculum Reinforcement Learning For Coherence Explainable Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [DASFAA 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用三阶段课程强化学习（CTR→评分→解释生成）训练 LLM，并设计一致性奖励与评估方案，使解释与评分双向对齐。

venues/WSDM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Reason4Rec: Deliberative User Preference Alignment of Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [TKDE 2026][大语言模型推荐] 提出审慎推荐任务与三专家多步推理框架，用评论监督偏好蒸馏-匹配-预测，评分预测与排序全面领先。

venues/WSDM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Coherency Improved Explainable Recommendation via Large Language Model
venues/WSDM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [AAAI 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 LLaMA2 先预测评分再以软评分嵌入引导解释生成，配合课程学习与无标注一致性自动评测，解释一致性提升 7.3%。

venues/WSDM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: The Utility of LLMs in Recommender Systems Explanation Evaluation
venues/WSDM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [RecSys 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 系统评测 14 个 LLM 作为推荐解释评审员与 216 名人类评分的一致性，发现排序相关中等但绝对评分一致性低，并给出四条实用准则。

venues/WSDM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Bi-NAS: Towards Effective and Personalized Explanation for Recommender Systems via Bi-Level Neural Architecture Search
venues/WSDM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [ICDM 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用双层 NAS 自动搜索交叉注意力与特征交互算子，再以零样本 LLM 提示生成个性化解释，四数据集上推荐与解释指标双优。

venues/WSDM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: DLF: Enhancing Explicit-Implicit Interaction via Dynamic Low-Order-Aware Fusion for CTR Prediction
venues/WSDM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [SIGIR 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 以残差感知低阶交互网络与逐层注意力融合，动态平衡显隐式特征交叉，四数据集AUC全面SOTA。

venues/WSDM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Beyond Dense Connectivity: Explicit Sparsity for Scalable Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [SIGIR 2026][CTR预估与特征交叉] 揭示稠密MLP隐式权重稀疏现象，提出 filter-then-fuse 多视图显式稀疏框架 SSR，在十亿级工业数据与三个公开集上以更低算力超越 RankMixer。

venues/WSDM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: TayFCS: Towards Light Feature Combination Selection for Deep Recommender Systems
venues/WSDM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [KDD 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用泰勒展开+IME近似一次性梯度回传估计高阶组合重要性，再用LR滑窗剔除冗余，三数据集AUC显著提升且线上CVR+13.9%

venues/WSDM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Task-Blind No MORE: Multi-Task Information Flow in Unified Ranking Backbones
venues/WSDM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [CIKM 2026][多任务学习与列表级重排] 将多任务信息流下沉至统一排序主干，以共享/私有 Anchor Token 逐层共演化，离线七任务全胜、线上时长+3.0%、P99 延迟降约30%。

venues/WSDM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.title: Native Multimodal Representation Learning for Click-Through Rate Prediction in E-Commerce Scenarios
venues/WSDM/2025/ctr_feature_interaction.description: [CIKM 2026][多模态推荐] 揭示端到端联合训练在强预训练编码器上失效的根因（CTR 监督多模态不可解释+梯度不一致），提出 Mine-Then-Train 挖掘三元组微调编码器，线上 CTR +1.5%、RPM +0.5%。

venues/WSDM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: A Survey of Personalized Federated Foundation Models for Privacy-Preserving Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [IJCAI-ECAI 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 综述提出“主动语义保人格”范式，用几何正交约束与语义感知聚合解耦全局知识与用户人格，并给出五类开放问题与未来路线。

venues/WSDM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: A Federated Framework for LLM-based Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [NAACL 2025 Findings][去偏公平与工业架构] FELLRec 用动态聚合+课程升温平衡客户端性能，并以分层卸载降低 LLM 联邦推荐端侧开销。

venues/WSDM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Personalized Recommendation Models in Federated Settings: A Survey
venues/WSDM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [TKDE 2025][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 首篇以“个性化模型”为核心的 FedRecSys 综述，给出双层优化定义并系统梳理四类挑战与解法。

venues/WSDM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Rethinking Fairness in LLM-Based Recommender Systems: A Survey
venues/WSDM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [EMNLP 2026 Findings][去偏公平与可信推荐] 首个 LLM4Rec 公平性综述，提出「偏置机制×公平目标」二维分类法，系统梳理数据集、评估协议、缓解策略与可信交叉议题。

venues/WSDM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.title: Federated User Preference Modeling for Privacy-Preserving Cross-Domain Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/debias_fairness_industr.description: [TMM 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用评论+潜在正物品挖掘综合偏好，再以 LDP 原型经联邦聚合跨域迁移，四组 CDR 任务 HR@10 平均提升约 13%。

venues/WSDM/2025/graph_rec/an_aspect_per.title: GENET: Unleashing the Power of Side Information for Recommendation via Hypergraph Pre-training
venues/WSDM/2025/graph_rec/an_aspect_per.description: [DASFAA 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 将异构边信息统一构建为超图，通过超边预测与双层自监督对比预训练，再以 LightGCN/GRU 微调，Top-N 与序列推荐最高提升 38%，冷启动提升 175%+。

venues/WSDM/2025/graph_rec/an_aspect_per.title: ContextGNN: Beyond Two-Tower Recommendation Systems
venues/WSDM/2025/graph_rec/an_aspect_per.description: [ICLR 2025][图神经网络推荐] 提出局部成对表征+全局双塔回退的混合GNN架构，在RelBench十个任务上平均MAP较最强成对基线提升20%。

venues/WSDM/2025/graph_rec/an_aspect_per.title: HADSF: Aspect Aware Semantic Control for Explainable Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/graph_rec/an_aspect_per.description: [WSDM 2026][大语言模型推荐] 两阶段受控方面词表+动态个性化抽取，提出ADR/OFR幻觉度量，揭示幻觉-性能非单调关系，小模型可媲美大模型

venues/WSDM/2025/graph_rec/an_aspect_per.title: Disentangling Likes and Dislikes in Personalized Generative Explainable Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/graph_rec/an_aspect_per.description: [WWW 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用 LLM 重构正负观点分离的可解释推荐数据集，提出情感匹配与正负内容相似度指标，并证明将预测评分作为输入可显著提升情感感知解释生成。

venues/WSDM/2025/graph_rec/an_aspect_per.title: Dual-Channel Multiplex Graph Neural Networks for Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/graph_rec/an_aspect_per.description: [TKDE 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 双通道多路图网络显式建模行为模式、隐式挖掘关系链依赖，三数据集全指标平均提升 10%+

venues/WSDM/2025/graph_rec/lightgnn_simp.title: Graph-Sequential Alignment and Uniformity: Toward Enhanced Recommendation Systems
venues/WSDM/2025/graph_rec/lightgnn_simp.description: [WWW 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 以共享嵌入层联合训练 LightGCN 与 SASRec，用对齐-均匀性损失实现跨子模块知识迁移，Leave-One-Out 全库排序下 R@10 最高提升 13.4%。

venues/WSDM/2025/graph_rec/lightgnn_simp.title: LightKG: Efficient Knowledge-Aware Recommendations with Simplified GNN Architecture
venues/WSDM/2025/graph_rec/lightgnn_simp.description: [KDD 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 用标量对编码关系+线性聚合+免子图对比层，在稀疏场景超越12个KGRS基线5.8%并省84.3%训练时间

venues/WSDM/2025/graph_rec/lightgnn_simp.title: Pre-training for Recommendation Unlearning
venues/WSDM/2025/graph_rec/lightgnn_simp.description: [SIGIR 2025][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 提出预训练式影响编码器 UnlearnRec，将遗忘请求映射为嵌入漂移，免重训实现高效图推荐遗忘，10x 加速且保持精度。

venues/WSDM/2025/graph_rec/lightgnn_simp.title: PULSE: Socially-Aware User Representation Modeling Toward Parameter-Efficient Graph Collaborative Filtering
venues/WSDM/2025/graph_rec/lightgnn_simp.description: [WWW 2026][社交与群组推荐] 用社区结构与社交邻居物品信号替代显式用户嵌入，参数降 50% 且 NDCG@20 提升 8-9%

venues/WSDM/2025/graph_rec/lightgnn_simp.title: NLGCL: Naturally Existing Neighbor Layers Graph Contrastive Learning for Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/graph_rec/lightgnn_simp.description: [RecSys 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 用 GNN 相邻层天然异构节点作正样本对替代图增广，免视图构建，全库排序下 NDCG@10 最高提升 12.41% 且训练最快。

venues/WSDM/2025/graph_rec/mixrec_hetero.title: Hierarchical Graph Information Bottleneck for Multi-Behavior Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/graph_rec/mixrec_hetero.description: [RecSys 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用信息瓶颈原理重构多行为层次推荐，以 InfoNCE 保真、HSIC 压缩、可学习边丢弃去噪，全库排序下 HR@10 最高提升 15.08%。

venues/WSDM/2025/graph_rec/mixrec_hetero.title: Graph Cross-Correlated Network for Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/graph_rec/mixrec_hetero.description: [TKDE 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 用非递归 PGR 保留各跳邻居纯语义，再以 HCC/ECC 显式建模用户-物品子图交叉相关项，全库排序下 NDCG@20 平均提升约 1.8%–2.9%。

venues/WSDM/2025/graph_rec/mixrec_hetero.title: Intent-guided Heterogeneous Graph Contrastive Learning for Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/graph_rec/mixrec_hetero.description: [TKDE 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 用元路径意图构建双对比学习视图，并以信息瓶颈掩码自编码器去噪，六数据集全库排序 Recall@20 最高提升 12.4%。

venues/WSDM/2025/graph_rec/mixrec_hetero.title: Dual-Channel Multiplex Graph Neural Networks for Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/graph_rec/mixrec_hetero.description: [TKDE 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 双通道多路图网络显式建模行为模式、隐式挖掘关系链依赖，三数据集全指标平均提升 10%+

venues/WSDM/2025/graph_rec/mixrec_hetero.title: Latent Factor Modeling with Expert Network for Multi-Behavior Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/graph_rec/mixrec_hetero.description: [TKDE 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用门控专家网络显式建模共享潜在因子，配合对比学习保证因子独立与一致，在三个多行为数据集 Full-Ranking 下 HR@10 最高提升 3.95%。

venues/WSDM/2025/llm_rec/dlcrec_a_novel_.title: Tree of Preferences for Diversified Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/llm_rec/dlcrec_a_novel_.description: [NeurIPS 2025][LLM4Rec] 用 LLM 构建粗到细偏好树挖掘欠探索兴趣并合成交互去偏，在 Twitter/Weibo/Amazon 上同时提升多样性与相关性。

venues/WSDM/2025/llm_rec/dlcrec_a_novel_.title: LettinGo: Explore User Profile Generation for Recommendation System
venues/WSDM/2025/llm_rec/dlcrec_a_novel_.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 用多LLM探索开放式用户画像、以下游推荐成败构造偏好对、DPO对齐画像生成器，Amazon Books Acc 66.3%→70.4%。

venues/WSDM/2025/llm_rec/dlcrec_a_novel_.title: How to Diversify any Personalized Recommender?
venues/WSDM/2025/llm_rec/dlcrec_a_novel_.description: [ECIR 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 提出用户画像级预处理：用逻辑回归识别用户代表类别、userKNN 生成候选，再按 λ% 增删交互，使任意推荐器在保持精度的同时提升多样性与少数类曝光公平。

venues/WSDM/2025/llm_rec/dlcrec_a_novel_.title: Controlling Diversity at Inference: Guiding Diffusion Recommender Models with Targeted Category Preferences
venues/WSDM/2025/llm_rec/dlcrec_a_novel_.description: [KDD 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 提出解耦扩散模型 D3Rec，通过类别偏好引导的反向去噪过程，在推理阶段灵活控制推荐准确率-多样性权衡。

venues/WSDM/2025/llm_rec/dlcrec_a_novel_.title: RecLM: Recommendation Instruction Tuning
venues/WSDM/2025/llm_rec/dlcrec_a_novel_.description: [ACL 2025][大语言模型推荐] 以两轮协同指令微调+RL画像精炼为LLM注入协同信号，作为即插即用画像增强器在零样本冷启动下带来最高 200%+ 的 Recall 提升。

venues/WSDM/2025/multi_task_reranking/se.title: FELLAS: Enhancing Federated Sequential Recommendation with LLM as External Services
venues/WSDM/2025/multi_task_reranking/se.description: [TOIS 2025][大语言模型推荐] 将 LLM 作为外部服务为联邦序列推荐提供物品级与序列级表征，配合 dX-privacy 扰动与对比学习，在 Full-Ranking 下显著超越 FedSeqRec 并逼近集中式训练。

venues/WSDM/2025/multi_task_reranking/se.title: Causal-Invariant Cross-Domain Out-of-Distribution Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/multi_task_reranking/se.description: [TOIS 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 统一建模跨域与单域双重分布偏移，用双层因果结构与 LLM 引导混杂因子发现实现跨域 OOD 推荐，HR@10 平均提升 6.34%。

venues/WSDM/2025/multi_task_reranking/se.title: Privacy-Preserving Sequential Recommendation with Collaborative Confusion
venues/WSDM/2025/multi_task_reranking/se.description: [TOIS 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用相似序列引导的逐项修改器在推荐前混淆交互序列，66% 修改率下推荐精度仍超 99% SOTA。

venues/WSDM/2025/multi_task_reranking/se.title: Learning Robust Sequential Recommenders through Confident Soft Labels
venues/WSDM/2025/multi_task_reranking/se.description: [TOIS 2025][序列推荐] 用模型级/数据级/训练级三种教师模块生成高置信软标签，与 one-hot 联合训练学生序列推荐器，全库排序下 Recall@10 最高提升约 11%。

venues/WSDM/2025/multi_task_reranking/se.title: Dual-Stream MLP is All You Need for CTR Prediction
venues/WSDM/2025/multi_task_reranking/se.description: [TKDD 2026][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用知识蒸馏把复杂显式交叉教师压进纯MLP双流学生，配合隐状态BN与预测对齐，三基准AUC全面SOTA且推理低延迟。

venues/WSDM/2025/multimodal_rec/spectrum.title: COHESION: Composite Graph Convolutional Network with Dual-Stage Fusion for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/multimodal_rec/spectrum.description: [SIGIR 2025][多模态推荐] 用行为模态早期精炼+晚期注意力融合的双阶段融合，配合异质/同质复合图与自适应BPR，在三个 Amazon 数据集上 R@20 相对提升 4.4%–6.1%。

venues/WSDM/2025/multimodal_rec/spectrum.title: Hypercomplex Prompt-aware Multimodal Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/multimodal_rec/spectrum.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 用 Cayley-Dickson 超复数多分量嵌入 + 超复数乘法非线性融合 + Prompt 动态补偿，在四个 Amazon 数据集 Full-Ranking 下 Recall@20 最高提升约 13%。

venues/WSDM/2025/multimodal_rec/spectrum.title: Structured Spectral Reasoning for Frequency-Adaptive Multimodal Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/multimodal_rec/spectrum.description: [NeurIPS 2025][多模态推荐] 将多模态图信号分解为等能量频带，用频带掩码一致性训练、低秩超谱算子与谱对比正则实现频率自适应融合，全库排序下冷启动 Recall@20 提升约 10%。

venues/WSDM/2025/multimodal_rec/spectrum.title: Tackling the Modality Inhibitance Effect with Wavelet-based Modality Integration in Multi-modal Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/multimodal_rec/spectrum.description: [TKDE 2026][多模态推荐] 提出模态抑制效应(MIE)概念，用Haar小波多分辨率分解提取各模态本质特征、结构感知多模态图学习与交叉加权自适应调节器，在4数据集Full-Ranking下平均提升6.48%。

venues/WSDM/2025/multimodal_rec/spectrum.title: MENTOR: Multi-level Self-supervised Learning for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/multimodal_rec/spectrum.description: [AAAI 2025][多模态推荐] 以 ID 嵌入为锚做四级跨模态分布对齐，叠加特征掩码与图扰动自监督，Amazon 三集 Recall@20 最高提升 74.73%

venues/WSDM/2025/multimodal_rec/teach_me.title: Beyond Noisy Signals: Dual-Level Denoising for Multi-modal Sequential Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/multimodal_rec/teach_me.description: [ACM MM 2026][多模态推荐] 图拉普拉斯低通滤波去特征噪声 + FFT 可学习频域滤波去序列噪声，四数据集 Full-Ranking 全面 SOTA，R@20 最高 +19.33%。

venues/WSDM/2025/multimodal_rec/teach_me.title: Multi-Modal Multi-Behavior Sequential Recommendation with Conditional Diffusion-Based Feature Denoising
venues/WSDM/2025/multimodal_rec/teach_me.description: [SIGIR 2025][多模态推荐] 用条件扩散分别对模态与行为特征去噪，并以多专家网络解耦共性/特性兴趣，在 Rec-Tmal/Kuaishou 上 HR@10 提升约 4-8%。

venues/WSDM/2025/multimodal_rec/teach_me.title: Spectrum-based Modality Representation Fusion Graph Convolutional Network for Multimodal Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/multimodal_rec/teach_me.description: [WSDM 2025][多模态推荐] 将多模态特征投影至频域做滤波去噪与点积融合，配合模态专属/融合双图学习与模态感知偏好模块，在 Amazon 三数据集全库排序下 Recall@20 相对最优基线提升约 5%。

venues/WSDM/2025/multimodal_rec/teach_me.title: Post-Training Denoising of User Profiles with LLMs in Collaborative Filtering Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/multimodal_rec/teach_me.description: [ECIR 2026][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 用 LLM 零样本/少样本提示在推理前清洗用户画像，无需重训 CF 模型即获最高 13% NDCG/HR 提升。

venues/WSDM/2025/multimodal_rec/teach_me.title: Unleashing the Power of Large Language Model for Denoising Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/multimodal_rec/teach_me.description: [WWW 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] LLaRD 用 LLM 生成偏好知识与图 CoT 关系知识，再以信息瓶颈对齐去噪图，Full-Ranking 下 Recall@20 最高提升约 14%。

venues/WSDM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/choosing_.title: HARPO: Hierarchical Agentic Reasoning for User-Aligned Conversational Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/choosing_.description: [ACL 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 将对话推荐重构为多维质量驱动的结构化决策，用分层偏好奖励引导树搜索推理，ReDial R@10 达 29.8%（+18.7%）。

venues/WSDM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/choosing_.title: Towards Automatic Sampling of User Behaviors for Sequential Recommender Systems
venues/WSDM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/choosing_.description: [IJCAI 2025][序列与会话推荐] 提出 AutoSAM，用轻量采样器+强化学习多目标奖励自适应丢弃低信息历史行为，在四个真实数据集全库排序下 NDCG@10 平均提升约 8%。

venues/WSDM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/choosing_.title: LLM-Enhanced Reinforcement Learning for Long-Term User Satisfaction in Interactive Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/choosing_.description: [DASFAA 2026][强化学习与动态探索推荐] LLM 做类别级语义规划、PPO 做物品级策略，KuaiSim 全会话仿真下 Tint/Rcum 显著超越 DNaIR 等 SOTA。

venues/WSDM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/choosing_.title: Goal-Conditioned Supervised Learning for Multi-Objective Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/choosing_.description: [NeurIPS 2026][多任务学习与列表级重排] 将 GCSL 的标量目标扩展为多维向量目标，用 Transformer 编码器 + 交叉熵直接做多目标下一物品预测，无需复杂架构与权重调参，在 RetailRocket/Challenge15 上购买 HR@10 相对提升约 4-17%。

venues/WSDM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/choosing_.title: MARCO: A Cooperative Knowledge Transfer Framework for Personalized Cross-domain Recommendations
venues/WSDM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/choosing_.description: [SIGIR-AP 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 将多源跨域推荐建模为协作式多智能体强化学习，每源域一个 Agent 估计贡献并加熵正则，冷启动 MAE 最高降 32.6%。

venues/WSDM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/large_lan.title: Beyond Static LLM Policies: Imitation-Enhanced Reinforcement Learning for Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/large_lan.description: [ICDM 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用 LLM 轨迹作次优示范，经对抗逆强化学习提取奖励并加权模仿，离线 RL 策略在 Steam/Amazon 上累积奖励较 BiLLP 提升 13%+。

venues/WSDM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/large_lan.title: Energy-Guided Diffusion Sampling for Long-Term User Behavior Prediction in Reinforcement Learning-based Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/large_lan.description: [CIKM 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用扩散策略替代行为克隆以提升离线RL4RS策略表达能力，并以Q值能量引导采样降低随机性，六数据集与仿真环境全面领先。

venues/WSDM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/large_lan.title: DARLR: Dual-Agent Offline Reinforcement Learning for Recommender Systems with Dynamic Reward
venues/WSDM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/large_lan.description: [SIGIR 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 双智能体离线 RL 用选择器聚合相似用户动态重塑奖励与不确定性惩罚，四数据集累积奖励全面超越 ROLeR/DORL。

venues/WSDM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/large_lan.title: Reward Balancing Revisited: Enhancing Offline Reinforcement Learning for Recommender Systems
venues/WSDM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/large_lan.description: [WWW 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用扩散世界模型显式建模奖励不确定性，并以衰减加权的交互/熵双惩罚平衡多样性与长期收益，在三个真实数据集上刷新离线RL推荐SOTA。

venues/WSDM/2025/rl_bandit_rec/supervise.title: Beyond Static LLM Policies: Imitation-Enhanced Reinforcement Learning for Recommendation

venues/WSDM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.title: DIAURec: Dual-Intent Space Representation Optimization for Recommendation

venues/WSDM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.title: Fusion and Alignment Enhancement with Large Language Models for Tail-item Sequential Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用自适应门控融合 ID/LLM 嵌入并以双层对齐+课程学习消除空间结构冲突，全库排序下尾部长尾 H@10 最高提升 427%。

venues/WSDM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.title: Generative Data Augmentation in Graph Contrastive Learning for Recommendation

venues/WSDM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.title: SGCL: Unifying Self-Supervised and Supervised Learning for Graph Recommendation

venues/WSDM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.title: SimDiffRec: Semantic Similarity-Guided Diffusion for Contrastive Sequential Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/self_supervised_denoisi.description: [WSDM 2026][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 用语义相似物品均值替代高斯随机噪声做扩散增强，按去噪置信度选增强位置并配难负采样，五数据集 Full-Ranking 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/facet_aw.title: PRISM: Personalized Recommendation via Information Synergy Module

venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/facet_aw.title: STAR-Rec: Making Peace with Length Variance and Pattern Diversity in Sequential Recommendation

venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/facet_aw.title: Efficient Multimodal Streaming Recommendation via Expandable Side Mixture-of-Experts

venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/facet_aw.title: RoTE: Coarse-to-Fine Multi-Level Rotary Time Embedding for Sequential Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/facet_aw.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 将时间戳分解为年/月/日多粒度并借 RoPE 旋转注入 Q/K，即插即用提升 SASRec/RPG，NDCG@5 最高 +20.11%

venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/facet_aw.title: Empowering Sequential Recommendation from Collaborative Signals and Semantic Relatedness

venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/oracle_g.title: DELRec: Distilling Sequential Pattern to Enhance LLMs-based Sequential Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/oracle_g.description: [ICDE 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用软提示两阶段蒸馏传统序列模型的时间感知与推荐模式，再微调 LLM 做序列推荐，四数据集 HR/NDCG 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/oracle_g.title: Lost in Sequence: Do Large Language Models Understand Sequential Recommendation?
venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/oracle_g.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 揭示现有 LLM4Rec 模型无法捕捉交互序列顺序信息，提出冻结 LLM 与 CF-SRec、仅训练轻量 MLP 的蒸馏框架 LLM-SRec，在 Amazon 四数据集上 NDCG@10 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/oracle_g.title: Pre-trained LLMs Meet Sequential Recommenders: Efficient User-Centric Knowledge Distillation
venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/oracle_g.description: [ECIR 2026][大语言模型推荐] 用预训练 LLM 生成文本用户画像并蒸馏进 SASRec/BERT4Rec 隐层，两阶段训练实现零推理开销的语义增强，Recall@10 最高提升 23.5%。

venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/oracle_g.title: Efficient Sequential Recommendation for Long Term User Interest Via Personalization
venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/oracle_g.description: [ICDM 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用可学习 token 将长历史分段压缩为个性化专家，配合定制注意力掩码与 KV 缓存，在 HSTU/HLLM 上以约 1/4 推理开销逼近全序列精度。

venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/oracle_g.title: Maximum In-Support Return Modeling for Dynamic Recommendation with Language Model Prior
venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/oracle_g.description: [CIKM 2025][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 将轨迹拼接从训练期移至动作推理期，用 expectile 回归估计最大在支撑回报并自适应截断历史，配合 LLM 先验初始化 DT，在 5 个离线数据集与 VirtualTB 仿真上全面超越 EDT4Rec。

venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/personal.title: Dual-Diffusional Generative Fashion Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/personal.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 双分支扩散 Transformer 联合生成时尚单品图像与属性级文本，以结构化偏好加权采样建模用户，PFITB/GOR 双任务个性化指标显著领先且训练提速约 7 倍。

venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/personal.title: StyleTailor: Towards Personalized Fashion Styling via Hierarchical Negative Feedback
venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/personal.description: [AAAI 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 首个统一个性化服装设计、购物推荐与虚拟试穿的协作智能体框架，以三级分层负反馈闭环迭代优化，在自建 64 样本基准上 Style Consistency 相对基线提升 39.4%。

venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/personal.title: DeepAffinity: Long-Term Aspect Preference Prediction in eCommerce using Small Language Models
venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/personal.description: [RecSys 2026][LLM4Rec] 用 135M 小模型+结构化字符串化+多任务预测头，从时序行为预测品牌/尺码/颜色等商品属性偏好，Fashion 微 F1 0.34 超 Gemini 零样本与 3B SFT。

venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/personal.title: PALATE: Pretrained Autoregressive LATent Embeddings
venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/personal.description: [GRAIL@CIKM 2026][生成式推荐] 用GPT式自回归模型对消费者门店互动序列建模，导出末词元隐状态为冻结256维用户嵌入，供DCNv2广告排序器跨场景复用，离线AUC+0.59%/+0.57%，线上收入+0.79%/+0.94%。

venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/personal.title: Improving Visual Recommendation on E-commerce Platforms Using Vision-Language Models
venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/personal.description: [RecSys 2025][多模态推荐] 在 Mercari C2C 平台微调 SigLIP 图像编码器做视觉相似召回，离线 nDCG@5 +9.1%，线上 CTR +50%、CVR +14%。

venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/temporal.title: Improving Sequential Recommendations via Bidirectional Temporal Data Augmentation with Pre-training
venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/temporal.description: [TKDE 2025][序列与会话推荐] BARec 用双向时序增强预训练生成保偏好伪先验物品，并以 KL 知识增强微调对齐原/增广序列分布，全库排序下 Beauty Recall@5 提升 16.6%。

venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/temporal.title: RoTE: Coarse-to-Fine Multi-Level Rotary Time Embedding for Sequential Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/temporal.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 将时间戳分解为年/月/日多粒度并借 RoPE 旋转注入 Q/K，即插即用提升 SASRec/RPG，NDCG@5 最高 +20.11%

venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/temporal.title: A Contextual-Aware Position Encoding for Sequential Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/temporal.description: [WWW 2025][序列与会话推荐] 首个为序列推荐定制的上下文感知位置编码 CAPE：用目标-上下文不相似度累加动态分配位置，配合门控融合异构特征，在 5 个骨干与工业 A/B 上稳定涨点。

venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/temporal.title: GLINT-RU: Gated Lightweight Intelligent Recurrent Units for Sequential Recommender Systems
venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/temporal.description: [KDD 2025][序列与会话推荐] 单层并行专家混合（密集选择GRU+线性注意力）+门控MLP的高效序列推荐，Leave-One-Out全库排序下精度与推理速度双超SOTA。

venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/temporal.title: Rethinking Convolutional Networks for Attribute-Aware Sequential Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/temporal.description: [IJCAI 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用金字塔式降尺度卷积替代自注意力聚合属性感知序列，线性复杂度下在四个 Amazon 数据集上 HR@10 最高提升 4.08%。

venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/your_cau.title: Residual Dominance as a Structural Account of Last-Item Reliance in Causal Self-Attention Recommenders
venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/your_cau.description: [RecSys 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用范数分解揭示残差连接主导同位置信息保留，并以推理期残差缩放诊断因果自注意力推荐器的末项依赖机制。

venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/your_cau.title: Revisiting Self-Attentive Sequential Recommendation Beyond the LLM Paradigm
venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/your_cau.description: [ICDM 2026][序列与会话推荐] 以 SASRec 为锚点对比推荐与语言建模的熵结构差异，诊断四条继承假设并给出数据优先议程，含同模型双视图实证。

venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/your_cau.title: BlossomRec: Block-level Fused Sparse Attention Mechanism for Sequential Recommendations
venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/your_cau.description: [WWW 2026][序列与会话推荐] 双路块级稀疏注意力（LTIS 块选择 + STIS 幂律掩码）经门控融合，长序列训练提速 3.2×、显存降至 1/11，精度持平或超越 SASRec。

venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/your_cau.title: LREA: Low-Rank Efficient Attention on Modeling Long-Term User Behaviors for CTR Prediction
venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/your_cau.description: [SIGIR 2025][CTR预估与特征交叉] 用低秩分解+矩阵吸收把万级长行为序列压到秩 r 维做目标注意力，配非负正则保非线性，线上仅增 3ms 延迟、CTR +5.88%。

venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/your_cau.title: Revisiting Self-attention for Cross-domain Sequential Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2025/sequential_rec/your_cau.description: [KDD 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 将跨域序列推荐重构为推荐损失与跨域注意力抑制的双目标帕累托优化，以即插即用方式改造自注意力，平均提升 Recall@10 达 9.8%/16.0%。

venues/WSDM/2026/cold_start_rec/epiccbr_.title: Personalized Diffusion Model Reshapes Cold-Start Bundle Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2026/cold_start_rec/epiccbr_.description: [WWW 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 用个性化条件扩散在分布空间生成捆绑包，配合解耦自注意力与KL正则，冷启动捆绑推荐全库排序Recall@20最高提升1155%。

venues/WSDM/2026/cold_start_rec/epiccbr_.title: Learning Sparse Representations of Multimodal Content for Enhanced Cold Item Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2026/cold_start_rec/epiccbr_.description: [RecSys 2026][冷启动与长尾推荐] 将多模态内容冷启动表征改为 top-K 稀疏嵌入，并用 α-entmax 预稀疏激活诱导锐化与去噪，冷启动 NDCG@20 提升 16.6%–75.5% 且存储更低。

venues/WSDM/2026/cold_start_rec/epiccbr_.title: Intent-guided Heterogeneous Graph Contrastive Learning for Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2026/cold_start_rec/epiccbr_.description: [TKDE 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 用元路径意图构建双对比学习视图，并以信息瓶颈掩码自编码器去噪，六数据集全库排序 Recall@20 最高提升 12.4%。

venues/WSDM/2026/cold_start_rec/epiccbr_.title: SCONE: A Novel Stochastic Sampling to Generate Contrastive Views and Hard Negative Samples for Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2026/cold_start_rec/epiccbr_.description: [WSDM 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 用分数生成模型统一生成用户-物品特定对比视图与难负样本，6 数据集全库排序 Recall@20 最高提升 1.70%。

venues/WSDM/2026/cold_start_rec/epiccbr_.title: Semantic Retrieval Augmented Contrastive Learning for Sequential Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2026/cold_start_rec/epiccbr_.description: [NeurIPS 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用 LLM 语义检索构建用户/物品候选池并配可学习样本合成器，替代随机增广与 K-Means 硬规则，全库排序下 HR@20 最高提升 11.82%。

venues/WSDM/2026/collaborative_filtering.title: Quantifying User Coherence: A Unified Framework for Analyzing Recommender Systems Across Domains
venues/WSDM/2026/collaborative_filtering.description: [WWW 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 提出 Mean Surprise 与 Mean Conditional Surprise 两个信息论度量刻画用户画像一致性，揭示复杂模型增益集中于高一致用户，并支撑分层评测与用户分群建模。

venues/WSDM/2026/collaborative_filtering.title: All-in-One: Heterogeneous Interaction Modeling for Cold-Start Rating Prediction
venues/WSDM/2026/collaborative_filtering.description: [ICDE 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] HIRE 用纯 MHSA 在采样的预测上下文上端到端学习用户/物品/属性三层异构交互，三种冷启动场景下 Precision/NDCG/MAP 平均超 12 个基线 0.21/0.29/0.22。

venues/WSDM/2026/collaborative_filtering.title: A Self-Supervised Mixture-of-Experts Framework for Multi-behavior Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2026/collaborative_filtering.description: [CIKM 2025][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 揭示多行为推荐在已访问/未访问物品上的性能鸿沟，提出双专家 MoE + 专家自适应 SSL（访问过滤/新颖性推断对比 + 行为生成）框架，全库排序下 HR@20 最高提升 65.46%。

venues/WSDM/2026/collaborative_filtering.title: Continual Recommender Systems
venues/WSDM/2026/collaborative_filtering.description: [CIKM 2025][序列与会话推荐] 系统梳理持续推荐的两大技术路线（经验回放与正则化），并延伸至资源受限与序列交互场景，给出可信性、基础模型与搜推统一三大开放方向。

venues/WSDM/2026/collaborative_filtering.title: CoLLM: Integrating Collaborative Embeddings into Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2026/collaborative_filtering.description: [TKDE 2025][大语言模型推荐] 将传统协同过滤模型学到的用户/物品表征经 MLP 映射进 LLM 词嵌入空间，以两阶段调优兼顾暖启动与冷启动，AUC 相对 TALLRec 提升约 8%。

venues/WSDM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Towards Personalized Federated Multi-Scenario Multi-Task Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [WSDM 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 首个联邦多场景多任务推荐框架 PF-MSMTrec，通过专家参数解耦、联邦批归一化与冲突协调缓解数据/模型/任务三级冲突，AliExpress 与 Tenrec 上 CTR/CTCVR AUC 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/WSDM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: MPFormer: Adaptive Framework for Industrial Multi-Task Personalized Sequential Retriever
venues/WSDM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [CIKM 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用目标条件化 Transformer 统一多目标召回，并以排序分数监督动态配额分配，在快手 4 亿 DAU 上实现 +0.43% 总时长与 66.7% 推理资源节省。

venues/WSDM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Efficient Multi-task Prompt Tuning for Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [TOIS 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 提出两阶段 MPT-Rec：GAN 解耦任务共享/特有信息后冻结主干，仅用任务感知 Prompt 微调新任务，参数降至 10% 且性能保持 95%+。

venues/WSDM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Paragon: Parameter Generation for Controllable Multi-Task Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [RecSys 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用扩散模型按偏好权重条件生成适配器参数，免重训实现测试时可控多任务推荐，响应时间降低 94.6%+。

venues/WSDM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.title: Personalized Task Dependency Graphs for Mitigating Signal Erosion in Multi-Task Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2026/cross_domain_multi_scen.description: [CIKM 2026][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用低秩个性化任务依赖图+硬因果掩码GCN替代刚性漏斗，缓解深层稀疏任务信号侵蚀，离线AUC最高+1.45%，线上CVR+1.2%。

venues/WSDM/2026/generative_rec/accelera.title: Efficient Sequential Recommendation for Long Term User Interest Via Personalization
venues/WSDM/2026/generative_rec/accelera.description: [ICDM 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用可学习 token 将长历史分段压缩为个性化专家，配合定制注意力掩码与 KV 缓存，在 HSTU/HLLM 上以约 1/4 推理开销逼近全序列精度。

venues/WSDM/2026/generative_rec/accelera.title: Mixture of Sequence: Theme-Aware Mixture-of-Experts for Long-Sequence Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2026/generative_rec/accelera.description: [WWW 2026][序列与会话推荐] 揭示长序列“会话跳跃”现象，用主题码本路由+多尺度专家融合做子序列抽取，AUC 平均提升 0.68% 且 FLOPs 更低

venues/WSDM/2026/generative_rec/accelera.title: Closing the Long-Short View Gap in Sequential Recommendation without Cached History
venues/WSDM/2026/generative_rec/accelera.description: [CIKM 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用角度相似度打分+softmax1 修正长视训练几何缺陷，再仅微调 Bias/LayerNorm 实现无缓存短视推理，短窗下反超全序列基线。

venues/WSDM/2026/generative_rec/accelera.title: Scaling Recommender Transformers to One Billion Parameters
venues/WSDM/2026/generative_rec/accelera.description: [KDD 2026][序列与会话推荐] ARGUS 将自回归预训练解耦为反馈预测与下一物品预测双任务，把推荐 Transformer 编码器扩到 10 亿参数，线上听歌时长 +2.26%、点赞率 +6.37%。

venues/WSDM/2026/generative_rec/accelera.title: Leveraging Memory Retrieval to Enhance LLM-based Generative Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2026/generative_rec/accelera.description: [WWW 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 PPL 降幅自动标注记忆价值并训练检索器，为 LLM 生成式推荐注入长期兴趣，全库排序下 Recall@1 稳定提升。

venues/WSDM/2026/generative_rec/continuo.title: On Efficiency-Effectiveness Trade-off of Diffusion-based Recommenders
venues/WSDM/2026/generative_rec/continuo.description: [NeurIPS 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用时间一致性正则平滑去噪函数实现一步生成，再用自适应偏好对齐修正轨迹偏差，兼顾扩散推荐效率与效果。

venues/WSDM/2026/generative_rec/continuo.title: Distinguished Quantized Guidance for Diffusion-based Sequence Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2026/generative_rec/continuo.description: [WWW 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用语义码本量化序列增强扩散引导，并以对比差异最大化抑制流行度偏置生成，四数据集全库排序全面领先。

venues/WSDM/2026/generative_rec/continuo.title: Unlocking the Power of Diffusion Models in Sequential Recommendation: A Simple and Effective Approach
venues/WSDM/2026/generative_rec/continuo.description: [KDD 2025][序列与会话推荐] 揭示扩散序列推荐中的嵌入坍缩问题，提出逐 token 独立扩散+三阶段训练，六数据集 HR@20 平均提升 15.45%。

venues/WSDM/2026/generative_rec/continuo.title: S-Diff: An Anisotropic Diffusion Model for Collaborative Filtering in Spectral Domain
venues/WSDM/2026/generative_rec/continuo.description: [WSDM 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 将扩散前向过程搬到物品图拉普拉斯谱域，用特征值参数化各向异性噪声保低频，配合 FiLM 条件去噪，全库排序下 Recall@20 最高提升约 5.5%。

venues/WSDM/2026/generative_rec/continuo.title: Time Matters: Enhancing Sequential Recommendations with Time-Guided Graph Neural ODEs
venues/WSDM/2026/generative_rec/continuo.description: [KDD 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用时间引导扩散补全稀疏用户时间图、图神经ODE对齐用户兴趣与物品演化，五数据集Recall@20最高提升46%。

venues/WSDM/2026/generative_rec/unlockin.title: Generative Large Recommendation Models: Emerging Trends in LLMs for Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2026/generative_rec/unlockin.description: [WWW 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 系统梳理生成式大推荐模型范式：数据质量、缩放律、用户行为挖掘与训练推理效率四大议题及未来方向。

venues/WSDM/2026/generative_rec/unlockin.title: Scaling Recommender Transformers to One Billion Parameters
venues/WSDM/2026/generative_rec/unlockin.description: [KDD 2026][序列与会话推荐] ARGUS 将自回归预训练解耦为反馈预测与下一物品预测双任务，把推荐 Transformer 编码器扩到 10 亿参数，线上听歌时长 +2.26%、点赞率 +6.37%。

venues/WSDM/2026/generative_rec/unlockin.title: MTGR: Industrial-Scale Generative Recommendation Framework in Meituan
venues/WSDM/2026/generative_rec/unlockin.description: [CIKM 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义 ID] 以用户级样本聚合复用 HSTU 编码器并保留 DLRM 交叉特征，实现 65× FLOPs 下线上 CTCVR +1.02%、推理成本降 12%

venues/WSDM/2026/generative_rec/unlockin.title: Towards Next-Generation Recommender Systems: A Benchmark for Personalized Recommendation Assistant with LLMs
venues/WSDM/2026/generative_rec/unlockin.description: [WSDM 2026][大语言模型推荐] 构建 RecBench+ 约3万条复杂用户查询基准，覆盖显式/隐式/误导条件与画像偏好，系统评测7个LLM并揭示SFT+RFT两阶段微调最优。

venues/WSDM/2026/generative_rec/unlockin.title: SLMRec: Distilling Large Language Models into Small for Sequential Recommendation
venues/WSDM/2026/generative_rec/unlockin.description: [ICLR 2025][LLM4Rec] 发现 LLM 中间层冗余，用逐层分块特征蒸馏将 8 层教师压缩为 4 层学生，仅 13% 参数达 6.6x/8.0x 加速且性能不降。

venues/WSDM/2026/llm_rec/hadsf_aspect_aw.title: Beyond Utility: Evaluating LLM as Recommender
venues/WSDM/2026/llm_rec/hadsf_aspect_aw.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出含历史长度敏感性、候选位置偏差、画像生成与幻觉四维的 LLM 推荐多维评测框架，揭示 LLM 在重排与冷启动占优但位置偏差严重。

venues/WSDM/2026/llm_rec/hadsf_aspect_aw.title: An Aspect Performance-aware Hypergraph Neural Network for Review-based Recommendation

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/beyond_retrieval.description: [ECIR 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用轻量实体级序列推荐器产出候选、LLM 做上下文适配重排，ReDial/INSPIRED 上 H@5 平均提升 54%/25%。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/beyond_retrieval.title: Refining Text Generation for Realistic Conversational Recommendation via Direct Preference Optimization
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/beyond_retrieval.description: [EMNLP 2025][对话推荐与智能体] 用 DPO 对齐 LLM 生成的对话摘要与物品推荐信息，使评分器更准，Tabidachi 上 HR@1 提升 21.3%。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/beyond_retrieval.title: Collaborative Retrieval for Large Language Model-based Conversational Recommender Systems
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/beyond_retrieval.description: [WWW 2025][对话推荐与智能体] 用 EASE 协同检索 + 两步 LLM 反思重排为黑盒 LLM 注入 CF 知识，Reddit-v2/Redial 全库排序 Recall@20 显著超越 Zero-shot LLM。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/beyond_retrieval.title: FLARE: Fusing Language Models and Collaborative Architectures for Recommender Enhancement
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/beyond_retrieval.description: [WWW 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用冻结 mT5+Perceiver 将文本注入 Bert4Rec，并以重调 Bert4Rec 基线、大词表评测与 Critiquing 任务重估 ID+文本增益。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/beyond_utility_e.title: Can LLMs Outshine Conventional Recommenders? A Comparative Evaluation
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/beyond_utility_e.description: [NeurIPS 2025 DB Track][大语言模型推荐] RecBench 系统对比 17 个 LLM 与 DLRM 在 4 种物品表征、CTR/SeqRec 双任务上的精度-效率权衡，LLM 精度领先但推理慢千倍。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/beyond_utility_e.title: Generative Large Recommendation Models: Emerging Trends in LLMs for Recommendation
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/beyond_utility_e.description: [WWW 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 系统梳理生成式大推荐模型范式：数据质量、缩放律、用户行为挖掘与训练推理效率四大议题及未来方向。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/beyond_utility_e.title: Do LLMs Memorize Recommendation Datasets? A Preliminary Study on MovieLens-1M
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/beyond_utility_e.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用少样本提示探测 GPT/Llama 对 MovieLens-1M 的物品、用户与交互记忆覆盖率，揭示记忆量与推荐性能强相关且放大流行度偏置。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/beyond_utility_e.title: The Mental World of Large Language Models in Recommendation: A Benchmark on Association, Personalization, and Knowledgeability
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/beyond_utility_e.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出 LRWorld 基准（38K 样本/23M tokens），从关联、个性化、知识性三尺度十因素 31 任务系统评测数十个 LLM，揭示其在神经嵌入检索上的致命短板。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/beyond_utility_e.title: Exploring the Potential of LLMs for Serendipity Evaluation in Recommender Systems
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/beyond_utility_e.description: [RecSys 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 用 LLM 模拟用户对推荐结果做惊喜度（serendipity）打分，在淘宝与 MovieLens 两个真实用户调研数据集上做元评估，最优配置 Pearson 相关达 21.5%，显著超越传统代理指标。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/d2k_turning_hist.title: Bridging the User-side Knowledge Gap in Knowledge-aware Recommendations with Large Language Models
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/d2k_turning_hist.description: [AAAI 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 LLM 推断用户兴趣并结构化为 CIKG 异构图，配合兴趣重建与跨域对比学习去噪，在三个数据集全库排序下 R@100 最高提升 9.31%。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/d2k_turning_hist.title: Request-Only Optimization for Recommendation Systems
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/d2k_turning_hist.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 以用户请求为训练样本单元，在数据源头去重用户特征，实现训练吞吐 2-6 倍提升并支撑 HSTU 生成式推荐规模化落地。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/d2k_turning_hist.title: Can Recommender Systems Teach Themselves? A Recursive Self-Improving Framework with Fidelity Control
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/d2k_turning_hist.description: [ICML 2026][自监督对比学习与交互去噪] 提出 RSIR 递归自我改进框架，用模型自生成序列+保真度质量控制稠密化稀疏交互，理论证明其等价于流形切向隐式正则，多骨干多数据集 Full-Ranking 下 NDCG/Recall 稳定提升 3%–14%。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/d2k_turning_hist.title: Online Item Cold-Start Recommendation with Popularity-Aware Meta-Learning
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/d2k_turning_hist.description: [KDD 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 按流行度固定切分元学习任务并配冷启动增强器，流式在线场景下冷启动召回相对 SOTA 提升 11%–74%。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/d2k_turning_hist.title: One for Dozens: Adaptive REcommendation for All Domains with Counterfactual Augmentation
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/d2k_turning_hist.description: [AAAI 2025][跨域与多场景推荐] 用分层专家+彩票假设掩码剪枝为数十域学专属子网，并以流行度反事实增强少数域，DomainAUC 提升 2‰~8.4‰。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/eager_llm_enhanc.title: Pre-trained LLMs Meet Sequential Recommenders: Efficient User-Centric Knowledge Distillation
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/eager_llm_enhanc.description: [ECIR 2026][大语言模型推荐] 用预训练 LLM 生成文本用户画像并蒸馏进 SASRec/BERT4Rec 隐层，两阶段训练实现零推理开销的语义增强，Recall@10 最高提升 23.5%。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/eager_llm_enhanc.title: Generative Large Recommendation Models: Emerging Trends in LLMs for Recommendation
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/eager_llm_enhanc.description: [WWW 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 系统梳理生成式大推荐模型范式：数据质量、缩放律、用户行为挖掘与训练推理效率四大议题及未来方向。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/eager_llm_enhanc.title: CoLLM: Integrating Collaborative Embeddings into Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/eager_llm_enhanc.description: [TKDE 2025][大语言模型推荐] 将传统协同过滤模型学到的用户/物品表征经 MLP 映射进 LLM 词嵌入空间，以两阶段调优兼顾暖启动与冷启动，AUC 相对 TALLRec 提升约 8%。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/eager_llm_enhanc.title: Recommender AI Agent: Integrating Large Language Models for Interactive Recommendations
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/eager_llm_enhanc.description: [TOIS 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 以 LLM 为大脑、传统推荐模型为工具，配合候选总线、长短期画像、计划优先执行与反思机制，在 Steam/MovieLens/Beauty 上显著超越 GPT-4 与 Chat-Rec。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/eager_llm_enhanc.title: Empowering Compact LLMs with Fusion of Layer-wise Exits for Recommendation
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/eager_llm_enhanc.description: [ICDM 2026][LLM4Rec] 在紧凑 LLM 每层插入预测出口并用连续 ReLU 路由器自适应融合多层打分分布，target-k hinge 损失约束激活出口数，全库排序下精度超越大模型基线且延迟仅增 <1ms。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/enhancing_news_r.title: Revisiting Language Models in Neural News Recommender Systems
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/enhancing_news_r.description: [ECIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 在 MIND 上统一复现 8 种 LM 作为新闻编码器，发现更大模型不必然更优，但显著利好冷启动用户。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/enhancing_news_r.title: Can LLMs Outshine Conventional Recommenders? A Comparative Evaluation
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/enhancing_news_r.description: [NeurIPS 2025 DB Track][大语言模型推荐] RecBench 系统对比 17 个 LLM 与 DLRM 在 4 种物品表征、CTR/SeqRec 双任务上的精度-效率权衡，LLM 精度领先但推理慢千倍。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/enhancing_news_r.title: LSNR: Learned Sparse News Recommendations with Attentive User Modeling
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/enhancing_news_r.description: [SIGIR-AP 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用独立编码+注意力聚合替代 STAR 的历史拼接，构建双通路稀疏用户向量，MIND NDCG@10 较 STAR 提升 11%，短历史场景反超稠密模型。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/enhancing_news_r.title: The Mental World of Large Language Models in Recommendation: A Benchmark on Association, Personalization, and Knowledgeability
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/enhancing_news_r.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出 LRWorld 基准（38K 样本/23M tokens），从关联、个性化、知识性三尺度十因素 31 任务系统评测数十个 LLM，揭示其在神经嵌入检索上的致命短板。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/enhancing_news_r.title: Rethinking LLM-Based Recommendations: A Personalized Query-Driven Parallel Integration
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/enhancing_news_r.description: [ACL 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出 QUEREC 并行框架，用 LLM 零样本生成个性化用户查询与特征增强物品描述，与 CF 模型并行全库检索后自适应重排，Full-Ranking 下最高提升 57%。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/external_large_f.title: RecRanker: Instruction Tuning Large Language Model as Ranker for Top-k Recommendation
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/external_large_f.description: [TOIS 2025][大语言模型推荐] 以自适应用户采样、位置偏移与检索信号增强构建三类排序指令微调 LLM 重排器，并提出混合排序集成，Leave-One-Out 全库排序下 HR/NDCG 最高提升 213%。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/external_large_f.title: One Model for All: Large Language Models are Domain-Agnostic Recommendation Systems
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/external_large_f.description: [TOIS 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 LLM 编码跨域混合标题序列实现域无关推荐，采样 1000 负例评测，SPIAO 上较最优基线相对提升约 19%。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/external_large_f.title: Thoroughly Modeling Multi-domain Pre-trained Recommendation as Language
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/external_large_f.description: [TOIS 2025][LLM4Rec] 将多域序列推荐彻底转为文本生成任务，用五项指标指导行为-文本双向适配，7 数据集微调与零样本均最优，NDCG@1 最高提升 23%。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/external_large_f.title: Eval4DiRec: A Unified and Systematic Evaluation Framework for Diffusion-based Recommender Systems
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/external_large_f.description: [TKDD 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 首个面向扩散推荐的开源统一评测框架，覆盖 5 场景 14 模型，标准化扩散推理配置并揭示噪声调度与步数的关键影响。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/external_large_f.title: PTF-FSR: A Parameter Transmission-Free Federated Sequential Recommender System
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/external_large_f.description: [TOIS 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用指数机制生成扰动序列替代参数传输，实现模型隐私与轻量通信的联邦序列推荐框架，通信降至 KB 级。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/filtering_discom.title: Towards Next-Generation Recommender Systems: A Benchmark for Personalized Recommendation Assistant with LLMs
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/filtering_discom.description: [WSDM 2026][大语言模型推荐] 构建 RecBench+ 约3万条复杂用户查询基准，覆盖显式/隐式/误导条件与画像偏好，系统评测7个LLM并揭示SFT+RFT两阶段微调最优。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/filtering_discom.title: iAgent: LLM Agent as a Shield between User and Recommender Systems
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/filtering_discom.description: [ACL 2025 Findings][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 提出 user-agent-platform 新范式，用个体指令感知 LLM Agent 在用户与平台间做重排护盾，四数据集平均提升 16.6%。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/filtering_discom.title: Biases in LLM-Generated Musical Taste Profiles for Recommendation
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/filtering_discom.description: [RecSys 2025][LLM4Rec] 通过 64 人用户研究揭示 LLM 生成音乐品味画像存在流派/国别系统性偏差，且用户认同度与下游推荐指标仅弱相关。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/filtering_discom.title: Evaluating Podcast Recommendations with Profile-Aware LLM-as-a-Judge
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/filtering_discom.description: [RecSys 2025][LLM4Rec] 用90天收听历史蒸馏自然语言用户画像，驱动零样本LLM做剧集级与模型级离线评判，47人用户研究中与人工判断高度一致。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/filtering_discom.title: Prompt Tuning as User Inherent Profile Inference Machine
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/filtering_discom.description: [CIKM 2025][LLM4Rec] 将用户潜在画像建模为可训练软提示，用因果掩码+EM 推断、码本量化成协同 ID，AUC 最高相对提升 4.77%，已上线华为应用市场。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/g_refer_graph_re.title: Enhancing Collaborative Semantics of Language Model-Driven Recommendations via Graph-Aware Learning
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/g_refer_graph_re.description: [TKDE 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用多跳提示+图感知对比学习把 GNN 聚合意图注入 LLM，在三个 Amazon/Yelp 数据集 Full-Ranking 下 HR@10 最高提升约 15%。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/g_refer_graph_re.title: Comprehending Knowledge Graphs with Large Language Models for Recommender Systems
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/g_refer_graph_re.description: [SIGIR 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 用 LLM 理解 KG 局部子图并构建语义物品图做全局检索增强，离线预计算语义嵌入后接入 LightGCN，全库排序下全面超越 12 个基线。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/g_refer_graph_re.title: An Automatic Graph Construction Framework based on Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/g_refer_graph_re.description: [KDD 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 用 LLM 逐点生成语义向量 + 残差量化抽取隐因子作额外节点，O(N) 构图并设计元路径聚合，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@10 最高提升 43.57%，华为广告 A/B 提升 RPM 2.69%。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/g_refer_graph_re.title: Path-based summary explanations for graph recommenders (extended version)
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/g_refer_graph_re.description: [ICDE 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 首次提出路径解释的摘要化：用 Steiner Tree 与 Prize-Collecting Steiner Tree 将多条用户-物品解释路径压缩为连通子图，在可理解性、多样性、隐私与可扩展性上全面优于逐条路径基线。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/g_refer_graph_re.title: CORONA: A Coarse-to-Fine Framework for Graph-based Recommendation with Large Language Models
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/g_refer_graph_re.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 LLM 做偏好/意图推理在交互图上逐级缩小候选子图，再由 GNN 精排，全库排序下 Recall 平均相对提升 18.6%。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/large_language_m.title: Collaborative Retrieval for Large Language Model-based Conversational Recommender Systems

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/large_language_m.description: [ICWSM 2026][LLM4Rec] 预注册在线实验(N=759)+访谈(N=30)对比无解释/通用解释/情境化解释，情境化解释显著提升认知需求与观看意愿，但对功利/情感需求增益有限。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/large_language_m.title: From Counterfactual Edits to Human Narratives: LLM-Driven Interpretations for Recommender System Explanations
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/large_language_m.description: [CIKM 2026][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用 LLM 将冗长反事实编辑列表摘要为高层偏好叙事，并以人类校准指标评估正确性/信息量/语言质量。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/large_language_m.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用少样本提示探测 GPT/Llama 对 MovieLens-1M 的物品、用户与交互记忆覆盖率，揭示记忆量与推荐性能强相关且放大流行度偏置。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/large_language_m.title: Beyond Retrieval: Generating Narratives in Conversational Recommender Systems
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/large_language_m.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 构建 REGEN 叙事数据集并提出 CF+内容嵌入经 Adapter 注入 LLM 的融合架构，在 Office/Clothing 两域上 BLEU/ROUGE/语义相似度较单模态提升 4–12%。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/legommenders_a_c.description: [NeurIPS 2025 DB Track][大语言模型推荐] RecBench 系统对比 17 个 LLM 与 DLRM 在 4 种物品表征、CTR/SeqRec 双任务上的精度-效率权衡，LLM 精度领先但推理慢千倍。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/legommenders_a_c.description: [TKDE 2025][大语言模型推荐] 将传统协同过滤模型学到的用户/物品表征经 MLP 映射进 LLM 词嵌入空间，以两阶段调优兼顾暖启动与冷启动，AUC 相对 TALLRec 提升约 8%。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/legommenders_a_c.title: EAGER-LLM: Enhancing Large Language Models as Recommenders through Exogenous Behavior-Semantic Integration
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/legommenders_a_c.description: [WWW 2025][大语言模型推荐] 以双源知识富集物品索引+非侵入多尺度对齐重建+退火适配器，将外源行为/语义信号注入 LLM 生成式推荐，Amazon 三数据集 Full-Ranking 下 Recall@10 最高提升 26.16%。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/legommenders_a_c.title: Generative Large Recommendation Models: Emerging Trends in LLMs for Recommendation
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/legommenders_a_c.description: [WWW 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 系统梳理生成式大推荐模型范式：数据质量、缩放律、用户行为挖掘与训练推理效率四大议题及未来方向。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/legommenders_a_c.title: RALLRec: Improving Retrieval Augmented Large Language Model Recommendation with Representation Learning
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/legommenders_a_c.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 用 LLM 生成物品详述并做文本-协同表征对比对齐，配合时间感知重排器提升 RAG 式 LLM 推荐的检索质量。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/leveraging_llms_.title: Effectiveness of LLMs in Temporal User Profiling for Recommendation
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/leveraging_llms_.description: [ICDM 2025 Workshop][LLM4Rec] 用 LLM 分别生成短期/长期自然语言画像，经 SBERT 编码与注意力融合做内容推荐，Movies&TV 上 Recall@10 相对提升 17%。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/leveraging_llms_.title: Heterogeneous Influence Maximization in User Recommendation
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/leveraging_llms_.description: [CIKM 2025][社交与群组推荐] 将异质传播概率与 RR 集影响力最大化引入好友邀请推荐，HeteroIR/HeteroIM 在 NSpread/Recall/NDCG 全面领先并落地腾讯游戏 A/B 提升 8.5%/10%。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/leveraging_llms_.title: A Survey on LLM-powered Agents for Recommender Systems
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/leveraging_llms_.description: [ACL 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 系统综述 LLM Agent 推荐的三范式（推荐/交互/仿真）与四模块架构，梳理数据集与评测协议并指出统一评测缺失。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/leveraging_llms_.title: Beyond Utility: Evaluating LLM as Recommender
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/leveraging_llms_.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出含历史长度敏感性、候选位置偏差、画像生成与幻觉四维的 LLM 推荐多维评测框架，揭示 LLM 在重排与冷启动占优但位置偏差严重。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/leveraging_llms_.title: AgentRecBench: Benchmarking LLM Agent-based Personalized Recommender Systems
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/leveraging_llms_.description: [NeurIPS 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 首个 LLM 智能体推荐系统基准，构建 U-R-I 文本交互环境与三类场景，揭示结构化工作流智能体显著优于传统与朴素 Agent。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/leveraging_memor.title: Collaborative Memory Augmentation for Generative Recommendation
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/leveraging_memor.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐] 为生成式推荐引入跨用户协同记忆库，用可学习查询token压缩序列、目标感知检索与门控交叉注意力融合，Full-Ranking下NDCG@5最高提升23.7%。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/leveraging_memor.title: Enhancing Time Awareness in Generative Recommendation
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/leveraging_memor.description: [EMNLP 2025 Findings][生成式推荐] 将绝对时间戳与目标相对间隔verbalize进提示，并叠加全局转移图与免训练趋势重排，Full-Ranking下R@5最高提升15.4%。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/leveraging_memor.title: Lost in Sequence: Do Large Language Models Understand Sequential Recommendation?
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/leveraging_memor.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 揭示现有 LLM4Rec 模型无法捕捉交互序列顺序信息，提出冻结 LLM 与 CF-SRec、仅训练轻量 MLP 的蒸馏框架 LLM-SRec，在 Amazon 四数据集上 NDCG@10 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/leveraging_memor.title: Multi-Grained Patch Training for Efficient LLM-based Recommendation
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/leveraging_memor.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用层次化 item/session patch 压缩长交互历史，两阶段训练让 LLM 理解压缩表征，同 token 预算下 HR@20 最高提升 72%。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/leveraging_memor.title: Generative Archetype-Grounded Item Representations for Sequential Recommendation
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/leveraging_memor.description: [WWW 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用 LLM 生成物品“目标人群原型”文本并单次前向抽取 prefill/decoding 双嵌入，再以行为关联分数调制排斥力做校准，Full-Ranking 下 HR@10 最高 +6.95%。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/panoramic_intere.title: Enhancing News Recommendation with Hierarchical LLM Prompting
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/panoramic_intere.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 用分层提示让 LLM 生成更丰富的新闻标题与实体，作为模型无关的数据增强模块，在 MIND 上以 AUC 68.88 超越 GLoCIM 等 SOTA。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/panoramic_intere.title: CROWN: A Novel Approach to Comprehending Users' Preferences for Accurate Personalized News Recommendation
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/panoramic_intere.description: [WWW 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 以类别引导意图解耦、标题-内容一致性加权与 GNN 混合用户表征，统一解决新闻推荐的多意图、读后偏好差异与冷启动三大难题。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/panoramic_intere.title: LSNR: Learned Sparse News Recommendations with Attentive User Modeling
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/panoramic_intere.description: [SIGIR-AP 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用独立编码+注意力聚合替代 STAR 的历史拼接，构建双通路稀疏用户向量，MIND NDCG@10 较 STAR 提升 11%，短历史场景反超稠密模型。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/panoramic_intere.title: Mitigating Popularity Bias in Counterfactual Explanations using Large Language Models
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/panoramic_intere.description: [RecSys 2025][去偏公平与可信推荐] 用 LLM 生成用户画像并贪心剔除“出格”历史项，作为 ACCENT 反事实解释的即插即用预处理，使解释流行度分布更贴合用户偏好。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/panoramic_intere.title: Large Language Models as Narrative-Driven Recommenders
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/panoramic_intere.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 系统评测 38 个 LLM 在 Reddit 叙事式电影推荐上的表现，发现零样本提示即可显著超越 doc2vec 基线 70%+，中型开源模型接近大型闭源模型。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/rallrec_improvin.title: Rethinking LLM-Based Recommendations: A Personalized Query-Driven Parallel Integration
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/rallrec_improvin.description: [ACL 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出 QUEREC 并行框架，用 LLM 零样本生成个性化用户查询与特征增强物品描述，与 CF 模型并行全库检索后自适应重排，Full-Ranking 下最高提升 57%。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/rallrec_improvin.title: Collaborative Retrieval for Large Language Model-based Conversational Recommender Systems
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/rallrec_improvin.description: [WWW 2025][对话推荐与智能体] 用 EASE 协同检索 + 两步 LLM 反思重排为黑盒 LLM 注入 CF 知识，Reddit-v2/Redial 全库排序 Recall@20 显著超越 Zero-shot LLM。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/rallrec_improvin.title: Can LLMs Outshine Conventional Recommenders? A Comparative Evaluation
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/rallrec_improvin.description: [NeurIPS 2025 DB Track][大语言模型推荐] RecBench 系统对比 17 个 LLM 与 DLRM 在 4 种物品表征、CTR/SeqRec 双任务上的精度-效率权衡，LLM 精度领先但推理慢千倍。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/rallrec_improvin.title: ClusterRAG: Cluster-Based Collaborative Filtering for Personalized Retrieval-Augmented Generation
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/rallrec_improvin.description: [ACL 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用 HDBSCAN 将用户按画像嵌入聚类，簇内 ColBERTv2 排序选近邻，簇-文档两级检索融合协同画像做个性化 RAG，LaMP 全任务最优。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/rallrec_improvin.title: Knowledge Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation for LLM-based Recommendation
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/rallrec_improvin.description: [ACL 2025][LLM4Rec] 用跳场知识子图索引+流行度选择性检索+GNN软提示，将KG结构知识注入冻结LLM，MovieLens-1M ACC 相对提升58.6%且推理仅慢0.14s

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/samplellm_optimi.title: RecBase: Generative Foundation Model Pretraining for Zero-Shot Recommendation
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/samplellm_optimi.description: [EMNLP 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用课程学习增强的 RQ-VAE 将跨域物品统一离散为层级概念 ID，从零预训练 1.5B 自回归推荐基座，在 8 个未见数据集零样本 AUC 全面超越 7B LLM。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/samplellm_optimi.title: Token-level Collaborative Alignment for LLM-based Generative Recommendation
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/samplellm_optimi.description: [WWW 2026][LLM4Rec] 将CF物品级logits投影为token级分布并与one-hot融合成软标签，以soft-NTP损失显式对齐LLM生成，即插即用提升多骨干推荐效果。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/samplellm_optimi.title: Reason4Rec: Deliberative User Preference Alignment of Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/samplellm_optimi.description: [TKDE 2026][大语言模型推荐] 提出审慎推荐任务与三专家多步推理框架，用评论监督偏好蒸馏-匹配-预测，评分预测与排序全面领先。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/samplellm_optimi.title: ProMax: Exploring the Potential of LLM-derived Profiles with Distribution Shaping for Recommender Systems
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/samplellm_optimi.description: [SIGIR 2026][LLM推荐] 将 LLM 画像视为检索信号而非融合特征，用双路分布重塑（监督+自监督）引导基座模型，LightGCN 上 NDCG@10 最高提升 8.44%。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/samplellm_optimi.title: Generative Data Transformation: From Mixed to Unified Data
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/samplellm_optimi.description: [WWW 2026][跨域与多场景推荐] 提出数据侧范式 Taesar，用三模型对比解码把跨域混合序列重生成纯目标域序列，免改架构即插即用，Books HR@10 提升 29.4%。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/sprec_self_play_.title: DynamicPO: Dynamic Preference Optimization for Recommendation
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/sprec_self_play_.description: [DASFAA 2026][LLM4Rec] 揭示多负样本 DPO 的偏好优化坍缩现象，提出动态边界负样本选择与双边际动态 β 调整，即插即用提升 LLM 推荐 HitRatio@1。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/sprec_self_play_.title: Towards Fair Large Language Model-based Recommender Systems without Costly Retraining
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/sprec_self_play_.description: [WWW 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 将 LLM-RS 去偏重构为免重训机器遗忘任务：可学习掩码定位致偏样本 + 影响函数一步参数修正，公平性提升同时精度不降、耗时降 96%。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/sprec_self_play_.title: USB-Rec: An Effective Framework for Improving Conversational Recommendation Capability of Large Language Model
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/sprec_self_play_.description: [RecSys 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 用带标签用户模拟器自动构造偏好对做 RL 训练，再在推理期用内部用户模拟器+树搜索自增强，iEval 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/sprec_self_play_.title: What Makes LLMs Effective Sequential Recommenders? A Study on Preference Intensity and Temporal Context
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/sprec_self_play_.description: [ACL 2026][大语言模型推荐] 揭示二元偏好对齐丢失偏好强度与时序上下文，提出自适应奖励边际 RecPO，五数据集 HR@1 全面领先 S-DPO。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/sprec_self_play_.title: Lost in Sequence: Do Large Language Models Understand Sequential Recommendation?
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/sprec_self_play_.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 揭示现有 LLM4Rec 模型无法捕捉交互序列顺序信息，提出冻结 LLM 与 CF-SRec、仅训练轻量 MLP 的蒸馏框架 LLM-SRec，在 Amazon 四数据集上 NDCG@10 全面超越 SOTA。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/tf_dcon_leveragi.title: A Bi-Step Grounding Paradigm for Large Language Models in Recommendation Systems
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/tf_dcon_leveragi.description: [TORS 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出 BIGRec 两步接地范式：先指令微调 LLM 生成物品语义 token，再以 L2 距离对齐真实物品空间，全库排序下 1024 样本即超越全量训练基线。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/tf_dcon_leveragi.title: Thoroughly Modeling Multi-domain Pre-trained Recommendation as Language
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/tf_dcon_leveragi.description: [TOIS 2025][LLM4Rec] 将多域序列推荐彻底转为文本生成任务，用五项指标指导行为-文本双向适配，7 数据集微调与零样本均最优，NDCG@1 最高提升 23%。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/tf_dcon_leveragi.title: Mitigating Propensity Bias of Large Language Models for Recommender Systems
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/tf_dcon_leveragi.description: [TOIS 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用谱条件 iVAE 编码 LLM 侧信息避免维度坍缩，并以反事实推断消除 LLM 倾向性偏差，在 6 个 CF 骨干上全库排序一致提升。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/tf_dcon_leveragi.title: Music Recommendation with Large Language Models: Challenges, Opportunities, and Evaluation
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/tf_dcon_leveragi.description: [TORS 2026][LLM4Rec] 系统梳理 LLM 驱动音乐推荐在用户建模、物品建模与自然语言请求三方面的变革，并提出 NLP 启发的评估分类体系与 MRS 成功/风险维度框架。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/tf_dcon_leveragi.title: How Can Recommender Systems Benefit from Large Language Models: A Survey
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/tf_dcon_leveragi.description: [TOIS 2025][LLM4Rec] 以“WHERE×HOW”双正交视角系统梳理 LLM 融入推荐全链路的五阶段角色与四象限适配范式，并给出效率/效果/伦理三大挑战。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/training_large_r.title: Token-level Collaborative Alignment for LLM-based Generative Recommendation
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/training_large_r.description: [WWW 2026][LLM4Rec] 将CF物品级logits投影为token级分布并与one-hot融合成软标签，以soft-NTP损失显式对齐LLM生成，即插即用提升多骨干推荐效果。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/training_large_r.title: Enhancing Collaborative Semantics of Language Model-Driven Recommendations via Graph-Aware Learning
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/training_large_r.description: [TKDE 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用多跳提示+图感知对比学习把 GNN 聚合意图注入 LLM，在三个 Amazon/Yelp 数据集 Full-Ranking 下 HR@10 最高提升约 15%。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/training_large_r.title: Generative Recommender with End-to-End Learnable Item Tokenization
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/training_large_r.description: [SIGIR 2025][生成式推荐] 提出 ETEGRec 双编码器-解码器框架，用序列-物品对齐与偏好-语义对齐将 RQ-VAE 分词器与 T5 推荐器端到端联合优化，全库排序下 Recall@10 相对 LETTER 提升约 5%。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/training_large_r.title: CORONA: A Coarse-to-Fine Framework for Graph-based Recommendation with Large Language Models
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/training_large_r.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 LLM 做偏好/意图推理在交互图上逐级缩小候选子图，再由 GNN 精排，全库排序下 Recall 平均相对提升 18.6%。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/training_large_r.title: Graph-Sequential Alignment and Uniformity: Toward Enhanced Recommendation Systems
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/training_large_r.description: [WWW 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 以共享嵌入层联合训练 LightGCN 与 SASRec，用对齐-均匀性损失实现跨子模块知识迁移，Leave-One-Out 全库排序下 R@10 最高提升 13.4%。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/uncertainty_quan.title: Uncertainty-Aware Adaptive Recommendation across User Lifecycle
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/uncertainty_quan.description: [KDD 2026][强化学习与动态探索推荐] 用 EPE Critic 与经验贝叶斯先验方差量化逐样本认知不确定性，对低活跃用户风险规避降权、高活跃用户 UCB 探索加成，14 天线上 A/B 验证留存与多样性双收益。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/uncertainty_quan.title: Do LLMs Memorize Recommendation Datasets? A Preliminary Study on MovieLens-1M
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/uncertainty_quan.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用少样本提示探测 GPT/Llama 对 MovieLens-1M 的物品、用户与交互记忆覆盖率，揭示记忆量与推荐性能强相关且放大流行度偏置。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/uncertainty_quan.title: Beyond Utility: Evaluating LLM as Recommender
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/uncertainty_quan.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出含历史长度敏感性、候选位置偏差、画像生成与幻觉四维的 LLM 推荐多维评测框架，揭示 LLM 在重排与冷启动占优但位置偏差严重。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/uncertainty_quan.title: Harnessing Light for Cold-Start Recommendations: Leveraging Epistemic Uncertainty to Enhance Performance in User-Item Interactions
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/uncertainty_quan.description: [CIKM 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 用集成 CVAE 生成暖化嵌入，并以 Sinkhorn 散度版 PaiDE 估计认知不确定性做优化，在冷启动 CTR 上稳定超越 CVAR 等基线。

venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/uncertainty_quan.title: Can LLMs Outshine Conventional Recommenders? A Comparative Evaluation
venues/WWW/2025/llm_rec/uncertainty_quan.description: [NeurIPS 2025 DB Track][大语言模型推荐] RecBench 系统对比 17 个 LLM 与 DLRM 在 4 种物品表征、CTR/SeqRec 双任务上的精度-效率权衡，LLM 精度领先但推理慢千倍。

venues/WWW/2025/multi_task_reranking/a_h.title: Not All Candidates are Created Equal: A Heterogeneity-Aware Approach to Pre-ranking in Recommender Systems
venues/WWW/2025/multi_task_reranking/a_h.description: [WWW 2026][多任务学习与列表级重排] 针对粗排异构候选的梯度冲突与算力错配，提出 GHCL 分组对比损失与难度感知双模型路由，AUC 全面超越 SOTA 且线上降本 6%。

venues/WWW/2025/multi_task_reranking/a_h.title: Killing Two Birds with One Stone: Unifying Retrieval and Ranking with a Single Generative Recommendation Model
venues/WWW/2025/multi_task_reranking/a_h.description: [SIGIR 2025][生成式推荐] 将召回与排序统一为单生成模型的位置级序列生成任务，配合排序驱动增强器与梯度自适应加权实现协同与同步优化，全库排序下召回排序双提升。

venues/WWW/2025/multi_task_reranking/a_h.title: InteractRank: Personalized Web-Scale Search Pre-Ranking with Cross Interaction Features
venues/WWW/2025/multi_task_reranking/a_h.description: [WWW 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 在双塔预排序点积之上叠加历史交互统计特征 IQP 与实时用户序列，以 1.1× FLOPs 实现线上 SIFR +6.5%、F1S +9.2%。

venues/WWW/2025/multi_task_reranking/a_h.title: GReF: A Unified Generative Framework for Efficient Reranking via Ordered Multi-token Prediction
venues/WWW/2025/multi_task_reranking/a_h.description: [CIKM 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用双向编码器+动态匹配自回归解码器统一生成式重排，Rerank-DPO 端到端对齐用户偏好，OMTP 多token并行解码将延迟压至 12.97ms，快手线上转发+2.98%。

venues/WWW/2025/multi_task_reranking/a_h.title: CSMF: Cascaded Selective Mask Fine-Tuning for Multi-Objective Embedding-Based Retrieval
venues/WWW/2025/multi_task_reranking/a_h.description: [SIGIR 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 借鉴 PEFT 选择性掩码思想，按曝光→点击→转化级联顺序分阶段微调双塔召回，零参数增量实现多目标融合检索。

venues/WWW/2025/multi_task_reranking/llm.title: Profiling What Matters: Context-Aware Item Profiles from Large-Scale Metadata for LLM Recommenders
venues/WWW/2025/multi_task_reranking/llm.description: [CIKM 2026][大语言模型推荐] 将海量异构物品元数据结构化并训练轻量选择器，为每个用户-物品对动态生成上下文相关画像，显著提升 LLM 重排效果。

venues/WWW/2025/multi_task_reranking/llm.title: Rankformer: A Graph Transformer for Recommendation based on Ranking Objective
venues/WWW/2025/multi_task_reranking/llm.description: [WWW 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 从 BPR 梯度下降推导出图 Transformer 层，正负样本分离聚合+基准项+偏移项，线性加速后 4 数据集平均提升 4.48%

venues/WWW/2025/multi_task_reranking/llm.title: Rethinking LLM-Based Recommendations: A Personalized Query-Driven Parallel Integration
venues/WWW/2025/multi_task_reranking/llm.description: [ACL 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出 QUEREC 并行框架，用 LLM 零样本生成个性化用户查询与特征增强物品描述，与 CF 模型并行全库检索后自适应重排，Full-Ranking 下最高提升 57%。

venues/WWW/2025/multi_task_reranking/llm.title: Comprehensive List Generation for Multi-Generator Reranking
venues/WWW/2025/multi_task_reranking/llm.description: [SIGIR 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 提出多生成器-评估器重排框架与列表全面性指标，用 CLIG 自动学习互补生成器，离线 AUC 提升 0.9%、线上观看时长 +0.48%。

venues/WWW/2025/multi_task_reranking/llm.title: Breaking the Likelihood Trap: Consistent Generative Recommendation with Graph-structured Model
venues/WWW/2025/multi_task_reranking/llm.description: [KDD 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用有向无环图解码器扩展非自回归生成空间，并以 Gumbel-Softmax 打通评估器梯度，破解似然陷阱，快手线上 Views +0.78%。

venues/WWW/2025/multi_task_reranking/nlg.description: [CIKM 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用双向编码器+动态匹配自回归解码器统一生成式重排，Rerank-DPO 端到端对齐用户偏好，OMTP 多token并行解码将延迟压至 12.97ms，快手线上转发+2.98%。

venues/WWW/2025/multi_task_reranking/nlg.title: DeGRe: Dense-supervised Generative Reranking for Recommendation

venues/WWW/2025/multi_task_reranking/nlg.title: GoalRank: Group-Relative Optimization for a Large Ranking Model
venues/WWW/2025/multi_task_reranking/nlg.description: [ICLR 2026][多任务学习与列表级重排] 证明单生成器排序器近似误差严格优于多生成器-评估器，提出组相对优化训练大排序模型，离线 H@6 最高 +25.4%，线上全量部署。

venues/WWW/2025/multi_task_reranking/nlg.title: You Only Evaluate Once: A Tree-based Rerank Method at Meituan
venues/WWW/2025/multi_task_reranking/nlg.description: [CIKM 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 用树状多尺度上下文提取+上下文缓存实现单阶段全排列重排，离线GAUC显著提升并落地美团外卖。

venues/WWW/2025/multi_task_reranking/pcl.title: Continual Recommender Systems
venues/WWW/2025/multi_task_reranking/pcl.description: [CIKM 2025][序列与会话推荐] 系统梳理持续推荐的两大技术路线（经验回放与正则化），并延伸至资源受限与序列交互场景，给出可信性、基础模型与搜推统一三大开放方向。

venues/WWW/2025/multi_task_reranking/pcl.title: Efficient Multi-task Prompt Tuning for Recommendation

venues/WWW/2025/multi_task_reranking/pcl.title: Capturing User Interests from Data Streams for Continual Sequential Recommendation
venues/WWW/2025/multi_task_reranking/pcl.description: [WSDM 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用线性注意力参数化记忆替代回放/正则，配合 Cauchy-Schwarz 归一化与共享兴趣池，在流式数据块上兼顾历史保留与新兴趣获取。

venues/WWW/2025/multi_task_reranking/pcl.title: KuaiRecV2: Benchmarking Large-Scale Continual Learning for Diversified and Multi-task Recommendation
venues/WWW/2025/multi_task_reranking/pcl.description: [NeurIPS 2026][去偏公平、可信隐私与工业架构] 快手 30 天 4.84 亿交互动态物品池基准，统一评测持续学习、Token 级多样性与多任务检索。

venues/WWW/2025/multi_task_reranking/pcl.title: Mosaic: A Fleet of User Embedding Specialists for Recommendation at Meta

venues/WWW/2025/multi_task_reranking/xmt.title: Efficient Multi-task Prompt Tuning for Recommendation

venues/WWW/2025/multi_task_reranking/xmt.title: Combinatorial Optimization Perspective based Framework for Multi-behavior Recommendation

venues/WWW/2025/sequential_rec/efficient.description: [ICDM 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用可学习 token 将长历史分段压缩为个性化专家，配合定制注意力掩码与 KV 缓存，在 HSTU/HLLM 上以约 1/4 推理开销逼近全序列精度。

venues/WWW/2025/sequential_rec/efficient.title: Closing the Long-Short View Gap in Sequential Recommendation without Cached History

venues/WWW/2025/sequential_rec/efficient.title: GLINT-RU: Gated Lightweight Intelligent Recurrent Units for Sequential Recommender Systems

venues/WWW/2025/sequential_rec/flare_fus.title: The Mental World of Large Language Models in Recommendation: A Benchmark on Association, Personalization, and Knowledgeability
venues/WWW/2025/sequential_rec/flare_fus.description: [KDD 2025][LLM4Rec] 提出 LRWorld 基准（38K 样本/23M tokens），从关联、个性化、知识性三尺度十因素 31 任务系统评测数十个 LLM，揭示其在神经嵌入检索上的致命短板。

venues/WWW/2025/sequential_rec/flare_fus.title: LLM2Rec: Large Language Models Are Powerful Embedding Models for Sequential Recommendation
venues/WWW/2025/sequential_rec/flare_fus.description: [KDD 2025][大语言模型推荐] 两阶段将 LLM 改造为融合协同信号与语义的物品嵌入模型，Full-Ranking 下域内平均提升约 15%、跨域仍稳定增益。

venues/WWW/2025/sequential_rec/flare_fus.title: Exploring the Upper Limits of Text-Based Collaborative Filtering Using Large Language Models: Discoveries and Insights
venues/WWW/2025/sequential_rec/flare_fus.description: [CIKM 2025][LLM4Rec] 将 TCF 物品编码器从 125M 一路放大到 175B，系统检验缩放极限、通用表征、对 IDCF 的竞争力与零样本迁移四项命题。

venues/WWW/2025/sequential_rec/large_mem.title: Efficient Sequential Recommendation for Long Term User Interest Via Personalization

venues/WWW/2025/sequential_rec/large_mem.title: Large Language Model Simulator for Cold-Start Recommendation
venues/WWW/2025/sequential_rec/large_mem.description: [WSDM 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 用 LLM 模拟冷物品的用户交互行为，并以耦合漏斗（FAISS 过滤 + LLM 精炼）把十亿级候选压到数百，离线冷召回 NDCG 提升 37%+，线上冷启 GMV +16.9%。

venues/WWW/2025/sequential_rec/large_mem.title: Closing the Long-Short View Gap in Sequential Recommendation without Cached History
venues/WWW/2025/sequential_rec/large_mem.description: [CIKM 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用角度相似度打分+softmax1 修正长视训练几何缺陷，再仅微调 Bias/LayerNorm 实现无缓存短视推理，短窗下反超全序列基线。

venues/WWW/2025/sequential_rec/retrieval.title: TokenRec: Learning to Tokenize ID for LLM-based Generative Recommendation
venues/WWW/2025/sequential_rec/retrieval.description: [TKDE 2025][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用掩码K路向量量化把GNN协同表征压成LLM兼容离散token，并以生成式检索替代自回归解码，HR@20平均提升约19%、推理加速超10倍。

venues/WWW/2025/sequential_rec/td3_tucke.title: GLINT-RU: Gated Lightweight Intelligent Recurrent Units for Sequential Recommender Systems

venues/WWW/2025/sequential_rec/td3_tucke.title: One Sequential Recommendation Model Pretrained from Synthetic Priors Predicts Multiple Datasets

venues/WWW/2026/agent_conversational_rec.title: Recommendation and Temptation
venues/WWW/2026/agent_conversational_rec.description: [RecSys 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 将用户选择解耦为 enrichment 与 temptation 双效用并引入站外选项，证明局部贪心最优并给出可估计算子，MovieLens 与仿真全面超越基线。

venues/WWW/2026/agent_conversational_rec.title: Mend the Measurement Gap: Latent User Preference Modeling for Short-Form Video Recommendation
venues/WWW/2026/agent_conversational_rec.description: [RecSys 2026][多模态推荐] 将异构行为反馈视为隐价值状态的噪声测量，用受限基线+因子化路由瓶颈解耦时长混杂，YouTube Shorts 线上主指标提升 2.67%

venues/WWW/2026/agent_conversational_rec.title: Exploiting Fine-Grained Skip Behaviors for Micro-Video Recommendation

venues/WWW/2026/cold_start_rec/llm_reaso.title: Large Language Model Simulator for Cold-Start Recommendation
venues/WWW/2026/cold_start_rec/llm_reaso.description: [WSDM 2025][冷启动与长尾推荐] 用 LLM 模拟冷物品的用户交互行为，并以耦合漏斗（FAISS 过滤 + LLM 精炼）把十亿级候选压到数百，离线冷召回 NDCG 提升 37%+，线上冷启 GMV +16.9%。

venues/WWW/2026/cold_start_rec/llm_reaso.title: Pre-trained LLMs Meet Sequential Recommenders: Efficient User-Centric Knowledge Distillation

venues/WWW/2026/cold_start_rec/tail_awar.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用自适应门控融合 ID/LLM 嵌入并以双层对齐+课程学习消除空间结构冲突，全库排序下尾部长尾 H@10 最高提升 427%。

venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/iterative_semant.title: Bridging the User-side Knowledge Gap in Knowledge-aware Recommendations with Large Language Models
venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/iterative_semant.description: [AAAI 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 LLM 推断用户兴趣并结构化为 CIKG 异构图，配合兴趣重建与跨域对比学习去噪，在三个数据集全库排序下 R@100 最高提升 9.31%。

venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/iterative_semant.title: ProEx: A Unified Framework Leveraging Large Language Model with Profile Extrapolation for Recommendation
venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/iterative_semant.description: [KDD 2026][大语言模型推荐] 用四步 CoT 为每个用户/物品生成多面画像并做环境不变性融合，在三个数据集上对 6 个基模型平均提升 5%+。

venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/iterative_semant.title: SPRIG: Semantic-ID-enhanced Paths for Knowledge Graph-based Generative Recommendation
venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/iterative_semant.description: [CIKM 2026][生成式推荐] 将内容派生的分层语义 ID 注入知识图谱路径语言建模，以 768 个共享码替代逐物品词表，nDCG@10 较 KGGLM 提升 44%/58% 且参数与算力更低。

venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/raie_region_awar.title: GenRecEdit: Adapting Model Editing for Generative Recommendation with Cold-Start Items
venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/raie_region_awar.description: [SIGIR 2026][冷启动与长尾推荐] 将 NLP 模型编辑迁移至生成式推荐，用逐位置定位-编辑+One-One 触发注入冷启动物品 SID 模式，仅需重训 9.5% 时间即大幅缓解冷启动坍缩。

venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/raie_region_awar.title: CRAMER: Control via Request-Aware Masking for Editing Recommenders
venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/raie_region_awar.description: [ICML 2026][序列与会话推荐] 将自然语言请求编码为稀疏行列门控掩码，对冻结序列推荐骨干做后验行为编辑，采样100负例排序下全面超越四类请求感知基线且推理仅增0.018s。

venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/raie_region_awar.title: Balancing Fine-tuning and RAG: A Hybrid Strategy for Dynamic LLM Recommendation Updates
venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/raie_region_awar.description: [RecSys 2025][LLM4Rec] 以十亿用户短视频兴趣探索系统为案例，量化对比微调与RAG的更新代价/敏捷性，提出月度微调+周内RAG刷新的混合更新策略，线上A/B显著提升满意度。

venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/raie_region_awar.title: CoLLM: Integrating Collaborative Embeddings into Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/raie_region_awar.description: [TKDE 2025][大语言模型推荐] 将传统协同过滤模型学到的用户/物品表征经 MLP 映射进 LLM 词嵌入空间，以两阶段调优兼顾暖启动与冷启动，AUC 相对 TALLRec 提升约 8%。

venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/raie_region_awar.title: What Makes LLMs Effective Sequential Recommenders? A Study on Preference Intensity and Temporal Context
venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/raie_region_awar.description: [ACL 2026][大语言模型推荐] 揭示二元偏好对齐丢失偏好强度与时序上下文，提出自适应奖励边际 RecPO，五数据集 HR@1 全面领先 S-DPO。

venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/taosr_agrl_adapt.title: ADORE: Autonomous Domain-Oriented Relevance Engine for E-commerce
venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/taosr_agrl_adapt.description: [SIGIR 2025][LLM4Rec] 用 CoT-LLM 自动挖掘难样本、KTO 对齐用户行为、错误类型感知合成对抗样本，再以关键属性显式蒸馏到轻量 BERT，离线 F1 85.45%、线上 CTR +1.24%。

venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/taosr_agrl_adapt.title: EAGER: Enrich-and-Align Generative Query Recommendation from Clicked Items in E-commerce Search
venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/taosr_agrl_adapt.description: [EMNLP 2026 Industry][LLM4Rec] 两阶段生成式 I2Q 查询推荐：课程化 SFT 扩意图覆盖 + GRPO 混合奖励对齐线上约束，线上 UCTR +0.83%、Pay Count +3.49%。

venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/taosr_agrl_adapt.title: Think before Recommendation: Autonomous Reasoning-enhanced Recommender
venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/taosr_agrl_adapt.description: [NeurIPS 2025][LLM4Rec] 用纯 GRPO 强化学习替代教师蒸馏，让单个 LLM 自主习得「用户分析→物品分析→匹配→打分」推理链，评分预测 MAE 最高降 29.9%。

venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/taosr_agrl_adapt.title: Relevance Matters: A Multi-Task and Multi-Stage Large Language Model Approach for E-commerce Query Rewriting
venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/taosr_agrl_adapt.description: [ICDE 2026][LLM4Rec] 将相关性打标任务注入电商查询改写，多任务 SFT + 查询级归一化 GRPO 融合奖励对齐，离线召回 67.94%、线上 UCVR +0.181%。

venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/taosr_agrl_adapt.title: STARec: An Efficient Agent Framework for Recommender Systems via Autonomous Deliberate Reasoning
venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/taosr_agrl_adapt.description: [CIKM 2025][对话推荐与智能体仿真] 将每位用户建模为具备快/慢双认知的 LLM Agent，用 SFT 蒸馏 + GRPO 排序奖励两阶段训练，仅用 0.4% 数据即在 ML-1M/CDs 上超越全量训练基线。

venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/thinkrec_thinkin.title: Improving LLM-powered Recommendations with Personalized Information
venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/thinkrec_thinkin.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 将用户偏好与物品感知两条 CoT 显式抽取并注入 CRM 召回与 LLM 重排，Leave-One-Out 全库排序下 Hit@10 最高提升约 11%，并显著降低位置偏差。

venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/thinkrec_thinkin.title: Reason4Rec: Deliberative User Preference Alignment of Large Language Models for Recommendation
venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/thinkrec_thinkin.description: [TKDE 2026][大语言模型推荐] 提出审慎推荐任务与三专家多步推理框架，用评论监督偏好蒸馏-匹配-预测，评分预测与排序全面领先。

venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/thinkrec_thinkin.title: Think before Recommendation: Autonomous Reasoning-enhanced Recommender
venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/thinkrec_thinkin.description: [NeurIPS 2025][LLM4Rec] 用纯 GRPO 强化学习替代教师蒸馏，让单个 LLM 自主习得「用户分析→物品分析→匹配→打分」推理链，评分预测 MAE 最高降 29.9%。

venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/thinkrec_thinkin.title: MGFRec: Towards Reinforced Reasoning Recommendation with Multiple Groundings and Feedback
venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/thinkrec_thinkin.description: [KDD 2026][大语言模型推荐] 将单步 grounding 扩展为多轮物品空间接地并引入用户 Agent 反馈，用 GRPO 训练 LLM 推理推荐，Full-Ranking 下 H@5 最高提升约 8.8%。

venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/thinkrec_thinkin.title: Personalized Recommendation Tool Learning via Autonomous Language Agents
venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/thinkrec_thinkin.description: [RecSys 2026][LLM4Rec] 让 LLM 智能体做个性化工具选择、传统推荐模型做全库打分，以架构设计绕开幻觉与上下文长度限制，Full-Ranking 下 R@10 最高提升 68.8%。

venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/token_level_coll.title: Learning Decomposed Contextual Token Representations from Pretrained and Collaborative Signals for Generative Recommendation
venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/token_level_coll.description: [SIGIR 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] DECOR 用冻结码本+可学协同嵌入分解融合、上下文 token 组合与可学 BOS 查询，缓解静态分词歧义与预训练语义丢失，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@10 最高提升 14%。

venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/token_level_coll.title: Generative Recommender with End-to-End Learnable Item Tokenization
venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/token_level_coll.description: [SIGIR 2025][生成式推荐] 提出 ETEGRec 双编码器-解码器框架，用序列-物品对齐与偏好-语义对齐将 RQ-VAE 分词器与 T5 推荐器端到端联合优化，全库排序下 Recall@10 相对 LETTER 提升约 5%。

venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/token_level_coll.title: Distribution-Level Contrastive Supervision for Generative Recommendation
venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/token_level_coll.description: [RecSys 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 用分词器多层码本概率分布作软语义目标，以负对称KL+BPR对比监督对齐推荐器表征，即插即用提升多种生成式骨干。

venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/token_level_coll.title: Process-Supervised LLM Recommenders via Flow-guided Tuning
venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/token_level_coll.description: [SIGIR 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 GFlowNet 将物品级奖励分解为 token 级过程奖励，替代 SFT 的似然最大化，在 Amazon 三数据集上同时提升准确率、公平性与多样性。

venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/token_level_coll.title: Training Large Recommendation Models via Graph-Language Token Alignment
venues/WWW/2026/llm_rec/token_level_coll.description: [WWW 2025][LLM4Rec] 将 LightGCN 用户/物品节点经投影器对齐进 LLaMA-2 词表空间，用 GLLM logits 匹配层做端到端物品预测，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@10 最高提升 185%。

venues/WWW/2026/multi_task_reranking/not.title: A Hybrid Cross-Stage Coordination Pre-ranking Model for Online Recommendation Systems
venues/WWW/2026/multi_task_reranking/not.description: [WWW 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 提出 HCCP 粗排模型，融合上游召回与下游精排多级未曝光样本，用 Margin InfoNCE 联合优化一致性与长尾精度，JD 线上 UCVR+14.9%。

venues/WWW/2026/multi_task_reranking/not.title: GRank: Towards Target-Aware and Streamlined Industrial Retrieval with a Generate-Rank Framework

venues/WWW/2026/multimodal_rec/personali.title: NoteLLM-2: Multimodal Large Representation Models for Recommendation

venues/WWW/2026/multimodal_rec/personali.description: [AAAI 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 MLLM 将商品图转为文本摘要，再以循环式提示推断动态用户偏好，SFT 微调 LLaVA 做多模态序列推荐，AUC 最高提升约 4.3%。

venues/WWW/2026/multimodal_rec/prism_per.description: [ICDE 2026][多模态推荐] 用类别预测任务引导注意力 MoE 动态分配模态权重，并以模态交换对比学习对齐跨模态序列表征，Full-Ranking 下 NDCG@5 最高提升 15.3%。

venues/WWW/2026/multimodal_rec/prism_per.description: [AAAI 2025][大语言模型推荐] 用 MLLM 将商品图转为文本摘要，再以循环式提示推断动态用户偏好，SFT 微调 LLaVA 做多模态序列推荐，AUC 最高提升约 4.3%。

venues/WWW/2026/multimodal_rec/prism_per.description: [ACM MM 2025][多模态推荐] 将各模态视为独立语义环境做 IRM 不变学习，并用 IB 压缩模态特有信息，在模态缺失场景下 Full-Ranking Recall@20 稳定提升 2%–4%。

venues/WWW/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/a.title: Think2Go: Generative Next POI Recommendation with LLM Reasoning
venues/WWW/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/a.description: [KDD 2026][时空轨迹与POI推荐] 统一SFT与RL推理的生成式Next-POI框架，用KDE时空认知不确定性与难度感知奖励差校准优势函数，Acc@1较GNPR提升5.8–7.5%。

venues/WWW/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/a.title: SPOT-Trip: Dual-Preference Driven Out-of-Town Trip Recommendation
venues/WWW/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/a.description: [NeurIPS 2025][时空轨迹与POI推荐] 首次形式化异地行程推荐，用知识图谱静态偏好+Neural ODE动态偏好解耦建模，F1最高提升17.01%。
