venues/WWW/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/a.description: [ACL 2025 Findings][时空轨迹与POI本地生活推荐] 构建50万真实POI与近4000条真人行程的个性化旅行规划基准，提出可行性/合理性/个性化三维评估与奖励模型对比框架，揭示SOTA LLM行程超越真人比例不足10%。

venues/WWW/2026/poi_spatiotemporal_rec/a.title: Predicting User Behavior in Smart Spaces with LLM-Enhanced Logs and Personalized Prompts

venues/WWW/2026/sequential_rec/make_it_l.description: [ICLR 2026][序列与会话推荐] VISTA 将超长用户历史两阶段解耦：离线用准线性注意力压缩为数百种子嵌入并缓存，下游仅做候选-摘要注意力，工业上线推理 GPU 降 94%。

venues/WWW/2026/sequential_rec/make_it_l.title: Closing the Long-Short View Gap in Sequential Recommendation without Cached History
venues/WWW/2026/sequential_rec/make_it_l.description: [CIKM 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用角度相似度打分+softmax1 修正长视训练几何缺陷，再仅微调 Bias/LayerNorm 实现无缓存短视推理，短窗下反超全序列基线。

venues/WWW/2026/sequential_rec/make_it_l.title: Towards Generalizable and Efficient Large-Scale Generative Recommenders
venues/WWW/2026/sequential_rec/make_it_l.description: [RecSys 2026][生成式推荐与离散语义ID] 将生成式推荐骨干从2M扩至1B，用偏移幂律缩放律诊断任务天花板，并以MTP、采样softmax与语义塔解决缓存陈旧与冷启动，1M用户影子MRR全线提升。

venues/WWW/2026/sequential_rec/mixture_o.title: STAR-Rec: Making Peace with Length Variance and Pattern Diversity in Sequential Recommendation
venues/WWW/2026/sequential_rec/mixture_o.description: [SIGIR 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用偏好感知注意力与 SSM 双路径自适应融合 + 序列级 MoE，统一建模长度方差与行为模式多样性，Leave-One-Out 全库排序下 Recall@10 最高提升 2.15%。

venues/WWW/2026/sequential_rec/mixture_o.title: DP-Rec: Towards Dynamic Patching for Efficient Long-Sequence Recommendation
venues/WWW/2026/sequential_rec/mixture_o.description: [RecSys 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用对比熵惊讶度动态切分长交互序列为变长行为块，在 FLOPs 匹配下 NDCG@10 最高提升 21.1%，实现更优效率-精度前沿。

venues/WWW/2026/sequential_rec/mixture_o.title: RoTE: Coarse-to-Fine Multi-Level Rotary Time Embedding for Sequential Recommendation
venues/WWW/2026/sequential_rec/mixture_o.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 将时间戳分解为年/月/日多粒度并借 RoPE 旋转注入 Q/K，即插即用提升 SASRec/RPG，NDCG@5 最高 +20.11%

venues/WWW/2026/sequential_rec/mixture_o.title: HORIZON: A Benchmark for In-the-wild User Behaviour Modeling
venues/WWW/2026/sequential_rec/mixture_o.description: [ACL 2026 Findings][跨域与多场景推荐] 重构 Amazon Reviews 为 54M 用户跨域长程基准，提出时间-用户双轴四象限评估与 LLM 查询改写/长程建模任务，揭示 ID 模型在时间外推下崩塌。

venues/WWW/2026/sequential_rec/mixture_o.title: Modeling Stage-wise Evolution of User Interests for News Recommendation
venues/WWW/2026/sequential_rec/mixture_o.description: [WWW 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用全局LightGCN+阶段时序子图LSTM/自注意力双分支建模新闻兴趣演化，Adressa AUC 0.7993 大幅超越SOTA。

venues/WWW/2026/sequential_rec/modeling_.title: CPMR: Context-Aware Incremental Sequential Recommendation with Pseudo-Multi-Task Learning
venues/WWW/2026/sequential_rec/modeling_.description: [CIKM 2023][序列与会话推荐] 提出伪多任务学习范式，用历史图与上下文图双通道演化用户/物品时序状态，在四个数据集上 MRR 平均提升 30.98%。

venues/WWW/2026/sequential_rec/modeling_.title: RoTE: Coarse-to-Fine Multi-Level Rotary Time Embedding for Sequential Recommendation
venues/WWW/2026/sequential_rec/modeling_.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 将时间戳分解为年/月/日多粒度并借 RoPE 旋转注入 Q/K，即插即用提升 SASRec/RPG，NDCG@5 最高 +20.11%

venues/WWW/2026/sequential_rec/modeling_.title: Unleashing the Potential of Sparse Attention on Long-term Behaviors for CTR Prediction
venues/WWW/2026/sequential_rec/modeling_.description: [WWW 2026][CTR预估与特征交叉] 面向长行为序列 CTR 的个性化时间分块 + 三分支稀疏注意力 SparseCTR，AUC 相对提升 8.49%，线上 CTR +1.72%。

venues/WWW/2026/sequential_rec/modeling_.title: Mixture of Sequence: Theme-Aware Mixture-of-Experts for Long-Sequence Recommendation
venues/WWW/2026/sequential_rec/modeling_.description: [WWW 2026][序列与会话推荐] 揭示长序列“会话跳跃”现象，用主题码本路由+多尺度专家融合做子序列抽取，AUC 平均提升 0.68% 且 FLOPs 更低

venues/WWW/2026/sequential_rec/modeling_.title: STAR-Rec: Making Peace with Length Variance and Pattern Diversity in Sequential Recommendation
venues/WWW/2026/sequential_rec/modeling_.description: [SIGIR 2025][序列与会话推荐] 用偏好感知注意力与 SSM 双路径自适应融合 + 序列级 MoE，统一建模长度方差与行为模式多样性，Leave-One-Out 全库排序下 Recall@10 最高提升 2.15%。

venues/WWW/2026/sequential_rec/vk_lsvd_a.title: A Content-Driven Micro-Video Recommendation Dataset at Scale
venues/WWW/2026/sequential_rec/vk_lsvd_a.description: [CIKM 2025][多模态推荐] 发布十亿级含原始视频模态的微视频推荐数据集 MicroLens，并系统基准 IDRec/VIDRec/VideoRec 三类范式，揭示端到端视频编码优于冻结特征的关键结论。

venues/WWW/2026/sequential_rec/vk_lsvd_a.title: Short Video Segment-level User Dynamic Interests Modeling in Personalized Recommendation
venues/WWW/2026/sequential_rec/vk_lsvd_a.description: [SIGIR 2025][多模态推荐] 将短视频切分为5秒片段，用CLIP视觉+ID双模态跨注意力建模片段级动态兴趣，以段内排序损失解决标签缺失，在跳看预测与视频推荐两任务上大幅超越基线。

venues/WWW/2026/sequential_rec/vk_lsvd_a.title: SequenceO1: End-to-End Ultra-Long (100K) Sequence Modeling in Recommendation with Low-Rank Caching
venues/WWW/2026/sequential_rec/vk_lsvd_a.description: [RecSys 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用可学习原型压缩 100K 历史为定长 sketch 并缓存复用，端到端精排训练/推理 FLOPs 降 49.9×/63.9×，线上 Finish +2.33%。

venues/WWW/2026/sequential_rec/vk_lsvd_a.title: Binge Watch: Reproducible Multimodal Benchmark Datasets for Large-Scale Movie Recommendation on MovieLens-10M and 20M
venues/WWW/2026/sequential_rec/vk_lsvd_a.description: [RecSys 2026][多模态推荐] 为 ML-10M/20M 构建可复现多模态基准 M3L（剧情/海报/预告片文本-图像-视频-音频），保留>90%交互并验证音频模态的关键增益。

venues/WWW/2026/sequential_rec/vk_lsvd_a.title: Beyond Item IDs: Scaling Short-Form-Video Recommendation via Semantic-Native Long Sequence Modeling
venues/WWW/2026/sequential_rec/vk_lsvd_a.description: [SIGIR 2026][序列与会话推荐] 用深度截断 Bi-gram 语义 ID 替代正交 Video ID，并以无参时间折叠压缩 Transformer 将序列扩至 2000，线上满意观看时长 +1.42%。

venues/WWW/2026/social_group_rec/from_ag.title: Community-Aware Social Community Recommendation
venues/WWW/2026/social_group_rec/from_ag.description: [CIKM 2025][社交与群组推荐] 提出 CASO，用模块度最大化、社交紧密度聚合与协同编码三路解耦用户表征，并以 HSIC 互斥与 KL 社区检测损失优化，在 6 个真实社交网络上 Full-Ranking 全面超越 9 个基线。

venues/WWW/2026/social_group_rec/from_ag.title: Score-based Generative Diffusion Models for Social Recommendations
venues/WWW/2026/social_group_rec/from_ag.description: [TKDE 2025][社交与群组推荐] 用 SDE 扩散模型在隐空间直接生成协同一致的社交表征，配合课程训练与跨域对比学习，Full-Ranking 下 Recall@10 相对提升 1.85%–3.07%。

venues/WWW/2026/social_group_rec/from_ag.title: LLM4Rerank: LLM-based Auto-Reranking Framework for Recommendations
venues/WWW/2026/social_group_rec/from_ag.description: [WWW 2025][多任务学习与列表级重排] 将准确性/多样性/公平性抽象为全连接图节点，用零样本 LLM 以 CoT 多跳自动重排，三数据集上多准则均衡超越 SOTA。

venues/WWW/2026/social_group_rec/from_ag.title: Quantifying User Coherence: A Unified Framework for Analyzing Recommender Systems Across Domains
venues/WWW/2026/social_group_rec/from_ag.description: [WWW 2026][去偏公平与工业架构] 提出 Mean Surprise 与 Mean Conditional Surprise 两个信息论度量刻画用户画像一致性，揭示复杂模型增益集中于高一致用户，并支撑分层评测与用户分群建模。

venues/WWW/2026/social_group_rec/from_ag.title: Creator-Side Recommender System: Challenges, Designs, and Applications
venues/WWW/2026/social_group_rec/from_ag.description: [WWW 2025][去偏公平与工业架构] 提出创作者侧推荐系统 DualRec，将用户侧召回/排序镜像为物品找用户，并用用户可用性计算 UAC 解决用户可达性问题，快手线上 DAC 提升 2.9%。

venues/WWW/2026/social_group_rec/pulse_s.title: Graph Cross-Correlated Network for Recommendation
venues/WWW/2026/social_group_rec/pulse_s.description: [TKDE 2025][图神经网络与知识图谱推荐] 用非递归 PGR 保留各跳邻居纯语义，再以 HCC/ECC 显式建模用户-物品子图交叉相关项，全库排序下 NDCG@20 平均提升约 1.8%–2.9%。

venues/WWW/2026/social_group_rec/pulse_s.title: AlphaFree: Recommendation Free from Users, IDs, and GNNs
venues/WWW/2026/social_group_rec/pulse_s.description: [WWW 2026][大语言模型推荐] 用语言表征替代ID、在线推断用户偏好、以相似物品增强+对比对齐替代GNN，实现无用户/无ID/无GNN的轻量推荐，内存降69%、冷启动提升26–38%。

venues/WWW/2026/social_group_rec/pulse_s.title: A Node-Aware Dynamic Quantization Approach for Graph Collaborative Filtering
venues/WWW/2026/social_group_rec/pulse_s.description: [CIKM 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 提出节点感知动态量化 GNAQ，用参数共享学习每节点量化步长并以图消息传递更新，2-bit 下 Recall@10 平均提升 27.8%。

venues/WWW/2026/social_group_rec/pulse_s.title: Memory Is No Longer a Bottleneck: Memory-Efficient Graph Filtering for Scalable Collaborative Filtering
venues/WWW/2026/social_group_rec/pulse_s.description: [TKDE 2026][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用逐用户 Krylov 子空间替代全量物品相似度图，实现免训练多项式图滤波，内存降 5.74×、推理加速 26× 且精度反超 SOTA。

venues/WWW/2026/social_group_rec/pulse_s.title: Graph Spectral Filtering with Chebyshev Interpolation for Recommendation
venues/WWW/2026/social_group_rec/pulse_s.description: [SIGIR 2025][协同过滤与双塔召回] 用切比雪夫插值逼近非线性图滤波器，直接以原始交互为信号，突破 LightGCN 的截断线性低通瓶颈，Full-Ranking 下全面 SOTA 且推理快 8.1 倍。
